senses.en: to lower someone in rank, dignity, or respect

ex.en: He refused to abase himself by begging for his old job back.
ex.zh: 他不願意低聲下氣地求回原本的工作。

root.note: 使變低 → 貶低

senses.en: the woman who is head of a convent

ex.en: The abbess welcomed the travelers into the quiet convent.
ex.zh: 女修道院院長歡迎旅人進入寧靜的修道院。

parts.m: father 父親（abbot 修道院院長）

root.note: 女性的修道院院長

senses.en: a building where monks or nuns live and worship

ex.en: Tourists crowded into the ancient abbey to admire its stained glass.
ex.zh: 遊客擠進古老的修道院欣賞彩繪玻璃。

root.note: 院長管理的地方 → 修道院

senses.en: the man who is head of a monastery

ex.en: The abbot rang the bell to call the monks to prayer.
ex.zh: 修道院院長敲鐘召集修士們禱告。

root.note: 修士們的「父親」→ 院長

senses.en: to give up a throne or high office
to fail to carry out a duty or responsibility

ex.en: Parents cannot simply abdicate responsibility for their children's education.
ex.zh: 父母不能就這樣放棄教育孩子的責任。

root.note: 宣告離開（王位）→ 退位

senses.en: the part of the body containing the stomach and intestines; the belly

ex.en: The patient complained of a sharp pain in his abdomen.
ex.zh: 病人抱怨腹部劇烈疼痛。

senses.en: relating to the abdomen

ex.en: Sit-ups strengthen the abdominal muscles.
ex.zh: 仰臥起坐可以鍛鍊腹部肌肉。

root.note: 腹部的

senses.en: the act of taking someone away illegally by force

ex.en: Police are investigating the abduction of a local businessman.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查一名當地商人遭綁架的案件。

root.note: 把人帶走 → 綁架

senses.en: in bed

ex.en: The old man lay abed until noon on cold winter days.
ex.zh: 寒冷的冬日，那位老人總是在床上躺到中午。

root.note: 在床上（古語）

senses.en: a departure from what is normal or expected

ex.en: The poor test score was an aberration for a student who usually earned top marks.
ex.zh: 對一個平常總拿高分的學生來說，這次考不好只是個意外。

root.note: 偏離正路 → 異常

senses.en: to encourage or help someone do something wrong

ex.en: The driver was charged with helping to abet the robbery.
ex.zh: 那名司機被控協助搶劫。

root.note: 唆使（狗去咬）→ 教唆

mn: 常見片語 aid and abet（協助犯罪）。

senses.en: a state of temporary disuse or suspension

ex.en: The building project is in abeyance until funding is found.
ex.zh: 在找到資金之前，建案暫時擱置。

parts.m: gape 張口等待（古法文 baer）

root.note: 張著嘴等待 → 懸而未決

mn: 常用片語 in abeyance（擱置中）。

senses.en: a feeling of intense hatred or disgust

ex.en: She expressed her abhorrence of violence in any form.
ex.zh: 她表示痛恨任何形式的暴力。

root.note: 嚇得發抖而退開 → 憎惡

senses.en: causing hatred or disgust; morally unacceptable

ex.en: Most people find cruelty to animals abhorrent.
ex.zh: 大多數人都覺得虐待動物令人憎惡。

root.note: 讓人嚇得發抖退開的 → 可憎的（horror 同源）

senses.en: the act of obeying or following a rule; also, staying

ex.en: Strict abidance by the rules is expected of every member.
ex.zh: 每位成員都必須嚴格遵守規則。

root.note: abide 的名詞

senses.en: (of a bad situation) extremely severe or hopeless
without pride or dignity

ex.en: Many families in the region live in abject poverty.
ex.zh: 這個地區有許多家庭生活極度貧困。

root.note: 被丟到一旁的 → 悲慘的、卑賤的

senses.en: to formally reject or give up a belief or claim
senses.zh: 公開放棄（信仰、主張）；發誓斷絕

ex.en: The prisoner was forced to abjure his political beliefs.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯被迫公開放棄自己的政治信念。

root.note: 發誓遠離 → 公開放棄

senses.en: physically strong and healthy

ex.en: Every able-bodied villager helped rebuild the bridge after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水過後，每個身強體壯的村民都幫忙重建橋梁。

senses.en: the act of washing oneself, often as a religious ritual

ex.en: The pilgrims performed a ritual ablution before entering the temple.
ex.zh: 朝聖者進入神廟前先進行淨身儀式。

root.note: 把髒東西洗掉 → 淨身

senses.en: to give up or deny oneself something

ex.en: Monks abnegate worldly pleasures to focus on spiritual life.
ex.zh: 修士捨棄世俗享樂，專注於靈性生活。

root.note: 否定並推開 → 放棄

senses.en: different from what is usual or expected, often in a worrying way

ex.en: The scan showed an abnormal growth in her lung.
ex.zh: 掃描顯示她的肺部有異常的腫塊。

root.note: 偏離標準的 → 異常的

senses.en: causing disgust or hatred; very bad

ex.en: The prisoners were kept in abominable conditions.
ex.zh: 囚犯被關在惡劣至極的環境裡。

root.note: 被視為凶兆而避開的 → 可憎的

mn: 雪怪的英文就是 the Abominable Snowman（可怕的雪人）。

senses.en: to detest or hate intensely

ex.en: I abominate hypocrisy.
ex.zh: 我痛恨虛偽。

ex.en: She has always abominated cruelty, especially toward children.
ex.zh: 她一向痛恨殘忍的行為，尤其是對孩子的殘忍。

root.note: 視為凶兆而躲開 → 痛恨

senses.en: something that causes disgust or hatred

ex.en: The critic called the new glass tower an abomination.
ex.zh: 那位評論家說這座新的玻璃大樓簡直是醜陋的怪物。

root.note: 可憎之物

senses.en: existing in a land from the earliest times; native

ex.en: The museum displays aboriginal art from across the continent.
ex.zh: 博物館展出來自整片大陸的原住民藝術。

root.note: 從一開始就在的 → 原住民的

senses.en: the earliest known inhabitants of a region

ex.en: The aborigines of the island had lived there for thousands of years.
ex.zh: 這座島的原住民已在那裡生活了數千年。

root.note: 從最初就居住在此的人

senses.en: honest and open; without secrecy

ex.en: The whole deal was completely aboveboard, with every document made public.
ex.zh: 整筆交易完全光明正大，每份文件都有公開。

root.note: 手放在桌面上（打牌不作弊）→ 光明正大

senses.en: to scrape or wear away by rubbing

ex.en: Years of wind and sand had begun to abrade the stone statue.
ex.zh: 多年的風沙已開始磨損那座石像。

root.note: 刮掉 → 磨損

senses.en: a scraped area of skin; the process of wearing away by rubbing

ex.en: She fell off her bike and got a painful abrasion on her knee.
ex.zh: 她從腳踏車上摔下來，膝蓋擦傷了，很痛。

root.note: 刮掉 → 擦傷

senses.en: to shorten a book or text without losing its meaning
to limit or reduce a right

ex.en: The publisher decided to abridge the novel for younger readers.
ex.zh: 出版社決定為年輕讀者出版這本小說的刪節版。

root.note: 使變短 → 刪節（brief 同源）

senses.en: a shortened version of a book or text

ex.en: I read an abridgment of the novel because the original is over a thousand pages.
ex.zh: 我讀的是那本小說的刪節版，因為原著超過一千頁。

root.note: abridge 的名詞

senses.en: to formally cancel or repeal a law or agreement

ex.en: The new government moved quickly to abrogate the unpopular treaty.
ex.zh: 新政府迅速廢除了那項不受歡迎的條約。

root.note: 把提過的法案拿掉 → 廢除

senses.en: sudden and unexpected
brief to the point of rudeness

ex.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm went off.
ex.zh: 火災警報一響，會議就突然結束了。

root.note: 突然斷開 → 突然的

senses.en: a swollen area in body tissue containing pus

ex.en: The dentist drained the abscess under his tooth.
ex.zh: 牙醫把他牙齒下方的膿腫引流出來。

root.note: （體液）離開正常位置聚集 → 膿腫

senses.en: the natural shedding of leaves or fruit from a plant; the act of cutting off

ex.en: Shorter days trigger leaf abscission in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天白晝變短會引發葉子脫落。

root.note: 切離 → 脫落（scissors 剪刀同源）

senses.en: to leave secretly, often to avoid arrest or with stolen money

ex.en: The treasurer tried to abscond with the club's funds.
ex.zh: 財務長企圖捲走社團的經費潛逃。

root.note: 偷偷藏起來離開 → 潛逃

senses.en: the state of being away; the lack of something

ex.en: In the absence of evidence, the judge dismissed the case.
ex.zh: 由於缺乏證據，法官駁回了這個案子。

root.note: 不在場 → 缺席

senses.en: forgetful or not paying attention

ex.en: The absent-minded professor left his umbrella on the bus again.
ex.zh: 那位心不在焉的教授又把雨傘忘在公車上了。

senses.en: formal release from guilt, blame, or punishment

ex.en: He confessed his mistake and asked for absolution.
ex.zh: 他承認錯誤並請求原諒。

root.note: 把罪鬆開 → 赦免

senses.en: to declare someone free from guilt, blame, or responsibility

ex.en: The report did not absolve the company of responsibility for the spill.
ex.zh: 報告並沒有免除公司對漏油事件的責任。

root.note: 鬆開罪責 → 赦免（solve、dissolve 同源）

senses.en: to take in liquid, energy, or information
to hold someone's full attention

ex.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
ex.zh: 植物透過根部吸收水分。

root.note: 吸進去 → 吸收

senses.en: the process of taking something in; complete attention

ex.en: Vitamin D helps the body's absorption of calcium.
ex.zh: 維生素 D 有助於身體吸收鈣質。

root.note: absorb 的名詞

senses.en: to choose not to do something, especially something enjoyable
to choose not to vote

ex.en: Athletes must abstain from alcohol during training season.
ex.zh: 運動員在訓練期間必須戒酒。

root.note: 把自己抓住、遠離 → 戒除

senses.en: moderate or restrained, especially in eating and drinking

ex.en: My grandfather credits his long life to his abstemious habits.
ex.zh: 我祖父認為他長壽是因為飲食很有節制。

parts.m: strong drink 烈酒（拉丁文 temetum）

root.note: 遠離烈酒 → 節制的

mn: 開頭是 abs（腹肌）：想練出腹肌，飲食就得有節制。

senses.en: the practice of not doing or having something, especially alcohol

ex.en: After years of heavy drinking, he chose total abstinence.
ex.zh: 酗酒多年後，他選擇完全戒酒。

root.note: abstain 的名詞

senses.en: difficult to understand; obscure

ex.en: The lecture on quantum theory was too abstruse for most of the audience.
ex.zh: 那場量子理論講座對大多數聽眾來說太深奧了。

root.note: 被推到遠處藏起來 → 深奧難懂

senses.en: wildly unreasonable or ridiculous

ex.en: It is absurd to expect students to read five novels in one week.
ex.zh: 期待學生一週讀完五本小說實在很荒謬。

root.note: 刺耳不和諧 → 荒謬

senses.en: existing in large quantities; more than enough

ex.en: Fish are abundant in the cold waters off the coast.
ex.zh: 沿岸的冷水海域魚類豐富。

root.note: 像波浪一樣滿溢出來 → 豐富的

senses.en: extremely offensive and insulting; involving cruelty

ex.en: The fan was removed from the stadium for shouting abusive language.
ex.zh: 那名球迷因為大聲辱罵而被請出球場。

root.note: 不當使用 → 濫用、虐待的

senses.en: (of land or a building) to be next to or touch

ex.en: Their backyard gardens abut each other, separated only by a low fence.
ex.zh: 兩家的後院緊鄰，中間只隔著一道矮籬笆。

root.note: 盡頭碰在一起 → 毗鄰

senses.en: a very deep hole; a disastrous situation

ex.en: The country was on the edge of an economic abyss.
ex.zh: 那個國家正處於經濟崩潰的邊緣。

root.note: 沒有底的 → 深淵

senses.en: relating to education and scholarship
not of practical relevance; theoretical
senses.zh: 純理論的；無實際意義的

ex.en: Her academic performance improved after she joined the study group.
ex.zh: 她加入讀書會後，學業表現進步了。

parts.m: Akademia 柏拉圖講學的園林

root.note: 源自柏拉圖的學院 → 學術的

senses.en: a member of an academy, especially one for arts or sciences

ex.en: She was elected an academician for her research in physics.
ex.zh: 她因物理學研究而獲選為院士。

root.note: 學院的成員 → 院士

senses.en: a school for special training; a society of scholars or artists

ex.en: He trained at a military academy before joining the army.
ex.zh: 他從軍前在軍事學院受訓。

parts.m: Akademia 柏拉圖講學的園林

root.note: 柏拉圖講學之處 → 學院

senses.en: to agree to a request or demand
to take up an office or position, such as a throne

ex.en: The principal refused to accede to the students' demands.
ex.zh: 校長拒絕答應學生的要求。

root.note: 走向（對方的立場）→ 同意

mn: 別和 exceed（超過）搞混：accede 是「同意」。

senses.en: to increase speed; to make something happen sooner

ex.en: New technology will accelerate the pace of change.
ex.zh: 新科技將加速改變的步調。

root.note: 使更快 → 加速

senses.en: to agree to take something offered; to believe or come to terms with

ex.en: She was thrilled to accept the scholarship offer.
ex.zh: 她很高興地接受了獎學金。

root.note: 拿過來 → 接受

mn: 別和 except（除了…之外）搞混。

senses.en: the means or right to enter or use something
to reach or obtain, especially data

ex.en: Every student has access to the library's online database.
ex.zh: 每個學生都能使用圖書館的線上資料庫。

root.note: 走進去 → 進入、管道

senses.en: able to be reached, entered, or used
easy to understand

ex.en: The author writes about science in a style that is accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 這位作者用人人都讀得懂的方式寫科學。

root.note: 可以走進去的 → 可進入、易懂的

senses.en: the act of reaching a position of power, such as a throne
a new item added to a collection

ex.en: The queen's accession to the throne was celebrated across the country.
ex.zh: 女王登基受到全國慶祝。

root.note: 走上（王位）→ 就任

senses.en: an extra item that adds to something; a fashion item
a person who helps someone commit a crime

ex.en: A scarf can be a stylish accessory in winter.
ex.zh: 圍巾在冬天可以是很有型的配件。

root.note: 跟著走的東西 → 附屬品、從犯

senses.en: enthusiastic public praise
to praise enthusiastically and publicly

ex.en: Her first novel won wide acclaim from critics.
ex.zh: 她的第一本小說廣受評論家讚揚。

root.note: 對著人大喊（喝采）→ 讚揚

senses.en: to provide lodging or space for
to adapt to or fit in with someone's needs

ex.en: The hotel can accommodate up to three hundred guests.
ex.zh: 這家飯店最多可以容納三百位客人。

root.note: 使尺寸剛好合適 → 容納、配合

mn: 拼字注意：兩個 c、兩個 m。

senses.en: music played to support a singer or instrument
something that goes along with something else

ex.en: She sang with a simple piano accompaniment.
ex.zh: 她在簡單的鋼琴伴奏下演唱。

root.note: 陪伴 → 伴奏、伴隨物

senses.en: a person who plays music to support a singer or soloist

ex.en: The choir's accompanist has played the piano for them for twenty years.
ex.zh: 合唱團的伴奏者已經為他們彈了二十年的鋼琴。

root.note: 伴奏的人

senses.en: to go somewhere with someone
to happen or exist together with

ex.en: A parent must accompany each child on the field trip.
ex.zh: 校外教學時，每個孩子都要有一位家長陪同。

ex.en: Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult.
ex.zh: 十二歲以下的兒童必須由大人陪同。

root.note: 成為同伴 → 陪同

senses.en: a person who helps another commit a crime

ex.en: The thief's accomplice waited in the getaway car.
ex.zh: 小偷的共犯在逃跑用的車裡等著。

root.note: 被摺在一起、牽連在內的人 → 共犯

senses.en: to succeed in doing or completing something

ex.en: We can accomplish a lot more if we work together.
ex.zh: 如果我們合作，能完成的事會多很多。

root.note: 填滿 → 完成（complete 同源）

senses.en: a musical instrument with bellows and keys, played by squeezing

ex.en: An old man played the accordion on the street corner.
ex.zh: 一位老人在街角拉手風琴。

root.note: 發出和諧聲音的樂器

senses.en: to approach and speak to someone boldly or aggressively

ex.en: Reporters rushed to accost the senator as he left the building.
ex.zh: 參議員一走出大樓，記者就衝上前攔住他。

root.note: 走到身旁 → 上前搭話

senses.en: a report or description of an event
an arrangement to keep money with a bank
to give an explanation (account for)

ex.en: Her account of the accident differed from the driver's.
ex.zh: 她對事故的描述跟司機的說法不同。

root.note: 計算清楚 → 帳目、交代

senses.en: to dress or equip, especially for military service

ex.en: The knights would accouter themselves in armor before the tournament.
ex.zh: 騎士們在比武大會前會穿上盔甲。

parts.m: sew, dress 縫製、穿著（古法文）

root.note: 給人穿戴上 → 裝備

senses.en: to officially recognize as meeting a standard
to give credit to someone for something

ex.en: An independent board will accredit the new medical school.
ex.zh: 將由一個獨立委員會認證這所新醫學院。

root.note: 給予信任 → 認可

senses.en: to gather or increase gradually over time

ex.en: Dust will accumulate quickly if you don't clean the shelves.
ex.zh: 如果不清理架子，灰塵很快就會堆積。

root.note: 堆起來 → 累積

senses.en: the quality of being correct and precise

ex.en: Please check the accuracy of your calculations.
ex.zh: 請檢查你計算的準確度。

root.note: 小心仔細 → 準確

senses.en: correct in all details; exact

ex.en: The witness gave an accurate description of the suspect.
ex.zh: 目擊者準確地描述了嫌犯的樣貌。

root.note: 小心做成的 → 準確的

senses.en: under a curse; hateful or very annoying

ex.en: The sailors believed the ship was accursed after so many storms.
ex.zh: 遇上那麼多暴風雨後，水手們相信這艘船被詛咒了。

root.note: 被詛咒的

senses.en: a claim that someone has done something wrong

ex.en: He strongly denied the accusation of cheating.
ex.zh: 他強烈否認作弊的指控。

root.note: 對人提起訴訟 → 指控

senses.en: suggesting that someone has done something wrong

ex.en: She gave him an accusatory look when the vase was found broken.
ex.zh: 發現花瓶破了的時候，她用責怪的眼神看著他。

root.note: 帶有指控意味的

senses.en: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal

ex.en: It is unfair to accuse someone without any proof.
ex.zh: 沒有任何證據就指控別人是不公平的。

root.note: 對人提出訴訟 → 指控

senses.en: to make someone used to something

ex.en: It took weeks to accustom ourselves to the cold climate.
ex.zh: 我們花了好幾週才習慣寒冷的氣候。

root.note: 使成為習慣

senses.en: sharpness or bitterness of taste or manner

ex.en: The critic was known for the acerbity of his reviews.
ex.zh: 那位評論家以尖刻的評論聞名。

root.note: 苦澀 → 尖刻

senses.en: a salt or ester of acetic acid; a type of plastic film

ex.en: The teacher wrote notes on a sheet of clear acetate for the projector.
ex.zh: 老師在透明投影片上寫筆記給投影機使用。

root.note: 醋酸形成的鹽

senses.en: relating to vinegar or acetic acid

ex.en: Vinegar gets its sour taste from acetic acid.
ex.zh: 醋的酸味來自醋酸。

root.note: 醋的

senses.en: a continuous dull pain
to suffer continuous dull pain; to long for

ex.en: After the long hike, I had an ache in my knees.
ex.zh: 長途健行後，我的膝蓋隱隱作痛。

senses.en: like Achilles; invulnerable or heroic, yet with one weak spot
senses.zh: 像阿基里斯般的；英勇無敵的

ex.en: The general showed Achillean courage in battle.
ex.zh: 將軍在戰場上展現阿基里斯般的勇氣。

root.note: 希臘神話英雄，全身刀槍不入，唯獨腳跟是弱點（Achilles' heel）

senses.en: without color; (of a lens) not splitting light into colors

ex.en: The artist painted the room in achromatic shades of black, white, and gray.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家把房間漆成黑、白、灰等無彩色的色調。

root.note: 沒有顏色的

senses.en: a chemical substance with a sour taste that can burn or dissolve things
sour; (of remarks) sharp and hurtful

ex.en: Lemon juice contains citric acid.
ex.zh: 檸檬汁含有檸檬酸。

root.note: 酸的

senses.en: to make or become acidic

ex.en: Rising carbon dioxide levels acidify the oceans.
ex.zh: 二氧化碳濃度上升使海洋酸化。

ex.en: Pollution can acidify lakes and kill the fish in them.
ex.zh: 污染會使湖泊酸化，讓湖裡的魚死亡。

root.note: 使變酸

senses.en: to admit that something is true
to show that you have noticed or received something

ex.en: The company refused to acknowledge any wrongdoing.
ex.zh: 公司拒絕承認有任何不當行為。

root.note: 表示知道 → 承認

senses.en: acceptance of the truth of something; an expression of thanks

ex.en: The author listed her teachers in the acknowledgment at the front of the book.
ex.zh: 作者在書前的致謝辭裡列出了她的老師們。

root.note: acknowledge 的名詞

senses.en: the highest point of achievement or excellence

ex.en: Winning the gold medal was the acme of her career.
ex.zh: 贏得金牌是她職業生涯的巔峰。

parts.m: point, peak 尖端（希臘文 akmē）

root.note: 尖端 → 巔峰

senses.en: relating to sound or hearing
(of an instrument) not electrically amplified

ex.en: He played an acoustic guitar at the small café.
ex.zh: 他在那間小咖啡館彈木吉他。

root.note: 聽覺的

senses.en: to make someone aware of or familiar with something

ex.en: New employees need time to acquaint themselves with the software.
ex.zh: 新進員工需要時間熟悉這套軟體。

root.note: 使知道 → 使熟悉

senses.en: to accept or agree to something reluctantly but without protest

ex.en: The manager refused at first but eventually had to acquiesce to the union's demands.
ex.zh: 經理起初拒絕，但最後不得不默許工會的要求。

root.note: 安靜下來、不再反對 → 默許

mn: 中間的 quie 就是 quiet：安安靜靜地接受，就是默許。

senses.en: reluctant acceptance without protest

ex.en: His silence was taken as acquiescence to the plan.
ex.zh: 他的沉默被視為默許這個計畫。

root.note: acquiesce 的名詞

senses.en: to get or obtain something, often through effort

ex.en: It takes years to acquire fluency in a foreign language.
ex.zh: 要花好幾年才能流利地說一種外語。

root.note: 尋求而得到 → 獲得（inquire、require 同源）

senses.en: something obtained; the act of obtaining

ex.en: The museum's latest acquisition is a rare Chinese scroll.
ex.zh: 博物館最新的收藏是一幅罕見的中國卷軸。

root.note: acquire 的名詞

senses.en: to declare someone not guilty of a crime
to behave or perform in a certain way (acquit oneself)

ex.en: The jury voted to acquit the defendant of all charges.
ex.zh: 陪審團投票宣判被告所有罪名均不成立。

root.note: 使（罪名）免除 → 宣告無罪

senses.en: a judgment that a person is not guilty

ex.en: The acquittal surprised everyone who had followed the trial.
ex.zh: 無罪判決讓所有關注這場審判的人都很驚訝。

root.note: acquit 的名詞

senses.en: release from a debt; a written receipt for payment

ex.en: The merchant gave him a signed acquittance once the debt was paid.
ex.zh: 債務還清後，商人給了他一張簽名的收據。

root.note: 免除債務的證明

senses.en: an area of land measured in acres

ex.en: The farm's total acreage has doubled in ten years.
ex.zh: 這座農場的總面積十年來增加了一倍。

root.note: 英畝的總量

senses.en: having a bitter, unpleasantly sharp smell or taste
angry and bitter

ex.en: Acrid smoke from the burning tires filled the air.
ex.zh: 燃燒輪胎冒出的刺鼻濃煙瀰漫空中。

root.note: 尖銳刺激的 → 刺鼻的（acrimony 同源）

senses.en: angry and bitter (of speech or a discussion)

ex.en: The two candidates held an acrimonious debate on television.
ex.zh: 兩位候選人在電視上進行了一場火藥味十足的辯論。

root.note: acrimony 的形容詞

senses.en: bitterness or ill feeling, especially in speech or manner

ex.en: The divorce was settled without acrimony, and the couple remained friends.
ex.zh: 這場離婚沒有鬧得很難看，兩人仍然是朋友。

root.note: 又尖又苦的態度 → 尖刻

senses.en: giving someone a legal reason to sue
able to be acted on; practical

ex.en: The consultant gave us actionable advice we could use right away.
ex.zh: 顧問給了我們馬上就能執行的建議。

root.note: 可以採取行動（或訴訟）的

senses.en: actual existence; reality

ex.en: In actuality, the project cost twice as much as planned.
ex.zh: 實際上，這個計畫花的錢是預算的兩倍。

root.note: 實際存在的狀態

senses.en: a person who calculates insurance risks and premiums

ex.en: An actuary uses statistics to estimate how long people will live.
ex.zh: 精算師用統計數據估算人們的壽命。

root.note: 原指記錄員 → 精算師

senses.en: to cause a machine to operate
to motivate someone to act

ex.en: A small lever is used to actuate the brakes.
ex.zh: 用一根小槓桿來啟動煞車。

root.note: 使動起來 → 啟動、驅使

senses.en: the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions

ex.en: Her business acumen turned a small bakery into a national chain.
ex.zh: 她的商業頭腦把一家小麵包店發展成全國連鎖店。

root.note: 頭腦尖銳 → 敏銳（acute 同源）

senses.en: (of a bad situation) severe or serious
having sharp perception
(of an angle) less than 90 degrees

ex.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺非常敏銳。

root.note: 尖銳的 → 嚴重的、敏銳的

senses.en: refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind

ex.en: She was adamant that she had locked the door before leaving.
ex.zh: 她堅稱出門前有鎖門。

parts.m: to tame 馴服（希臘文 daman）

root.note: 無法被馴服 → 原指極堅硬的石頭，引申為堅定不移

senses.en: something added at the end of a book or document

ex.en: An addendum to the contract explains the new payment schedule.
ex.zh: 合約的附錄說明了新的付款時程。

root.note: 應被加上的東西 → 附錄

senses.en: to confuse; to make unable to think clearly

ex.en: Too much late-night studying can addle your brain.
ex.zh: 熬夜讀太多書會讓腦袋變得糊里糊塗。

parts.m: rotten 腐爛的（古英文 adela）

root.note: 原指蛋壞掉 → 腦袋糊塗

senses.en: to offer as evidence or proof

ex.en: The lawyer was unable to adduce any evidence of fraud.
ex.zh: 律師無法提出任何詐欺的證據。

root.note: 把（證據）帶上來 → 舉證

senses.en: to stick firmly to something
to follow a rule or belief closely

ex.en: All players must adhere to the rules of the tournament.
ex.zh: 所有選手都必須遵守比賽規則。

root.note: 黏在…上 → 黏附、遵守

senses.en: the act of following a rule or belief closely

ex.en: Strict adherence to safety rules prevented any injuries.
ex.zh: 嚴格遵守安全規定，避免了任何傷亡。

root.note: adhere 的名詞

senses.en: a supporter of a person, party, or belief

ex.en: Each adherent of the movement pledged to live simply.
ex.zh: 這個運動的每位擁護者都承諾過簡樸的生活。

root.note: 黏著（某信念）的人 → 擁護者

senses.en: the action or quality of sticking to something

ex.en: This tape has strong adhesion even on wet surfaces.
ex.zh: 這種膠帶即使在潮濕的表面上附著力也很強。

root.note: 黏著

senses.en: the state of being next to something

ex.en: The hotel's adjacency to the beach makes it very popular.
ex.zh: 這家飯店緊鄰海灘，所以非常受歡迎。

root.note: 躺在旁邊 → 鄰近

senses.en: next to or very near something

ex.en: The school is adjacent to a large public park.
ex.zh: 學校緊鄰著一座大型公園。

root.note: 躺在旁邊的 → 鄰近的

senses.en: to declare or decide officially

ex.en: The panel will adjudge the winner of the essay contest next week.
ex.zh: 評審團將在下週裁定作文比賽的優勝者。

root.note: 做出判斷 → 裁定

senses.en: something added to another thing but not essential to it
connected in a supporting role

ex.en: She works as an adjunct professor at two universities.
ex.zh: 她在兩所大學擔任兼任教授。

root.note: 連接上去的 → 附屬

senses.en: a solemn and urgent request

ex.en: Despite his mother's adjuration, he went out into the storm.
ex.zh: 不顧母親的苦苦懇求，他還是冒著暴風雨出門了。

root.note: 要人發誓 → 懇求

senses.en: a military officer who assists a commanding officer

ex.en: The colonel's adjutant delivered the orders to each unit.
ex.zh: 上校的副官把命令傳達給各個部隊。

root.note: 幫忙的人 → 副官

senses.en: a person who manages an organization or business

ex.en: A hospital administrator oversees budgets and staffing.
ex.zh: 醫院的行政主管負責預算與人力安排。

root.note: 負責服務與管理的人

senses.en: acceptable or allowed, especially as evidence in court
senses.zh: 可接受的；（證據）可採納的

ex.en: The judge ruled that the recording was admissible in court.
ex.zh: 法官裁定這段錄音可以作為法庭證據。

root.note: 可以放進來的 → 可接受的

senses.en: the right or permission to enter a place

ex.en: The sign on the door read: No admittance.
ex.zh: 門上的告示寫著：禁止進入。

root.note: 放行進入

senses.en: to warn or reprimand someone firmly

ex.en: The librarian had to admonish the students for talking too loudly.
ex.zh: 圖書館員不得不告誡那些學生說話太大聲。

root.note: 對人提出警告 → 告誡

senses.en: a firm warning or reprimand

ex.en: The coach's admonition to stay focused was ignored.
ex.zh: 教練要大家保持專注的告誡被當成耳邊風。

root.note: admonish 的名詞

senses.en: trouble or fuss about something

ex.en: Without further ado, let's begin the ceremony.
ex.zh: 廢話不多說，典禮開始吧。

root.note: 要做的事 → 忙亂

mn: 莎士比亞劇名 Much Ado About Nothing（無事生非）。

senses.en: deep love and respect; worship

ex.en: The puppy looked up at its owner with pure adoration.
ex.zh: 小狗用充滿崇拜的眼神抬頭望著主人。

root.note: 向…祈禱 → 崇拜

senses.en: clever or skillful in using the hands or mind

ex.en: The adroit negotiator found a deal that satisfied both sides.
ex.zh: 那位機敏的談判者找到了讓雙方都滿意的協議。

root.note: 像右手一樣靈活 → 靈巧的

senses.en: a substance added to make something impure or of lower quality

ex.en: Chalk was once used as an adulterant in cheap flour.
ex.zh: 粉筆灰曾被摻進廉價麵粉裡。

root.note: 使（東西）變質的添加物

senses.en: to make food or drink impure by adding something inferior

ex.en: Some dishonest sellers adulterate honey with cheap syrup.
ex.zh: 有些不肖商人在蜂蜜裡摻入便宜的糖漿。

root.note: 改變（成分）→ 摻假

senses.en: to give a partial or faint outline of; to foreshadow

ex.en: The opening scene seems to adumbrate the tragedy to come.
ex.zh: 開場那一幕似乎預示著即將到來的悲劇。

root.note: 投下影子 → 概略描繪、預示（umbrella 同源）

senses.en: the arrival of an important person, thing, or event

ex.en: The advent of the internet changed how we communicate.
ex.zh: 網路的出現改變了我們溝通的方式。

root.note: 來到 → 出現（adventure 同源）

senses.en: harmful or unfavorable

ex.en: The medicine has few adverse side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥幾乎沒有不良副作用。

root.note: 轉過來對著你 → 不利的

mn: adverse 形容「事情」不利；averse 形容「人」反感（averse to…）。

senses.en: difficulties or misfortune

ex.en: She showed great courage in the face of adversity.
ex.zh: 她在逆境中展現了莫大的勇氣。

root.note: 情勢轉而對你不利 → 逆境

senses.en: to refer to or mention (advert to)
(British) an advertisement

ex.en: In his speech, the mayor did not advert to the scandal.
ex.zh: 市長在演講中沒有提到那樁醜聞。

root.note: 把注意力轉向 → 提及

senses.en: a person or company that pays to promote products

ex.en: The magazine lost its biggest advertiser last year.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌去年失去了最大的廣告主。

root.note: 讓人轉頭注意的人 → 廣告商

senses.en: having the power only to give advice
an official warning

ex.en: She sits on the advisory board of a local charity.
ex.zh: 她是一個地方慈善機構的顧問委員。

root.note: 幫忙看 → 諮詢的

senses.en: public support for a cause or policy

ex.en: Her advocacy for clean water brought change to many villages.
ex.zh: 她對乾淨飲水的倡導為許多村莊帶來改變。

root.note: 為…發聲 → 倡導

senses.en: a person who publicly supports a cause
senses.zh: 擁護者；提倡者；辯護律師

senses.en: [ˋædvəˏket] to publicly support or recommend

ex.en: She is a strong advocate of equal education for all children.
ex.zh: 她大力提倡所有孩子享有平等的教育。

root.note: 被叫來為你發聲的人 → 辯護者、擁護者

senses.en: existing or happening in the air; from above
(British) an antenna

ex.en: The aerial photograph showed how far the flood had spread.
ex.zh: 空拍照片顯示出洪水蔓延的範圍。

root.note: 空中的

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft, especially a balloon or airship
senses.zh: 飛行員；（熱氣球、飛艇的）駕駛員

ex.en: The daring aeronaut crossed the channel in a hot-air balloon.
ex.zh: 那位大膽的飛行員乘熱氣球飛越了海峽。

root.note: 空中的水手 → 飛行員（astronaut 同構）

senses.en: the science or practice of flight

ex.en: He studied aeronautics before becoming a pilot.
ex.zh: 他在成為飛行員之前學的是航空學。

root.note: 在空中航行的學問

senses.en: an aircraft that is lighter than air, such as a balloon

ex.en: A tethered aerostat hovered above the stadium with cameras.
ex.zh: 一架繫留氣球載著攝影機停在體育場上空。

root.note: 靜止在空中的東西

senses.en: the science of gases at rest and of balloons and airships that float in air

ex.en: Early balloon makers had to understand aerostatics to keep their craft in the air.
ex.zh: 早期製作熱氣球的人必須懂氣體靜力學，才能讓氣球留在空中。

root.note: 研究空氣靜止狀態的學問

senses.en: friendly and easy to talk to

ex.en: The affable host made every guest feel welcome.
ex.zh: 和藹可親的主人讓每位客人都覺得賓至如歸。

root.note: 可以跟他說話的 → 和藹可親

senses.en: to have an influence on; to make a difference to
to pretend to have or feel

ex.en: Even a small change in temperature can affect how the plants grow.
ex.zh: 即使只是溫度的小變化，也可能影響植物的生長。

root.note: 對某物做了些什麼 → 影響

mn: affect 是動詞（Action 開頭 A）；effect 是結果（End 開頭 E）。

senses.en: behavior or speech that is unnatural and meant to impress

ex.en: His British accent was an affectation he picked up after one summer in London.
ex.zh: 他的英國腔是在倫敦待了一個夏天後裝出來的。

root.note: 假裝 → 做作

senses.en: to officially connect with a larger organization
[əˋfɪlɪɪt] an organization connected to a larger one

ex.en: The local station is an affiliate of a national network.
ex.zh: 這家地方電台是某個全國性電視網的附屬台。

root.note: 收為兒子 → 使隸屬

senses.en: agreeing or saying yes

ex.en: She gave an affirmative nod when asked if she was ready.
ex.zh: 被問到是否準備好時，她肯定地點了點頭。

root.note: 使堅定 → 肯定的

senses.en: to attach or fasten something
[ˋæfɪks] a prefix or suffix

ex.en: Please affix a stamp to the envelope before mailing it.
ex.zh: 寄出前請在信封上貼一張郵票。

root.note: 固定上去 → 貼上

senses.en: wealth; having a great deal of money

ex.en: The town's affluence is obvious from its large houses.
ex.zh: 從那些大房子就看得出這個小鎮很富裕。

root.note: （財富）流過來 → 富裕

senses.en: an action or remark that causes offense
to offend or insult

ex.en: The rude comment was an affront to everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 那句無禮的話冒犯了房間裡的每一個人。

root.note: 當面打臉 → 冒犯

senses.en: on fire; burning
filled with strong emotion

ex.en: The whole forest seemed afire with autumn colors.
ex.zh: 整片森林在秋色中彷彿燃燒了起來。

root.note: 在火中的

senses.en: in preparation or happening, often secretly
senses.zh: 進行中的；（祕密）醞釀中的

senses.en: on foot

ex.en: The detective sensed that something strange was afoot.
ex.zh: 偵探察覺到有什麼奇怪的事正在醞釀。

root.note: 已經起步 → 進行中

senses.en: mentioned earlier

ex.en: The aforesaid property will be sold at auction.
ex.zh: 上述房產將進行拍賣。

root.note: 之前說過的

senses.en: in a new or different way; again

ex.en: After the fire, the family had to start their lives afresh.
ex.zh: 火災過後，這家人不得不重新開始生活。

root.note: 重新

senses.en: something added or thought of later, not part of the original plan

ex.en: The garage was clearly an afterthought, built years after the house.
ex.zh: 車庫顯然是事後才加的，比房子晚好幾年才蓋。

root.note: 之後才有的想法

senses.en: to collect or form into a mass
[əˋglɑmərɪt] a mass of things collected together

ex.en: Small particles agglomerate into larger clumps over time.
ex.zh: 小顆粒會隨著時間聚集成較大的團塊。

root.note: 聚成一個球 → 聚集成團

senses.en: to increase the power, wealth, or status of

ex.en: The dictator used the war to aggrandize himself.
ex.zh: 那個獨裁者利用戰爭擴張自己的權勢。

root.note: 使變大 → 擴大權勢

senses.en: to make a problem or injury worse
(informal) to annoy

ex.en: Running on a sprained ankle will only aggravate the injury.
ex.zh: 扭傷了腳踝還去跑步，只會讓傷勢更嚴重。

root.note: 使更沉重 → 加重（gravity 同源）

senses.en: annoyance or trouble; the act of making something worse

ex.en: Fixing the old car caused him more aggravation than it was worth.
ex.zh: 修那輛舊車讓他惱火，根本不值得。

root.note: aggravate 的名詞

senses.en: a whole formed by combining several elements
formed by combining many parts; total
[ˋægrɪˏget] to combine into a whole

ex.en: The team won on aggregate after two matches.
ex.zh: 兩場比賽加總後，這支隊伍獲勝。

root.note: 聚成一群 → 總計

senses.en: to attack first; to start a quarrel

ex.en: The smaller nation had no reason to aggress against its powerful neighbor.
ex.zh: 這個小國沒有理由去挑釁強大的鄰國。

root.note: 朝人走過去 → 攻擊

senses.en: hostile or violent behavior toward another

ex.en: The invasion was an act of aggression condemned by many nations.
ex.zh: 那次入侵是受到許多國家譴責的侵略行為。

root.note: 主動朝人走去 → 攻擊

senses.en: to cause distress or a sense of unfair treatment

ex.en: The unfair decision will aggrieve many loyal workers.
ex.zh: 這個不公平的決定會讓許多忠誠的員工感到委屈。

root.note: 使心情沉重 → 使苦惱

senses.en: filled with horror or shock

ex.en: We were aghast at the damage the storm had caused.
ex.zh: 看到暴風雨造成的破壞，我們都嚇呆了。

root.note: 像見鬼一樣 → 驚駭

senses.en: able to move quickly and easily; quick-thinking

ex.en: The agile goalkeeper blocked every shot.
ex.zh: 那位身手敏捷的守門員擋下了每一次射門。

root.note: 能夠快速動作的 → 敏捷的

senses.en: to make someone anxious or nervous
to campaign publicly for a change
to stir or shake a liquid

ex.en: Loud noises tend to agitate the animals at the shelter.
ex.zh: 巨大的噪音往往會讓收容所的動物不安。

root.note: 不停推動 → 攪動、使不安

senses.en: relating to farming or farmland

ex.en: Before industrialization, most of the country was agrarian.
ex.zh: 工業化之前，這個國家大部分都是農業社會。

root.note: 田地的 → 農業的（agriculture 同源）

senses.en: a military officer who acts as a personal assistant to a senior officer

ex.en: The general's aide-de-camp handled all his correspondence.
ex.zh: 將軍的侍從官處理他所有的信件。

parts.m: of the field 戰場的（法文）

root.note: 戰場上的助手

senses.en: an illness, usually a minor one

ex.en: A cold is a common ailment in winter.
ex.zh: 感冒是冬天常見的小毛病。

root.note: 讓人不舒服的東西

senses.en: spacious and well ventilated
light and casual; not serious

ex.en: The new apartment is bright and airy, with large windows.
ex.zh: 新公寓有大窗戶，明亮又通風。

root.note: 充滿空氣的

senses.en: similar in character; related

ex.en: Learning a language is akin to building a house, brick by brick.
ex.zh: 學語言就像一磚一瓦地蓋房子。

root.note: 同一家族的 → 類似的

senses.en: a smooth white stone used for carving
smooth and white like alabaster

ex.en: The statue was carved from a single block of alabaster.
ex.zh: 這座雕像是用一整塊雪花石膏雕成的。

senses.en: brisk and cheerful readiness

ex.en: She accepted the invitation with alacrity, eager to see her old friends.
ex.zh: 她爽快地接受邀請，迫不及待想見老朋友。

parts.m: lively 活潑的（拉丁文 alacer）

root.note: 活潑輕快的狀態 → 爽快

mn: 把它想成「a-lack-rity」的反面：一點都不 lack（缺乏）熱情。

senses.en: although; even though

ex.en: He accepted the job, albeit with some hesitation.
ex.zh: 他接下了這份工作，雖然有些猶豫。

root.note: all be it（即使全都是如此）→ 雖然

senses.en: a person or animal born without normal skin, hair, or eye color

ex.en: The zoo's albino tiger has white fur and pale blue eyes.
ex.zh: 動物園的白化老虎有白色的毛和淡藍色的眼睛。

root.note: 白色的 → 白化症（album 同源）

senses.en: a book for photos or stamps; a collection of recordings

ex.en: The band released its first album last spring.
ex.zh: 這個樂團去年春天發行了第一張專輯。

root.note: 原指白色的空白板 → 相簿

senses.en: a medieval science that tried to turn metals into gold
a seemingly magical process of transformation

ex.en: Medieval alchemy tried to turn lead into gold.
ex.zh: 中世紀的煉金術試圖把鉛變成金子。

root.note: 源自阿拉伯文 → 煉金術（chemistry 同源）

senses.en: a colorless liquid in drinks like beer and wine; drinks containing it

ex.en: Drivers should never drink alcohol before getting behind the wheel.
ex.zh: 開車前絕對不要喝酒。

root.note: 源自阿拉伯文，原指精煉的粉末 → 精華 → 酒精

senses.en: addiction to alcoholic drinks

ex.en: He sought treatment for alcoholism and has been sober for five years.
ex.zh: 他接受酗酒治療，已經戒酒五年了。

root.note: 酒精成癮

senses.en: a small recessed space set back in a wall

ex.en: She placed a reading chair in the alcove by the window.
ex.zh: 她在窗邊的凹室放了一張閱讀椅。

root.note: 源自阿拉伯文 al-qubba（拱室）

senses.en: a tree of the birch family that grows in wet ground

ex.en: An alder leaned over the stream behind the cottage.
ex.zh: 一棵榿木斜斜地伸到小屋後面的溪流上方。

senses.en: an elected member of a city council

ex.en: The alderman promised to fix the potholes in his ward.
ex.zh: 那位市議員承諾修補他選區裡的坑洞。

root.note: 年長者 → 地方議員

senses.en: the position or term of office of an alderman

ex.en: He held the aldermanship of the ward for twelve years.
ex.zh: 他在那個選區擔任市議員長達十二年。

root.note: 市議員的職位

senses.en: a false or assumed name
also known as

ex.en: The spy traveled under an alias to avoid detection.
ex.zh: 那名間諜用化名出行，以免被發現。

parts.m: otherwise 在別的時候（拉丁文）

root.note: 另一個（名字）

senses.en: foreign; unfamiliar or strange
senses.zh: 外國的；陌生的；格格不入的

senses.en: a foreigner; a creature from another world

ex.en: The idea of working from home was alien to my grandfather.
ex.zh: 在家工作這個概念對我祖父來說很陌生。

root.note: 屬於別處的 → 外來的

senses.en: able to be transferred to another owner

ex.en: Land was considered alienable property that could be bought and sold.
ex.zh: 土地被視為可以買賣轉讓的財產。

root.note: 可轉給別人的

mn: 反義字 inalienable 更常見：美國獨立宣言提到的「不可剝奪的權利」。

senses.en: to make someone feel isolated or unfriendly

ex.en: His rude remarks will only alienate his supporters.
ex.zh: 他粗魯的言論只會讓支持者離他而去。

root.note: 使成為外人 → 使疏遠

senses.en: the feeling of being isolated or estranged

ex.en: Many new immigrants experience a sense of alienation.
ex.zh: 許多新移民會有疏離感。

root.note: alienate 的名詞

senses.en: food; nourishment

ex.en: Books were the aliment of her lively mind.
ex.zh: 書本是滋養她活躍心靈的養分。

root.note: 滋養的東西（alimony 同源）

senses.en: a chemical substance that neutralizes acids

ex.en: Baking soda is a mild alkali that neutralizes stomach acid.
ex.zh: 小蘇打是一種溫和的鹼，可以中和胃酸。

root.note: 源自阿拉伯文，指植物燒成的灰

senses.en: to reduce or relieve fear, worry, or pain

ex.en: The doctor tried to allay the patient's fears about surgery.
ex.zh: 醫生試著消除病人對手術的恐懼。

root.note: 放下 → 平息

senses.en: to claim something is true without proof

ex.en: Several witnesses allege that the driver ran a red light.
ex.zh: 幾名目擊者聲稱那名司機闖了紅燈。

root.note: 在法庭上陳述 → 宣稱

senses.en: a story in which characters and events represent deeper moral or political meanings

ex.en: Orwell's Animal Farm is an allegory of the Russian Revolution.
ex.zh: 歐威爾的《動物農莊》是在影射俄國革命的寓言。

root.note: 說的是其他事 → 寓言

senses.en: to make suffering, a problem, or difficulty less severe

ex.en: The nurse gave him medicine to alleviate the pain.
ex.zh: 護士給他藥來減輕疼痛。

root.note: 使變輕 → 減輕

senses.en: a narrow passage between or behind buildings

ex.en: The cat disappeared down a dark alley.
ex.zh: 那隻貓消失在一條漆黑的小巷裡。

root.note: 走路的通道

senses.en: a union or agreement between groups for mutual benefit

ex.en: The two companies formed an alliance to develop electric cars.
ex.zh: 兩家公司結盟開發電動車。

root.note: 綁在一起 → 聯盟

senses.en: to give or share out a portion of something

ex.en: The teacher will allot ten minutes to each presentation.
ex.zh: 老師會給每份報告分配十分鐘。

root.note: 分出一份 → 分配

senses.en: a share or amount given to someone

ex.en: Each family received a small allotment of land to farm.
ex.zh: 每戶人家都分到一小塊地耕種。

root.note: allot 的名詞

senses.en: to mention something indirectly

ex.en: She did not mention his name, but everyone knew who she meant to allude to.
ex.zh: 她沒有說出他的名字，但大家都知道她在暗指誰。

root.note: 用玩笑的方式提到 → 暗指

senses.en: an indirect reference to something

ex.en: The poem contains an allusion to a Greek myth.
ex.zh: 這首詩引用了一個希臘神話的典故。

root.note: allude 的名詞

mn: 別和 illusion（錯覺）搞混。

senses.en: land gradually added to a shore by flowing water; a flood

ex.en: The alluvion left by the river made the valley very fertile.
ex.zh: 河流留下的沖積土讓山谷非常肥沃。

root.note: 水沖刷過來堆積的土

senses.en: a person or country that supports another
[əˋlaɪ] to join with others for a common purpose

ex.en: She found an unexpected ally in the school principal.
ex.zh: 她意外地發現校長站在她這一邊。

root.note: 綁在一起的人 → 盟友

senses.en: a yearly book with a calendar and information such as weather and tides

ex.en: Farmers once relied on an almanac to decide when to plant.
ex.zh: 農夫從前靠曆書決定何時播種。

senses.en: not friendly or involved; distant

ex.en: The new student seemed aloof, but she was actually just shy.
ex.zh: 那個新同學看起來很冷淡，其實她只是害羞。

root.note: 船頭保持在上風處、遠離岸邊 → 保持距離

senses.en: a raised table or structure used in religious ceremonies

ex.en: The couple exchanged vows in front of the altar as the guests watched.
ex.zh: 這對新人在祭壇前交換誓言，賓客們在一旁觀禮。

root.note: 高起的台子 → 祭壇

mn: altar（祭壇）和 alter（改變）同音，a 結尾的是祭壇。

senses.en: to change or cause to change
to make changes to clothing so it fits better

ex.en: The new evidence did not alter the jury's final decision.
ex.zh: 新證據並沒有改變陪審團的最終判決。

root.note: 變成另一個樣子 → 改變

senses.en: a change or modification

ex.en: The tailor made a small alteration so the jacket would fit perfectly.
ex.zh: 裁縫稍微修改了一下，讓外套完全合身。

root.note: 變成另一個樣子的動作 → 修改

senses.en: to argue or quarrel noisily

ex.en: The two neighbors began to altercate loudly over the broken fence.
ex.zh: 兩個鄰居為了壞掉的籬笆大聲爭吵起來。

root.note: 你一言、另一個人一語 → 爭吵

mn: 名詞 altercation（爭吵）較常見。

senses.en: to occur or do things in turn, one after the other
[ˋɔltɚnɪt] every other; occurring by turns
[ˋɔltɚnɪt] a substitute

ex.en: The farmers alternate crops each year to keep the soil healthy.
ex.zh: 農夫每年輪作不同作物，讓土壤保持健康。

root.note: 一個接著另一個 → 輪流

senses.en: one of two or more available possibilities
available as another possibility; different from the usual

ex.en: Solar power is a cleaner alternative to burning coal.
ex.zh: 太陽能是比燃煤更乾淨的替代方案。

root.note: 另一個可選的 → 替代方案

senses.en: the height of something above sea level or the ground

ex.en: Climbers often feel dizzy at such a high altitude.
ex.zh: 登山者在這麼高的海拔常會頭暈。

root.note: 高的程度 → 高度

senses.en: the lowest female singing voice, or a singer with this voice

ex.en: She sings alto in the school choir.
ex.zh: 她在學校合唱團唱女低音。

root.note: 原指比男聲部「高」的聲部 → 女低音

senses.en: unselfish concern for the well-being of others

ex.en: Donating a kidney to a stranger is an act of pure altruism.
ex.zh: 把腎臟捐給陌生人是純粹無私的行為。

root.note: 為別人著想的主義 → 利他主義

senses.en: a person who unselfishly cares about the welfare of others

ex.en: A true altruist helps others without expecting anything in return.
ex.zh: 真正無私的人幫助別人不求回報。

root.note: 為別人著想的人 → 利他主義者

senses.en: a mixture or blend of different things
an alloy of mercury with another metal, used in dental fillings

ex.en: The city's cuisine is an amalgam of Chinese, Malay, and Indian flavors.
ex.zh: 這座城市的料理融合了中式、馬來和印度風味。

senses.en: to combine or unite to form one organization or structure

ex.en: The two small schools decided to amalgamate to save money.
ex.zh: 這兩所小學校決定合併以節省經費。

root.note: 做成混合物 → 合併

senses.en: a person who does something for pleasure rather than as a job
not professional; sometimes, lacking skill

ex.en: The photo contest is open to any amateur with a camera.
ex.zh: 這場攝影比賽開放給任何有相機的業餘愛好者參加。

root.note: 因為熱愛而做的人 → 業餘愛好者

senses.en: relating to or expressing romantic or sexual love

ex.en: The poet wrote amatory verses to the woman he admired.
ex.zh: 詩人為他傾慕的女子寫下情詩。

root.note: 與愛有關的 → 戀愛的

senses.en: able to use the right and left hands equally well

ex.en: The ambidextrous pitcher could throw with either arm.
ex.zh: 那位左右開弓的投手用哪隻手都能投球。

root.note: 兩隻手都像右手一樣靈巧 → 雙手都靈巧的

senses.en: open to more than one interpretation; not clear
senses.zh: 模稜兩可的；含糊不清的

ex.en: The ending of the novel is ambiguous, so readers still argue about what really happened.
ex.zh: 這本小說的結局模稜兩可，所以讀者到現在還在爭論到底發生了什麼事。

root.note: 被推往兩個方向 → 模稜兩可

senses.en: having a strong desire for success or achievement
(of a plan) difficult and requiring great effort

ex.en: The city has an ambitious plan to plant a million trees.
ex.zh: 這座城市有個宏大的計畫，要種一百萬棵樹。

root.note: 古羅馬候選人四處走動拉票 → 有野心的

senses.en: extremely pleasing to taste or smell; divine
senses.zh: 美味的；芳香的；神仙般的

ex.en: An ambrosial smell of fresh bread drifted from the bakery.
ex.zh: 麵包店飄出剛出爐麵包的誘人香味。

root.note: ambrosia 是希臘眾神吃了會長生不老的食物 → 美味如仙饌的

senses.en: a vehicle for taking sick or injured people to the hospital

ex.en: Someone called an ambulance after the cyclist fell.
ex.zh: 那位騎單車的人摔倒後，有人叫了救護車。

root.note: 原指跟著軍隊移動的野戰醫院 → 救護車

senses.en: to walk or move from place to place

ex.en: After surgery, patients are encouraged to ambulate as soon as possible.
ex.zh: 手術後，醫生鼓勵病人盡早下床走動。

root.note: 走動

senses.en: a surprise attack by people hiding and waiting
to attack suddenly from a hidden position

ex.en: The soldiers walked straight into an ambush in the narrow valley.
ex.zh: 士兵們在狹窄的山谷中直接中了埋伏。

root.note: 躲在灌木叢裡 → 埋伏

senses.en: to make something bad or unsatisfactory better

ex.en: The city built new shelters to ameliorate living conditions for the homeless.
ex.zh: 市政府蓋了新的收容所，改善遊民的生活條件。

root.note: 使變得更好 → 改善

senses.en: willing to accept or be persuaded; cooperative
capable of being treated or dealt with in a certain way

ex.en: The principal was amenable to the students' idea of a later start time.
ex.zh: 校長願意接受學生延後上學時間的提議。

root.note: 可以被引導的 → 順從的

senses.en: a word or phrase typical of American English
loyalty to the United States or its customs

ex.en: The British editor marked "gotten" as an Americanism.
ex.zh: 那位英國編輯把 gotten 標註為美式用語。

root.note: 美國特有的東西 → 美式用語

senses.en: friendly and without disagreement

ex.en: The two companies reached an amicable agreement without going to court.
ex.zh: 兩家公司沒有上法院，就達成了友好的協議。

root.note: 像朋友一樣的 → 友好的

senses.en: a friendly relationship, especially between countries
senses.zh: 友好；和睦（尤指國與國之間）

ex.en: The treaty opened a new era of amity between the former enemies.
ex.zh: 這項條約開啟了兩個昔日敵國之間友好的新時代。

root.note: 彼此友愛 → 友好

mn: amity（友好）和 enmity（敵意）是一對反義詞。

senses.en: showing or feeling romantic or sexual desire

ex.en: She ignored his amorous glances across the room.
ex.zh: 她不理會他從房間另一頭投來的愛慕眼神。

root.note: 充滿愛意的 → 多情的

senses.en: without a clear shape, form, or structure

ex.en: The committee's plan was still amorphous, with no clear goals or deadlines.
ex.zh: 委員會的計畫仍然很模糊，沒有明確的目標或期限。

root.note: 沒有形狀的 → 無定形的

senses.en: a love affair, especially a secret one

ex.en: The novel follows the painter's brief amour with a mysterious dancer.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫畫家與一名神祕舞者的短暫戀情。

root.note: 法文的「愛」→ 戀情

senses.en: the basic unit for measuring electric current

ex.en: The ampere is the standard unit scientists use to measure electric current.
ex.zh: 安培是科學家用來測量電流的標準單位。

root.note: 以物理學家安培命名的單位

senses.en: the symbol &, meaning "and"

ex.en: The law firm uses an ampersand between the partners' names.
ex.zh: 這家律師事務所在合夥人的名字之間用 & 符號連接。

root.note: 舊時背字母時唸的 and per se and 連讀 → ampersand

senses.en: able to live both on land and in water
(of military operations) involving forces landing from the sea

ex.en: Frogs are amphibious animals that begin life in water.
ex.zh: 青蛙是兩棲動物，一開始在水中生活。

root.note: 過兩種生活的 → 兩棲的

senses.en: a round or oval open-air building with rising rows of seats around a central space

ex.en: The band played to thousands in the outdoor amphitheater.
ex.zh: 樂團在戶外圓形劇場為數千人表演。

root.note: 四周都有座位的劇場 → 圓形劇場

senses.en: the maximum extent of a vibration or wave
great size, range, or abundance

ex.en: A louder sound has a greater amplitude.
ex.zh: 越大聲的聲音振幅越大。

root.note: 大的程度 → 廣大、振幅

senses.en: more than enough; fully

ex.en: Her hard work was amply rewarded with a scholarship.
ex.zh: 她的努力換得一份獎學金，獲得了充分的回報。

root.note: 大量地 → 充分地

senses.en: to cut off a limb or part of the body by surgery

ex.en: Doctors had to amputate his leg after the infection spread.
ex.zh: 感染擴散後，醫生不得不切除他的腿。

root.note: 從四周修剪掉 → 切除

senses.en: the feeling of finding something funny or entertaining
an activity that provides entertainment

ex.en: To everyone's amusement, the puppy stole the speaker's microphone.
ex.zh: 小狗把講者的麥克風叼走了，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

root.note: 使人開心的事 → 樂趣

senses.en: something placed in the wrong time period, or that seems out of date
senses.zh: 時代錯置；過時的人或事物

ex.en: A wristwatch on a Roman soldier in the movie is an obvious anachronism.
ex.zh: 電影裡羅馬士兵戴手錶，明顯是時代錯置。

root.note: 違反時間順序 → 時代錯置

senses.en: a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of another

ex.en: "Listen" is an anagram of "silent."
ex.zh: listen 是 silent 的字母重組詞。

root.note: 把字母重新排列 → 字母重組詞

senses.en: similar in some way, so that a comparison can be made

ex.en: The heart is analogous to a pump that pushes blood through the body.
ex.zh: 心臟類似一個幫浦，把血液推送到全身。

root.note: 依照相同比例的 → 類似的

senses.en: a comparison between two things to explain or clarify something

ex.en: The teacher used the analogy of a highway to explain how blood vessels work.
ex.zh: 老師用高速公路來比喻血管的運作。

root.note: 依照相同道理來比較 → 類比

senses.en: a person who studies information in detail to understand or explain it

ex.en: One analyst predicted that housing prices would fall next year.
ex.zh: 一位分析師預測明年房價會下跌。

root.note: 把事情徹底拆解的人 → 分析師

senses.en: to examine something in detail in order to understand it

ex.en: Scientists will analyze the water samples for pollution.
ex.zh: 科學家會分析水樣是否受到汙染。

root.note: 徹底拆解開來 → 分析

senses.en: a state of disorder because there is no government or control

ex.en: When the police went on strike, the city fell into anarchy.
ex.zh: 警察罷工後，整座城市陷入一片混亂。

root.note: 沒有統治者 → 無政府狀態

senses.en: something or someone that one strongly dislikes
senses.zh: 令人極度厭惡的人或事物

senses.en: a formal curse by a church

ex.en: Raising taxes is anathema to the party's voters.
ex.zh: 加稅是這個政黨的選民深惡痛絕的事。

root.note: 原指供奉起來的祭品，後指被詛咒之物 → 極度厭惡的事

senses.en: the scientific study of the structure of bodies
the physical structure of a living thing; a detailed analysis

ex.en: Medical students spend months studying human anatomy.
ex.zh: 醫學生要花好幾個月研讀人體解剖學。

root.note: 把身體完全切開研究 → 解剖學

senses.en: one's family or ethnic origins; one's ancestors as a group

ex.en: She traced her ancestry back to farmers in southern Italy.
ex.zh: 她追溯家世，發現祖先是義大利南部的農民。

root.note: 走在前面的人 → 祖先

senses.en: a short, interesting story about a real incident or person

ex.en: The speaker opened with a funny anecdote about her first job.
ex.zh: 講者以一則關於她第一份工作的趣事開場。

root.note: 原指沒有公開發表的小故事 → 軼事

senses.en: a condition in which the blood lacks enough healthy red blood cells

ex.en: A lack of iron in the diet can cause anemia.
ex.zh: 飲食中缺鐵可能造成貧血。

root.note: 沒有（足夠的）血 → 貧血

senses.en: suffering from anemia; pale
lacking energy, strength, or vitality

ex.en: The economy showed only anemic growth last quarter.
ex.zh: 上一季經濟成長十分疲弱。

root.note: 缺血的 → 貧血的、無力的

senses.en: an instrument for measuring wind speed

ex.en: The anemometer on the roof recorded gusts of over 100 kilometers per hour.
ex.zh: 屋頂上的風速計測到時速超過一百公里的陣風。

root.note: 測量風的儀器 → 風速計

senses.en: a drug that makes a person unable to feel pain
causing a loss of feeling

ex.en: The dentist gave me a local anesthetic before pulling the tooth.
ex.zh: 牙醫拔牙前幫我打了局部麻醉。

root.note: 使人沒有感覺 → 麻醉的

senses.en: again, often in a new or different way

ex.en: After the fire, the family had to start life anew in another town.
ex.zh: 火災後，這家人不得不在另一個小鎮重新開始生活。

root.note: 從新的開始 → 重新

senses.en: like an angel; very kind, pure, or beautiful

ex.en: The child had an angelic face but a mischievous personality.
ex.zh: 那個孩子有張天使般的臉，個性卻很頑皮。

root.note: 像天使的

senses.en: a member of the Germanic peoples who ruled England before 1066; also, Old English
senses.zh: 盎格魯撒克遜人；古英語

senses.en: relating to the Anglo-Saxons or to people of English descent

ex.en: Many everyday English words come from Anglo-Saxon roots.
ex.zh: 許多日常英文字源自盎格魯撒克遜語。

root.note: 兩支日耳曼民族的合稱

senses.en: intense dislike or fear of England or English people

ex.en: The pamphlet was full of Anglophobia and anger at British rule.
ex.zh: 這本小冊子充滿仇英情緒和對英國統治的憤怒。

root.note: 害怕、厭惡英國 → 仇英情緒

senses.en: having sharp corners or angles
(of a person) thin and bony

ex.en: The modern building has an angular shape made of glass and steel.
ex.zh: 這棟現代建築由玻璃和鋼材構成，外形稜角分明。

root.note: 有角的

senses.en: containing no water

ex.en: The chemist stored the anhydrous salt in a sealed jar to keep out moisture.
ex.zh: 化學家把無水鹽放在密封罐中，防止受潮。

root.note: 沒有水的

senses.en: a critical comment or criticism

ex.en: The critic's sharp animadversion on the play upset the director.
ex.zh: 評論家對這齣戲的尖銳批評讓導演很不高興。

root.note: 把心思轉向（缺點）→ 批評

senses.en: to criticize or comment critically on something

ex.en: The reviewer chose to animadvert on the author's careless research.
ex.zh: 評論者特別批評作者研究粗糙。

root.note: 把心思轉向（缺點）→ 批評

senses.en: a microscopic animal

ex.en: Under the lens, each drop of pond water held a moving animalcule or two.
ex.zh: 透過鏡片看，每滴池水裡都有一兩隻在動的微生物。

root.note: 很小的動物 → 微生物

senses.en: to bring to life; to make lively
to make drawings or models appear to move in a film
[ˋænəmɪt] alive; having life

ex.en: A good teacher can animate even the dullest topic.
ex.zh: 好老師能讓最枯燥的主題也變得生動。

root.note: 給予生命 → 使有生氣

senses.en: strong dislike or hostility

ex.en: There was clear animosity between the two rival teams.
ex.zh: 兩支敵對隊伍之間明顯有敵意。

root.note: 氣憤滿滿的心 → 敵意

senses.en: a writer of annals; a historian who records events year by year

ex.en: The monastery's annalist recorded every flood and famine.
ex.zh: 修道院的編年史作者記錄了每一次水災和饑荒。

root.note: 逐年記錄的人 → 編年史作者

senses.en: a record of events year by year; historical records

ex.en: Her discovery earned her a place in the annals of science.
ex.zh: 她的發現讓她在科學史上留名。

root.note: 逐年的記錄 → 編年史

senses.en: to take control of a territory and add it to one's own
[ˋænɛks] an extra building added to or near a main one

ex.en: The empire tried to annex the small neighboring kingdom.
ex.zh: 那個帝國企圖併吞鄰近的小王國。

root.note: 綁到自己身上 → 併吞

senses.en: to destroy completely
to defeat completely

ex.en: A single asteroid strike could annihilate an entire city.
ex.zh: 一次小行星撞擊就可能徹底摧毀整座城市。

root.note: 使化為烏有 → 殲滅

senses.en: to add notes or comments to a text or diagram

ex.en: Please annotate the poem with your own questions and ideas.
ex.zh: 請在這首詩旁寫下你自己的問題和想法作為註解。

root.note: 在旁邊加上記號 → 註解

senses.en: happening once a year; calculated over a year
a plant that lives for only one year

ex.en: The town holds an annual festival every October.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮每年十月都會舉辦年度慶典。

root.note: 每年的

senses.en: a fixed sum of money paid to someone every year

ex.en: After retiring, she lived comfortably on a small annuity.
ex.zh: 退休後，她靠一筆不多的年金過著舒適的生活。

root.note: 每年領取的錢 → 年金

senses.en: a formal announcement; (the Annunciation) the angel Gabriel's announcement to Mary that she would bear Jesus

ex.en: The museum owns a famous painting of the Annunciation.
ex.zh: 這間博物館藏有一幅著名的天使報喜畫作。

root.note: 向人宣告 → 宣告

senses.en: the positive electrode of an electrolytic cell; the terminal where current enters

ex.en: In this battery, electrons flow away from the anode.
ex.zh: 在這個電池裡，電子從陽極流出。

root.note: 電流往上進入的路 → 陽極

senses.en: with a name that is not known or not revealed
lacking individual or unusual features

ex.en: An anonymous donor gave a million dollars to the hospital.
ex.zh: 一位匿名捐贈者捐了一百萬美元給醫院。

root.note: 沒有名字的 → 匿名的

senses.en: active hostility or opposition

ex.en: The long antagonism between the two families ended with a marriage.
ex.zh: 兩個家族長久的敵對因為一場婚姻而結束。

root.note: 互相爭鬥 → 敵對

senses.en: relating to the region around the South Pole
(the Antarctic) the region around the South Pole

ex.en: Penguins thrive in the freezing Antarctic waters.
ex.zh: 企鵝在冰冷的南極海域中繁衍興盛。

parts.m: north, bear 北方（大熊星座）

root.note: 北極的對面 → 南極的

senses.en: a stake put into the pot before a poker hand; an amount one must pay to take part

ex.en: The rival company raised the ante by offering free shipping.
ex.zh: 對手公司提供免運費，把競爭又拉高了一級。

root.note: 發牌之前先下的注 → 賭注

mn: raise the ante 是常見片語，意思是「提高賭注、加碼」。

senses.en: to come before in time, order, or rank

ex.en: The early sketches antecede the finished painting by several years.
ex.zh: 這些早期草圖比完成的畫作早了好幾年。

ex.en: In this story, the dream must antecede the journey.
ex.zh: 在這個故事裡，那場夢必須發生在旅程之前。

root.note: 走在前面 → 先於

senses.en: a thing or event that existed before and led to another
(grammar) the word a pronoun refers to
preceding in time or order

ex.en: The telegraph was an important antecedent of the telephone.
ex.zh: 電報是電話的重要前身。

root.note: 走在前面的東西 → 前例

senses.en: a small room leading to a larger one

ex.en: Visitors waited in the antechamber before meeting the king.
ex.zh: 訪客們在前廳等候，然後才晉見國王。

root.note: 大房間前面的房間 → 前廳

senses.en: to come before something in time
to write an earlier date on a document than the real one

ex.en: These cave paintings antedate the invention of writing by thousands of years.
ex.zh: 這些洞穴壁畫比文字的發明早了數千年。

root.note: 日期在前 → 早於

senses.en: extremely old-fashioned or outdated
belonging to the time before the biblical Flood

ex.en: The office still uses an antediluvian computer system from the 1990s.
ex.zh: 這間辦公室還在用 1990 年代的老古董電腦系統。

root.note: 諾亞大洪水之前的 → 老掉牙的

senses.en: happening before noon; in the morning

ex.en: The old diary lists an antemeridian walk as part of his daily routine.
ex.zh: 那本舊日記把上午散步列為他每天的例行公事。

root.note: 正午之前的 → 上午的

mn: 縮寫 a.m. 就來自拉丁文 ante meridiem。

senses.en: existing before the creation of the world

ex.en: The myth describes an antemundane darkness from which the gods arose.
ex.zh: 這則神話描述了天地初開之前的一片黑暗，眾神從中誕生。

root.note: 世界之前的 → 創世之前的

senses.en: relating to pregnant women or to the period before birth

ex.en: She attended an antenatal class to prepare for the birth.
ex.zh: 她參加產前課程，為生產做準備。

root.note: 出生之前的 → 產前的

senses.en: situated at or near the front
coming earlier in time

ex.en: The injury damaged the anterior part of the knee.
ex.zh: 這次受傷傷到了膝蓋的前側。

root.note: 更前面的 → 前部的

senses.en: a small room leading into a larger, more important one

ex.en: We sat in the anteroom until the judge was ready to see us.
ex.zh: 我們坐在前廳，等法官準備好見我們。

root.note: 前面的房間 → 前廳

senses.en: a published collection of poems, stories, or other writings

ex.en: Her short story was chosen for a national anthology of young writers.
ex.zh: 她的短篇小說入選全國青年作家選集。

root.note: 採集花朵（佳作）→ 選集

senses.en: a hard type of coal that burns with little smoke

ex.en: Pennsylvania was once famous for its anthracite mines.
ex.zh: 賓州過去以無煙煤礦聞名。

root.note: 煤的礦物 → 無煙煤

senses.en: the study of human societies, cultures, and development

ex.en: She majored in anthropology and spent a year living in a remote village.
ex.zh: 她主修人類學，並在偏遠村落住了一年。

root.note: 研究人類的學問 → 人類學

senses.en: having a human form or human characteristics

ex.en: The temple walls are carved with anthropomorphous gods.
ex.zh: 神廟牆上刻滿了人形的神祇。

root.note: 人的形狀的 → 似人形的

senses.en: (usually antics) foolish, silly, or amusing behavior
grotesque or bizarre; playful

ex.en: Each antic the clown performed made the children scream with laughter.
ex.zh: 小丑每做一個滑稽動作，孩子們就笑得尖叫。

parts.m: grotesque 古怪（義大利文 antico）

root.note: 古怪的裝飾 → 滑稽的舉動

senses.en: in Christian belief, a great enemy of Christ expected before the end of the world

ex.en: Medieval preachers warned that the Antichrist would come before the Last Judgment.
ex.zh: 中世紀的傳教士警告說，敵基督會在最後審判前到來。

root.note: 反對基督者 → 敵基督

senses.en: a disappointing ending after a build-up of excitement
senses.zh: 虎頭蛇尾；令人掃興的結局

ex.en: After months of hype, the final episode was a huge anticlimax.
ex.zh: 炒作了好幾個月，最後一集卻令人大失所望。

root.note: 與高潮相反 → 令人掃興的結局

senses.en: a weather system of high pressure, usually bringing calm, clear weather

ex.en: A large anticyclone brought a week of sunny, dry weather.
ex.zh: 一個大型反氣旋帶來了一週晴朗乾燥的天氣。

root.note: 與氣旋相反 → 反氣旋

senses.en: a medicine taken to counteract a poison
something that counteracts an unpleasant situation

ex.en: Laughter can be the best antidote to stress.
ex.zh: 笑可以是對抗壓力的最佳良方。

root.note: 給予來對抗（毒）的東西 → 解毒劑

senses.en: a contradiction in terms or ideas

ex.en: Calling the plan both "risk-free" and "daring" is an antilogy.
ex.zh: 說這個計畫既「零風險」又「大膽」，根本前後矛盾。

root.note: 話語互相衝突 → 前後矛盾

senses.en: to feel a strong dislike or aversion

ex.en: It is natural to antipathize with those who mock your beliefs.
ex.zh: 對嘲笑你信仰的人感到反感是很自然的。

root.note: 有對立的感覺 → 反感

senses.en: a short chant or hymn sung in alternating parts by two groups

ex.en: The monks sang an antiphon, one side of the choir answering the other.
ex.zh: 修士們唱起輪唱聖歌，詩班一邊唱、另一邊回應。

root.note: 相對應的聲音 → 輪唱聖歌

senses.en: alternate singing or chanting by two groups; a musical response

ex.en: The choir's antiphony echoed from both sides of the cathedral.
ex.zh: 詩班的輪唱從大教堂兩側迴盪開來。

root.note: 相對應的歌聲 → 輪唱

senses.en: places directly opposite each other on the earth; often Australia and New Zealand, from a British view
senses.zh: 地球上相對的兩點；（英國人說法）澳洲和紐西蘭

senses.en: the exact opposite of something

ex.en: After college, he traveled to the antipodes and settled in New Zealand.
ex.zh: 大學畢業後，他遠赴地球另一端，定居紐西蘭。

root.note: 腳底相對的地方 → 地球另一端

senses.en: a person who studies or collects antiques and ancient objects
senses.zh: 古物研究者；古董收藏家

ex.en: The local antiquary could identify every coin found in the field.
ex.zh: 當地那位古物專家能辨認田裡挖到的每一枚錢幣。

root.note: 研究古物的人

senses.en: to make old-fashioned or obsolete

ex.en: Smartphones will soon antiquate many of the devices we use today.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機很快就會讓我們現在用的許多裝置過時。

root.note: 使變老舊 → 使過時

mn: 形容詞 antiquated（過時的）比動詞常見得多。

senses.en: a valuable old object, such as furniture or jewelry
old and valuable because of age or quality

ex.en: My grandmother keeps her letters in an antique wooden desk.
ex.zh: 我奶奶把信件放在一張古董木桌裡。

root.note: 屬於從前的 → 古董

senses.en: a substance that kills germs and prevents infection
preventing infection; extremely clean
lacking warmth or character

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the cut with an antiseptic before bandaging it.
ex.zh: 護士先用消毒劑清理傷口，再包紮起來。

root.note: 對抗腐爛的 → 抗菌的

senses.en: opposed to slavery

ex.en: Frederick Douglass became a powerful antislavery speaker.
ex.zh: 腓德烈克・道格拉斯成為一位強而有力的反奴隸制度演說家。

root.note: 反對奴隸制度的

senses.en: a drug that relieves muscle spasms
relieving spasms of the muscles

ex.en: The doctor prescribed an antispasmodic for her stomach cramps.
ex.zh: 醫生開了解痙攣藥來治她的胃痙攣。

root.note: 對抗痙攣的

senses.en: the second section of a Greek choral ode, answering the first (the strophe)
senses.zh: （希臘合唱頌歌的）第二節；回舞歌

ex.en: The chorus moved back across the stage as they sang the antistrophe.
ex.zh: 合唱隊一邊唱回舞歌，一邊走回舞台另一側。

root.note: 反方向轉回來時唱的段落 → 回舞歌

senses.en: an antibody that neutralizes a specific toxin

ex.en: The patient received an antitoxin to fight the snake venom.
ex.zh: 病人注射了抗毒素來對抗蛇毒。

root.note: 對抗毒素的物質

senses.en: a word opposite in meaning to another

ex.en: "Cold" is the antonym of "hot."
ex.zh: cold 是 hot 的反義詞。

root.note: 意思相反的字 → 反義詞

senses.en: worried or nervous about something uncertain
eager or strongly wanting to do something

ex.en: He felt anxious while waiting for his test results.
ex.zh: 他在等考試成績時感到很焦慮。

root.note: 心被勒緊 → 焦慮的

senses.en: lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern

ex.en: Voter apathy led to the lowest turnout in decades.
ex.zh: 選民的冷漠導致數十年來最低的投票率。

root.note: 沒有感覺 → 冷漠

senses.en: an opening, hole, or gap
the adjustable opening in a camera that lets in light

ex.en: Light entered the dark room through a small aperture in the wall.
ex.zh: 光線從牆上的一個小孔照進暗房。

root.note: 打開的地方 → 孔

senses.en: the top or highest point of something

ex.en: At the apex of her career, she was the most famous actress in the country.
ex.zh: 在事業巔峰時，她是全國最有名的女演員。

senses.en: a short, clever saying that expresses a general truth

ex.en: "Less is more" is a popular aphorism among designers.
ex.zh: 「少即是多」是設計師之間常說的格言。

root.note: 劃清界限、下定義的話 → 格言

senses.en: a place where bees are kept

ex.en: The farm has a small apiary that produces honey every summer.
ex.zh: 這座農場有個小型養蜂場，每年夏天都產蜂蜜。

root.note: 養蜜蜂的地方 → 養蜂場

senses.en: the highest point or climax of something
the point in an orbit farthest from the earth

ex.en: The empire reached its apogee under its third emperor.
ex.zh: 這個帝國在第三任皇帝統治下達到巔峰。

root.note: 離地球最遠的點 → 遠地點、巔峰

senses.en: a statement saying that one is sorry
a formal written defense of a belief or action

ex.en: The company issued a public apology for the data leak.
ex.zh: 那家公司為資料外洩公開道歉。

root.note: 為自己開脫的話 → 辯解、道歉

senses.en: the abandonment of a religious or political belief

ex.en: In some countries, apostasy can lead to severe punishment.
ex.zh: 在某些國家，背棄宗教信仰可能遭受嚴厲懲罰。

root.note: 站到別處去 → 叛教

senses.en: a person who abandons a religious or political belief

ex.en: The former member was treated as an apostate by the group.
ex.zh: 那位前成員被團體視為叛徒。

root.note: 站到別處去的人 → 叛教者

senses.en: one of the twelve followers sent by Jesus to spread his teaching
a strong supporter of an idea or cause

ex.en: She became an apostle of healthy eating after her illness.
ex.zh: 生病之後，她成了健康飲食的熱心倡導者。

root.note: 被派出去的人 → 使徒

senses.en: a person who prepared and sold medicines in earlier times; a pharmacist

ex.en: In the village, the apothecary mixed herbs for every illness.
ex.zh: 在村子裡，藥劑師會為各種病痛調配草藥。

root.note: 原指儲藏室 → 管理藥材的人 → 藥劑師

senses.en: the highest point or perfect example of something
the raising of a person to the rank of a god

ex.en: Critics called the film the apotheosis of the director's style.
ex.zh: 影評人說這部電影是導演風格的極致之作。

root.note: 轉變成神 → 神化 → 極致

senses.en: to greatly shock or disgust someone

ex.en: The cruel treatment of the animals will appall anyone who sees the video.
ex.zh: 任何看到影片的人，都會對這些動物遭受的殘忍對待感到震驚。

root.note: 使人臉色發白 → 使驚駭

senses.en: clearly visible or understood; obvious
seeming real but not necessarily so

ex.en: It soon became apparent that no one had read the instructions.
ex.zh: 很快就很明顯了：根本沒人讀過說明書。

root.note: 出現在眼前的 → 明顯的

senses.en: a ghost or ghostlike image of a person
the sudden appearance of something remarkable

ex.en: The guard swore he saw an apparition in the castle hallway.
ex.zh: 守衛發誓他在城堡走廊看到了幽靈。

root.note: 突然出現的東西 → 幽靈

senses.en: to calm or satisfy someone by giving in to their demands

ex.en: The government tried to appease the protesters by lowering fuel prices.
ex.zh: 政府試圖以調降油價來安撫抗議者。

root.note: 使回到和平 → 安撫

senses.en: (of a court) dealing with appeals against earlier decisions

ex.en: The case went to an appellate court after the first verdict.
ex.zh: 第一審判決後，這個案子上訴到了上訴法院。

root.note: 向（上級）呼喊的 → 上訴的

senses.en: a name or title

ex.en: The town earned the appellation "City of Bridges" for its many rivers.
ex.zh: 這座城鎮因為河流眾多，而得到「橋之城」的稱號。

root.note: 用來叫某人的東西 → 名稱

senses.en: to add something to the end of a document or piece of writing

ex.en: Please append a list of sources to your essay.
ex.zh: 請在論文後面附上參考資料清單。

root.note: 掛在後面 → 附加

senses.en: to relate to or belong to

ex.en: These rules appertain only to students living on campus.
ex.zh: 這些規定只適用於住校的學生。

root.note: 被牢牢握在（某範圍）內 → 屬於

senses.en: highly appropriate or relevant

ex.en: Her apposite quotation perfectly summed up the discussion.
ex.zh: 她引用的話非常貼切，完美總結了這場討論。

root.note: 放在正好的地方 → 恰當的

senses.en: (grammar) placing a noun phrase next to another that refers to the same thing

ex.en: In "my brother, the doctor," the second phrase is in apposition to the first.
ex.zh: 在 my brother, the doctor 裡，後面那個片語是前面的同位語。

root.note: 放在旁邊 → 同位語

senses.en: to judge the value, quality, or nature of something

ex.en: An expert will appraise the painting before the auction.
ex.zh: 拍賣前會有專家為這幅畫估價。

root.note: 給定一個價值 → 估價

mn: appraise（估價）和 apprise（通知）很像，別搞混。

senses.en: large or important enough to be noticed

ex.en: The new medicine made no appreciable difference to her symptoms.
ex.zh: 新藥對她的症狀沒有明顯的改善。

root.note: 可以估出價值的 → 可觀的

senses.en: to arrest someone for a crime
to understand or perceive

ex.en: Police managed to apprehend the thief two blocks away.
ex.zh: 警方在兩條街外成功逮捕了小偷。

root.note: 抓住（人或意思）→ 逮捕、理解

senses.en: capable of being understood or perceived

ex.en: The teacher made the difficult theory apprehensible to young students.
ex.zh: 老師讓這個艱深的理論變得連年幼的學生都能理解。

root.note: 可以抓住（意思）的 → 可理解的

senses.en: approval or praise

ex.en: The plan won the approbation of both parents and teachers.
ex.zh: 這個計畫獲得家長和老師雙方的認可。

root.note: 證明是好的 → 認可

senses.en: suitable or proper in the circumstances
[əˋproprɪˏet] to take something for one's own use, often without permission
[əˋproprɪˏet] to set aside money for a specific purpose

ex.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a job interview at a bank.
ex.zh: 去銀行面試穿牛仔褲並不恰當。

root.note: 變成自己的 → 挪用；適合自己的 → 適當的

senses.en: a bridge or channel built to carry water over long distances

ex.en: The Romans built a stone aqueduct to bring water into the city.
ex.zh: 羅馬人建造了一座石造渡槽，把水引進城裡。

root.note: 引導水的建築 → 導水管

senses.en: of, like, or containing water

ex.en: The salt was dissolved to make an aqueous solution.
ex.zh: 這些鹽被溶解製成水溶液。

root.note: 水的

senses.en: a person who settles a dispute or has final authority
a person whose views on taste or style are respected

ex.en: The magazine sees itself as the arbiter of good taste in fashion.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌自認是時尚品味的權威。

parts.m: judge, witness 裁判者（拉丁文）

root.note: 做裁判的人 → 仲裁者

senses.en: based on random choice or personal whim rather than reason
(of power) used without limits or fairness

ex.en: The deadline seemed arbitrary, since no one could explain why it was chosen.
ex.zh: 這個期限似乎很隨意，因為沒人能解釋為什麼定在那天。

root.note: 全憑裁判者一人決定 → 武斷的

senses.en: to act as an impartial judge to settle a dispute

ex.en: A neutral expert was hired to arbitrate the contract dispute.
ex.zh: 雙方聘請一位中立專家來仲裁這起合約糾紛。

root.note: 擔任裁判 → 仲裁

senses.en: a shady garden shelter formed by trees or climbing plants on a frame

ex.en: We ate lunch under a grape arbor in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在花園的葡萄藤架下吃午餐。

root.note: 樹木或植物形成的遮蔭 → 藤架

senses.en: living in trees; relating to trees

ex.en: Koalas are arboreal animals that rarely come down to the ground.
ex.zh: 無尾熊是樹棲動物，很少下到地面。

root.note: 樹的 → 樹棲的

senses.en: treelike in size, shape, or branching

ex.en: Some ferns in the rainforest grow to an arborescent height.
ex.zh: 雨林中有些蕨類能長到像樹一樣高。

root.note: 漸漸長成樹的樣子 → 樹狀的

senses.en: a garden where many kinds of trees are grown for study and display

ex.en: The university arboretum has over two thousand kinds of trees.
ex.zh: 這所大學的樹木園裡有超過兩千種樹。

root.note: 種樹的地方 → 樹木園

senses.en: the cultivation and care of trees and shrubs

ex.en: He studied arboriculture and now cares for the city's street trees.
ex.zh: 他學的是樹木栽培，現在負責照顧市區的行道樹。

root.note: 種植樹木 → 樹木栽培

senses.en: a covered passage with arches, often lined with shops
a place with coin-operated games

ex.en: We spent the afternoon playing games at the arcade.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都在電玩遊樂場打電動。

root.note: 一連串的拱 → 拱廊

senses.en: the study of human history through digging up and examining ancient remains

ex.en: Advances in archaeology have changed how we view ancient Egypt.
ex.zh: 考古學的進展改變了我們對古埃及的看法。

root.note: 研究古代的學問 → 考古學

senses.en: very old or old-fashioned; no longer in everyday use

ex.en: "Thou" is an archaic word for "you."
ex.zh: thou 是 you 的古老說法。

root.note: 古代的 → 過時的

senses.en: an old word or style that is no longer in common use

ex.en: The poet used "ere" as a deliberate archaism.
ex.zh: 詩人刻意用 ere 這個古語。

root.note: 古代的用語 → 古語

senses.en: an angel of high rank

ex.en: The painting shows the archangel Michael defeating a dragon.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪天使長米迦勒擊敗惡龍。

root.note: 天使中的首領 → 天使長

senses.en: a bishop of the highest rank, in charge of a large area

ex.en: The archbishop led the ceremony in the cathedral.
ex.zh: 大主教在大教堂主持典禮。

root.note: 主教中的首領 → 大主教

senses.en: a senior member of the clergy who assists a bishop

ex.en: The archdeacon visited each parish in the district once a year.
ex.zh: 副主教每年到轄區內的每個教區巡視一次。

root.note: 執事中的首領 → 副主教

senses.en: a perfect or typical example of something
an original model; a recurring symbol or character in literature

ex.en: The wise old mentor is a common archetype in fantasy stories.
ex.zh: 睿智的老導師是奇幻故事中常見的原型角色。

root.note: 最初的模型 → 原型

senses.en: a group of islands

ex.en: The Philippines is an archipelago of more than seven thousand islands.
ex.zh: 菲律賓是由七千多座島嶼組成的群島。

root.note: 原指愛琴海（主要的海），因多島而引申為群島

senses.en: very enthusiastic or passionate

ex.en: She is an ardent supporter of animal rights.
ex.zh: 她是動物權的熱烈支持者。

root.note: 燃燒般的 → 熱烈的

senses.en: great enthusiasm or passion

ex.en: Their ardor for the project faded after the funding was cut.
ex.zh: 經費被刪減後，他們對這個計畫的熱情也消退了。

root.note: 燃燒的感覺 → 熱情

senses.en: having little or no rain; very dry
lacking interest or imagination

ex.en: Few crops can survive in such an arid climate.
ex.zh: 在這麼乾旱的氣候下，很少有作物能存活。

root.note: 乾燥的

senses.en: the highest social class, usually with inherited titles and wealth
government by a small privileged class

ex.en: The French aristocracy lost much of its power after the revolution.
ex.zh: 法國貴族階級在大革命後失去了大部分權力。

root.note: 由最好的人統治 → 貴族統治

senses.en: a member of the aristocracy; a noble

ex.en: The old castle once belonged to a wealthy aristocrat.
ex.zh: 這座古堡曾經屬於一位富有的貴族。

root.note: 最好的統治者 → 貴族

senses.en: a large fleet of warships or other vessels

ex.en: An armada of fishing boats sailed out to rescue the stranded sailors.
ex.zh: 一大批漁船出海營救受困的水手。

root.note: 武裝起來的一群 → 艦隊

senses.en: as much as one can hold in one or both arms

ex.en: She came home with an armful of library books.
ex.zh: 她抱著一大疊圖書館的書回家。

root.note: 一整個手臂的量 → 一抱

senses.en: a place where weapons are stored
a supply of resources available for use

ex.en: The rebels broke into the armory and seized the rifles.
ex.zh: 叛軍闖入軍械庫，奪走了步槍。

root.note: 放武器的地方 → 軍械庫

senses.en: a pleasant, distinctive smell

ex.en: The aroma of fresh coffee filled the kitchen.
ex.zh: 現煮咖啡的香味瀰漫整個廚房。

senses.en: to bring someone before a court to answer a criminal charge
to criticize harshly

ex.en: Prosecutors will arraign the suspect on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 檢察官將在週一上午提審這名嫌犯。

root.note: 叫來說清楚道理 → 傳訊

senses.en: to put things in a neat or particular order
to plan or organize something in advance

ex.en: Can you arrange a meeting with the principal for Friday?
ex.zh: 你能幫我安排週五跟校長見面嗎？

root.note: 放進行列中 → 排列

senses.en: a plan or preparation for a future event
the way things are organized or placed
an agreement between people

ex.en: The flower arrangement on the table was beautiful.
ex.zh: 桌上的插花非常漂亮。

root.note: 排列好的東西 → 安排、布置

senses.en: complete; utter (used for something bad)

ex.en: That claim is arrant nonsense, and everyone knows it.
ex.zh: 那個說法根本是一派胡言，大家都知道。

root.note: 原為 errant（遊蕩的），用於 arrant thief（到處作案的賊）→ 十足的

senses.en: (usually arrears) money that is owed and should already have been paid

ex.en: The tenant was three months in arrear with his rent.
ex.zh: 那名房客已經拖欠三個月的房租了。

root.note: 落在後面 → 拖欠

mn: 通常用複數 arrears，片語 in arrears 表示「拖欠」。

senses.en: the act of reaching a place
a person or thing that has just arrived or appeared
senses.zh: 新來的人；新出現的事物

ex.en: The arrival of the train was delayed by heavy snow.
ex.zh: 火車因大雪而延誤抵達。

root.note: 靠岸 → 抵達

senses.en: having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance

ex.en: His arrogant attitude made it hard for him to keep friends.
ex.zh: 他傲慢的態度讓他很難維持友誼。

root.note: 要求別人把好處歸給自己 → 傲慢的

senses.en: to take or claim something without justification

ex.en: The committee tried to arrogate powers that belonged to the council.
ex.zh: 委員會企圖擅取原本屬於理事會的權力。

root.note: 要求歸給自己 → 擅取

senses.en: a well in which water rises by natural pressure without pumping

ex.en: The ranch gets its water from an artesian well that never needs a pump.
ex.zh: 這座牧場的水來自一口自流井，完全不需要抽水機。

root.note: 最早在法國阿圖瓦鑽出的井 → 自流井

senses.en: clever in a crafty or cunning way
showing skill or creative talent

ex.en: The artful salesman convinced her to buy two phones she didn't need.
ex.zh: 那個狡猾的推銷員說服她買了兩支她根本不需要的手機。

root.note: 充滿技巧的 → 巧妙的、狡猾的

senses.en: relating to the legends of King Arthur and his knights

ex.en: The novel retells an Arthurian legend from Guinevere's point of view.
ex.zh: 這部小說從桂妮薇兒的角度重述亞瑟王傳說。

root.note: 亞瑟王的

senses.en: clever tricks used to deceive others
skill or ingenuity

ex.en: She won the argument through honesty, not artifice.
ex.zh: 她靠的是誠實而非詭計贏得這場辯論。

root.note: 用技巧做出來的 → 巧計

senses.en: without deceit; simple and natural
without skill; clumsy

ex.en: The child's artless honesty charmed everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 孩子天真坦率的話讓全桌的人都很喜歡。

root.note: 沒有心機的 → 天真的

senses.en: rising in power or influence
(in the ascendant) a position of growing power

ex.en: The young party is now ascendant after winning several elections.
ex.zh: 這個年輕的政黨連贏數場選舉後，現在正處於上升期。

root.note: 向上爬的 → 上升的

senses.en: the act of rising to a higher position
(the Ascension) the ascent of Jesus into heaven

ex.en: Her ascension to the throne was celebrated across the country.
ex.zh: 全國各地都在慶祝她登基。

root.note: 向上爬 → 上升

senses.en: a climb or movement upward
an upward slope
a rise to a higher status

ex.en: The final ascent to the summit took four hours.
ex.zh: 最後攻頂的那段攀登花了四個小時。

root.note: 向上爬 → 攀登

mn: ascent（上升）和 assent（同意）同音，別搞混。

senses.en: practicing strict self-discipline and avoiding pleasure
a person who lives a life of strict self-denial

ex.en: The monk lived an ascetic life with no possessions but a bowl and a robe.
ex.zh: 那位僧人過著苦行生活，除了一個缽和一件袍子別無長物。

root.note: 嚴格修練的 → 苦行的

senses.en: to regard something as caused by or belonging to someone or something

ex.en: Doctors ascribe his recovery to the new treatment.
ex.zh: 醫生把他的康復歸功於新療法。

root.note: 寫在某人名下 → 歸因於

senses.en: (of reproduction) not involving the joining of male and female cells
without sexual feelings or interest

ex.en: Some plants use asexual reproduction to make copies of themselves.
ex.zh: 有些植物用無性生殖來複製自己。

root.note: 不涉及兩性的 → 無性的

senses.en: very pale because of shock, fear, or illness

ex.en: His face turned ashen when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到消息時，臉色一下子變得慘白。

root.note: 像灰燼一樣的顏色 → 灰白的

senses.en: with suspicion or disapproval
with a sideways glance

ex.en: The old farmers looked askance at the city boy's new ideas.
ex.zh: 老農夫們對這個城市男孩的新點子抱持懷疑的眼光。

mn: 常用片語 look askance at，意思是「用懷疑的眼光看待」。

senses.en: harshness of tone or manner
roughness or harshness of conditions

ex.en: "Sit down," the coach said with some asperity.
ex.zh: 「坐下。」教練語氣有些嚴厲地說。

root.note: 粗糙 → 粗暴

senses.en: a person who hopes to achieve a particular position or goal

ex.en: Each aspirant for the scholarship must write a personal essay.
ex.zh: 每位申請這項獎學金的人都必須寫一篇個人自述。

root.note: 朝著目標喘氣追逐的人 → 有抱負者

senses.en: a hope or ambition to achieve something

ex.en: Her aspiration is to become the first doctor in her family.
ex.zh: 她的志向是成為家族裡第一位醫生。

root.note: 朝著目標呼吸（渴望）→ 抱負

senses.en: to have a strong hope to achieve something

ex.en: Many young athletes aspire to play in the Olympics.
ex.zh: 許多年輕運動員都渴望參加奧運。

root.note: 朝著目標呼吸 → 渴望

senses.en: a person who physically attacks another

ex.en: The victim could not describe her assailant because it was too dark.
ex.zh: 因為太暗，受害者無法描述攻擊她的人。

root.note: 撲向別人的人 → 攻擊者

senses.en: a person who murders an important person for political or religious reasons

ex.en: The assassin was caught before he could reach the president.
ex.zh: 刺客在接近總統前就被抓到了。

parts.m: hashish user 吸大麻者（阿拉伯文）

root.note: 源自中世紀一個據說吸食大麻後行刺的教派 → 刺客

senses.en: to murder an important person, usually for political reasons

ex.en: The rebels plotted to assassinate the king during the parade.
ex.zh: 叛軍密謀在遊行時暗殺國王。

root.note: 做刺客做的事 → 暗殺

senses.en: the murder of an important person, usually for political reasons

ex.en: The assassination of the archduke helped start World War I.
ex.zh: 大公遇刺事件促成了第一次世界大戰的爆發。

root.note: 刺客的行為 → 暗殺

senses.en: a test of the quality or purity of a metal or substance
to test the purity or content of something
(old use) to attempt

ex.en: The lab ran an assay to measure how much gold the ore contained.
ex.zh: 實驗室做了化驗，測量礦石的含金量。

root.note: 試一試 → 化驗

senses.en: official agreement or approval
to agree to or approve of something

ex.en: The law cannot take effect without the governor's assent.
ex.zh: 沒有州長的同意，這條法律無法生效。

root.note: 有相同的感覺 → 同意

mn: assent（同意）和 ascent（上升）同音；反義詞是 dissent。

senses.en: to judge the nature, quality, or value of something
to calculate the amount of a tax or fine

ex.en: Engineers came to assess the damage after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後，工程師前來評估損害情況。

root.note: 坐在（法官）旁邊協助判斷 → 評估

senses.en: a person who estimates the value of property, often for tax purposes
a person who judges the quality of something, such as exam work

ex.en: The tax assessor visited to estimate the value of our house.
ex.zh: 稅務估價員來估算我們房子的價值。

root.note: 坐在旁邊判斷的人 → 評估員

senses.en: property owned by a person or company that has value
useful or valuable qualities or people

ex.en: The company sold some of its assets to pay off its debts.
ex.zh: 那家公司賣掉部分資產來償還債務。

senses.en: showing great care, attention, and hard work
senses.zh: 勤勉的；刻苦的；一絲不苟的

ex.en: Thanks to her assiduous practice, she played the concerto flawlessly.
ex.zh: 多虧她勤奮練習，這首協奏曲她演奏得完美無瑕。

root.note: 一直坐在工作旁 → 勤勉的

senses.en: a person to whom a right, property, or task is legally transferred

ex.en: The patent was transferred to the assignee after the company was sold.
ex.zh: 公司出售後，這項專利轉讓給了受讓人。

root.note: 被指派（標記）給的人 → 受讓人

senses.en: to take in and fully understand information or ideas
to become part of a group or culture; to absorb into a larger group

ex.en: It took the immigrants years to assimilate into their new culture.
ex.zh: 這些移民花了好幾年才融入新的文化。

root.note: 變得和…相似 → 同化

senses.en: repetition of similar vowel sounds in nearby words

ex.en: "Hear the mellow wedding bells" uses assonance with its repeated "e" sounds.
ex.zh: Hear the mellow wedding bells 這句用了重複的 e 音，形成母音韻。

root.note: 聲音彼此呼應 → 母音韻

senses.en: having repeated or similar vowel sounds
