ex.en: The poet chose assonant words like "lake" and "fade" to create a soft rhythm.
ex.zh: 詩人挑選 lake 和 fade 這類母音押韻的字，營造柔和的節奏。

root.note: 聲音相呼應的 → 母音押韻的

senses.en: to correspond in vowel sound; to rhyme by vowel sounds

ex.en: In this line, "time" and "light" assonate but do not fully rhyme.
ex.zh: 在這行詩裡，time 和 light 母音押韻，但不算完全押韻。

root.note: 聲音相呼應 → 母音押韻

senses.en: to make an unpleasant feeling less intense
to satisfy a need such as hunger or thirst

ex.en: The mayor tried to assuage fears that the water was unsafe.
ex.zh: 市長試圖緩解民眾對水質不安全的恐懼。

root.note: 使變甜 → 緩和

senses.en: causing skin or body tissue to tighten
sharp or severe in manner or style
a substance that tightens skin or tissue

ex.en: The critic's astringent review hurt the young author's feelings.
ex.zh: 評論家尖刻的書評傷了那位年輕作者的心。

root.note: 使綁緊的 → 收斂的；嚴厲的

senses.en: able to judge situations accurately and use them to one's advantage

ex.en: An astute investor noticed the trend before anyone else.
ex.zh: 一位精明的投資人比其他人更早察覺這個趨勢。

root.note: 機靈 → 精明的

senses.en: the belief that God or gods do not exist

ex.en: The book explores the history of atheism in Western thought.
ex.zh: 這本書探討西方思想中無神論的歷史。

root.note: 沒有神的主義 → 無神論

senses.en: (literary) eager or longing for something; thirsty

ex.en: The young scholar was athirst for knowledge of ancient languages.
ex.zh: 那位年輕學者渴望學習古代語言的知識。

root.note: 非常口渴 → 渴望的

senses.en: across from side to side; across the path of
in opposition to; contrary to what is expected

ex.en: A fallen tree lay athwart the road after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，一棵倒下的樹橫在路上。

root.note: 橫在上面 → 橫越

senses.en: a device that turns liquid into a fine spray

ex.en: She sprayed perfume from a glass atomizer.
ex.zh: 她用玻璃噴霧瓶噴香水。

root.note: 把液體變成微粒的器具 → 噴霧器

senses.en: to do something to make up for a wrong or sin

ex.en: He volunteered every weekend to atone for his past mistakes.
ex.zh: 他每個週末都去當志工，彌補過去犯的錯。

root.note: at one（重歸於好）→ 彌補、贖罪

mn: 拆成 at-one：做了補償，雙方才能重新「合而為一」。

senses.en: the act of making up for a wrong or sin

ex.en: She offered to repaint the fence as atonement for the damage.
ex.zh: 她提議重新油漆籬笆，作為損壞的補償。

root.note: 贖罪的行為

senses.en: extremely bad or unpleasant
extremely cruel or wicked

ex.en: The service at the restaurant was atrocious, so we left early.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的服務糟透了，所以我們提早離開。

root.note: 殘忍的 → 極糟的

senses.en: an extremely cruel or violent act, especially in war

ex.en: The museum documents every atrocity committed during the war.
ex.zh: 這間博物館記錄了戰爭期間的每一樁暴行。

root.note: 殘忍的行為 → 暴行

senses.en: to provide or serve as clear evidence of
to declare that something is true, especially formally

ex.en: Thousands of fans can attest to the band's amazing live shows.
ex.zh: 成千上萬的歌迷都能證明這個樂團的現場演出有多精彩。

root.note: 去當證人 → 證明

senses.en: the chief legal officer of a country or state

ex.en: The attorney-general announced a new investigation into the company.
ex.zh: 司法部長宣布對那家公司展開新的調查。

root.note: 首席律師 → 司法部長

senses.en: (of hair) reddish-brown

ex.en: The girl with auburn hair won first prize in the spelling bee.
ex.zh: 那個赤褐色頭髮的女孩贏得拼字比賽冠軍。

senses.en: showing a willingness to take bold risks
showing a rude lack of respect

ex.en: The team made an audacious attempt to climb the mountain in winter.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍大膽嘗試在冬天攀登這座山。

root.note: 很敢的 → 大膽的

senses.en: able to be heard

ex.en: Her voice was barely audible over the noise of the crowd.
ex.zh: 在人群的喧鬧聲中，她的聲音幾乎聽不見。

root.note: 可以聽見的

senses.en: a short performance to test whether a performer is suitable for a role
to perform in or hold an audition

ex.en: She practiced the song all week for her audition.
ex.zh: 她整個星期都在練這首歌，準備試鏡。

root.note: 讓人聽聽看 → 試演

senses.en: relating to the sense of hearing

ex.en: Some students are auditory learners who remember best by listening.
ex.zh: 有些學生是聽覺型學習者，靠聽最容易記住。

root.note: 與聽有關的 → 聽覺的

senses.en: to make something greater by adding to it

ex.en: He took a weekend job to augment his income.
ex.zh: 他找了份週末工作來增加收入。

root.note: 增加

senses.en: to be a sign of a likely future outcome
a fortune-teller in ancient Rome who read signs from birds

ex.en: The strong sales numbers augur well for the new company.
ex.zh: 亮眼的銷售數字對這家新公司來說是個好兆頭。

parts.m: increase 增加（一說源自 avis 鳥）

root.note: 古羅馬占卜官觀察飛鳥預測吉凶 → 預示

mn: 常用 augur well / augur ill，表示「是好兆頭／壞兆頭」。

senses.en: relating to St. Augustine or his teachings
a member of a religious order following the rule of St. Augustine

ex.en: The scholar studied the Augustinian idea of original sin.
ex.zh: 那位學者研究聖奧古斯丁的原罪觀。

root.note: 聖奧古斯丁的

senses.en: a distinctive feeling or quality that seems to surround a person or place

ex.en: The old library had an aura of mystery.
ex.zh: 那座老圖書館散發著一股神祕的氣息。

root.note: 周圍的一陣氣息 → 氣氛

senses.en: relating to the ear or to hearing

ex.en: The music exam includes an aural test of rhythm and pitch.
ex.zh: 音樂考試包含節奏和音高的聽力測驗。

root.note: 耳朵的 → 聽覺的

mn: aural（聽覺的）和 oral（口頭的）發音幾乎一樣，要看拼字分辨。

senses.en: the outer part of the ear
an upper chamber of the heart (atrium)

ex.en: The doctor examined the auricle for signs of infection.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查外耳有沒有感染的跡象。

root.note: 小耳朵 → 外耳

senses.en: relating to the ear or hearing
told privately into someone's ear

ex.en: Catholic confession is sometimes called auricular confession because it is spoken privately.
ex.zh: 天主教的告解有時被稱作「耳語告解」，因為是私下說的。

root.note: 耳朵的

senses.en: containing gold

ex.en: Miners flocked to the auriferous hills of California.
ex.zh: 礦工們蜂擁至加州產金的山區。

root.note: 帶有黃金的 → 含金的

senses.en: natural bands of colored light in the sky near the poles
(literary) the dawn

ex.en: We stayed up all night to watch the aurora over Iceland.
ex.zh: 我們整晚不睡，只為了看冰島上空的極光。

parts.m: dawn 黎明（羅馬黎明女神）

root.note: 黎明女神 → 曙光、極光

senses.en: (usually auspices) support or sponsorship
a sign of what will happen; an omen

ex.en: The ancient priest read the flight of birds as a favorable auspice.
ex.zh: 古代祭司把鳥群的飛行視為吉兆。

root.note: 觀察鳥來占卜 → 預兆

mn: 常用片語 under the auspices of，意為「在…的贊助／主辦下」。

senses.en: severe or strict in manner or attitude
plain and without decoration or comfort

ex.en: The monks lived in austere rooms with only a bed and a desk.
ex.zh: 僧侶們住在只有一張床和一張桌子的簡樸房間裡。

parts.m: harsh, dry 嚴酷、乾澀（希臘文）

root.note: 嚴酷乾澀 → 嚴峻、樸素

senses.en: absolute rule by one person; autocracy
economic self-sufficiency (also spelled autarky)

ex.en: Under the emperor's autarchy, no one dared to question his orders.
ex.zh: 在皇帝的專制統治下，沒人敢質疑他的命令。

root.note: 一個人自己統治 → 獨裁

senses.en: real or genuine; not fake
accurate and reliable; true to the original

ex.en: This small restaurant serves authentic Thai food.
ex.zh: 這家小餐館供應道地的泰國菜。

root.note: 自己親手做的 → 真正的

senses.en: the quality of being real, genuine, or true

ex.en: Experts questioned the authenticity of the old letter.
ex.zh: 專家質疑這封舊信的真實性。

root.note: 真正的性質 → 真實性

senses.en: an account of a person's life written by that person

ex.en: In her autobiography, the scientist describes growing up on a farm.
ex.zh: 這位科學家在自傳中描述了她在農場長大的經歷。

root.note: 自己寫自己的生平 → 自傳

senses.en: a system of government in which one person has absolute power

ex.en: The country slowly moved from autocracy toward democracy.
ex.zh: 這個國家慢慢從獨裁走向民主。

root.note: 一個人自己統治 → 獨裁政治

senses.en: a ruler with absolute power; a person who insists on complete obedience

ex.en: The boss ran the office like an autocrat, ignoring everyone's suggestions.
ex.zh: 老闆像獨裁者一樣管理辦公室，對大家的建議一概不理。

root.note: 自己一人說了算的統治者 → 獨裁者

senses.en: a moving mechanical figure or robot
a person who acts mechanically without thinking

ex.en: After the night shift, he moved like an automaton.
ex.zh: 值完夜班後，他整個人像機器人一樣機械地動作。

root.note: 自己會動的東西 → 自動機械

senses.en: having self-government; independent
able to operate without human control

ex.en: The company is testing an autonomous car on city streets.
ex.zh: 那家公司正在市區街道測試自動駕駛汽車。

root.note: 自己訂法則的 → 自治的

senses.en: the right or condition of self-government
freedom to make one's own decisions

ex.en: Teenagers often want more autonomy over their own schedules.
ex.zh: 青少年常希望對自己的時間安排有更多自主權。

root.note: 自己訂法則 → 自治

senses.en: an examination of a dead body to find the cause of death

ex.en: An autopsy showed that the man had died of a heart attack.
ex.zh: 驗屍結果顯示，那名男子死於心臟病發作。

root.note: 親眼看 → 驗屍

senses.en: relating to or typical of autumn
past the prime of life

ex.en: The hills glowed with autumnal shades of red and gold.
ex.zh: 山丘閃耀著紅色和金色的秋日色彩。

root.note: 秋天的

senses.en: providing extra help or support
a helper or extra worker; (grammar) a helping verb

ex.en: The hospital has an auxiliary generator in case the power fails.
ex.zh: 醫院有一台備用發電機，以防停電。

root.note: 提供幫助的 → 輔助的

senses.en: a large mass of snow and ice falling rapidly down a mountain
a sudden, overwhelming amount of something

ex.en: The singer received an avalanche of messages after her performance.
ex.zh: 演出之後，那位歌手收到如雪片般湧來的訊息。

root.note: 往山谷落下 → 雪崩

senses.en: extreme greed for wealth or material gain

ex.en: His avarice drove him to cheat his own business partners.
ex.zh: 貪婪驅使他去欺騙自己的生意夥伴。

root.note: 極度渴望（錢財）→ 貪婪

senses.en: to state firmly that something is true

ex.en: The witness continued to aver that she had seen the suspect.
ex.zh: 證人仍然堅稱她看到了那名嫌犯。

root.note: 聲明為真 → 斷言

senses.en: strongly opposed to or disliking something

ex.en: She is not averse to hard work if the pay is fair.
ex.zh: 只要薪水合理，她並不排斥辛苦的工作。

root.note: 把臉轉開 → 厭惡的

mn: 常用片語 be averse to（厭惡、不願意）；別和 adverse（不利的）搞混。

senses.en: a strong dislike

ex.en: My cat has a strong aversion to water.
ex.zh: 我的貓非常討厭水。

root.note: 想轉身離開 → 厭惡

senses.en: to prevent something bad from happening
to turn away one's eyes or thoughts

ex.en: Quick action by the pilot helped avert a disaster.
ex.zh: 機長的迅速反應避免了一場災難。

root.note: 使轉開 → 避開

senses.en: a large cage or building for keeping birds

ex.en: The zoo's aviary houses parrots from around the world.
ex.zh: 動物園的鳥園飼養了來自世界各地的鸚鵡。

root.note: 養鳥的地方 → 鳥舍

senses.en: extreme eagerness or enthusiasm

ex.en: She read mystery novels with an avidity that amazed her friends.
ex.zh: 她看推理小說的熱切程度令朋友們吃驚。

root.note: 渴望的狀態 → 熱切

senses.en: a hobby or activity done in addition to one's regular job

ex.en: She is a lawyer by profession, but her avocation is painting.
ex.zh: 她的職業是律師，但她的嗜好是畫畫。

root.note: 被召喚離開本業的事 → 副業、嗜好

mn: vocation 是本業，a-vocation 是本業之外的嗜好。

senses.en: to declare openly and firmly

ex.en: The candidate will avow his support for the new law at tonight's rally.
ex.zh: 這位候選人將在今晚的造勢大會上公開表態支持新法。

root.note: 對眾人發誓 → 公開聲明

senses.en: to wake up or cause to wake up
to make someone aware of or interested in something

ex.en: A trip to the museum helped awaken her interest in history.
ex.zh: 一趟博物館之旅喚起了她對歷史的興趣。

root.note: 使醒來 → 喚醒

senses.en: away from the expected course; wrong
out of the normal position; crooked

ex.en: Their camping trip went awry when a storm blew away the tent.
ex.zh: 暴風雨把帳篷吹走後，他們的露營之旅就全亂了套。

root.note: 扭曲的 → 歪斜、出錯

mn: 常用 go awry，意為「出差錯」。

senses.en: yes (used in voting or in some dialects)
a vote in favor

ex.en: When the chair asked for votes, most members answered "aye."
ex.zh: 主席要求表決時，大多數成員都回答「贊成」。

senses.en: a flowering shrub with bright pink, red, or white blossoms

ex.en: Every spring, the azalea in our yard bursts into pink flowers.
ex.zh: 每年春天，我們院子裡的杜鵑花都會盛開粉紅色的花朵。

root.note: 長在乾燥土壤中的花 → 杜鵑花

senses.en: bright blue like a clear sky
a bright blue color

ex.en: The boat floated on the calm azure sea.
ex.zh: 小船漂浮在平靜蔚藍的海面上。

parts.m: lapis lazuli 青金石（波斯文 lazward）

root.note: 青金石的顏色 → 天藍色

senses.en: relating to Francis Bacon or his method of reasoning from observation
senses.zh: 培根（學說）的；經驗歸納法的

ex.en: Early scientists followed the Baconian method of gathering facts before forming theories.
ex.zh: 早期科學家遵循培根的方法，先蒐集事實再建立理論。

parts.m: 英國哲學家法蘭西斯・培根

root.note: 培根的

senses.en: a single-celled microorganism (plural: bacteria)

ex.en: This bacterium can survive in boiling hot springs.
ex.zh: 這種細菌能在滾燙的溫泉中存活。

root.note: 最早觀察到的細菌呈小棍狀 → 細菌

mn: bacterium 是單數，bacteria 是複數。

senses.en: to repeatedly and annoyingly ask someone to do something
a heavily built animal with black and white stripes that lives in burrows

ex.en: The kids continued to badger their parents for a new puppy.
ex.zh: 孩子們不斷纏著爸媽要養新的小狗。

senses.en: to totally confuse or puzzle someone

ex.en: The strange symptoms continue to baffle doctors.
ex.zh: 這些奇怪的症狀持續讓醫生們百思不解。

senses.en: an officer who keeps order in a courtroom
(British) an official who takes property to pay debts

ex.en: The bailiff asked everyone in the courtroom to rise.
ex.zh: 法警請法庭上所有人起立。

root.note: 負責看管的人 → 法警

senses.en: a thick green woolen cloth used to cover pool and card tables

ex.en: The billiard table was covered in fresh green baize.
ex.zh: 撞球桌鋪上了嶄新的綠色粗呢。

senses.en: a large bundle of hay, cotton, or other material tied tightly
to make into bales

ex.en: The farmer lifted a heavy bale of hay onto the truck.
ex.zh: 農夫把一大捆沉重的乾草抬上卡車。

senses.en: threatening harm; menacing

ex.en: The guard dog gave us a baleful stare from behind the fence.
ex.zh: 看門狗從籬笆後面兇狠地瞪著我們。

root.note: 充滿惡意的

senses.en: a poem or song that tells a story
a slow, romantic popular song

ex.en: The singer ended the concert with a quiet love ballad.
ex.zh: 歌手以一首輕柔的抒情情歌為演唱會收尾。

root.note: 原指伴舞的歌 → 歌謠

senses.en: a sweet-smelling oily substance from certain trees, used in medicine
something that soothes or heals

ex.en: The healer rubbed a soothing balsam on the wound.
ex.zh: 醫者在傷口上抹了一層舒緩的香膏。

senses.en: so ordinary or overused as to be boring
senses.zh: 陳腔濫調的；平庸乏味的

ex.en: The movie was full of banal dialogue and predictable jokes.
ex.zh: 這部電影充滿陳腔濫調的台詞和老套的笑話。

senses.en: a song traditionally sung by Venetian gondoliers, or music in that style

ex.en: The pianist played a gentle barcarole that sounded like rocking waves.
ex.zh: 鋼琴家彈奏了一首輕柔的船歌，聽起來就像搖晃的波浪。

root.note: 船夫唱的歌 → 船歌

senses.en: a male singing voice between tenor and bass, or a singer with this voice

ex.en: He sang the role in a rich, warm baritone.
ex.zh: 他用渾厚溫暖的男中音演唱這個角色。

root.note: 低沉的聲調 → 男中音

senses.en: a barometer that records changes in air pressure on paper

ex.en: The barograph showed a sharp drop in pressure before the storm.
ex.zh: 自記氣壓計顯示暴風雨來臨前氣壓急遽下降。

root.note: 把氣壓寫下來的儀器 → 自記氣壓計

senses.en: an instrument that measures air pressure
something that shows changes in public opinion or conditions

ex.en: Consumer spending is a useful barometer of the economy's health.
ex.zh: 消費支出是衡量經濟是否健康的實用指標。

root.note: 測量氣壓的儀器

senses.en: except for; if something does not happen

ex.en: Barring any delays, the train will arrive at noon.
ex.zh: 如果沒有延誤，火車將在中午抵達。

root.note: 把某事擋在外面 → 除…之外

senses.en: to lie in warmth and sunlight for pleasure
to enjoy praise or attention

ex.en: Lizards bask on warm rocks to raise their body temperature.
ex.zh: 蜥蜴躺在溫暖的石頭上曬太陽，提高體溫。

senses.en: the lowest male singing voice; the lowest range of musical sound
a bass guitar or double bass
[bæs] a kind of freshwater or sea fish

ex.en: He plays bass in a jazz band on weekends.
ex.zh: 他週末在一個爵士樂團裡彈貝斯。

mn: 當「低音、貝斯」時唸 [bes]（同 base），當「鱸魚」時唸 [bæs]。

senses.en: to pour juices or melted fat over meat while it cooks
to sew with long, loose, temporary stitches

ex.en: Remember to baste the turkey every thirty minutes.
ex.zh: 記得每三十分鐘在火雞上淋一次油。

senses.en: a thin stick used by a conductor to lead an orchestra
a short stick passed between runners in a relay race
a police officer's club

ex.en: The last runner dropped the baton just before the finish line.
ex.zh: 最後一棒的跑者在終點線前掉了接力棒。

mn: pass the baton 可比喻「交棒、傳承責任」。

senses.en: a large military unit made up of several companies
a large group of people

ex.en: A battalion of soldiers was sent to help after the flood.
ex.zh: 一個營的士兵被派去協助水災救援。

root.note: 打仗的隊伍 → 營

senses.en: a long, narrow strip of wood used to hold something in place
to fasten or secure with strips of wood

ex.en: Before the typhoon, we had to batten down the windows.
ex.zh: 颱風來之前，我們得先把窗戶釘牢。

mn: batten down the hatches 原指船員封好艙口，比喻「做好迎接困難的準備」。

senses.en: to hit repeatedly and violently
a mixture of flour, eggs, and milk used in cooking
(baseball) the player trying to hit the ball

ex.en: Huge waves continued to batter the coast all night.
ex.zh: 巨浪整晚不停地猛烈拍打著海岸。

root.note: 反覆地打 → 猛擊

senses.en: a small, cheap decorative object

ex.en: She hung a shiny bauble on the Christmas tree.
ex.zh: 她在聖誕樹上掛了一顆亮晶晶的小飾品。

senses.en: to cry loudly
to shout or call out loudly

ex.en: The baby began to bawl as soon as the plane took off.
ex.zh: 飛機一起飛，嬰兒就開始放聲大哭。

mn: bawl out someone 是口語，表示「痛罵某人」。

senses.en: (in the Catholic Church) to declare a dead person blessed, a step toward sainthood
to make extremely happy

ex.en: The pope will beatify the nun at a ceremony next year.
ex.zh: 教宗將在明年的典禮上為這位修女宣福。

root.note: 使成為有福的人 → 宣福

senses.en: supreme happiness or blessedness
(the Beatitudes) the blessings spoken by Jesus in the Sermon on the Mount

ex.en: The saint's face in the painting shows a look of calm beatitude.
ex.zh: 畫中聖人的臉上流露出平靜的至福神情。

root.note: 有福的狀態 → 至福

senses.en: a boyfriend or male admirer (old-fashioned)

ex.en: Grandma still keeps the letters from her first beau.
ex.zh: 奶奶至今還保存著初戀男友寫給她的信。

root.note: 俊美的男子 → 男朋友

senses.en: (of a sailing ship) to be unable to move because there is no wind
to make calm

ex.en: A sudden loss of wind could becalm the sailboat for hours.
ex.zh: 風突然停了，帆船可能會停在原地好幾個小時。

root.note: 使平靜 → 因無風而停航

senses.en: a gesture calling someone, as in "at someone's beck and call"
(northern England) a small stream

ex.en: He expects his assistants to be at his beck and call day and night.
ex.zh: 他要求助理們日夜隨傳隨到。

root.note: 招手示意

mn: 幾乎只用在片語 at someone's beck and call（隨叫隨到）。

senses.en: to smear or cover with something sticky or dirty

ex.en: The toddlers managed to bedaub the walls with finger paint.
ex.zh: 那群幼兒竟然用手指畫顏料把牆壁塗得亂七八糟。

root.note: 到處塗抹 → 弄髒

senses.en: to decorate lavishly

ex.en: Volunteers will bedeck the streets with flags for the festival.
ex.zh: 志工們會在街上掛滿旗子，為節慶做裝飾。

root.note: 到處裝飾

senses.en: a scene of uproar and confusion

ex.en: When the fire alarm went off, the cafeteria turned into bedlam.
ex.zh: 火災警報一響，餐廳立刻陷入一片混亂。

parts.m: Bethlehem 伯利恆（倫敦一家精神病院的俗稱）

root.note: 舊時倫敦的瘋人院 → 混亂吵鬧的場面

senses.en: to confuse or make unclear
to cover with fog

ex.en: Too much technical language can befog the main point of an argument.
ex.zh: 太多專業術語會讓論點的重點變得模糊。

root.note: 使籠罩在霧中 → 使模糊

senses.en: to become a friend to someone, especially someone who needs help
senses.zh: 與…交朋友；照顧（需要幫助的人）

ex.en: She made an effort to befriend the new student from Japan.
ex.zh: 她主動和從日本來的新同學交朋友。

root.note: 使成為朋友

senses.en: to cause or give rise to
(old use) to become the father of

ex.en: Violence tends to beget more violence.
ex.zh: 暴力往往會招致更多暴力。

root.note: 產生出 → 招致

senses.en: to envy someone for something they have
to give something reluctantly

ex.en: I don't begrudge her the award; she worked hard for it.
ex.zh: 我不嫉妒她得獎，那是她努力換來的。

root.note: 心懷怨恨 → 嫉妒

senses.en: (old use) to make late; to delay

ex.en: The old diary complains that storms would often belate the mail coach.
ex.zh: 那本舊日記抱怨，暴風雨常常讓郵車延誤。

root.note: 使變遲 → 延誤

mn: 現代幾乎只用形容詞 belated（遲來的），例如 a belated birthday gift。

senses.en: to secure a climber or rope with a safety line
(nautical, as a command) to stop

ex.en: Her partner will belay her while she climbs the rock wall.
ex.zh: 她攀爬岩壁時，她的搭檔會幫她確保。

root.note: 把繩子牢牢固定 → 確保

senses.en: to give a false impression of; to hide the true nature of
to show something to be false

ex.en: His calm smile could not belie the fear in his eyes.
ex.zh: 他平靜的笑容掩飾不了眼中的恐懼。

root.note: （外表）說謊 → 給人假象

senses.en: to accept that something is true
to think or suppose

ex.en: I can't believe how fast this summer went by.
ex.zh: 真不敢相信這個暑假過得這麼快。

senses.en: to make someone or something seem unimportant

ex.en: Good coaches never belittle players for making mistakes.
ex.zh: 好的教練從不因球員犯錯而貶低他們。

root.note: 使變小 → 貶低

senses.en: a beautiful woman, especially the most beautiful at an event
senses.zh: 美女；（場合中）最美的女子

ex.en: In her red gown, she was the belle of the ball.
ex.zh: 穿著紅色禮服的她是舞會上最美的女子。

root.note: 美麗的女子

senses.en: eager to fight or argue; aggressive

ex.en: The leader's bellicose speech worried neighboring countries.
ex.zh: 那位領導人好戰的演說讓鄰國感到憂心。

root.note: 傾向戰爭的 → 好戰的

senses.en: hostile and aggressive
engaged in a war
a nation or person engaged in war or conflict

ex.en: The belligerent customer shouted at the cashier.
ex.zh: 那位充滿敵意的顧客對著收銀員大吼。

root.note: 進行戰爭的 → 好鬥的

senses.en: to express sadness or complaint about something

ex.en: Many teachers bemoan the lack of funding for the arts.
ex.zh: 許多老師抱怨藝術教育的經費不足。

root.note: 一直呻吟 → 哀嘆

senses.en: a prayer asking for God's blessing, especially at the end of a service

ex.en: The priest ended the ceremony with a benediction.
ex.zh: 神父以祝禱結束了儀式。

root.note: 說好話 → 祝福

senses.en: a person who gives money or other help to a person or cause

ex.en: An anonymous benefactor donated a million dollars to the school library.
ex.zh: 一位匿名捐助者捐了一百萬美元給學校圖書館。

root.note: 做好事的人 → 捐助者

senses.en: a church position that provides a priest with income or property

ex.en: The young priest was given a small benefice in a country parish.
ex.zh: 那位年輕神父獲派到鄉下教區擔任一個小小的有俸聖職。

root.note: 給予的好處 → 聖俸

senses.en: doing good or causing good to be done; generous

ex.en: A beneficent donor paid for the new library wing.
ex.zh: 一位慈善的捐助者出資興建了圖書館的新側館。

root.note: 做好事的 → 行善的

mn: beneficent（做好事的）重點在行動；benevolent（善意的）重點在心意。

senses.en: favorable or advantageous; producing good results

ex.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to both body and mind.
ex.zh: 規律運動對身心都有益。

root.note: 帶來好處的 → 有益的

senses.en: a person who gains or benefits from something
a person who receives money or property from a will or insurance

ex.en: She was named the sole beneficiary of her uncle's will.
ex.zh: 她被指定為叔叔遺囑的唯一受益人。

root.note: 得到好處的人 → 受益者

senses.en: an advantage or helpful result
to receive help or gain an advantage; to be good for
money provided by the government or an employer

ex.en: Regular exercise has many health benefits, and everyone can benefit from it.
ex.zh: 規律運動對健康有許多好處，每個人都能從中受益。

root.note: 做得好的事 → 好處

senses.en: the quality of being kind and generous

ex.en: The old king was known for his wisdom and benevolence.
ex.zh: 那位老國王以智慧和仁慈聞名。

root.note: 懷著好的意願 → 仁慈

senses.en: well-meaning and kindly; generous in helping others

ex.en: A benevolent stranger paid for the family's groceries.
ex.zh: 一位好心的陌生人替這家人付了買菜的錢。

root.note: 懷著好的意願 → 仁慈的

senses.en: gentle and kindly
(of a disease or tumor) not harmful

ex.en: The doctor was relieved to find that the tumor was benign.
ex.zh: 醫生發現腫瘤是良性的，鬆了一口氣。

parts.m: good 好（在這個字裡拼成 beni）

root.note: 天生善良 → 和善的、良性的

senses.en: kind and gracious, especially toward those of lower rank
favorable or beneficial

ex.en: The queen gave the children a benignant smile.
ex.zh: 女王對孩子們露出慈祥的微笑。

root.note: 天性善良的 → 慈祥的

senses.en: kindness and gentleness

ex.en: Her grandmother's benignity made every visitor feel welcome.
ex.zh: 她奶奶的慈祥讓每位訪客都覺得備受歡迎。

root.note: 天性善良 → 慈祥

senses.en: (literary) a blessing

ex.en: The rain after the long drought felt like a benison to the farmers.
ex.zh: 久旱之後的雨，對農民來說就像一份祝福。

root.note: 源自 benediction → 祝福

senses.en: to leave property to someone in a will
to pass something on to future generations

ex.en: She plans to bequeath her house to her nephew.
ex.zh: 她打算把房子遺贈給她的姪子。

root.note: （在遺囑中）說明給誰 → 遺贈

senses.en: to deprive someone of a close relative or friend through death

ex.en: The war would bereave thousands of families of their sons.
ex.zh: 這場戰爭會讓成千上萬的家庭失去兒子。

root.note: 被奪走 → 喪失親人

mn: 最常見形容詞 bereaved（喪親的），例如 the bereaved family。

senses.en: a bed on a ship or train
a place where a ship stays in port
to bring a ship into a berth

ex.en: I slept in the upper berth on the overnight train.
ex.zh: 我在夜車上睡上鋪。

mn: give someone a wide berth 意為「遠遠避開某人」。

senses.en: to ask someone urgently and emotionally; to beg

ex.en: I beseech you to reconsider before it is too late.
ex.zh: 我懇求你在一切太遲之前重新考慮。

root.note: 極力尋求 → 懇求

senses.en: to trouble or threaten persistently
to surround or attack from all sides

ex.en: Money problems continue to beset the small company.
ex.zh: 財務問題持續困擾著這家小公司。

root.note: 四面都被放了東西 → 包圍、困擾

senses.en: to smear with something dirty or sticky
to damage someone's reputation

ex.en: Rumors could besmear the good name of an honest man.
ex.zh: 謠言可能玷汙一個誠實之人的好名聲。

root.note: 到處塗抹 → 弄髒

senses.en: cruel or savage like a wild animal

ex.en: The prisoners suffered bestial treatment at the hands of the guards.
ex.zh: 囚犯遭到守衛野蠻的對待。

root.note: 像野獸的 → 野蠻的

senses.en: to scatter things over a surface

ex.en: The flower girls will bestrew the aisle with rose petals.
ex.zh: 花童們會在走道上撒滿玫瑰花瓣。

root.note: 到處撒 → 撒滿

senses.en: to sit or stand with one leg on each side of
to dominate or tower over

ex.en: The knight had to bestride his horse in heavy armor.
ex.zh: 騎士必須穿著笨重的盔甲跨上馬背。

root.note: 大步跨上 → 跨坐

senses.en: (old use) to think about or remind oneself of something

ex.en: Before you act, bethink yourself of the consequences.
ex.zh: 行動之前，先想想後果。

root.note: 仔細想 → 想起

senses.en: (old use) to happen or happen to

ex.en: Woe betide anyone who arrives late to her class.
ex.zh: 誰上她的課遲到，誰就要倒大楣。

root.note: 發生、降臨

mn: 幾乎只用在 woe betide...（…要倒楣了）。

senses.en: (old use) early; in good time

ex.en: The farmer rose betimes to milk the cows.
ex.zh: 農夫一早就起床擠牛奶。

root.note: 在時間之內 → 及時、早

senses.en: to formally promise someone in marriage

ex.en: In the old story, the king plans to betroth his daughter to a prince.
ex.zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，國王打算把女兒許配給一位王子。

root.note: 立下誓約 → 訂婚

senses.en: a formal agreement to marry; an engagement

ex.en: The two families celebrated the betrothal with a large feast.
ex.zh: 兩個家族舉辦盛宴慶祝這樁婚約。

root.note: 訂婚這件事

senses.en: a sloping edge or surface
to cut a sloping edge on something

ex.en: The carpenter used a plane to bevel the edge of the table.
ex.zh: 木匠用刨刀把桌緣刨成斜角。

senses.en: to confuse someone completely

ex.en: The long list of rules may bewilder new players.
ex.zh: 一長串的規則可能會讓新玩家摸不著頭緒。

root.note: 使迷路 → 使困惑

senses.en: a list of books and sources used or referred to in a piece of writing

ex.en: Remember to include a bibliography at the end of your research paper.
ex.zh: 記得在研究報告最後附上參考書目。

root.note: 寫下書的清單 → 參考書目

senses.en: an extreme passion for collecting books

ex.en: His bibliomania filled every room of the house with old books.
ex.zh: 他的藏書癖讓家裡每個房間都堆滿了舊書。

root.note: 對書的狂熱 → 藏書癖

senses.en: a person who loves or collects books

ex.en: As a true bibliophile, she spends every weekend in used bookstores.
ex.zh: 身為真正的愛書人，她每個週末都泡在二手書店裡。

root.note: 愛書的人

senses.en: fond of drinking alcohol

ex.en: The novel's bibulous uncle is always asking for another glass of wine.
ex.zh: 小說裡那位嗜酒的叔叔總是再要一杯酒。

root.note: 愛喝的 → 嗜酒的

senses.en: (old use) to remain or wait

ex.en: She decided to bide her time until the right job came along.
ex.zh: 她決定靜待時機，直到合適的工作出現。

mn: 常用片語 bide one's time，意為「靜待時機」。

senses.en: happening every two years
a plant that lives for two years; an event held every two years

ex.en: The city hosts a biennial art festival that draws visitors from abroad.
ex.zh: 這座城市每兩年舉辦一次藝術節，吸引國外遊客。

root.note: 兩年的 → 兩年一次的

mn: biennial 是兩年一次；biannual 是一年兩次。

senses.en: a stand on which a coffin or dead body is placed before burial

ex.en: The coffin rested on a bier covered with flowers.
ex.zh: 棺木停放在鋪滿鮮花的棺架上。

senses.en: a person who marries someone while already married to another

ex.en: The court discovered that the man was a bigamist with two families.
ex.zh: 法院發現這名男子是重婚者，有兩個家庭。

root.note: 有兩段婚姻的人 → 重婚者

senses.en: the crime of marrying someone while already married to another

ex.en: Bigamy is illegal in most countries.
ex.zh: 在大多數國家，重婚是違法的。

root.note: 兩段婚姻 → 重婚

senses.en: a long, gradual curve in a coastline; a wide bay
a loop in a rope

ex.en: The fishing village sits on a sheltered bight of the coast.
ex.zh: 這座漁村位於海岸一處避風的海灣。

senses.en: involving two sides or two parties, especially two countries
affecting both sides of the body

ex.en: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement.
ex.zh: 兩國簽署了雙邊貿易協定。

root.note: 兩邊的 → 雙邊的

senses.en: able to speak two languages fluently; written in two languages

ex.en: Growing up in Montreal, she became bilingual in French and English.
ex.zh: 在蒙特婁長大的她，法語和英語都說得很流利。

root.note: 兩種語言的 → 雙語的

senses.en: an early type of motion-picture projector
(rare) a short biography

ex.en: Crowds in 1900 paid a nickel to watch films on the biograph.
ex.zh: 1900 年的觀眾花五分錢，觀看用早期放映機播放的影片。

root.note: 記錄生動的畫面 → 早期電影放映機

senses.en: an account of someone's life written by another person

ex.en: I just finished reading a biography of Marie Curie.
ex.zh: 我剛讀完一本居禮夫人的傳記。

root.note: 寫下一個人的生平 → 傳記

senses.en: the scientific study of living things

ex.en: In biology class, we looked at plant cells under a microscope.
ex.zh: 在生物課上，我們用顯微鏡觀察植物細胞。

root.note: 研究生命的學問 → 生物學

senses.en: an animal that walks on two feet

ex.en: Humans are the only biped among the great apes that always walks upright.
ex.zh: 人類是大型猿類中唯一總是直立行走的兩足動物。

root.note: 兩隻腳的動物

senses.en: a right or privilege that a person has from birth

ex.en: Many believe that a good education should be every child's birthright.
ex.zh: 許多人認為良好的教育應該是每個孩子與生俱來的權利。

root.note: 出生就有的權利

senses.en: anger and resentment because of unfair treatment
a sharp, unpleasant taste

ex.en: Years later, she still felt bitterness about losing the job.
ex.zh: 多年後，她對丟掉那份工作仍然心懷怨恨。

root.note: 苦的狀態 → 苦味、怨恨

senses.en: to speak disrespectfully about God or sacred things

ex.en: In the village, it was considered a crime to blaspheme in public.
ex.zh: 在那個村子裡，公開褻瀆神明被視為犯罪。

root.note: 說壞話 → 褻瀆

senses.en: done openly and obviously, without shame

ex.en: Copying the whole essay from the internet was a blatant act of cheating.
ex.zh: 把整篇文章從網路上抄下來，是明目張膽的作弊行為。

senses.en: a large, strong fire
to burn brightly and strongly
a very bright display of light or color

ex.en: Firefighters worked all night to put out the blaze.
ex.zh: 消防員徹夜奮戰撲滅大火。

mn: blaze a trail 意為「開路；開創先河」。

senses.en: to display or announce something prominently
a coat of arms or its formal description

ex.en: The team will blazon its logo across every jersey and banner.
ex.zh: 球隊會把隊徽印在每件球衣和旗幟上大肆展示。

senses.en: (of a place) bare, cold, and unwelcoming
without hope or encouragement

ex.en: After the factory closed, the town's future looked bleak.
ex.zh: 工廠關閉後，這個小鎮的未來看起來一片黯淡。

senses.en: a small mark or flaw that spoils appearance
a fault in character or reputation
to spoil the appearance or quality of

ex.en: The scandal left a blemish on his otherwise spotless record.
ex.zh: 那件醜聞在他原本無瑕的紀錄上留下了一個汙點。

senses.en: showing a casual and careless lack of concern
(literary) happy and carefree

ex.en: He showed a blithe disregard for the rules.
ex.zh: 他對規則一副毫不在乎的樣子。

senses.en: (literary) cheerful and lighthearted

ex.en: The blithesome song of the birds filled the spring morning.
ex.zh: 春天的早晨充滿了鳥兒歡快的歌聲。

root.note: 快樂的

senses.en: the act of sealing off a place to stop goods or people from entering or leaving
to seal off a place in this way

ex.en: The navy set up a blockade to stop supplies from reaching the port.
ex.zh: 海軍實施封鎖，阻止補給運進港口。

root.note: 阻擋的行動 → 封鎖

senses.en: a ship's officer in charge of equipment and the deck crew

ex.en: The boatswain shouted orders to the sailors on deck.
ex.zh: 水手長對甲板上的水手們大聲下令。

root.note: 船上管事的人 → 水手長

mn: 拼法很長，唸法卻只有 [ˋbosṇ]，也常拼成 bosun。

senses.en: the part of a dress above the waist

ex.en: The wedding dress had a lace bodice and a long skirt.
ex.zh: 這件婚紗有蕾絲上身和長裙襬。

senses.en: relating to the body
by taking hold of the whole body; physically

ex.en: The attack caused serious bodily harm to the victim.
ex.zh: 這次攻擊對受害者造成嚴重的身體傷害。

root.note: 身體的

senses.en: noisy, energetic, and cheerful

ex.en: The boisterous crowd cheered every time the home team scored.
ex.zh: 主隊每次得分，喧鬧的觀眾就歡聲雷動。

senses.en: the trunk of a tree

ex.en: The old oak had a bole so wide that four people couldn't reach around it.
ex.zh: 那棵老橡樹的樹幹粗到四個人都環抱不住。

senses.en: a Spanish dance in triple time, or music for it
a short, open jacket ending above the waist

ex.en: The orchestra played Ravel's famous bolero to close the concert.
ex.zh: 管弦樂團演奏拉威爾著名的波麗露舞曲為音樂會作結。

senses.en: the round seed pod of cotton or flax

ex.en: Each cotton boll splits open to reveal soft white fibers.
ex.zh: 每個棉鈴裂開後，就露出柔軟的白色纖維。

senses.en: to support or strengthen
a long, thick pillow

ex.en: The coach's speech helped bolster the team's confidence before the final.
ex.zh: 教練的談話在決賽前幫忙提振了球隊的信心。

root.note: 用長枕墊高 → 支撐、加強

senses.en: a device designed to explode and cause damage
to attack with bombs
(informal) to fail badly

ex.en: Police cleared the building after a bomb threat.
ex.zh: 接到炸彈威脅後，警方疏散了整棟大樓。

senses.en: to attack continuously with bombs or shells
to direct a large number of questions or messages at someone

ex.en: Reporters began to bombard the actor with questions.
ex.zh: 記者們開始連番向那位演員提問。

root.note: 用炸彈不斷攻擊 → 砲轟

senses.en: a member of a bomber crew who aims and releases the bombs

ex.en: The bombardier waited for the signal before releasing the bombs.
ex.zh: 投彈手等到信號後才投下炸彈。

root.note: 負責砲轟的人 → 轟炸手

senses.en: high-sounding language with little meaning, used to impress

ex.en: Behind all the bombast, the politician offered no real plan.
ex.zh: 在那些浮誇的言詞背後，這位政客提不出任何實際的計畫。

root.note: 原指塞衣服的棉絮 → 塞滿空話的言詞

senses.en: rough and bad-mannered

ex.en: His boorish behavior at dinner embarrassed everyone.
ex.zh: 他在晚餐時的粗魯行為讓大家都很尷尬。

root.note: 像粗人一樣的 → 粗魯的

senses.en: to make someone feel tired and uninterested
a dull or tiresome person or thing
to make a hole with a drill

ex.en: I don't want to bore you with every detail of my trip.
ex.zh: 我不想用旅途中的每個細節讓你聽得厭煩。

senses.en: a town or district with its own local government

ex.en: Brooklyn is the most populous borough of New York City.
ex.zh: 布魯克林是紐約市人口最多的行政區。

senses.en: a woman's chest
a place of warmth, love, and protection
(of a friend) very close

ex.en: The two girls have been bosom friends since kindergarten.
ex.zh: 這兩個女孩從幼稚園起就是知心好友。

senses.en: relating to plants or the study of plants

ex.en: We saw rare orchids at the botanical garden.
ex.zh: 我們在植物園看到了稀有的蘭花。

root.note: 植物的

senses.en: to study or collect plants in their natural habitat

ex.en: The students went to the mountains to botanize for their science project.
ex.zh: 學生們上山採集植物做科學專題。

root.note: 研究植物

senses.en: the scientific study of plants

ex.en: She studied botany and now works at a seed bank.
ex.zh: 她學植物學，現在在種子銀行工作。

root.note: 研究植物的學問

senses.en: large in quantity; abundant
giving generously

ex.en: Good weather led to a bountiful harvest this year.
ex.zh: 好天氣讓今年大豐收。

root.note: 充滿豐盛的 → 豐富的

senses.en: to remove parts of a book or play considered improper or offensive

ex.en: The publisher decided to bowdlerize the novel for younger readers.
ex.zh: 出版社決定為年輕讀者刪改這部小說中不雅的部分。

root.note: 鮑德勒曾刪改莎士比亞劇作中的不雅內容 → 刪改

senses.en: a person who bowls, as in bowling or cricket
senses.zh: 打保齡球的人；（板球）投球手

senses.en: a hard black felt hat with a round top (bowler hat)

ex.en: The best bowler on our team scored over 250 points.
ex.zh: 我們隊上最厲害的保齡球選手打了超過兩百五十分。

root.note: 滾球的人

senses.en: to refuse to buy, use, or take part in something as a protest
an act of boycotting

ex.en: Students decided to boycott the cafeteria until prices dropped.
ex.zh: 學生們決定抵制學生餐廳，直到價格調降為止。

root.note: 1880 年愛爾蘭佃農集體孤立一位叫 Boycott 的經理 → 抵制

senses.en: (Scottish) a steep hillside or slope

ex.en: Sheep grazed on the green brae above the river.
ex.zh: 羊群在河邊高處的青翠山坡上吃草。

senses.en: a person who boasts too much

ex.en: Nobody likes a braggart who talks only about his own success.
ex.zh: 沒人喜歡只會談論自己成就的吹牛大王。

root.note: 愛吹噓的人

senses.en: to wave something, especially a weapon, in a threatening or excited way

ex.en: The robber began to brandish a knife at the cashier.
ex.zh: 搶匪開始對著收銀員揮舞刀子。

root.note: 揮劍 → 揮舞

senses.en: a bold show of confidence meant to impress or hide fear

ex.en: His bravado disappeared the moment the roller coaster started.
ex.zh: 雲霄飛車一開動，他的逞強就消失得無影無蹤。

root.note: 假裝勇敢 → 虛張聲勢

senses.en: used to express approval of a performer

ex.en: The audience stood up and shouted "Bravo!" at the end of the opera.
ex.zh: 歌劇結束時，觀眾起立高喊「太棒了！」

parts.m: brave, excellent 勇敢、傑出（義大利文）

root.note: 喝采聲

senses.en: (of a donkey) to make a loud, harsh cry
to laugh or speak loudly and harshly

ex.en: We could hear the donkey bray from across the field.
ex.zh: 我們在田野另一邊都聽得到驢子的叫聲。

senses.en: to join metal pieces using melted brass or another alloy

ex.en: The mechanic will braze the broken pipe instead of replacing it.
ex.zh: 技師會用銅焊把斷掉的管子接起來，而不是換新的。

root.note: 用黃銅接合 → 銅焊

senses.en: a metal container holding burning coals for heat or cooking

ex.en: The guards warmed their hands over a glowing brazier.
ex.zh: 守衛們在燒得通紅的火盆上烤手取暖。

senses.en: an act of breaking a law, rule, or agreement
a gap or break in a wall or barrier
to break through or break a rule

ex.en: Sharing the secret documents was a serious breach of trust.
ex.zh: 洩漏機密文件是嚴重的背信行為。

mn: breach（違反、缺口）和 breech（臀部、槍膛）發音相同，別搞混。

senses.en: a large wave that breaks into white foam on the shore
a person or device that breaks something

ex.en: Surfers waited for the next big breaker to roll in.
ex.zh: 衝浪客等待下一道大浪打過來。

root.note: 打碎在岸上的浪

senses.en: the back part of a gun barrel
(old use) the buttocks; a breech birth is a baby born feet or bottom first

ex.en: The soldier loaded a shell into the breech of the cannon.
ex.zh: 士兵把砲彈裝進大砲的砲尾。

senses.en: (old or formal plural of brother) fellow members of a group or religion

ex.en: The farmers stood with their brethren in the neighboring towns.
ex.zh: 農民們與鄰近城鎮的同胞站在一起。

root.note: brother 的古式複數

senses.en: the use of few words; conciseness
shortness of time

ex.en: The speech was praised for its brevity and clarity.
ex.zh: 這場演講以簡潔清楚而受到讚賞。

root.note: 短的性質 → 簡潔、短暫

mn: 莎士比亞名言：Brevity is the soul of wit.（簡潔是智慧的靈魂。）

senses.en: small decorative objects of little value

ex.en: Her shelves were crowded with bric-a-brac from her travels.
ex.zh: 她的架子上擺滿了旅行帶回來的小擺設。

root.note: 隨便湊來的小東西 → 小擺設

senses.en: the straps on a horse's head used to control it
to show sudden anger or offense
to bring under control

ex.en: She put the bridle on the horse before the ride.
ex.zh: 騎馬前，她先幫馬套上馬勒。

senses.en: a large military unit made up of several battalions
a group of people organized for a purpose

ex.en: The fire brigade arrived within minutes of the call.
ex.zh: 消防隊接到電話後幾分鐘內就趕到了。

senses.en: a military officer who commands a brigade

ex.en: The brigadier inspected the troops before the parade.
ex.zh: 准將在閱兵前檢閱部隊。

root.note: 指揮一個旅的人 → 旅長

senses.en: a member of a gang that robs travelers in forests or mountains

ex.en: Travelers feared being robbed by a brigand on the mountain pass.
ex.zh: 旅人們害怕在山口遭到土匪搶劫。

senses.en: (old use) sulfur

ex.en: The preacher warned of fire and brimstone for those who sinned.
ex.zh: 傳道人警告犯罪的人將遭受烈火與硫磺的懲罰。

root.note: 會燃燒的石頭 → 硫磺

mn: fire and brimstone 常用來形容「地獄般的懲罰」或激烈的說教。

senses.en: water with a lot of salt in it, used for preserving food
(literary) the sea

ex.en: Soak the cucumbers in brine for a week to make pickles.
ex.zh: 把小黃瓜泡在鹽水裡一週就能做成醃黃瓜。

senses.en: a short, stiff hair on an animal or brush
to react angrily or defensively
(bristle with) to be full of something

ex.en: She began to bristle when he criticized her work in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 他當眾批評她的工作時，她立刻火冒三丈。

senses.en: a female figure with a helmet, shield, and trident that symbolizes Britain; the Latin name for Britain
senses.zh: 不列顛尼亞（英國的擬人化象徵；不列顛的拉丁名）

ex.en: Old British coins show Britannia holding a shield and trident.
ex.zh: 英國舊硬幣上印著手持盾牌和三叉戟的不列顛尼亞女神。

root.note: 不列顛的拉丁名

senses.en: a word or phrase typical of British English

ex.en: "Queue" instead of "line" is a common Briticism.
ex.zh: 用 queue 而不是 line，是很常見的英式用語。

root.note: 英國特有的用語

senses.en: hard but easily broken
(of a person or situation) fragile or unstable; sharp and tense

ex.en: Old bones become brittle and break easily.
ex.zh: 老化的骨頭會變脆，很容易骨折。

senses.en: to raise a difficult subject for discussion
to pierce or open a container to draw out liquid

ex.en: I wasn't sure how to broach the topic of money with my parents.
ex.zh: 我不知道要怎麼跟爸媽提起錢的事。

mn: broach（提出話題）和 brooch（胸針）同音。

senses.en: to send out a program on television or radio
a radio or television program
to tell something to many people

ex.en: The station will broadcast the game live tonight.
ex.zh: 電視台今晚將現場直播這場比賽。

root.note: 原指大範圍撒種子 → 廣播

senses.en: a heavy, ankle-high work shoe

ex.en: The farmer laced up each muddy brogan before heading to the barn.
ex.zh: 農夫把沾滿泥巴的粗工作鞋一隻隻繫好，才去穀倉。

root.note: 粗鞋

senses.en: a strong regional accent, especially Irish or Scottish
senses.zh: （愛爾蘭、蘇格蘭等的）鄉音；口音

senses.en: a strong leather shoe with decorative holes

ex.en: The old fisherman spoke with a thick Irish brogue.
ex.zh: 那位老漁夫說話帶著濃濃的愛爾蘭口音。

senses.en: the business of a broker; a company that buys and sells for clients
the fee charged by a broker

ex.en: She opened an account with an online brokerage to buy stocks.
ex.zh: 她在一家網路證券商開戶買股票。

root.note: 經紀人的業務或費用

senses.en: a reddish-brown liquid chemical element with a strong smell (Br)

ex.en: Bromine is one of the few elements that is liquid at room temperature.
ex.zh: 溴是少數在室溫下呈液態的元素之一。

root.note: 氣味難聞的元素 → 溴

senses.en: inflammation of the tubes that carry air to the lungs

ex.en: His cold turned into bronchitis, and he coughed for weeks.
ex.zh: 他的感冒轉成支氣管炎，咳了好幾個星期。

root.note: 支氣管發炎

senses.en: either of the two main tubes that carry air from the windpipe to the lungs (plural: bronchi)

ex.en: The scan showed a small blockage in the left bronchus.
ex.zh: 掃描顯示左側支氣管有輕微阻塞。

root.note: 氣管的分支 → 支氣管

senses.en: a decorative pin worn on clothing

ex.en: She wore her grandmother's silver brooch on her coat.
ex.zh: 她在外套上別著奶奶的銀胸針。

mn: brooch 雖然拼 oo，卻唸 [o]，和 broach 同音。

senses.en: friendship and loyalty between people
an organization or group of people with common interests

ex.en: The soldiers felt a deep sense of brotherhood after the war.
ex.zh: 戰後，士兵們之間有著深厚的袍澤之情。

root.note: 兄弟的關係 → 情誼

senses.en: to frighten someone into doing something with threats or harsh words

ex.en: The manager tried to browbeat his staff into working late.
ex.zh: 經理試圖威逼員工加班。

root.note: 皺眉瞪人來打壓 → 恫嚇

senses.en: abrupt and short in speech or manner; rudely brief

ex.en: The doctor's brusque manner made the patient feel ignored.
ex.zh: 醫生冷淡唐突的態度讓病人覺得被忽視。

senses.en: a person who acts in a silly way to make people laugh; a fool

ex.en: He acted like a buffoon at the party to get attention.
ex.zh: 他在派對上像個小丑一樣耍寶，只為了引人注意。

senses.en: silly or foolish behavior meant to be funny

ex.en: The teacher had no patience for buffoonery during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試期間，老師完全無法容忍耍寶的行為。

root.note: 小丑的行為

senses.en: round or bulging in shape
(of a plant) growing from a bulb

ex.en: The cartoon character had a bulbous red nose.
ex.zh: 那個卡通角色有個圓鼓鼓的紅鼻子。

root.note: 像球莖的 → 圓鼓鼓的

senses.en: a young castrated bull

ex.en: The farmer used a bullock to pull the heavy cart.
ex.zh: 農夫用一頭閹牛拉那輛沉重的車。

root.note: 小公牛

senses.en: a tall grasslike plant that grows in or near water

ex.en: A heron stood still among the bulrush at the edge of the pond.
ex.zh: 一隻蒼鷺靜靜地站在池塘邊的蘆葦叢中。

root.note: 大型的燈心草

senses.en: a defensive wall
a person or thing that protects or defends

ex.en: A free press is a bulwark against government corruption.
ex.zh: 新聞自由是對抗政府貪腐的堡壘。

senses.en: a bar at the front or back of a car that protects it in a crash
unusually large or plentiful

ex.en: Farmers expect a bumper crop of apples this year.
ex.zh: 農民預計今年蘋果會大豐收。

root.note: 承受碰撞的東西 → 保險桿

senses.en: irritatingly self-important and pushy

ex.en: The bumptious new intern kept telling senior staff how to do their jobs.
ex.zh: 那個自以為是的新實習生一直教資深員工怎麼做事。

root.note: 到處碰撞、強出頭 → 自以為是的

senses.en: to do a task badly or clumsily

ex.en: If you rush the job, you might bungle it completely.
ex.zh: 如果你急著完成，可能會把事情全搞砸。

senses.en: the ability to float in water or air
cheerfulness; the ability to recover quickly
(of an economy) a high level of activity

ex.en: Salt water has greater buoyancy than fresh water.
ex.zh: 鹹水的浮力比淡水大。

root.note: 像浮標一樣浮起的能力 → 浮力

senses.en: able to float
cheerful and optimistic
(of an economy or market) strong and active

ex.en: Despite the bad news, she remained buoyant and hopeful.
ex.zh: 儘管聽到壞消息，她依然樂觀並充滿希望。

root.note: 像浮標一樣浮著的 → 能漂浮的；心情輕快的

senses.en: a government department or an office for a particular type of business
a chest of drawers or a writing desk

ex.en: The weather bureau issued a warning about the coming typhoon.
ex.zh: 氣象局針對即將來襲的颱風發布警報。

parts.m: desk, cloth 書桌、桌布（法文）

root.note: 桌子 → 辦公的地方 → 局

senses.en: a system of government run by many officials with complicated rules
too many complicated rules and procedures

ex.en: Getting a permit took months because of all the bureaucracy.
ex.zh: 因為層層的官僚程序，申請許可證花了好幾個月。

root.note: 由辦公室統治 → 官僚體制

senses.en: (historical) a citizen of a town or borough with full rights; an elected representative

ex.en: In colonial Virginia, each county elected a burgess to the assembly.
ex.zh: 在殖民時期的維吉尼亞，每個郡都會選出一名議員進入議會。

root.note: 城鎮的居民 → 市民

senses.en: (old use) a citizen of a town, especially a wealthy middle-class one

ex.en: The painting shows a proud Dutch burgher in a black coat.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪一位身穿黑外套、神情自豪的荷蘭市民。

root.note: 城鎮裡的人 → 市民

senses.en: to polish metal by rubbing
to improve someone's image or reputation

ex.en: The company hired a PR firm to burnish its image after the scandal.
ex.zh: 醜聞過後，公司聘請公關公司來提升形象。

parts.m: brown, shine 棕色、發亮（古法文 brunir）

root.note: 使發亮 → 擦亮

senses.en: a person who manages the money of a school or college

ex.en: Students must pay their fees at the bursar's office before classes begin.
ex.zh: 學生必須在開學前到會計室繳交學費。

root.note: 掌管錢包的人 → 財務主管

senses.en: to move around in a busy, energetic way
excited and noisy activity

ex.en: I love the hustle and bustle of the night market.
ex.zh: 我喜歡夜市熙熙攘攘的熱鬧氣氛。

mn: 常見片語 hustle and bustle，意為「熙來攘往、熱鬧忙碌」。

senses.en: to hit with the head or horns
a person who is often mocked
the thick end of a tool or weapon; the end of a cigarette

ex.en: He was tired of being the butt of everyone's jokes.
ex.zh: 他受夠了一直當大家的笑柄。

mn: butt in 是口語的「插嘴、干涉」。

senses.en: an isolated hill with steep sides and a flat top

ex.en: A red rock butte rose sharply from the desert floor.
ex.zh: 一座紅色岩石的平頂孤山從沙漠地面陡然聳起。

senses.en: a structure built against a wall to support it
to support or strengthen an argument or idea

ex.en: She used data from three studies to buttress her argument.
ex.zh: 她用三項研究的數據來支持她的論點。

senses.en: a rule made by a local authority or an organization for its members

ex.en: A city by-law bans loud music after ten at night.
ex.zh: 一條市府規章禁止晚上十點後大聲播放音樂。

parts.m: town 城鎮（古北歐語 býr）

root.note: 城鎮自訂的法律 → 地方法規

senses.en: a small secret group plotting to gain political power

ex.en: A cabal of advisers secretly controlled the king's decisions.
ex.zh: 一群顧問組成的小圈子暗中操控國王的決策。

parts.m: kabbalah 猶太神祕教義（希伯來文）

root.note: 神祕教義 → 祕密小團體

senses.en: secret or mystical teachings, especially the Jewish Kabbalah; the use of obscure symbols
senses.zh: 神祕教義；（猶太）卡巴拉學說

ex.en: The old manuscript was full of cabalism and strange symbols.
ex.zh: 那份古老手稿充滿了神祕教義和奇怪的符號。

root.note: 神祕教義的學說

senses.en: a cupboard with shelves or drawers
the group of senior ministers who advise a head of government

ex.en: The president met with his cabinet to discuss the crisis.
ex.zh: 總統與內閣開會討論這場危機。

root.note: 小房間 → 櫥櫃；密室議事 → 內閣

senses.en: a harsh, unpleasant mixture of sounds

ex.en: The cacophony of car horns made it impossible to think.
ex.zh: 此起彼落的汽車喇叭聲吵得讓人沒辦法思考。

root.note: 難聽的聲音 → 噪音

senses.en: very pale, thin, and bony, like a corpse
senses.zh: 面如死灰的；骨瘦如柴的

ex.en: After months of illness, he looked cadaverous.
ex.zh: 病了幾個月後，他看起來形容枯槁。

root.note: 像屍體的 → 面如死灰的

senses.en: the rise and fall of the voice in speaking
a rhythm or beat; (music) the ending of a phrase

ex.en: The soothing cadence of her voice helped the children fall asleep.
ex.zh: 她聲音溫柔的抑揚頓挫讓孩子們漸漸入睡。

root.note: 聲音的起落 → 抑揚頓挫

senses.en: a showy solo passage in a concerto for a soloist to display skill

ex.en: The violinist played a dazzling cadenza near the end of the concerto.
ex.zh: 小提琴家在協奏曲接近尾聲時演奏了一段炫目的華彩樂段。

root.note: 源自 cadence，出現在樂曲收尾之前 → 華彩樂段

senses.en: (old use) a cowardly or despicable person
cowardly and base

ex.en: In the old ballad, the caitiff runs away and leaves his friends to fight alone.
ex.zh: 在那首古老的歌謠裡，那個懦夫逃走了，讓朋友們獨自作戰。

root.note: 俘虜 → 可憐人 → 卑鄙的人

senses.en: to persuade someone by flattery or gentle urging

ex.en: She tried to cajole her brother into lending her his car.
ex.zh: 她想用好話哄哥哥把車借給她。

senses.en: the use of flattery or coaxing to persuade someone

ex.en: No amount of cajolery could change the stubborn old man's mind.
ex.zh: 再多的甜言蜜語也改變不了那個固執老人的心意。

root.note: 哄騙的行為

senses.en: able to be measured or calculated

ex.en: The risk is small but calculable.
ex.zh: 風險雖小，但可以估算出來。

root.note: 可以計算的

senses.en: the branch of mathematics dealing with rates of change and areas
a particular method of reasoning or calculation
a hard stone formed in the body

ex.en: She is taking calculus in her senior year of high school.
ex.zh: 她高三要修微積分。

parts.m: limestone, pebble 石灰石、小石子

root.note: 古羅馬人用小石子計算 → 微積分

senses.en: a hard, thick area of skin; a callus
lack of feeling; insensitivity

ex.en: Years of guitar playing left a callosity on each fingertip.
ex.zh: 多年彈吉他在每根指尖都留下了一層老繭。

root.note: 皮膚變硬 → 老繭

senses.en: young and inexperienced; immature

ex.en: He was a callow youth when he first arrived in the big city.
ex.zh: 他初到大城市時，還是個少不更事的年輕人。

senses.en: a unit for measuring the energy value of food

ex.en: A can of soda contains nearly 150 calories, so check the calorie count first.
ex.zh: 一罐汽水大約含一百五十大卡，所以先看看熱量標示。

root.note: 熱量單位

senses.en: a false statement made to damage someone's reputation

ex.en: The senator dismissed the accusation as pure calumny.
ex.zh: 那位參議員駁斥這項指控純屬誹謗。

parts.m: trick, deceive 欺騙（拉丁文 calvi）

root.note: 欺騙性的言論 → 誹謗

senses.en: the hill outside Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified
(calvary) an experience of great suffering

ex.en: The painting shows three crosses on the hill of Calvary.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪了各各他山上的三座十字架。

root.note: 「髑髏地」之意

mn: Calvary（各各他）和 cavalry（騎兵）字母順序很像，別搞混。

senses.en: the Protestant teachings of John Calvin, stressing God's power and predestination

ex.en: Calvinism had a strong influence on the Puritans of New England.
ex.zh: 喀爾文主義對新英格蘭的清教徒影響深遠。

root.note: 喀爾文的學說

senses.en: to convert to or make consistent with Calvinism

ex.en: Reformers hoped to Calvinize the churches of Scotland.
ex.zh: 宗教改革者希望讓蘇格蘭的教會改信喀爾文主義。

root.note: 使成為喀爾文派

senses.en: past tense of come
a thin grooved strip of lead that holds pieces of glass in a stained-glass window

ex.en: The artist bent each lead came to hold the small pieces of colored glass.
ex.zh: 藝術家把每根鉛條彎好，用來固定一片片的彩色玻璃。

mn: 這裡收錄的是名詞「鉛條」的罕用義；平常看到的 came 是 come 的過去式。

senses.en: a small part in a film or play played by a famous actor
a piece of jewelry with a raised carved design

ex.en: The author made a cameo appearance in the film version of her book.
ex.zh: 作者在她的小說改編電影中客串演出。

senses.en: an organized series of actions to achieve a goal
a series of military operations
to work in an organized way toward a goal

ex.en: The students started a campaign to reduce plastic waste at school.
ex.zh: 學生們發起一項減少校園塑膠垃圾的運動。

root.note: 原指在野外作戰 → 戰役 → 活動

senses.en: a member of the ancient people living in Canaan before the Israelites
relating to Canaan or its people

ex.en: Archaeologists found a Canaanite temple buried under the city.
ex.zh: 考古學家在城市底下發現一座迦南神廟。

root.note: 迦南的人

senses.en: a small yellow songbird often kept as a pet
bright yellow

ex.en: Miners once used a canary to detect poisonous gas underground.
ex.zh: 礦工過去會用金絲雀來偵測地底的毒氣。

root.note: 原產於加那利群島的鳥 → 金絲雀

mn: a canary in a coal mine 比喻「危險的早期警訊」。

senses.en: truthful and direct; frank
(of a photo) taken informally, without the subject posing

ex.en: Thank you for your candid feedback on my essay.
ex.zh: 謝謝你對我的文章提出坦率的意見。

root.note: 純白無瑕的 → 坦率的

senses.en: the quality of being open and honest

ex.en: I appreciated her candor when she told me my essay needed more work.
ex.zh: 她坦白告訴我作文還需要修改，我很感謝她的直率。

root.note: 潔白發亮 → 純潔、坦白（candle 蠟燭同源）

senses.en: relating to dogs
a dog; a pointed tooth between the incisors and molars

ex.en: The airport uses a canine unit to sniff out illegal drugs.
ex.zh: 機場用緝毒犬隊來嗅出非法藥物。

root.note: 狗的

senses.en: a general rule or principle by which something is judged
a collection of works considered the most important or genuine
a church law; a clergyman of a cathedral

ex.en: Shakespeare's plays are central to the canon of English literature.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞的劇作是英國文學經典的核心。

parts.m: rule, measuring rod 規則、量尺（希臘文）

root.note: 量尺 → 標準 → 公認的經典

mn: canon（準則、經典）和 cannon（大砲）只差一個 n。

senses.en: insincere talk about moral or religious matters
the special language of a particular group; jargon
to tilt or slope

ex.en: His speech about honesty was just empty cant.
ex.zh: 他那篇關於誠實的演說只不過是虛偽的空話。

parts.m: sing, chant 唱（拉丁文 cantare）

root.note: 像唸經般重複的話 → 偽善言詞

senses.en: a musical work for voices and instruments, often on a religious subject

ex.en: The choir performed a Bach cantata at the Christmas concert.
ex.zh: 合唱團在聖誕音樂會上演唱了一首巴哈的清唱劇。

root.note: 唱的作品 → 清唱劇

senses.en: one of the main divisions of a long poem

ex.en: We read the first canto of Dante's Inferno in class.
ex.zh: 我們在課堂上讀了但丁《地獄篇》的第一章。

root.note: 一段歌 → 長詩的一章

senses.en: a military camp or quarters, especially a permanent one

ex.en: The soldiers returned to the cantonment after a week of training.
ex.zh: 士兵們在一週訓練後回到營區。

root.note: 劃出來駐紮的區域 → 營地

senses.en: having a lot of space inside; roomy

ex.en: She carried everything she needed in one capacious bag.
ex.zh: 她把所有需要的東西都裝進一個容量很大的包包裡。

root.note: 能容納很多的 → 寬敞的

senses.en: any of the tiny blood vessels connecting arteries and veins
very thin like a hair; relating to capillaries

ex.en: Oxygen passes from each capillary into the surrounding cells.
ex.zh: 氧氣從每一條微血管進入周圍的細胞。

root.note: 細如毛髮的 → 微血管

senses.en: to stop resisting and give in to an opponent or demand

ex.en: After a long strike, the company was forced to capitulate to the workers' demands.
ex.zh: 經過長期罷工，公司被迫屈服於工人的要求。

root.note: 按條款談定（投降條件）→ 投降

senses.en: a sudden, unexplained change of mind or behavior

ex.en: The schedule changed at the manager's caprice, confusing everyone.
ex.zh: 行程隨著經理一時興起而變動，讓大家無所適從。

parts.m: goat 山羊（一說 capo 頭）

root.note: 像山羊亂跳般 → 反覆無常

senses.en: a title or short explanation under a picture
words shown on screen during a film or video

ex.en: She wrote a funny caption for the photo of her dog.
ex.zh: 她為狗狗的照片寫了一段有趣的說明。

root.note: 抓住重點的文字 → 標題

senses.en: tending to find fault or raise petty objections

ex.en: The captious critic complained about every tiny detail of the film.
ex.zh: 那位吹毛求疵的影評人對電影的每個小細節都有意見。

root.note: 愛抓別人小辮子的 → 吹毛求疵的

senses.en: to attract and hold the attention or interest of

ex.en: The magician's tricks never fail to captivate young audiences.
ex.zh: 魔術師的把戲總能迷住年輕觀眾。

root.note: 使成為俘虜 → 迷住

senses.en: the dead body of an animal
the remaining framework of something

ex.en: Vultures circled above the carcass of a zebra.
ex.zh: 禿鷹在一具斑馬屍體上空盤旋。

senses.en: relating to the heart

ex.en: The runner collapsed from a sudden cardiac arrest during the race.
ex.zh: 那名跑者在比賽中因突發心臟驟停而倒下。

root.note: 與心臟有關的

senses.en: of the greatest importance; fundamental
a senior official of the Roman Catholic Church
a North American songbird, the male of which is bright red

ex.en: The cardinal rule of the lab is never to eat near the chemicals.
ex.zh: 實驗室最重要的規則就是絕對不要在化學藥品旁邊吃東西。

root.note: 像門軸一樣讓一切運轉 → 最重要的

senses.en: a mark (^) placed below a line to show where something should be inserted

ex.en: The editor drew a caret to show where the missing word belonged.
ex.zh: 編輯畫了一個插入符號，標出漏掉的字該放在哪裡。

parts.m: it lacks 缺少（拉丁文 carere）

root.note: 「這裡缺了東西」→ 插入符號

mn: 別和 carrot（紅蘿蔔）、carat（克拉）搞混，三個字發音幾乎一樣。

senses.en: a picture or description that exaggerates certain features for comic effect
to represent in an exaggerated way

ex.en: The street artist drew a funny caricature of me with a huge head.
ex.zh: 街頭畫家幫我畫了一張大頭的搞笑漫畫像。

parts.m: load, exaggerate 裝載、誇大（義大利文 caricare）

root.note: 把特徵過度加重 → 誇張的漫畫

senses.en: the killing of a large number of people

ex.en: Reporters described the carnage left behind after the bombing.
ex.zh: 記者描述了爆炸後留下的慘烈屠殺景象。

root.note: 一堆血肉 → 大屠殺

senses.en: relating to physical, especially sexual, desires and activities

ex.en: The monks tried to rise above carnal desires through prayer and fasting.
ex.zh: 修士們試圖透過禱告和禁食超越肉體的慾望。

root.note: 屬於肉體的

senses.en: feeding on the flesh of other animals

ex.en: Lions and wolves are carnivorous animals that hunt for food.
ex.zh: 獅子和狼是靠獵食為生的肉食性動物。

root.note: 吃肉的 → 肉食性的

senses.en: to drink alcohol and enjoy oneself noisily with others

ex.en: The sailors went ashore to carouse in the harbor taverns all night.
ex.zh: 水手們上岸，在港口的酒館裡痛飲狂歡了一整夜。

parts.m: drink up 乾杯（德文 gar aus）

root.note: 「全部喝光」→ 狂歡痛飲

senses.en: the decaying flesh of dead animals

ex.en: Vultures circled above, searching for carrion in the desert.
ex.zh: 禿鷹在上空盤旋，在沙漠中尋找腐肉。

root.note: 死掉的肉 → 腐肉

senses.en: firm, flexible tissue found in joints, the nose, and the ears

ex.en: Years of running had worn down the cartilage in her knees.
ex.zh: 多年的跑步磨損了她膝蓋的軟骨。

senses.en: a container holding ink, film, or other material that fits into a device
a case containing a bullet and explosive for a gun

ex.en: The printer stopped working until I replaced the empty ink cartridge.
ex.zh: 印表機停擺，直到我換掉用完的墨水匣才恢復。

senses.en: a hereditary social class, especially in Hindu society

ex.en: In the old system, a person's caste decided what jobs they could hold.
ex.zh: 在舊制度下，一個人的種姓決定了他能從事什麼工作。

root.note: 保持血統純正的群體 → 種姓

senses.en: to criticize or reprimand severely

ex.en: Critics were quick to castigate the director for the film's lazy plot.
ex.zh: 影評人很快就嚴厲批評導演，說這部片的劇情很草率。

parts.m: drive, make 使（拉丁文 agere）

root.note: 使之純潔 → 懲戒、嚴厲糾正

senses.en: relaxed and unconcerned; informal
happening by chance; not regular or permanent

ex.en: You can wear casual clothes to the picnic.
ex.zh: 去野餐可以穿便服。

root.note: 碰巧發生的 → 偶然的、隨意的

senses.en: a person killed or injured in a war or accident
a person or thing harmed as a result of an event

ex.en: The only casualty of the storm was an old oak tree that fell over.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雨唯一的犧牲品是一棵倒下的老橡樹。

root.note: 意外發生的事 → 意外中的傷亡者

senses.en: a whip with nine knotted cords, once used for flogging

ex.en: Sailors who disobeyed orders were once punished with the cat-o'-nine-tails.
ex.zh: 不服從命令的水手，從前會被處以九尾鞭的鞭刑。

senses.en: a large-scale and violent event, such as a flood or war

ex.en: Scientists believe a cataclysm wiped out the dinosaurs.
ex.zh: 科學家認為是一場大災難讓恐龍滅絕。

root.note: 大水往下沖刷 → 大洪水、大災難

senses.en: a clouding of the lens of the eye that blurs vision
a large waterfall

ex.en: After surgery to remove the cataract, my grandmother could read again.
ex.zh: 動了白內障手術之後，我奶奶又能看書了。

root.note: 向下衝的水 → 瀑布；像水幕遮住眼睛 → 白內障

senses.en: an event causing great and sudden damage or suffering

ex.en: The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe for the coastline.
ex.zh: 這次漏油事件對海岸線來說是一場環境浩劫。

root.note: 突然往下翻轉 → 災難

senses.en: the negatively charged electrode of an electrical device

ex.en: In an old television tube, electrons shoot out from the cathode toward the screen.
ex.zh: 在舊式電視的映像管裡，電子從陰極射向螢幕。

root.note: 電流往下走的路 → 陰極

senses.en: the faith, practices, and church of Roman Catholics

ex.en: Catholicism spread across Latin America during the colonial era.
ex.zh: 天主教在殖民時期傳遍拉丁美洲。

root.note: 普世的信仰 → 天主教

senses.en: the quality of including a wide variety of things; broad-mindedness
senses.zh: 廣泛；兼容並蓄；心胸寬大

ex.en: The catholicity of her taste in music surprised her friends.
ex.zh: 她聽音樂的品味之廣泛讓朋友們很驚訝。

root.note: 包含全部 → 廣泛、兼容並蓄

senses.en: a meeting of members of a political party to choose candidates or decide policy
to hold or take part in such a meeting

ex.en: The Iowa caucus is one of the first tests for presidential candidates.
ex.zh: 愛荷華州黨團會議是總統候選人最早面對的考驗之一。

senses.en: relating to or acting as a cause

ex.en: Researchers have not proven a causal link between the drug and the illness.
ex.zh: 研究人員尚未證明這種藥和該疾病之間有因果關係。

root.note: 與原因有關的 → 因果的

mn: 別和 casual（隨意的）搞混：causal 是 cause（原因）的形容詞。

senses.en: able to burn or corrode living tissue by chemical action
sarcastic in a scathing and bitter way

ex.en: The critic's caustic review hurt the young author's feelings.
ex.zh: 評論家尖酸刻薄的書評傷了那位年輕作家的心。

root.note: 會灼燒的 → 腐蝕性的、刻薄的

senses.en: to burn the skin or flesh of a wound to stop bleeding or prevent infection

ex.en: The doctor had to cauterize the wound to stop the bleeding.
ex.zh: 醫生必須燒灼傷口來止血。

parts.m: branding iron 烙鐵（希臘文 kautēr）

root.note: 用烙鐵燙 → 燒灼傷口

senses.en: to give up power or territory, often unwillingly

ex.en: After losing the war, the country was forced to cede part of its land.
ex.zh: 戰敗之後，那個國家被迫割讓部分領土。

root.note: 退讓走開 → 割讓

senses.en: to examine and remove parts of books, films, or news considered unacceptable
an official who examines and removes unacceptable material

ex.en: The government tried to censor news about the protests.
ex.zh: 政府試圖審查有關抗議活動的新聞。

root.note: 負責評估的人 → 審查員

mn: censor 是審查；sensor 是感應器；censure 是譴責，三個字常被混淆。

senses.en: severely critical of others

ex.en: Her censorious neighbors complained about every party she threw.
ex.zh: 她那些愛挑剔的鄰居對她辦的每場派對都有意見。

root.note: 像審查員一樣 → 愛挑剔的

senses.en: an official count of a population

ex.en: The national census is conducted every ten years.
ex.zh: 全國人口普查每十年進行一次。

root.note: 評估人口與財產 → 人口普查

senses.en: the hundredth anniversary of an event

ex.en: The school held a grand celebration for its centenary.
ex.zh: 學校為了百年校慶舉辦了盛大的慶祝活動。

root.note: 一百年 → 百週年

senses.en: a unit of volume equal to one hundredth of a liter
senses.zh: 公撮；釐升（百分之一公升）

ex.en: The recipe calls for one centiliter of vanilla extract.
ex.zh: 這份食譜需要一釐升的香草精。

root.note: 百分之一公升

senses.en: a unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter

ex.en: The seedling grew almost a centimeter overnight.
ex.zh: 幼苗一夜之間長了將近一公分。

root.note: 百分之一公尺

senses.en: a commander of about a hundred soldiers in the ancient Roman army

ex.en: The centurion led his men across the river at dawn.
ex.zh: 百夫長在黎明時率領士兵渡河。

root.note: 統領百人的軍官

senses.en: a grass grown for its grain, such as wheat, rice, or corn
a breakfast food made from grain

ex.en: I usually eat a bowl of cereal with milk for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐通常吃一碗加牛奶的穀片。

root.note: 屬於穀物女神的 → 穀物

mn: 別和 serial（連續的）搞混，兩字同音。

senses.en: relating to or used for formal ceremonies
having a formal role but little real power

ex.en: The king's role today is mostly ceremonial.
ex.zh: 如今國王的角色大多是象徵性的。

root.note: 與儀式有關的

senses.en: excessively formal and polite

ex.en: The butler greeted us with a ceremonious bow.
ex.zh: 管家以極為隆重的鞠躬迎接我們。

root.note: 充滿儀式感的 → 拘泥禮節的

senses.en: the fact or process of stopping

ex.en: Both sides agreed to a cessation of fighting during the holiday.
ex.zh: 雙方同意在假期期間停火。

root.note: 退下、停下 → 停止

senses.en: the formal giving up of rights or territory

ex.en: The treaty required the cession of the island to its neighbor.
ex.zh: 條約規定要把這座島割讓給鄰國。

root.note: 讓出 → 割讓（cede 的名詞）

mn: cession（割讓）與 session（會期）同音。

senses.en: annoyance or embarrassment at having failed or been humiliated

ex.en: To my chagrin, I realized I had worn my sweater inside out all day.
ex.zh: 讓我懊惱的是，我發現自己整天都把毛衣穿反了。

mn: 想成 sha-grin：想笑（grin）卻笑不出來的尷尬懊惱。

senses.en: a lizard that can change the color of its skin
a person who often changes opinions or behavior to suit the situation
senses.zh: 善變的人；見風轉舵的人

ex.en: A political chameleon, he changed his views whenever public opinion shifted.
ex.zh: 他是政治上的變色龍，只要民意一變，他的立場就跟著變。

root.note: 「地上的獅子」→ 變色龍

senses.en: a court of equity; an office for public records

ex.en: The inheritance dispute dragged on in chancery for years.
ex.zh: 這場遺產糾紛在衡平法院拖了好幾年。

senses.en: complete disorder and confusion

ex.en: The power outage caused chaos at the busy train station.
ex.zh: 停電讓繁忙的火車站陷入一片混亂。

root.note: 世界形成前的空無深淵 → 混亂

senses.en: a feature or quality typical of a person, place, or thing
typical of a particular person or thing

ex.en: Patience is a characteristic of every good teacher.
ex.zh: 耐心是每位好老師都有的特質。

root.note: 刻在身上的記號 → 特徵

senses.en: to describe the distinctive nature or features of
to be typical of

ex.en: How would you characterize the mood of the crowd?
ex.zh: 你會怎麼形容群眾的情緒？

root.note: 標出特徵 → 描述特性

senses.en: a person who falsely claims to have special knowledge or skill

ex.en: The so-called healer turned out to be a charlatan selling colored water.
ex.zh: 那個所謂的治療師原來是個賣有色水的江湖騙子。

parts.m: chatter 喋喋不休（義大利文 ciarlare）

root.note: 靠一張嘴說個不停的人 → 騙子

senses.en: a deep crack in the earth
a large difference between people or groups

ex.en: A wide chasm separates the views of the two parties.
ex.zh: 兩黨的看法之間存在巨大的鴻溝。

parts.m: gaping hole 張開的口（希臘文 khasma）

root.note: 大地張開的口 → 深淵、鴻溝

senses.en: to make someone feel sorry for a mistake and behave better
to punish in order to correct

ex.en: Losing the championship seemed to chasten the once-arrogant team.
ex.zh: 輸掉冠軍賽似乎讓這支曾經自大的球隊收斂了許多。

root.note: 使變純潔 → 使悔改、收斂

senses.en: to scold or criticize severely
to punish physically

ex.en: The coach did not chastise the players, but encouraged them instead.
ex.zh: 教練沒有責罵球員，反而鼓勵他們。

root.note: 透過懲罰使人純潔 → 斥責

senses.en: the state of not having sexual relations; purity

ex.en: The nuns took vows of poverty, obedience, and chastity.
ex.zh: 修女們立下了守貧、服從和貞潔的誓願。

root.note: 純潔的狀態 → 貞潔

senses.en: a large French country house or castle

ex.en: We toured an old chateau surrounded by vineyards.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了一座被葡萄園環繞的古老莊園。

parts.m: castle 城堡（法文，源自拉丁文 castellum）

root.note: castle 的法文 → 城堡

senses.en: a personal possession; movable property

ex.en: Under that cruel law, an enslaved person was treated as a chattel.
ex.zh: 在那條殘酷的法律下，奴隸被當作動產看待。

parts.m: property 財產（與 cattle 牲畜同源）

root.note: 古時牲畜就是主要財產 → 動產

senses.en: to examine something to make sure it is correct or safe
to stop or slow the progress of
a written order to a bank to pay money

ex.en: Please check your answers before you hand in the test.
ex.zh: 交卷前請檢查你的答案。

mn: 片語 checks and balances 指「權力制衡」。

senses.en: a light, sheer fabric made of silk or nylon

ex.en: She wore a flowing chiffon dress to the wedding.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件飄逸的雪紡洋裝去參加婚禮。

root.note: 薄如破布的布料 → 雪紡紗

senses.en: the medieval code of knights, valuing bravery, honor, and courtesy
polite and considerate behavior, especially of men toward women

ex.en: Holding the door for others is a small act of chivalry.
ex.zh: 替別人撐住門是一個小小的紳士行為。

root.note: 騎馬的武士 → 騎士精神

senses.en: a serious infectious disease of the intestines spread by dirty water

ex.en: Clean drinking water helped stop the spread of cholera in the city.
ex.zh: 乾淨的飲用水幫助遏止了霍亂在城市裡的傳播。

root.note: 古人以為與膽汁有關的疾病 → 霍亂

senses.en: easily angered; bad-tempered

ex.en: The choleric old man shouted at anyone who stepped on his lawn.
ex.zh: 那個脾氣暴躁的老人會對任何踩到他草坪的人大吼。

root.note: 古人認為黃膽汁過多使人易怒

senses.en: sung by or written for a choir

ex.en: The school's choral group performed at the holiday concert.
ex.zh: 學校的合唱團在節日音樂會上演出。

root.note: 與合唱團有關的

senses.en: the title given to Jesus of Nazareth, meaning "the anointed one"

ex.en: Christians believe that Christ rose from the dead on Easter.
ex.zh: 基督徒相信基督在復活節從死裡復活。

parts.m: anointed 受膏者（希臘文 khristos）

root.note: 被塗油祝聖的人 → 基督

senses.en: to baptize and give a name to a baby
to give a name to something, or use it for the first time

ex.en: They decided to christen the new boat with a bottle of champagne.
ex.zh: 他們決定用一瓶香檳為新船舉行命名典禮。

root.note: 使成為基督徒 → 施洗命名

senses.en: Christians or Christian countries considered as a whole
senses.zh: 基督教世界；全體基督徒

ex.en: In the Middle Ages, Rome was the center of Christendom.
ex.zh: 在中世紀，羅馬是基督教世界的中心。

root.note: 基督徒的領域

senses.en: relating to color or colors
(in music) using notes a half step apart

ex.en: The pianist played a rapid chromatic scale up the keyboard.
ex.zh: 鋼琴家沿著鍵盤快速彈了一段半音階。

root.note: 與顏色有關的

senses.en: the arrangement of events in the order in which they happened

ex.en: The detective carefully rebuilt the chronology of the crime.
ex.zh: 偵探仔細重建了犯罪事件的時間順序。

root.note: 依時間記述 → 年表

senses.en: a very accurate clock, especially one used at sea

ex.en: A reliable chronometer allowed sailors to calculate their longitude.
ex.zh: 可靠的航海鐘讓水手能算出所在的經度。

root.note: 測量時間的儀器

senses.en: a secret way of writing; a code
a person or thing of no importance
the symbol zero (0)

ex.en: The spies sent messages in a cipher that took years to crack.
ex.zh: 間諜用一種花了好幾年才破解的密碼傳送訊息。

parts.m: zero, empty 零、空（阿拉伯文 sifr）

root.note: 原指零 → 數字符號 → 密碼；也指「等於零」的小人物

senses.en: to move continuously through a closed system or area
to pass from person to person or place to place

ex.en: Rumors began to circulate that the factory would close.
ex.zh: 工廠要關閉的謠言開始流傳。

root.note: 繞圈移動 → 循環、流傳

senses.en: the distance around the edge of a circle or round object

ex.en: The circumference of the Earth is about 40,000 kilometers.
ex.zh: 地球的圓周長約四萬公里。

root.note: 繞一圈帶過去的距離 → 周長

senses.en: the use of many words when fewer would do, especially to be vague
senses.zh: 拐彎抹角的說法；迂迴的說詞

ex.en: The spokesman's answer was pure circumlocution with no real information.
ex.zh: 發言人的回答全是拐彎抹角的話，沒有任何實質資訊。

root.note: 繞著圈子說話 → 拐彎抹角

senses.en: to sail or travel all the way around something, especially the world

ex.en: She hopes to circumnavigate the globe in a small sailboat.
ex.zh: 她希望駕著一艘小帆船環遊世界。

root.note: 駕船繞一圈 → 環航

senses.en: to restrict or limit within certain bounds
to draw a line around

ex.en: New laws may circumscribe the power of local governments.
ex.zh: 新法律可能會限制地方政府的權力。

root.note: 在四周畫線 → 限制範圍

senses.en: careful to consider all risks before acting

ex.en: Investors have become more circumspect since last year's market crash.
ex.zh: 去年股市崩盤之後，投資人變得更謹慎了。

root.note: 往四周看清楚 → 謹慎的

senses.en: a fortress, usually on high ground above a city
a place or institution seen as protecting a principle

ex.en: The ancient citadel overlooks the entire valley.
ex.zh: 這座古老的要塞俯瞰整座山谷。

root.note: 城中的小城 → 要塞

senses.en: to quote or mention as evidence or an example
to officially order someone to appear in court

ex.en: Be sure to cite every source you use in your research paper.
ex.zh: 研究報告中用到的每一個資料來源都一定要註明出處。

parts.m: call, set in motion 召喚

root.note: 把證據叫出來 → 引用

mn: cite（引用）、site（地點）、sight（視覺）三字同音。

senses.en: a person who makes a claim, especially for money or a right

ex.en: Each claimant must provide proof of the damage to receive payment.
ex.zh: 每位索賠人必須提出損害證明才能獲得賠償。

root.note: 提出要求的人

senses.en: the supposed ability to see future events or things beyond normal senses

ex.en: She joked that it took clairvoyance to predict what her boss wanted.
ex.zh: 她開玩笑說，要猜到老闆想要什麼得靠千里眼。

root.note: 看得很清楚 → 千里眼

senses.en: making a loud, confused noise
expressing demands or complaints loudly

ex.en: The clamorous crowd demanded to see the singer again.
ex.zh: 吵嚷的群眾大聲要求歌手再次出場。

root.note: 大聲喊叫的 → 吵鬧的

senses.en: a group of families, especially in Scotland, descended from a common ancestor
a close group of people with a common interest

ex.en: The whole clan gathered at grandmother's house for the New Year.
ex.zh: 全家族在過年時聚集到奶奶家。

senses.en: kept secret or done secretly, especially because it is illegal

ex.en: The resistance held clandestine meetings in a basement.
ex.zh: 反抗組織在地下室裡祕密集會。

parts.m: secretly 祕密地（拉丁文 clam）

root.note: 暗中進行的

senses.en: a continuous loud, ringing noise

ex.en: The clangor of the church bells woke the whole village.
ex.zh: 教堂鐘聲響亮的叮噹聲吵醒了整個村莊。

root.note: 響亮的金屬聲

senses.en: to make something clearer or easier to understand

ex.en: Could you clarify what you meant by that comment?
ex.zh: 你可以說明一下那句話是什麼意思嗎？

root.note: 使清楚

senses.en: loud and clear
a medieval trumpet with a shrill, clear sound

ex.en: The speech was a clarion call for action on climate change.
ex.zh: 這場演講是一記呼籲對氣候變遷採取行動的響亮號角。

root.note: 聲音清亮的號角

mn: 常見片語 clarion call：響亮的號召。

senses.en: to arrange in groups according to shared qualities
to officially mark information as secret

ex.en: Biologists classify animals by their physical features.
ex.zh: 生物學家依據身體特徵把動物分類。

root.note: 放進類別 → 分類

senses.en: official permission for something to happen
the removal of unwanted things
the space between two objects

ex.en: The pilot waited for clearance from the control tower before takeoff.
ex.zh: 機長在起飛前等待塔台的許可。

root.note: 清空、放行 → 許可、清除

senses.en: mercy shown in punishing someone, especially by an authority
mildness of weather

ex.en: The prisoner's family begged the governor for clemency.
ex.zh: 囚犯的家人懇求州長寬大處理。

root.note: 溫和地對待 → 寬恕

senses.en: (of weather) mild
merciful

ex.en: We moved the party outdoors to enjoy the clement weather.
ex.zh: 我們把派對移到戶外，享受溫和的好天氣。

root.note: 溫和的

mn: 反義字 inclement weather（惡劣天氣）更常見。

senses.en: (of a sailing ship) with the sails pulled tight to sail as close to the wind as possible

ex.en: The yacht sailed close-hauled into the strong northern wind.
ex.zh: 遊艇迎著強勁的北風搶風航行。

senses.en: a person or company that makes or sells clothes or cloth

ex.en: The old clothier on Main Street still makes suits by hand.
ex.zh: 大街上那家老服裝店至今仍手工縫製西裝。

root.note: 做布、賣衣服的人

senses.en: awkward in movement or handling things
done without skill or tact

ex.en: I am so clumsy that I spilled coffee on my keyboard again.
ex.zh: 我笨手笨腳的，又把咖啡灑在鍵盤上了。

senses.en: a substance that causes a liquid, especially blood, to thicken or clot

ex.en: The nurse applied a coagulant to stop the bleeding quickly.
ex.zh: 護士塗上凝血劑來迅速止血。

root.note: 把液體趕在一起 → 凝結劑

senses.en: to change from a liquid to a thick or solid state

ex.en: Blood begins to coagulate within minutes of a cut.
ex.zh: 割傷後幾分鐘內血液就會開始凝結。

root.note: 聚在一起 → 凝固

senses.en: the process of coming together to form one mass or whole

ex.en: The coalescence of small groups created a powerful national movement.
ex.zh: 許多小團體的結合，形成了一股強大的全國性運動。

root.note: 一起長成一體 → 合併

senses.en: an alliance of groups or parties for combined action

ex.en: Several parties formed a coalition to run the government.
ex.zh: 幾個政黨組成聯盟來組織政府。

root.note: 一起成長的團體 → 聯盟

senses.en: to treat in an overly protective and indulgent way
to cook an egg in water just below boiling

ex.en: Some parents coddle their children and never let them fail.
ex.zh: 有些父母溺愛孩子，從不讓他們經歷失敗。

senses.en: an addition or supplement that changes part of a will

ex.en: A codicil added just before his death left the house to his nurse.
ex.zh: 他臨終前追加的遺囑附錄把房子留給了他的看護。

parts.m: book, code 書、法典（拉丁文 codex）

root.note: 小小的追加條文

senses.en: to force someone to do something by using threats

ex.en: No one should coerce a witness into changing their story.
ex.zh: 任何人都不應該脅迫證人改變證詞。

parts.m: shut in, restrain 關住（拉丁文 arcere）

root.note: 把人圍住 → 強迫

senses.en: the use of force or threats to make someone do something

ex.en: He claimed that he signed the confession under coercion.
ex.zh: 他聲稱自己是在脅迫下簽下自白書的。

root.note: 把人圍住逼迫 → 脅迫

senses.en: using force or threats to make people obey

ex.en: Critics called the new policy coercive and unfair.
ex.zh: 批評者說新政策具有強迫性而且不公平。

root.note: 以圍困逼迫的 → 強制的

senses.en: clear, logical, and convincing
senses.zh: 有說服力的；令人信服的

ex.en: She presented a cogent argument for keeping the library open on weekends.
ex.zh: 她提出很有說服力的論點，主張圖書館週末也要開放。

root.note: 把人推到同一個結論 → 有說服力的

senses.en: (of words) having the same origin as a word in another language
a word that has the same origin as another

ex.en: The English word "night" is a cognate of the German word "Nacht."
ex.zh: 英文的 night 和德文的 Nacht 是同源字。

root.note: 一起出生的 → 同源的

senses.en: having knowledge or awareness of something

ex.en: Drivers should be cognizant of the dangers of texting while driving.
ex.zh: 駕駛人應該意識到開車時傳訊息的危險。

root.note: 完全知道 → 察覺到的

senses.en: to form a unified, logical whole
to stick together

ex.en: Your ideas are interesting, but they do not cohere into a clear argument.
ex.zh: 你的想法很有趣，但無法連貫成一個清楚的論點。

root.note: 黏在一起 → 凝聚、連貫

senses.en: the state of sticking or working together as a unit

ex.en: The team's success came from strong cohesion among its players.
ex.zh: 這支球隊的成功來自球員之間強大的凝聚力。

root.note: 黏在一起 → 凝聚

senses.en: forming a united whole

ex.en: A cohesive essay connects every paragraph to the main idea.
ex.zh: 一篇結構緊密的文章，會把每一段都連結到主旨。

root.note: 黏得很緊 → 有凝聚力的

senses.en: to happen at the same time
to be the same or agree

ex.en: My vacation will coincide with my sister's wedding.
ex.zh: 我的假期剛好和我姐姐的婚禮撞在一起。

root.note: 一起落在同一點上 → 同時發生

senses.en: a surprising occurrence of events at the same time without apparent connection

ex.en: By pure coincidence, we booked seats next to each other on the plane.
ex.zh: 純屬巧合，我們在飛機上訂到了相鄰的座位。

root.note: 一起落下 → 巧合

senses.en: happening at the same time or occupying the same space

ex.en: The rise in sales was coincident with the new advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 銷售額上升和新的廣告宣傳剛好同時發生。

root.note: 一起落下的 → 同時發生的

senses.en: to work together with others on a project
to cooperate traitorously with an enemy

ex.en: Students will collaborate in small groups to design a robot.
ex.zh: 學生們將以小組合作的方式設計一台機器人。

root.note: 一起工作 → 合作

senses.en: to fall down or in suddenly
to fail suddenly and completely
a sudden fall or failure

ex.en: The old bridge could collapse under the weight of a heavy truck.
ex.zh: 那座舊橋可能會在重型卡車的重量下倒塌。

root.note: 整個一起塌下 → 倒塌

senses.en: able to be folded into a smaller shape

ex.en: We packed a collapsible table for the camping trip.
ex.zh: 我們帶了一張可摺疊的桌子去露營。

root.note: 可以收起來的

senses.en: a person one works with in a profession or business

ex.en: I asked a colleague to cover my shift while I was sick.
ex.zh: 我生病時請一位同事幫我代班。

parts.m: choose 選（拉丁文 legare 派遣）

root.note: 一起被選派的人 → 同事

senses.en: done by or shared by all members of a group
a business or group owned and run by its members

ex.en: Cleaning up the park was a collective effort by the whole town.
ex.zh: 清理公園是全鎮居民共同努力的成果。

root.note: 收集在一起的 → 集體的

senses.en: a person who collects things as a hobby
a person whose job is to collect money owed

ex.en: The stamp collector paid a fortune for one rare stamp.
ex.zh: 那位集郵家花了一大筆錢買一張稀有郵票。

root.note: 收集東西的人

senses.en: a college student or recent graduate

ex.en: Every collegian in the dorm stayed up late before final exams.
ex.zh: 期末考前，宿舍裡每個大學生都熬夜到很晚。

root.note: 大學裡的人

senses.en: to hit something violently when moving
to come into conflict

ex.en: Two cars will collide if that driver does not slow down.
ex.zh: 如果那位駕駛不減速，兩輛車就會相撞。

root.note: 撞在一起

senses.en: a coal miner
a ship that carries coal

ex.en: The old collier came home every night covered in black dust.
ex.zh: 那位老礦工每天晚上回家時都滿身黑色煤灰。

root.note: 挖煤的人

senses.en: an instance of two things hitting each other
a conflict between opposing ideas or interests

ex.en: No one was hurt in the collision between the two bikes.
ex.zh: 兩輛腳踏車相撞，沒有人受傷。

root.note: 撞在一起 → 碰撞

senses.en: used in ordinary, informal conversation rather than formal writing

ex.en: Avoid colloquial expressions like "kind of" in your formal essay.
ex.zh: 正式作文裡要避免像 kind of 這類口語用法。

root.note: 大家一起說話時用的 → 口語的

senses.en: a word or phrase used in informal speech

ex.en: "Gonna" is a colloquialism that should not appear in a research paper.
ex.zh: gonna 是口語用法，不應出現在研究報告裡。

root.note: 口語的說法

senses.en: a formal conversation or conference

ex.en: The two scholars held a lively colloquy on the future of democracy.
ex.zh: 兩位學者就民主的未來進行了一場熱烈的對談。

root.note: 一起說話 → 對談

senses.en: secret cooperation in order to cheat or deceive others

ex.en: The two companies were fined for collusion in setting prices.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司因勾結聯合定價而被罰款。

root.note: 一起玩把戲 → 勾結

senses.en: a statue much bigger than life size
a person or thing of enormous size, importance, or ability

ex.en: The tech company has grown into a global colossus.
ex.zh: 這家科技公司已經成長為全球性的龐然大物。

parts.m: giant statue 巨像（希臘文 kolossos）

root.note: 古代羅德島太陽神巨像 → 巨人、巨頭
