senses.en: pleasant to look at; attractive

ex.en: The old ballad tells of a comely maiden who lived by the sea.
ex.zh: 那首老民謠講述一位住在海邊的美麗少女。

senses.en: an item of food
edible

ex.en: The market sold every comestible you could imagine, from cheese to squid.
ex.zh: 這個市場賣各種你想像得到的食物，從起司到魷魚都有。

root.note: 可以吃的 → 食物

senses.en: amusing, especially in a silly or absurd way

ex.en: The puppy looked comical in its oversized raincoat.
ex.zh: 小狗穿著過大的雨衣，看起來好滑稽。

root.note: 像喜劇一樣的 → 滑稽的

senses.en: to honor and remember an important person or event

ex.en: A statue was built to commemorate the soldiers who died in the war.
ex.zh: 人們建造一座雕像來紀念在戰爭中犧牲的士兵。

root.note: 大家一起記住 → 紀念

senses.en: a spoken description of an event as it happens
a set of explanations or opinions about something

ex.en: The film is a sharp commentary on modern social media.
ex.zh: 這部電影是對現代社群媒體的一番犀利評論。

root.note: 用心思寫下的說明 → 評論、註解

senses.en: to mix or blend together

ex.en: In this city, old traditions and new ideas commingle freely.
ex.zh: 在這座城市裡，古老傳統和新觀念自然地交融在一起。

root.note: 混在一起

senses.en: a military department responsible for supplying food

ex.en: The army's commissariat struggled to feed the troops through the winter.
ex.zh: 軍隊的糧食補給部門在整個冬天都很難讓部隊吃飽。

root.note: 負責運送物資的部門

senses.en: a group of people given official authority to do a task
money paid to a salesperson based on sales
to order or authorize the making of something

ex.en: The museum plans to commission a new mural for its entrance.
ex.zh: 博物館打算委託製作一幅新的壁畫放在入口。

root.note: 把任務交付出去 → 委託、委員會

senses.en: dedication to a cause, activity, or relationship
a promise or obligation

ex.en: Learning a language takes real commitment and daily practice.
ex.zh: 學一種語言需要真正的投入和每天的練習。

root.note: 把自己交付出去 → 投入、承諾

senses.en: the act of sending someone to prison or a hospital
the burial of a body

ex.en: The judge ordered the committal of the suspect to a psychiatric hospital.
ex.zh: 法官下令把嫌犯送進精神病院。

root.note: 把人送去某處

senses.en: a raw material or product that can be bought and sold
a useful or valuable thing

ex.en: Oil is the most traded commodity in the world.
ex.zh: 石油是全世界交易量最大的商品。

root.note: 合用的東西 → 商品

mn: 在很多年輕人眼中，時間是最稀缺的 commodity（資源）。

senses.en: a state of noisy confusion or disturbance

ex.en: We heard a commotion outside and ran to the window.
ex.zh: 我們聽到外面一陣騷動，就跑到窗邊看。

root.note: 大家一起亂動 → 騷動

senses.en: to travel regularly between home and work or school
to reduce a sentence of punishment to a less severe one
a regular journey to and from work

ex.en: Many workers commute to the city by train every day.
ex.zh: 很多上班族每天搭火車通勤到市區。

root.note: 改變、交換 → 減刑；定期換地點 → 通勤

senses.en: similar enough to be compared; roughly equal

ex.en: The two phones have comparable prices and features.
ex.zh: 這兩支手機的價格和功能差不多。

root.note: 可放在一起比的 → 相當的

mn: 重音在第一音節：ˋcomparable，不是 comˋparable。

senses.en: measured or judged by comparison with something else; relative
involving the study of similarities and differences

ex.en: After the storm, the town returned to comparative calm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，小鎮恢復了相對的平靜。

root.note: 放在一起比的 → 相對的

senses.en: the act of examining how two or more things are alike or different

ex.en: In comparison with last year, sales have doubled.
ex.zh: 和去年相比，銷售額增加了一倍。

root.note: 放在一起看是否相等 → 比較

senses.en: to pay someone for loss, injury, or work
to make up for something bad or missing

ex.en: He tried to compensate for his slow start by running faster at the end.
ex.zh: 他試著在最後加速，來彌補起跑太慢。

root.note: 一起秤、使兩邊平衡 → 補償

senses.en: the ability to do something successfully or efficiently

ex.en: Nobody questions her competence as a surgeon.
ex.zh: 沒有人質疑她身為外科醫生的能力。

root.note: 足以一起競爭 → 勝任的能力

senses.en: having enough skill or knowledge to do something well

ex.en: She is a competent driver, even in heavy snow.
ex.zh: 即使在大雪中，她也是個稱職的駕駛。

root.note: 能一起追求的 → 能勝任的

senses.en: involving competition
strongly wanting to win
as good as or better than others

ex.en: Getting into a top university has become extremely competitive.
ex.zh: 進入頂尖大學已經變得極為競爭。

root.note: 一起追求同一目標 → 競爭的

senses.en: a person or company that competes against others

ex.en: Each competitor must finish the race within three hours.
ex.zh: 每位參賽者都必須在三小時內跑完全程。

root.note: 一起追求的人 → 競爭者

senses.en: self-satisfaction combined with unawareness of danger

ex.en: Complacence after one success can lead to failure next time.
ex.zh: 一次成功後的自滿，可能導致下一次的失敗。

root.note: 對自己非常滿意 → 自滿

senses.en: too satisfied with oneself and unaware of possible dangers

ex.en: After three straight wins, the team grew complacent and stopped practicing hard.
ex.zh: 連贏三場之後，球隊變得自滿，不再認真練習。

root.note: 對自己非常滿意 → 自滿的

mn: 別和 complaisant（殷勤順從的）搞混：complacent 是對自己滿意，complaisant 是想讓別人滿意。

senses.en: willingness to please others or to accept their wishes

ex.en: His complaisance made him popular, but he rarely stood up for himself.
ex.zh: 他的隨和讓他很受歡迎，但他很少為自己爭取。

root.note: 想讓別人高興 → 殷勤順從

senses.en: willing to please others; obliging

ex.en: The complaisant clerk agreed to every change the customer requested.
ex.zh: 那位殷勤的店員答應了顧客提出的每一項更改。

root.note: 一心讓人高興的 → 殷勤的

mn: complaisant 想讓別人滿意；complacent 是對自己滿意。

senses.en: a thing that completes or goes well with something else
to add to something in a way that improves it

ex.en: The spicy sauce is a perfect complement to the grilled fish.
ex.zh: 這種辣醬和烤魚是絕配。

root.note: 把缺的填滿 → 補充

mn: complEment 讓東西完整（complEte）；complIment 是「I」說好話稱讚你。

senses.en: made of many connected parts; complicated
[ˋkɑmplɛks] a group of related buildings
[ˋkɑmplɛks] an emotional problem or obsession

ex.en: Climate change is a complex problem with no simple solution.
ex.zh: 氣候變遷是個複雜的問題，沒有簡單的解方。

root.note: 交織在一起 → 複雜的

senses.en: willing to obey or agree to others' wishes
meeting rules or standards

ex.en: All new cars must be compliant with the safety regulations.
ex.zh: 所有新車都必須符合安全規範。

root.note: 滿足要求的 → 順從的、合規的

senses.en: to make something more difficult or confusing

ex.en: Please don't complicate the plan by adding more stops.
ex.zh: 請不要再增加停靠點，讓計畫變得更複雜。

root.note: 摺在一起 → 使複雜

senses.en: something that makes a situation more difficult
a secondary medical problem that makes an illness worse

ex.en: The surgery went smoothly without any complication.
ex.zh: 手術進行得很順利，沒有出現任何併發症。

root.note: 摺在一起、糾纏 → 複雜因素、併發症

senses.en: involvement with others in a crime or wrongdoing

ex.en: The guard denied any complicity in the robbery.
ex.zh: 警衛否認與這起搶案有任何共謀關係。

root.note: 被摺進同一件事 → 共謀

senses.en: a polite expression of praise or admiration
[ˋkɑmpləˏmɛnt] to politely praise someone

ex.en: She blushed when he paid her a compliment on her singing.
ex.zh: 他稱讚她歌唱得好時，她臉紅了。

mn: complIment 是「I」說好話稱讚你；complEment 讓東西完整（complEte）。

senses.en: a part of a larger whole, especially of a machine

ex.en: Trust is an essential component of any healthy relationship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何健康關係中不可或缺的要素。

root.note: 放在一起組成整體的東西 → 成分

senses.en: to behave in a particular way
to agree or be consistent with

ex.en: Players are expected to comport themselves with dignity on and off the field.
ex.zh: 球員無論在場內外都應該舉止得體。

root.note: 帶著自己 → 舉止

senses.en: the state of being calm and in control of oneself

ex.en: Even when the crowd booed, the speaker kept her composure.
ex.zh: 即使群眾噓聲四起，演講者依然保持鎮定。

root.note: 把自己擺好、收拾整齊 → 沉著

senses.en: able to be understood

ex.en: The teacher made the difficult theory comprehensible to beginners.
ex.zh: 老師讓初學者也能理解這個艱深的理論。

root.note: 可以抓住的 → 可理解的

senses.en: the ability to understand something

ex.en: The reading comprehension section is the hardest part of the test.
ex.zh: 閱讀理解是這個考試最難的部分。

root.note: 完全抓住意思 → 理解

senses.en: including all or nearly all elements or aspects

ex.en: The guidebook gives a comprehensive list of museums in Paris.
ex.zh: 這本旅遊指南列出了巴黎博物館的完整清單。

root.note: 全部一把抓住 → 全面的

senses.en: to press or squeeze into a smaller space
[ˋkɑmprɛs] a pad pressed on the body to stop bleeding or reduce swelling

ex.en: You can compress the files to save space on your computer.
ex.zh: 你可以壓縮檔案以節省電腦的空間。

root.note: 壓在一起 → 壓縮

senses.en: able to be pressed into a smaller space

ex.en: Gases are compressible, but liquids hardly change in volume.
ex.zh: 氣體可以壓縮，但液體的體積幾乎不變。

root.note: 可以壓在一起的

senses.en: the act of pressing something into a smaller space

ex.en: Video compression lets us stream movies without long delays.
ex.zh: 影片壓縮技術讓我們能串流看電影而不用等很久。

root.note: 壓在一起 → 壓縮

senses.en: to consist of; to be made up of
to make up or form a whole

ex.en: The committee will comprise five teachers and three parents.
ex.zh: 委員會將由五位老師和三位家長組成。

root.note: 一起拿在手中 → 包含

mn: 傳統用法是 A comprises B（A 包含 B），不說 is comprised of，但後者已很常見。

senses.en: a strong, irresistible urge to do something
the act of forcing someone to do something

ex.en: She felt a compulsion to check her phone every few minutes.
ex.zh: 她有一種每隔幾分鐘就想看手機的強烈衝動。

root.note: 用力推動 → 強迫、衝動

senses.en: required by law or rules; mandatory

ex.en: Physical education is compulsory for all first-year students.
ex.zh: 體育課是所有一年級學生的必修課。

root.note: 被強力推著做 → 強制的

senses.en: a feeling of guilt that prevents or follows doing something wrong

ex.en: He lied to his friends without the slightest compunction.
ex.zh: 他對朋友說謊，一點也不內疚。

root.note: 良心被刺痛 → 內疚

senses.en: to calculate a figure or amount

ex.en: The app can compute your total bill including tax and tip.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式可以計算含稅和小費的總金額。

root.note: 一起算 → 計算（computer 同源）

senses.en: to admit that something is true, often unwillingly
to give up or yield, as in a game or election

ex.en: The candidate had to concede defeat late on election night.
ex.zh: 候選人在選舉之夜很晚時不得不承認落敗。

root.note: 完全讓步 → 承認、認輸

senses.en: excessive pride in oneself
a clever or elaborate comparison in literature

ex.en: His conceit made it hard for him to accept any criticism.
ex.zh: 他的自負讓他很難接受任何批評。

root.note: 原指「想法」→ 對自己的過高想法 → 自負

senses.en: to form an idea or plan in the mind
to become pregnant

ex.en: It is hard to conceive of a world without the internet.
ex.zh: 很難想像一個沒有網路的世界。

root.note: 把想法抓進腦中 → 構想；把胎兒懷在身體裡 → 懷孕

senses.en: a musical work for one or more solo instruments and an orchestra

ex.en: The young violinist performed a Mozart concerto with the orchestra.
ex.zh: 那位年輕小提琴家和管弦樂團合奏了一首莫札特協奏曲。

parts.m: agreement, harmony 協調（義大利文）

root.note: 獨奏與樂團協調演出 → 協奏曲

senses.en: something given up or allowed in order to reach agreement
a reduced price for certain groups
the right to sell goods in a certain place

ex.en: The union agreed to a pay freeze as a concession to save jobs.
ex.zh: 工會同意凍薪，作為保住工作機會的讓步。

root.note: 讓步（concede 的名詞）

senses.en: to stop someone from being angry; to win over

ex.en: The manager offered a free meal to conciliate the angry customer.
ex.zh: 經理提供一頓免費餐點來安撫生氣的顧客。

parts.m: council, bring together 召集、會議

root.note: 把人們召集在一起 → 調解、安撫

senses.en: intended to make someone less angry

ex.en: After the argument, she sent him a conciliatory text message.
ex.zh: 吵架之後，她傳了一則求和的簡訊給他。

root.note: 想讓雙方重聚的 → 和解的

senses.en: serving to prove a case; ending doubt

ex.en: The DNA test provided conclusive proof of his innocence.
ex.zh: DNA 檢驗提供了證明他清白的確鑿證據。

root.note: 把爭議完全關上 → 決定性的

senses.en: agreement or harmony between people or groups
a treaty

ex.en: The neighbors have lived in concord for decades.
ex.zh: 這些鄰居幾十年來相處和睦。

root.note: 心在一起 → 和諧

senses.en: an alphabetical index of the words in a book or author's works
agreement

ex.en: The scholar used a concordance to find every time Shakespeare used the word "love."
ex.zh: 學者利用語詞索引，找出莎士比亞每一次使用 love 這個字的地方。

root.note: 一致 → 把相同字詞彙整在一起的索引

senses.en: to agree with an opinion
to happen at the same time

ex.en: Most experts concur that the drug is safe.
ex.zh: 多數專家都同意這種藥是安全的。

root.note: 一起跑向同一方向 → 同意

senses.en: agreement
the fact of two or more things happening at the same time

ex.en: The plan cannot go ahead without the concurrence of the board.
ex.zh: 沒有董事會的同意，這個計畫無法進行。

root.note: 一起跑 → 同意、同時發生

senses.en: existing or happening at the same time

ex.en: He is serving two concurrent sentences of five years each.
ex.zh: 他同時服兩個各五年的刑期。

root.note: 一起跑的 → 同時的

senses.en: a temporary brain injury caused by a blow to the head
a violent shock, as from an explosion

ex.en: The football player suffered a concussion during the game.
ex.zh: 那名美式足球員在比賽中發生腦震盪。

root.note: 猛烈撞擊搖晃 → 腦震盪

senses.en: water that forms on a cold surface when warm air cools
the act of making something shorter or denser

ex.en: Condensation formed on the outside of the cold glass.
ex.zh: 冰涼的杯子外面凝結了一層水珠。

root.note: 變得濃密 → 凝結、濃縮

senses.en: to make shorter or more concise
to change from a gas into a liquid

ex.en: Can you condense your ten-page report into one paragraph?
ex.zh: 你可以把十頁的報告濃縮成一段嗎？

root.note: 使變濃密 → 濃縮

senses.en: to act in a way that shows one feels superior to others
senses.zh: 以高人一等的態度對待

senses.en: to do something one considers beneath one's dignity

ex.en: Good teachers never condescend to their students.
ex.zh: 好老師從不對學生擺出高高在上的姿態。

root.note: 從高處爬下來 → 屈尊、擺架子

senses.en: an expression of sympathy, especially when someone has died

ex.en: Please accept my deepest condolence on the loss of your father.
ex.zh: 令尊過世，請接受我最深切的慰問。

root.note: 一起悲傷 → 弔唁

mn: 常用複數片語 offer one's condolences（表達慰問）。

senses.en: to help to bring about a result

ex.en: Regular sleep and exercise conduce to good health.
ex.zh: 規律的睡眠和運動有助於身體健康。

root.note: 一起引向某結果 → 有助於

senses.en: making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible

ex.en: A noisy dorm is not conducive to studying.
ex.zh: 吵雜的宿舍不利於讀書。

root.note: 引向好結果的 → 有助於

mn: 固定搭配 be conducive to：有助於。

senses.en: able to conduct heat or electricity

ex.en: Copper is highly conductible, so it is used in electrical wires.
ex.zh: 銅的傳導性很好，所以被用在電線中。

root.note: 能引導（電、熱）通過的

senses.en: a channel or pipe for carrying water or protecting wires
a person or organization that passes things between others

ex.en: The charity acts as a conduit for donations to disaster victims.
ex.zh: 這個慈善團體是把捐款轉交給災民的管道。

root.note: 引導東西通過的通道

senses.en: sweets and candy considered as a group
a shop that sells sweets

ex.en: The window of the confectionery was filled with colorful chocolates.
ex.zh: 糖果店的櫥窗擺滿了五顏六色的巧克力。

root.note: 把材料一起做成的甜食

senses.en: a league or alliance of states or groups
(the Confederacy) the southern states that left the U.S. in 1860–61

ex.en: The tribes formed a loose confederacy to defend their lands.
ex.zh: 這些部落組成一個鬆散的聯盟來保衛土地。

root.note: 一起立約 → 聯盟

senses.en: a person one works with, especially secretly or illegally; an accomplice
joined by an agreement or treaty
[kənˋfɛdəˏret] to bring into an alliance

ex.en: The thief escaped with the help of a confederate waiting in a car.
ex.zh: 小偷在車上等候的同夥協助下逃走了。

root.note: 一起立約的人 → 同夥

senses.en: to discuss something together in order to decide
to give a title, degree, or right

ex.en: The university will confer an honorary degree on the scientist.
ex.zh: 大學將頒授榮譽學位給那位科學家。

root.note: 把意見帶到一起 → 商議；把榮譽帶給人 → 授予

senses.en: a person who attends a conference
a person on whom something is conferred

ex.en: Each conferee received a name badge and a schedule at the door.
ex.zh: 每位與會者在門口都領到名牌和議程表。

root.note: 參與商議或被授予的人

senses.en: a priest who hears confessions
a person to whom one tells secrets

ex.en: The old priest had been the village confessor for forty years.
ex.zh: 那位老神父在村裡聽告解已經四十年了。

root.note: 聽人坦白的人

senses.en: a person one trusts with private matters

ex.en: My older sister has always been my closest confidant.
ex.zh: 我姐姐一直是我最親密的知己。

root.note: 完全信任的人 → 知己

mn: 別和 confident（有自信的）搞混；confidant 重音在最後。

senses.en: to tell someone a secret because you trust them

ex.en: She decided to confide in her teacher about the bullying.
ex.zh: 她決定向老師吐露被霸凌的事。

root.note: 完全信任對方 → 吐露心事

senses.en: belief in one's own abilities
trust in someone or something
a secret told to someone

ex.en: Practice will give you the confidence to speak in public.
ex.zh: 練習會給你在公開場合說話的自信。

root.note: 完全的信任 → 信心

senses.en: feeling sure about oneself or about something

ex.en: I am confident that we will finish the project on time.
ex.zh: 我確信我們會準時完成這個專案。

root.note: 充滿信任的 → 有自信的

senses.en: the state of being kept in a closed space, such as a prison
the period around giving birth

ex.en: The prisoner spent a month in solitary confinement.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯被單獨監禁了一個月。

root.note: 限制在界線內 → 監禁

senses.en: to take someone's property with authority, often as punishment

ex.en: Teachers may confiscate phones that are used during class.
ex.zh: 老師可以沒收上課時使用的手機。

root.note: 收進國庫 → 沒收

senses.en: a large, destructive fire
a large-scale conflict or war

ex.en: A small spark grew into a conflagration that destroyed the forest.
ex.zh: 一點小火星演變成一場燒毀整片森林的大火。

root.note: 猛烈燃燒 → 大火

senses.en: the place where two rivers join
a coming together of people or things

ex.en: The city was built at the confluence of two great rivers.
ex.zh: 這座城市建在兩條大河的匯流處。

root.note: 流到一起 → 匯流

senses.en: flowing together or merging

ex.en: The two confluent streams form a wide river below the hill.
ex.zh: 兩條匯流的小溪在山下形成一條寬闊的河。

root.note: 流在一起的

senses.en: similar in form or nature; consistent
willing to obey or conform

ex.en: The new rules should be conformable to the national standards.
ex.zh: 新的規定應該與國家標準相符。

root.note: 形狀可以一致的 → 相符的

senses.en: the fact of meeting a standard or rule

ex.en: The inspector checked the building for conformance with fire codes.
ex.zh: 檢查員檢查這棟建築是否符合消防法規。

root.note: 形狀一致 → 符合

senses.en: the shape or structure of something, especially an animal

ex.en: The judges examined the horse's conformation before awarding the prize.
ex.zh: 評審在頒獎前仔細檢查馬的體型構造。

root.note: 各部分組合成的形狀 → 構造

senses.en: behavior that follows accepted rules or customs
agreement with a standard or law

ex.en: Teenagers often feel strong pressure toward conformity.
ex.zh: 青少年常常感受到很大的從眾壓力。

root.note: 和大家同一個樣子 → 從眾

senses.en: to face someone or something in a challenging or hostile way
to deal with a problem directly

ex.en: We must confront the problem instead of ignoring it.
ex.zh: 我們必須正視這個問題，而不是忽略它。

root.note: 面對面 → 對抗、正視

senses.en: to become thick or solid, especially by cooling

ex.en: Leftover gravy will congeal if you leave it in the fridge.
ex.zh: 剩下的肉汁放進冰箱就會凝固。

root.note: 一起凍住 → 凝結（gel 果凍同源）

senses.en: pleasant because of shared interests or personality
suited to one's taste; agreeable

ex.en: The office was quiet and congenial, a perfect place to write.
ex.zh: 辦公室安靜又舒適，是寫作的完美地點。

root.note: 性情相同的 → 意氣相投

mn: 別和 congenital（先天的）搞混。

senses.en: to block or overfill, especially with traffic or fluid

ex.en: Holiday shoppers congest the downtown streets every December.
ex.zh: 每年十二月，購物人潮都讓市區街道擁塞不堪。

root.note: 全部堆在一起 → 擁擠、阻塞

senses.en: to gather into a crowd or group

ex.en: Students congregate in the cafeteria before the first bell.
ex.zh: 第一聲鐘響前，學生們都聚集在餐廳裡。

root.note: 聚成一群 → 聚集

senses.en: (of trees) bearing cones and usually keeping needles all year

ex.en: Pine and fir are common coniferous trees in cold regions.
ex.zh: 松樹和冷杉是寒冷地區常見的針葉樹。

root.note: 結毬果的 → 針葉樹的

senses.en: an opinion formed without complete information
to form an opinion without proof

ex.en: Without more data, the cause of the crash is only conjecture.
ex.zh: 沒有更多資料的話，墜機原因只是推測而已。

root.note: 把線索丟在一起拼湊 → 推測

senses.en: to join or combine

ex.en: The two small schools will conjoin to form one larger academy.
ex.zh: 這兩所小學校將合併成一所更大的學院。

root.note: 連在一起

senses.en: relating to marriage or the relationship between husband and wife

ex.en: The novel explores the joys and troubles of conjugal life.
ex.zh: 這本小說探討婚姻生活的甜蜜與煩惱。

root.note: 套在同一副軛下 → 夫妻的

senses.en: to list the different forms of a verb
to join together

ex.en: In French class, we learned to conjugate the verb "to be."
ex.zh: 在法文課上，我們學了 be 動詞的變化。

root.note: 把同一字根的形式連在一起 → 動詞變化

senses.en: the set of forms a verb takes
the act of joining together

ex.en: Spanish verb conjugation can be tricky for beginners.
ex.zh: 西班牙文的動詞變化對初學者來說可能很棘手。

root.note: 連在一起的各種形式 → 動詞變化

senses.en: a word such as "and" or "but" that connects words or clauses
the state of being joined or happening together

ex.en: The medicine works best in conjunction with a healthy diet.
ex.zh: 這種藥搭配健康的飲食效果最好。

root.note: 連在一起 → 結合、連接詞

mn: 常見片語 in conjunction with：與…一起、配合。

senses.en: to secretly allow or help with something wrong
to plot secretly

ex.en: The guards were accused of helping to connive at the prisoner's escape.
ex.zh: 警衛被控縱容囚犯越獄。

parts.m: shut the eyes 閉眼（拉丁文 nivere）

root.note: 一起閉上眼睛裝沒看到 → 縱容

senses.en: an expert judge in matters of taste, such as art, food, or wine

ex.en: As a coffee connoisseur, he can taste the difference between beans instantly.
ex.zh: 身為咖啡行家，他一喝就能分辨不同咖啡豆的差別。

root.note: 非常懂的人 → 鑑賞家

senses.en: to suggest an idea or feeling in addition to the literal meaning

ex.en: The word "home" can connote warmth and safety.
ex.zh: home 這個字可以隱含溫暖和安全的感覺。

root.note: 附帶一起標記的意思 → 隱含

mn: denote 是字面意思，connote 是附帶的聯想。

senses.en: relating to marriage

ex.en: After fifty years together, the couple still enjoyed connubial happiness.
ex.zh: 在一起五十年後，這對夫妻仍享受著婚姻的幸福。

root.note: 結為夫妻的

senses.en: to take control of a place or people by military force
to overcome a problem or weakness

ex.en: She worked hard to conquer her fear of public speaking.
ex.zh: 她努力克服對公開演講的恐懼。

parts.m: seek, gain 尋求、獲得（拉丁文 quaerere）

root.note: 盡力取得 → 征服

senses.en: related by blood; descended from the same ancestor

ex.en: Doctors noted that the patient's parents were consanguineous cousins.
ex.zh: 醫生注意到病人的父母是有血緣關係的表親。

root.note: 有共同血液的 → 血親的

senses.en: a person's inner sense of right and wrong

ex.en: His conscience would not let him keep the wallet he found.
ex.zh: 他的良心不容許他留下撿到的錢包。

root.note: 內心清楚知道對錯 → 良心

mn: conscience（良心）和 conscious（有意識的）拼法很像，要小心。

senses.en: careful to do one's work well and thoroughly
guided by one's sense of right and wrong

ex.en: She is a conscientious student who always checks her work twice.
ex.zh: 她是個認真的學生，總是把作業檢查兩遍。

root.note: 憑良心做事的 → 認真盡責

mn: conscientious objector：因良心拒服兵役者。

senses.en: aware of and responding to one's surroundings; awake
aware of something; deliberate

ex.en: She made a conscious effort to eat more vegetables.
ex.zh: 她刻意努力多吃蔬菜。

root.note: 知道周遭的 → 有意識的

senses.en: to force someone by law to serve in the armed forces
[ˋkɑnskrɪpt] a person drafted into military service
senses.zh: 應徵入伍者；義務役士兵

ex.en: During the war, the government began to conscript young men.
ex.zh: 戰爭期間，政府開始徵召年輕男子入伍。

root.note: 把名字一起寫進名冊 → 徵召

senses.en: to make or declare something sacred
to dedicate to a particular purpose

ex.en: The bishop came to consecrate the new church.
ex.zh: 主教前來為新教堂祝聖。

root.note: 使變得神聖

senses.en: following one after another without interruption

ex.en: It rained for five consecutive days.
ex.zh: 連續下了五天的雨。

root.note: 一個跟著一個 → 連續的

senses.en: general agreement among a group

ex.en: There is a scientific consensus that the climate is warming.
ex.zh: 科學界已有氣候正在暖化的共識。

root.note: 大家感覺一致 → 共識

senses.en: a preference for traditional values and resistance to change

ex.en: The town's conservatism made it slow to accept new ideas.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮的保守作風讓它很慢才接受新觀念。

root.note: 主張保存舊事物 → 保守主義

senses.en: favoring traditional values and opposed to sudden change
(of an estimate) cautiously low

ex.en: Even by a conservative estimate, the repairs will cost ten thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 即使保守估計，修繕費也要一萬美元。

root.note: 想保存現狀的 → 保守的

senses.en: a school for training in music or drama
a glass room or greenhouse for plants

ex.en: She was accepted into a famous music conservatory in Vienna.
ex.zh: 她獲准進入維也納一所著名的音樂學院。

root.note: 保存（植物、藝術傳統）的地方

senses.en: to send or deliver goods to someone
to put someone or something in an unpleasant place or situation
senses.zh: 把…打入（不好的處境）；丟棄

ex.en: I decided to consign my old sofa to the basement.
ex.zh: 我決定把舊沙發丟到地下室去。

root.note: 蓋章封好交出去 → 託運、交付

senses.en: the person to whom goods are sent

ex.en: The consignee must sign for the package when it arrives.
ex.zh: 包裹送達時，收貨人必須簽收。

root.note: 被託運交付貨物的人 → 收貨人

senses.en: the person who sends goods to someone

ex.en: The shop pays the consignor once the item is sold.
ex.zh: 物品賣出後，店家才會付錢給寄售人。

root.note: 託運貨物的人 → 發貨人

senses.en: the quality of always behaving or performing in the same way
the thickness or firmness of a substance

ex.en: Great athletes are known for their consistency, not just talent.
ex.zh: 偉大的運動員以穩定性聞名，而不只是天分。

root.note: 一直站在一起、不變 → 一致性

senses.en: to comfort someone who is sad or disappointed
[ˋkɑnsol] a panel of controls, or a video game system

ex.en: Nothing I said could console her after she lost the match.
ex.zh: 她輸掉比賽後，我說什麼都安慰不了她。

root.note: 給予安慰

senses.en: to make something stronger or more secure
to combine several things into one

ex.en: The company plans to consolidate its three offices into one building.
ex.zh: 公司計畫把三個辦公室合併到一棟大樓裡。

root.note: 使一起變堅固 → 鞏固、合併

senses.en: agreement or harmony
a pleasing combination of musical notes

ex.en: Her actions were in consonance with her stated beliefs.
ex.zh: 她的行為與她所宣稱的信念一致。

root.note: 聲音相合 → 和諧、一致

senses.en: a speech sound that is not a vowel, such as b or t
in agreement or harmony

ex.en: The letter "b" is a consonant, while "a" is a vowel.
ex.zh: 字母 b 是子音，而 a 是母音。

root.note: 需和母音一起發聲的音 → 子音

senses.en: the husband or wife of a ruling monarch
[kənˋsɔrt] to spend time with, often people others disapprove of

ex.en: The queen's consort attended the ceremony at her side.
ex.zh: 女王的配偶陪在她身旁出席典禮。

root.note: 共享同一命運的人 → 配偶、同伴

senses.en: easy to see or notice; attracting attention

ex.en: His bright red jacket made him conspicuous in the crowd.
ex.zh: 他那件鮮紅色外套讓他在人群中很顯眼。

root.note: 很容易被看到 → 顯眼的

mn: conspicuous consumption：炫耀性消費。

senses.en: a person who takes part in a secret plan to do something harmful

ex.en: Each conspirator swore to keep the plan a secret.
ex.zh: 每個共謀者都發誓要保守這個計畫的祕密。

root.note: 一起低聲呼吸、密談的人 → 共謀者

senses.en: to secretly plan with others to do something harmful or illegal
(of events) to combine to produce a bad result

ex.en: Bad weather and traffic seemed to conspire to make us late.
ex.zh: 壞天氣和塞車好像串通好要讓我們遲到。

root.note: 一起呼吸、湊在一起密談 → 密謀

senses.en: a police officer of low rank, especially in Britain

ex.en: The village constable knew every family by name.
ex.zh: 村裡的警員叫得出每一戶人家的名字。

senses.en: a group of stars forming a recognized pattern
a group of related people or things

ex.en: Orion is the easiest constellation to find in the winter sky.
ex.zh: 獵戶座是冬季夜空中最容易找到的星座。

root.note: 星星聚在一起 → 星座

senses.en: a feeling of shock and anxiety, usually at something unexpected

ex.en: To the consternation of the fans, the concert was canceled at the last minute.
ex.zh: 演唱會在最後一刻取消，讓歌迷們驚愕不已。

parts.m: strew, throw down 撒下、擊倒

root.note: 被擊倒在地 → 驚愕

senses.en: the voters in an area who elect a representative; the area itself
a group of supporters

ex.en: The senator held a meeting to hear from her constituency.
ex.zh: 那位參議員舉辦座談會聆聽選區民眾的意見。

root.note: 一起選出代表的一群人 → 選區

senses.en: a voter in a particular area
a part of a whole
being a part of a whole

ex.en: Every constituent received a letter from the mayor.
ex.zh: 每位選民都收到了市長的來信。

root.note: 一起構成整體的部分 → 成分、選民

senses.en: to make narrower or tighter by squeezing
to limit or restrict

ex.en: Cold weather can constrict the blood vessels in your hands.
ex.zh: 寒冷的天氣會使手部的血管收縮。

root.note: 一起拉緊 → 收縮

senses.en: a government official living in a foreign city to help citizens of their own country
one of two chief magistrates of ancient Rome

ex.en: The consul helped the stranded tourists get new passports.
ex.zh: 領事協助受困的觀光客取得新護照。

mn: consul（領事）、council（議會）、counsel（勸告）容易混淆。

senses.en: the office or building of a consul

ex.en: You can apply for a visa at the consulate downtown.
ex.zh: 你可以到市中心的領事館申請簽證。

root.note: 領事辦公的地方

senses.en: showing great skill; perfect
[ˋkɑnsəˏmet] to complete or make perfect

ex.en: She is a consummate professional who never misses a deadline.
ex.zh: 她是個無懈可擊的專業人士，從不錯過任何截止日期。

root.note: 達到最高點 → 完美的

senses.en: the using up of a resource
the act of eating or drinking
(old use) tuberculosis

ex.en: Electricity consumption rises sharply in the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天用電量會急劇上升。

root.note: 全部拿走用掉 → 消耗

senses.en: (old use) suffering from tuberculosis
relating to using up resources

ex.en: The consumptive poet coughed through the long, cold winter.
ex.zh: 那位患肺結核的詩人在漫長寒冬裡咳個不停。

root.note: 把身體消耗殆盡的 → 患肺結核的

senses.en: the spreading of disease by close contact
the spreading of a harmful idea or practice

ex.en: Patients were kept apart to prevent contagion.
ex.zh: 病人被隔離開來以防傳染。

root.note: 互相接觸而傳開 → 傳染

senses.en: (of a disease) spread by contact
(of a feeling) likely to spread to others

ex.en: Her laughter was so contagious that soon everyone was smiling.
ex.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，很快大家都笑了。

root.note: 接觸就會傳開的

senses.en: to make something impure by adding a harmful substance

ex.en: Chemicals from the factory could contaminate the river.
ex.zh: 工廠排出的化學物質可能會汙染河川。

root.note: 碰到髒東西 → 汙染

senses.en: to think about something deeply and carefully
to look at thoughtfully

ex.en: She sat by the lake to contemplate her future.
ex.zh: 她坐在湖邊思考自己的未來。

parts.m: temple 神殿（觀測天象之處）

root.note: 在神殿中仔細觀察 → 深思

senses.en: existing or happening at the same time

ex.en: Historians compared the diary with contemporaneous newspaper reports.
ex.zh: 歷史學家把這本日記和同時期的報紙報導互相比對。

root.note: 同一時間的

senses.en: belonging to the present time; modern
living or happening at the same time
a person living at the same time as another

ex.en: The museum is known for its collection of contemporary art.
ex.zh: 這間博物館以當代藝術收藏聞名。

root.note: 同一時間的 → 當代的

senses.en: deserving contempt; despicable

ex.en: Stealing from a charity is a contemptible act.
ex.zh: 偷慈善機構的錢是很卑劣的行為。

root.note: 值得被輕視的 → 可鄙的

mn: contemptible 是「令人鄙視的」；contemptuous 是「（某人）表示鄙視的」。

senses.en: showing that one thinks someone or something is worthless

ex.en: He gave a contemptuous laugh when he saw my old car.
ex.zh: 他看到我的舊車時輕蔑地笑了一聲。

root.note: 充滿輕視的

senses.en: a person or team competing for a title or prize

ex.en: After winning ten straight games, the team is a serious contender for the title.
ex.zh: 連贏十場後，這支球隊成了冠軍的有力角逐者。

root.note: 努力爭取的人

senses.en: the state of touching or being next to something

ex.en: The contiguity of the two farms made sharing equipment easy.
ex.zh: 兩座農場相鄰，因此共用設備很方便。

root.note: 互相接觸 → 鄰近

senses.en: sharing a border; touching

ex.en: Alaska is not part of the contiguous United States.
ex.zh: 阿拉斯加不屬於美國本土相連的四十八州。

root.note: 互相接觸的 → 相鄰的

senses.en: self-restraint, especially regarding sexual activity
the ability to control one's bladder and bowels

ex.en: The monks practiced continence as part of their religious life.
ex.zh: 修士們把節慾當作宗教生活的一部分。

root.note: 把自己握緊不放 → 自制

senses.en: a future event that is possible but cannot be predicted with certainty
senses.zh: 意外事件；可能發生的情況

ex.en: We need a contingency plan in case it rains on the day of the festival.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個應變計畫，以防活動當天下雨。

root.note: 碰巧撞在一起的事 → 意外情況

mn: contingency plan：應變計畫、備案。

senses.en: depending on something else happening
a group of people forming part of a larger group

ex.en: The job offer is contingent on a background check.
ex.zh: 這份工作錄取與否，取決於背景調查的結果。

root.note: 跟別的事碰在一起才成立 → 取決於

mn: 固定搭配 contingent on/upon：取決於。

senses.en: the state of continuing
a postponement of a court case

ex.en: The lawyer asked the judge for a continuance to gather more evidence.
ex.zh: 律師請求法官延期審理，以蒐集更多證據。

root.note: 一直握住不放 → 持續

senses.en: the act of continuing, or something that continues something else

ex.en: The new policy is simply a continuation of the old one.
ex.zh: 新政策只是舊政策的延續。

root.note: 持續握住 → 延續

senses.en: the unbroken and consistent existence of something over time

ex.en: Keeping the same teacher for three years gives students continuity.
ex.zh: 連續三年由同一位老師帶班，能給學生一種延續性。

root.note: 一直不斷 → 連續性

senses.en: going on without stopping or interruption

ex.en: The machine makes a continuous humming noise.
ex.zh: 這台機器發出持續不斷的嗡嗡聲。

root.note: 一直握住不放的 → 連續的

mn: continuous 是完全不中斷；continual 是反覆不斷（中間可能停一下）。

senses.en: to twist or bend out of normal shape

ex.en: Acrobats can contort their bodies into amazing shapes.
ex.zh: 特技演員能把身體扭成驚人的形狀。

root.note: 用力扭 → 扭曲

senses.en: goods that have been imported or exported illegally

ex.en: Customs officers found contraband hidden in the truck.
ex.zh: 海關人員在卡車裡查到藏匿的走私貨。

root.note: 違反禁令的東西 → 違禁品

senses.en: a combination of statements or ideas that are opposed to one another
the act of saying the opposite of what someone said

ex.en: There is a contradiction between what he says and what he does.
ex.zh: 他說的和做的之間存在矛盾。

root.note: 說相反的話 → 矛盾

senses.en: mutually opposed or inconsistent

ex.en: The witnesses gave contradictory accounts of the accident.
ex.zh: 目擊者對這起事故的描述互相矛盾。

root.note: 說法相反的 → 矛盾的

senses.en: the placing of things in opposition or contrast
(in logic) the contrapositive form of a statement

ex.en: The poem sets youth in contraposition to old age.
ex.zh: 這首詩把青春和老年放在對立的位置。

root.note: 放在相對的位置 → 對立

senses.en: to violate a law, rule, or agreement
to contradict or oppose

ex.en: Selling the medicine without a license would contravene the law.
ex.zh: 無照販售這種藥會觸犯法律。

root.note: 迎面反著來 → 違反

senses.en: a gift or payment to a common fund
a part played in bringing about a result

ex.en: Marie Curie made a major contribution to the study of radioactivity.
ex.zh: 居禮夫人對放射性的研究有重大貢獻。

root.note: 大家一起給 → 貢獻、捐獻

senses.en: a person or thing that gives or helps cause something

ex.en: Car exhaust is a major contributor to air pollution.
ex.zh: 汽車廢氣是空氣汙染的主要來源之一。

root.note: 一起出力的人

senses.en: feeling or showing sincere regret for having done wrong

ex.en: The contrite boy apologized for breaking the window.
ex.zh: 那個男孩很懊悔，為打破窗戶道了歉。

root.note: 心被磨碎 → 痛悔的

senses.en: a clever device or machine
a scheme or trick; something artificial

ex.en: The plot relies on one unlikely contrivance after another.
ex.zh: 這個情節靠的是一個接一個牽強的巧合安排。

root.note: 想出來的點子 → 裝置、計謀

senses.en: to plan or create something cleverly or with difficulty
to manage to do something

ex.en: The prisoners tried to contrive a way to escape.
ex.zh: 囚犯們設法想出一個逃跑的方法。

root.note: 想辦法找到 → 設計、策劃

mn: 形容詞 contrived 是「做作的、不自然的」。

senses.en: the power to direct or influence people or events
to have power over; to limit or manage

ex.en: You need to control your temper during the debate.
ex.zh: 辯論時你要控制好自己的脾氣。

senses.en: a person or device that controls something
a person in charge of an organization's finances

ex.en: The air traffic controller guided the plane safely to the runway.
ex.zh: 航管人員引導飛機安全降落在跑道上。

root.note: 控制的人或裝置

senses.en: stubbornly disobedient to authority

ex.en: The contumacious witness refused every order of the court.
ex.zh: 那個頑固的證人拒絕了法庭的每一項命令。

root.note: 驕傲膨脹起來 → 違抗的

senses.en: stubborn refusal to obey authority, especially a court

ex.en: His contumacy earned him an extra week in jail.
ex.zh: 他的抗命讓他多坐了一週的牢。

root.note: 驕傲膨脹 → 違抗

senses.en: to injure the skin without breaking it; to bruise

ex.en: A hard fall can contuse the muscle without breaking any bones.
ex.zh: 重重跌一跤可能會撞傷肌肉，但不一定骨折。

root.note: 重重敲打 → 瘀傷

senses.en: a bruise

ex.en: The X-ray showed no fracture, only a deep contusion.
ex.zh: X 光顯示沒有骨折，只是深層挫傷。

root.note: 被打出來的傷 → 瘀傷

senses.en: to recover health and strength after an illness

ex.en: After the surgery, she went to the countryside to convalesce.
ex.zh: 手術後，她到鄉下去療養。

root.note: 開始變得強壯 → 康復

senses.en: the time spent recovering from an illness

ex.en: His convalescence took longer than the doctors expected.
ex.zh: 他的康復期比醫生預期的還要長。

root.note: 逐漸變強壯的期間 → 恢復期

senses.en: recovering from an illness
a person recovering from an illness

ex.en: The convalescent patient was allowed short walks in the garden.
ex.zh: 康復中的病人獲准在花園裡短暫散步。

root.note: 正在變強壯的

senses.en: to come together or call people together for a meeting

ex.en: The principal will convene a meeting of all teachers on Friday.
ex.zh: 校長將在星期五召開全體教師會議。

root.note: 一起來 → 召開會議

senses.en: the state of being able to do something easily and with little effort
a useful device or service

ex.en: Online shopping offers great convenience for busy people.
ex.zh: 網路購物對忙碌的人來說非常方便。

root.note: 剛好一起到來、很合適 → 方便

senses.en: to come together from different directions and meet
(of ideas) to become similar

ex.en: Thousands of fans will converge on the stadium for the final.
ex.zh: 數千名球迷將湧向體育場觀看決賽。

root.note: 一起轉向同一點 → 匯合

senses.en: coming closer together; tending toward the same point

ex.en: Test questions often require convergent thinking to find one correct answer.
ex.zh: 考題常常需要聚斂性思考，找出唯一的正確答案。

root.note: 轉向同一點的 → 匯聚的

senses.en: familiar with or knowledgeable about something

ex.en: She is conversant with several programming languages.
ex.zh: 她精通好幾種程式語言。

root.note: 常和某事物打轉在一起 → 熟悉的

mn: 固定搭配 be conversant with：熟悉、精通。

senses.en: the process of changing from one form or use to another
a change in religious faith or beliefs

ex.en: The conversion of the old factory into apartments took two years.
ex.zh: 把舊工廠改建成公寓花了兩年時間。

root.note: 整個轉過來 → 轉換

senses.en: able to be changed into another form or exchanged
a car with a roof that can be folded back

ex.en: They drove along the coast in a red convertible.
ex.zh: 他們開著一輛紅色敞篷車沿著海岸兜風。

root.note: 可以轉變的

senses.en: curved outward like the outside of a ball

ex.en: A convex mirror gives drivers a wider view of the road.
ex.zh: 凸面鏡讓駕駛人看到更寬廣的路面。

mn: concave 有個 cave（洞穴）是凹進去的；convex 則相反，是凸出來的。

senses.en: the act of carrying something from one place to another
a vehicle
the legal transfer of property

ex.en: A horse-drawn cart was the only conveyance available in the village.
ex.zh: 馬車是村裡唯一的交通工具。

root.note: 一起上路 → 運送

senses.en: friendly, lively, and enjoyable

ex.en: The dinner party had a warm, convivial atmosphere.
ex.zh: 這場晚宴的氣氛溫馨又熱鬧。

root.note: 一起生活、吃喝 → 歡樂的

senses.en: a coil or twist, such as a fold of the brain's surface
something complex and hard to follow

ex.en: I got lost in every convolution of the novel's plot.
ex.zh: 我迷失在這本小說錯綜複雜的情節裡。

root.note: 捲在一起 → 迴旋、複雜

senses.en: to roll or twist together

ex.en: The vines convolve around the old iron fence.
ex.zh: 藤蔓盤繞在老舊的鐵欄杆上。

root.note: 捲在一起

senses.en: a group of vehicles or ships traveling together, often with protection

ex.en: A convoy of trucks carried food to the flooded towns.
ex.zh: 一支卡車車隊把食物運到淹水的城鎮。

root.note: 一起上路 → 車隊

senses.en: to shake violently and uncontrollably
to cause to laugh uncontrollably

ex.en: His jokes made the whole audience convulse with laughter.
ex.zh: 他的笑話讓全場觀眾笑得前仰後合。

root.note: 猛烈拉扯 → 抽搐

senses.en: a sudden, violent, uncontrollable shaking of the body
a violent social or natural upheaval

ex.en: The child had a convulsion caused by a high fever.
ex.zh: 那個孩子因發高燒而抽搐。

root.note: 猛烈拉扯 → 抽搐

senses.en: abundant; in large amounts

ex.en: She took copious notes during the lecture.
ex.zh: 她在課堂上做了大量的筆記。

root.note: 豐富的

mn: 想成 copy：可以複製很多份 → 大量的。

senses.en: a woman who flirts playfully

ex.en: In the old play, the coquette teases every young man in town.
ex.zh: 在那齣老戲裡，那位賣弄風情的女子挑逗鎮上每個年輕男子。

root.note: 像公雞般昂首炫耀的女子

senses.en: a decorative molding along the top of a wall or building

ex.en: Pigeons sat in a row along the stone cornice of the bank.
ex.zh: 鴿子在銀行的石造飛簷上排成一排。

senses.en: a horn-shaped container overflowing with fruit, symbolizing plenty
an abundant supply of good things

ex.en: The farmers market is a cornucopia of fresh produce.
ex.zh: 農夫市集裡新鮮蔬果應有盡有。

root.note: 豐富之角 → 豐饒

senses.en: a natural consequence or result
a statement that follows directly from one already proved

ex.en: Higher prices were a corollary of the fuel shortage.
ex.zh: 物價上漲是燃料短缺的必然結果。

senses.en: the ceremony of crowning a king or queen

ex.en: Millions watched the coronation on television.
ex.zh: 數百萬人透過電視收看加冕典禮。

root.note: 戴上王冠 → 加冕

senses.en: a small crown worn by nobles

ex.en: The duchess wore a jeweled coronet at the royal ball.
ex.zh: 公爵夫人在皇家舞會上戴著鑲寶石的小冠冕。

root.note: 小王冠

senses.en: relating to the body
a low-ranking officer in the army

ex.en: Corporal punishment is banned in schools in many countries.
ex.zh: 很多國家的學校禁止體罰。

root.note: 身體的

mn: corporal punishment：體罰。

senses.en: relating to a large company or business
shared by all members of a group

ex.en: She left her corporate job to open a bakery.
ex.zh: 她辭去公司的工作，開了一家麵包店。

root.note: 結合成一體的 → 公司的、團體的

senses.en: having a physical body; material rather than spiritual

ex.en: The ghost in the story has no corporeal form.
ex.zh: 故事中的鬼魂沒有實體。

root.note: 有身體的 → 有形的

senses.en: a large military unit
a group of people doing a particular activity

ex.en: The press corps waited outside for the president's statement.
ex.zh: 記者團在外面等候總統發表聲明。

root.note: 一個整體 → 團體

mn: corps 唸 [kor]，p 和 s 不發音；別和 corpse（屍體）搞混。

senses.en: a dead body, especially of a human

ex.en: The detective knelt beside the corpse to look for clues.
ex.zh: 偵探跪在屍體旁尋找線索。

root.note: （死去的）身體

senses.en: (of a person) large and fat

ex.en: The corpulent innkeeper laughed as he poured our drinks.
ex.zh: 那位胖胖的旅店老闆一邊笑一邊幫我們倒飲料。

root.note: 身體滿滿的 → 肥胖

senses.en: a blood cell or other tiny body in an organism

ex.en: Each red corpuscle carries oxygen through the body.
ex.zh: 每個紅血球都在體內輸送氧氣。

root.note: 小小的身體 → 血球

senses.en: to have a relationship in which one thing affects or depends on another

ex.en: Studies show that sleep quality can correlate with school performance.
ex.zh: 研究顯示睡眠品質可能與學業表現相關。

root.note: 彼此關聯

senses.en: having a mutual relationship
either of two things closely related

ex.en: "Either" and "or" are correlative conjunctions.
ex.zh: either 和 or 是對等相關連接詞。

root.note: 互相關聯的

senses.en: able to be corrected or reformed

ex.en: The teacher believed every student was corrigible with enough patience.
ex.zh: 老師相信只要有足夠耐心，每個學生都能改過。

root.note: 可以扳直的 → 可改正的

mn: 反義字 incorrigible（無可救藥的）更常見。

senses.en: to confirm or give support to a statement or theory

ex.en: Security camera footage helped corroborate the witness's story.
ex.zh: 監視器畫面幫忙證實了目擊者的說法。

root.note: 使更有力量 → 證實（robust 強壯的同源）

senses.en: evidence that confirms a statement or theory

ex.en: Police needed corroboration before charging the suspect.
ex.zh: 警方在起訴嫌犯前需要佐證。

root.note: 使說法更有力 → 佐證

senses.en: to destroy or damage metal slowly by chemical action
to weaken or destroy gradually

ex.en: Salt water can corrode the metal parts of a boat.
ex.zh: 鹹水會腐蝕船上的金屬零件。

root.note: 一點一點啃掉 → 腐蝕

senses.en: the process of damage to metal or stone by chemical action

ex.en: The bridge was closed because of severe corrosion in its steel beams.
ex.zh: 這座橋因鋼樑嚴重鏽蝕而封閉。

root.note: 被啃蝕 → 腐蝕

senses.en: causing damage to metal or other materials by chemical action
harmful in a gradual way
senses.zh: 有破壞性的；逐漸侵蝕的

ex.en: Wear gloves when handling this corrosive cleaning product.
ex.zh: 使用這種腐蝕性清潔劑時請戴手套。

root.note: 會啃蝕的

senses.en: able to be bribed or made dishonest

ex.en: A corruptible judge is a danger to the whole justice system.
ex.zh: 可被收買的法官對整個司法體系是一大威脅。

root.note: 可以被打破（原則）的 → 可收買的

senses.en: dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people in power
the process of changing or damaging something

ex.en: The mayor promised to fight corruption in city hall.
ex.zh: 市長承諾要打擊市政府的貪腐。

root.note: 徹底破壞（道德） → 腐敗

senses.en: affecting only the appearance, not the basic nature
a product applied to improve appearance

ex.en: The changes to the plan are only cosmetic and solve nothing.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的修改只是表面功夫，什麼都沒解決。

root.note: 整理外表 → 化妝的、表面的

senses.en: relating to the universe
extremely large; vast

ex.en: Scientists study cosmic rays that reach Earth from distant stars.
ex.zh: 科學家研究從遙遠星體到達地球的宇宙射線。

root.note: 宇宙的

senses.en: a theory or story about the origin of the universe

ex.en: Each ancient culture had its own cosmogony explaining how the world began.
ex.zh: 每個古文明都有自己解釋世界如何開始的創世說。

root.note: 宇宙的誕生 → 宇宙起源論

senses.en: the science that describes and maps the general features of the universe

ex.en: Medieval cosmography placed the Earth at the center of everything.
ex.zh: 中世紀的宇宙誌把地球放在萬物的中心。

root.note: 描繪宇宙的學問

senses.en: the science of the origin and development of the universe

ex.en: Modern cosmology suggests the universe began with the Big Bang.
ex.zh: 現代宇宙學認為宇宙起源於大霹靂。

root.note: 研究宇宙的學問

senses.en: including people and influences from many different countries
(of a person) well traveled and sophisticated

ex.en: London is a cosmopolitan city where hundreds of languages are spoken.
ex.zh: 倫敦是個國際化的城市，人們說著數百種語言。

root.note: 世界公民的 → 國際化的

senses.en: the belief that all people belong to one world community

ex.en: The philosopher's cosmopolitanism led him to see himself as a citizen of the world.
ex.zh: 那位哲學家的世界主義讓他自視為世界公民。

root.note: 世界公民主義

senses.en: the universe seen as a well-ordered whole

ex.en: Humans have always wondered about their place in the cosmos.
ex.zh: 人類一直好奇自己在宇宙中的位置。

root.note: 有秩序的整體 → 宇宙

senses.en: a claim made in response to another claim, especially in a lawsuit

ex.en: The tenant filed a counter-claim against the landlord for unpaid repairs.
ex.zh: 房客對房東提出反訴，要求支付未處理的修繕費用。

root.note: 反過來提出的要求

senses.en: to act against something to reduce or cancel its effect

ex.en: Drinking water can help counteract the effects of the heat.
ex.zh: 喝水有助於抵消炎熱帶來的影響。

root.note: 反向行動 → 抵消

senses.en: to balance or offset by having an opposite effect
[ˋkaʊntɚˏbæləns] a weight or force that balances another

ex.en: Her calm nature helps counterbalance his quick temper.
ex.zh: 她沉穩的個性有助於平衡他的急性子。

root.note: 從另一邊平衡

senses.en: an accusation made in response to another accusation

ex.en: The senator answered the charge of lying with a countercharge of his own.
ex.zh: 那位參議員被指說謊，隨即提出反指控。

root.note: 反過來的指控

senses.en: made to look exactly like something valuable in order to deceive
to make a fake copy of something
a fake copy

ex.en: The store clerk spotted a counterfeit twenty-dollar bill.
ex.zh: 店員發現了一張偽造的二十元美鈔。

root.note: 對照著做出來的 → 仿冒

senses.en: a person or thing that has the same position or function as another in a different place
senses.zh: 對應的人或物；對口單位

ex.en: The foreign minister met with her Japanese counterpart in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 外交部長在東京與日本外相會面。

root.note: 相對應的另一部分

senses.en: to offset the effect of something by opposing action

ex.en: Strong local support may countervail the national trend.
ex.zh: 強大的地方支持可能會抵消全國性的趨勢。

parts.m: be strong 強（拉丁文 valere）

root.note: 以力量相抗 → 抵消

mn: 常見於經貿用語 countervailing duties（平衡稅）。

senses.en: (old use) an office where a business keeps its accounts

ex.en: In the old story, the king sat in his counting-house counting out his money.
ex.zh: 在那個老故事裡，國王坐在帳房裡數著他的錢。

senses.en: a person from the same country as someone else
a person who lives in the countryside

ex.en: The tennis star beat her own countryman in the final.
ex.zh: 那位網球明星在決賽中擊敗了自己的同胞。

senses.en: not deterred by danger or pain; brave

ex.en: It was courageous of her to speak up against the bully.
ex.zh: 她敢站出來對抗霸凌者，真的很勇敢。

root.note: 有心、有膽的 → 勇敢的

senses.en: a series of lessons in a subject
the direction or route taken
(of liquid) to flow quickly

ex.en: The ship changed course to avoid the storm.
ex.zh: 船隻改變航道以避開暴風雨。

root.note: 奔跑的路線 → 路線、課程

senses.en: (literary) a swift horse

ex.en: The knight rode into battle on a mighty courser.
ex.zh: 騎士騎著一匹駿馬奔赴戰場。

root.note: 跑得快的馬

senses.en: polite and considerate behavior
a polite act or remark

ex.en: Out of courtesy, he let the elderly woman go first.
ex.zh: 出於禮貌，他讓那位老太太先走。

root.note: 宮廷中的禮儀 → 禮貌

mn: courtesy of…：承蒙…提供。

senses.en: a formal agreement or promise, often legal or religious

ex.en: The nations signed a covenant to protect human rights.
ex.zh: 各國簽署了保護人權的公約。

root.note: 一起來達成的約定 → 盟約

senses.en: not openly shown or acknowledged; secret

ex.en: The spy agency ran a covert operation overseas.
ex.zh: 情報機構在海外執行了一項祕密行動。

root.note: 被蓋起來的 → 祕密的

mn: covert 和 cover（覆蓋）同源；反義字是 overt（公開的）。

senses.en: a small flock of birds, especially partridges
a small group of people

ex.en: A covey of quail burst out of the tall grass.
ex.zh: 一群鵪鶉從高高的草叢中飛竄而出。

parts.m: brood, sit on eggs 孵（拉丁文 cubare）

root.note: 同一窩孵出的鳥 → 一群

senses.en: to crouch down or shrink back in fear

ex.en: The dog would cower under the bed whenever it thundered.
ex.zh: 每次打雷，那隻狗都會縮到床底下。

senses.en: the person who steers a rowing boat and directs the rowers

ex.en: The coxswain shouted the rhythm to keep the rowers together.
ex.zh: 舵手大聲喊出節奏，讓划手們動作一致。

root.note: 小船上的僕役 → 舵手

senses.en: a steep, rugged cliff or rock

ex.en: An eagle built its nest high on a rocky crag.
ex.zh: 一隻老鷹把巢築在高高的岩壁上。

senses.en: the part of the skull that holds the brain

ex.en: The helmet protects the cranium from serious injury.
ex.zh: 安全帽保護顱骨免於嚴重受傷。

root.note: 頭骨

senses.en: lacking sensitivity, refinement, or intelligence

ex.en: Making jokes at a funeral would be crass.
ex.zh: 在喪禮上開玩笑是很粗俗的。

root.note: 粗厚不細緻 → 粗俗

senses.en: a powerful desire for something

ex.en: Late at night I often have a craving for something sweet.
ex.zh: 深夜時我常常很想吃甜的東西。

root.note: 渴望

senses.en: to make a high, harsh sound when moved or under pressure
a harsh, squeaking sound

ex.en: The old wooden stairs creak with every step.
ex.zh: 那座老舊的木樓梯每走一步都會嘎吱作響。

mn: creak（嘎吱聲）和 creek（小溪）同音。

senses.en: a place where dairy products such as butter and cheese are made or sold

ex.en: We bought fresh butter at the local creamery.
ex.zh: 我們在當地的乳品店買了新鮮奶油。

root.note: 做奶製品的地方

senses.en: thick, smooth, and rich like cream

ex.en: This soup is so creamy and delicious.
ex.zh: 這碗湯又濃郁又好喝。

root.note: 像奶油的

senses.en: belief in or acceptance of something as true

ex.en: New evidence gave credence to the witness's story.
ex.zh: 新證據讓目擊者的說法更加可信。

root.note: 相信

mn: 常見搭配 give/lend credence to：使…更可信。

senses.en: able to be believed; convincing

ex.en: The reporter checked that every source was credible.
ex.zh: 記者確認每一個消息來源都可信。

root.note: 可以相信的

mn: credible 是「別人信得過」，credulous 是「自己太好騙」。

senses.en: too ready to believe things; easily fooled

ex.en: The scam targeted credulous customers who believed they had won a prize.
ex.zh: 這個騙局專找容易輕信的顧客，讓他們以為自己中了獎。

root.note: 太容易相信 → 輕信的

mn: credible 是「別人信得過」，credulous 是「自己太好騙」。

senses.en: a set of beliefs or principles, especially religious

ex.en: The club welcomes people of every race and creed.
ex.zh: 這個社團歡迎所有種族與信仰的人。

parts.m: believe 相信（拉丁文 credo「我相信」）

root.note: 「我相信…」→ 信條

senses.en: a place where dead bodies are burned

ex.en: The family gathered at the crematory to say goodbye.
ex.zh: 家人聚集在火葬場做最後的道別。

root.note: 焚燒的地方 → 火葬場

senses.en: a deep, open crack in a glacier or ice sheet

ex.en: The climbers roped together in case someone fell into a crevasse.
ex.zh: 登山者用繩子互相綁著，以防有人掉進冰隙。

root.note: 冰上的大裂縫

mn: crevasse 是冰河上的大裂縫；crevice 是岩石或牆上的小縫。

senses.en: a narrow opening or crack in a rock or wall

ex.en: A lizard slipped into a crevice in the stone wall.
ex.zh: 一隻蜥蜴溜進了石牆的縫隙裡。

root.note: 小裂縫

senses.en: a standard by which something is judged

ex.en: Price was not the only criterion we used to choose a laptop.
ex.zh: 價格不是我們挑筆電的唯一標準。

root.note: 判斷的依據 → 標準

mn: 複數是 criteria。

senses.en: a detailed analysis and evaluation of something
to evaluate in a detailed way

ex.en: The art teacher gave a thoughtful critique of each painting.
ex.zh: 美術老師對每幅畫都給了用心的評析。

root.note: 判斷分析 → 評論

senses.en: plates, dishes, and cups made of earthenware or china

ex.en: We wrapped the crockery in newspaper before moving.
ex.zh: 搬家前我們用報紙把碗盤包好。

root.note: 陶罐類的總稱

senses.en: a container in which metals are heated to very high temperatures
a severe test or trial that produces change

ex.en: The war was a crucible that shaped a new generation of leaders.
ex.zh: 這場戰爭是一座熔爐，淬鍊出新一代的領袖。

senses.en: a long, determined campaign for a cause
one of the medieval Christian military expeditions to the Holy Land
to campaign energetically for a cause

ex.en: She led a crusade against plastic waste in her town.
ex.zh: 她在鎮上發起了一場反塑膠垃圾運動。

root.note: 背負十字架的出征 → 十字軍 → 運動

senses.en: an animal with a hard shell and jointed legs, such as a crab or shrimp

ex.en: A lobster is a crustacean that lives on the ocean floor.
ex.zh: 龍蝦是一種生活在海底的甲殼類動物。

root.note: 有硬殼的動物

senses.en: having a hard shell; relating to crustaceans

ex.en: The tide pool was full of small crustaceous creatures.
ex.zh: 潮池裡滿是小小的甲殼類生物。

root.note: 有外殼的

senses.en: a text written in code

ex.en: The newspaper prints a cryptogram for readers to solve every Sunday.
ex.zh: 報紙每週日都會刊登一則密碼謎題讓讀者破解。

root.note: 隱藏起來的文字 → 密碼文

senses.en: to form crystals
(of ideas) to become clear and definite

ex.en: Traveling abroad helped crystallize her plans for the future.
ex.zh: 出國旅行讓她對未來的計畫變得明確。

root.note: 變成晶體 → 結晶、明確化

senses.en: a short, thick stick used as a weapon
to beat with a cudgel

ex.en: The guard carried a heavy cudgel on his belt.
ex.zh: 守衛腰間掛著一根沉重的棍棒。

mn: 片語 take up the cudgels for：挺身為…辯護。

senses.en: relating to cooking or the kitchen

ex.en: He went to culinary school to become a professional chef.
ex.zh: 他就讀烹飪學校，想成為專業廚師。

root.note: 廚房的 → 烹飪的

senses.en: to select from a large quantity
to reduce an animal population by killing some

ex.en: The editor will cull the best stories from hundreds of submissions.
ex.zh: 編輯將從數百篇投稿中挑出最好的故事。

root.note: 挑選收集 → 揀選

senses.en: deserving blame

ex.en: The court found the company culpable for the chemical spill.
ex.zh: 法院判定這家公司應為化學物外洩負責。

root.note: 可被歸咎的

senses.en: a person responsible for a crime or wrongdoing
the cause of a problem

ex.en: A loose wire turned out to be the culprit behind the power outage.
ex.zh: 原來一條鬆脫的電線才是停電的元兇。

parts.m: ready 準備好（古法文 prest）

root.note: 犯了錯的人 → 犯人

senses.en: a tunnel or pipe that carries water under a road

ex.en: Heavy rain flooded the culvert under the highway.
ex.zh: 大雨淹沒了公路底下的涵洞。

senses.en: greed for money or possessions

ex.en: The con artist took advantage of his victims' cupidity.
ex.zh: 那個騙子利用了受害者的貪婪。

root.note: 強烈的慾望 → 貪婪（邱比特 Cupid 同源）

senses.en: able to be cured

ex.en: Many cancers are curable if found early.
ex.zh: 許多癌症若及早發現是可以治癒的。

root.note: 可以治療的

senses.en: a person in charge of a museum or collection

ex.en: The curator chose which paintings would appear in the exhibit.
ex.zh: 策展人挑選哪些畫作會出現在展覽中。

root.note: 照管收藏品的人

senses.en: a rare, unusual, or interesting object

ex.en: I bought a small curio from the antique shop as a gift for my aunt.
ex.zh: 我在古董店買了一件小古玩送給阿姨。

root.note: 引人好奇的東西 → 珍品

senses.en: written with the letters joined together
handwriting with joined letters

ex.en: My grandmother writes letters in beautiful cursive script.
ex.zh: 我奶奶用漂亮的草寫體寫信。

root.note: 筆跑得很快 → 草寫的

senses.en: hasty and not thorough

ex.en: After a cursory glance at the menu, he ordered a burger.
ex.zh: 他匆匆瞄了一眼菜單，就點了漢堡。

root.note: 跑過去看一下 → 草率的

senses.en: rudely brief in speech

ex.en: She gave a curt reply and walked away.
ex.zh: 她冷冷地簡短回了一句就走了。

root.note: 話很短 → 簡慢的

senses.en: to reduce or limit something

ex.en: The school had to curtail after-school programs because of budget cuts.
ex.zh: 學校因預算刪減，不得不縮減課後活動。

root.note: 剪短 → 縮減

mn: 想成 cut + tail：把尾巴剪掉 → 縮減。

senses.en: a woman's bow made by bending the knees
to make such a bow

ex.en: The little girl learned to curtsy before meeting the queen.
ex.zh: 小女孩在晉見女王前學會了行屈膝禮。

root.note: 表示禮貌的動作 → 屈膝禮

senses.en: the curve traced by a point on the rim of a rolling circle

ex.en: A point on a rolling bicycle wheel traces a cycloid.
ex.zh: 滾動的腳踏車輪上的一點會畫出一條擺線。

root.note: 圓滾動產生的曲線

senses.en: a young swan

ex.en: A gray cygnet followed its mother across the pond.
ex.zh: 一隻灰色的小天鵝跟著媽媽游過池塘。

root.note: 小天鵝

senses.en: believing that people are motivated only by self-interest
senses.zh: 憤世嫉俗的；認為人都自私的

senses.en: doubtful that something will be worthwhile

ex.en: After many broken promises, voters have become cynical about politicians.
ex.zh: 經歷多次跳票後，選民對政客變得憤世嫉俗。

root.note: 源自古希臘「犬儒學派」→ 憤世嫉俗的

senses.en: a belief that people act only out of self-interest; distrust

ex.en: His cynicism made it hard for him to trust anyone's kindness.
ex.zh: 他的憤世嫉俗讓他很難相信任何人的善意。

root.note: 犬儒主義

senses.en: a person or thing that is the center of attention or admiration

ex.en: In her red gown, she was the cynosure of the entire ballroom.
ex.zh: 穿著紅色禮服的她，成了整個舞廳的焦點。

root.note: 「狗尾巴」指小熊座（北極星所在），水手都盯著它 → 眾人注目的焦點

senses.en: bold and willing to take risks
adventurous courage

ex.en: The firefighters made a daring rescue from the burning building.
ex.zh: 消防員從失火的大樓中進行了一次大膽的救援。

root.note: 敢於冒險的

senses.en: (literary) growing dark; in the dark

ex.en: The poet walked alone across the darkling plain.
ex.zh: 詩人獨自走過昏暗的平原。

root.note: 在黑暗中

senses.en: Charles Darwin's theory that species evolve through natural selection
senses.zh: 達爾文學說；天擇演化論

ex.en: Darwinism changed how scientists understood the history of life on Earth.
ex.zh: 達爾文學說改變了科學家對地球生命史的理解。

root.note: 達爾文的學說

senses.en: (old use) a mean, sneaky coward

ex.en: Only a dastard would attack a sleeping enemy.
ex.zh: 只有卑鄙的懦夫才會攻擊熟睡中的敵人。

mn: 形容詞 dastardly（卑鄙的）比較常見。

senses.en: a single piece of information or fact
a fixed point or line used as a reference for measurement

ex.en: Each datum in the survey was checked twice for accuracy.
ex.zh: 調查中的每一筆資料都經過兩次核對以確保準確。

root.note: 被給定的東西 → 資料

mn: datum 是單數，複數是 data。

senses.en: showing fearlessness and determination

ex.en: The dauntless explorer set off across the frozen continent.
ex.zh: 那位無所畏懼的探險家出發橫越冰封的大陸。

root.note: 嚇不倒的 → 無畏的

senses.en: (old use) a worker hired and paid by the day

ex.en: The farmer hired a day-man to help bring in the harvest.
ex.zh: 農夫雇了一名日薪工人幫忙收割。

senses.en: a race or contest in which two or more competitors finish exactly even

ex.en: The two horses crossed the line together, and the race was declared a dead-heat.
ex.zh: 兩匹馬同時衝過終點，比賽被判定為平手。

senses.en: a scarcity or lack of something

ex.en: There is a dearth of qualified teachers in rural areas.
ex.zh: 鄉村地區缺乏合格的教師。

root.note: 東西稀少所以珍貴 → 缺乏

mn: dear + th：東西少了才變得 dear（珍貴）。

senses.en: a human skull used as a symbol of death

ex.en: The pirate flag showed a death's-head above two crossed bones.
ex.zh: 海盜旗上畫著骷髏頭和兩根交叉的骨頭。

senses.en: to reduce the quality, value, or dignity of something

ex.en: Cheap jokes only debase the level of political debate.
ex.zh: 廉價的笑話只會拉低政治辯論的水準。

root.note: 使降低 → 貶低

senses.en: open to discussion or argument; not certain

ex.en: Whether the new rule will help students is debatable.
ex.zh: 新規定是否對學生有幫助，還有待商榷。

root.note: 可以辯論的

senses.en: confident, stylish, and charming (usually of a man)
senses.zh: 溫文爾雅的；風度翩翩的

ex.en: The debonair actor charmed everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 那位風度翩翩的演員迷倒了派對上的每一個人。

root.note: 有好風度的 → 溫文爾雅

senses.en: a person's first appearance or performance in public
to appear or present for the first time

ex.en: The young pianist made her debut at the age of twelve.
ex.zh: 那位年輕的鋼琴家在十二歲時首次登台。

root.note: 開始朝目標出發 → 首次登場

senses.en: a flat shape with ten straight sides and ten angles

ex.en: The students used a ruler to draw a regular decagon.
ex.zh: 學生們用尺畫出一個正十邊形。

root.note: 十個角 → 十邊形

senses.en: a unit of mass equal to ten grams

ex.en: A decagram of salt is roughly two teaspoons.
ex.zh: 十公克的鹽大約是兩茶匙。

root.note: 十公克

senses.en: a unit of volume equal to ten liters

ex.en: The bucket holds exactly one decaliter of water.
ex.zh: 這個水桶剛好能裝十公升的水。

root.note: 十公升

senses.en: the Ten Commandments; any set of ten basic rules

ex.en: The coach posted a decalogue of team rules in the locker room.
ex.zh: 教練在更衣室貼出了球隊的十條守則。

root.note: 十句話 → 十誡

senses.en: a collection of a hundred tales by the Italian writer Boccaccio, told over ten days

ex.en: In the Decameron, ten young people tell stories while hiding from the plague.
ex.zh: 在《十日談》中，十個年輕人一邊躲避瘟疫一邊說故事。

root.note: 十天 → 十日談

senses.en: a unit of length equal to ten meters

ex.en: A decameter is equal to ten meters, about the length of a school bus.
ex.zh: 一個十公尺單位等於十公尺，大約是一輛校車的長度。

root.note: 十公尺

senses.en: to leave suddenly or secretly
to break up a camp

ex.en: The con man tried to decamp with the investors' money.
ex.zh: 那名騙子試圖捲走投資人的錢潛逃。

root.note: 離開營地 → 拔營、潛逃

senses.en: to cut off the head of
to remove the leadership of an organization

ex.en: The storm seemed to decapitate every flower in the garden.
ex.zh: 暴風雨彷彿把花園裡每朵花的頭都削掉了。

root.note: 去掉頭 → 斬首

senses.en: a crustacean with ten legs, such as a crab or lobster

ex.en: A crab is a decapod because it has ten legs.
ex.zh: 螃蟹屬於十足目動物，因為牠有十隻腳。

root.note: 十隻腳的動物

senses.en: a line of verse with ten syllables

ex.en: Each line of the sonnet is a decasyllable.
ex.zh: 這首十四行詩的每一行都是十個音節。

root.note: 十個音節

senses.en: the act of hiding the truth to trick someone

ex.en: Their friendship ended when she discovered his deceit.
ex.zh: 她發現他的欺騙後，兩人的友誼就結束了。

root.note: 把人帶離真相 → 欺騙

senses.en: tending to lie or trick others

ex.en: The deceitful salesman hid the car's real problems.
ex.zh: 那個不老實的業務員隱瞞了車子真正的問題。

root.note: 充滿欺騙的

senses.en: to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: Don't let the calm water deceive you; the current is very strong.
ex.zh: 別被平靜的水面騙了，水流其實很強。

root.note: 把人從真相帶走 → 欺騙

mn: 拼字口訣：i before e except after c → deceive。

senses.en: behavior that is moral, honest, and respectful

ex.en: He did not even have the decency to apologize.
ex.zh: 他連道歉的基本禮貌都沒有。

root.note: 合宜得體 → 正派

senses.en: of an acceptable or good enough quality
honest, kind, and respectable

ex.en: She found a decent job with a good salary.
ex.zh: 她找到一份薪水不錯的像樣工作。

root.note: 合宜的 → 像樣、正派

mn: 別和 descent（下降）搞混，唸法也不同：decent [ˋdisṇt]。

senses.en: (of trees) shedding leaves every year
(of teeth or horns) falling off at a certain stage

ex.en: Maples and oaks are deciduous trees that lose their leaves in autumn.
ex.zh: 楓樹和橡樹是秋天會落葉的落葉樹。

root.note: 往下掉落的 → 落葉的

senses.en: based on the number ten
a fraction written with a dot, such as 0.5

ex.en: Move the decimal point two places to the right.
ex.zh: 把小數點向右移兩位。

root.note: 以十為單位的

senses.en: to kill or destroy a large part of something

ex.en: A new disease could decimate the bee population.
ex.zh: 一種新的疾病可能讓蜜蜂數量銳減。

root.note: 古羅馬軍中處死十分之一士兵以示懲戒 → 大量毀滅

senses.en: to work out the meaning of something hard to read or understand

ex.en: I could barely decipher the doctor's handwriting.
ex.zh: 我幾乎看不懂醫生寫的字。

root.note: 解開密碼 → 破譯

senses.en: a speech delivered with dramatic force; the art of formal speaking

ex.en: The actor's declamation of the poem moved the audience to tears.
ex.zh: 那位演員慷慨激昂地朗誦這首詩，讓觀眾感動落淚。

root.note: 大聲疾呼 → 演說

senses.en: expressing feelings in a loud, dramatic way, often without real depth
senses.zh: 高談闊論的；誇張做作的

ex.en: His declamatory style of speaking annoyed the quiet audience.
ex.zh: 他那種慷慨激昂的說話風格讓安靜的聽眾感到厭煩。

root.note: 大聲疾呼的

senses.en: (of a sentence) making a statement

ex.en: "The sky is blue" is a declarative sentence.
ex.zh: The sky is blue 是一個直述句。

root.note: 說清楚的 → 陳述的

senses.en: the changes in form of nouns, pronouns, or adjectives in some languages
a decline or falling off

ex.en: Latin students must memorize each noun declension.
ex.zh: 學拉丁文的學生必須背下每一種名詞變格。

root.note: 從原形往下偏 → 詞形變化

senses.en: to make something look more attractive by adding things to it
to give a medal or award to

ex.en: We will decorate the classroom for the holiday party.
ex.zh: 我們會為節日派對布置教室。

root.note: 使變美 → 裝飾

senses.en: polite and behaving properly in a social situation
senses.zh: 端莊得體的；合乎禮節的

ex.en: The guests remained decorous throughout the formal ceremony.
ex.zh: 賓客們在整個正式典禮中都舉止端莊。

root.note: 合宜的 → 得體的

senses.en: [ˋdikɔɪ] a person or thing used to lure someone into a trap
to lure into a trap

ex.en: Hunters placed a wooden duck on the water as a decoy.
ex.zh: 獵人把一隻木鴨放在水面上當誘餌。

senses.en: old and in very poor condition

ex.en: The decrepit old barn looked ready to fall down.
ex.zh: 那座破舊的老穀倉看起來快要倒了。

root.note: 老到嘎吱作響 → 衰老破舊

senses.en: the quality of being committed to a task or purpose
words at the beginning of a book honoring someone

ex.en: Her dedication to her patients earned her an award.
ex.zh: 她對病人的全心奉獻讓她獲得了一個獎項。

root.note: 正式宣告要奉獻給… → 奉獻

senses.en: to reach a conclusion by reasoning from evidence

ex.en: From the muddy boots, the detective could deduce that the man had walked through the field.
ex.zh: 從泥濘的靴子，偵探可以推斷那個人曾走過田地。

root.note: 從證據引導出結論 → 推論

mn: deduce（推論）別和 deduct（扣除）搞混。

senses.en: to spoil the surface or appearance of something

ex.en: Vandals tried to deface the statue with spray paint.
ex.zh: 破壞者試圖用噴漆塗汙雕像。

root.note: 毀壞表面

senses.en: to misuse or steal money one has been trusted with

ex.en: The treasurer was caught trying to defalcate the club's funds.
ex.zh: 財務被逮到企圖侵吞社團的經費。

root.note: 用鐮刀割走一部分 → 侵吞

senses.en: the act of damaging someone's reputation with false statements

ex.en: The actor sued the magazine for defamation.
ex.zh: 那位演員控告這家雜誌誹謗。

root.note: 把名聲拉下 → 誹謗

senses.en: to damage someone's reputation by saying false things

ex.en: It is illegal to defame someone by spreading lies online.
ex.zh: 在網路上散播謊言誹謗他人是違法的。

root.note: 拉低名聲 → 誹謗

senses.en: a preselected option used when no other choice is made
failure to pay a debt or fulfill a duty
to fail to pay a debt

ex.en: If the company cannot pay its loans, it will default.
ex.zh: 如果公司無法償還貸款，就會違約。

root.note: 缺失、沒做到 → 違約；沒選時的預設

mn: by default：因對方缺席或無其他選擇而自動…。

senses.en: a person accused or sued in a court of law

ex.en: The defendant pleaded not guilty to all charges.
ex.zh: 被告對所有罪名都表示不認罪。

root.note: 要把攻擊擋開的人 → 被告

senses.en: able to be justified or supported by argument
able to be protected from attack

ex.en: Her decision to leave early was perfectly defensible.
ex.zh: 她提早離開的決定完全說得過去。

root.note: 可以擋開攻擊的 → 站得住腳

senses.en: used or intended to protect against attack
quick to protect oneself from criticism

ex.en: He gets defensive whenever someone questions his work.
ex.zh: 只要有人質疑他的工作，他就會變得很防衛。

root.note: 擋開攻擊的 → 防禦的

senses.en: to put off to a later time
to yield to another's opinion or authority out of respect

ex.en: On medical questions, I defer to my doctor's judgment.
ex.zh: 在醫療問題上，我聽從醫生的判斷。

root.note: 帶離現在 → 延後；把決定權帶給別人 → 聽從

senses.en: polite respect and willingness to accept someone's opinion

ex.en: Out of deference to her grandmother, she wore a dress to church.
ex.zh: 出於對奶奶的尊重，她穿洋裝去教會。

root.note: 聽從他人 → 尊重

senses.en: openly resisting or refusing to obey

ex.en: The defiant teenager refused to turn off his music.
ex.zh: 那個叛逆的青少年拒絕關掉音樂。

root.note: 撤回信任與忠誠 → 反抗的

senses.en: a lack or shortage of something needed
a weakness or fault

ex.en: A vitamin D deficiency can make you feel tired.
ex.zh: 缺乏維生素 D 可能讓你覺得疲倦。

root.note: 沒做到、不夠 → 缺乏

senses.en: lacking in some necessary quality or amount

ex.en: The soil here is deficient in nitrogen.
ex.zh: 這裡的土壤缺乏氮。

root.note: 做得不夠的 → 不足的

senses.en: clearly stated or decided; not vague

ex.en: We need a definite answer by Friday.
ex.zh: 我們需要在星期五之前得到確定的答覆。

root.note: 界限劃清楚的 → 明確的

senses.en: to cause something to change direction
to turn attention or criticism away

ex.en: The politician tried to deflect questions about the scandal.
ex.zh: 那位政客試圖迴避有關醜聞的提問。

root.note: 彎離原本方向 → 使偏斜

senses.en: to clear an area of trees

ex.en: Farmers continue to deforest the hills to plant crops.
ex.zh: 農民持續砍伐山坡上的森林來種植作物。

root.note: 去除森林

senses.en: to change the shape of something so that it looks wrong

ex.en: Extreme heat can deform plastic containers.
ex.zh: 高溫會使塑膠容器變形。

root.note: 偏離原本的形狀 → 變形

senses.en: a part of the body that is not the normal shape

ex.en: Surgery corrected the deformity in the child's foot.
ex.zh: 手術矯正了孩子腳部的畸形。

root.note: 偏離正常形狀 → 畸形

senses.en: to illegally take money or property from someone by trickery

ex.en: The group tried to defraud elderly people through fake phone calls.
ex.zh: 這個集團試圖以假電話詐騙老人。

root.note: 以詐欺手段騙取

senses.en: to pay all or part of the cost of something

ex.en: The scholarship will help defray the cost of tuition.
ex.zh: 這筆獎學金將有助於支付學費。

senses.en: the state of having low moral standards; decline

ex.en: The novel describes the degeneracy of a once-great family.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫一個曾經顯赫的家族如何墮落。

root.note: 偏離本類、向下沉淪 → 墮落

senses.en: to become worse in quality or condition
[dɪˋdʒɛnərɪt] having low moral standards

ex.en: The friendly debate began to degenerate into a shouting match.
ex.zh: 友善的辯論開始演變成互相叫罵。

root.note: 偏離原本的本質 → 退化

senses.en: the process of becoming worse or damaged
the condition of being humiliated or losing respect

ex.en: Pollution has caused serious degradation of the river.
ex.zh: 汙染已經造成這條河嚴重惡化。

root.note: 往下降一階 → 惡化、降級

senses.en: to treat with disrespect; to humiliate
to break down or become worse in quality

ex.en: Plastic bags can take hundreds of years to degrade.
ex.zh: 塑膠袋可能要幾百年才能分解。

root.note: 往下降一階 → 貶低、降解

senses.en: to lose or remove water

ex.en: You can dehydrate quickly if you run in hot weather without water.
ex.zh: 在炎熱天氣跑步不喝水，很快就會脫水。

root.note: 去除水分 → 脫水

senses.en: to worship or treat as a god

ex.en: Fans sometimes deify celebrities as if they were perfect.
ex.zh: 粉絲有時把名人神化，好像他們完美無缺。

root.note: 使成為神

senses.en: to do something one thinks is beneath one's dignity

ex.en: The famous actor did not even deign to reply to my letter.
ex.zh: 那位知名演員連回我的信都不屑。

parts.m: think worthy 認為值得（拉丁文 dignus）

root.note: 認為對方值得 → 屈尊（dignity 同源）

senses.en: a person who believes God created the universe but does not interfere with it

ex.en: As a deist, he believed in a creator but rejected miracles.
ex.zh: 身為自然神論者，他相信造物主，但不相信神蹟。

root.note: 相信神（但不干預）的人

senses.en: a god or goddess

ex.en: Zeus was the most powerful deity in Greek mythology.
ex.zh: 宙斯是希臘神話中最強大的神。

root.note: 神

senses.en: to make someone sad or discouraged

ex.en: One bad grade should not deject you for the whole semester.
ex.zh: 一次成績不好，不應該讓你沮喪整個學期。

root.note: 把心情丟到谷底 → 使沮喪

mn: 形容詞 dejected（沮喪的）更常用。

senses.en: a sad and depressed state; low spirits

ex.en: The players walked off the field in dejection after the loss.
ex.zh: 輸球後，球員們垂頭喪氣地走下球場。

root.note: 心情被丟到谷底 → 沮喪

senses.en: (of food) delicious
delightful; charming

ex.en: The bakery sells a delectable chocolate cake.
ex.zh: 這家麵包店賣一種非常可口的巧克力蛋糕。

parts.m: delight 使愉快（拉丁文 delectare）

root.note: 令人愉快的 → 美味的

senses.en: pleasure and delight

ex.en: The chef prepared a feast for the delectation of his guests.
ex.zh: 主廚準備了一場盛宴讓賓客享受。

root.note: 愉悅

senses.en: causing harm or damage

ex.en: Smoking has a deleterious effect on nearly every organ in the body.
ex.zh: 吸菸對身體幾乎每個器官都有害。

parts.m: destroyer 破壞者（希臘文 dēlētēr）

root.note: 具破壞性的 → 有害的

mn: 聯想 delete（刪除）：會把你刪掉的東西當然有害。

senses.en: a rare or expensive food considered a special treat
fineness or fragility
tact and care in dealing with a difficult situation
senses.zh: （處理事情的）細膩；需謹慎處理的性質

ex.en: In many coastal towns, sea urchin is considered a delicacy.
ex.zh: 在許多沿海城鎮，海膽被視為珍饈。

root.note: 令人愉悅的精緻東西 → 佳餚、精緻

senses.en: to describe or explain something precisely
to mark the exact boundary of

ex.en: The contract should clearly delineate each person's responsibilities.
ex.zh: 合約應該清楚說明每個人的責任。

root.note: 用線描繪出來 → 描述、劃定

senses.en: to become liquid by absorbing moisture from the air
to melt away

ex.en: Some salts deliquesce when left in humid air.
ex.zh: 有些鹽類放在潮濕的空氣中會潮解。

root.note: 開始變成液體 → 潮解

senses.en: in a state of wild excitement or great happiness
confused and restless, especially because of fever or illness
senses.zh: （因發燒等）神智不清的；譫妄的

ex.en: The fans were delirious when their team scored in the final second.
ex.zh: 球隊在最後一秒得分時，球迷們欣喜若狂。

root.note: 犁田偏離了犁溝 → 脫離正軌 → 神智錯亂的

senses.en: to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: Do not delude yourself into thinking the exam will be easy.
ex.zh: 別自欺欺人，以為考試會很簡單。

root.note: 把人玩弄於股掌 → 欺騙

senses.en: a severe flood or heavy downpour
a large number of things arriving at the same time
to overwhelm with a large number of things

ex.en: After the announcement, the company received a deluge of complaints.
ex.zh: 公告發出後，公司湧入了大量投訴。

root.note: 把一切沖走的水 → 洪水

senses.en: a false belief that is firmly held despite evidence against it

ex.en: He was under the delusion that everyone at school admired him.
ex.zh: 他妄想學校裡每個人都很崇拜他。

root.note: 被玩弄而產生的想法 → 錯覺

mn: delusion 是堅信不疑的錯誤信念；illusion 多指感官上的錯覺。

senses.en: to remove the magnetic properties of something

ex.en: A strong magnet can demagnetize the strip on a credit card.
ex.zh: 強力磁鐵可能會讓信用卡的磁條消磁。

root.note: 去除磁性 → 消磁

senses.en: a political leader who gains support by appealing to people's emotions and prejudices rather than reason

ex.en: The demagogue blamed immigrants for every problem the town faced.
ex.zh: 那位煽動型政客把鎮上的所有問題都怪到移民頭上。

root.note: 帶領（煽動）人民的人 → 煽動家

senses.en: outward behavior or manner

ex.en: Despite the pressure, the pilot kept a calm demeanor.
ex.zh: 儘管壓力很大，機長仍保持冷靜的態度。

root.note: 一個人如何引導、表現自己 → 舉止

senses.en: behaving irrationally, especially because of anger or distress
suffering from dementia

ex.en: The demented laughter in the horror movie gave me chills.
ex.zh: 恐怖片裡那瘋狂的笑聲讓我全身發冷。

root.note: 心智離開了 → 發狂的

senses.en: a fault or disadvantage
a mark given as a punishment for a fault or offense

ex.en: Every late assignment will earn you a demerit on your record.
ex.zh: 每遲交一次作業，你的紀錄上就會被記一個缺點。

root.note: 與優點相反的 → 缺點

mn: 常見片語 merits and demerits（優缺點）。

senses.en: the end or failure of something
a person's death

ex.en: Online shopping contributed to the demise of many small bookstores.
ex.zh: 網路購物是許多小書店倒閉的原因之一。

root.note: 送走、讓出 → 原指財產轉讓，後指死亡、終結

senses.en: to release troops from active military service

ex.en: After the peace treaty, the government began to demobilize its army.
ex.zh: 和約簽訂後，政府開始遣散軍隊。

root.note: 動員的相反 → 復員

senses.en: to pull down or destroy a building
to prove an argument or theory completely wrong

ex.en: The city plans to demolish the old stadium next year.
ex.zh: 市政府打算明年拆除舊體育場。

root.note: 把建好的東西拆下 → 拆除

senses.en: clearly apparent or capable of being proved

ex.en: The new policy has had a demonstrable effect on air quality.
ex.zh: 新政策對空氣品質已產生明顯的效果。

root.note: 能夠清楚顯示出來 → 可證明的

senses.en: to show clearly that something is true or exists
to show how something works
to take part in a public protest

ex.en: The study aims to demonstrate a link between sleep and memory.
ex.zh: 這項研究旨在證明睡眠和記憶之間的關聯。

root.note: 清楚地顯示出來 → 證明、示範

senses.en: tending to show feelings, especially affection, openly
serving to show or prove something

ex.en: My family is not very demonstrative, so we rarely hug.
ex.zh: 我家人不太會表達感情，所以很少擁抱。

root.note: 把感情顯示出來 → 感情外露的

senses.en: a person who takes part in a public protest
a person who shows how something works

ex.en: One demonstrator held a sign demanding cleaner air.
ex.zh: 一名示威者舉著要求空氣更乾淨的標語。

root.note: 公開表達（顯示）意見的人 → 示威者

senses.en: soothing, especially to irritated skin or membranes
a substance that soothes irritation

ex.en: Honey acts as a demulcent for a sore throat.
ex.zh: 蜂蜜可以作為舒緩喉嚨痛的緩和劑。

root.note: 輕撫使平靜 → 緩和的

senses.en: a charge paid for delaying a ship or freight beyond the agreed time

ex.en: The importer had to pay demurrage because the cargo sat at the port for a week.
ex.zh: 貨物在港口擱了一週，進口商只好支付滯留費。

root.note: 延遲而付的費用 → 滯留費

senses.en: shaped like a tree; branching

ex.en: The fossil showed a delicate dendroid pattern on the rock.
ex.zh: 這塊化石在岩石上呈現精緻的樹枝狀紋路。

root.note: 像樹的 → 樹狀的

senses.en: the scientific study of trees

ex.en: She took a dendrology course to learn how to identify local trees.
ex.zh: 她修了一門樹木學課程，學習辨認當地的樹種。

root.note: 研究樹的學問 → 樹木學

senses.en: a person, animal, or plant that lives in a particular place

ex.en: The octopus is a clever denizen of the ocean floor.
ex.zh: 章魚是海底聰明的居民。

root.note: 住在裡面的人 → 居民

senses.en: to give a name to; to express an amount in a particular currency

ex.en: The company chose to denominate its bonds in US dollars.
ex.zh: 公司選擇以美元作為債券的計價貨幣。

root.note: 給予名字 → 命名

senses.en: a recognized branch of a church or religion
the face value of a banknote, coin, or stamp

ex.en: The machine only accepts bills of a small denomination.
ex.zh: 這台機器只收小面額的紙鈔。

root.note: 被命名的類別 → 教派、面額

senses.en: the number below the line in a fraction
a shared feature (in the phrase "common denominator")

ex.en: In the fraction three-quarters, four is the denominator.
ex.zh: 在四分之三這個分數中，四是分母。

root.note: 為分數「命名」的數（幾分之幾）→ 分母

mn: lowest common denominator：最小公分母，也引申為「迎合最低水準大眾」。

senses.en: to be a sign of; to indicate
to stand as a name or symbol for

ex.en: On this map, a red dot is used to denote a hospital.
ex.zh: 在這張地圖上，紅點用來表示醫院。

root.note: 做出標記 → 表示

mn: denote 是字面意義；connote 是言外之意、聯想意義。

senses.en: the final part of a story in which the plot is resolved

ex.en: The denouement reveals that the quiet butler was the hero all along.
ex.zh: 結局揭曉原來那位沉默的管家才是真正的英雄。

root.note: 把情節的結解開 → 結局

senses.en: to publicly declare something or someone to be wrong or evil
to inform against someone

ex.en: Leaders around the world rushed to denounce the attack.
ex.zh: 各國領袖紛紛譴責這起攻擊事件。

root.note: 公開宣告某人的罪過 → 譴責

senses.en: a paste or powder for cleaning teeth

ex.en: The old advertisement promised that its dentifrice would whiten any smile.
ex.zh: 那則舊廣告保證它的牙膏能讓任何笑容變白。

root.note: 摩擦牙齒的東西 → 牙膏

senses.en: to strip something of its covering, possessions, or natural features

ex.en: Years of logging will denude the hills of their forests.
ex.zh: 多年的伐木會讓山坡的森林被砍光。

root.note: 使完全赤裸 → 剝光

senses.en: public condemnation of someone or something
the act of informing against someone

ex.en: The senator's speech was a fierce denunciation of the new tax.
ex.zh: 參議員的演說是對新稅制的強烈譴責。

root.note: 公開宣告其過錯 → 譴責

senses.en: to use up the supply or resources of something

ex.en: Overfishing can deplete fish populations within a few years.
ex.zh: 過度捕撈可能在幾年內就讓魚群大量減少。

root.note: 與填滿相反 → 耗盡

senses.en: deserving strong condemnation; shockingly bad

ex.en: The animals were kept in deplorable conditions.
ex.zh: 那些動物被關在極其惡劣的環境中。

root.note: 讓人痛哭的 → 可悲的、糟糕的

senses.en: to feel or express strong disapproval of something

ex.en: Many teachers deplore the loss of arts programs in schools.
ex.zh: 許多老師對學校取消藝術課程深感痛惜。

root.note: 為某事痛哭 → 深感遺憾、譴責

senses.en: a person who gives sworn testimony, especially in writing

ex.en: The deponent signed the statement in front of a notary.
ex.zh: 作證人在公證人面前簽署了證詞。

root.note: 把證詞放下（記錄下來）的人 → 證人

senses.en: to greatly reduce the number of people living in a place

ex.en: The lack of jobs threatens to depopulate rural villages.
ex.zh: 缺乏工作機會可能使鄉村人口大量流失。

root.note: 去除人口 → 使人口減少

senses.en: to force a foreigner to leave a country
to behave in a specified way

ex.en: The government can deport visitors who overstay their visas.
ex.zh: 政府可以將簽證逾期的訪客驅逐出境。

root.note: 把人帶走 → 驅逐出境

senses.en: the way a person stands, walks, and behaves

ex.en: The finishing school taught young women deportment and etiquette.
ex.zh: 那所禮儀學校教導年輕女性儀態和禮節。

root.note: 如何攜帶（持）自己 → 舉止

senses.en: a sworn statement made outside of court, used as evidence
the removal of someone from power
the laying down of sediment

ex.en: The witness gave a deposition before the trial began.
ex.zh: 證人在審判開始前提供了宣誓證詞。

root.note: 放下 → 沉積、放下權位、寫下證詞

senses.en: a person who puts money in a bank account

ex.en: Each depositor is insured for up to a certain amount.
ex.zh: 每位存款人都享有一定金額以內的存款保險。

root.note: 把錢放下的人 → 存款人

senses.en: a place where things are stored for safekeeping

ex.en: The library serves as a depository for government documents.
ex.zh: 這座圖書館是政府文件的保存處。

root.note: 放東西的地方 → 儲藏所

senses.en: to make someone morally bad; to corrupt

ex.en: Some critics feared that violent films would deprave young viewers.
ex.zh: 有些評論家擔心暴力電影會使年輕觀眾墮落。

root.note: 使變得彎曲、邪惡 → 使墮落

senses.en: to express disapproval of
to belittle; to play down
(software) to mark a feature as no longer recommended

ex.en: She tends to deprecate her own achievements when people praise her.
ex.zh: 別人稱讚她時，她總是貶低自己的成就。

root.note: 祈求讓某事遠離 → 反對、不贊成

mn: self-deprecating（自嘲的）很常見；別和 depreciate（貶值）搞混。

senses.en: to lose value over time
to belittle or disparage

ex.en: A new car can depreciate by twenty percent in its first year.
ex.zh: 新車在第一年就可能折舊兩成。

root.note: 價格往下 → 貶值

senses.en: a reduction in the value of something over time

ex.en: The depreciation of the currency made imports more expensive.
ex.zh: 貨幣貶值讓進口商品變得更貴。

root.note: 價格往下 → 貶值

senses.en: to make someone sad or discouraged
