to reduce the level or activity of something
senses.zh: 使（價格、活動）降低；使蕭條

senses.en: to push or press down

ex.en: Gray, rainy weather tends to depress me.
ex.zh: 陰雨綿綿的天氣常讓我心情低落。

root.note: 往下壓 → 使沮喪、使降低

senses.en: a mental condition of persistent sadness and loss of interest
a long period of severe economic decline
a sunken area on a surface

ex.en: Millions lost their jobs during the Great Depression of the 1930s.
ex.zh: 1930 年代的經濟大蕭條期間，數百萬人失業。

root.note: 被往下壓的狀態 → 沮喪、蕭條、凹陷

senses.en: the distance from the top or surface to the bottom
complexity and thoroughness of thought or feeling

ex.en: The novel shows surprising emotional depth for a first book.
ex.zh: 以處女作來說，這本小說展現了驚人的情感深度。

senses.en: in a very poor condition because of neglect; abandoned
failing to do one's duty
a homeless person without means of support

ex.en: Artists turned the derelict factory into a busy gallery.
ex.zh: 藝術家們把那座廢棄工廠改造成熱鬧的藝廊。

root.note: 完全丟下不管 → 被遺棄的；失職的

senses.en: to express contempt for; to mock

ex.en: Critics were quick to deride the idea, but it later proved successful.
ex.zh: 評論家們很快就嘲笑這個點子，但它後來證明是成功的。

root.note: 居高臨下地笑 → 嘲笑

senses.en: deserving to be mocked; laughable

ex.en: His derisible excuse made the whole class groan.
ex.zh: 他那可笑的藉口讓全班都唉聲嘆氣。

root.note: 能被嘲笑的 → 可笑的

senses.en: contemptuous ridicule or mockery

ex.en: His strange proposal was met with derision from the committee.
ex.zh: 他那奇怪的提案遭到委員會的嘲笑。

root.note: 居高臨下地笑 → 嘲笑

senses.en: the origin or source of something, especially a word
the process of obtaining something from a source

ex.en: The derivation of the word "salary" is linked to salt.
ex.zh: 「salary（薪水）」這個字的起源與鹽有關。

root.note: 從源頭引出的水流 → 起源、衍生

senses.en: imitative of someone else's work; unoriginal
something that comes from another source
(math) the rate of change of a function; (finance) a contract based on an asset's value

ex.en: Critics called the band's new album dull and derivative.
ex.zh: 樂評認為這個樂團的新專輯既無聊又缺乏原創性。

root.note: 從別的源頭引出來的 → 衍生的、模仿的

senses.en: to obtain something from a specified source
to originate or develop from

ex.en: Many people derive great pleasure from gardening.
ex.zh: 許多人從園藝中獲得極大的樂趣。

root.note: 從溪流引出水 → 獲得、源自

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with the skin

ex.en: She is doing her residency in dermatology at a large hospital.
ex.zh: 她在一家大醫院的皮膚科當住院醫師。

root.note: 研究皮膚的學問 → 皮膚醫學

senses.en: a crane for lifting heavy objects
the framework over an oil well

ex.en: A tall derrick rose above the oil field.
ex.zh: 一座高聳的鑽塔矗立在油田上。

mn: 源自 17 世紀倫敦一位名叫 Derrick 的絞刑手，原本指絞刑架。

senses.en: a person, animal, or plant descended from a particular ancestor
something that developed from an earlier form

ex.en: She is a descendant of farmers who settled here two centuries ago.
ex.zh: 她是兩百年前在此定居的農民的後代。

root.note: 從家族往下傳的人 → 後代

senses.en: descending; going downward
variant spelling of "descendant"

ex.en: The descendent path wound down toward the river.
ex.zh: 那條下坡路蜿蜒通往河邊。

root.note: 往下爬的 → 下降的

mn: 名詞「後代」通常拼成 descendant；-ent 多作形容詞用。

senses.en: the action of moving downward
a person's family origin or ancestry

ex.en: The plane began its descent toward the airport.
ex.zh: 飛機開始朝機場下降。

root.note: 往下爬 → 下降；世代往下 → 血統

mn: descent（下降）vs. dissent（異議）vs. decent（正派的）。

senses.en: to catch sight of something distant or hard to see

ex.en: From the tower, the guard could descry a ship on the horizon.
ex.zh: 從塔上，守衛隱約看見地平線上有一艘船。

senses.en: a dry, barren area with little rainfall
[dɪˋzɝt] to abandon a person or place, especially without help
[dɪˋzɝt] to leave the armed forces without permission

ex.en: Camels can travel for days across the desert without drinking.
ex.zh: 駱駝可以好幾天不喝水穿越沙漠。

ex.en: A true friend would never desert you in a crisis.
ex.zh: 真正的朋友絕不會在危難時拋棄你。

root.note: 不再連接 → 拋棄；被拋棄的荒地 → 沙漠

mn: desert 只有一個 s；甜點 dessert 有兩個 s（甜點吃再多也不嫌多）。

senses.en: a substance used to absorb moisture and keep things dry

ex.en: A small packet of desiccant keeps the seaweed snacks crisp.
ex.zh: 一小包乾燥劑讓海苔零食保持酥脆。

root.note: 使完全乾燥的東西 → 乾燥劑

senses.en: to officially choose someone or something for a particular role
to give a name or label to
appointed to a position but not yet in it

ex.en: The city will designate this area as a nature reserve.
ex.zh: 市政府將把這個地區劃定為自然保護區。

root.note: 做記號標出 → 指定

senses.en: to stop doing something

ex.en: The court ordered the company to desist from using the logo.
ex.zh: 法院命令該公司停止使用這個商標。

root.note: 站開、不再繼續 → 停止

mn: 法律用語 cease and desist（停止並終止）。

senses.en: the act of stopping, especially of criminal behavior

ex.en: Job training programs can encourage desistance from crime.
ex.zh: 職業訓練計畫能鼓勵人們不再犯罪。

root.note: 站開不再繼續 → 停止

senses.en: the complete loss of hope
to lose all hope

ex.en: Do not despair; there is still time to fix the mistake.
ex.zh: 別絕望，還有時間可以補救這個錯誤。

root.note: 沒有希望 → 絕望

senses.en: a reckless and dangerous criminal

ex.en: In the old western, a desperado robbed the train at gunpoint.
ex.zh: 在那部老西部片中，一名亡命之徒持槍搶劫火車。

root.note: 絕望而不顧一切的人 → 亡命之徒

senses.en: feeling or showing hopelessness and willing to try anything
extremely serious or dangerous
having a great need or desire for something

ex.en: After hours in the sun, the hikers were desperate for water.
ex.zh: 在烈日下走了幾個小時後，健行者們極度渴望喝水。

root.note: 沒有希望的 → 絕望的、不顧一切的

senses.en: deserving hatred and contempt

ex.en: Stealing from a charity is a despicable act.
ex.zh: 偷慈善機構的錢是卑劣的行為。

root.note: 該被往下看（瞧不起）的 → 卑鄙的

senses.en: without being affected by; in spite of

ex.en: The game continued despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 儘管下著大雨，比賽仍繼續進行。

root.note: 原意是輕視；「不把某事放在眼裡」→ 儘管

mn: despite 後面直接接名詞，不加 of；in spite of 才要 of。

senses.en: to become discouraged or lose hope
a state of low spirits (as in "the slough of despond")

ex.en: We must not despond just because the first attempt failed.
ex.zh: 我們不能只因為第一次嘗試失敗就灰心喪志。

root.note: 放棄承諾、喪失勇氣 → 沮喪

senses.en: in low spirits from loss of hope or courage

ex.en: He became despondent after being rejected by every college he applied to.
ex.zh: 被所有申請的大學拒絕後，他變得非常消沉。

root.note: 喪失勇氣與信心的 → 沮喪的

senses.en: a ruler with absolute power, especially one who uses it cruelly

ex.en: The despot jailed anyone who dared to criticize him.
ex.zh: 那個暴君把任何敢批評他的人都關進牢裡。

parts.m: master, lord 主人（希臘文 despotēs）

root.note: 家中的主人 → 擁有絕對權力的人

senses.en: rule by a single person with absolute power

ex.en: The revolution ended centuries of despotism.
ex.zh: 這場革命終結了數百年的專制統治。

root.note: 暴君的統治制度 → 專制

senses.en: extremely poor and lacking basic necessities
completely lacking in something (destitute of)

ex.en: The flood left thousands of families destitute.
ex.zh: 這場水災讓數千個家庭一貧如洗。

root.note: 被放在一旁、被拋棄的 → 一無所有的

senses.en: lacking a plan or purpose; jumping from one thing to another
senses.zh: 散漫的；雜亂無章的；隨意的

ex.en: We made desultory conversation while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公車時，我們有一搭沒一搭地聊著。

root.note: 像馬戲團演員在馬背間跳來跳去 → 東跳西跳、散漫的

senses.en: to discourage someone from doing something, usually by fear of consequences

ex.en: Bright lights can deter burglars from entering a home.
ex.zh: 明亮的燈光可以嚇阻竊賊闖入住家。

root.note: 嚇走 → 嚇阻

senses.en: to become progressively worse

ex.en: Without repairs, the old bridge will deteriorate quickly.
ex.zh: 若不維修，這座舊橋會很快損壞。

root.note: 變得更壞 → 惡化

senses.en: having exact and definite limits

ex.en: The contract runs for a determinate period of five years.
ex.zh: 這份合約有明確的期限，為期五年。

root.note: 界限已劃定的 → 確定的

senses.en: firmness of purpose; resoluteness
the process of establishing something exactly

ex.en: Her determination to finish the marathon inspired everyone.
ex.zh: 她跑完馬拉松的決心激勵了每一個人。

root.note: 把界限劃定 → 確定；心意已定 → 決心

senses.en: a thing that discourages someone from doing something
able or intended to deter

ex.en: Security cameras act as a deterrent to shoplifters.
ex.zh: 監視器對順手牽羊的人具有嚇阻作用。

root.note: 把人嚇走的東西 → 嚇阻物

senses.en: to dislike intensely

ex.en: I detest waking up early on cold winter mornings.
ex.zh: 我非常討厭在寒冷的冬天早上早起。

root.note: 舉證指責、詛咒 → 痛恨

senses.en: to reduce the value or quality of something (detract from)

ex.en: A few typos do not detract from the strength of her essay.
ex.zh: 幾個錯字並不影響她這篇文章的出色。

root.note: 把價值拉走 → 減損

senses.en: harm or damage

ex.en: He worked long hours to the detriment of his health.
ex.zh: 他長時間工作，損害了自己的健康。

root.note: 磨掉、磨損 → 損害

mn: 常用片語 to the detriment of（對…有害）。

senses.en: to thrust or force down or away

ex.en: The powerful current can detrude loose rocks from the riverbank.
ex.zh: 強勁的水流能把鬆動的石塊從河岸推落。

root.note: 往下推 → 推落、逐出

senses.en: to depart from an established course or standard

ex.en: The pilot had to deviate from the planned route because of a storm.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雨，機長必須偏離原定航線。

root.note: 離開原本的路 → 偏離

senses.en: reckless mischief; wicked behavior

ex.en: The twins were always up to some devilry when the teacher looked away.
ex.zh: 老師一轉身，那對雙胞胎總是在搞惡作劇。

root.note: 魔鬼般的行為 → 惡作劇、惡行

senses.en: reckless mischief; wicked behavior (chiefly American variant of devilry)
senses.zh: 惡作劇；惡行（devilry 的美式變體）

ex.en: The boys' deviltry included hiding frogs in the teacher's desk.
ex.zh: 那群男孩的惡作劇包括把青蛙藏進老師的桌子裡。

root.note: 魔鬼般的行為 → 惡作劇

senses.en: using dishonest or indirect methods to get what one wants
not straight or direct; winding

ex.en: The villain came up with a devious plan to steal the jewels.
ex.zh: 反派想出一個狡詐的計畫來偷珠寶。

root.note: 偏離正路的 → 迂迴的、不正當的

senses.en: to plan or invent something by careful thought

ex.en: Engineers must devise a way to cool the new engine.
ex.zh: 工程師必須想出辦法讓新引擎降溫。

root.note: 仔細劃分、安排 → 設計

mn: devise（動詞，想出）vs. device（名詞，裝置）。

senses.en: deeply religious
totally committed to a cause or belief

ex.en: My devout grandmother prays every morning before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我虔誠的祖母每天早餐前都會禱告。

root.note: 完全發誓奉獻的 → 虔誠的

senses.en: skill in performing tasks, especially with the hands
mental skill or quickness

ex.en: Playing the piano requires great manual dexterity.
ex.zh: 彈鋼琴需要非常靈巧的雙手。

root.note: 像右手一樣靈活 → 靈巧

senses.en: characteristic of the devil; extremely wicked or cruel

ex.en: The villain's diabolic scheme nearly destroyed the city.
ex.zh: 反派那惡毒的陰謀差點毀掉整座城市。

root.note: 丟出惡意中傷的話（希臘文 diabolos 誹謗者 = 魔鬼）→ 惡魔般的

senses.en: (of a mark or sign) placed on a letter to show a different pronunciation

ex.en: The word "café" has a diacritical mark over the final letter.
ex.zh: 「café」這個字的最後一個字母上有一個變音符號。

root.note: 用來分辨區別的 → 區別發音的

senses.en: to identify the nature of an illness or problem by examination

ex.en: The mechanic needed an hour to diagnose the engine problem.
ex.zh: 技師花了一小時才找出引擎的問題。

root.note: 透徹地知道 → 診斷

senses.en: the identification of an illness or problem

ex.en: Early diagnosis greatly improves the chance of recovery.
ex.zh: 及早診斷能大大提高康復的機會。

root.note: 透徹地知道 → 診斷

senses.en: a form of a language spoken in a particular region or by a particular group

ex.en: My grandparents speak a dialect that I can barely understand.
ex.zh: 我祖父母說的方言我幾乎聽不懂。

root.note: 彼此之間的說話方式 → 方言

senses.en: a person skilled in logical argument and debate

ex.en: A skilled dialectician, she exposed every flaw in her opponent's reasoning.
ex.zh: 她是位高明的辯論家，揭露了對手推理中的每個漏洞。

root.note: 善於彼此對話論辯的人 → 辯證家

senses.en: conversation between two or more people, as in a book or film
a discussion aimed at resolving a problem

ex.en: The two countries agreed to open a dialogue on trade.
ex.zh: 兩國同意就貿易問題展開對話。

root.note: 彼此之間的說話 → 對話

senses.en: (of fabric) light, delicate, and see-through

ex.en: The dancer wore a diaphanous scarf that floated as she spun.
ex.zh: 舞者披著一條輕薄透明的圍巾，旋轉時隨之飄揚。

root.note: 光線能穿透而顯現 → 透明的

senses.en: (of a molecule) consisting of two atoms

ex.en: Oxygen gas is a diatomic molecule made of two oxygen atoms.
ex.zh: 氧氣是由兩個氧原子組成的雙原子分子。

root.note: 兩個原子的 → 雙原子的

senses.en: a bitter, forceful verbal attack or criticism

ex.en: The coach launched into a diatribe against the referees.
ex.zh: 教練開始對裁判大肆抨擊。

root.note: 原指消磨時間的講論，後指冗長的抨擊

senses.en: a formal pronouncement from an authority
a short statement expressing a general truth

ex.en: The old dictum "less is more" guides her design style.
ex.zh: 「少即是多」這句老格言引導著她的設計風格。

root.note: 被說出來的話 → 格言、宣告

senses.en: intended to teach, especially a moral lesson
in the manner of a teacher, often in a way that is preachy

ex.en: The fable is didactic, ending with a clear lesson about honesty.
ex.zh: 這則寓言帶有教化意味，結尾明確點出誠實的道理。

root.note: 用來教導的 → 教誨的

senses.en: a way in which things are not the same
the amount left when one number is subtracted from another
a disagreement

ex.en: Can you spot the difference between these two pictures?
ex.zh: 你看得出這兩張圖片的不同之處嗎？

root.note: 往不同方向帶開 → 差異

senses.en: (logic) a characteristic that distinguishes one species from others of the same genus

ex.en: In Aristotle's definition, "rational" is the differentia that separates humans from other animals.
ex.zh: 在亞里斯多德的定義中，「理性」是區分人類與其他動物的種差。

root.note: 把事物區分開的特徵 → 種差

senses.en: showing or depending on a difference; varying by circumstances
a difference in amount between comparable things
a gear that lets a vehicle's wheels turn at different speeds

ex.en: The pay differential between men and women remains a concern.
ex.zh: 男女之間的薪資差距仍是令人關注的問題。

root.note: 有區別的 → 差別的

senses.en: to recognize or show the difference between things
to make something different or distinct

ex.en: Young children often cannot differentiate between fantasy and reality.
ex.zh: 年幼的孩子常常分不清幻想和現實。

root.note: 把事物區分開來 → 區分

senses.en: shyness caused by a lack of self-confidence

ex.en: His diffidence made him hesitate to speak up in meetings.
ex.zh: 他缺乏自信，因此在會議上不太敢發言。

root.note: 不信任自己 → 缺乏自信

senses.en: modest or shy because of a lack of self-confidence

ex.en: The diffident new student barely spoke during her first week.
ex.zh: 那位羞怯的新同學第一週幾乎沒開口說話。

root.note: 不信任自己的 → 缺乏自信的

mn: diffident（不自信）和 confident（自信）是同字根 fid 的反義詞。

senses.en: able to spread out or be diffused

ex.en: Small, diffusible molecules pass easily through the cell membrane.
ex.zh: 小而可擴散的分子能輕易穿過細胞膜。

root.note: 能向四處倒出、流散的 → 可擴散的

senses.en: the spreading of something more widely
(science) the movement of particles from higher to lower concentration

ex.en: The printing press sped up the diffusion of new ideas across Europe.
ex.zh: 印刷術加快了新思想在歐洲的傳播。

root.note: 向四處流散 → 擴散

senses.en: a person of high rank or office

ex.en: Each foreign dignitary was greeted at the airport by the mayor.
ex.zh: 每位外國貴賓都由市長在機場親自迎接。

root.note: 尊貴的人 → 顯要人物

senses.en: a pair of letters representing one sound, such as "ph" or "sh"
senses.zh: 二合字母（兩個字母發一個音）

ex.en: The letters "th" form a digraph in the word "think."
ex.zh: 在 think 這個字中，th 是一個二合字母。

root.note: 兩個寫出的字母 → 二合字母

senses.en: to leave the main subject temporarily in speech or writing

ex.en: Let me digress for a moment to tell you a funny story.
ex.zh: 讓我稍微離題一下，跟你們說個有趣的故事。

root.note: 走開、離開主路 → 離題

senses.en: to make or become wider or larger
to speak or write at length (dilate on)

ex.en: Your pupils dilate when you walk into a dark room.
ex.zh: 當你走進暗室時，瞳孔會放大。

root.note: 向外張開變寬 → 擴張

senses.en: slow to act; intended to cause delay

ex.en: The lawyer used dilatory tactics to postpone the trial.
ex.zh: 律師用拖延戰術來延後審判。

parts.m: carry, put off 帶走、延後

root.note: 把事情往後推延的 → 拖延的

mn: 不要和 dilate（擴張）搞混：dilatory 與 delay 意思相近。

senses.en: a situation requiring a difficult choice between two options

ex.en: She faced a dilemma: tell the truth or protect her friend.
ex.zh: 她陷入兩難：說出實話，還是保護朋友。

root.note: 兩個前提 → 兩難

senses.en: a person who dabbles in an art or field without real commitment or knowledge

ex.en: Real painters dismissed him as a dilettante who painted only on weekends.
ex.zh: 真正的畫家們把他當成只在週末作畫的半吊子。

parts.m: delight 使愉快（義大利文 dilettare）

root.note: 只為取樂而涉獵的人 → 業餘愛好者

senses.en: careful and persistent work or effort

ex.en: Her diligence paid off when she won a full scholarship.
ex.zh: 她的勤奮有了回報，贏得了全額獎學金。

root.note: 用心挑選、珍視 → 認真 → 勤勉

mn: due diligence：盡職調查（商業、法律常用）。

senses.en: to make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water
to make something weaker in force or effect
(of a liquid) weakened by adding water

ex.en: You should dilute the juice with water for young children.
ex.zh: 給幼童喝的果汁應該用水稀釋。

root.note: 洗開、沖淡 → 稀釋

senses.en: a reduction in size, amount, or importance

ex.en: Doctors noticed a steady diminution in the tumor's size.
ex.zh: 醫生注意到腫瘤的大小持續縮小。

root.note: 變小 → 減少

senses.en: with little light; not brightly
vaguely or faintly

ex.en: I only dimly remember the house where I was born.
ex.zh: 我只隱約記得我出生的那棟房子。

senses.en: a sound formed by combining two vowels in a single syllable, as in "coin"

ex.en: The vowel sound in "boy" is a diphthong.
ex.zh: boy 這個字裡的母音是一個雙母音。

root.note: 兩個聲音 → 雙母音

mn: 注意拼法有兩個 h：di-ph-th-ong；ph 唸作 [f]。

senses.en: the management of relations between countries
skill in dealing with people tactfully

ex.en: The conflict was finally settled through careful diplomacy.
ex.zh: 這場衝突最終透過謹慎的外交手段解決。

parts.m: double, folded 對折（希臘文 diploma 對折的文件）

root.note: 處理官方對折文書（國書）的事務 → 外交

senses.en: an official who represents a country abroad
a person who deals with others tactfully

ex.en: The diplomat worked for years to improve relations between the two nations.
ex.zh: 這位外交官花了多年時間改善兩國關係。

root.note: 持有官方文書的人 → 外交官

senses.en: relating to diplomacy
tactful in dealing with people

ex.en: She gave a diplomatic answer that did not offend anyone.
ex.zh: 她給了一個圓滑的回答，誰也沒得罪。

root.note: 與外交文書有關的 → 外交的、圓滑的

senses.en: a diplomat (dated)

ex.en: The old diplomatist had served at embassies on four continents.
ex.zh: 那位老外交官曾在四大洲的大使館任職。

root.note: 從事外交的人 → 外交官

senses.en: to have a different opinion
(of food or climate) to make someone feel unwell

ex.en: It is fine to disagree as long as we stay respectful.
ex.zh: 只要彼此保持尊重，意見不同是沒關係的。

root.note: 不同意

senses.en: to refuse to accept something as valid

ex.en: The referee may disallow the goal if a player was offside.
ex.zh: 如果有球員越位，裁判可能判進球無效。

root.note: 不允許 → 駁回

senses.en: to cease to be visible
to cease to exist

ex.en: Many local languages may disappear within a generation.
ex.zh: 許多地方語言可能在一個世代內消失。

root.note: 與出現相反 → 消失

senses.en: to fail to meet someone's hopes or expectations

ex.en: I promise I will not disappoint you this time.
ex.zh: 我保證這次不會讓你失望。

root.note: 原指撤除職位，引申為讓期待落空 → 使失望

senses.en: to have or express an unfavorable opinion
to officially refuse to agree to

ex.en: My parents disapprove of video games on school nights.
ex.zh: 我爸媽不贊成我在上學日的晚上打電動。

root.note: 不贊成

senses.en: to take weapons away from someone
to reduce a country's military forces
to make someone less hostile or suspicious; to charm
senses.zh: 使消除敵意；使卸下心防

ex.en: Her warm smile seemed to disarm even the angriest customers.
ex.zh: 她溫暖的笑容似乎連最生氣的客人都能讓他們消氣。

root.note: 去除武器 → 解除武裝；卸下心防

senses.en: to make untidy or disordered

ex.en: Please do not disarrange the books on the display table.
ex.zh: 請不要把展示桌上的書弄亂。

root.note: 與排列整齊相反 → 弄亂

senses.en: to deny any responsibility for or connection with

ex.en: The party was quick to disavow the candidate's offensive remarks.
ex.zh: 該黨迅速撇清與候選人冒犯性言論的關係。

root.note: 不承認 → 否認

senses.en: a denial of responsibility for or connection with something

ex.en: The company issued a public disavowal of the manager's comments.
ex.zh: 公司公開聲明與該經理的言論劃清界線。

root.note: 不承認 → 否認

senses.en: a person who refuses to believe something, especially religious claims

ex.en: Even a disbeliever had to admit the magic trick was impressive.
ex.zh: 就連不信邪的人也不得不承認那個魔術令人驚嘆。

root.note: 不相信的人

senses.en: to relieve of a burden or worry

ex.en: Talking to a counselor helped her disburden her mind of guilt.
ex.zh: 和輔導員談談幫助她卸下了心中的罪惡感。

root.note: 去除負擔 → 卸下重擔

senses.en: to pay out money from a fund

ex.en: The foundation will disburse the grants in early spring.
ex.zh: 基金會將於初春撥發補助款。

root.note: 從錢包裡拿出 → 支付

mn: burs 就是 purse（錢包）；reimburse（償還）也是同字根。

senses.en: to get rid of something as no longer useful
[ˋdɪskɑrd] something that has been thrown away

ex.en: Please discard any food that has passed its expiration date.
ex.zh: 請丟掉任何超過保存期限的食物。

root.note: 把手上的牌丟掉 → 丟棄

senses.en: able to be seen, noticed, or recognized

ex.en: There was no discernible difference between the two samples.
ex.zh: 兩個樣本之間看不出有任何差別。

root.note: 能夠分辨開來的 → 可辨別的

senses.en: a follower or student of a teacher, leader, or philosophy

ex.en: As a disciple of the famous chef, he learned every classic recipe.
ex.zh: 身為那位名廚的弟子，他學會了每一道經典食譜。

root.note: 學習的人 → 門徒

senses.en: concerning punishment for breaking rules
relating to an academic field

ex.en: The student faced disciplinary action for cheating on the exam.
ex.zh: 該學生因考試作弊而面臨懲處。

root.note: 與訓練、紀律有關的 → 懲戒的

senses.en: the practice of training people to obey rules; controlled behavior
a branch of knowledge
to punish or train someone to obey rules

ex.en: It takes discipline to practice the violin every day.
ex.zh: 每天練小提琴需要自律。

root.note: 學習與訓練 → 紀律；學問 → 學科

senses.en: to refuse to acknowledge or accept responsibility for

ex.en: The website tried to disclaim any responsibility for errors.
ex.zh: 這個網站試圖撇清對任何錯誤的責任。

root.note: 不主張 → 否認、放棄

senses.en: to change or spoil the color of something

ex.en: Strong sunlight can discolor wooden furniture over time.
ex.zh: 強烈的陽光久了會讓木製家具變色。

root.note: 破壞顏色 → 變色

senses.en: to make someone feel uneasy or embarrassed
to defeat or thwart (archaic)

ex.en: The reporter's pointed question seemed to discomfit the mayor.
ex.zh: 記者尖銳的問題似乎讓市長很窘迫。

parts.m: make, do 做（拉丁文 facere）

root.note: 把做好的事破壞掉 → 挫敗 → 使困窘

mn: 別和 discomfort 混淆：discomfit 是「使窘迫、挫敗」。

senses.en: slight pain or physical unease
a feeling of embarrassment or anxiety

ex.en: You may feel some discomfort after the injection.
ex.zh: 打針後你可能會感到有些不舒服。

root.note: 不舒適

senses.en: to break the connection of or between
a lack of connection or understanding between things

ex.en: Remember to disconnect the charger once the battery is full.
ex.zh: 電池充飽後記得拔掉充電器。

root.note: 與連在一起相反 → 斷開

senses.en: very unhappy and unable to be comforted
senses.zh: 極度沮喪的；無法安慰的

ex.en: The disconsolate child sat alone after losing his puppy.
ex.zh: 那個失去小狗的孩子傷心地獨自坐著，怎麼安慰都沒用。

root.note: 無法被安慰的 → 極度沮喪的

senses.en: the act of stopping or ending something

ex.en: Customers protested the discontinuance of the bus route.
ex.zh: 乘客們抗議該公車路線停駛。

root.note: 不再繼續 → 停止

senses.en: disagreement between people
a lack of harmony between musical notes

ex.en: The argument over money caused discord within the family.
ex.zh: 為錢的爭執造成家中不和。

root.note: 心不在一起 → 不和

senses.en: to refuse to approve of; to discourage
to disturb the composure of

ex.en: The school board chose to discountenance the use of phones in class.
ex.zh: 校董會決定不贊成在課堂上使用手機。

root.note: 不給好臉色 → 不贊成

senses.en: to find something unexpectedly or for the first time
to become aware of a fact

ex.en: Scientists hope to discover life on other planets.
ex.zh: 科學家希望能在其他行星上發現生命。

root.note: 掀開蓋子 → 發現

senses.en: to harm the good reputation of someone
to cause an idea or evidence to seem false
loss of reputation or respect

ex.en: The lawyer tried to discredit the witness by pointing out past lies.
ex.zh: 律師藉由指出證人過去的謊言，試圖讓其證詞不可信。

root.note: 使不被相信 → 使丟臉、使不可信

senses.en: careful in speech or action to avoid causing offense or revealing secrets
unobtrusive; not attracting attention

ex.en: Please be discreet and do not mention the surprise party.
ex.zh: 請保密，不要提起驚喜派對的事。

root.note: 能分辨輕重的 → 謹慎的

mn: discreet（謹慎的）vs. discrete（分離的、個別的），拼法相近，意思不同。

senses.en: showing a lack of agreement; inconsistent

ex.en: The two witnesses gave discrepant accounts of the accident.
ex.zh: 兩名證人對這起事故的說法不一致。

root.note: 發出不同的聲音 → 不一致的

senses.en: to treat people unfairly based on race, sex, age, etc.
to recognize a difference between things

ex.en: Employers must not discriminate against applicants because of their age.
ex.zh: 雇主不得因應徵者的年齡而歧視他們。

root.note: 分辨區別 → 區別對待 → 歧視

senses.en: moving from subject to subject; rambling
proceeding by reasoning rather than intuition

ex.en: His discursive lecture covered everything except the assigned topic.
ex.zh: 他那東拉西扯的講課，除了指定主題之外什麼都講了。

root.note: 到處亂跑的 → 散漫的

senses.en: the act of talking about something to reach a decision or exchange ideas

ex.en: We had a long discussion about climate change in class.
ex.zh: 我們在課堂上針對氣候變遷進行了很長的討論。

root.note: 把問題敲開、分析 → 討論

senses.en: to deprive someone of the right to vote or other rights

ex.en: Strict ID laws may disenfranchise elderly and poor voters.
ex.zh: 嚴格的身分證明法規可能會剝奪年長和貧窮選民的投票權。

root.note: 去除權利 → 剝奪選舉權

senses.en: to separate or release something from something else
to withdraw from involvement or combat

ex.en: Students who disengage from class often fall behind.
ex.zh: 上課不投入的學生往往會跟不上進度。

root.note: 與咬合、參與相反 → 脫離

senses.en: disapproval or dislike

ex.en: The old tradition has fallen into disfavor among young people.
ex.zh: 這項舊傳統已經不受年輕人青睞。

root.note: 不喜愛 → 不贊成、失寵

senses.en: to spoil the appearance of

ex.en: Graffiti can disfigure even the most beautiful building.
ex.zh: 塗鴉能毀掉即使是最美的建築外觀。

root.note: 破壞形狀 → 損毀外觀

senses.en: the state of being only partly or carelessly dressed

ex.en: The actor answered the door in dishabille, still wearing his robe.
ex.zh: 那位演員衣衫不整地來應門，身上還穿著浴袍。

root.note: 沒穿好衣服 → 衣衫不整

senses.en: not truthful; likely to lie, cheat, or steal

ex.en: It is dishonest to copy a classmate's homework.
ex.zh: 抄同學的作業是不誠實的行為。

root.note: 不誠實的

senses.en: to make someone realize that a belief is false, often causing disappointment
disappointment from discovering something is not as good as believed

ex.en: I hate to disillusion you, but the job is not as glamorous as it looks.
ex.zh: 我不想讓你失望，但這份工作沒有看起來那麼光鮮。

root.note: 去除幻想 → 幻滅

senses.en: to clean something with chemicals to destroy bacteria

ex.en: Nurses disinfect the equipment after every patient.
ex.zh: 護理師在每位病人使用後都會為器材消毒。

root.note: 去除感染源 → 消毒

senses.en: a chemical that destroys bacteria

ex.en: Wipe the counter with disinfectant after cutting raw meat.
ex.zh: 切完生肉後，要用消毒劑擦拭流理台。

root.note: 去除感染源的東西 → 消毒劑

senses.en: to prevent someone from inheriting one's property

ex.en: The wealthy father threatened to disinherit his son.
ex.zh: 那位有錢的父親揚言要剝奪兒子的繼承權。

root.note: 去除繼承權

senses.en: not influenced by personal advantage; impartial
not interested (informal usage, often considered incorrect)

ex.en: A disinterested judge should decide the case.
ex.zh: 這件案子應該由一位公正無私的法官來判決。

root.note: 不牽涉個人利益的 → 公正的

mn: SAT 常考：disinterested 是「公正無私」，uninterested 才是「不感興趣」。

senses.en: lacking connection; separating
(grammar) expressing a choice or contrast, as "or" or "but"

ex.en: The film's disjunctive editing jumps between three different decades.
ex.zh: 這部電影不連貫的剪輯在三個年代之間跳來跳去。

root.note: 不連接的 → 分離的

senses.en: to move a bone out of its normal position in a joint
to disturb the normal order or position of something

ex.en: He fell off his bike and managed to dislocate his shoulder.
ex.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來，肩膀脫臼了。

root.note: 離開原位 → 脫臼、擾亂

senses.en: the act of ordering someone to leave a job
the act of treating something as unworthy of consideration

ex.en: The worker sued the company over his unfair dismissal.
ex.zh: 那名員工因遭不當解雇而控告公司。

root.note: 送走 → 解雇、駁回

senses.en: to get off a horse or bicycle
to remove something from its support

ex.en: Riders must dismount and walk their bikes across the bridge.
ex.zh: 騎士必須下車，牽著腳踏車走過橋。

root.note: 與騎上相反 → 下馬

senses.en: failure or refusal to obey rules or authority

ex.en: Civil disobedience was a key strategy of the civil rights movement.
ex.zh: 公民不服從是民權運動的一項重要策略。

root.note: 不服從

senses.en: refusing or failing to obey

ex.en: The disobedient puppy kept chewing the furniture.
ex.zh: 那隻不聽話的小狗一直咬家具。

root.note: 不服從的

senses.en: to refuse to acknowledge any connection with someone or something

ex.en: His parents threatened to disown him if he dropped out of school.
ex.zh: 他父母揚言，如果他輟學就要跟他斷絕關係。

root.note: 不承認是自己的 → 斷絕關係

senses.en: to speak of someone or something as having little value

ex.en: Good leaders do not disparage the ideas of their team members.
ex.zh: 好的領導者不會貶低團隊成員的想法。

root.note: 使降到不平等的地位 → 貶低

senses.en: a great difference, often an unfair one

ex.en: The report highlights the disparity between rich and poor neighborhoods.
ex.zh: 這份報告凸顯了富裕與貧窮社區之間的差距。

root.note: 不相等 → 差距

senses.en: to make a doubt, feeling, or belief disappear

ex.en: The scientist hoped to dispel common myths about vaccines.
ex.zh: 這位科學家希望能破除關於疫苗的常見迷思。

root.note: 驅趕走 → 驅散

senses.en: special permission to be exempt from a rule
the act of distributing something
a system or order prevailing at a particular time

ex.en: The athlete received a special dispensation to miss the final exam.
ex.zh: 這名運動員獲得特許，可以不參加期末考。

root.note: 秤好分發出去 → 分配；對規定的特別分配 → 特許

senses.en: to take the place of; to replace
to force people to leave their home
to move something from its usual position

ex.en: Robots may displace many factory workers in the coming decades.
ex.zh: 未來幾十年，機器人可能會取代許多工廠工人。

root.note: 離開原位置 → 取代、使流離失所

senses.en: to take land, property, or possessions away from someone

ex.en: The new law allowed the state to dispossess farmers of their land.
ex.zh: 新法允許政府剝奪農民的土地。

root.note: 去除擁有權 → 剝奪

senses.en: formal debate or argument

ex.en: Medieval students trained in public disputation on philosophy.
ex.zh: 中世紀的學生透過公開的哲學辯論來接受訓練。

root.note: 各自思考、提出不同想法 → 辯論

senses.en: to exclude someone from an activity for breaking a rule
to make someone unsuitable for a position

ex.en: A false start will disqualify a runner from the race.
ex.zh: 偷跑會讓跑者失去比賽資格。

root.note: 去除資格

senses.en: a feeling of worry or unease
to make someone worried or uneasy

ex.en: There is growing disquiet among parents about the new policy.
ex.zh: 家長們對新政策的憂慮日益加深。

root.note: 不平靜 → 不安

senses.en: to pay no attention to; to ignore
the act of ignoring something

ex.en: Drivers who disregard the speed limit put everyone at risk.
ex.zh: 無視速限的駕駛會讓所有人陷入危險。

root.note: 不注意 → 忽視

senses.en: not considered respectable in character or appearance

ex.en: He lost money by investing with a disreputable company.
ex.zh: 他投資了一家名聲不佳的公司，結果賠了錢。

root.note: 不被人看好的 → 名聲不好的

senses.en: the state of having a bad reputation

ex.en: The cheating scandal brought the whole sport into disrepute.
ex.zh: 這起作弊醜聞讓整個運動項目聲名狼藉。

root.note: 失去好名聲 → 不名譽

senses.en: to take off one's clothes; to undress

ex.en: Patients are asked to disrobe and put on a hospital gown.
ex.zh: 病人被要求脫掉衣服，換上病人服。

root.note: 脫下袍子 → 脫衣服

senses.en: to interrupt an activity or process by causing disorder
to radically change an industry or market with a new approach

ex.en: The storm could disrupt train service for several days.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雨可能讓火車停駛好幾天。

root.note: 破開 → 擾亂、中斷

senses.en: to fail to satisfy; to make discontented

ex.en: Long waiting times will dissatisfy even loyal customers.
ex.zh: 漫長的等待時間會讓即使是忠實的顧客也不滿意。

root.note: 不使滿足 → 使不滿

senses.en: to cut up a body or plant to study its parts
to analyze something in great detail

ex.en: In biology class, we had to dissect a frog.
ex.zh: 在生物課上，我們必須解剖一隻青蛙。

root.note: 切開 → 解剖

senses.en: the cutting up of a body or plant to study it
a detailed analysis

ex.en: The article offers a careful dissection of the election results.
ex.zh: 這篇文章對選舉結果做了細緻的剖析。

root.note: 切開 → 解剖、剖析

senses.en: to hide one's true feelings, motives, or beliefs

ex.en: She tried to dissemble her disappointment with a smile.
ex.zh: 她試著用微笑掩飾自己的失望。

root.note: 表現得和真實不相似 → 掩飾

mn: dissemble（掩飾）vs. disassemble（拆解）vs. resemble（相似）。

senses.en: to spread information or ideas widely

ex.en: Social media can disseminate news faster than any newspaper.
ex.zh: 社群媒體傳播新聞的速度比任何報紙都快。

root.note: 把種子撒開 → 散播

senses.en: disagreement that leads to discord

ex.en: The budget cuts created dissension among the staff.
ex.zh: 預算刪減在員工之間造成了不和。

root.note: 感覺各不相同 → 意見分歧

senses.en: the expression of disagreement with official views
to express disagreement with a prevailing opinion

ex.en: In a democracy, citizens have the right to dissent.
ex.zh: 在民主國家，公民有表達異議的權利。

root.note: 感覺不同 → 異議

mn: dissent（異議）的反義詞是 assent（同意）；別和 descent（下降）搞混。

senses.en: disagreeing with the majority or official view
a person who disagrees

ex.en: Only one dissentient voice was heard during the vote.
ex.zh: 表決時只有一個反對的聲音。

root.note: 感覺不同的 → 持異議的

senses.en: inclined to quarrel or cause disagreement

ex.en: One dissentious member kept the committee from reaching a decision.
ex.zh: 一位愛唱反調的成員讓委員會遲遲無法做出決定。

root.note: 感覺總是不同的 → 好爭吵的

senses.en: a long piece of academic writing, especially for a doctoral degree

ex.en: She spent three years writing her dissertation on ocean currents.
ex.zh: 她花了三年撰寫關於洋流的博士論文。

root.note: 把論點分開排列討論 → 論文

senses.en: a harmful action, especially one intended to help

ex.en: Giving students the answers does them a disservice.
ex.zh: 直接給學生答案反而是在害他們。

root.note: 不好的服務 → 幫倒忙

mn: 常用片語 do someone a disservice（害了某人、對某人不公）。

senses.en: to separate or divide into parts

ex.en: No quarrel could dissever the bond between the two sisters.
ex.zh: 再大的爭吵也無法切斷這對姊妹的情誼。

root.note: 切開分離

senses.en: not alike; different

ex.en: The twins have remarkably dissimilar personalities.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎的個性截然不同。

root.note: 不相似的

senses.en: to disappear or cause to disappear; to scatter
to waste money or energy foolishly

ex.en: The morning fog began to dissipate as the sun rose.
ex.zh: 太陽升起後，晨霧開始消散。

root.note: 向四處撒開 → 消散、揮霍

senses.en: the process of scattering or disappearing
indulgence in harmful pleasures

ex.en: Years of dissipation had ruined his health and fortune.
ex.zh: 多年的放蕩生活毀了他的健康和財富。

root.note: 向四處撒開 → 消散、揮霍

senses.en: lacking moral restraint; indulging in sensual pleasures

ex.en: The novel's hero wastes his youth in a dissolute life of gambling.
ex.zh: 小說主角在賭博的放蕩生活中虛擲了青春。

root.note: 道德束縛被鬆開 → 放蕩的

senses.en: the formal ending of an organization, marriage, or official body
the process of dissolving or breaking down

ex.en: The dissolution of the Soviet Union took place in 1991.
ex.zh: 蘇聯於 1991 年解體。

root.note: 鬆開分散 → 解散、溶解

senses.en: to become or cause to become part of a liquid
to formally end an organization or agreement
to be overcome by emotion (dissolve into tears)

ex.en: Stir the tea until the sugar starts to dissolve.
ex.zh: 攪拌茶水直到糖開始溶解。

root.note: 鬆開分散 → 溶解、解散

senses.en: a harsh combination of sounds
a lack of agreement or consistency

ex.en: Cognitive dissonance occurs when our actions conflict with our beliefs.
ex.zh: 當行為與信念相衝突時，就會產生認知失調。

root.note: 聲音不合在一起 → 不和諧

senses.en: lacking harmony; harsh-sounding
conflicting or inconsistent

ex.en: The composer used dissonant chords to create tension.
ex.zh: 作曲家運用不和諧和弦來營造緊張感。

root.note: 聲音不合的 → 不和諧的

senses.en: to persuade someone not to do something

ex.en: Nothing could dissuade her from traveling alone.
ex.zh: 什麼都無法勸阻她獨自旅行。

root.note: 勸人離開某念頭 → 勸阻

mn: persuade 是勸人去做；dissuade 是勸人別做。

senses.en: the act of persuading someone not to do something

ex.en: Despite gentle dissuasion from his parents, he quit his job.
ex.zh: 儘管父母溫和勸阻，他還是辭了工作。

root.note: 勸人離開某念頭 → 勸阻

senses.en: a contagious viral disease of dogs and some other animals
a type of water-based paint

ex.en: Puppies should be vaccinated against distemper.
ex.zh: 幼犬應該接種犬瘟熱疫苗。

root.note: （體液）調和失當 → 疾病

senses.en: to swell or cause to swell by pressure from inside

ex.en: Eating too fast can distend your stomach and cause discomfort.
ex.zh: 吃太快可能會使胃脹大而感到不適。

root.note: 向外伸展 → 膨脹

senses.en: capable of being stretched or swollen

ex.en: The bladder is a highly distensible organ.
ex.zh: 膀胱是可高度擴張的器官。

root.note: 能向外伸展的 → 可膨脹的

senses.en: the state of being swollen or stretched

ex.en: The doctor noticed some distention of the patient's abdomen.
ex.zh: 醫生注意到病人的腹部有些腫脹。

root.note: 向外伸展 → 膨脹

senses.en: to purify a liquid by heating it and condensing the vapor
to extract the essential meaning of something

ex.en: The teacher tried to distill the long chapter into three key points.
ex.zh: 老師試著把冗長的章節濃縮成三個重點。

root.note: 一滴滴落下 → 蒸餾、提煉

senses.en: the process of purifying a liquid by heating and cooling
the essential meaning extracted from something

ex.en: Seawater can be made drinkable through distillation.
ex.zh: 海水可以透過蒸餾變成可飲用的水。

root.note: 一滴滴落下 → 蒸餾

senses.en: a person or company that makes alcoholic spirits by distilling

ex.en: The whisky distiller ages its spirits in oak barrels.
ex.zh: 這家威士忌酒廠把酒放在橡木桶中陳年。

root.note: 做蒸餾的人 → 釀酒商

senses.en: a clear difference between similar things
excellence that sets someone apart
a special honor or award

ex.en: It is important to make a distinction between fact and opinion.
ex.zh: 區分事實與意見是很重要的。

root.note: 刺上記號以示區別 → 區別；與眾不同 → 卓越

senses.en: to pull or twist out of shape
to give a misleading account of facts

ex.en: Some reporters distort the facts to make a story more exciting.
ex.zh: 有些記者會扭曲事實，讓報導更聳動。

root.note: 扭開 → 扭曲

senses.en: to seize someone's property to force payment of a debt

ex.en: The landlord threatened to distrain the tenant's furniture for unpaid rent.
ex.zh: 房東揚言要扣押房客的家具來抵欠繳的房租。

root.note: 強力拉扯拿走 → 扣押

senses.en: a person who seizes property to force payment of a debt

ex.en: The distrainor must follow strict legal procedures when taking goods.
ex.zh: 扣押財物者在拿走物品時必須遵守嚴格的法律程序。

root.note: 扣押財物的人

senses.en: deeply upset and agitated
senses.zh: 心煩意亂的；極度憂慮的

ex.en: The distraught parents searched all night for their lost child.
ex.zh: 心急如焚的父母徹夜尋找走失的孩子。

root.note: 心被拉扯開 → 心煩意亂

senses.en: a feeling that someone or something cannot be relied upon
to doubt the honesty or reliability of

ex.en: Many voters distrust politicians who change their positions often.
ex.zh: 許多選民不信任立場常常改變的政治人物。

root.note: 不信任

senses.en: the breaking up of a union; separation or disagreement

ex.en: Lincoln feared that slavery would lead to disunion.
ex.zh: 林肯擔心奴隸制度會導致國家分裂。

root.note: 不聯合 → 分裂

senses.en: a word with two syllables

ex.en: "Table" is a disyllable, while "cat" has only one syllable.
ex.zh: table 是雙音節字，而 cat 只有一個音節。

root.note: 兩個音節 → 雙音節字

senses.en: active during the day
happening daily

ex.en: Unlike owls, most songbirds are diurnal.
ex.zh: 和貓頭鷹不同，大多數鳴禽是在白天活動的。

root.note: 白天的 → 日行性的

senses.en: a straying from the main subject; a digression

ex.en: After a long divagation about his childhood, the speaker returned to his topic.
ex.zh: 講者談了一大段童年往事後，才回到主題。

root.note: 四處遊蕩 → 離題

senses.en: tending to be different or develop in different directions

ex.en: The two scientists hold sharply divergent views on the issue.
ex.zh: 兩位科學家對這個議題的看法截然不同。

root.note: 往不同方向轉開 → 分歧的

senses.en: showing a great deal of variety; very different

ex.en: New York is one of the most diverse cities in the world.
ex.zh: 紐約是世界上最多元的城市之一。

root.note: 轉向不同方向的 → 多樣的

senses.en: the act of turning something aside from its course
something that draws attention away
senses.zh: 轉移注意力的事物；佯攻

senses.en: an entertaining activity

ex.en: While his partner created a diversion, the thief slipped away.
ex.zh: 同夥引開大家注意力時，小偷趁機溜走了。

root.note: 轉開 → 改道、轉移注意、消遣

senses.en: the state of being varied; variety
the inclusion of people of different backgrounds

ex.en: Rainforests have an amazing diversity of plant and animal life.
ex.zh: 熱帶雨林擁有驚人的動植物多樣性。

root.note: 轉向各方 → 多樣性

senses.en: to cause something to change direction
to draw attention away from something
to entertain or amuse

ex.en: Engineers plan to divert the river to protect the town.
ex.zh: 工程師計畫讓河流改道以保護小鎮。

root.note: 轉開 → 使轉向

senses.en: able to be turned aside or redirected

ex.en: Only a small portion of the funds is divertible to other projects.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分資金可以轉用到其他計畫。

root.note: 能夠轉開的 → 可轉向的

senses.en: to deprive or rid someone of something
to sell off investments or a business

ex.en: The university decided to divest from fossil fuel companies.
ex.zh: 這所大學決定從化石燃料公司撤資。

root.note: 脫掉衣服 → 剝奪、除去

senses.en: the practice of seeking knowledge of the future by supernatural means

ex.en: Ancient Chinese used turtle shells for divination.
ex.zh: 古代中國人用龜甲來占卜。

root.note: 向神詢問未來 → 占卜

senses.en: the state of being divine
a god or goddess
the study of religion; theology

ex.en: He studied divinity before becoming a minister.
ex.zh: 他在成為牧師之前攻讀神學。

root.note: 神的性質 → 神性、神學

senses.en: able to be divided, especially without a remainder

ex.en: Any even number is divisible by two.
ex.zh: 任何偶數都能被二整除。

root.note: 能被分開的 → 可除的

senses.en: a number by which another number is divided

ex.en: In twelve divided by three, three is the divisor.
ex.zh: 在十二除以三中，三是除數。

root.note: 用來分開另一個數的數 → 除數

senses.en: to reveal private or secret information

ex.en: The reporter refused to divulge the name of her source.
ex.zh: 記者拒絕透露消息來源的姓名。

root.note: 散布給大眾 → 洩漏

senses.en: the act of revealing secret information

ex.en: The divulgence of the plan ruined the surprise.
ex.zh: 計畫洩漏，毀了這個驚喜。

root.note: 散布給大眾 → 洩漏

senses.en: quiet and easy to control or teach

ex.en: The horse was so docile that even small children could ride it.
ex.zh: 這匹馬非常溫馴，連小孩都能騎。

root.note: 容易教的 → 溫順的

senses.en: a list of cases awaiting trial in a court
a list of things to be done; an agenda

ex.en: The Supreme Court has several major cases on its docket this year.
ex.zh: 最高法院今年的待審案件中有幾件重大案件。

senses.en: a female deer, rabbit, or similar animal

ex.en: A doe and her fawn grazed quietly at the edge of the forest.
ex.zh: 一頭母鹿和她的小鹿在森林邊安靜地吃草。

mn: doe 和 dough（麵團）同音；Do-Re-Mi 歌裡的「Doe, a deer」。

senses.en: a set of principles laid down by an authority as undeniably true

ex.en: Good scientists question dogma instead of accepting it blindly.
ex.zh: 優秀的科學家會質疑教條，而不是盲目接受。

parts.m: opinion, belief 意見、信條（希臘文）

root.note: 被認定為真的信條 → 教條

senses.en: stating opinions as if they were certainly true, without considering others

ex.en: He is so dogmatic that he never listens to other points of view.
ex.zh: 他非常武斷，從不聽取其他觀點。

root.note: 把自己的信條當成真理 → 武斷的

senses.en: to state opinions in an arrogant, authoritative way
senses.zh: 武斷地主張；教條式地斷言

ex.en: Teachers should explain their reasoning rather than dogmatize.
ex.zh: 老師應該解釋自己的道理，而不是武斷地下結論。

root.note: 把意見當成信條宣布 → 武斷地主張

senses.en: expressing sorrow; mournful

ex.en: The puppy looked up at me with doleful eyes.
ex.zh: 小狗用哀傷的眼神抬頭看著我。

root.note: 充滿悲傷的

senses.en: sorrowful; doleful (archaic)

ex.en: A dolesome melody drifted from the old church.
ex.zh: 一段哀傷的旋律從古老的教堂飄出。

root.note: 帶著悲傷的

senses.en: sorrow or grief (literary)

ex.en: The poem expresses the dolor of a mother who has lost her son.
ex.zh: 這首詩表達了一位喪子母親的悲痛。

root.note: 痛苦 → 悲傷

senses.en: feeling or expressing great sorrow or distress

ex.en: The widow's dolorous cries echoed through the empty house.
ex.zh: 寡婦悲痛的哭聲迴盪在空蕩的屋子裡。

root.note: 充滿悲傷的

senses.en: an area of knowledge or activity
an area of territory controlled by a ruler or government
a set of addresses on the internet

ex.en: Cooking has always been my father's domain in our house.
ex.zh: 在我們家，下廚一直是我爸爸的專屬領域。

root.note: 主人所管轄的地方 → 領地、領域

senses.en: home or family life

ex.en: After years of travel, he settled into quiet domesticity.
ex.zh: 多年奔波後，他安定下來過著平靜的家庭生活。

root.note: 家中的狀態 → 家庭生活

senses.en: the place where a person legally lives

ex.en: You must list your permanent domicile on the tax form.
ex.zh: 你必須在報稅表上填寫你的永久住所。

root.note: 家 → 住所

senses.en: power and influence over others

ex.en: The company has maintained its dominance in the smartphone market.
ex.zh: 這家公司在智慧型手機市場一直保持主導地位。

root.note: 像主人一樣掌控 → 支配

senses.en: most important, powerful, or influential
(genetics) of a gene that shows its effect even if only one copy is present

ex.en: English has become the dominant language of the internet.
ex.zh: 英語已成為網路上的主流語言。

root.note: 像主人的 → 佔優勢的

senses.en: to have control or power over
to be the most important or noticeable feature of

ex.en: A few large companies dominate the music industry.
ex.zh: 少數幾家大公司主宰了音樂產業。

root.note: 當主人 → 支配

senses.en: the exercise of control or power over others

ex.en: The empire sought domination over the entire region.
ex.zh: 這個帝國企圖統治整個地區。

root.note: 當主人 → 統治

senses.en: to control others in an arrogant, bossy way

ex.en: The older brother tended to domineer over his siblings.
ex.zh: 那個哥哥往往對弟妹們頤指氣使。

root.note: 擺出主人架子 → 專橫

mn: 形容詞 domineering（專橫的）比動詞更常見。

senses.en: to give money or goods to help a cause
to allow blood or an organ to be removed for others

ex.en: Every year we donate old clothes to the homeless shelter.
ex.zh: 我們每年都把舊衣服捐給遊民收容所。

root.note: 給予 → 捐贈

senses.en: a person who donates; a donor

ex.en: An anonymous donator paid for the new library wing.
ex.zh: 一位匿名捐贈者出資興建了圖書館的新側翼。

root.note: 給予的人 → 捐贈者

senses.en: a person or organization that receives a gift

ex.en: The donee must sign a form acknowledging the gift.
ex.zh: 受贈人必須簽署表格，確認收到贈與。

root.note: 被給予的人 → 受贈人

senses.en: a person who gives money or goods to a cause
a person who gives blood or an organ

ex.en: A kidney donor saved my uncle's life.
ex.zh: 一位腎臟捐贈者救了我叔叔的命。

root.note: 給予的人 → 捐贈者

senses.en: temporarily inactive but capable of becoming active

ex.en: The volcano has been dormant for over two hundred years.
ex.zh: 這座火山已休眠超過兩百年。

root.note: 睡著的 → 休眠的

mn: dorm（宿舍）就是睡覺的地方，同字根。

senses.en: a close-fitting jacket worn by men in the 14th–17th centuries
one of a pair of similar things; one of two words from the same origin
senses.zh: 成對物之一；（同源）對似詞

ex.en: The actor playing Hamlet wore a black velvet doublet.
ex.zh: 飾演哈姆雷特的演員穿著黑色天鵝絨緊身上衣。

root.note: 原指雙層的衣服 → 緊身上衣

senses.en: to twice the degree; in two ways

ex.en: Check your answers carefully, then make doubly sure you signed your name.
ex.zh: 仔細檢查答案，然後再三確認你有簽名。

senses.en: money or property brought by a bride to her husband at marriage

ex.en: In some cultures, a bride's family still pays a dowry.
ex.zh: 在某些文化中，新娘家仍需支付嫁妝。

root.note: （出嫁時）給予的財物 → 嫁妝

senses.en: the former currency of Greece, replaced by the euro in 2002
an ancient Greek silver coin

ex.en: Greece replaced the drachma with the euro in 2002.
ex.zh: 希臘於 2002 年以歐元取代德拉克馬。

senses.en: a systematic search, especially by police, for criminals
a net dragged along the bottom of a river or sea

ex.en: Police set up a citywide dragnet to catch the escaped prisoner.
ex.zh: 警方布下全市搜捕網，追捕越獄犯人。

root.note: 拖著走的網 → 拖網 → 大搜捕

senses.en: to force someone into doing something
a mounted infantry soldier in former times

ex.en: My sister tried to dragoon me into helping with her move.
ex.zh: 我姊姊想逼我幫她搬家。

parts.m: dragon 龍（士兵持的火槍稱為「龍」）

root.note: 持「龍」火槍的騎兵 → 龍騎兵；用武力逼迫 → 強迫

senses.en: the process or system of removing water from an area

ex.en: Poor drainage caused the streets to flood after the storm.
ex.zh: 排水不良導致暴雨過後街道淹水。

root.note: 排水

senses.en: a person who writes plays

ex.en: Shakespeare is often called the greatest dramatist in English.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞常被稱為英語世界最偉大的劇作家。

root.note: 寫戲劇的人

senses.en: to adapt a story into a play or film
to exaggerate the excitement or seriousness of something

ex.en: Please do not dramatize a small mistake into a disaster.
ex.zh: 請不要把一個小錯誤誇大成一場災難。

root.note: 使成為戲劇 → 改編；誇大

senses.en: likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect; extreme

ex.en: The company took drastic measures to avoid bankruptcy.
ex.zh: 公司採取了激烈的措施以避免破產。

parts.m: active, effective 有效的（希臘文 drastikos）

root.note: 作用強烈的 → 激烈的

senses.en: a long period of little or no rainfall

ex.en: The drought destroyed most of the farmers' crops this year.
ex.zh: 今年的乾旱摧毀了農民大部分的作物。

mn: 注意發音是 [draʊt]，和 doubt 押韻，不是 [drɔt]。

senses.en: sleepy and lethargic

ex.en: This medicine may make you feel drowsy, so do not drive.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能會讓你昏昏欲睡，請勿開車。

senses.en: hard, boring, or unpleasant work
senses.zh: 苦差事；單調乏味的工作

ex.en: Washing dishes by hand every night felt like drudgery.
ex.zh: 每晚手洗碗盤感覺像是苦差事。

root.note: 做苦工 → 苦差事

senses.en: hesitating or doubting
not to be relied upon; suspect

ex.en: I am dubious about his claim that he finished the project in one night.
ex.zh: 他聲稱一個晚上就完成了專題，我對此半信半疑。

root.note: 在兩者間猶豫 → 懷疑的

senses.en: a young duck

ex.en: Each duckling followed its mother into the pond.
ex.zh: 每隻小鴨都跟著媽媽下到池塘裡。

root.note: 小的鴨子

mn: the ugly duckling：醜小鴨（後來蛻變的人）。

senses.en: (of a metal) able to be drawn out into a thin wire
senses.zh: （金屬）可延展的；可拉成細絲的

senses.en: easily influenced; pliable

ex.en: Copper is ductile, so it can be made into thin electrical wires.
ex.zh: 銅具有延展性，所以可以製成細電線。

root.note: 能被拉長的 → 可延展的

senses.en: a performance or piece of music for two people

ex.en: The siblings sang a beautiful duet at the wedding.
ex.zh: 這對兄妹在婚禮上唱了一首優美的二重唱。

root.note: 兩人的小曲 → 二重唱

senses.en: to make persistent demands for payment of a debt
of a dull grayish-brown color

ex.en: The collector would dun him every week for the unpaid bill.
ex.zh: 討債人每週都向他催討欠款。

senses.en: a house divided into two separate homes; an apartment on two floors
having two parts

ex.en: We rented one side of a duplex near the university.
ex.zh: 我們在大學附近租了雙併住宅的一側。

root.note: 摺成兩層 → 雙重的；雙層住宅

senses.en: deceitfulness; saying one thing and doing another
senses.zh: 欺騙；表裡不一；兩面手法

ex.en: The spy's duplicity was finally exposed after years of lies.
ex.zh: 這名間諜多年的欺騙終於被揭穿。

root.note: 有兩面（雙重摺疊）→ 表裡不一

senses.en: imprisonment (archaic, often in "durance vile")

ex.en: The prince spent ten years in durance before his release.
ex.zh: 王子被囚禁十年後才獲釋。

root.note: 長久的忍受 → 監禁

senses.en: the time during which something continues

ex.en: Please remain seated for the duration of the flight.
ex.zh: 飛行全程請保持坐在座位上。

root.note: 持續的時間

senses.en: dutiful and obedient (archaic)

ex.en: The duteous son visited his aging father every day.
ex.zh: 那位孝順的兒子每天都去探望年邁的父親。

root.note: 盡義務的 → 盡職的

senses.en: (of goods) on which customs duty must be paid

ex.en: Travelers must declare any dutiable items at customs.
ex.zh: 旅客必須在海關申報任何應課稅物品。

root.note: 應該繳稅的 → 應課稅的

senses.en: conscientiously fulfilling one's duty; obedient

ex.en: A dutiful daughter, she called her mother every evening.
ex.zh: 她是個孝順的女兒，每天晚上都打電話給媽媽。

root.note: 充滿義務感的 → 盡職的

senses.en: to become gradually smaller in size or amount

ex.en: Without new members, the club's numbers will continue to dwindle.
ex.zh: 沒有新成員加入的話，社團人數將持續減少。

senses.en: a unit of force in the CGS system

ex.en: One dyne is equal to one hundred-thousandth of a newton.
ex.zh: 一達因等於十萬分之一牛頓。

root.note: 力量的單位

senses.en: serious and sincere
seriousness (in the phrase "in earnest")

ex.en: He made an earnest effort to improve his grades.
ex.zh: 他認真努力地想提高成績。

mn: 片語 in earnest：認真地、正式開始。

senses.en: pottery made of fired clay

ex.en: The museum displays earthenware from the Neolithic period.
ex.zh: 博物館展出新石器時代的陶器。

parts.m: made of earth 泥土做的

root.note: 泥土做的器物 → 陶器

senses.en: fit or good enough to be eaten

ex.en: The bread was stale but still eatable.
ex.zh: 麵包雖然不新鮮了，但還能吃。

root.note: 能吃的

mn: edible 指「可食用的（無毒）」；eatable 偏指「味道還吃得下」。

senses.en: cheerful and full of energy
senses.zh: 熱情洋溢的；興高采烈的

ex.en: The ebullient host greeted every guest with a hug.
ex.zh: 熱情洋溢的主人擁抱迎接每一位客人。

root.note: 沸騰到冒出來 → 熱情洋溢

mn: bull 像 bubble：情緒像滾水一樣冒泡泡。

senses.en: unconventional and slightly strange
a person with unusual habits
(of a circle or orbit) not centered on the same point

ex.en: My eccentric neighbor keeps twenty cats and paints them all.
ex.zh: 我那古怪的鄰居養了二十隻貓，還替牠們全部畫像。

root.note: 偏離中心的 → 古怪的

senses.en: the quality of being unconventional or strange
(math, astronomy) the deviation of a curve or orbit from a circle

ex.en: His eccentricity included wearing a long cape to class every day.
ex.zh: 他的怪癖之一是每天穿著長披風來上課。

root.note: 偏離中心 → 古怪

senses.en: the blocking of light from one celestial body by another
to overshadow; to surpass in importance
a loss of importance or power

ex.en: Thousands gathered to watch the total solar eclipse.
ex.zh: 數千人聚集觀看日全蝕。

root.note: 光離開了 → 蝕；使失色

senses.en: to spend less money or use fewer resources; to save

ex.en: We need to economize on electricity during the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天我們需要節約用電。

root.note: 好好管理家務開支 → 節約

senses.en: an overwhelming feeling of great happiness

ex.en: The fans screamed in ecstasy when the band appeared on stage.
ex.zh: 樂團一登台，歌迷們便欣喜若狂地尖叫。

root.note: 站到自己之外（靈魂出竅）→ 狂喜

senses.en: feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness

ex.en: She was ecstatic when she got into her dream university.
ex.zh: 她被夢想中的大學錄取時欣喜若狂。

root.note: 站到自己之外 → 狂喜的

senses.en: fit or safe to be eaten

ex.en: Not every wild mushroom is edible, so be careful.
ex.zh: 並非所有野生菇類都能吃，要小心。

root.note: 能吃的

senses.en: an official order issued by a person in authority

ex.en: The king issued an edict banning all public gatherings.
ex.zh: 國王頒布法令，禁止一切公開集會。

root.note: 說出來的（命令）→ 法令

senses.en: to instruct or improve someone morally or intellectually

ex.en: The museum aims to edify as well as entertain its visitors.
ex.zh: 這間博物館的目標是在娛樂參觀者的同時也給予啟發。

root.note: 建造（品格）→ 教化

mn: edifice（大廈）和 edify（建造心靈）同字根。

senses.en: a newspaper article expressing the editors' opinion
relating to editing or editors

ex.en: The newspaper ran an editorial criticizing the new tax.
ex.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇批評新稅制的社論。

root.note: 編輯的（意見）→ 社論

senses.en: to bring out or develop something latent; to infer

ex.en: A good teacher can educe talents that students did not know they had.
ex.zh: 好老師能引出學生自己都不知道的才能。

root.note: 引導出來 → 引出

senses.en: to erase a mark from a surface
to make oneself appear unimportant (efface oneself)

ex.en: Time and weather had begun to efface the words on the old gravestone.
ex.zh: 歲月與風雨已開始磨去舊墓碑上的字跡。

root.note: 把臉（表面）抹去 → 擦掉

mn: self-effacing：謙遜低調的，SAT 常見。

senses.en: a change that results from an action or cause
to bring about or cause to happen

ex.en: The medicine had an immediate effect on her headache.
ex.zh: 這藥對她的頭痛立即見效。

root.note: 做出來的東西 → 結果、效果

mn: affect 通常是動詞（影響）；effect 通常是名詞（效果），當動詞時是「造成、實現」。

senses.en: successful in producing a desired result
(of a law or rule) in operation

ex.en: Regular exercise is an effective way to reduce stress.
ex.zh: 規律運動是紓解壓力的有效方法。

root.note: 能做出結果的 → 有效的

senses.en: successful in producing the intended result

ex.en: The treaty proved an effectual means of keeping peace.
ex.zh: 事實證明這項條約是維持和平的有效手段。

root.note: 能做出結果的 → 有效的

mn: 反義詞 ineffectual（無能的、無效的）比 effectual 更常見。

senses.en: (of a man) the quality of having traits traditionally seen as feminine

ex.en: Older critics mocked the poet's supposed effeminacy.
ex.zh: 老一輩的評論家嘲笑這位詩人所謂的女子氣。

root.note: 變得像女人 → 女子氣

senses.en: (of a man) having traits traditionally seen as feminine, often used disapprovingly
senses.zh: （男子）娘娘腔的；女子氣的（多含貶義）

ex.en: In the old film, the villain mocks the hero as weak and effeminate.
ex.zh: 在那部老電影裡，反派嘲笑男主角軟弱又娘娘腔。

root.note: 變得像女人的 → 女子氣的

senses.en: to give off bubbles; to fizz
to be lively and enthusiastic

ex.en: Drop the tablet in water and watch it effervesce.
ex.zh: 把藥片丟進水裡，看它冒泡。

root.note: 沸騰冒出 → 冒泡

senses.en: (of a liquid) giving off bubbles
lively and enthusiastic

ex.en: Her effervescent personality made her popular with everyone.
ex.zh: 她活潑開朗的個性讓她人緣很好。

root.note: 沸騰冒泡的 → 活潑的

senses.en: weak and ineffective, especially from over-refinement
no longer capable of producing; worn out

ex.en: The effete aristocracy could no longer govern the country.
ex.zh: 那衰敗無能的貴族階層已無法治理國家。

root.note: 生育殆盡 → 衰竭的

senses.en: successful in producing the desired result; effective

ex.en: Rest proved more efficacious than any medicine for his injury.
ex.zh: 對他的傷來說，休息比任何藥都有效。

root.note: 能做出結果的 → 有效的

senses.en: the ability to produce a desired result

ex.en: Researchers are testing the efficacy of the new vaccine.
ex.zh: 研究人員正在測試新疫苗的效力。

root.note: 做出結果的能力 → 功效

senses.en: the ability to achieve maximum results with minimum waste

ex.en: The new software improved the efficiency of the whole office.
ex.zh: 新軟體提升了整個辦公室的效率。

root.note: 做事出成果的程度 → 效率

senses.en: working well with little waste of time or energy

ex.en: LED bulbs are far more efficient than old light bulbs.
ex.zh: LED 燈泡比舊式燈泡節能得多。

root.note: 能做出成果的 → 有效率的

mn: effective 重「有效果」，efficient 重「效率高、不浪費」。

senses.en: the most developed stage; a flowering
(chemistry) a powdery deposit on a surface

ex.en: The Renaissance was an efflorescence of art and science.
ex.zh: 文藝復興是藝術與科學的全盛時期。

root.note: 開出花來 → 開花、鼎盛

senses.en: blossoming; flourishing
(chemistry) forming a powdery crust

ex.en: The efflorescent city attracted artists from all over Europe.
ex.zh: 這座繁盛的城市吸引了來自歐洲各地的藝術家。

root.note: 正在開花的 → 繁盛的

senses.en: an unpleasant or harmful smell or discharge

ex.en: A foul effluvium rose from the polluted river.
ex.zh: 遭汙染的河流散發出一股惡臭。

root.note: 流出來的東西 → 臭氣

senses.en: shameless boldness; insolent nerve

ex.en: He had the effrontery to ask for a raise after missing a week of work.
ex.zh: 他曠職一週後竟厚著臉皮要求加薪。

root.note: 不知羞恥地把臉伸出來 → 厚顏無恥

senses.en: a brilliant radiance; shining brightness

ex.en: The effulgence of the rising sun filled the valley.
ex.zh: 旭日的光輝灑滿了山谷。

root.note: 向外發光 → 光輝

senses.en: to pour out a liquid, light, or feeling

ex.en: The flowers effuse a sweet scent in the evening.
ex.zh: 這些花在傍晚散發出甜美的香氣。

root.note: 往外倒 → 流出

senses.en: an unrestrained outpouring of words or feelings
(medicine) an escape of fluid into a body cavity

ex.en: Her effusion of thanks embarrassed the shy volunteer.
ex.zh: 她滔滔不絕的感謝讓那位害羞的志工很不好意思。

root.note: 往外倒出 → 傾吐、流露

senses.en: the belief or practice of acting in one's own self-interest

ex.en: His egoism made him ignore the needs of his teammates.
ex.zh: 他的自我中心讓他忽略了隊友的需要。

root.note: 以我為主的主義 → 利己主義

mn: egoism 偏重「利己」；egotism 偏重「自負、老愛談自己」。

senses.en: a self-centered person who acts mainly in their own interest

ex.en: An egoist rarely considers how his choices affect others.
ex.zh: 利己主義者很少考慮自己的選擇會如何影響別人。

root.note: 以我為主的人 → 利己主義者

senses.en: an exaggerated sense of self-importance; conceit

ex.en: The actor's egotism made him difficult to work with.
ex.zh: 那位演員的自大使人難以與他共事。

root.note: 滿腦子只有我 → 自負

senses.en: a conceited person who talks mostly about themselves

ex.en: Only an egotist would talk about himself for the entire dinner.
ex.zh: 只有自大的人才會整頓晚餐都在談自己。

root.note: 滿腦子只有我的人 → 自負的人

senses.en: outstandingly bad; shocking

ex.en: Copying an entire essay from the internet is an egregious violation of school rules.
ex.zh: 從網路上抄一整篇文章，是嚴重違反校規的行為。

root.note: 超出群體 → 原意是「傑出的」，後來轉成貶義「惡劣得出眾」

senses.en: the act of going out; a way out; an exit

ex.en: The fire code requires a clear path of egress from every room.
ex.zh: 消防法規要求每個房間都要有暢通的出口通道。

root.note: 走出去 → 出口

senses.en: to force or throw something out
to force someone to leave a place
(of a pilot) to escape from an aircraft by a seat that shoots out

ex.en: The referee had to eject two players for fighting.
ex.zh: 裁判不得不將兩名打架的球員驅逐出場。

root.note: 丟出去 → 噴出、逐出

senses.en: (of time) to pass

ex.en: Several months will elapse before the results are announced.
ex.zh: 要過好幾個月結果才會公布。

root.note: （時間）悄悄滑走 → 流逝

senses.en: the ability to return to original shape after being stretched
(economics) how much demand or supply changes in response to price

ex.en: As we age, our skin loses some of its elasticity.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，皮膚會失去一些彈性。

parts.m: drive, push 推動（希臘文 elaunein）

root.note: 被推開後能彈回 → 彈性

senses.en: chemical decomposition produced by passing an electric current through a liquid
the removal of hair roots using an electric current

ex.en: Water can be split into hydrogen and oxygen by electrolysis.
ex.zh: 水可以透過電解分解成氫和氧。

root.note: 用電分解 → 電解

senses.en: a printing plate copy made by depositing metal on a mold by electrolysis

ex.en: Printers once used an electrotype to reproduce detailed engravings.
ex.zh: 印刷業者曾用電鑄版來複製精細的版畫。

root.note: 用電製成的印版 → 電鑄版

senses.en: a sad poem or song, especially one for someone who has died

ex.en: The poet wrote an elegy for his late friend.
ex.zh: 詩人為已故的朋友寫了一首輓歌。

root.note: 哀悼的歌 → 輓歌

senses.en: an essential part of something
a substance that cannot be broken down chemically
a situation in which one feels comfortable (in one's element)

ex.en: Trust is an essential element of any friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何友誼的基本要素。

mn: in one's element：如魚得水；the elements：惡劣天氣（風雨）。

senses.en: to draw out a response, answer, or fact from someone

ex.en: The teacher asked questions to elicit ideas from the quiet students.
ex.zh: 老師透過提問引導安靜的學生說出想法。

root.note: 誘引出來 → 引出

mn: elicit（引出）和 illicit（非法的）發音相近，別搞混。

senses.en: meeting the conditions to do or receive something
(of a person) desirable as a marriage partner

ex.en: Students with good grades are eligible for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 成績好的學生有資格申請這項獎學金。

root.note: 能被選出來的 → 有資格的

senses.en: to completely remove or get rid of
to exclude from a competition by defeat

ex.en: The new system will eliminate the need for paper forms.
ex.zh: 新系統將不再需要紙本表格。

root.note: 趕出門檻外 → 排除

senses.en: relating to the reign of Queen Elizabeth I of England (1558–1603)
a person, especially a writer, of that period
senses.zh: 伊莉莎白時代的人（作家）

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote many plays for the Elizabethan stage.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞為伊莉莎白時代的舞台寫了許多劇作。

root.note: 伊莉莎白女王時代的

senses.en: the skill of clear and expressive speech

ex.en: She took lessons in elocution to improve her public speaking.
ex.zh: 她上了朗誦課來提升公開演講能力。

root.note: 把話說出來的技巧 → 演說術

senses.en: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
clearly expressive of a feeling

ex.en: Her eloquent speech moved the entire audience.
ex.zh: 她雄辯的演說感動了全場觀眾。

root.note: 很會把話說出來的 → 雄辯的

senses.en: to make something clear; to explain

ex.en: Could you elucidate what you meant by that remark?
ex.zh: 你能解釋一下那句話是什麼意思嗎？

root.note: 使清楚明亮 → 闡明

senses.en: to escape from or avoid, especially cleverly
to fail to be understood or achieved by someone

ex.en: The name of the song continues to elude me.
ex.zh: 我一直想不起那首歌的名字。

root.note: 玩弄一番後溜出去 → 躲避

mn: elude（躲避）vs. allude（暗指）vs. delude（欺騙）。

senses.en: the act of escaping or evading

ex.en: The fox's clever elusion of the hunters became a local legend.
ex.zh: 那隻狐狸巧妙躲過獵人的故事成了當地傳說。

root.note: 溜走 → 逃避

senses.en: to make abnormally thin and weak

ex.en: Long illness can emaciate even a strong person.
ex.zh: 長期患病可能讓身強體壯的人也變得骨瘦如柴。

root.note: 使變得非常瘦 → 使消瘦

mn: 形容詞 emaciated（骨瘦如柴的）比動詞更常用。

senses.en: to issue or spread out from a source

ex.en: A delicious smell began to emanate from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房開始飄出誘人的香味。

root.note: 流出來 → 散發

senses.en: to set free from legal, social, or political restrictions

ex.en: Education can emancipate people from poverty.
ex.zh: 教育能使人擺脫貧窮。

root.note: 從（主人）手中拿出來 → 解放

senses.en: an official ban on trade with a particular country
to officially ban trade in goods

ex.en: The United Nations imposed an arms embargo on the country.
ex.zh: 聯合國對該國實施武器禁運。

root.note: 用障礙擋在裡面 → 禁運

senses.en: to go on board a ship or aircraft
to begin a new project or course of action (embark on)

ex.en: After graduation, she will embark on a career in medicine.
ex.zh: 畢業後，她將展開醫學生涯。

root.note: 進入船中 → 上船；開始旅程

senses.en: to make someone feel awkward or ashamed

ex.en: Please do not embarrass me in front of my friends.
ex.zh: 拜託不要在我朋友面前讓我難堪。

root.note: 陷入障礙中 → 使尷尬

mn: 拼法兩個 r、兩個 s：embarrass。

senses.en: to make something more attractive by adding decorations
to add untrue details to a story to make it more interesting

ex.en: My uncle likes to embellish his fishing stories.
ex.zh: 我叔叔喜歡把他的釣魚故事加油添醋。

root.note: 使變美 → 裝飾、渲染

senses.en: to secretly steal money that one has been trusted to manage

ex.en: The accountant tried to embezzle funds from the charity.
ex.zh: 那名會計試圖侵吞慈善機構的資金。

parts.m: destroy, squander 破壞、揮霍（古法語）

root.note: 揮霍（別人的錢）→ 盜用

senses.en: to display a design or name prominently on something

ex.en: The team will emblazon its logo on every jersey.
ex.zh: 球隊會在每件球衣上印上醒目的隊徽。

root.note: 放上紋章 → 醒目地裝飾

senses.en: a design or symbol representing a group or idea

ex.en: The dove is a widely recognized emblem of peace.
ex.zh: 鴿子是廣為人知的和平象徵。

parts.m: throw, put 放（希臘文 ballein）

root.note: 鑲嵌放入的裝飾 → 徽章、象徵

senses.en: to be a clear, visible expression of an idea or quality
to include or contain as a part

ex.en: The young athlete seemed to embody the spirit of the Olympics.
ex.zh: 這位年輕運動員彷彿體現了奧運精神。

root.note: 放入身體 → 使具體化、體現

senses.en: to give someone the courage or confidence to do something

ex.en: The first victory may embolden the team to aim even higher.
ex.zh: 第一場勝利可能會讓隊伍更有信心挑戰更高目標。

root.note: 使變大膽

senses.en: the blocking of a blood vessel by a clot or air bubble

ex.en: A pulmonary embolism can be life-threatening if not treated quickly.
ex.zh: 肺栓塞若不及時治療可能危及生命。

root.note: 被丟進（血管）裡的東西 → 栓塞

senses.en: to involve someone deeply in a conflict or difficult situation

ex.en: The prince did not want to embroil his country in another war.
ex.zh: 王子不想讓他的國家捲入另一場戰爭。

root.note: 使陷入混亂 → 使捲入紛爭

senses.en: to move out of something and become visible
(of facts) to become known
to come through a difficult situation

ex.en: New evidence began to emerge during the investigation.
ex.zh: 調查期間，新證據開始浮現。

root.note: 從水中浮出 → 出現

senses.en: the process of coming into view or existence

ex.en: The emergence of smartphones changed how we communicate.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了我們溝通的方式。

root.note: 浮現 → 出現

senses.en: in the process of coming into being

ex.en: Many investors are interested in emergent technologies like quantum computing.
ex.zh: 許多投資人對量子運算等新興科技很有興趣。

root.note: 正在浮現的 → 新興的

senses.en: retired but keeping one's title as an honor

ex.en: She is now a professor emeritus of history at the university.
ex.zh: 她現在是該大學的歷史系榮譽退休教授。

root.note: 服務完畢、贏得（退休）→ 榮譽退休的

senses.en: a person who leaves their own country to live in another

ex.en: Each emigrant carried only one suitcase on the long voyage.
ex.zh: 每位移民在漫長的航程中只帶了一只行李箱。

root.note: 遷移出去的人 → 移出者

mn: emigrant 從原國「移出」；immigrant 是「移入」新國家的人。

senses.en: to leave one's own country to settle permanently in another

ex.en: His grandparents decided to emigrate to Canada in 1970.
ex.zh: 他的祖父母在 1970 年決定移民加拿大。

root.note: 遷移出去 → 移居國外

senses.en: fame or recognized superiority in a field
a piece of rising ground
a title for a cardinal (Your Eminence)

ex.en: She rose to eminence as one of the country's top surgeons.
ex.zh: 她成為全國頂尖的外科醫師之一而聲名顯赫。

root.note: 突出於眾人之上 → 卓越

mn: éminence grise（幕後掌權者）源自法文。

senses.en: famous and respected within a particular field
(of a quality) outstanding; notable

ex.en: An eminent scientist gave the opening lecture.
ex.zh: 一位傑出的科學家發表了開幕演講。

root.note: 突出的 → 傑出的

mn: eminent（傑出的）vs. imminent（即將發生的）vs. immanent（內在的）。

senses.en: to produce and send out light, heat, gas, or sound

ex.en: Electric cars emit far less pollution than gasoline cars.
ex.zh: 電動車排放的汙染遠少於汽油車。

root.note: 送出去 → 發出、排放

senses.en: special importance given to something
stress placed on a word or syllable in speaking

ex.en: Our school places great emphasis on reading.
ex.zh: 我們學校非常重視閱讀。

root.note: 把內在顯示出來 → 強調

senses.en: to give special importance to something

ex.en: The coach wanted to emphasize the importance of teamwork.
ex.zh: 教練想要強調團隊合作的重要性。

root.note: 把重點顯示出來 → 強調

senses.en: expressing something forcefully and clearly
clear and decisive

ex.en: Her answer was an emphatic "No!"
ex.zh: 她斬釘截鐵地回答：「不！」

root.note: 用力顯示出來的 → 強調的

senses.en: a person who works for another person or company for pay

ex.en: Every new employee must attend a safety training session.
ex.zh: 每位新員工都必須參加安全訓練課程。

root.note: 被雇用的人

senses.en: a person or company that pays people to work for them

ex.en: My employer offers free lunch on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我的雇主每週五提供免費午餐。

root.note: 雇用人的人 → 雇主

senses.en: a large store selling a wide variety of goods
a center of commerce; a marketplace

ex.en: The old emporium sold everything from hats to hardware.
ex.zh: 那家老百貨店從帽子到五金什麼都賣。

root.note: 商人聚集之處 → 商場

senses.en: to give someone the authority or power to do something
to make someone stronger and more confident

ex.en: The program aims to empower young women through education.
ex.zh: 這個計畫旨在透過教育增強年輕女性的能力。

root.note: 使有權力 → 授權

senses.en: to try to match or surpass someone, usually by imitation
(computing) to reproduce the function of another system

ex.en: Many young players try to emulate their favorite athletes.
ex.zh: 許多年輕球員試著仿效他們最喜愛的運動員。

root.note: 與人競爭而模仿 → 仿效

senses.en: to make a bill into law
to act out a role or play

ex.en: Congress voted to enact stricter gun laws.
ex.zh: 國會投票制定了更嚴格的槍枝法律。

root.note: 使成為法案 → 制定

senses.en: to fill with love or delight (usually passive: be enamored of/with)

ex.en: The city's charm is sure to enamor first-time visitors.
ex.zh: 這座城市的魅力必定會讓初次造訪的遊客著迷。

root.note: 使陷入愛中 → 使迷戀

mn: 常用 be enamored of/with：迷戀於…。

senses.en: to settle in or set up a camp

ex.en: The army will encamp by the river for the night.
ex.zh: 軍隊今晚將在河邊紮營。

root.note: 進入營地 → 紮營

senses.en: a speech or piece of writing that praises someone highly

ex.en: The retiring teacher received an encomium from her former students.
ex.zh: 這位退休老師收到以前學生獻上的讚辭。

parts.m: revel, celebration 慶典（希臘文 komos）

root.note: 慶典中的頌讚 → 讚詞

senses.en: to include a wide range of things
to surround and have within

ex.en: The course will encompass both ancient and modern history.
ex.zh: 這門課將涵蓋古代史與近代史。

root.note: 放入圓圈內 → 包含

senses.en: a repeated or extra performance at the audience's request
called out by an audience to request more

ex.en: The crowd cheered until the singer came back for an encore.
ex.zh: 觀眾不停歡呼，直到歌手回台上安可。

root.note: 再一次 → 加演

senses.en: to give support, confidence, or hope to someone
to help something develop

ex.en: Good teachers encourage students to ask questions.
ex.zh: 好老師會鼓勵學生發問。

root.note: 使有勇氣 → 鼓勵

senses.en: to gradually intrude on someone's territory, rights, or time

ex.en: New housing developments continue to encroach on farmland.
ex.zh: 新的住宅開發案持續侵占農地。

root.note: 用鉤子鉤進來 → 侵占

senses.en: to restrict or burden someone so that movement or action is difficult

ex.en: Heavy backpacks will encumber the hikers on the steep trail.
ex.zh: 沉重的背包會拖累健行者在陡峭山路上的行進。

root.note: 放入障礙中 → 妨礙

senses.en: a letter from the Pope sent to all bishops of the Roman Catholic Church

ex.en: The Pope's encyclical addressed climate change and the poor.
ex.zh: 教宗的通諭談到了氣候變遷與窮人的問題。

root.note: 在圈內傳閱的（信）→ 通諭

senses.en: a book or set of books giving information on many subjects

ex.en: Before the internet, we looked up facts in an encyclopedia.
ex.zh: 在網路出現之前，我們都查百科全書來找資料。

root.note: 全面性的教育 → 百科全書

senses.en: to put someone or something at risk

ex.en: Texting while driving can endanger lives.
ex.zh: 開車時傳訊息可能危及性命。

root.note: 使陷入危險

mn: endangered species：瀕臨絕種的物種。

senses.en: to cause someone to be loved or liked

ex.en: His kindness to animals will endear him to the whole town.
ex.zh: 他對動物的善心會讓全鎮的人都喜歡他。

root.note: 使變得親愛 → 使受喜愛

senses.en: (of a disease) regularly found in a particular area or group
(of a plant or animal) native only to a certain place

ex.en: The Formosan black bear is endemic to Taiwan.
ex.zh: 台灣黑熊是台灣特有種。

root.note: 存在於本地人民之中的 → 地方性的

mn: endemic（地方性）vs. epidemic（流行性）vs. pandemic（全球大流行）。

senses.en: to provide someone with a quality or ability

ex.en: Nature seemed to endue her with a gift for music.
ex.zh: 上天似乎賦予了她音樂天分。

parts.m: lead, put on 引導、穿上（拉丁文 inducere）

root.note: 給人穿上（特質）→ 賦予

senses.en: able to be tolerated or endured

ex.en: A cool breeze made the summer heat more endurable.
ex.zh: 一陣涼風讓夏天的酷熱變得比較能忍受。

root.note: 能夠持久撐住的 → 可忍受的

senses.en: the ability to endure a difficult process without giving up

ex.en: Running a marathon requires great physical endurance.
ex.zh: 跑馬拉松需要很強的體力耐力。

root.note: 持久撐住 → 耐力

senses.en: showing or involving great activity or vitality

ex.en: The energetic puppy ran around the yard for hours.
ex.zh: 那隻精力旺盛的小狗在院子裡跑了好幾個小時。

root.note: 內在有做工的能量 → 精力充沛的

senses.en: to cause someone to feel drained of energy; to weaken

ex.en: The long, humid summer tends to enervate everyone in the city.
ex.zh: 漫長潮濕的夏天常讓城裡每個人都無精打采。

root.note: 把筋骨抽掉 → 使衰弱

mn: 陷阱字：enervate 不是「使充滿活力」，而是相反的「使衰弱」。

senses.en: to make someone or something weak

ex.en: Years of poor diet can enfeeble the body.
ex.zh: 多年的不良飲食會使身體衰弱。

root.note: 使虛弱

senses.en: to give someone the right to vote
to free a slave (historical)

ex.en: The amendment would enfranchise citizens aged sixteen and older.
ex.zh: 這項修正案將賦予十六歲以上公民投票權。

root.note: 使有權利 → 給予選舉權

senses.en: to cause or give rise to a feeling or situation

ex.en: Unfair rules only engender resentment among workers.
ex.zh: 不公平的規定只會引起員工的不滿。

root.note: 使產生 → 引起

senses.en: to cut a design or words into a hard surface
to fix something firmly in the mind

ex.en: The jeweler will engrave our initials inside the rings.
ex.zh: 珠寶師會把我們名字的縮寫刻在戒指內側。

root.note: 刻進裡面 → 雕刻

senses.en: to absorb all the attention of someone

ex.en: A good mystery novel can engross me for hours.
ex.zh: 一本好的推理小說能讓我全神貫注好幾個小時。

root.note: 把（注意力）全部收入 → 使全神貫注

mn: 常用 be engrossed in：全神貫注於。

senses.en: to improve the quality, value, or extent of something

ex.en: A little lemon juice will enhance the flavor of the fish.
ex.zh: 加一點檸檬汁能提升魚的風味。

root.note: 使變高 → 提高

senses.en: a person or thing that is mysterious or difficult to understand

ex.en: How the ancient pyramids were built remains something of an enigma.
ex.zh: 古代金字塔是如何建造的，至今仍是個謎。

root.note: 謎語 → 謎

senses.en: to instruct or urge someone to do something
(law) to prohibit someone from doing something by court order

ex.en: The doctor will enjoin you to rest for at least a week.
ex.zh: 醫生會囑咐你至少休息一週。

root.note: 把責任加到某人身上 → 命令

senses.en: to arouse a feeling or passion; to set on fire

ex.en: A great teacher can enkindle a lifelong love of learning.
ex.zh: 一位好老師能點燃終身對學習的熱愛。

root.note: 使燃起 → 激起

senses.en: to give someone greater knowledge or understanding

ex.en: Could you enlighten me about how this machine works?
ex.zh: 你可以告訴我這台機器是怎麼運作的嗎？

root.note: 使心中有光 → 啟發

mn: the Enlightenment：18 世紀歐洲的啟蒙運動。

senses.en: to join or enroll someone in the armed forces
to ask for and obtain someone's help or support

ex.en: We need to enlist more volunteers for the beach cleanup.
ex.zh: 我們需要招募更多志工參加淨灘活動。

root.note: 列入名單 → 從軍、招募

senses.en: the state of being actively opposed or hostile to someone

ex.en: There was deep enmity between the two rival families.
ex.zh: 這兩個敵對家族之間存在深仇大恨。

root.note: 不是朋友 → 敵意

mn: enmity 和 enemy 同源：做敵人的狀態。

senses.en: to give someone a noble rank or title
to make someone or something more dignified

ex.en: Hard work can ennoble even the simplest job.
ex.zh: 勤奮能使最平凡的工作也變得崇高。

root.note: 使高貴

senses.en: the great size or seriousness of something bad
a very wicked act

ex.en: Only later did we realize the enormity of the disaster.
ex.zh: 直到後來我們才明白這場災難有多嚴重。

root.note: 超出常規 → 極度嚴重、暴行

mn: 傳統上 enormity 指「壞事的嚴重性」，中性的大小最好用 enormousness 或 magnitude。

senses.en: very large in size, quantity, or extent

ex.en: The project required an enormous amount of time and money.
ex.zh: 這個計畫需要龐大的時間和金錢。

root.note: 超出一般標準的 → 巨大的

senses.en: to make someone very angry

ex.en: Unfair decisions by the referee will enrage the fans.
ex.zh: 裁判不公的判決會激怒球迷。

root.note: 使狂怒 → 激怒

senses.en: to give intense pleasure or joy to

ex.en: Her singing seemed to enrapture everyone in the hall.
ex.zh: 她的歌聲似乎讓全場的人都陶醉了。

root.note: 使心神被攫住 → 使陶醉

senses.en: to place something precious in an appropriate place
to preserve a right or idea in a form that ensures respect

ex.en: The constitution will enshrine the right to free speech.
ex.zh: 憲法將明文保障言論自由的權利。

root.note: 放入神龕 → 奉為神聖、珍藏

senses.en: to catch in or as if in a trap

ex.en: The spider waits to ensnare insects in its web.
ex.zh: 蜘蛛等著用網捕捉昆蟲。

root.note: 使落入陷阱

senses.en: to involve something as a necessary part or consequence

ex.en: What exactly does this job entail?
ex.zh: 這份工作具體需要做些什麼？

parts.m: cut, limit 切、限定（古法語 taille）

root.note: 原指限定繼承人，引申為必然帶來 → 需要、牽涉

senses.en: to cause something to become twisted together or caught
to involve someone in difficult circumstances

ex.en: Fishing nets can entangle sea turtles and dolphins.
ex.zh: 漁網可能纏住海龜和海豚。

root.note: 使纏結在一起

senses.en: to capture the fascinated attention of

ex.en: The magician's tricks never fail to enthrall young audiences.
ex.zh: 魔術師的把戲總能迷住年幼的觀眾。

root.note: 使成為奴隸 → 使著迷

senses.en: to place a monarch on the throne
to give a place of great importance to

ex.en: The nation gathered to enthrone its new king.
ex.zh: 全國民眾齊聚一堂，為新國王舉行登基典禮。

root.note: 放上王座 → 使登基

senses.en: to say something that shows great excitement
to make someone interested and excited

ex.en: She will enthuse about her trip to anyone who listens.
ex.zh: 只要有人願意聽，她就會熱情地大談她的旅行。

root.note: 神附在體內 → 充滿熱情（逆構自 enthusiasm）

senses.en: having or showing intense and eager enjoyment or interest

ex.en: The team was enthusiastic about trying the new training plan.
ex.zh: 隊員們很熱衷嘗試新的訓練計畫。

root.note: 神附在體內的 → 熱情的

senses.en: the whole of something

ex.en: Please read the contract in its entirety before signing.
ex.zh: 簽名前請把合約從頭到尾讀完。

root.note: 整個 → 全部

mn: 常用片語 in its entirety（完整地、全部）。

senses.en: the scientific study of insects

ex.en: His love of beetles led him to study entomology in college.
ex.zh: 他對甲蟲的熱愛讓他在大學攻讀昆蟲學。

parts.m: insect 昆蟲（希臘文，原意「切成節」）

root.note: 研究昆蟲的學問

mn: entomology（昆蟲學）vs. etymology（字源學），常被搞混。

senses.en: the internal organs, especially the intestines, of a person or animal

ex.en: Ancient priests examined animal entrails to predict the future.
ex.zh: 古代祭司會查看動物內臟來預測未來。

root.note: 身體裡面的東西 → 內臟

senses.en: an earnest or humble request

ex.en: The king ignored every entreaty for mercy.
ex.zh: 國王對所有求情的懇求都置之不理。

root.note: 一再與人商量 → 懇求

senses.en: the main course of a meal (in American usage)
the right or opportunity to enter a group or place

ex.en: For my entree, I ordered grilled salmon.
ex.zh: 我的主菜點了烤鮭魚。

root.note: 進入 → 入場；原指正餐前的菜，美式指主菜

senses.en: to establish an attitude, habit, or belief so firmly that change is difficult
to dig trenches to protect troops

ex.en: Repeating a bad habit every day will only entrench it further.
ex.zh: 每天重複一個壞習慣只會讓它更根深蒂固。

root.note: 躲進壕溝固守 → 使根深蒂固

senses.en: to wind or twist together

ex.en: The two stories entwine in the final chapter.
ex.zh: 兩條故事線在最後一章交織在一起。

root.note: 纏繞在一起

senses.en: to mention a number of things one by one

ex.en: The report will enumerate the main causes of the accident.
ex.zh: 報告會逐一列出事故的主要原因。

root.note: 一個個數出來 → 列舉

senses.en: a long poem or story about heroic deeds
heroic or grand in scale
(informal) particularly impressive

ex.en: Homer's Odyssey is an epic about a hero's long journey home.
ex.zh: 荷馬的《奧德賽》是一部描寫英雄漫長歸鄉之旅的史詩。

parts.m: word, song 話語、詩歌（希臘文 epos）

root.note: 吟唱的長篇詩歌 → 史詩

senses.en: a person who takes great pleasure in fine food and drink

ex.en: As a true epicure, he traveled to Italy just to taste truffles.
ex.zh: 身為真正的美食家，他專程飛到義大利只為品嚐松露。

parts.m: Epicurus 伊比鳩魯（希臘哲學家）

root.note: 源自主張追求快樂的哲學家伊比鳩魯 → 美食家

senses.en: relating to the philosophy of Epicurus, which saw pleasure as the highest good
senses.zh: 伊比鳩魯學派的；享樂主義的

senses.en: devoted to refined enjoyment, especially of food and drink
a follower of Epicurus; a person devoted to pleasure
senses.zh: 伊比鳩魯學派的人；享樂主義者

ex.en: The Epicurean ideal was a calm life free from pain and fear.
ex.zh: 伊比鳩魯學派的理想是一種沒有痛苦與恐懼的平靜生活。

root.note: 伊比鳩魯學派的 → 享樂的

senses.en: (in old astronomy) a small circle whose center moves around a larger circle

ex.en: Ptolemy added an epicycle to explain why planets seemed to move backward.
ex.zh: 托勒密加入本輪，來解釋行星為何看似逆行。

root.note: 在圓上的圓 → 本輪

senses.en: a curve traced by a point on a circle rolling around the outside of another circle

ex.en: The toy drawing set lets children create an epicycloid with colored pens.
ex.zh: 這套繪圖玩具讓孩子用彩色筆畫出外擺線。

root.note: 在圓上滾動形成的圓形曲線 → 外擺線

senses.en: a widespread outbreak of an infectious disease in a community
a sudden, widespread increase in something undesirable
widespread; affecting many people at once

ex.en: The flu epidemic closed schools across the region.
ex.zh: 流感大流行使整個地區的學校停課。

root.note: 降臨在人民身上的 → 流行病

senses.en: the outer layer of the skin

ex.en: Sunburn damages the cells of the epidermis.
ex.zh: 曬傷會損害表皮細胞。

root.note: 皮膚上層 → 表皮

senses.en: a short, witty saying or poem

ex.en: Oscar Wilde was famous for his clever epigram, "I can resist everything except temptation."
ex.zh: 王爾德以一句妙語聞名：「除了誘惑，我什麼都能抗拒。」

root.note: 刻寫在（紀念物）上的短句 → 警句

senses.en: a section at the end of a book or play that comments on what has happened

ex.en: The epilogue shows the characters ten years later.
ex.zh: 尾聲描寫了角色們十年後的樣子。

root.note: 附加的話 → 結語

senses.en: a moment of sudden and great realization
(Epiphany) a Christian festival on January 6
