ex.en: She had an epiphany: she wanted to be a teacher, not a lawyer.
ex.zh: 她突然頓悟：她想當老師，而不是律師。

root.note: （神）顯現 → 頓悟

senses.en: one part of a TV or radio series
an event or series of events forming part of a longer sequence

ex.en: I stayed up late to watch the final episode of the series.
ex.zh: 我熬夜看了這部影集的最後一集。

root.note: （希臘悲劇中）合唱之間插入的部分 → 插曲、一集

senses.en: words written in memory of a person, especially on a tombstone

ex.en: The epitaph on her grave read, "She loved and was loved."
ex.zh: 她墓碑上的墓誌銘寫著：「她愛人，也被人所愛。」

root.note: 刻在墳墓上的文字 → 墓誌銘

senses.en: a descriptive word or phrase added to a person's name
an insulting or abusive word

ex.en: Richard I earned the epithet "the Lionheart" for his bravery.
ex.zh: 理查一世因英勇而獲得「獅心王」的稱號。

root.note: 附加放上去的名稱 → 稱號

senses.en: a perfect example of a quality or type

ex.en: The hotel was the epitome of luxury.
ex.zh: 這家飯店是奢華的典範。

root.note: 切下來的精華摘要 → 縮影、典型

mn: 注意發音 [ɪˋpɪtəmɪ]，結尾不是 [tom]。

senses.en: (of a disease) spreading rapidly among animals
an outbreak of disease among animals

ex.en: An epizootic outbreak of bird flu forced farmers to cull their chickens.
ex.zh: 一波禽流感疫情迫使農民撲殺雞隻。

root.note: 降臨在動物身上的 → 動物流行性的

senses.en: a particular period of time in history or a person's life
(geology) a division of time within a period

ex.en: The invention of the steam engine marked a new epoch in history.
ex.zh: 蒸汽機的發明標誌著歷史的新紀元。

root.note: 停頓的時間點 → 紀元

senses.en: the third part of a classical Greek ode, after the strophe and antistrophe
senses.zh: （古希臘頌歌的）尾曲；長短句詩

ex.en: The chorus sang the epode after the strophe and antistrophe.
ex.zh: 合唱團在正旋舞歌與反旋舞歌之後唱出尾曲。

root.note: 附加的歌 → 尾曲

senses.en: to make things equal or uniform
(sports) to score a goal that makes the score even

ex.en: The new law aims to equalize funding between rich and poor schools.
ex.zh: 新法旨在讓富裕與貧窮學校的經費更平均。

root.note: 使相等

senses.en: mental calmness, especially in a difficult situation

ex.en: She accepted the bad news with remarkable equanimity.
ex.zh: 她以驚人的沉著接受了這個壞消息。

root.note: 心情平穩 → 沉著

senses.en: relating to horse riding
a person who rides horses skillfully

ex.en: The park features an equestrian statue of a famous general.
ex.zh: 公園裡有一座著名將軍的騎馬雕像。

root.note: 與馬有關的 → 馬術的

mn: 這裡的 equ 是「馬」，不是「相等」。

senses.en: a state in which opposing forces are balanced
a calm state of mind

ex.en: The market reaches equilibrium when supply matches demand.
ex.zh: 當供給與需求相符時，市場就達到均衡。

root.note: 天平兩邊相等 → 平衡

senses.en: fair and impartial

ex.en: We need an equitable way to divide the work.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個公平的方式來分配工作。

root.note: 平等對待的 → 公平的

senses.en: the quality of being fair and impartial
the value of shares or ownership in a company or property

ex.en: The school board is committed to equity for all students.
ex.zh: 教育委員會致力於讓所有學生享有公平。

root.note: 平等 → 公平

senses.en: equal in value, amount, meaning, or function
a thing that is equal to or corresponds with another

ex.en: A kilometer is roughly equivalent to 0.62 miles.
ex.zh: 一公里大約等於 0.62 英里。

root.note: 價值相等的 → 相當的

senses.en: open to more than one interpretation, often to avoid commitment
senses.zh: 模稜兩可的；含糊其詞的

ex.en: The senator gave an equivocal answer that pleased neither side.
ex.zh: 那位參議員給了一個模稜兩可的回答，兩邊都不滿意。

root.note: 兩種聲音一樣大 → 模稜兩可

senses.en: to use vague language to avoid committing oneself or telling the truth

ex.en: When asked about the missing money, the treasurer began to equivocate.
ex.zh: 被問到失蹤的款項時，財務長開始支吾其詞。

root.note: 說出兩種意思同等可能的話 → 含糊其詞

senses.en: to destroy something completely; to get rid of

ex.en: Vaccines helped eradicate smallpox worldwide.
ex.zh: 疫苗幫助全世界根除了天花。

root.note: 連根拔出 → 根除

senses.en: straying from the proper course or standards
traveling in search of adventure

ex.en: An errant golf ball smashed the clubhouse window.
ex.zh: 一顆打偏的高爾夫球砸破了俱樂部會所的窗戶。

root.note: 走偏的 → 犯錯的；四處遊蕩的

mn: knight-errant：遊俠騎士。

senses.en: not even or regular in pattern or movement; unpredictable

ex.en: His erratic driving made the other drivers nervous.
ex.zh: 他忽快忽慢的開車方式讓其他駕駛很緊張。

root.note: 四處遊蕩的 → 不穩定的

senses.en: wrong; incorrect

ex.en: The article was based on erroneous information.
ex.zh: 這篇文章是根據錯誤的資訊寫成的。

root.note: 走錯的 → 錯誤的

senses.en: having or showing great knowledge from study

ex.en: The erudite professor could quote poetry in five languages.
ex.zh: 那位博學的教授能用五種語言引用詩句。

root.note: 去除粗野 → 受過教育、博學的（rude 同源）

senses.en: deep, extensive learning or knowledge

ex.en: The professor's erudition impressed even other experts.
ex.zh: 那位教授的博學連其他專家都佩服。

root.note: 脫離粗野無知 → 博學

mn: rude 原意是「未受教育的」，e-rud-ition 就是擺脫無知。

senses.en: to deliberately avoid using or doing something

ex.en: Many athletes eschew sugary drinks during training.
ex.zh: 許多運動員在訓練期間戒掉含糖飲料。

root.note: 避開 → 戒絕

senses.en: to catch sight of; to notice

ex.en: From the hilltop, we could espy a small cottage in the valley.
ex.zh: 從山頂上，我們可以看到山谷裡有一間小屋。

root.note: 偵察看到 → 發現

senses.en: a polite title added after a man's name (Esq.), or used for lawyers in the US
senses.zh: 先生（加在姓名後的尊稱）；（美）律師的頭銜

senses.en: (historical) a young nobleman who served a knight

ex.en: In medieval times, an esquire carried the knight's shield.
ex.zh: 在中世紀，騎士侍從負責替騎士拿盾牌。

parts.m: shield-bearer 持盾者（拉丁文 scutarius）

root.note: 替騎士持盾的人 → 侍從 → 尊稱

senses.en: the most important quality or basic nature of something
a concentrated extract of a plant or other substance

ex.en: The essence of good teaching is making students curious.
ex.zh: 好教學的精髓在於激發學生的好奇心。

root.note: 事物存在的根本 → 本質

mn: in essence：本質上、基本上。

senses.en: concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty (variant of aesthetic)
senses.zh: 美學的；審美的（aesthetic 的美式拼法）

senses.en: a set of principles about beauty or artistic style

ex.en: The building was designed for esthetic appeal as well as function.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的設計兼顧美感與實用。

root.note: 感官知覺的 → 審美的

senses.en: worthy of great respect
able to be estimated

ex.en: The award honors an estimable scholar who taught here for forty years.
ex.zh: 這個獎項表彰一位在此執教四十年的可敬學者。

root.note: 值得高度評價的 → 可敬的

senses.en: to cause someone to be no longer close or friendly with another

ex.en: A bitter argument over money could estrange the two brothers for years.
ex.zh: 一場為錢而起的激烈爭吵可能讓兩兄弟疏遠多年。

parts.m: foreign, strange 陌生的（拉丁文 extraneus）

root.note: 使變得陌生 → 使疏遠

mn: 常用 estranged：分居的、疏遠的（例如 estranged wife）。

senses.en: the wide mouth of a river where it meets the sea

ex.en: Many birds feed in the estuary where fresh water meets salt water.
ex.zh: 許多鳥類在淡水與海水交會的河口覓食。

root.note: 受潮汐影響的地方 → 河口

senses.en: relating to eugenics, the discredited practice of trying to improve human populations by controlled breeding

ex.en: Historians condemn the eugenic policies of the early twentieth century.
ex.zh: 歷史學家譴責二十世紀初的優生政策。

root.note: 好的出生 → 優生的

senses.en: to praise highly, especially someone who has died

ex.en: Friends gathered to eulogize the beloved teacher.
ex.zh: 朋友們齊聚一堂，頌揚這位深受愛戴的老師。

root.note: 說好話 → 頌揚

senses.en: a speech or piece of writing praising someone, especially at a funeral

ex.en: Her son delivered a moving eulogy at the funeral.
ex.zh: 她的兒子在葬禮上致了一篇感人的悼詞。

root.note: 說好話 → 頌詞、悼詞

mn: eulogy（頌詞、悼詞）vs. elegy（輓歌、哀歌）。

senses.en: a mild or indirect word used in place of one that seems harsh or blunt

ex.en: "Passed away" is a common euphemism for "died."
ex.zh: 「過世」是「死亡」常見的委婉說法。

root.note: 說好聽的話 → 委婉語

senses.en: pleasing to the ear

ex.en: Italian is often described as a euphonious language.
ex.zh: 義大利語常被形容為悅耳的語言。

root.note: 好聽的聲音 → 悅耳的

senses.en: the quality of being pleasing to the ear, especially in word choice

ex.en: Poets choose words for their euphony as well as their meaning.
ex.zh: 詩人選字時，除了意義也會考慮聲音是否悅耳。

root.note: 好聽的聲音 → 悅耳

senses.en: to escape or avoid, especially by cleverness or trickery
to avoid giving a direct answer to

ex.en: The senator tried to evade the reporter's question about the budget.
ex.zh: 那位參議員試圖迴避記者關於預算的問題。

root.note: 走出去、溜掉 → 逃避

senses.en: to fade away gradually; to vanish

ex.en: Morning mist will evanesce as soon as the sun rises.
ex.zh: 太陽一升起，晨霧就會漸漸消散。

root.note: 逐漸變空 → 消失

senses.en: quickly fading or disappearing; short-lived

ex.en: The evanescent beauty of cherry blossoms draws huge crowds every spring.
ex.zh: 櫻花轉瞬即逝的美每年春天都吸引大批人潮。

root.note: 逐漸變空的 → 轉瞬即逝的

senses.en: relating to a Protestant tradition stressing personal conversion and the Bible
extremely enthusiastic in promoting a cause

ex.en: She speaks about healthy eating with an almost evangelical passion.
ex.zh: 她談起健康飲食時，帶著近乎傳教般的熱情。

root.note: 好消息（福音）的 → 福音派的

senses.en: a person who seeks to convert others to Christianity
an enthusiastic supporter of something

ex.en: He became an evangelist for electric cars after his first test drive.
ex.zh: 第一次試駕後，他就成了電動車的熱心推廣者。

root.note: 傳播好消息的人 → 傳福音者

senses.en: the act of escaping or avoiding something, especially a duty
an indirect or misleading answer

ex.en: The company was fined millions for tax evasion.
ex.zh: 這家公司因逃稅被罰了數百萬。

root.note: 走出去、溜掉 → 逃避

senses.en: happening at the end of a process or period of time

ex.en: Few people predicted the team's eventual victory in the finals.
ex.zh: 很少有人預料到這支隊伍最後會在決賽中獲勝。

root.note: 最後出來的結果 → 最終的

senses.en: to turn inside out or outward

ex.en: Surgeons had to evert the eyelid to remove the tiny splinter.
ex.zh: 外科醫師必須把眼瞼翻開，才能取出那根小木刺。

root.note: 向外轉 → 外翻

senses.en: to force someone to leave a property, usually by legal process

ex.en: The landlord threatened to evict the tenants if they did not pay rent.
ex.zh: 房東威脅說如果房客不付房租，就要把他們趕出去。

root.note: （在官司中）打敗對方並把人趕出去 → 驅逐

senses.en: of or providing evidence

ex.en: The blurry photo had little evidential value in court.
ex.zh: 那張模糊的照片在法庭上幾乎沒有證據價值。

root.note: 讓人看得出來的 → 證據的

senses.en: to reveal or show clearly (a feeling or quality)

ex.en: The young pianist did not evince any nervousness on stage.
ex.zh: 那位年輕鋼琴家在台上沒有顯露出一絲緊張。

root.note: 證明出來 → 清楚表明

mn: 別和 evict（驅逐）搞混：evince 是「顯露」。

senses.en: to bring a feeling, memory, or image into the mind

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread can evoke memories of my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 剛出爐的麵包香能喚起我對祖母廚房的回憶。

root.note: 把東西呼喚出來 → 喚起

senses.en: the process by which species develop from earlier forms over time
gradual development

ex.en: Darwin's theory of evolution changed how scientists viewed life on Earth.
ex.zh: 達爾文的演化論改變了科學家看待地球生命的方式。

root.note: （像捲軸一樣）慢慢展開 → 演化、發展

senses.en: to develop gradually
(of species) to change over generations

ex.en: Over the years, the small startup would evolve into a global company.
ex.zh: 這些年來，那家小新創公司逐步發展成一家跨國企業。

root.note: 慢慢展開 → 發展、演化

senses.en: to make a problem, bad situation, or feeling worse

ex.en: Scratching the rash will only exacerbate the itching.
ex.zh: 抓疹子只會讓癢更嚴重。

root.note: 弄得更苦澀 → 使惡化

senses.en: to describe something as larger, better, or worse than it really is

ex.en: Fishermen tend to exaggerate the size of the fish they caught.
ex.zh: 釣客往往會誇大自己釣到的魚有多大。

root.note: 一直往上堆 → 誇大

senses.en: to irritate or annoy intensely

ex.en: His constant excuses began to exasperate even his most patient teacher.
ex.zh: 他不斷找藉口，連最有耐心的老師都被惹火了。

root.note: 使變得很粗暴 → 激怒

senses.en: to dig out or uncover, especially for archaeological study

ex.en: Archaeologists plan to excavate the ancient city next summer.
ex.zh: 考古學家計畫明年夏天開挖這座古城。

root.note: 挖出空洞 → 挖掘

senses.en: to be greater than a number or amount
to go beyond what is allowed

ex.en: Drivers who exceed the speed limit will be fined.
ex.zh: 超速的駕駛人將被罰款。

root.note: 走出界線 → 超過

senses.en: to be exceptionally good at something

ex.en: Students who excel in math may join the advanced class.
ex.zh: 數學特別優秀的學生可以加入進階班。

root.note: 高出眾人 → 擅長、傑出

senses.en: the quality of being outstanding or extremely good

ex.en: The school has a long tradition of academic excellence.
ex.zh: 這所學校向來以學術卓越著稱。

root.note: 高出眾人 → 卓越

senses.en: a title used for certain high officials, such as ambassadors
senses.zh: 閣下（對大使、總督等的尊稱）

ex.en: The guard bowed and said, "His Excellency will see you now."
ex.zh: 警衛鞠躬說：「大使閣下現在要見您。」

root.note: 地位高出眾人者 → 閣下

senses.en: extremely good; outstanding

ex.en: The restaurant serves excellent food at reasonable prices.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳以合理的價格提供極好的餐點。

root.note: 高出眾人的 → 優秀的

senses.en: a short passage taken from a book, film, or piece of music
[ɛkˋsɝpt] to take a short passage from a longer work

ex.en: The teacher read an excerpt from the novel to spark our interest.
ex.zh: 老師朗讀了小說的一段節錄來引起我們的興趣。

root.note: 摘取出來的部分 → 摘錄

senses.en: an amount that is more than necessary or allowed
[ˋɛksɛs] more than is needed or usual

ex.en: Eating sugar in excess can lead to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 攝取過量的糖可能導致嚴重的健康問題。

root.note: 走出界線 → 過量

senses.en: easily excited or upset

ex.en: The excitable puppy jumped on every visitor who came through the door.
ex.zh: 那隻容易興奮的小狗會撲向每個進門的訪客。

root.note: 容易被喚起情緒的 → 易激動的

senses.en: the act of stimulating; (science) raising to a higher energy state

ex.en: The excitation of electrons by light makes the material glow.
ex.zh: 光激發電子，使這種材料發光。

root.note: 喚起出來 → 刺激、激發

senses.en: a sudden cry or remark expressing strong emotion

ex.en: She let out an exclamation of surprise when she opened the gift.
ex.zh: 她打開禮物時驚喜地叫了一聲。

root.note: 大聲叫出來 → 驚呼

mn: exclamation mark 就是驚嘆號（!）。

senses.en: to deny access to or keep out
to rule out a possibility

ex.en: The club voted to exclude anyone who broke its safety rules.
ex.zh: 俱樂部投票決定，把違反安全規定的人排除在外。

root.note: 關在外面 → 排除

senses.en: the act of keeping someone or something out

ex.en: The exclusion of women from voting lasted for centuries.
ex.zh: 將女性排除在投票權之外的情形持續了好幾個世紀。

root.note: 關在外面 → 排除

senses.en: an abnormal outgrowth on a body or plant
an ugly or unwanted addition

ex.en: Many residents saw the new parking tower as an excrescence on the old town.
ex.zh: 許多居民覺得新的立體停車場是老城區的一個礙眼贅物。

root.note: 向外長出來的東西 → 贅生物

senses.en: the process of eliminating waste from the body; the waste itself

ex.en: The kidneys play a key role in the excretion of waste.
ex.zh: 腎臟在排泄廢物中扮演關鍵角色。

root.note: 分離出去 → 排泄

senses.en: to cause intense physical or mental pain; to torture

ex.en: The long wait for the test results seemed to excruciate the whole family.
ex.zh: 漫長地等待檢查結果，似乎讓全家人痛苦萬分。

root.note: 釘上十字架般地折磨 → 使極度痛苦

senses.en: a short journey or trip, especially for pleasure
a brief departure from a main topic

ex.en: Our class went on an excursion to the science museum.
ex.zh: 我們班去科學博物館校外教學。

root.note: 跑出去一趟 → 短途旅行

senses.en: able to be forgiven or justified

ex.en: A small mistake on your first day is perfectly excusable.
ex.zh: 第一天上班犯個小錯是完全可以原諒的。

root.note: 能免於指控的 → 可原諒的

senses.en: extremely bad or unpleasant

ex.en: The hotel's service was execrable, and we left a day early.
ex.zh: 那家飯店的服務糟透了，我們提早一天離開。

root.note: 被逐出神聖之外、遭詛咒的 → 極糟的

senses.en: the act of cursing or expressing great loathing

ex.en: The dictator's name became an object of execration after his fall.
ex.zh: 獨裁者垮台後，他的名字成了眾人唾罵的對象。

root.note: 逐出神聖之外 → 詛咒

senses.en: a person appointed to carry out the terms of a will

ex.en: She named her eldest son as the executor of her will.
ex.zh: 她指定長子為遺囑執行人。

root.note: 把事情追到完成的人 → 執行人

senses.en: a critical explanation or interpretation of a text, especially scripture

ex.en: The professor offered a careful exegesis of the ancient poem.
ex.zh: 教授對那首古詩做了仔細的詮釋。

root.note: 把意思引導出來 → 詮釋

senses.en: a person or thing serving as a typical or excellent model

ex.en: The old library is an exemplar of Gothic Revival architecture.
ex.zh: 那座老圖書館是哥德復興式建築的典範。

root.note: 作為例子的東西 → 典範

senses.en: serving as a desirable model; very good
(of punishment) serving as a warning

ex.en: The firefighter received a medal for her exemplary courage.
ex.zh: 那位消防員因堪為表率的勇氣而獲頒獎章。

root.note: 可以當例子的 → 模範的

senses.en: to be a typical example of
to illustrate by giving an example

ex.en: These paintings exemplify the bright colors of the Impressionist style.
ex.zh: 這些畫作正是印象派鮮明色彩的典型代表。

root.note: 使成為例子 → 例證

senses.en: free from an obligation or rule that applies to others
to free from an obligation

ex.en: Students with medical notes are exempt from the swimming test.
ex.zh: 有醫生證明的學生可以免考游泳。

root.note: 被拿出來、不算在內 → 豁免的

senses.en: to apply force, influence, or pressure
to make a strong effort

ex.en: Parents exert a strong influence on their children's habits.
ex.zh: 父母對孩子的習慣有很大的影響力。

parts.m: join, put 放置（拉丁文 serere）

root.note: 把力量放出去 → 施加

senses.en: to breathe out

ex.en: Take a deep breath, hold it, and then slowly exhale.
ex.zh: 深吸一口氣，憋住，然後慢慢吐氣。

root.note: 向外呼氣 → 呼氣

senses.en: to tire out completely
to use up completely
waste gases from an engine

ex.en: If we keep spending like this, we will exhaust our savings by June.
ex.zh: 如果我們繼續這樣花錢，六月前就會把積蓄用光。

root.note: 汲取到見底 → 耗盡

senses.en: able to be used up completely

ex.en: Coal and oil are exhaustible resources that will not last forever.
ex.zh: 煤和石油是會耗盡的資源，不會永遠存在。

root.note: 可以被汲取到見底的 → 可耗盡的

senses.en: a state of extreme tiredness
the act of using something up

ex.en: After running the marathon, she collapsed from exhaustion.
ex.zh: 跑完馬拉松後，她累到虛脫倒下。

root.note: 被汲取到見底 → 筋疲力盡

senses.en: including every possible detail; thorough

ex.en: The police conducted an exhaustive search of the forest.
ex.zh: 警方對森林進行了地毯式的搜索。

root.note: 把所有東西都汲取出來的 → 詳盡的

mn: exhaustive 是「詳盡的」，不是 exhausting（令人疲憊的）。

senses.en: to make someone feel very happy, animated, or elated

ex.en: A fast ride down the snowy slope never fails to exhilarate him.
ex.zh: 從雪坡上飛速滑下總是讓他興奮不已。

root.note: 使非常快樂 → 使振奮

senses.en: to dig up a buried body
to bring something forgotten back to attention

ex.en: The court ordered officials to exhume the body for a new autopsy.
ex.zh: 法院下令官員開棺驗屍重新解剖。

root.note: 從土裡挖出來 → 掘墓

senses.en: an urgent need or demand

ex.en: The hospital must be ready for every exigency, from floods to power cuts.
ex.zh: 醫院必須為各種緊急狀況做好準備，從水災到停電都是。

root.note: 驅使人非做不可 → 急迫需要

senses.en: pressing; demanding immediate attention
requiring much effort; demanding

ex.en: Police may enter a home without a warrant in exigent circumstances.
ex.zh: 在緊急情況下，警方可以無搜索票進入民宅。

root.note: 驅使人立即行動的 → 緊急的

senses.en: the fact or state of being real or alive
a way of living

ex.en: Scientists debate the existence of life on other planets.
ex.zh: 科學家爭論其他星球上是否存在生命。

root.note: 站出來、顯現出來 → 存在

senses.en: a way out of a place
to go out of or leave

ex.en: Please use the nearest exit in case of fire.
ex.zh: 發生火災時，請使用最近的出口。

root.note: 走出去 → 出口

senses.en: a mass departure of people

ex.en: Rising rents caused an exodus of young families from the city.
ex.zh: 房租上漲導致年輕家庭大批離開這座城市。

root.note: 走上出去的路 → 大批出走

mn: 聖經《出埃及記》就叫 Exodus。

senses.en: to officially declare someone free from blame

ex.en: New DNA evidence helped exonerate the man after ten years in prison.
ex.zh: 新的 DNA 證據幫這名入獄十年的男子洗清了罪名。

root.note: 卸下負擔 → 免除罪責

senses.en: the quality of being unreasonably high, especially in price

ex.en: Travelers complained about the exorbitance of airport food prices.
ex.zh: 旅客抱怨機場的餐點價格貴得離譜。

root.note: 偏離軌道 → 過分

senses.en: (of a price or amount) unreasonably high

ex.en: We refused to pay the exorbitant fee for a bottle of water.
ex.zh: 我們拒絕為一瓶水付那麼離譜的價錢。

root.note: 偏離正常軌道的 → 過高的

senses.en: to drive out an evil spirit
to get rid of an unpleasant memory or feeling
senses.zh: 擺脫（不愉快的記憶、情緒）

ex.en: Writing the memoir helped her exorcise the painful memories of the war.
ex.zh: 寫回憶錄幫助她擺脫了戰爭的痛苦記憶。

root.note: 以誓言命令（邪靈）出去 → 驅魔

senses.en: originating in or typical of a distant foreign country
attractive because unusual

ex.en: The market sells exotic fruits from Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 這個市場販賣來自東南亞的異國水果。

root.note: 來自外面的 → 異國的

senses.en: to become or make larger
to give more details about

ex.en: The company plans to expand into Japan next year.
ex.zh: 這家公司計畫明年拓展到日本市場。

root.note: 向外展開 → 擴大

senses.en: a wide, open area of land, sea, or sky

ex.en: From the plane we saw a vast expanse of desert.
ex.zh: 從飛機上我們看到一大片廣闊的沙漠。

root.note: 向外展開的一片 → 廣闊區域

senses.en: the act of becoming larger or more extensive

ex.en: The rapid expansion of the city put pressure on its water supply.
ex.zh: 城市的迅速擴張對供水造成壓力。

root.note: 向外展開 → 擴張

senses.en: a person who lives outside their native country
[ɛksˋpetrɪˏet] to leave or expel from one's native country

ex.en: As an expatriate in Tokyo, he often missed Taiwanese food.
ex.zh: 身為旅居東京的外國人，他常常想念台灣菜。

root.note: 離開祖國的人 → 旅居國外者

senses.en: to believe that something will happen
to require something as appropriate

ex.en: We expect the package to arrive on Friday.
ex.zh: 我們預計包裹會在週五送達。

root.note: 向外張望等待 → 期待

senses.en: the state of expecting something, especially something pleasant
the expected length of something (e.g., life expectancy)

ex.en: Life expectancy in Taiwan has risen steadily over the past fifty years.
ex.zh: 台灣的平均壽命在過去五十年來穩定上升。

root.note: 向外張望等待 → 期待

senses.en: to cough up and spit out phlegm

ex.en: The doctor asked the patient to expectorate into a small cup.
ex.zh: 醫生要病人把痰咳到小杯子裡。

root.note: 從胸腔弄出來 → 咳痰

senses.en: the quality of being convenient and practical, even if improper or immoral
senses.zh: 權宜之計；（不顧原則的）方便行事

ex.en: The mayor was accused of choosing political expediency over principle.
ex.zh: 市長被指控為了政治上的方便而犧牲原則。

root.note: 把腳從束縛中解開、行動方便 → 權宜

senses.en: convenient and practical, though possibly improper
a means of achieving an end, often a temporary one

ex.en: It was more expedient to hire a taxi than to wait for the bus.
ex.zh: 叫計程車比等公車方便多了。

root.note: 讓腳自由行動的 → 方便的

senses.en: to make a process happen faster

ex.en: Paying an extra fee will expedite the passport application.
ex.zh: 多付一筆費用可以加快護照申請的速度。

root.note: 把腳從束縛中解開 → 使加速

senses.en: done with speed and efficiency

ex.en: The team found an expeditious way to process the refunds.
ex.zh: 團隊找到一個迅速處理退款的方法。

root.note: 腳步自由、行動快的 → 迅速的

senses.en: to spend or use up time, money, or energy
senses.zh: 花費；耗費（時間、金錢、精力）

ex.en: Don't expend all your energy in the first lap of the race.
ex.zh: 別在比賽的第一圈就把力氣用光。

root.note: 把錢秤出去 → 花費

senses.en: the cost of something; money spent
something given up for a result (at the expense of)

ex.en: He succeeded at work but at the expense of his health.
ex.zh: 他在工作上成功了，卻犧牲了健康。

root.note: 付出去的錢 → 費用

senses.en: to make amends for guilt or wrongdoing

ex.en: He volunteered for years, hoping to expiate the harm he had caused.
ex.zh: 他當了好幾年志工，希望彌補自己造成的傷害。

root.note: 用虔誠的行為把罪清出去 → 贖罪

senses.en: to analyze and explain in detail

ex.en: The essay asks students to explicate a short poem line by line.
ex.zh: 這篇作文要學生逐行解析一首短詩。

root.note: 把摺起來的東西攤開 → 闡明

senses.en: stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion
showing sexual or violent content openly

ex.en: The teacher gave explicit instructions about how to cite sources.
ex.zh: 老師給了關於如何引用資料的明確指示。

root.note: 攤開來擺明的 → 明確的

senses.en: to burst violently
to increase suddenly and rapidly
to show sudden strong emotion

ex.en: Fireworks explode over the harbor every New Year's Eve.
ex.zh: 每年跨年夜，煙火都會在港口上空綻放。

root.note: 原指拍手把演員轟下台 → 引申為爆開

senses.en: a violent bursting with noise
a sudden large increase

ex.en: The explosion shattered windows three blocks away.
ex.zh: 這場爆炸震碎了三條街外的窗戶。

root.note: 向外爆開 → 爆炸

senses.en: able or likely to explode
likely to cause strong emotions or conflict
senses.zh: 一觸即發的；易引起爭議的

senses.en: a substance that can explode

ex.en: Immigration remains an explosive issue in the election.
ex.zh: 移民問題在這次選舉中仍是一觸即發的議題。

root.note: 會向外爆開的 → 爆炸性的

senses.en: a detailed explanation of a theory or idea
a large public exhibition

ex.en: The first chapter is a clear exposition of the author's main argument.
ex.zh: 第一章清楚闡述了作者的主要論點。

root.note: 把東西擺出來給人看 → 說明、展覽

senses.en: intended to explain or describe something

ex.en: An expository essay explains a topic using facts rather than opinions.
ex.zh: 說明文是用事實而非意見來解釋一個主題。

root.note: 把道理擺出來的 → 說明性的

senses.en: to express strong disagreement or protest

ex.en: She tried to expostulate with the referee, but he ignored her.
ex.zh: 她試圖跟裁判據理力爭，但裁判不理她。

root.note: 強烈地要求 → 抗議、勸誡

senses.en: the state of being unprotected from something harmful
public attention or publicity

ex.en: Long exposure to loud music can damage your hearing.
ex.zh: 長時間接觸大聲的音樂會損害聽力。

root.note: 被放在外面 → 暴露

senses.en: effectively showing thought or feeling
senses.zh: 富於表現力的；表情豐富的

ex.en: The actor has an expressive face that shows every emotion.
ex.zh: 那位演員表情豐富，每種情緒都寫在臉上。

root.note: 把感受擠壓出來的 → 富表現力的

senses.en: the act of forcing someone to leave a place or organization

ex.en: Cheating on the final exam could result in expulsion from the school.
ex.zh: 期末考作弊可能會被學校開除。

root.note: 推出去 → 驅逐

senses.en: still in existence; surviving

ex.en: Only three copies of the original manuscript are still extant.
ex.zh: 原始手稿只剩下三份存世。

root.note: 還站在那裡的 → 現存的

mn: extant（現存的）與 extinct（滅絕的）意思相反，別搞混。

senses.en: spoken or done without preparation

ex.en: His extemporaneous speech at the wedding made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 他在婚禮上的即興致詞逗得大家哈哈大笑。

root.note: 出於當下那個時刻的 → 即興的

senses.en: without planning or preparation
spoken or done without preparation

ex.en: The mayor spoke extempore when the microphone failed and her notes blew away.
ex.zh: 麥克風故障、講稿又被風吹走時，市長只好即席發言。

root.note: 出於當下（拉丁文 ex tempore）→ 即席地

senses.en: able to be extended or stretched

ex.en: The software is extensible, so users can add their own features.
ex.zh: 這套軟體可擴充，使用者能加入自己的功能。

root.note: 能向外伸展的 → 可延伸的

senses.en: an additional period of time
an added part that makes something larger
a telephone line within a building

ex.en: The professor granted me a one-week extension on my paper.
ex.zh: 教授答應讓我的報告延一週交。

root.note: 向外伸展 → 延長

senses.en: covering a large area or amount; wide-ranging

ex.en: The storm caused extensive damage along the coast.
ex.zh: 暴風雨沿著海岸造成大規模的破壞。

root.note: 向外伸展很遠的 → 廣泛的

senses.en: a muscle that straightens or extends a part of the body

ex.en: The extensor in your forearm straightens your fingers.
ex.zh: 前臂的伸肌負責把手指伸直。

root.note: 使肢體伸展的東西 → 伸肌

senses.en: to make a wrong seem less serious by giving an excuse

ex.en: Nothing can extenuate his decision to drive after drinking.
ex.zh: 他酒後開車的決定沒有任何理由可以開脫。

root.note: 使變薄 → 減輕（罪過）

mn: 常見片語 extenuating circumstances（情有可原的情況）。

senses.en: the outer surface or structure
situated on the outside

ex.en: Beneath his tough exterior, he is actually very kind.
ex.zh: 在他強硬的外表下，其實是個非常善良的人。

root.note: 較外面的 → 外部

senses.en: belonging to or on the outside
coming from outside an organization or country

ex.en: The company hired an external auditor to review its accounts.
ex.zh: 公司聘請外部審計人員來審查帳目。

root.note: 在外面的 → 外部的

senses.en: (of a species) no longer existing
(of a volcano) no longer active

ex.en: Dinosaurs became extinct about 66 million years ago.
ex.zh: 恐龍大約在六千六百萬年前滅絕。

root.note: 火被熄滅 → 滅絕的

senses.en: to put out a fire or light
to end or destroy (a hope, feeling)

ex.en: Firefighters worked all night to extinguish the blaze.
ex.zh: 消防員整夜奮戰撲滅大火。

root.note: 把火弄熄 → 撲滅

senses.en: to praise enthusiastically

ex.en: Health experts often extol the benefits of regular exercise.
ex.zh: 健康專家經常大力讚揚規律運動的好處。

root.note: 把人高高舉起 → 讚揚

senses.en: to obtain something by force, threats, or other unfair means

ex.en: The gang tried to extort money from local shop owners.
ex.zh: 那個幫派試圖向當地店家勒索錢財。

root.note: 扭出來 → 勒索

senses.en: the crime of obtaining money through threats or force

ex.en: The official was arrested on charges of extortion and bribery.
ex.zh: 那名官員因涉嫌勒索和賄賂而被捕。

root.note: 扭出來 → 勒索

senses.en: to hand over an accused person to the country where the crime was committed

ex.en: The government agreed to extradite the suspect to face trial in France.
ex.zh: 政府同意將嫌犯引渡到法國受審。

root.note: 把人交出去 → 引渡

senses.en: the legal process of handing over an accused person to another country

ex.en: The two countries do not have an extradition treaty.
ex.zh: 這兩個國家之間沒有引渡條約。

root.note: 把人交出去 → 引渡

senses.en: done outside the normal legal process, often illegally
senses.zh: 法外的；未經司法程序的

ex.en: Human rights groups condemned the extrajudicial killings by the police.
ex.zh: 人權團體譴責警方未經司法程序的殺戮。

root.note: 在審判之外的 → 法外的

senses.en: irrelevant or unrelated to the subject
coming from outside

ex.en: Cut any extraneous details so your essay stays focused.
ex.zh: 刪掉所有無關的細節，讓你的文章保持聚焦。

root.note: 在外面的 → 不相干的

senses.en: very unusual or remarkable
(of a meeting or official) additional; special

ex.en: The young violinist has an extraordinary talent.
ex.zh: 這位年輕的小提琴家擁有非凡的天分。

root.note: 在一般秩序之外的 → 非凡的

senses.en: excessive spending or use of resources
an expensive luxury

ex.en: A new sports car seemed like a needless extravagance.
ex.zh: 買一輛新跑車似乎是不必要的奢侈。

root.note: 遊蕩到界線之外 → 過度、奢侈

senses.en: spending or costing too much money
exceeding what is reasonable

ex.en: They threw an extravagant party with fireworks and a live band.
ex.zh: 他們辦了一場有煙火和現場樂團的奢華派對。

root.note: 遊蕩到界線之外的 → 過度的

senses.en: a person with extreme political or religious views

ex.en: Police arrested a violent extremist who was planning an attack.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了一名正在策劃攻擊的暴力極端分子。

root.note: 站在最邊緣的人 → 極端分子

senses.en: the farthest point or limit
a hand or foot (usually plural)
extreme hardship or danger

ex.en: The lighthouse stands at the southern extremity of the island.
ex.zh: 燈塔矗立在島嶼的最南端。

root.note: 最外面的地方 → 末端

senses.en: to free from a difficult situation or place

ex.en: It took an hour to extricate the dog from the narrow pipe.
ex.zh: 花了一小時才把狗從狹窄的管子裡救出來。

root.note: 從麻煩中弄出來 → 使擺脫

senses.en: to force or push out; to shape by forcing through a die

ex.en: The machine can extrude plastic into long, thin tubes.
ex.zh: 這台機器能把塑膠擠壓成細長的管子。

root.note: 向外擠 → 擠出

senses.en: the quality of being full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness

ex.en: The children's exuberance filled the whole house with noise.
ex.zh: 孩子們興高采烈，吵得整間屋子熱鬧非凡。

root.note: 極為豐盛 → 活力充沛

senses.en: full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness
senses.zh: 熱情洋溢的；充滿活力的

senses.en: (of plants) growing thickly

ex.en: The exuberant fans cheered and danced after the final whistle.
ex.zh: 終場哨聲響起後，熱情的球迷又叫又跳。

root.note: 極為豐盛的 → 活力充沛的

senses.en: to invent something false in order to deceive
to construct or manufacture

ex.en: The researcher was fired for trying to fabricate data.
ex.zh: 那名研究員因企圖捏造數據而被開除。

root.note: 動手製作 → 製造；引申為捏造

senses.en: extraordinarily good; wonderful
existing only in fables or myths

ex.en: We had a fabulous time at the beach this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末我們在海灘玩得很開心。

root.note: 像故事裡才有的 → 驚人的、極好的

senses.en: one side or aspect of something
one of the flat surfaces of a cut gem

ex.en: Music is an important facet of her life.
ex.zh: 音樂是她生活中重要的一環。

root.note: 小小的一面 → 方面

senses.en: treating serious issues with inappropriate humor
senses.zh: （不合時宜地）愛開玩笑的；油嘴滑舌的

ex.en: His facetious comments during the funeral upset the family.
ex.zh: 他在喪禮上不合時宜的玩笑話讓家屬很不高興。

root.note: 愛說笑的 → 開玩笑的

senses.en: of or affecting the face
a beauty treatment for the face

ex.en: Her facial expression showed that she was confused.
ex.zh: 她的臉部表情顯示她很困惑。

root.note: 臉的

senses.en: too simple; showing a lack of careful thought
done easily and effortlessly
senses.zh: 容易做到的；輕而易舉的

ex.en: The critic dismissed the book's facile solutions to complex problems.
ex.zh: 評論家對這本書用膚淺方法解決複雜問題的做法不屑一顧。

root.note: 很容易做的 → 輕易的；引申為膚淺的

senses.en: to make an action or process easier

ex.en: The new app will facilitate communication between teachers and parents.
ex.zh: 這個新應用程式將促進老師與家長之間的溝通。

root.note: 使變容易 → 促進

senses.en: a building or equipment provided for a purpose
a natural ability to do something easily

ex.en: The city opened a new sports facility with two swimming pools.
ex.zh: 市政府啟用了一座有兩個游泳池的新運動設施。

root.note: 讓事情容易的東西 → 設施；做事容易 → 才能

senses.en: an exact copy, especially of a document or picture
a fax

ex.en: The museum displays a facsimile of the original declaration.
ex.zh: 博物館展出原版宣言的複製品。

root.note: 做得一模一樣 → 複製品

mn: fax（傳真）就是 facsimile 的縮寫。

senses.en: a small group within a larger group that disagrees with the rest

ex.en: A rebel faction within the party opposed the new leader.
ex.zh: 黨內一個反叛派系反對新領導人。

root.note: 一起做事的一群人 → 派系

senses.en: causing or inclined to cause disagreement within a group
senses.zh: 派系鬥爭的；好鬧分裂的

ex.en: Factious debates kept the council from passing a budget.
ex.zh: 派系間的爭吵使議會遲遲無法通過預算。

root.note: 愛搞派系的 → 分裂的

mn: factious（搞派系的）別和 factitious（人為的）、fictitious（虛構的）搞混。

senses.en: based on a mistaken belief or faulty reasoning

ex.en: The argument that cold weather causes colds is fallacious.
ex.zh: 冷天氣會導致感冒的說法是錯誤的。

root.note: 騙人的 → 謬誤的

senses.en: a mistaken belief
a flaw in reasoning that makes an argument invalid

ex.en: It is a fallacy that money always brings happiness.
ex.zh: 錢一定會帶來快樂是一種謬見。

root.note: 騙人的想法 → 謬見

senses.en: capable of making mistakes

ex.en: Even the best doctors are fallible and sometimes misdiagnose patients.
ex.zh: 即使是最好的醫生也會犯錯，有時會誤診。

root.note: 可能出錯的

senses.en: (of farmland) plowed but left unplanted to restore fertility
inactive; not productive for a period

ex.en: Farmers let the field lie fallow for a year to rest the soil.
ex.zh: 農夫讓這塊田休耕一年，讓土壤休養。

senses.en: to suffer or cause to suffer extreme hunger

ex.en: Without supplies, the stranded hikers began to famish.
ex.zh: 沒有補給，受困的登山客開始挨餓。

root.note: 使飢餓

mn: 常用形容詞 famished（餓壞了的）。

senses.en: a person with extreme, uncritical enthusiasm for a cause or activity

ex.en: My uncle is a baseball fanatic who never misses a game.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是個棒球狂熱者，從不錯過任何一場比賽。

root.note: 被神廟的神附身般狂熱 → 狂熱者

mn: fan（粉絲）就是從 fanatic 縮短來的。

senses.en: a person with a special interest in breeding or growing certain animals or plants

ex.en: The pigeon fancier kept over fifty birds on his rooftop.
ex.zh: 那位賽鴿愛好者在屋頂上養了五十多隻鴿子。

root.note: 喜愛某物的人 → 愛好者

senses.en: lacking imagination or fancy
senses.zh: 缺乏想像力的；無幻想的

ex.en: The report was dry and fanciless, full of numbers but no ideas.
ex.zh: 這份報告枯燥乏味，只有數字而沒有想法。

root.note: 沒有想像的 → 缺乏想像力的

senses.en: very attentive to detail and hard to please

ex.en: He is so fastidious about his desk that he lines up his pencils by length.
ex.zh: 他對書桌非常講究，連鉛筆都照長短排好。

root.note: 對很多東西都嫌惡 → 挑剔的

senses.en: to understand something after much thought
a unit of water depth equal to six feet
senses.zh: 噚（測水深單位，約 1.8 公尺）

ex.en: I cannot fathom why anyone would leave a dog in a hot car.
ex.zh: 我實在無法理解怎麼會有人把狗留在很熱的車裡。

senses.en: silly and pointless

ex.en: He made a fatuous remark that nobody bothered to answer.
ex.zh: 他說了句蠢話，沒人理他。

root.note: 愚蠢的

senses.en: not working or made correctly; having defects
(of reasoning) containing mistakes

ex.en: The fire was caused by faulty wiring in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 火災是由廚房的線路故障引起的。

senses.en: (Roman myth) a rural god with a human body and a goat's horns, ears, and legs
senses.zh: （羅馬神話）半人半羊的農牧神

ex.en: In the story, a friendly faun meets a girl in the snowy woods.
ex.zh: 故事裡，一位友善的羊人在雪林中遇見一個女孩。

mn: faun（羊人）與 fawn（小鹿）同音。

senses.en: to flatter someone to gain favor
a young deer
light yellowish-brown

ex.en: The new employees fawn over the boss whenever she walks by.
ex.zh: 每次老闆經過，新員工都會拍她馬屁。

senses.en: loyalty sworn by a vassal to a feudal lord

ex.en: The knights knelt and swore fealty to their new king.
ex.zh: 騎士們跪下，宣誓效忠新國王。

root.note: 忠誠 → 效忠

senses.en: possible and practical to do

ex.en: Building a bridge across the strait is technically feasible but very expensive.
ex.zh: 在海峽上建橋在技術上可行，但非常昂貴。

root.note: 做得到的 → 可行的

senses.en: to unite states or groups under a central government while keeping some independence

ex.en: The colonies decided to federate into a single nation.
ex.zh: 這些殖民地決定聯合成一個國家。

root.note: 以盟約結合 → 結成聯邦

senses.en: a deceptive movement meant to distract an opponent
to make a deceptive movement

ex.en: The boxer threw a feint with his left before landing a right hook.
ex.zh: 拳擊手先用左手虛晃一招，再打出右勾拳。

mn: feint（假動作）與 faint（昏倒）同音。

senses.en: to congratulate

ex.en: The principal came on stage to felicitate the winning team.
ex.zh: 校長上台祝賀獲勝的隊伍。

root.note: 使快樂、祝人快樂 → 祝賀

senses.en: intense happiness
the ability to find apt expression

ex.en: The writer is admired for the felicity of her word choice.
ex.zh: 這位作家以用字恰到好處而備受推崇。

root.note: 快樂 → 幸福；讓人愉快的措辭 → 恰當

senses.en: a person who has committed a serious crime

ex.en: In some states, a convicted felon cannot vote.
ex.zh: 在某些州，被定罪的重罪犯不能投票。

senses.en: relating to or involving a serious crime

ex.en: He was charged with felonious assault after the fight.
ex.zh: 那場鬥毆之後，他被以重傷害罪起訴。

root.note: 罪犯的 → 重罪的

senses.en: a serious crime, such as murder or robbery

ex.en: Armed robbery is a felony that carries a long prison sentence.
ex.zh: 持械搶劫是會判長期徒刑的重罪。

senses.en: having qualities traditionally associated with women
(grammar) of the gender class that includes most words for females

ex.en: In French, the word for "table" is feminine.
ex.zh: 在法文中，「桌子」這個字是陰性的。

root.note: 女人的

senses.en: a place where ferns are grown
senses.zh: 蕨類植物園；蕨類栽培處

ex.en: The old greenhouse was turned into a shady fernery.
ex.zh: 那座舊溫室被改成陰涼的蕨類植物園。

root.note: 種蕨類的地方

senses.en: savagely fierce, cruel, or violent
extremely intense

ex.en: A ferocious storm knocked down trees across the island.
ex.zh: 一場猛烈的暴風雨吹倒了全島的樹木。

root.note: 非常野蠻的 → 兇猛的

senses.en: the state of being fierce or violent

ex.en: The ferocity of the attack shocked the whole town.
ex.zh: 攻擊之兇殘震驚了全鎮。

root.note: 兇猛

senses.en: having or showing passionate intensity

ex.en: She is a fervent supporter of animal rights.
ex.zh: 她是動物權的熱烈支持者。

root.note: 沸騰的 → 熱烈的

senses.en: intensely enthusiastic, sometimes excessively so

ex.en: The candidate's fervid speech stirred the crowd.
ex.zh: 候選人慷慨激昂的演說激起了群眾的情緒。

root.note: 沸騰的 → 熾熱的

senses.en: intense and passionate feeling

ex.en: The fans sang the anthem with religious fervor.
ex.zh: 球迷們以宗教般的熱忱高唱隊歌。

root.note: 沸騰 → 熱情

senses.en: relating to a festival; festive

ex.en: The streets took on a festal air during the lantern celebration.
ex.zh: 燈節期間，街頭洋溢著節慶氣氛。

root.note: 節日的

senses.en: relating to a celebration; cheerful and jolly

ex.en: Red lanterns gave the street a festive look before Lunar New Year.
ex.zh: 農曆新年前，紅燈籠讓街道充滿節慶氣息。

root.note: 節日的

senses.en: to honor or entertain someone lavishly
a celebration or outdoor festival, often for charity
senses.zh: 慶祝會；（戶外）義賣園遊會

ex.en: The town plans to fete the returning gold medalist with a parade.
ex.zh: 鎮上計畫以遊行盛大歡迎凱旋的金牌得主。

root.note: 舉辦節慶 → 盛大款待

senses.en: an unborn offspring in the later stages of development

ex.en: An ultrasound lets doctors check the health of the fetus.
ex.zh: 超音波讓醫師能檢查胎兒的健康狀況。

senses.en: relating to the medieval system in which vassals held land in return for service to a lord

ex.en: Under the feudal system, peasants worked the land for their lord.
ex.zh: 在封建制度下，農民為領主耕種土地。

root.note: 封地的 → 封建的

senses.en: the social system of medieval Europe based on land held in exchange for service

ex.en: Feudalism declined as trade and towns grew in Europe.
ex.zh: 隨著歐洲貿易和城鎮的發展，封建制度逐漸衰落。

root.note: 以封地為基礎的制度

senses.en: a flat-topped red felt hat with a tassel, worn in some Muslim countries
senses.zh: 土耳其氈帽（紅色平頂附流蘇）

ex.en: The waiter wore a red fez with a black tassel.
ex.zh: 服務生戴著一頂有黑色流蘇的紅色土耳其帽。

mn: 得名於摩洛哥城市 Fez（非斯）。

senses.en: a complete and humiliating failure

ex.en: The product launch was a fiasco because the demo crashed on stage.
ex.zh: 這次產品發表會是一場大災難，因為展示時當機了。

senses.en: changing frequently, especially in loyalty or affection

ex.en: Pop stars know that fans can be fickle and quickly move on.
ex.zh: 流行歌手都知道粉絲很善變，很快就會轉移目標。

senses.en: not real or true; invented

ex.en: He checked into the hotel under a fictitious name.
ex.zh: 他用假名入住飯店。

root.note: 捏造出來的 → 虛構的

senses.en: faithfulness to a person, cause, or belief
the degree of accuracy of a copy or reproduction

ex.en: The translation keeps close fidelity to the original text.
ex.zh: 這份譯文非常忠實於原文。

root.note: 值得信任 → 忠誠

mn: hi-fi 音響就是 high fidelity（高傳真）。

senses.en: (technical) used as a fixed standard of reference for measurement
based on trust; fiduciary

ex.en: The engineer placed a fiducial mark on each circuit board for alignment.
ex.zh: 工程師在每塊電路板上標了一個對位用的基準點。

root.note: 可信賴的 → 作為基準的

senses.en: land held under the feudal system in exchange for service
an area controlled by one person

ex.en: The king granted the knight a small fief near the river.
ex.zh: 國王把河邊的一小塊封地賜給騎士。

senses.en: a long speech used to delay or block a vote in a legislature
to delay a vote by speaking at length

ex.en: The senator spoke for 24 hours in a filibuster against the bill.
ex.zh: 那位參議員發表長達二十四小時的冗長演說來阻撓法案。

senses.en: the last part of a performance or event, often the most exciting

ex.en: The concert ended with a spectacular finale of fireworks.
ex.zh: 演唱會以壯觀的煙火秀作為壓軸。

root.note: 結束的部分 → 終曲

senses.en: the quality of being final and unchangeable

ex.en: He closed the door with a sense of finality.
ex.zh: 他帶著一種不容挽回的決絕把門關上。

root.note: 最終且不變的性質

senses.en: after a long time, usually with difficulty or delay
as the last in a series

ex.en: After three hours of waiting, the train finally arrived.
ex.zh: 等了三個小時後，火車終於到了。

root.note: 到了結束時 → 終於

senses.en: relating to money or finance

ex.en: The family faced financial difficulties after the factory closed.
ex.zh: 工廠倒閉後，這家人陷入經濟困境。

root.note: 結清債務 → 財務的

senses.en: a person who manages or provides large amounts of money

ex.en: A wealthy financier paid for the construction of the new museum.
ex.zh: 一位富有的金融家出資興建新的博物館。

root.note: 處理財務的人 → 金融家

senses.en: showy, elegant clothing or decoration

ex.en: Guests arrived at the ball dressed in all their finery.
ex.zh: 賓客們穿著最華麗的盛裝來參加舞會。

root.note: 精美的衣物 → 華服

senses.en: skill and delicacy in handling something
to handle a situation with skill, sometimes deceptively

ex.en: The diplomat handled the tense negotiation with great finesse.
ex.zh: 這位外交官以高超的手腕處理了緊張的談判。

root.note: 精細的處理 → 技巧

senses.en: having limits or bounds

ex.en: Fresh water is a finite resource that we must protect.
ex.zh: 淡水是有限的資源，我們必須保護。

root.note: 有界限的 → 有限的

senses.en: relating to government revenue, taxes, and spending

ex.en: The government announced a new fiscal policy to reduce debt.
ex.zh: 政府宣布一項新的財政政策以減少債務。

parts.m: treasury, basket 國庫（原指錢籃子）

root.note: 國庫的 → 財政的

mn: fiscal year 是會計年度。

senses.en: a person who sells fish

ex.en: The fishmonger cleaned the fish before wrapping it in paper.
ex.zh: 魚販把魚處理乾淨後才用紙包起來。

root.note: 賣魚的商人

senses.en: a long, narrow crack or opening
a split or division between groups

ex.en: Steam rose from a fissure in the volcanic rock.
ex.zh: 蒸氣從火山岩的裂縫中冒出。

root.note: 分裂開的地方 → 裂縫

senses.en: active or occurring irregularly; not steady

ex.en: After the scary movie, I had a fitful night of sleep.
ex.zh: 看完恐怖片後，我整晚睡得斷斷續續。

root.note: 一陣一陣的 → 斷斷續續的

senses.en: a piece of equipment fixed in position in a building
senses.zh: 固定裝置（如燈具、衛浴設備）

senses.en: a person or thing that has been in a place for a long time
senses.zh: 固定存在的人或事物；常客

ex.en: The old man on the park bench became a fixture of the neighborhood.
ex.zh: 公園長椅上的那位老先生已經成了社區的固定風景。

root.note: 被固定的東西 → 固定裝置

senses.en: a naval officer above the rank of captain, such as an admiral

ex.en: As a flag-officer, she commanded an entire fleet of ships.
ex.zh: 身為海軍將官，她指揮整支艦隊。

root.note: 有權懸掛自己旗幟的軍官 → 將官

senses.en: (of a wrong act) shockingly obvious and offensive

ex.en: Selling fake medicine is a flagrant violation of the law.
ex.zh: 販賣假藥是公然違法的行為。

root.note: 像火一樣燒得顯眼的 → 明目張膽的

mn: 別和 fragrant（芳香的）搞混：flagrant 多了 l，指明目張膽。

senses.en: showy and confident in a way that attracts attention
senses.zh: 浮誇的；愛炫耀的；華麗的

ex.en: The singer is known for her flamboyant costumes and wild hairstyles.
ex.zh: 那位歌手以華麗的服裝和誇張的髮型聞名。

root.note: 像火焰般耀眼的 → 華麗浮誇的

senses.en: gas in the stomach or intestines
pompous or empty speech

ex.en: Beans can cause flatulence in some people.
ex.zh: 豆類會讓某些人腸胃脹氣。

root.note: 充滿氣 → 脹氣

senses.en: the act of bending; a bend (also spelled flexion)
(grammar) inflection

ex.en: The therapist measured the flection of the patient's knee.
ex.zh: 治療師測量病人膝蓋的彎曲程度。

root.note: 彎曲

senses.en: a young bird that has just learned to fly
new and inexperienced

ex.en: The fledgling company struggled to find its first customers.
ex.zh: 這家剛起步的公司努力尋找第一批客戶。

root.note: 剛長羽毛的小鳥 → 雛鳥、新手

senses.en: able to bend easily without breaking
able to change or be changed easily

ex.en: My job has flexible hours, so I can pick up my kids after school.
ex.zh: 我的工作時間很彈性，所以可以接孩子放學。

root.note: 能彎曲的 → 有彈性的

senses.en: weak and easily damaged
(of an excuse or argument) weak and unconvincing

ex.en: He gave a flimsy excuse for missing the meeting.
ex.zh: 他為缺席會議找了個站不住腳的藉口。

senses.en: not showing proper seriousness or respect
senses.zh: 輕率的；無禮的；不正經的

ex.en: The judge warned the witness not to be flippant in court.
ex.zh: 法官警告證人在法庭上不要輕浮無禮。

senses.en: a sheet of floating ice

ex.en: A polar bear rested on a floe in the Arctic Ocean.
ex.zh: 一隻北極熊在北冰洋的浮冰上休息。

mn: floe（浮冰）與 flow（流動）同音。

senses.en: the plants of a particular region or period

ex.en: Scientists study the unique flora of the rain forest.
ex.zh: 科學家研究熱帶雨林獨特的植物群。

root.note: 花草 → 植物群（羅馬花神 Flora）

mn: flora and fauna：植物與動物。

senses.en: relating to or decorated with flowers

ex.en: She wore a floral dress to the spring picnic.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件碎花洋裝去參加春季野餐。

root.note: 花的

senses.en: (of language or style) too elaborate or ornate
senses.zh: （文字、風格）華麗的；過分修飾的

senses.en: (of a face) reddish

ex.en: The editor cut the florid descriptions from the novel.
ex.zh: 編輯刪掉了小說中過度華麗的描述。

root.note: 開滿花的 → 華麗的

senses.en: a person who sells and arranges flowers

ex.en: He ordered a bouquet from the florist for his mother's birthday.
ex.zh: 他向花店訂了一束花送給媽媽當生日禮物。

root.note: 賣花的人

senses.en: to rise and fall irregularly

ex.en: Vegetable prices fluctuate depending on the weather.
ex.zh: 蔬菜價格隨天氣而波動。

root.note: 像波浪一樣起伏 → 波動

senses.en: an irregular rise and fall in number or amount

ex.en: Sudden fluctuation in the exchange rate worried investors.
ex.zh: 匯率的突然波動讓投資人憂心。

root.note: 像波浪般起伏 → 波動

senses.en: a duct or pipe in a chimney for smoke and gases

ex.en: Open the flue before you light a fire in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 在壁爐生火前要先打開煙道。

mn: flue（煙道）與 flu（流感）同音。

senses.en: able to speak or write a language easily and accurately
smooth and effortless

ex.en: After two years in Madrid, she became fluent in Spanish.
ex.zh: 在馬德里待了兩年後，她的西班牙文變得很流利。

root.note: 像水一樣流動的 → 流利的

senses.en: (archaic) flowing; fluid

ex.en: Old texts describe the fluential motion of rivers toward the sea.
ex.zh: 古老的文獻描述河流奔向大海的流動。

root.note: 流動的

senses.en: continuous change
the action of flowing

ex.en: The fashion industry is in a constant state of flux.
ex.zh: 時尚產業一直處於不斷變動之中。

root.note: 流動 → 不斷變化

senses.en: full of fog; misty
confused or unclear

ex.en: On foggy mornings, drivers must slow down on the highway.
ex.zh: 起霧的早晨，駕駛在高速公路上必須減速。

mn: 常見片語 I haven't the foggiest idea（我完全不知道）。

senses.en: a minor weakness or odd habit in someone's character

ex.en: His only foible is that he always arrives five minutes late.
ex.zh: 他唯一的小毛病就是總會遲到五分鐘。

senses.en: to force someone to accept something unwanted

ex.en: Don't try to foist your old furniture on your neighbors.
ex.zh: 別想把你的舊家具硬塞給鄰居。

mn: 常用 foist something on/upon someone。

senses.en: the leaves of a plant or tree, collectively

ex.en: Tourists travel to Kyoto each autumn to see the red foliage.
ex.zh: 每年秋天，遊客都會到京都欣賞紅葉。

root.note: 葉子的總稱

senses.en: a large sheet folded once to make two leaves of a book; a book of such size
a page or leaf number

ex.en: The library owns a rare folio of Shakespeare's plays.
ex.zh: 這間圖書館收藏一本罕見的莎士比亞劇作對開本。

root.note: 紙頁 → 對開本

senses.en: the traditional beliefs, stories, and customs of a community

ex.en: According to local folklore, a dragon once lived in the lake.
ex.zh: 根據當地的民間傳說，湖裡曾經住著一條龍。

root.note: 民間流傳的知識 → 民俗

senses.en: to touch or stroke gently and lovingly

ex.en: The little girl liked to fondle the kitten's soft ears.
ex.zh: 小女孩喜歡撫摸小貓柔軟的耳朵。

senses.en: foolish behavior or actions

ex.en: The teacher had no patience for foolery during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試期間老師對胡鬧毫無耐心。

root.note: 傻瓜的行為

senses.en: a note printed at the bottom of a page (usually spelled footnote)
a minor or less important event

ex.en: The author added a foot-note to explain the old term.
ex.zh: 作者加了一個註腳來解釋那個舊詞。

root.note: 寫在頁面底部的註記 → 註腳

senses.en: excessive concern with clothes and appearance
senses.zh: （男子）過度講究打扮；紈褲習氣

ex.en: His silk gloves and perfumed hair were pure foppery.
ex.zh: 他的絲質手套和噴了香水的頭髮純粹是紈褲子弟的做作。

root.note: 紈褲子弟的行為

senses.en: (of a man) too concerned with clothes and appearance
senses.zh: （男子）過分講究衣著的；花花公子的

ex.en: The foppish young lord changed his coat three times a day.
ex.zh: 那位愛打扮的年輕貴族一天要換三次外套。

root.note: 像紈褲子弟的

senses.en: patient self-control; tolerance

ex.en: The nurse showed great forbearance with the difficult patient.
ex.zh: 護理師對那位難搞的病人展現了極大的耐心。

root.note: 忍住不做 → 克制

senses.en: (archaic, Scottish) besides; in addition
(archaic, Scottish) besides; except

ex.en: The old ballad says the shepherd had a dog, and forby a flock of sheep.
ex.zh: 那首古老的民謠說，牧羊人有一條狗，此外還有一群羊。

root.note: 在旁邊還有 → 此外

senses.en: done using physical force
forceful and convincing

ex.en: Police found no signs of forcible entry into the house.
ex.zh: 警方在屋子裡沒發現強行闖入的跡象。

root.note: 用力的 → 強制的

senses.en: to act as a warning of something bad; to predict

ex.en: The dark clouds seemed to forebode a terrible storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲似乎預示著一場可怕的暴風雨。

root.note: 事先預示 → 預兆

mn: 名詞 foreboding（不祥的預感）更常用。

senses.en: a prediction of future events, especially weather
to predict

ex.en: The weather forecast says it will rain all weekend.
ex.zh: 天氣預報說整個週末都會下雨。

root.note: 預先把眼光投向未來 → 預測

senses.en: the front part of a ship below the deck, where sailors live

ex.en: The sailors slept in the cramped forecastle at the bow.
ex.zh: 水手們睡在船頭擁擠的水手艙裡。

root.note: 古代戰船前方像城堡的高台 → 前甲板

mn: 航海用語唸作 [ˋfoksḷ]，常縮寫為 fo'c'sle。

senses.en: to take possession of a property because the owner failed to pay the mortgage
senses.zh: （因未繳房貸）取消贖回權；查封

senses.en: to rule out or prevent

ex.en: The bank may foreclose on the house if the payments stop.
ex.zh: 如果停止繳款，銀行可能會把房子收回拍賣。

root.note: 把人關在外面 → 取消贖回權

senses.en: an open area in front of a large building or gas station

ex.en: Visitors gathered in the forecourt of the palace to watch the guards.
ex.zh: 遊客聚集在宮殿前庭觀看衛兵。

root.note: 前面的庭院

senses.en: an ancestor, especially a male one

ex.en: Each forefather in our family tree was a farmer.
ex.zh: 我們族譜上的每一位祖先都是農夫。

root.note: 之前的父輩 → 祖先

senses.en: to go before; to precede (also used as a variant of forgo)
senses.zh: 在…之前；居先（亦作 forgo 的異體：放棄）

ex.en: Many people chose to forego dessert after the heavy meal.
ex.zh: 吃完豐盛的一餐後，很多人選擇不吃甜點。

root.note: 走在前面 → 居先

mn: 常用形容詞 foregone conclusion（必然的結果）。

senses.en: the part of a scene nearest to the viewer
the most important position
to make something the most prominent

ex.en: In the foreground of the photo, a child is feeding ducks.
ex.zh: 照片的前景中，有個小孩在餵鴨子。

root.note: 前面的地面 → 前景

senses.en: the part of the face above the eyebrows

ex.en: She wiped the sweat from her forehead after the run.
ex.zh: 跑完步後，她擦掉額頭上的汗。

root.note: 頭的前面 → 額頭

mn: 也常唸作 [ˋforˏhɛd]。

senses.en: of or from another country
strange or unfamiliar

ex.en: Learning a foreign language opens many doors.
ex.zh: 學習一門外語能開啟許多機會。

senses.en: a person from another country

ex.en: As a foreigner, he found the local customs fascinating.
ex.zh: 身為外國人，他覺得當地習俗非常有趣。

senses.en: to judge before hearing the facts; to prejudge

ex.en: We should not forejudge the new student before we get to know her.
ex.zh: 在認識新同學之前，我們不應該先入為主地評斷她。

root.note: 預先判斷

senses.en: awareness of something before it happens

ex.en: The official denied having any foreknowledge of the attack.
ex.zh: 那位官員否認事先知道這次攻擊。

root.note: 預先知道

senses.en: a worker who supervises other workers
the person who speaks for a jury

ex.en: The foreman checked each worker's safety gear before the shift.
ex.zh: 工頭在上工前檢查每位工人的安全裝備。

root.note: 站在前面帶頭的人 → 工頭

senses.en: (of God or fate) to decide or determine in advance

ex.en: Some believe that fate can foreordain every event in our lives.
ex.zh: 有些人相信命運預先注定了我們生命中的每件事。

root.note: 預先規定 → 注定

senses.en: the act of deciding something in advance, as by God or fate

ex.en: The sermon touched on the idea of foreordination and free will.
ex.zh: 那場講道談到了宿命與自由意志的概念。

root.note: 預先的安排 → 宿命

senses.en: the narrow space in the bow of a ship

ex.en: Extra ropes and anchors were stored in the forepeak.
ex.zh: 多餘的繩索和錨都存放在首尖艙裡。

root.note: 船最前面的尖端空間

senses.en: to come before; to be a sign of what is coming

ex.en: Small tremors often forerun a major earthquake.
ex.zh: 小規模的震動常常是大地震的前兆。

root.note: 跑在前面 → 先行、預示

mn: 名詞 forerunner（先驅）更常用。

senses.en: the main sail on the foremast of a ship

ex.en: The crew raised the foresail as the wind picked up.
ex.zh: 風勢漸強，船員們升起了前帆。

root.note: 前面的帆

mn: 航海用語也唸作 [ˋforsḷ]。

senses.en: to know or expect that something will happen

ex.en: No one could foresee how quickly the virus would spread.
ex.zh: 沒有人能預見病毒會傳播得這麼快。

root.note: 預先看到 → 預見

senses.en: the part of a shore between high and low tide marks

ex.en: At low tide, children search the foreshore for crabs.
ex.zh: 退潮時，孩子們在潮間帶找螃蟹。

root.note: 海岸前面的部分

senses.en: the ability to predict and prepare for future needs

ex.en: Thanks to her foresight, we had enough water when the pipes burst.
ex.zh: 多虧她有先見之明，水管爆裂時我們才有足夠的水。

root.note: 預先看到的能力 → 遠見

senses.en: to predict the future

ex.en: Nobody can foretell exactly what the stock market will do.
ex.zh: 沒有人能準確預言股市的走勢。

root.note: 預先說出 → 預言

senses.en: careful thought and planning for the future

ex.en: With a little forethought, you can avoid most travel problems.
ex.zh: 只要事先稍加考慮，就能避免大部分的旅遊問題。

root.note: 預先思考

senses.en: to lose or give up something as a penalty
something lost as a penalty

ex.en: If you cancel late, you will forfeit your deposit.
ex.zh: 如果太晚取消，你的訂金就會被沒收。

senses.en: (archaic) to prevent or forbid, as in "heaven forfend"

ex.en: "Heaven forfend that we should be late!" she joked.
ex.zh: 「老天保佑我們別遲到！」她開玩笑說。

root.note: 把壞事擋開 → 防止

senses.en: the crime of making a fake copy of something
a forged document or artwork

ex.en: Experts proved the famous painting was a forgery.
ex.zh: 專家證實那幅名畫是贗品。

parts.m: shape metal, fake 鍛造、偽造

root.note: 偽造 → 偽造品

senses.en: to choose to go without something you want

ex.en: She decided to forgo her vacation to finish the project.
ex.zh: 為了完成專案，她決定放棄休假。

root.note: 離開不要了 → 放棄

mn: forgo（放棄）與 forego（居先）常被混用。

senses.en: the process of forming something
a particular arrangement or shape

ex.en: The geese flew south in a V formation.
ex.zh: 雁群排成 V 字隊形向南飛。

root.note: 成形 → 形成

senses.en: inspiring fear or respect through being powerful or capable
senses.zh: 令人敬畏的；強大的；難對付的

ex.en: The defending champion is a formidable opponent.
ex.zh: 衛冕冠軍是個難纏的對手。

root.note: 令人害怕的 → 可畏的

senses.en: a rule or fact written with mathematical symbols
a method or recipe for achieving something
powdered milk for babies

ex.en: Use this formula to find the area of a circle.
ex.zh: 用這個公式來求圓的面積。

root.note: 小小的固定形式 → 公式

senses.en: to promise to give up something
to lie under oath

ex.en: After the accident, he vowed to forswear drinking forever.
ex.zh: 那次車禍後，他發誓永遠戒酒。

root.note: 發誓捨棄 → 戒除

senses.en: a thing at which someone excels
[ˋfɔrtɪ] (music) loudly

ex.en: Cooking is not my forte, but I make a good omelet.
ex.zh: 做菜不是我的專長，但我煎的歐姆蛋還不錯。

root.note: 強項 → 專長

senses.en: forward or onward in time or place
out into view

ex.en: The dog ran back and forth along the fence.
ex.zh: 那隻狗沿著籬笆來回奔跑。

mn: 常見片語 back and forth（來回）、and so forth（等等）。

senses.en: direct and honest in speech or manner

ex.en: She gave a forthright answer about her mistakes.
ex.zh: 她坦白地說明了自己的錯誤。

root.note: 直直往前 → 直率的

senses.en: to strengthen a place against attack
to strengthen physically or mentally; to add nutrients to food

ex.en: Many companies fortify their cereal with vitamins and iron.
ex.zh: 許多公司在穀片中添加維生素和鐵來強化營養。

root.note: 使變強 → 加強

senses.en: courage in facing pain or difficulty

ex.en: She faced her long illness with remarkable fortitude.
ex.zh: 她以非凡的堅忍面對長期的病痛。

root.note: 內心強大的狀態 → 堅忍

senses.en: a group of four people, especially playing a game together

ex.en: We need one more player to make a foursome for golf.
ex.zh: 我們還需要一個人才能湊成四人一組打高爾夫。

root.note: 四人一組

senses.en: a crack or break, especially in a bone
to break or crack; to split a group

ex.en: The X-ray showed a small fracture in his wrist.
ex.zh: X 光顯示他的手腕有輕微骨折。

root.note: 破裂 → 骨折

senses.en: easily broken or damaged
(of a situation or person) weak or delicate

ex.en: Please handle the box carefully because the glasses are fragile.
ex.zh: 請小心搬這個箱子，因為裡面的玻璃杯很易碎。

root.note: 容易破的 → 易碎的

senses.en: physical weakness
a moral weakness or fault

ex.en: Jealousy is a common human frailty.
ex.zh: 嫉妒是人類常見的弱點。

parts.m: weak 虛弱（源自 frag 破裂）

root.note: 虛弱

senses.en: a fragrant resin burned as incense

ex.en: In the story, the wise men brought gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
ex.zh: 故事中，東方三博士帶來了黃金、乳香和沒藥。

root.note: 上等的香 → 乳香

senses.en: wild or distraught with fear, worry, or hurry
senses.zh: 發狂似的；慌亂的；手忙腳亂的

ex.en: The frantic mother searched the mall for her lost child.
ex.zh: 那位心急如焚的母親在商場裡尋找走失的孩子。

senses.en: of or like brothers; friendly
(of twins) developed from two separate eggs

ex.en: They are fraternal twins, so they do not look exactly alike.
ex.zh: 他們是異卵雙胞胎，所以長得不完全一樣。

root.note: 兄弟的

senses.en: the quality of being deceitful or dishonest

ex.en: The auditors uncovered clear fraudulence in the company's accounts.
ex.zh: 審計人員揭發了公司帳目中明顯的欺詐行為。

root.note: 充滿欺騙 → 欺詐

senses.en: obtained or done by deception, especially illegally

ex.en: The bank blocked several fraudulent charges on my credit card.
ex.zh: 銀行攔下了我信用卡上幾筆盜刷的費用。

root.note: 充滿欺騙的 → 欺詐的

senses.en: a noisy fight, quarrel, or competition
(of fabric or rope) to wear at the edges and unravel
(of nerves or temper) to show strain

ex.en: Two more candidates entered the fray just before the deadline.
ex.zh: 截止前又有兩位候選人加入戰局。

senses.en: relating to international trade without tariffs or restrictions

ex.en: The two nations signed a free-trade agreement last year.
ex.zh: 兩國去年簽訂了自由貿易協定。

senses.en: a member of an international secret fraternal society (the Freemasons)

ex.en: His great-grandfather was a freemason in the 1890s.
ex.zh: 他的曾祖父在十九世紀九〇年代是共濟會會員。

root.note: 原指自由行動的石匠公會 → 共濟會會員

senses.en: a person who forms opinions by reason rather than authority, especially about religion
senses.zh: 自由思想家（尤指不受宗教教條約束者）

ex.en: As a freethinker, she questioned every tradition she was taught.
ex.zh: 身為自由思想者，她質疑自己所學的每一項傳統。

root.note: 自由思考的人

senses.en: the rate at which something happens
(physics) the number of waves per second

ex.en: The frequency of heavy storms has increased in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來強烈暴風雨的發生頻率增加了。

root.note: 頻繁的程度 → 頻率

senses.en: a painting done on wet plaster on a wall or ceiling

ex.en: Michelangelo painted the famous fresco on the chapel ceiling.
ex.zh: 米開朗基羅在禮拜堂天花板上畫了那幅著名的濕壁畫。

root.note: 畫在新鮮（濕）灰泥上 → 濕壁畫

senses.en: the quality of being new, fresh, or original

ex.en: Store the bread in a sealed bag to keep its freshness.
ex.zh: 把麵包放進密封袋裡以保持新鮮。

senses.en: anxious, irritable, or restless

ex.en: The fretful baby cried until his mother picked him up.
ex.zh: 那個煩躁的嬰兒一直哭，直到媽媽把他抱起來。

root.note: 充滿煩惱的 → 焦躁的

senses.en: very unpleasant, serious, or shocking
(informal) extremely bad; very great

ex.en: The traffic this morning was frightful.
ex.zh: 今天早上的交通糟透了。

root.note: 充滿驚嚇的 → 可怕的

senses.en: very cold
stiff or formal in manner; lacking warmth

ex.en: The explorers survived the frigid Antarctic winter.
ex.zh: 探險家們熬過了南極的酷寒冬天。

root.note: 冷的

mn: frig 就是 fridge（冰箱）的冷。

senses.en: the room with a cold pool in an ancient Roman bath

ex.en: After the hot bath, Romans plunged into the frigidarium.
ex.zh: 泡完熱水澡後，羅馬人會跳進冷水浴室。

root.note: 冷的地方 → 冷水浴室

senses.en: lack of seriousness; lighthearted fun

ex.en: There was no room for frivolity during the serious meeting.
ex.zh: 在嚴肅的會議中容不得嬉鬧。

root.note: 瑣碎不正經 → 輕浮

senses.en: not serious; lacking purpose or value
(of a person) silly and not serious

ex.en: The judge dismissed the case as a frivolous lawsuit.
ex.zh: 法官以濫訴為由駁回了這起案件。

root.note: 瑣碎的

senses.en: (of hair) to form into tight, wiry curls
a mass of tightly curled hair

ex.en: Humid weather makes my hair frizz.
ex.zh: 潮濕的天氣會讓我的頭髮變得毛躁。

senses.en: to fry with a sizzling noise until crisp
to form hair into tight curls

ex.en: Let the bacon frizzle in the pan until it turns golden.
ex.zh: 讓培根在鍋裡滋滋作響，煎到金黃。

senses.en: lively and playful

ex.en: The frolicsome lambs chased each other across the meadow.
ex.zh: 活潑的小羊在草地上互相追逐。

root.note: 愛嬉戲的

senses.en: a border between two countries
the limit of knowledge or activity in a field

ex.en: Space remains the final frontier for human exploration.
ex.zh: 太空仍是人類探索的最後疆域。

root.note: 最前面的地方 → 邊境、前沿

senses.en: scruffy and neglected in appearance; musty
senses.zh: 邋遢的；不整潔的；有霉味的

ex.en: The old inn had frowzy curtains and a musty smell.
ex.zh: 那間老旅店的窗簾髒兮兮的，還有股霉味。

senses.en: careful and economical with money or food
simple and inexpensive

ex.en: By living a frugal life, they saved enough to buy a house.
ex.zh: 靠著節儉的生活，他們存夠了錢買房子。

root.note: 珍惜收成的 → 節儉的

senses.en: the realization or fulfillment of a plan or project

ex.en: After ten years of work, her dream finally came to fruition.
ex.zh: 經過十年的努力，她的夢想終於實現了。

root.note: 結出果實 → 實現

mn: 常用片語 come to fruition（實現）。

senses.en: tending to disappear quickly; fleeting

ex.en: Fame on social media is often fugacious.
ex.zh: 社群媒體上的名氣往往轉瞬即逝。

root.note: 容易逃走的 → 短暫的

senses.en: the point on which a lever rests or turns
the central or essential part of something

ex.en: A seesaw balances on a fulcrum in the middle.
ex.zh: 蹺蹺板靠中間的支點保持平衡。

senses.en: to protest or criticize angrily

ex.en: Critics continue to fulminate against the new tax.
ex.zh: 批評者持續猛烈抨擊這項新稅。

root.note: 像閃電般打下來 → 猛烈抨擊

senses.en: excessively flattering or insincere
generous or abundant

ex.en: His fulsome praise of the boss made his coworkers roll their eyes.
ex.zh: 他對老闆肉麻的吹捧讓同事們直翻白眼。

root.note: 滿到溢出來 → 過分的

mn: fulsome 不是「充分的」好意，傳統上指令人反感的過度讚美。

senses.en: to disinfect an area with chemical smoke or gas

ex.en: We had to fumigate the apartment to get rid of the termites.
ex.zh: 我們必須把公寓燻蒸消毒來消滅白蟻。

root.note: 用煙處理 → 燻蒸

senses.en: a person with official duties, often minor ones

ex.en: A low-level functionary stamped our papers and sent us away.
ex.zh: 一名基層公務員在我們的文件上蓋了章就打發我們走了。

root.note: 執行職務的人 → 官員

senses.en: forming a necessary base or core; of central importance
a basic rule or principle (usually plural)

ex.en: Freedom of speech is a fundamental right in a democracy.
ex.zh: 言論自由是民主社會的基本權利。

root.note: 底部基礎的 → 根本的

senses.en: (of goods) interchangeable with another item of the same kind

ex.en: Money is fungible, so one dollar is as good as any other.
ex.zh: 金錢是可互換的，一塊錢和另一塊錢價值相同。

root.note: 能代替履行的 → 可互換的

mn: NFT 就是 non-fungible token（非同質化代幣）。

senses.en: of, like, or caused by fungi

ex.en: A fungous growth spread across the damp wall.
ex.zh: 潮濕的牆上長滿了一片菌類。

root.note: 蘑菇般的 → 真菌的

senses.en: a living thing such as a mushroom, mold, or yeast

ex.en: A fungus attacked the tomato plants after weeks of rain.
ex.zh: 連下了幾週雨之後，番茄株遭到真菌感染。

root.note: 蘑菇 → 真菌

mn: 複數是 fungi [ˋfʌndʒaɪ]。

senses.en: to polish or restore something to good condition

ex.en: The new owners plan to furbish the old theater before reopening it.
ex.zh: 新業主打算在重新開幕前整修這座老戲院。

mn: refurbish（翻修）比 furbish 更常用。

senses.en: a unit of distance equal to one-eighth of a mile (about 201 meters)
senses.zh: 浪（長度單位，約 201 公尺）

ex.en: The horse took the lead in the final furlong of the race.
ex.zh: 那匹馬在比賽最後一浪取得領先。

root.note: 一條犁溝的長度 → 浪

senses.en: a leave of absence, especially for soldiers
a temporary unpaid leave from work
to put workers on temporary unpaid leave

ex.en: The factory put hundreds of workers on furlough during the slowdown.
ex.zh: 景氣低迷期間，工廠讓數百名員工放無薪假。

senses.en: a person who prepares or sells furs

ex.en: The old furrier had sold coats in the same shop for forty years.
ex.zh: 那位老毛皮商在同一間店賣了四十年大衣。

root.note: 處理毛皮的人

senses.en: to a greater extent or distance
additional
to help something progress

ex.en: Contact the office if you need further information.
ex.zh: 如果需要更多資訊，請聯絡辦公室。

mn: further 多指抽象程度，farther 多指實際距離。

senses.en: the advancement of a plan or interest

ex.en: The grant was used in furtherance of cancer research.
ex.zh: 這筆補助被用來推動癌症研究。

root.note: 推進

senses.en: secretive, as if trying to avoid notice
senses.zh: 偷偷摸摸的；鬼鬼祟祟的

ex.en: He cast a furtive glance at his phone during the test.
ex.zh: 考試時，他偷偷瞄了一眼手機。

root.note: 像小偷一樣的 → 偷偷摸摸的

senses.en: to join or blend together
a safety device in an electric circuit
a cord that is lit to set off an explosive

ex.en: The chef likes to fuse Thai and Italian flavors.
ex.zh: 這位主廚喜歡融合泰式和義式風味。

root.note: 熔化後倒在一起 → 融合

senses.en: able to be melted or fused

ex.en: The sewing kit includes a fusible tape that bonds fabric with an iron.
ex.zh: 這套縫紉工具附有可熱熔的布襯，用熨斗就能黏合布料。

root.note: 能熔化的

senses.en: incapable of producing any useful result; pointless

ex.en: It is futile to argue with him once he has made up his mind.
ex.zh: 他一旦下定決心，跟他爭論就是白費力氣。

root.note: 像漏水的容器一樣倒不滿 → 徒勞的

senses.en: a person who studies and predicts the future, especially of technology or society
a member of Futurism, an early 20th-century art movement

ex.en: The futurist predicted that most cars would drive themselves by 2040.
ex.zh: 那位未來學家預測，到 2040 年大部分汽車都會自動駕駛。

root.note: 研究未來的人

senses.en: the state of being lighthearted or cheerful
merrymaking; festive activity

ex.en: The gaiety of the festival spread through the whole village.
ex.zh: 節慶的歡樂氣氛傳遍了整個村莊。

root.note: 快樂

senses.en: in a cheerful or lighthearted way
with bright colors

ex.en: The streets were gaily decorated with flags and lanterns.
ex.zh: 街道上用旗子和燈籠裝飾得五彩繽紛。

senses.en: a person's or animal's manner of walking

ex.en: I recognized my father from far away by his slow, steady gait.
ex.zh: 我從遠處就憑他緩慢穩健的步伐認出了父親。

mn: gait（步態）與 gate（大門）同音。

senses.en: brave and heroic
(of a man) polite and attentive to women

ex.en: The team made a gallant effort but lost in the final minute.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍奮勇拚搏，但在最後一分鐘輸了。

senses.en: in great numbers or amounts (placed after a noun)
senses.zh: 大量的；很多的（置於名詞後）

ex.en: The night market has food stalls galore.
ex.zh: 夜市裡有非常多的小吃攤。

mn: galore 要放在名詞後面，例如 prizes galore。

senses.en: relating to electric current produced by chemical action
senses.zh: （化學反應產生的）電流的；伽凡尼的

senses.en: sudden and dramatic; stimulating

ex.en: Her speech had a galvanic effect on the tired volunteers.
ex.zh: 她的演講讓疲憊的志工們為之一振。

parts.m: Galvani 伽凡尼（義大利科學家）

root.note: 源自研究生物電的科學家 → 電流的、激勵的

senses.en: electricity produced by chemical action; its use in medicine

ex.en: Early scientists used galvanism to make a dead frog's leg twitch.
ex.zh: 早期科學家利用伽凡尼電流讓死青蛙的腿抽動。

parts.m: Galvani 伽凡尼（義大利科學家）

root.note: 伽凡尼發現的電流現象

senses.en: to shock or excite someone into taking action
to coat iron or steel with zinc to prevent rust

ex.en: The flood helped galvanize the town into building a new seawall.
ex.zh: 那場水災促使全鎮行動起來興建新的海堤。

parts.m: Galvani 伽凡尼（義大利科學家）

root.note: 像通電一樣刺激 → 激勵

senses.en: to bet money on the result of a game or event
to take a risk hoping for a good result
a risky action

ex.en: Quitting his job to start a business was a huge gamble.
ex.zh: 辭職去創業是一場很大的冒險。

senses.en: to run or jump around playfully

ex.en: The lambs gambol in the fields every spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天，小羊都在田野裡蹦蹦跳跳。

mn: gambol（蹦跳）與 gamble（賭博）同音。

senses.en: a person who gambles habitually

ex.en: The old gamester lost his fortune at the card tables.
ex.zh: 那個老賭徒在牌桌上輸光了家產。

root.note: 玩（賭）遊戲的人 → 賭徒

senses.en: the complete range or scope of something

ex.en: The movie covers the whole gamut of human emotions.
ex.zh: 這部電影涵蓋了人類所有的情緒。

mn: 常見片語 run the gamut（涵蓋從…到…的全部）。

senses.en: to decorate food with small additions
a small item used to decorate food
to take money from someone's wages by legal order

ex.en: Garnish the soup with chopped green onions before serving.
ex.zh: 上桌前在湯上撒一些蔥花裝飾。

senses.en: troops stationed in a town or fort to defend it
to station troops in a place

ex.en: A small garrison defended the fort for months.
ex.zh: 一支小規模駐軍守住堡壘好幾個月。

senses.en: a wire or cord used to strangle someone; a former method of execution
to strangle with a wire or cord

ex.en: In the spy novel, the assassin carried a thin wire garrote.
ex.zh: 在那部間諜小說中，殺手隨身帶著一條細鐵絲絞具。

senses.en: excessively talkative, especially about unimportant things

ex.en: The garrulous passenger next to me talked for the entire six-hour flight.
ex.zh: 我旁邊那位多話的乘客，在六小時的航程中說個不停。

root.note: 一直嘰嘰喳喳 → 喋喋不休

mn: 唸起來像「嘎嘎嘎」叫個不停。

senses.en: in the form of a gas

ex.en: Water turns from a liquid to a gaseous state when it boils.
ex.zh: 水沸騰時會從液態變成氣態。

root.note: 氣體的

senses.en: relating to the stomach

ex.en: Gastric acid helps the stomach break down food.
ex.zh: 胃酸幫助胃分解食物。

root.note: 胃的

senses.en: inflammation of the stomach lining

ex.en: Stress and spicy food made his gastritis worse.
ex.zh: 壓力和辛辣食物讓他的胃炎更加嚴重。

root.note: 胃發炎

senses.en: the art and science of good cooking and eating

ex.en: Lyon is famous as a capital of French gastronomy.
ex.zh: 里昂以法國美食之都聞名。

root.note: 關於胃的學問 → 美食學

senses.en: to estimate or judge something
an instrument for measuring
a standard measure, such as thickness or width

ex.en: It is hard to gauge how the public will react to the new law.
ex.zh: 很難判斷大眾對這條新法律會有什麼反應。

mn: 拼法容易寫錯：是 gauge，不是 guage。

senses.en: a police officer in France or another French-speaking country

ex.en: A gendarme stopped our car at the border near Lyon.
ex.zh: 在里昂附近的邊界，一名法國憲兵攔下了我們的車。

root.note: 武裝的人 → 憲兵

senses.en: a person who studies family history and lines of descent

ex.en: A genealogist helped her trace her family back to the 1700s.
ex.zh: 一位系譜學家幫她把家族追溯到十八世紀。

root.note: 研究世系的人

senses.en: a line of descent traced from an ancestor; family history
the study of family history

ex.en: She became interested in genealogy after finding old letters in the attic.
ex.zh: 她在閣樓發現舊信件後，開始對家譜研究產生興趣。

root.note: 研究世系 → 家譜

senses.en: a statement that is general rather than specific
the quality of being general

ex.en: The speech was full of generality and lacked real details.
ex.zh: 這篇演講充滿籠統的說法，缺乏具體細節。

root.note: 涵蓋整個種類的 → 一般性

senses.en: to make a broad statement based on limited examples
to make something more widely applicable

ex.en: It is unfair to generalize about a whole country from one visit.
ex.zh: 只去過一次就對整個國家一概而論是不公平的。

root.note: 擴及整個種類 → 概括

senses.en: in most cases; usually
by most people; widely

ex.en: I generally go to bed before eleven.
ex.zh: 我通常在十一點前上床睡覺。

root.note: 就整體而言 → 通常

senses.en: to produce or create

ex.en: Wind turbines generate electricity without burning fuel.
ex.zh: 風力發電機不需燃燒燃料就能發電。

root.note: 生出來 → 產生

senses.en: general rather than specific
(of a product) not sold under a brand name
senses.zh: 無品牌的；（藥品）學名藥的

ex.en: The generic version of the medicine costs much less.
ex.zh: 這種藥的學名藥版本便宜很多。

root.note: 整個種類的 → 通用的

senses.en: the quality of being kind and willing to give

ex.en: We were touched by the generosity of strangers after the flood.
ex.zh: 水災過後，陌生人的慷慨相助令我們感動。

parts.m: birth, noble birth 出身（高貴）

root.note: 出身高貴者的氣度 → 慷慨

senses.en: the origin or beginning of something

ex.en: The genesis of the idea was a conversation over dinner.
ex.zh: 這個點子源自一次晚餐時的聊天。

root.note: 誕生的過程 → 起源

mn: 聖經第一卷《創世記》就叫 Genesis。

senses.en: the quality of being friendly and cheerful

ex.en: The host's geniality made every guest feel welcome.
ex.zh: 主人的親切讓每位賓客都感到賓至如歸。

root.note: 精神愉快 → 親切

senses.en: relating to the reproductive organs

ex.en: The doctor explained the genital development of the fetus.
ex.zh: 醫師說明了胎兒生殖器官的發育情形。

root.note: 生育的

senses.en: (grammar) showing possession or origin
the genitive case

ex.en: In English, the genitive form of "cat" is "cat's."
ex.zh: 在英文中，cat 的所有格形式是 cat's。

root.note: 表示來源的 → 屬格

senses.en: polite, refined, or respectable, often in an affected way
senses.zh: 有教養的；（刻意）裝斯文的

ex.en: The hotel had a genteel atmosphere with afternoon tea and piano music.
ex.zh: 這間飯店有下午茶和鋼琴演奏，氣氛高雅。

root.note: 出身好的 → 有教養的

senses.en: a person who is not Jewish
not Jewish

ex.en: The historian studied relations between Jewish and gentile merchants.
ex.zh: 那位歷史學家研究猶太商人與非猶太商人之間的關係。

root.note: （其他）民族的 → 外邦人

senses.en: the science of the Earth's physical structure, rocks, and history
the geological features of an area

ex.en: She studied geology to learn how mountains are formed.
ex.zh: 她研讀地質學以了解山脈如何形成。

root.note: 研究地球的學問

senses.en: relevant to the subject being discussed

ex.en: Please keep your questions germane to today's topic.
ex.zh: 請讓你的問題和今天的主題相關。

parts.m: sprout, of the same parents 胚芽、同源

root.note: 同一個根長出來的 → 密切相關的

senses.en: (of a seed) to begin to grow
(of an idea) to begin to develop

ex.en: Keep the soil moist so the seeds will germinate.
ex.zh: 讓土壤保持濕潤，種子才會發芽。

root.note: 長出胚芽 → 發芽

senses.en: the period of development of a baby inside the mother
the development of an idea or plan

ex.en: An elephant's gestation period lasts almost two years.
ex.zh: 大象的懷孕期將近兩年。

root.note: 在體內攜帶 → 懷孕

senses.en: to use gestures, especially dramatically, while speaking

ex.en: Italians are said to gesticulate a lot when they talk.
ex.zh: 據說義大利人說話時很愛比手畫腳。

root.note: 做許多小動作 → 比手畫腳

senses.en: a movement of the hand or body to express meaning
an action that shows a feeling or intention

ex.en: Sending flowers was a kind gesture after her surgery.
ex.zh: 在她手術後送花是很體貼的舉動。

root.note: 動作 → 手勢

senses.en: causing great horror or fear
(informal) very bad or unpleasant
deathly pale

ex.en: The detectives arrived at the scene of a ghastly crime.
ex.zh: 探員們抵達了一起可怕罪行的現場。

senses.en: an insulting or mocking remark
to make mocking remarks

ex.en: He ignored every gibe about his old car.
ex.zh: 他對所有關於他那輛舊車的嘲諷都不予理會。

mn: gibe（嘲弄）也拼作 jibe，但 jibe 還有「一致」的意思。

senses.en: feeling dizzy
excitable and silly; lightheartedly happy

ex.en: The children were giddy with excitement on the last day of school.
ex.zh: 學期最後一天，孩子們興奮得不得了。

senses.en: extremely large

ex.en: A gigantic whale swam right beside our boat.
ex.zh: 一隻巨大的鯨魚就在我們的船旁游過。

root.note: 巨人般的 → 巨大的

senses.en: a person who gives something

ex.en: She is a generous giver to local charities.
ex.zh: 她經常慷慨捐款給當地的慈善機構。

root.note: 給予的人

senses.en: relating to ice or glaciers
extremely slow
cold and unfriendly

ex.en: Progress on the new subway line has been glacial.
ex.zh: 新地鐵線的工程進度極其緩慢。

root.note: 冰的；像冰河一樣慢的

senses.en: a large, slowly moving mass of ice

ex.en: The glacier has shrunk dramatically over the past century.
ex.zh: 這條冰河在過去一百年間大幅縮小。

root.note: 大塊的冰 → 冰河

senses.en: to make someone glad or happy

ex.en: News of her recovery will gladden everyone in the office.
ex.zh: 她康復的消息會讓辦公室裡每個人都很高興。

root.note: 使高興

senses.en: a person whose job is fitting glass into windows and doors

ex.en: We called a glazier to replace the broken window.
ex.zh: 我們請了一位玻璃工來更換破掉的窗戶。

root.note: 處理玻璃的人

senses.en: a faint or wavering light
a faint sign of something (e.g., hope)
to shine faintly

ex.en: The new treatment offers a glimmer of hope for patients.
ex.zh: 新療法為病人帶來了一線希望。

senses.en: a brief or partial view
to see briefly or partially

ex.en: Fans waited for hours to catch a glimpse of the star.
ex.zh: 粉絲們等了好幾個小時，只為看明星一眼。

senses.en: spherical or nearly spherical

ex.en: The plant produces small, globose fruits that turn red in autumn.
ex.zh: 這種植物會結出小小的球形果實，秋天轉為紅色。

root.note: 球狀的

senses.en: shaped like a globe or ball

ex.en: Astronomers photographed a globular cluster of ancient stars.
ex.zh: 天文學家拍下了一個由古老恆星組成的球狀星團。

root.note: 小球狀的

senses.en: having or deserving great fame or honor
very beautiful or delightful

ex.en: We had glorious weather for the whole trip.
ex.zh: 整趟旅程我們都遇到了極好的天氣。

root.note: 充滿榮耀的

senses.en: sticky, like glue

ex.en: Glutinous rice is used to make zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival.
ex.zh: 糯米被用來做端午節的粽子。

root.note: 像膠一樣的 → 黏的

mn: glutinous rice 就是糯米。

senses.en: excessively greedy, especially for food

ex.en: After a gluttonous holiday feast, we could barely move.
ex.zh: 節日大吃大喝一頓之後，我們幾乎動不了。

root.note: 貪吃者的

mn: 別和 glutinous（黏的）搞混。

senses.en: to grind one's teeth together, often in anger

ex.en: Losing fans will gnash their teeth over the referee's call.
ex.zh: 輸球的球迷會對裁判的判決咬牙切齒。

mn: 開頭的 g 不發音，唸作 [næʃ]。

senses.en: an extremely difficult problem, often solved only by bold action

ex.en: The new mayor promised to cut the Gordian knot of traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 新市長承諾要快刀斬亂麻解決塞車難題。

parts.m: Gordius 戈耳狄俄斯（傳說中的國王）

root.note: 亞歷山大大帝一劍砍斷戈耳狄俄斯之結 → 棘手難題

mn: cut the Gordian knot：快刀斬亂麻。

senses.en: a young goose

ex.en: A mother goose led her gosling across the road.
ex.zh: 一隻母鵝帶著牠的小鵝過馬路。

root.note: 小鵝

senses.en: a fine, filmy substance of cobwebs
very light, thin, and delicate

ex.en: The bride wore a veil of gossamer silk.
ex.zh: 新娘披著薄如蟬翼的絲質頭紗。

senses.en: a large fruit with a hard skin, often dried and used as a container

ex.en: The farmer carried water in a dried gourd.
ex.zh: 農夫用一個曬乾的葫蘆裝水。

senses.en: a person who enjoys eating, often too much

ex.en: The gourmand ordered three desserts after a five-course dinner.
ex.zh: 那個老饕吃完五道菜的晚餐後又點了三份甜點。

mn: gourmand 偏重「吃得多」，gourmet 偏重「懂得品味」。

senses.en: lacking elegance or charm; awkward
lacking good manners

ex.en: His graceless refusal embarrassed everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 他不得體的拒絕讓餐桌上的每個人都很尷尬。

root.note: 沒有優雅 → 笨拙的

senses.en: a gradual change through a series of stages
a stage or level in such a series

ex.en: The painting shows a soft gradation from blue to purple.
ex.zh: 這幅畫呈現從藍到紫的柔和漸層。

root.note: 一步一步的變化 → 漸變

senses.en: the degree of slope of a road or surface
a gradual change in a quantity or color

ex.en: The trail has a steep gradient near the summit.
ex.zh: 這條步道靠近山頂的地方坡度很陡。

root.note: 一階一階升高 → 坡度

senses.en: a building for storing grain
a region that produces a lot of grain

ex.en: The villagers stored their rice harvest in the granary.
ex.zh: 村民們把收成的稻米存放在穀倉裡。

root.note: 放穀粒的地方 → 穀倉

senses.en: splendor and impressiveness
high rank or importance

ex.en: Visitors are amazed by the grandeur of the Taroko Gorge.
ex.zh: 遊客都為太魯閣峽谷的壯麗景色驚嘆。

root.note: 偉大 → 壯麗

mn: delusions of grandeur：自大妄想。

senses.en: using pompous or overly elaborate language
senses.zh: 誇大其詞的；說話浮誇的

ex.en: The politician's grandiloquent speech promised everything but explained nothing.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物浮誇的演講承諾了一切，卻什麼也沒解釋。

root.note: 說大話的 → 浮誇的

senses.en: impressive or ambitious in scale, often excessively so
senses.zh: 宏大的；浮誇的；不切實際的

ex.en: His grandiose plans for a new stadium were never realistic.
ex.zh: 他興建新體育場的宏大計畫從來就不切實際。

root.note: 過於偉大的 → 浮誇的

senses.en: a person or organization that receives a grant

ex.en: Each grantee must submit a report on how the money was spent.
ex.zh: 每個受補助單位都必須提交經費使用報告。

root.note: 被給予的人 → 受讓人

senses.en: a person or organization that makes a grant or transfers property

ex.en: The grantor signed the deed to transfer the land.
ex.zh: 讓與人在契約上簽名，轉讓這塊土地。

root.note: 給予的人 → 授予人

senses.en: made of small grains or particles
very detailed

ex.en: The app gives granular data about how you spend your time.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式提供你時間分配的詳細資料。

root.note: 小顆粒的

senses.en: to form into grains or granules

ex.en: Factories granulate sugar by drying the syrup into tiny crystals.
ex.zh: 工廠把糖漿乾燥成細小晶體，製成砂糖顆粒。

root.note: 做成小顆粒

mn: granulated sugar 就是砂糖。

senses.en: a small grain or particle

ex.en: Stir the coffee until every granule dissolves.
ex.zh: 攪拌咖啡直到每一顆顆粒都溶解。

root.note: 小顆粒

senses.en: to struggle to deal with a difficult problem
to wrestle or fight at close quarters

ex.en: Many cities grapple with a shortage of affordable housing.
ex.zh: 許多城市都在努力應對平價住宅短缺的問題。

senses.en: pleasure, especially from satisfying a desire

ex.en: Social media offers instant gratification through likes and comments.
ex.zh: 社群媒體透過按讚和留言提供即時的滿足感。

root.note: 使人高興 → 滿足

mn: delayed gratification：延遲享樂。

senses.en: to give pleasure or satisfaction
