to indulge a desire

ex.en: It will gratify the coach to see her team play so well.
ex.zh: 看到隊伍表現這麼好，教練一定會很欣慰。

root.note: 使高興 → 使滿足

senses.en: done without good reason; unnecessary
given free of charge

ex.en: Critics complained about the film's gratuitous violence.
ex.zh: 影評人抱怨這部電影有太多不必要的暴力場面。

root.note: 免費給的 → 無端的、不必要的

senses.en: money given for service; a tip

ex.en: A 10% gratuity is added to the bill for large groups.
ex.zh: 大型團體的帳單會加收一成小費。

root.note: 出於好意的贈與 → 小費

senses.en: the force that attracts objects toward the Earth
extreme importance or seriousness

ex.en: The students did not understand the gravity of the situation.
ex.zh: 學生們不了解情況的嚴重性。

root.note: 重 → 重力；分量重 → 嚴重性

senses.en: fond of company; sociable
(of animals) living in groups

ex.en: Being gregarious, Maya made dozens of friends in her first week of college.
ex.zh: Maya 很愛交朋友，上大學第一週就交了好幾十個朋友。

root.note: 喜歡待在群體裡 → 愛交際的

senses.en: a soldier who threw grenades; a member of an elite infantry regiment

ex.en: Each grenadier in the old regiment wore a tall bearskin cap.
ex.zh: 那個老兵團的每名擲彈兵都戴著高高的熊皮帽。

root.note: 投手榴彈的人

senses.en: deep sorrow, especially after someone's death

ex.en: The whole town shared the family's grief.
ex.zh: 全鎮的人都和這家人一同悲痛。

root.note: 心情沉重 → 悲痛

senses.en: a real or imagined wrong that causes complaint

ex.en: Workers filed a grievance about unsafe conditions.
ex.zh: 工人們針對不安全的工作環境提出申訴。

root.note: 壓在心上的重擔 → 不滿

senses.en: very severe or serious
causing great sorrow

ex.en: Ignoring the warning was a grievous mistake.
ex.zh: 忽略這個警告是個嚴重的錯誤。

root.note: 沉重的 → 嚴重的

mn: 注意拼法和發音：grievous 只有兩個音節，不是 grievious。

senses.en: an ugly twisted facial expression showing pain or disgust
to twist the face in pain or disgust

ex.en: She made a grimace as she tasted the bitter medicine.
ex.zh: 她嚐到苦藥時皺起了臉。

mn: 也常唸作 [ˋgrɪməs]。

senses.en: a revolving stone used for sharpening or grinding

ex.en: If you want to pass, keep your nose to the grindstone.
ex.zh: 如果想及格，就要埋頭苦幹。

root.note: 磨東西的石頭

mn: keep one's nose to the grindstone：埋頭苦幹。

senses.en: causing horror or disgust
senses.zh: 恐怖的；令人毛骨悚然的

ex.en: Hikers made a grisly discovery in the woods.
ex.zh: 登山客在樹林裡有了一個令人毛骨悚然的發現。

mn: grisly（恐怖的）和 grizzly（灰熊）同音。

senses.en: comically or repulsively ugly or distorted
shockingly inappropriate

ex.en: The castle walls were decorated with grotesque stone faces.
ex.zh: 城堡的牆上裝飾著怪誕的石雕人臉。

root.note: 源自古羅馬洞穴中怪異的壁畫 → 怪誕的

senses.en: a small picturesque cave, especially an artificial one in a garden
senses.zh: 洞穴；（花園中的）人造岩洞

ex.en: The garden has a small grotto with a waterfall.
ex.zh: 花園裡有一個帶瀑布的小岩洞。

senses.en: the solid surface of the Earth
a reason or basis (often grounds)
to base something on; to forbid a child from going out

ex.en: The two sides finally found common ground on the issue.
ex.zh: 雙方終於在這個議題上找到共識。

mn: common ground：共同點、共識。

senses.en: to estimate or form an opinion without enough information
an estimate made without enough information

ex.en: If you don't know the answer, make an educated guess.
ex.zh: 如果你不知道答案，就做個有根據的推測。

senses.en: sly or cunning intelligence

ex.en: The fox in the fable uses guile to steal the crow's cheese.
ex.zh: 寓言裡的狐狸用詭計騙走了烏鴉的起司。

senses.en: innocent and without deception
senses.zh: 天真的；不狡詐的；坦率的

ex.en: The child's guileless smile won everyone over.
ex.zh: 孩子天真無邪的笑容贏得了所有人的心。

root.note: 沒有狡詐的 → 天真的

senses.en: a former British gold coin worth 21 shillings

ex.en: In 1790, the portrait was sold for a single guinea at a country fair.
ex.zh: 1790 年，這幅肖像在鄉間市集上只賣了一基尼。

mn: guinea pig（天竺鼠；實驗品）也用這個字。

senses.en: an outward appearance or form, often hiding the truth

ex.en: The scammer called under the guise of a bank employee.
ex.zh: 詐騙犯假冒銀行職員打電話來。

mn: 常用片語 under the guise of（以…為幌子）。

senses.en: easily persuaded to believe something; easily fooled

ex.en: Scammers often target gullible people with fake prizes.
ex.zh: 詐騙集團常用假獎品鎖定容易上當的人。

root.note: 容易被騙的

senses.en: shrewd initiative and resourcefulness; courage

ex.en: It took real gumption to start her own company at nineteen.
ex.zh: 十九歲就自己創業，需要真正的膽量。

senses.en: enjoyment and enthusiasm in doing something

ex.en: The kids ate their dumplings with great gusto.
ex.zh: 孩子們津津有味地吃著水餃。

root.note: 品嚐的樂趣 → 熱忱

senses.en: (informal) a man
a rope or wire used to steady a tent or pole

ex.en: The guy at the front desk gave us directions to the station.
ex.zh: 櫃檯的那位先生告訴我們去車站怎麼走。

senses.en: to eat or drink greedily
(of a vehicle) to use a lot of fuel

ex.en: Old trucks guzzle gas compared to modern hybrid cars.
ex.zh: 和現代油電混合車相比，老卡車非常耗油。

mn: gas-guzzler：耗油的車。

senses.en: government or rule by women

ex.en: The novel imagines a distant island ruled as a gynecocracy.
ex.zh: 這部小說想像了一個由女性統治的遙遠島嶼。

root.note: 女性統治

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with women's reproductive health

ex.en: She specialized in gynecology after medical school.
ex.zh: 她從醫學院畢業後專攻婦科。

root.note: 研究女性（身體）的學問 → 婦科

senses.en: to move rapidly in a circle or spiral
to dance in a wild or suggestive way

ex.en: The dancers began to gyrate to the rhythm of the drums.
ex.zh: 舞者們開始隨著鼓的節奏扭動身體。

root.note: 繞圈 → 旋轉

senses.en: a spinning wheel device used to keep balance or measure direction

ex.en: Your phone uses a tiny gyroscope to detect how you tilt it.
ex.zh: 手機用一個微小的陀螺儀偵測你怎麼傾斜它。

root.note: 觀察旋轉的儀器 → 陀螺儀

senses.en: suitable or good enough to live in

ex.en: Scientists are searching for habitable planets beyond our solar system.
ex.zh: 科學家正在太陽系外尋找適合居住的行星。

root.note: 能夠居住的

mn: inhabitable 也是「可居住的」，不是反義字。

senses.en: an inhabitant; (in Canada) a French-Canadian farmer
senses.zh: 居民；（加拿大的）法裔農民

ex.en: Each habitant of the valley farmed a narrow strip of land.
ex.zh: 山谷裡的每位居民都耕種一塊狹長的土地。

root.note: 居住的人 → 居民

senses.en: done constantly or as a habit

ex.en: Nobody believes a habitual liar.
ex.zh: 沒有人會相信一個習慣性說謊的人。

root.note: 習慣的

senses.en: a customary way of behaving; habit

ex.en: Rising at dawn had become a habitude he could not break.
ex.zh: 黎明即起已成為他改不掉的習性。

root.note: 習慣的狀態 → 習性

senses.en: a horse or carriage for hire
hired; (figuratively) overused

ex.en: Victorian travelers hired a hackney carriage at the station.
ex.zh: 維多利亞時代的旅客在車站僱一輛出租馬車。

mn: 形容詞 hackneyed（陳腐的）更常見。

senses.en: looking exhausted and unwell, especially from worry or lack of sleep

ex.en: After a week of night shifts, the nurse looked haggard.
ex.zh: 連續上了一週的夜班後，那位護理師看起來很憔悴。

senses.en: (of a past time) idyllically happy and peaceful
a mythical bird said to calm the sea; a kingfisher

ex.en: She often talks about the halcyon days of her childhood in the countryside.
ex.zh: 她常談起在鄉下度過的那段無憂無慮的童年時光。

mn: halcyon days：太平日子、美好時光。

senses.en: (especially of an old person) strong and healthy

ex.en: At ninety, my great-uncle is still hale and hearty.
ex.zh: 我的伯公九十歲了，仍然老當益壯。

mn: hale and hearty：健壯硬朗。

senses.en: writing done with a pen or pencil; a person's style of writing

ex.en: The teacher could not read his messy handwriting.
ex.zh: 老師看不懂他潦草的字跡。

root.note: 用手寫的字

senses.en: a person who follows another in hope of personal gain

ex.en: Every celebrity has at least one hanger-on hoping for free trips.
ex.zh: 每個名人身邊至少都有一個想蹭免費旅遊的跟班。

mn: 複數是 hangers-on。

senses.en: cheerful and not worried about the future
senses.zh: 無憂無慮的；隨遇而安的

ex.en: My happy-go-lucky brother never plans more than a day ahead.
ex.zh: 我那個無憂無慮的弟弟從不會提前計畫超過一天的事。

senses.en: a long, aggressive, or critical speech
senses.zh: 長篇大論的斥責；激烈演說

senses.en: to lecture someone at length in an aggressive way

ex.en: The coach delivered a harangue after the team's sloppy performance.
ex.zh: 球隊表現散漫後，教練發表了一番長篇訓斥。

senses.en: to repeatedly annoy, pressure, or intimidate someone

ex.en: It is illegal to harass people online.
ex.zh: 在網路上騷擾他人是違法的。

mn: 美式也常唸作 [həˋræs]。

senses.en: a person or thing that signals the approach of something

ex.en: The first swallow is a harbinger of spring.
ex.zh: 第一隻燕子是春天到來的預兆。

senses.en: lacking sympathy or kindness

ex.en: Only a hard-hearted person could ignore the crying child.
ex.zh: 只有鐵石心腸的人才會對那個哭泣的孩子視而不見。

senses.en: boldness or daring; sometimes impudence

ex.en: He had the hardihood to argue with the general in front of the troops.
ex.zh: 他竟然有膽在部隊面前和將軍爭論。

root.note: 勇敢的性質 → 大膽

senses.en: friendly and peaceful; free from conflict
pleasantly combined; tuneful

ex.en: The neighbors have kept a harmonious relationship for decades.
ex.zh: 這些鄰居幾十年來一直相處融洽。

root.note: 協調的 → 和諧的

senses.en: widespread destruction or great confusion

ex.en: The typhoon caused havoc across southern Taiwan.
ex.zh: 颱風在南台灣造成嚴重破壞。

mn: 常見片語 wreak havoc（造成嚴重破壞）。

senses.en: a thorny shrub or tree with white or pink flowers and small red berries

ex.en: A hawthorn hedge separated the two fields.
ex.zh: 一排山楂樹籬把兩塊田隔開。

root.note: 長刺的樹籬植物 → 山楂

senses.en: a danger or risk
to venture a guess or suggestion

ex.en: Wet floors are a common hazard in restaurant kitchens.
ex.zh: 濕滑的地板是餐廳廚房常見的危險。

mn: hazard a guess：冒昧猜測。

senses.en: with the head in front
without careful thought; rashly

ex.en: She dove headfirst into the cold lake.
ex.zh: 她頭朝下跳進冰冷的湖裡。

root.note: 頭先進去 → 頭朝前；引申為貿然

senses.en: with the head in front; headfirst

ex.en: The boy tripped and fell headforemost into the snowbank.
ex.zh: 男孩絆了一跤，頭朝前栽進雪堆裡。

root.note: 頭在最前面 → 頭朝前

senses.en: causing great sadness or distress

ex.en: The documentary tells the heartrending story of a family separated by war.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片講述一個因戰爭而分離的家庭令人心碎的故事。

root.note: 把心撕裂的 → 令人心碎的

senses.en: (dated, often offensive) like a heathen; uncivilized or irreligious

ex.en: Early missionaries wrongly described local festivals as heathenish customs.
ex.zh: 早期傳教士錯誤地將當地節慶描述為異教的風俗。

root.note: 像異教徒的

senses.en: showing a reckless lack of care or attention
senses.zh: 不注意的；漫不經心的；不顧的

ex.en: Heedless of the warning signs, the hikers left the trail.
ex.zh: 登山客不顧警告標誌，偏離了步道。

root.note: 沒有注意的

senses.en: a young cow that has not had a calf

ex.en: The farmer won a prize for his healthy young heifer.
ex.zh: 農夫養的健康小母牛得了獎。

senses.en: (of a crime or act) utterly evil or wicked

ex.en: The court called the attack a heinous crime.
ex.zh: 法院稱這次攻擊是十惡不赦的罪行。

senses.en: heavy bleeding from a broken blood vessel
to lose something (e.g., money) rapidly

ex.en: The patient suffered a brain hemorrhage and needed surgery.
ex.zh: 病人腦出血，必須動手術。

root.note: 血湧出來 → 出血

senses.en: swollen veins around the anus

ex.en: Sitting for long hours can make hemorrhoids worse.
ex.zh: 久坐可能會讓痔瘡惡化。

root.note: 會流血的 → 痔瘡

senses.en: a loyal follower who does unpleasant or criminal tasks for a leader

ex.en: The villain sent a henchman to steal the documents.
ex.zh: 反派派了一名手下去偷文件。

senses.en: (of a wife) to constantly nag and criticize one's husband

ex.en: In the old sitcom, the wife would henpeck her husband about every chore.
ex.zh: 在那部老情境喜劇裡，妻子為每件家事對丈夫嘮叨不停。

root.note: 像母雞啄公雞 → 對丈夫嘮叨

mn: henpecked husband：怕老婆的丈夫。

senses.en: a flat shape with seven straight sides

ex.en: The coin is shaped like a heptagon with curved edges.
ex.zh: 這枚硬幣的形狀像一個邊緣呈弧形的七邊形。

root.note: 七個角 → 七邊形

senses.en: government by seven rulers; the seven Anglo-Saxon kingdoms of early England
senses.zh: 七頭政治；（英國史）七國時代

ex.en: Historians use the term heptarchy for the seven early English kingdoms.
ex.zh: 歷史學家用「七國時代」一詞稱呼早期英格蘭的七個王國。

root.note: 七個統治者 → 七國時代

senses.en: (of a plant) having soft, non-woody stems

ex.en: Mint is a herbaceous plant that spreads quickly.
ex.zh: 薄荷是一種蔓延很快的草本植物。

root.note: 屬於草的 → 草本的

senses.en: a collection of dried plants organized for study
senses.zh: 植物標本館；植物標本集

ex.en: The university herbarium holds over a million plant specimens.
ex.zh: 這所大學的植物標本館收藏了超過一百萬件標本。

root.note: 放植物的地方 → 標本館

senses.en: feeding on plants

ex.en: Giraffes are herbivorous animals that eat leaves from tall trees.
ex.zh: 長頸鹿是吃高樹上葉子的草食性動物。

root.note: 吃草的

senses.en: passed from parent to child genetically
(of a title or position) passed down by inheritance

ex.en: Some forms of heart disease are hereditary.
ex.zh: 某些類型的心臟病是遺傳的。

root.note: 傳給繼承人的 → 遺傳的、世襲的

senses.en: the passing of traits from parents to offspring through genes

ex.en: Both heredity and environment shape a child's personality.
ex.zh: 遺傳和環境都會塑造孩子的個性。

root.note: 傳給繼承人 → 遺傳

senses.en: a belief contrary to official religious doctrine
an opinion strongly opposed to what is generally accepted

ex.en: In this town, saying you dislike baseball is almost heresy.
ex.zh: 在這個小鎮，說自己不喜歡棒球幾乎是大逆不道。

root.note: 自己選擇的（非正統）信仰 → 異端

senses.en: a person who holds beliefs opposed to official doctrine

ex.en: In the Middle Ages, a heretic could be burned at the stake.
ex.zh: 在中世紀，異端者可能會被處以火刑。

root.note: 做出（非正統）選擇的人

senses.en: traditions, buildings, or culture passed down from earlier generations

ex.en: The old temple is an important part of the town's cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 這座古廟是小鎮文化資產的重要部分。

root.note: 繼承下來的東西 → 遺產

senses.en: a condition in which an organ pushes through the muscle wall around it

ex.en: Lifting heavy boxes the wrong way can cause a hernia.
ex.zh: 用錯誤的方式搬重箱子可能會造成疝氣。

senses.en: the quality of being unwilling or slow to act or decide

ex.en: Vaccine hesitancy made the health campaign more difficult.
ex.zh: 對疫苗的猶豫態度讓衛教宣導更加困難。

root.note: 黏住走不動 → 猶豫

senses.en: slow to act or speak because of uncertainty

ex.en: She was hesitant to raise her hand in the large class.
ex.zh: 在大班級裡，她很猶豫要不要舉手。

root.note: 黏住走不動的 → 猶豫的

senses.en: a pause before saying or doing something

ex.en: He accepted the job offer without hesitation.
ex.zh: 他毫不猶豫地接受了這份工作。

root.note: 黏住走不動 → 猶豫

senses.en: not following accepted or orthodox beliefs

ex.en: The economist was known for her heterodox views on taxes.
ex.zh: 那位經濟學家以對稅制的非主流觀點聞名。

root.note: 不同的意見 → 非正統的

senses.en: the quality of being diverse or made of different parts

ex.en: The heterogeneity of the class made teaching both harder and richer.
ex.zh: 班上學生的多樣性讓教學更困難，也更豐富。

root.note: 種類不同 → 異質性

senses.en: made up of different or varied parts
senses.zh: 由不同成分組成的；異質的；多樣的

ex.en: Taiwan has a heterogeneous population with many cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 台灣的人口組成多元，具有許多不同的文化背景。

root.note: 種類不同的 → 異質的

senses.en: (biology) having different forms at different life stages or in different individuals

ex.en: Insects with heteromorphic life cycles look completely different as larvae and adults.
ex.zh: 具有異形生活史的昆蟲，幼蟲和成蟲的樣子完全不同。

root.note: 形態不同的

senses.en: a flat shape with six straight sides

ex.en: Each cell in a honeycomb is a hexagon.
ex.zh: 蜂巢的每個小格都是六邊形。

root.note: 六個角 → 六邊形

senses.en: having six angles

ex.en: The hexangular tiles fit together without any gaps.
ex.zh: 這些六角形磁磚拼在一起毫無縫隙。

root.note: 有六個角的

senses.en: an animal with six legs; an insect
having six legs

ex.en: The engineers built a hexapod robot that walks like an ant.
ex.zh: 工程師打造了一台像螞蟻一樣行走的六足機器人。

root.note: 六隻腳

senses.en: a pause or break in activity
a gap or opening

ex.en: The band returned after a five-year hiatus.
ex.zh: 這個樂團在暫停活動五年後復出。

root.note: 張開的缺口 → 中斷

senses.en: relating to winter

ex.en: The hibernal months bring heavy snow to the mountains.
ex.zh: 冬季月份為山區帶來大雪。

root.note: 冬天的

mn: hibernate（冬眠）同字根。

senses.en: (literary) relating to Ireland
(literary) an Irish person

ex.en: The poet praised the green Hibernian hills of his youth.
ex.zh: 詩人讚頌他年少時愛爾蘭的青翠山丘。

root.note: 愛爾蘭的

senses.en: extremely ugly or unpleasant

ex.en: My aunt gave me a hideous sweater for my birthday.
ex.zh: 阿姨送我一件醜死了的毛衣當生日禮物。

senses.en: extremely funny

ex.en: The movie was so hilarious that we laughed until we cried.
ex.zh: 這部電影太好笑了，我們笑到流眼淚。

root.note: 非常快樂的 → 爆笑的

senses.en: a small hill or mound

ex.en: We had our picnic on a grassy hillock by the river.
ex.zh: 我們在河邊一座長滿草的小山丘上野餐。

root.note: 小山丘

senses.en: to make it difficult for something to happen or progress

ex.en: Heavy rain may hinder the rescue efforts.
ex.zh: 大雨可能會阻礙救援行動。

senses.en: farthest behind; last

ex.en: The hindmost runner was still smiling at the finish line.
ex.zh: 跑在最後面的選手抵達終點時仍面帶微笑。

root.note: 最後面的

mn: every man for himself, and the devil take the hindmost：人不為己，天誅地滅。

senses.en: a thing that makes progress difficult

ex.en: His lack of experience was a hindrance at first.
ex.zh: 一開始，他缺乏經驗是一大障礙。

root.note: 阻礙

senses.en: hairy

ex.en: The hirsute actor had to shave his beard for the role.
ex.zh: 那位毛髮濃密的演員為了這個角色必須剃掉鬍子。

senses.en: to collect and hide a large amount of something
a secret store of money or valuables

ex.en: People began to hoard toilet paper before the lockdown.
ex.zh: 封城前，人們開始囤積衛生紙。

mn: hoard（囤積）與 horde（一大群）同音。

senses.en: (of a voice) rough and harsh

ex.en: After cheering all game, my voice was hoarse.
ex.zh: 整場比賽都在加油，我的聲音都啞了。

mn: hoarse（沙啞的）與 horse（馬）同音。

senses.en: special honor or respect shown publicly

ex.en: The film pays homage to the classic movies of the 1950s.
ex.zh: 這部電影向 1950 年代的經典電影致敬。

root.note: 成為（領主的）人、宣誓效忠 → 敬意

mn: 常見片語 pay homage to（向…致敬）。

senses.en: the quality of being all the same or similar

ex.en: The homogeneity of the town's shops made every street look the same.
ex.zh: 鎮上店家的同質性讓每條街看起來都一樣。

root.note: 種類相同 → 同質性

senses.en: of the same kind; uniform throughout

ex.en: Stir the paint until it becomes a homogeneous mixture.
ex.zh: 把油漆攪拌到均勻為止。

root.note: 種類相同的 → 同質的

senses.en: having the same relation, position, or structure; (biology) sharing a common evolutionary origin

ex.en: A bat's wing and a human arm are homologous structures.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠的翅膀和人類的手臂是同源構造。

root.note: 關係相同的 → 同源的

senses.en: a word that sounds or is spelled the same as another but has a different meaning

ex.en: "Bat" is a homonym because it can mean an animal or a piece of sports equipment.
ex.zh: bat 是同形異義字，可以指動物或球棒。

root.note: 名字相同 → 同名異義字

senses.en: a word that sounds the same as another but differs in meaning or spelling

ex.en: "Flour" is a homophone of "flower."
ex.zh: flour（麵粉）和 flower（花）是同音字。

root.note: 聲音相同 → 同音字

senses.en: a payment given for professional services that are traditionally done without charge
senses.zh: 酬金；謝禮（演講、審稿等的酬勞）

ex.en: The guest speaker received a modest honorarium for her lecture.
ex.zh: 那位客座講者因為演講拿到一筆不多的酬金。

root.note: 表示敬意而給的錢 → 酬金

senses.en: to deceive or trick someone

ex.en: The scammers tried to hoodwink elderly residents into buying fake insurance.
ex.zh: 詐騙集團想矇騙年長居民購買假保險。

root.note: 用頭罩蒙住眼睛 → 矇騙

mn: hood（頭罩）+ wink（眨眼）：把人眼睛蒙起來，就是矇騙。

senses.en: a large crowd of people or animals

ex.en: A horde of fans rushed toward the stage when the band appeared.
ex.zh: 樂團一出現，一大群歌迷就衝向舞台。

mn: 和 hoard（囤積）同音，注意拼法不同。

senses.en: socks, stockings, and tights as a group

ex.en: The department store keeps its hosiery near the shoe section.
ex.zh: 這家百貨公司把襪類商品擺在鞋區旁邊。

root.note: 各種長襪 → 襪類

senses.en: friendly and welcoming to guests or strangers
(of an environment) pleasant and favorable for living

ex.en: Our hosts were so hospitable that we felt at home immediately.
ex.zh: 主人非常好客，我們馬上就覺得像在家一樣。

root.note: 善待客人的 → 好客的

senses.en: the friendly and generous treatment of guests

ex.en: We thanked the villagers for their warm hospitality.
ex.zh: 我們感謝村民們熱情的款待。

root.note: 善待客人的態度 → 款待

senses.en: unfriendly or aggressive behavior; opposition
(hostilities) acts of warfare

ex.en: The new manager faced open hostility from the staff.
ex.zh: 新經理面對員工公開的敵意。

root.note: 把人當敵人 → 敵意

senses.en: a person who sells things aggressively or dishonestly

ex.en: A huckster at the fair promised his tonic would cure any illness.
ex.zh: 市集上一個小販保證他的補藥能治百病。

senses.en: showing kindness and compassion, especially by avoiding causing pain

ex.en: The shelter uses humane methods to care for stray animals.
ex.zh: 這間收容所用人道的方式照顧流浪動物。

root.note: 有人性的 → 人道的

mn: human（人類的）多一個 e 就變成 humane（人道的），重音也移到後面。

senses.en: concerned with improving people's welfare and reducing suffering
senses.zh: 人道主義的；人道救援的

senses.en: a person who works to improve the lives of others

ex.en: The earthquake created an urgent humanitarian crisis.
ex.zh: 這場地震造成了緊急的人道危機。

root.note: 主張照顧人類福祉 → 人道主義的

senses.en: to make more humane, personal, or relatable
senses.zh: 使人性化；使更有人情味

ex.en: Personal stories can humanize the statistics in a news report.
ex.zh: 個人故事能讓新聞報導中的統計數字更有人味。

root.note: 使有人性 → 人性化

senses.en: deceptive or false talk or behavior; nonsense
a hypocrite or impostor

ex.en: He dismissed the fortune teller's predictions as pure humbug.
ex.zh: 他認為算命師的預言全是胡扯。

mn: 狄更斯《小氣財神》裡 Scrooge 的口頭禪「Bah, humbug!」（胡扯！）。

senses.en: to make someone feel ashamed and foolish

ex.en: A good coach will never humiliate a player in front of the team.
ex.zh: 好教練絕不會在全隊面前羞辱球員。

root.note: 把人壓低 → 羞辱

senses.en: a soldier in a light cavalry regiment, especially in historic European armies

ex.en: The painting shows a hussar in a bright uniform riding into battle.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪一名身穿鮮豔制服的輕騎兵騎馬衝入戰場。

senses.en: to push or move someone roughly and hurriedly
busy, energetic activity
to obtain something by forceful or dishonest means

ex.en: Security guards had to hustle the singer through the crowd.
ex.zh: 保全人員得催著歌手快步穿過人群。

mn: 常見片語 hustle and bustle：熙熙攘攘、忙碌喧囂。

senses.en: something made by combining two different elements, such as a plant or animal from two species
made by combining two different elements
senses.zh: 混合的；混種的；油電混合的

ex.en: She traded her old car for a hybrid that uses much less gas.
ex.zh: 她把舊車換成一輛省很多油的油電混合車。

senses.en: a problem that keeps returning or growing despite efforts to solve it
(Greek myth) a many-headed serpent that grew two heads for each one cut off

ex.en: Corruption in the city was a hydra that no mayor could defeat.
ex.zh: 市政的貪腐像九頭蛇一樣，沒有一位市長能根除。

root.note: 住在水澤中的蛇怪 → 九頭蛇

senses.en: operated by the pressure of a liquid moving through pipes

ex.en: The mechanic used a hydraulic lift to raise the car.
ex.zh: 技師用液壓升降機把車子抬起來。

root.note: 水在管子中流動 → 液壓的

senses.en: the branch of physics that studies liquids in motion

ex.en: Engineers study hydrodynamics to design faster and safer ships.
ex.zh: 工程師研究流體動力學來設計更快、更安全的船。

root.note: 研究水的動力的學科 → 流體動力學

senses.en: producing electricity using the power of flowing water

ex.en: The hydroelectric dam supplies power to the entire valley.
ex.zh: 這座水力發電水壩為整個山谷供電。

root.note: 用水產生電的 → 水力發電的

senses.en: the study of the mechanics of fluids, both at rest and in motion

ex.en: A course in hydromechanics is required for civil engineering students.
ex.zh: 土木工程系的學生必須修流體力學。

root.note: 研究水（流體）力學的學科

senses.en: an instrument for measuring the density of liquids

ex.en: The brewer used a hydrometer to check the sugar content of the beer.
ex.zh: 釀酒師用比重計檢查啤酒的含糖量。

root.note: 測量液體的儀器 → 比重計

senses.en: the branch of physics that studies liquids at rest and the pressure they exert

ex.en: The principles of hydrostatics explain why a heavy ship can float.
ex.zh: 流體靜力學的原理解釋了為什麼沉重的船能浮起來。

root.note: 研究靜止的水的學科 → 流體靜力學

senses.en: (chemistry) containing water

ex.en: Gypsum is a hydrous mineral that loses water when heated.
ex.zh: 石膏是一種含水礦物，加熱時會失去水分。

root.note: 含有水的

senses.en: practices that keep people and places clean to prevent disease

ex.en: Good hand hygiene is the simplest way to stop the spread of germs.
ex.zh: 良好的手部衛生是阻止病菌傳播最簡單的方法。

parts.m: healthy 健康（希臘女神 Hygieia）

root.note: 來自健康女神之名 → 衛生

senses.en: too critical, especially of small faults
senses.zh: 吹毛求疵的；過於挑剔的

ex.en: His hypercritical boss found something wrong with every report.
ex.zh: 他那吹毛求疵的上司每份報告都能挑出毛病。

root.note: 過度批評的 → 吹毛求疵的

senses.en: a sleeplike state in which a person responds readily to suggestions

ex.en: Some people use hypnosis to help them quit smoking.
ex.zh: 有些人藉助催眠來戒菸。

root.note: 類似睡眠的狀態 → 催眠

senses.en: holding one's attention as if by hypnosis; mesmerizing
relating to or causing hypnosis or sleep

ex.en: The steady rhythm of the waves had a hypnotic effect on us.
ex.zh: 海浪穩定的節奏讓我們像被催眠了一樣。

root.note: 使人入睡般的 → 催眠的

senses.en: the practice of putting people into hypnosis

ex.en: The magician claimed to use hypnotism to control volunteers on stage.
ex.zh: 魔術師聲稱用催眠術控制台上的志願者。

root.note: 使人入睡般的技術 → 催眠術

senses.en: to put someone into a state of hypnosis
to capture someone's full attention

ex.en: The dancer's graceful movements seemed to hypnotize the audience.
ex.zh: 舞者優雅的動作彷彿讓觀眾都著迷了。

root.note: 使進入似睡狀態 → 催眠

senses.en: pretending to have beliefs or virtues that one does not actually have

ex.en: Voters were angered by the hypocrisy of officials who broke their own rules.
ex.zh: 官員違反自己訂的規定，這種虛偽讓選民很憤怒。

parts.m: judge, act a part 判斷、演戲

root.note: 希臘文原指「演員演戲」→ 裝出來的樣子 → 偽善

senses.en: a person who pretends to have beliefs or virtues that they do not have

ex.en: He felt like a hypocrite for lecturing his kids about junk food.
ex.zh: 他一邊吃零食一邊教訓孩子別吃垃圾食物，覺得自己像個偽君子。

parts.m: judge, act a part 判斷、演戲

root.note: 希臘文原指「演員」→ 裝模作樣的人 → 偽君子

senses.en: relating to the area under the skin; used for injecting under the skin
a hypodermic needle or syringe

ex.en: The nurse carefully disposed of the used hypodermic needle.
ex.zh: 護理師小心地處理用過的皮下注射針頭。

root.note: 皮膚之下的 → 皮下的

senses.en: the longest side of a right triangle, opposite the right angle

ex.en: Use the Pythagorean theorem to find the length of the hypotenuse.
ex.zh: 用畢氏定理求出斜邊的長度。

root.note: 在直角下方伸展開的邊 → 斜邊

senses.en: a proposed explanation that can be tested by further investigation

ex.en: The students designed an experiment to test their hypothesis.
ex.zh: 學生們設計實驗來驗證他們的假說。

root.note: 放在論證底下作為基礎 → 假說

senses.en: extreme, uncontrollable emotion or excitement, often shared by a group
senses.zh: 歇斯底里；（群眾的）狂熱恐慌

ex.en: Rumors of a shortage led to mass hysteria at the supermarket.
ex.zh: 缺貨的謠言在超市引發群眾恐慌。

senses.en: relating to fish

ex.en: The fossil showed clear ichthyic features such as fins and gills.
ex.zh: 這塊化石顯示出鰭和鰓等明顯的魚類特徵。

root.note: 魚的

senses.en: the scientific study of fish

ex.en: Her love of aquariums led her to study ichthyology in college.
ex.zh: 她對水族箱的熱愛讓她在大學主修魚類學。

root.note: 研究魚的學問 → 魚類學

senses.en: (plural) extinct marine reptiles with fish-like bodies that lived in the age of dinosaurs
senses.zh: 魚龍（已滅絕的海生爬蟲類，複數）

ex.en: Ichthyosaurs swam in ancient seas long before whales existed.
ex.zh: 魚龍早在鯨魚出現之前就在遠古海洋中游動。

root.note: 像魚的蜥蜴 → 魚龍

senses.en: in a very cold and unfriendly way

ex.en: "I have nothing to say to you," she replied icily.
ex.zh: 「我沒什麼話好跟你說。」她冷冰冰地回答。

root.note: 像冰一樣地 → 冷冰冰地

senses.en: the state of being icy; extreme coldness or unfriendliness

ex.en: The iciness in his voice told me he was still angry.
ex.zh: 他語氣中的冰冷讓我知道他還在生氣。

root.note: 像冰一樣的狀態 → 冰冷

senses.en: a person or thing regarded as a symbol of something
senses.zh: 偶像；代表性人物或事物

senses.en: a small picture on a screen that represents a program or function
a religious painting, especially in Eastern Christianity

ex.en: The Eiffel Tower has become an icon of Paris.
ex.zh: 艾菲爾鐵塔已成為巴黎的象徵。

senses.en: a person who attacks cherished beliefs or traditional institutions
senses.zh: 打破傳統的人；反傳統者

ex.en: A true iconoclast, the young architect ignored every traditional design rule.
ex.zh: 這位年輕建築師是真正的反傳統者，完全不理會傳統設計規則。

root.note: 打破聖像的人 → 挑戰傳統的人

senses.en: to regard or represent something as better than it really is

ex.en: It is easy to idealize the past and forget its hardships.
ex.zh: 人很容易把過去理想化，而忘了當時的艱辛。

root.note: 使成為理想的 → 理想化

senses.en: a group of words whose meaning differs from the meanings of the individual words
a characteristic style of a language, artist, or period

ex.en: "Break a leg" is an idiom that means "good luck."
ex.zh: 「Break a leg」是個慣用語，意思是「祝好運」。

parts.m: one's own, peculiar 自己的、特有的

root.note: 某語言特有的說法 → 慣用語

senses.en: a peculiar habit or way of behaving that is typical of one person

ex.en: One idiosyncrasy of my uncle is that he eats dessert before dinner.
ex.zh: 我叔叔有個怪癖，就是晚餐前先吃甜點。

root.note: 個人特有的性情組合 → 怪癖

senses.en: to admire or love someone greatly or excessively

ex.en: Many young players idolize the team's star striker.
ex.zh: 許多年輕球員把隊上的明星前鋒當偶像崇拜。

root.note: 當成偶像 → 崇拜

senses.en: not honorable in character or purpose; shameful
of humble birth

ex.en: Winning by cheating is an ignoble victory.
ex.zh: 靠作弊贏來的是不光彩的勝利。

root.note: 不高貴的 → 卑鄙的

senses.en: causing public shame or embarrassment

ex.en: The champion suffered an ignominious defeat in the first round.
ex.zh: 衛冕者在第一輪就吞下丟臉的敗仗。

root.note: 失去好名聲的 → 可恥的

senses.en: the ancient Greek epic poem attributed to Homer about the Trojan War
(iliad) a long series of disasters or a long story
senses.zh: 一連串的災難；長篇故事

ex.en: The Iliad describes the anger of Achilles during the siege of Troy.
ex.zh: 《伊利亞德》描寫阿基里斯在特洛伊圍城期間的憤怒。

root.note: 關於特洛伊城的史詩

senses.en: bad-tempered and unkind

ex.en: The ill-natured neighbor yelled at children who stepped on his lawn.
ex.zh: 那個壞脾氣的鄰居會對踩到他草坪的小孩大吼。

root.note: 天性不好的 → 脾氣壞的

senses.en: not allowed by law

ex.en: It is illegal to drive without a valid license.
ex.zh: 無照駕駛是違法的。

root.note: 不合法的

senses.en: impossible or very hard to read

ex.en: The doctor's handwriting was so illegible that the pharmacist called to check.
ex.zh: 醫生的字跡潦草到藥師得打電話確認。

root.note: 無法讀的 → 難以辨認的

senses.en: not allowed by law or rules; not valid
(of a child) born to parents not married to each other

ex.en: The opposition called the rushed election illegitimate.
ex.zh: 反對黨稱這場倉促舉行的選舉不具正當性。

root.note: 不合法的 → 不正當的

senses.en: opposed to free thought or individual rights; intolerant
senses.zh: 偏狹的；不自由的；壓制言論的

senses.en: (old use) stingy; ungenerous

ex.en: Critics warned that the illiberal law would silence journalists.
ex.zh: 批評者警告，這項壓制自由的法律會讓記者噤聲。

root.note: 不自由的 → 偏狹的

senses.en: forbidden by law, rules, or custom

ex.en: Police seized a large shipment of illicit drugs at the port.
ex.zh: 警方在港口查獲一大批非法毒品。

root.note: 不被允許的 → 非法的

mn: 別和 elicit（引出）搞混：兩字發音幾乎一樣。

senses.en: without limits; boundless

ex.en: Standing on the shore, she gazed at the illimitable ocean.
ex.zh: 她站在岸邊，凝望著無邊無際的大海。

root.note: 無法限制的 → 無限的

senses.en: unable to read or write
lacking knowledge in a particular field

ex.en: Volunteers teach illiterate adults to read at the community center.
ex.zh: 志工在社區中心教不識字的成人讀書。

root.note: 不懂文字的 → 文盲的

senses.en: lacking sense or clear, sound reasoning

ex.en: It seems illogical to buy an umbrella after the rain has stopped.
ex.zh: 雨都停了才買雨傘，似乎不太合理。

root.note: 不合道理的

senses.en: something that gives off light
giving off light

ex.en: Before electricity, whale oil was a common illuminant in homes.
ex.zh: 在有電之前，鯨油是家庭常用的照明燃料。

root.note: 照亮的東西 → 光源

senses.en: to light up
to help clarify or explain

ex.en: Her research helps illuminate how memory works in the brain.
ex.zh: 她的研究有助於闡明大腦中記憶如何運作。

root.note: 把光照在上面 → 照亮；闡明

senses.en: (literary) to light up or enlighten

ex.en: The poet prayed for wisdom to illumine his troubled mind.
ex.zh: 詩人祈求智慧來啟迪他困惑的心靈。

root.note: 把光照在上面 → 照亮

senses.en: a false idea or belief
something that appears different from what it really is

ex.en: Large mirrors create the illusion of a bigger room.
ex.zh: 大鏡子能營造房間比較大的錯覺。

root.note: 被玩弄的感官 → 錯覺

senses.en: deceptive; based on illusion

ex.en: The promise of quick riches proved to be illusive.
ex.zh: 一夕致富的承諾結果只是虛幻的。

root.note: 玩弄感官的 → 虛幻的

mn: 別和 elusive（難以捉摸的）搞混。

senses.en: based on illusion; not real

ex.en: The sense of safety behind the old wall was illusory.
ex.zh: 躲在舊牆後面的安全感只是一種假象。

root.note: 玩弄感官的 → 虛幻的

senses.en: possible to think of or imagine

ex.en: The shop sells every flavor of ice cream imaginable.
ex.zh: 這家店賣你想得到的每一種冰淇淋口味。

root.note: 能想像的

senses.en: existing only in the imagination

ex.en: The little girl had tea parties with her imaginary friend.
ex.zh: 那個小女孩會和她想像中的朋友一起開茶會。

root.note: 只存在於想像中的

mn: imaginary（想像中的）vs. imaginative（有想像力的）。

senses.en: to drink, especially alcohol
to absorb ideas or knowledge

ex.en: Children often imbibe their parents' attitudes without realizing it.
ex.zh: 孩子常在不知不覺中吸收父母的態度。

root.note: 喝進去 → 飲；吸收

senses.en: a complicated and embarrassing situation or conflict

ex.en: The minister was caught up in a political imbroglio over the missing funds.
ex.zh: 部長捲入一場關於失蹤款項的政治糾紛。

root.note: 纏成一團 → 糾葛

senses.en: (literary) to stain, especially with blood

ex.en: The old ballad tells of warriors who would imbrue their swords in battle.
ex.zh: 這首古老歌謠講述戰士們在戰場上讓劍沾滿鮮血。

root.note: 浸入 → 沾染

senses.en: the act of copying someone or something
a copy made to look like something else

ex.en: The bag looked expensive, but it was only a cheap imitation.
ex.zh: 那個包包看起來很貴，其實只是廉價的仿冒品。

root.note: 模仿

senses.en: a person or thing that copies another

ex.en: The popular app quickly attracted many imitators, but no imitator matched its quality.
ex.zh: 這款熱門應用程式很快就引來許多仿效者，但沒有一個比得上它的品質。

root.note: 模仿的人

senses.en: perfectly clean and tidy
free from mistakes or flaws

ex.en: The hotel room was immaculate when we arrived.
ex.zh: 我們抵達時，旅館房間一塵不染。

root.note: 沒有污點的 → 一塵不染

senses.en: unimportant; not relevant
not physical; spiritual

ex.en: Whether you arrive by bus or train is immaterial, as long as you are on time.
ex.zh: 只要準時到，你搭公車還是火車都無所謂。

root.note: 沒有實質的 → 無關緊要的

senses.en: behaving in a childish way
not fully grown or developed

ex.en: It was immature of him to sulk after losing the game.
ex.zh: 他輸了比賽就生悶氣，真是幼稚。

root.note: 未成熟的

senses.en: too large or great to be measured

ex.en: Her kindness had an immeasurable impact on my life.
ex.zh: 她的善良對我的人生有難以估量的影響。

root.note: 無法測量的

senses.en: extremely large or great

ex.en: Building the bridge required an immense amount of steel.
ex.zh: 建造這座橋需要大量的鋼材。

root.note: 大到無法測量 → 巨大的

senses.en: to put something completely into a liquid
to involve oneself deeply in an activity

ex.en: The best way to learn a language is to immerse yourself in it.
ex.zh: 學語言最好的方法是讓自己沉浸在那個語言環境中。

root.note: 浸入其中

senses.en: the act of putting something completely in a liquid
deep involvement in an activity or environment

ex.en: The school offers a Spanish immersion program for young children.
ex.zh: 這所學校為幼童提供西班牙語沉浸式課程。

root.note: 浸入其中 → 沉浸

senses.en: a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country

ex.en: My grandfather arrived as an immigrant with only one suitcase.
ex.zh: 我祖父以移民身分來到這裡時，只帶了一個行李箱。

root.note: 遷移進來的人 → 移民

mn: im-（進來）是 immigrant；e-（出去）是 emigrant。

senses.en: to come to live permanently in a foreign country

ex.en: Her parents decided to immigrate to Canada in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 她的父母在 1990 年代決定移民到加拿大。

root.note: 遷移進來 → 移入

senses.en: the state of being about to happen

ex.en: The imminence of the storm forced officials to close the schools.
ex.zh: 暴風雨迫在眉睫，官方只得下令停課。

parts.m: project, hang over 突出、懸垂

root.note: 懸在頭上 → 迫近

senses.en: about to happen very soon

ex.en: Dark clouds warned us that rain was imminent.
ex.zh: 烏雲警告我們雨快要下了。

parts.m: project, hang over 突出、懸垂

root.note: 懸在頭上的 → 迫在眉睫的

mn: 別和 eminent（傑出的）搞混：imminent 是「即將發生」。

senses.en: (of liquids) not able to be mixed together

ex.en: Oil and water are immiscible, so they separate into layers.
ex.zh: 油和水不互溶，所以會分成兩層。

root.note: 不能混合的

senses.en: not following accepted standards of right behavior

ex.en: Many people think it is immoral to profit from someone else's suffering.
ex.zh: 許多人認為從別人的痛苦中獲利是不道德的。

root.note: 不道德的

mn: immoral（不道德的）≠ amoral（無道德觀念的）。

senses.en: to make someone or something famous or remembered forever

ex.en: The artist wanted to immortalize her hometown in a series of paintings.
ex.zh: 這位畫家想用一系列畫作讓她的家鄉永垂不朽。

root.note: 使不死 → 使不朽

senses.en: not able to be moved
unwilling to change one's opinion

ex.en: On the issue of safety, the principal was immovable.
ex.zh: 在安全問題上，校長的立場堅定不移。

root.note: 無法移動的

senses.en: protected against a disease
not affected by something; exempt

ex.en: No one is immune to criticism in politics.
ex.zh: 在政治圈沒有人能免於批評。

root.note: 免除義務的 → 豁免；免疫

senses.en: unchanging over time; unable to be changed
senses.zh: 不可改變的；永恆不變的

ex.en: Scientists once believed the continents were immutable.
ex.zh: 科學家曾經認為大陸是永恆不變的。

root.note: 無法改變的

senses.en: to weaken or damage something

ex.en: Lack of sleep can impair your ability to concentrate.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會削弱你的專注力。

root.note: 使變得更糟 → 損害

senses.en: unable to be felt by touch
not easily understood

ex.en: An impalpable sadness hung over the empty house.
ex.zh: 一股說不出的哀傷籠罩著那棟空屋。

root.note: 摸不到的

senses.en: treating all sides equally; fair and unbiased

ex.en: A judge must remain impartial throughout the trial.
ex.zh: 法官在整個審判過程中必須保持公正。

root.note: 不站在任何一方的 → 公正的

senses.en: impossible to travel along or across

ex.en: Heavy snow made the mountain road impassable.
ex.zh: 大雪使山路無法通行。

root.note: 無法通過的

senses.en: incapable of feeling pain or emotion
senses.zh: 無感覺的；不受痛苦影響的

ex.en: The old monk seemed impassible, untouched by either joy or grief.
ex.zh: 老僧似乎無動於衷，喜悲都無法觸動他。

root.note: 不能感受痛苦的 → 無感覺的

mn: pass 在這裡是 passion 的「受苦」，不是「通過」；別和 impassable 搞混。

senses.en: not showing any emotion

ex.en: The guard's face remained impassive as the tourists tried to make him laugh.
ex.zh: 遊客們想逗那名衛兵笑，他卻始終面無表情。

root.note: 不表露感受的 → 面無表情的

senses.en: a tendency to be irritated by delays; eagerness

ex.en: The crowd's impatience grew as the concert started late.
ex.zh: 演唱會延遲開始，觀眾越來越不耐煩。

root.note: 無法忍受的 → 不耐煩

senses.en: without any faults; perfect

ex.en: The waiter spoke impeccable French.
ex.zh: 那名服務生說一口無可挑剔的法語。

root.note: 不會犯錯的 → 完美的

senses.en: having little or no money

ex.en: As an impecunious student, he lived on instant noodles.
ex.zh: 身為窮學生，他靠泡麵過活。

root.note: 沒有錢的 → 貧窮的

senses.en: to slow or block progress

ex.en: Fallen trees impede traffic after every major storm.
ex.zh: 每次大暴風雨過後，倒下的樹都會阻礙交通。

root.note: 把腳套住 → 阻礙

senses.en: to drive or force someone to do something

ex.en: Curiosity may impel a child to take apart a clock.
ex.zh: 好奇心可能驅使孩子把時鐘拆開。

root.note: 推向前 → 驅使

senses.en: to be about to happen, especially something bad
senses.zh: 迫近；即將發生（多指壞事）

ex.en: Few people noticed the danger that seemed to impend over the town.
ex.zh: 很少人注意到那股似乎正籠罩小鎮、即將來臨的危險。

root.note: 懸在頭上 → 迫近

senses.en: extremely important; absolutely necessary
an essential or urgent thing
(grammar) expressing a command

ex.en: It is imperative that you finish the application before Friday.
ex.zh: 你必須在星期五前完成申請，這非常重要。

root.note: 如命令般必須做的 → 必要的

senses.en: so slight or gradual that it cannot be noticed

ex.en: The change in the room's temperature was almost imperceptible.
ex.zh: 房間溫度的變化幾乎察覺不到。

root.note: 無法感知到的 → 察覺不到的

senses.en: not capable of being made perfect

ex.en: The philosopher argued that human nature is imperfectible.
ex.zh: 那位哲學家主張人性無法臻於完美。

root.note: 不能被做到完美的

senses.en: to put something or someone in danger

ex.en: Cutting the safety budget could imperil the lives of workers.
ex.zh: 削減安全預算可能會危及工人的生命。

root.note: 使進入危險 → 危及

senses.en: arrogant and domineering; expecting to be obeyed

ex.en: With an imperious wave of her hand, she dismissed the servants.
ex.zh: 她傲慢地揮揮手，把僕人打發走。

root.note: 總在發號施令的 → 專橫的

senses.en: not allowed

ex.en: Using a phone during the exam is impermissible.
ex.zh: 考試時使用手機是不被允許的。

root.note: 不能放行的 → 不容許的

senses.en: not showing personal feelings or warmth
not relating to any particular person

ex.en: The hospital felt cold and impersonal to the frightened child.
ex.zh: 對那個害怕的孩子來說，醫院感覺冰冷又沒有人情味。

root.note: 不帶個人情感的

senses.en: to pretend to be another person, for fun or to deceive

ex.en: It is a crime to impersonate a police officer.
ex.zh: 冒充警察是犯罪行為。

root.note: 進入別人的角色 → 冒充

senses.en: impossible to persuade

ex.en: My grandmother was impersuadable once she had made up her mind.
ex.zh: 我奶奶一旦下定決心，就誰也說服不了。

root.note: 勸不動的

senses.en: rude lack of respect

ex.en: The teacher would not tolerate such impertinence from a student.
ex.zh: 老師無法容忍學生如此無禮。

root.note: 不得體、不恰當 → 無禮

senses.en: unable to be upset; always calm

ex.en: The pilot remained imperturbable even during the violent storm.
ex.zh: 即使在猛烈的暴風雨中，機長依然泰然自若。

root.note: 無法被擾亂的 → 冷靜的

senses.en: not allowing liquid or gas to pass through
not affected or influenced by something
senses.zh: 不受影響的；無動於衷的

ex.en: He seemed impervious to criticism and kept doing things his own way.
ex.zh: 他似乎對批評無動於衷，照樣我行我素。

root.note: 沒有路可通過的 → 不透的；不受影響的

senses.en: the quality of acting quickly without thinking

ex.en: His youthful impetuosity led him to quit his job without a plan.
ex.zh: 年輕人的衝動讓他沒有任何計畫就辭職了。

root.note: 猛衝向前的性格 → 衝動

senses.en: acting quickly without thinking or care

ex.en: In an impetuous moment, he quit his job without having another one lined up.
ex.zh: 他一時衝動，在還沒找到下一份工作前就辭職了。

root.note: 猛然衝上前 → 衝動的

senses.en: something that encourages a process or activity to happen
(physics) the force that makes an object move

ex.en: The new funding gave fresh impetus to the research project.
ex.zh: 新的經費為研究計畫注入新的動力。

root.note: 向前衝的力量 → 推動力

senses.en: lack of respect for God or religion

ex.en: In ancient Athens, Socrates was accused of impiety.
ex.zh: 在古雅典，蘇格拉底被控不敬神。

root.note: 不虔誠

senses.en: showing a lack of respect for God or religion

ex.en: The villagers considered it impious to work on holy days.
ex.zh: 村民們認為在聖日工作是不敬神的。

root.note: 不虔誠的

mn: 注意重音在第一音節：IM-pious，和 pious 不一樣。

senses.en: not seeming reasonable or likely to be true
senses.zh: 難以置信的；不合情理的

ex.en: His excuse that a dog ate his homework sounded implausible.
ex.zh: 他說作業被狗吃掉，這個藉口聽起來很難讓人相信。

root.note: 不值得讚許、不可信的

senses.en: not bending easily; inflexible

ex.en: The old leather had become dry and impliable.
ex.zh: 那塊舊皮革已經變得又乾又硬。

root.note: 不能彎折的 → 不柔順的

senses.en: to show that someone is involved in a crime or wrongdoing
to suggest as a cause

ex.en: New evidence may implicate the manager in the fraud.
ex.zh: 新證據可能顯示經理涉入這起詐欺案。

root.note: 被折進去 → 牽連

senses.en: suggested but not directly stated
complete and without doubt

ex.en: There was an implicit threat in his polite words.
ex.zh: 他客氣的話語中暗藏威脅。

root.note: 折在裡面、沒攤開說 → 含蓄的

senses.en: to suggest something without saying it directly

ex.en: Are you trying to imply that I was lying?
ex.zh: 你是在暗示我說謊嗎？

root.note: 把意思折在話裡 → 暗示

mn: 說話的人 imply（暗示），聽話的人 infer（推論）。

senses.en: unwise; likely to cause problems

ex.en: It would be impolitic to criticize the boss at the company party.
ex.zh: 在公司聚會上批評老闆是不明智的。

root.note: 不精明的 → 失策的

senses.en: the act of bringing goods into a country from abroad

ex.en: The government banned the importation of certain plants to protect local crops.
ex.zh: 政府禁止進口某些植物，以保護本地作物。

root.note: 運進來 → 進口

senses.en: annoyingly persistent in asking for something

ex.en: The importunate salesman called my office five times in one day.
ex.zh: 那個糾纏不休的推銷員一天打了五次電話到我辦公室。

root.note: 不合時宜、令人不便的 → 糾纏不休的

senses.en: to ask someone repeatedly and annoyingly for something

ex.en: Street vendors importune tourists to buy their souvenirs.
ex.zh: 街頭小販不停糾纏遊客買紀念品。

root.note: 在不方便的時候煩人 → 糾纏

senses.en: unable to take effective action; powerless
(of a man) unable to achieve an erection

ex.en: The small country felt impotent against its powerful neighbor.
ex.zh: 這個小國面對強大的鄰國感到無能為力。

root.note: 沒有力量的 → 無力的

mn: 注意重音在第一音節：IM-potent。

senses.en: to make someone poor
to make something weaker or worse in quality

ex.en: Years of war can impoverish even a wealthy nation.
ex.zh: 多年戰爭即使是富國也會變窮。

root.note: 使陷入貧窮

senses.en: impossible to do or carry out in practice

ex.en: The plan to move the whole village was impracticable.
ex.zh: 把整個村莊遷走的計畫根本行不通。

root.note: 無法實行的

mn: impracticable（做不到）比 impractical（不實際、不切實用）更強烈。

senses.en: unable to be captured or broken into
unable to be defeated or challenged

ex.en: The castle on the cliff was nearly impregnable.
ex.zh: 懸崖上的城堡幾乎堅不可摧。

parts.m: take, seize 奪取（拉丁文 prehendere）

root.note: 無法被奪取的 → 攻不破的

senses.en: to soak or fill something with a substance
to make pregnant

ex.en: Workers impregnate the wood with chemicals to prevent rot.
ex.zh: 工人把木材浸透化學藥劑以防腐爛。

root.note: 使懷有 → 使充滿

senses.en: done without planning or preparation
without preparation

ex.en: The band gave an impromptu performance in the train station.
ex.zh: 樂團在火車站即興演出。

root.note: 「在手邊就緒」→ 立即、即興的

senses.en: not suitable or appropriate
not following rules or law

ex.en: Improper storage can cause food to spoil quickly.
ex.zh: 保存方式不當會讓食物很快壞掉。

root.note: 不適當的

senses.en: improper or unacceptable behavior

ex.en: The senator denied any impropriety in accepting the gift.
ex.zh: 那位參議員否認收受禮物有任何不當之處。

root.note: 不適當 → 不當行為

senses.en: not planning or saving for the future

ex.en: His improvident spending left him with no savings for retirement.
ex.zh: 他花錢不顧將來，結果退休時一點積蓄都沒有。

root.note: 不往前看的 → 不顧將來的

senses.en: to create or perform something without preparation
to make something from whatever is available

ex.en: When the power went out, we had to improvise with candles.
ex.zh: 停電時，我們只好拿蠟燭湊合著用。

root.note: 事先沒看過、沒準備 → 即興

senses.en: not showing care for the consequences; unwise

ex.en: It would be imprudent to invest all your savings in one company.
ex.zh: 把所有積蓄投資在一家公司是不明智的。

root.note: 沒有遠見的 → 輕率的

senses.en: rude and disrespectful behavior

ex.en: She had the impudence to laugh at the principal's warning.
ex.zh: 她竟然厚著臉皮嘲笑校長的警告。

root.note: 不知羞恥 → 厚顏無恥

senses.en: to question or attack the truth, honesty, or validity of something

ex.en: The lawyer tried to impugn the witness's credibility.
ex.zh: 律師試圖質疑證人的可信度。

root.note: 對著打 → 抨擊、質疑

mn: 字根 pugn（打鬥）也出現在 pugnacious（好鬥的）；g 不發音。

senses.en: a strong urge to do something
the force that pushes something forward

ex.en: She felt a sudden impulsion to call her old friend.
ex.zh: 她突然有股衝動想打電話給老朋友。

root.note: 往前推 → 推動；衝動

senses.en: acting suddenly without thinking carefully

ex.en: He regretted his impulsive decision to buy the expensive phone.
ex.zh: 他後悔自己一時衝動買了那支昂貴的手機。

root.note: 被一股力量推著走的 → 衝動的

senses.en: freedom from punishment or harmful consequences

ex.en: The gang operated with impunity because the police were bribed.
ex.zh: 因為警察被收買，那個幫派為所欲為而不受懲罰。

root.note: 不被懲罰

mn: 常見片語 with impunity：肆無忌憚地、不受懲罰地。

senses.en: mixed with other substances; not pure
morally wrong

ex.en: The gold was impure and contained traces of copper.
ex.zh: 這塊金子不純，含有少量的銅。

root.note: 不純的

senses.en: to attribute a fault or quality to someone

ex.en: It is unfair to impute bad motives to people you do not know.
ex.zh: 把不良動機歸咎於你不認識的人是不公平的。

root.note: 把（責任）算到某人身上 → 歸咎

senses.en: impossible or very difficult to reach
difficult to understand or use
senses.zh: 難以理解的；難以取得的

ex.en: The village is inaccessible by car during the rainy season.
ex.zh: 雨季時汽車無法開到那個村莊。

root.note: 無法走到的 → 難以到達的

senses.en: not correct or exact

ex.en: The map was inaccurate, so we got lost twice.
ex.zh: 地圖不準確，害我們迷路了兩次。

root.note: 不精確的

senses.en: not active or working

ex.en: The volcano has been inactive for thousands of years.
ex.zh: 這座火山已經數千年沒有活動了。

root.note: 不動的

senses.en: not enough or not good enough
(of a person) unable to deal with a situation
senses.zh: （人）能力不足的；自覺不夠好的

ex.en: The hospital's supply of beds was inadequate for the flu season.
ex.zh: 醫院的病床數量不足以應付流感季節。

root.note: 達不到相等（所需）的程度 → 不足的

senses.en: not allowed, especially as evidence in court
senses.zh: （法庭上）不予採納的；不容許的

ex.en: The judge ruled that the illegally recorded call was inadmissible.
ex.zh: 法官裁定那通非法錄音的電話不能作為證據。

root.note: 不能被放進來的 → 不予採納的

senses.en: not done on purpose; accidental

ex.en: An inadvertent click sent the email to the wrong person.
ex.zh: 不小心點了一下，郵件就寄錯人了。

root.note: 沒把注意力轉過去的 → 無意的

senses.en: likely to have bad results; unwise

ex.en: Doctors say it is inadvisable to swim right after a large meal.
ex.zh: 醫生說飽餐後馬上游泳是不明智的。

root.note: 不值得建議的 → 不明智的

senses.en: silly and without meaning

ex.en: I got tired of their inane chatter about celebrity gossip.
ex.zh: 我受夠了他們聊名人八卦的無聊廢話。

root.note: 空洞的 → 無意義的

senses.en: not alive

ex.en: Young children often talk to inanimate objects like toys.
ex.zh: 小孩子常常跟玩具之類無生命的東西說話。

root.note: 沒有生命的

senses.en: impossible to understand or grasp

ex.en: To the child, the lecture on quantum physics was inapprehensible.
ex.zh: 對那個孩子來說，量子物理的演講完全無法理解。

root.note: 無法抓住（意思）的 → 不可理解的

senses.en: not suitable or appropriate

ex.en: Comparing the tragedy to a sports game was an inapt remark.
ex.zh: 把這場悲劇比作一場球賽是很不恰當的說法。

root.note: 不適合的

mn: inapt 是「不恰當」；inept 是「笨拙無能」。

senses.en: unable to express ideas clearly
senses.zh: 口齒不清的；不善表達的

senses.en: not expressed in words

ex.en: He was so nervous that he became inarticulate during the interview.
ex.zh: 他緊張到面試時話都說不清楚。

root.note: 無法清楚分節發音的 → 口齒不清的

senses.en: impossible to hear

ex.en: Her voice was almost inaudible over the noise of the traffic.
ex.zh: 在車流噪音中，她的聲音幾乎聽不見。

root.note: 聽不到的

senses.en: existing from birth; natural

ex.en: Some scientists believe that the ability to learn language is inborn.
ex.zh: 有些科學家認為學習語言的能力是與生俱來的。

root.note: 出生時就在身上的 → 天生的

senses.en: produced by breeding closely related individuals
existing as a deep part of one's nature

ex.en: Inbred dogs are more likely to suffer from health problems.
ex.zh: 近親繁殖的狗比較容易有健康問題。

root.note: 在同一群體內繁殖的 → 近親繁殖的

senses.en: light produced by something that is very hot

ex.en: The incandescence of the molten metal lit up the whole factory.
ex.zh: 熔融金屬發出的白熱光芒照亮了整座工廠。

root.note: 發出光熱的狀態 → 白熱

senses.en: giving off light when heated
extremely bright, passionate, or angry
senses.zh: 光彩奪目的；極度激動的

ex.en: Many cities have replaced incandescent bulbs with LED lights.
ex.zh: 許多城市已把白熾燈泡換成 LED 燈。

root.note: 熾熱發光的

senses.en: to prevent someone from functioning normally
senses.zh: 使失去能力；使無法行動

ex.en: A back injury can incapacitate a worker for weeks.
ex.zh: 背部受傷可能讓工人好幾週無法工作。

root.note: 使失去能力

senses.en: lack of ability or strength to do something

ex.en: The leader's incapacity to make decisions frustrated the entire team.
ex.zh: 領導者無法做決定，讓整個團隊很沮喪。

root.note: 沒有能力

senses.en: to put in prison

ex.en: Some reformers argue that it is costly to incarcerate nonviolent offenders.
ex.zh: 有些改革者主張監禁非暴力犯的成本太高。

root.note: 關進監獄

senses.en: designed to cause fires
tending to stir up conflict or anger

ex.en: The politician's incendiary speech sparked protests across the city.
ex.zh: 那位政客煽動性的演說引發全市抗議。

root.note: 使燃燒的 → 縱火的；煽動的

senses.en: something that motivates or encourages someone to act

ex.en: The company offers a bonus as an incentive for good performance.
ex.zh: 公司提供獎金作為表現優良的激勵。

root.note: 原指「吹奏引人前進的曲調」→ 激勵

senses.en: the beginning of an institution or activity

ex.en: She has worked for the charity since its inception in 2005.
ex.zh: 這個慈善機構自 2005 年創立起，她就一直在那裡工作。

root.note: 著手去拿 → 開始

senses.en: relating to a beginning; initial
(grammar) expressing the start of an action

ex.en: The project was still in its inceptive stage when funding ran out.
ex.zh: 計畫還在初始階段時經費就用完了。

root.note: 開始著手的 → 初期的

senses.en: continuing without stopping

ex.en: The incessant barking of the neighbor's dog kept me awake.
ex.zh: 鄰居的狗叫個不停，吵得我睡不著。

root.note: 不停止的

senses.en: little by little; gradually

ex.en: The glacier retreated inchmeal over the centuries.
ex.zh: 幾百年來，冰河一點一點地後退。

parts.m: measure, portion 份量（古英文 mǣlum）

root.note: 一英寸一英寸地 → 逐漸地

senses.en: just begun and not fully formed or developed

ex.en: Her plan for the novel was still inchoate, just a few notes and ideas.
ex.zh: 她的小說構想還沒成形，只有一些筆記和點子。

root.note: 剛開始的 → 未成形的

mn: 發音 [ɪnˋkoɪt]，ch 唸 k。

senses.en: (grammar) expressing the beginning of an action or state

ex.en: In English, "grow dark" has an inchoative meaning.
ex.zh: 在英文裡，「grow dark」帶有表示開始的意思。

root.note: 表示開始的

senses.en: the rate at which something happens
(physics) the way light or a ray falls on a surface

ex.en: The incidence of heart disease has fallen in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來心臟病的發生率下降了。

root.note: 落在…上 → 發生（率）

senses.en: an event, especially an unusual or unpleasant one

ex.en: The police are investigating the incident at the train station.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查火車站發生的事件。

root.note: 落到身上的事 → 事件

senses.en: used to add information or change the subject; by the way
as a minor, unplanned result

ex.en: Incidentally, have you seen my blue umbrella anywhere?
ex.zh: 順帶一問，你有看到我的藍色雨傘嗎？

root.note: 碰巧落下的 → 附帶地

senses.en: to destroy something completely by burning

ex.en: The hospital must incinerate its medical waste safely.
ex.zh: 醫院必須安全地焚化醫療廢棄物。

root.note: 燒成灰

senses.en: the beginning or early stage of something

ex.en: Doctors caught the disease in its incipience, when treatment works best.
ex.zh: 醫生在疾病初期就發現了，這時治療效果最好。

root.note: 著手開始 → 初期

senses.en: beginning to happen or develop

ex.en: The dentist found an incipient cavity and filled it right away.
ex.zh: 牙醫發現一個初期蛀牙，立刻把它補好。

root.note: 剛著手開始的 → 初期的

senses.en: a narrow, sharp front tooth used for cutting

ex.en: The boy chipped an incisor when he fell off his bike.
ex.zh: 那個男孩騎腳踏車摔倒，撞缺了一顆門牙。

root.note: 切進去的東西 → 門牙

senses.en: to encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behavior

ex.en: He was arrested for trying to incite a riot online.
ex.zh: 他因試圖在網路上煽動暴動而被捕。

parts.m: set in motion, call 使動、召喚

root.note: 促使行動 → 煽動

senses.en: the act of encouraging violent or unlawful behavior

ex.en: The speaker was charged with incitement to violence.
ex.zh: 那位演講者被控煽動暴力。

root.note: 煽動

senses.en: impossible to force, control, or restrain
senses.zh: 無法強制的；控制不住的

ex.en: The prisoner had an incoercible will that no threat could break.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯意志堅定，任何威脅都無法使他屈服。

parts.m: shut up, restrain 關住、限制

root.note: 無法被強制的

senses.en: the quality of being unclear or lacking logical connection

ex.en: The incoherence of his essay made it hard to follow his argument.
ex.zh: 他的文章前後不連貫，讓人很難理解他的論點。

root.note: 黏不在一起 → 不連貫

senses.en: unclear and hard to understand; not logically connected

ex.en: The patient was feverish and incoherent.
ex.zh: 病人發燒而且說話語無倫次。

root.note: 黏不在一起的 → 不連貫的

senses.en: not able to burn

ex.en: The walls are lined with incombustible material to slow a fire.
ex.zh: 牆壁內襯有不可燃材料來延緩火勢。

root.note: 無法燃燒的

senses.en: so good that nothing else can be compared to it
senses.zh: 無可比擬的；無與倫比的

ex.en: The view from the summit was incomparable.
ex.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色無與倫比。

root.note: 無法比較的 → 無與倫比的

mn: 重音在第二音節：in-COM-parable。

senses.en: unable to exist or work together

ex.en: This charger is incompatible with older phone models.
ex.zh: 這個充電器和舊款手機不相容。

root.note: 無法一起承受、共處的 → 不相容的

senses.en: lack of the skill or ability to do something well

ex.en: The project failed because of the manager's incompetence.
ex.zh: 這個專案因為經理的無能而失敗。

root.note: 不能勝任

senses.en: not having the skill or ability to do something well

ex.en: The customers complained about the incompetent staff at the front desk.
ex.zh: 顧客抱怨櫃台人員不稱職。

root.note: 不能勝任的

senses.en: not finished or not having all its parts

ex.en: Your application is incomplete without a photo.
ex.zh: 沒有附照片的話，你的申請就不完整。

root.note: 沒有填滿的 → 不完整的

senses.en: impossible to understand

ex.en: The instructions were written in incomprehensible technical jargon.
ex.zh: 說明書用了一堆讓人看不懂的專業術語。

root.note: 無法完全抓住（意思）的 → 無法理解的

senses.en: not able to be compressed or made smaller

ex.en: For most practical purposes, water is treated as incompressible.
ex.zh: 在大多數實際應用中，水被視為不可壓縮的。

root.note: 無法壓在一起的 → 不可壓縮的

senses.en: impossible to imagine or believe
senses.zh: 不可思議的；難以想像的

ex.en: Just a few decades ago, video calls on a phone were inconceivable.
ex.zh: 就在幾十年前，用手機視訊通話還是難以想像的事。

root.note: 腦中無法掌握的 → 難以想像的

senses.en: not in harmony with the surroundings; out of place

ex.en: The modern glass tower looks incongruous among the old temples.
ex.zh: 那棟現代玻璃大樓在古老的寺廟之間顯得格格不入。

root.note: 不一致的 → 不協調的

senses.en: not important or significant

ex.en: Don't waste time arguing over inconsequential details.
ex.zh: 別浪費時間爭論那些無關緊要的細節。

root.note: 不會帶來後果的 → 不重要的

senses.en: small in size or amount; not worth considering

ex.en: Compared with the total budget, the cost of the repairs was inconsiderable.
ex.zh: 和總預算相比，修理費用微不足道。

root.note: 不值得考慮的 → 微不足道的

mn: 常見說法 not inconsiderable：「可不少」，是英式的委婉強調。

senses.en: not staying the same in behavior or quality
not in agreement with something else

ex.en: The witness's story was inconsistent with the video evidence.
ex.zh: 證人的說法和錄影證據不相符。

root.note: 無法站在一起的 → 不一致的

senses.en: frequently changing; not faithful

ex.en: The poet complained about his inconstant lover.
ex.zh: 詩人抱怨他那善變的情人。

root.note: 站不穩的 → 善變的

senses.en: impossible to deny or dispute

ex.en: The DNA test provided incontrovertible proof of his innocence.
ex.zh: DNA 檢測提供了他清白的確鑿證據。

root.note: 無法被反轉的 → 無可爭辯的

senses.en: causing trouble or difficulty

ex.en: Is it inconvenient for you to meet on Saturday morning?
ex.zh: 星期六早上見面對你來說會不方便嗎？

root.note: 不適合一起來的 → 不方便的

senses.en: impossible to justify or excuse
senses.zh: 無法辯護的；站不住腳的

senses.en: impossible to protect against attack

ex.en: Bullying a younger student is simply indefensible.
ex.zh: 霸凌學弟妹根本沒有任何辯解的餘地。

root.note: 無法擋開攻擊的 → 無法辯護的

senses.en: for a period of time with no fixed end
in a vague or unclear way

ex.en: The concert has been postponed indefinitely because of the storm.
ex.zh: 由於暴風雨，演唱會無限期延後。

root.note: 沒有界限地 → 無限期地

senses.en: impossible to remove or erase

ex.en: Her first trip abroad left an indelible impression on her.
ex.zh: 她第一次出國旅行留下了難以磨滅的印象。

parts.m: destroy, blot out 抹去（同 delete）

root.note: 無法抹去的

senses.en: too extreme or unusual to be described

ex.en: The joy of holding her newborn son was indescribable.
ex.zh: 抱著剛出生的兒子，那種喜悅難以形容。

root.note: 無法寫下來的 → 難以形容的

senses.en: not able to be destroyed
senses.zh: 不可毀滅的；堅不可摧的

ex.en: These plastic toys seem almost indestructible.
ex.zh: 這些塑膠玩具似乎幾乎摔不壞。

root.note: 無法拆毀的

senses.en: something that indicates or points out; an indicator

ex.en: Rising prices are often an indicant of a strong economy.
ex.zh: 物價上漲常是經濟強勁的指標。

root.note: 指出事情的東西 → 指標

senses.en: a sign that shows the condition or existence of something
a device such as a gauge or light that shows information

ex.en: Unemployment is an important indicator of economic health.
ex.zh: 失業率是經濟健康的重要指標。

root.note: 指出狀況的東西 → 指標

senses.en: to formally charge someone with a serious crime
to strongly criticize

ex.en: The grand jury voted to indict the company's former CEO for fraud.
ex.zh: 大陪審團投票決定以詐欺罪起訴該公司的前執行長。

root.note: 對某人宣告罪名 → 起訴

mn: c 不發音，唸起來像 in-DITE。

senses.en: extreme poverty

ex.en: The novel describes a family's slide from wealth into indigence.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫一個家庭從富裕淪為貧困的過程。

parts.m: in 在內（古拉丁文 indu）

root.note: 處於匱乏之中 → 貧困

senses.en: originating or living naturally in a particular place; native
senses.zh: 本土的；原生的；原住民的

ex.en: The museum displays art made by indigenous peoples of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這間博物館展示臺灣原住民族的藝術作品。

root.note: 在當地出生的 → 本土的

mn: 別和 indigent（貧窮的）搞混：indigenous 多了 -ous，意思是「本土的」。

senses.en: very poor; needy
a needy person

ex.en: The clinic provides free care to indigent patients.
ex.zh: 這間診所為貧困病患提供免費醫療。

root.note: 處於匱乏之中的 → 貧窮的

senses.en: difficult or impossible to digest
hard to understand or accept
senses.zh: 難以理解的；難以接受的

ex.en: Raw beans can be indigestible for many people.
ex.zh: 生豆子對許多人來說很難消化。

root.note: 無法分解帶走的 → 難消化的

senses.en: pain or discomfort in the stomach after eating

ex.en: Eating too fast can give you indigestion.
ex.zh: 吃太快會讓你消化不良。

root.note: 無法消化 → 消化不良

senses.en: angry because of unfair treatment

ex.en: She was indignant when the store refused to honor the warranty.
ex.zh: 店家拒絕履行保固，讓她很憤慨。

root.note: 認為受到不值得的對待 → 憤慨的

senses.en: treatment that makes someone feel ashamed or lose respect

ex.en: He suffered the indignity of being searched in front of his coworkers.
ex.zh: 他當著同事的面被搜身，受盡屈辱。

root.note: 不尊重 → 侮辱

senses.en: impossible to see or clearly distinguish

ex.en: The difference between the two copies was almost indiscernible.
ex.zh: 這兩份複本的差異幾乎看不出來。

root.note: 無法區分開的 → 難以辨別的

senses.en: careless about revealing secrets or saying embarrassing things
senses.zh: 輕率的；不謹慎的；口風不緊的

ex.en: An indiscreet comment on social media cost him his job.
ex.zh: 他在社群媒體上一句不謹慎的留言害他丟了工作。

root.note: 不懂得分辨該說什麼 → 輕率的

senses.en: done without careful judgment or choice; random
senses.zh: 不加區別的；隨意的；濫用的

ex.en: The indiscriminate use of antibiotics has created resistant bacteria.
ex.zh: 濫用抗生素已經造成抗藥性細菌。

root.note: 不加區分的

senses.en: absolutely necessary

ex.en: A good dictionary is indispensable for learning a new language.
ex.zh: 學新語言時，一本好字典是不可或缺的。

root.note: 不能分發出去、省掉的 → 不可或缺的

senses.en: not clear or sharp; hard to see or hear

ex.en: Through the fog, the shape of the boat was indistinct.
ex.zh: 透過濃霧，船的輪廓模糊不清。

root.note: 沒有清楚標記的 → 模糊的

senses.en: not able to be turned aside or diverted
senses.zh: 無法轉移的；無法避開的

ex.en: The river's course proved indivertible despite the engineers' efforts.
ex.zh: 儘管工程師們努力，河道還是無法改道。

root.note: 無法轉向一旁的

senses.en: unable to be divided or separated
(math) unable to be divided without a remainder

ex.en: The founders believed that the nation should be one and indivisible.
ex.zh: 建國者們相信國家應該是統一而不可分割的。

root.note: 無法分開的

senses.en: laziness; avoidance of activity or effort

ex.en: His failure was due more to indolence than to lack of talent.
ex.zh: 他的失敗與其說是缺乏天分，不如說是懶惰。

root.note: 不想吃苦 → 懶惰

senses.en: lazy; wanting to avoid activity or effort
(medicine) causing little or no pain; slow to develop

ex.en: The indolent cat spent the whole afternoon sleeping in the sun.
ex.zh: 那隻懶貓整個下午都在曬太陽睡覺。

root.note: 不想吃苦的 → 懶惰的

senses.en: impossible to defeat or discourage
senses.zh: 不屈不撓的；不可征服的

ex.en: The injured runner showed indomitable courage by finishing the race.
ex.zh: 受傷的跑者展現不屈不撓的勇氣，跑完了全程。

root.note: 無法被馴服的 → 不屈不撓的

senses.en: to formally admit someone to a position or organization
to enlist someone for military service

ex.en: The club will induct five new members at tonight's ceremony.
ex.zh: 這個社團將在今晚的典禮上正式接納五名新成員。

root.note: 引領進入 → 使入會、就職

senses.en: the act of allowing oneself to enjoy a pleasure
something enjoyed as a special treat
tolerance or leniency

ex.en: A hot bath after work is my favorite indulgence.
ex.zh: 下班後泡個熱水澡是我最愛的享受。

root.note: 對自己或他人寬容 → 放縱

senses.en: allowing someone to have or do whatever they want

ex.en: The indulgent grandparents let the kids eat candy before dinner.
ex.zh: 寵孫的祖父母讓孩子們在晚餐前吃糖。

root.note: 非常寬容的 → 縱容的

senses.en: to make someone drunk
[ɪnˋibrɪɪt] a drunken person

ex.en: Just two glasses of wine were enough to inebriate him.
ex.zh: 兩杯葡萄酒就足以讓他喝醉。

root.note: 使喝醉

senses.en: not fit or safe to eat

ex.en: The burnt cookies were completely inedible.
ex.zh: 那些烤焦的餅乾完全不能吃。

root.note: 不能吃的

senses.en: too great or extreme to be expressed in words

ex.en: They stood in ineffable wonder at the edge of the Grand Canyon.
ex.zh: 他們站在大峽谷邊緣，心中有種難以言喻的驚嘆。

root.note: 無法說出口的 → 難以言喻的

senses.en: failure to use time, energy, or resources well

ex.en: The report blamed the delays on inefficiency in the shipping department.
ex.zh: 報告把延誤歸咎於運輸部門的效率低落。

root.note: 做不出成果 → 效率低

senses.en: not using time, energy, or resources well

ex.en: Old light bulbs are inefficient because they waste energy as heat.
ex.zh: 舊式燈泡效率很低，因為它們把能量浪費在發熱上。

root.note: 做不出成果的 → 效率低的

senses.en: not qualified or allowed to do or receive something

ex.en: Students with failing grades are ineligible to play on the team.
ex.zh: 成績不及格的學生沒有資格參加校隊比賽。

root.note: 不能被選出的 → 不合格的

senses.en: having no skill; clumsy

ex.en: I am completely inept at fixing anything electrical.
ex.zh: 我對修理任何電器都完全不在行。

root.note: 不適合、不得要領的 → 笨拙的

mn: inept（笨拙）和 adept（熟練）正好相反。

senses.en: lacking the ability or strength to move
(chemistry) not reacting with other substances

ex.en: Helium is an inert gas that does not easily react with other elements.
ex.zh: 氦是一種不易與其他元素反應的惰性氣體。

root.note: 沒有技藝、不會動 → 不動的

senses.en: too great to be calculated or measured

ex.en: Her mentor's advice was of inestimable value to her career.
ex.zh: 導師的建議對她的職業生涯有無可估量的價值。

root.note: 無法估價的

senses.en: certain to happen; unavoidable

ex.en: With so many injured players, the team's defeat seemed inevitable.
ex.zh: 受傷的球員那麼多，球隊輸球似乎是必然的。

root.note: 無法避開的

senses.en: too bad to be excused or forgiven

ex.en: Leaving a dog in a hot car is inexcusable.
ex.zh: 把狗留在悶熱的車裡是不可原諒的。

root.note: 無法免除罪責的 → 不可原諒的

senses.en: never running out; unlimited

ex.en: The toddler seemed to have an inexhaustible supply of energy.
ex.zh: 那個小孩似乎有用不完的精力。

root.note: 汲取不完的

senses.en: impossible to stop or prevent
senses.zh: 無法阻擋的；不可避免的

senses.en: (of a person) unable to be persuaded

ex.en: Nothing could halt the inexorable rise of sea levels.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼能阻止海平面無可阻擋的上升。

root.note: 怎麼求都求不動的 → 無法阻擋的

senses.en: not practical or wise in a particular situation

ex.en: The advisers felt it was inexpedient to raise taxes before the election.
ex.zh: 顧問們認為在選前加稅並不明智。

root.note: 無法讓腳脫困的 → 不便、不得策的

senses.en: not costing a lot of money

ex.en: We found an inexpensive hotel close to the beach.
ex.zh: 我們找到一家靠近海灘又不貴的旅館。

root.note: 不必付出很多的 → 便宜的

senses.en: lack of knowledge or skill gained from experience

ex.en: The young driver's inexperience showed on the icy road.
ex.zh: 在結冰的路面上，那位年輕駕駛缺乏經驗就顯露出來了。

root.note: 沒有嘗試過 → 缺乏經驗

senses.en: impossible to explain or understand

ex.en: For some inexplicable reason, the printer stopped working.
ex.zh: 不知道什麼原因，印表機就是不動了。

root.note: 無法展開說明的 → 無法解釋的

senses.en: too strong to be put into words
senses.zh: 無法言喻的；難以表達的

ex.en: The family felt inexpressible relief when the lost child was found.
ex.zh: 走失的孩子被找到時，家人感到無法言喻的寬慰。

root.note: 無法壓出、說出的 → 無法言喻的

senses.en: not able to be stretched or extended
senses.zh: 不能伸展的；無伸縮性的

ex.en: The cable is made of an inextensible fiber that will not stretch under load.
ex.zh: 這條纜繩由無伸縮性的纖維製成，受力時不會拉長。

root.note: 無法向外伸展的

senses.en: never wrong or never failing
senses.zh: 絕不會錯的；萬無一失的

ex.en: No test is infallible, so doctors often order a second one.
ex.zh: 沒有任何檢驗是絕對不會出錯的，所以醫生常會要求再驗一次。

root.note: 不會犯錯的

senses.en: well known for something bad
senses.zh: 惡名昭彰的；聲名狼藉的

ex.en: The prison was infamous for its harsh conditions.
ex.zh: 那座監獄以條件惡劣而惡名昭彰。

root.note: 沒有好名聲的 → 惡名昭彰的

mn: 重音在第一音節 IN-famous，不是「不出名」而是「出壞名」。

senses.en: the state of being known for something very bad
a shocking or evil act

ex.en: The general's betrayal brought him lasting infamy.
ex.zh: 那位將軍的背叛讓他永遠背負惡名。

root.note: 壞名聲 → 惡名

senses.en: a conclusion reached from evidence and reasoning

ex.en: From the wet streets, the logical inference was that it had rained.
ex.zh: 從潮濕的街道，合理的推論是剛才下過雨。

root.note: 把證據帶進來得出結論 → 推論

senses.en: relating to hell or the underworld
(informal) extremely annoying

ex.en: Please turn off that infernal alarm!
ex.zh: 拜託把那個吵死人的鬧鐘關掉！

root.note: 在底下的世界 → 地獄的

senses.en: (of insects or animals) to be present in large, harmful numbers

ex.en: Termites can infest a wooden house without anyone noticing.
ex.zh: 白蟻可能在沒人察覺的情況下侵擾木造房屋。

parts.m: hostile 有敵意的（拉丁文 infestus）

root.note: 敵意地侵擾 → 大量出沒

senses.en: (old use, offensive) a person who does not believe in a particular religion

ex.en: In the medieval epic, the knight rides out to fight the infidel.
ex.zh: 在這部中世紀史詩中，騎士出征去攻打異教徒。

root.note: 沒有（正統）信仰的人 → 異教徒

senses.en: the act of being unfaithful to a partner
lack of religious belief

ex.en: The novel explores how infidelity destroys a marriage.
ex.zh: 這部小說探討外遇如何摧毀一段婚姻。

root.note: 不忠誠 → 不忠

senses.en: without limits in space, time, or amount
very great

ex.en: A kindergarten teacher needs infinite patience.
ex.zh: 幼兒園老師需要無比的耐心。

root.note: 沒有盡頭的 → 無限的

mn: 發音是 IN-fi-nit，最後不唸 night。

senses.en: the state or quality of having no end or limit

ex.en: The road seemed to stretch into infinity across the desert.
ex.zh: 那條路彷彿穿越沙漠無限延伸。

root.note: 沒有盡頭 → 無限

senses.en: physically weak, especially because of age or illness

ex.en: The volunteers deliver meals to elderly and infirm residents.
ex.zh: 志工為年長和體弱的居民送餐。

root.note: 不堅固的 → 虛弱的

senses.en: a place where sick or injured people are cared for, as in a school

ex.en: The student felt dizzy and went to the school infirmary.
ex.zh: 那個學生覺得頭暈，就去了學校保健室。

root.note: 照顧虛弱者的地方 → 醫務室

senses.en: physical or mental weakness, often caused by age

ex.en: Despite the infirmity of old age, he still walked to the market every day.
ex.zh: 儘管年老體衰，他仍然每天走路去市場。

root.note: 不強健 → 虛弱

senses.en: easily set on fire
easily angered or excited

ex.en: Keep inflammable liquids away from the stove.
ex.zh: 易燃液體要遠離爐子。

root.note: 能進入燃燒狀態的 → 易燃的

mn: inflammable 的 in- 不是「不」！它和 flammable 同義，都是「易燃的」。

senses.en: a condition in which part of the body becomes red, swollen, hot, and painful

ex.en: Ice can help reduce the inflammation in your knee.
ex.zh: 冰敷可以幫助減輕你膝蓋的發炎。

root.note: 身體像著火般紅熱 → 發炎

senses.en: unwilling to change or compromise
not able to bend

ex.en: The school's inflexible rules left no room for special cases.
ex.zh: 這所學校的規定毫無彈性，完全不容許特例。

root.note: 不能彎曲的

senses.en: the power to affect people or events
to have an effect on someone or something

ex.en: Parents have a strong influence on their children's eating habits.
ex.zh: 父母對孩子的飲食習慣有很大的影響。

root.note: 流入（人心）的力量 → 影響

senses.en: having great influence on someone or something

ex.en: She was one of the most influential scientists of her generation.
ex.zh: 她是她那一代最有影響力的科學家之一。

root.note: 有影響力的

senses.en: the arrival of a large number of people or things

ex.en: The town struggled to handle the influx of tourists in summer.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮難以應付夏天大量湧入的遊客。

root.note: 流進來 → 湧入

senses.en: the state of rarely happening

ex.en: The infrequence of rain in the region makes farming difficult.
ex.zh: 這個地區很少下雨，所以務農很困難。

root.note: 不頻繁 → 稀少

senses.en: not happening often

ex.en: Buses to the village are infrequent, so check the schedule.
ex.zh: 開往那個村子的公車班次很少，記得先查時刻表。

root.note: 不頻繁的

senses.en: to break a law or agreement
to limit or undermine something

ex.en: Copying the song without permission would infringe copyright law.
ex.zh: 未經許可翻唱這首歌會侵犯著作權法。

root.note: 闖入打破 → 違反

senses.en: to fill someone or something with a quality or feeling
to soak tea or herbs in liquid to extract flavor

ex.en: The new coach tried to infuse the team with confidence.
ex.zh: 新教練試著讓球隊充滿自信。

root.note: 倒進去 → 注入

senses.en: the introduction of something new into a situation
a drink made by soaking leaves or herbs in hot water
(medicine) a slow injection of fluid into a vein

ex.en: The business survived thanks to an infusion of cash from investors.
ex.zh: 這家公司靠著投資人注入的資金才撐了下來。

root.note: 倒進去 → 注入

senses.en: clever, original, and inventive

ex.en: She came up with an ingenious way to keep the cat off the table.
ex.zh: 她想出一個巧妙的方法讓貓不跳上桌。

root.note: 天生有才能的 → 巧妙的

mn: ingenious（聰明巧妙）vs. ingenuous（天真坦率）：多了 i 的比較聰明。

senses.en: the quality of being clever, original, and inventive

ex.en: With a little ingenuity, you can turn old jars into lamps.
ex.zh: 只要一點巧思，你就能把舊罐子變成燈。

root.note: 天生的才智 → 巧思

senses.en: innocent, trusting, and honest, sometimes too much so

ex.en: His ingenuous smile made it hard to believe he could lie.
ex.zh: 他天真的笑容讓人很難相信他會說謊。

root.note: 原指「生來自由的」→ 坦率、天真的

mn: ingenuous（天真）vs. ingenious（聰明）：注意中間的 u 和 i。

senses.en: causing shame; not glorious

ex.en: The army made an inglorious retreat under cover of darkness.
ex.zh: 軍隊趁著夜色狼狽撤退。

root.note: 不光榮的

senses.en: (variant of engraft) to graft a plant part onto another; to implant firmly

ex.en: The gardener tried to ingraft a pear branch onto the old tree.
ex.zh: 園丁試著把梨樹枝嫁接到老樹上。

root.note: 嫁接進去

senses.en: to try to gain someone's favor, often by flattery

ex.en: He tried to ingratiate himself with the new boss by bringing her coffee.
ex.zh: 他幫新老闆帶咖啡，試圖討好她。

root.note: 讓自己進入別人的好感中 → 討好

senses.en: lack of thankfulness

ex.en: She was hurt by her friend's ingratitude after all her help.
ex.zh: 她幫了朋友那麼多，朋友卻不知感恩，讓她很受傷。

root.note: 不感激

senses.en: one of the foods or substances combined to make a dish or product
an element that contributes to something

ex.en: Trust is the key ingredient in any successful friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何成功友誼中最重要的要素。

root.note: 走進（成品）裡的東西 → 成分

senses.en: the state of being a natural, permanent part of something

ex.en: Philosophers debated the inherence of beauty in the objects themselves.
ex.zh: 哲學家們辯論美是否固有於事物本身。

root.note: 黏在裡面 → 固有

senses.en: existing as a natural, basic part of something

ex.en: There are inherent risks in any extreme sport.
ex.zh: 任何極限運動都有其固有的風險。

root.note: 黏在裡面的 → 固有的

senses.en: to hinder, restrain, or prevent an action or process
to make someone feel too self-conscious to act naturally

ex.en: Some medicines inhibit the growth of bacteria.
ex.zh: 有些藥物能抑制細菌生長。

root.note: 把它握住不放出 → 抑制

senses.en: (of a place) harsh and difficult to live in
unfriendly to guests

ex.en: Antarctica is one of the most inhospitable places on Earth.
ex.zh: 南極洲是地球上最不適合居住的地方之一。

root.note: 不善待客人的 → 不好客、不宜居的

senses.en: extremely cruel
not human in nature or appearance

ex.en: The prisoners were held in inhuman conditions.
ex.zh: 囚犯被關在不人道的環境中。

root.note: 沒有人性的 → 殘忍的

senses.en: (formal) to bury a dead body

ex.en: The family chose to inhume the remains in the village cemetery.
ex.zh: 家屬選擇把遺體葬在村裡的墓地。

root.note: 放進土裡 → 埋葬

senses.en: harmful or tending to obstruct
unfriendly; hostile

ex.en: High taxes can be inimical to small businesses.
ex.zh: 高稅率可能對小型企業不利。

root.note: 不是朋友的 → 有敵意的、有害的

senses.en: great injustice or immoral behavior

ex.en: The preacher warned his congregation against iniquity and greed.
ex.zh: 傳道人告誡會眾要遠離罪惡與貪婪。

root.note: 不公平 → 不公正；罪惡

mn: 常見片語 den of iniquity：罪惡的淵藪。

senses.en: to cause a process or action to begin
to admit someone into a group, often with a ceremony
[ɪˋnɪʃɪɪt] a person who has been newly admitted to a group

ex.en: The city plans to initiate a new recycling program next year.
ex.zh: 市政府計畫明年開始一項新的回收計畫。

root.note: 走進去 → 開始

senses.en: to put a liquid such as a drug into the body with a needle
to introduce a new quality into something

ex.en: The new manager tried to inject some fun into the weekly meetings.
ex.zh: 新經理試著為每週會議注入一些樂趣。

root.note: 投進去 → 注射；注入

senses.en: a court order requiring someone to do or stop doing something
an authoritative warning or order

ex.en: A judge issued an injunction to stop the construction.
ex.zh: 法官發出禁制令，要求停止施工。

root.note: 把命令加到某人身上 → 禁制令

senses.en: a slight suspicion or hint

ex.en: I had no inkling that they were planning a surprise party.
ex.zh: 我完全沒察覺他們在籌劃驚喜派對。

mn: 常見句型：have no inkling（毫無頭緒、完全沒察覺）。

senses.en: located away from the coast
toward or in the interior of a country

ex.en: The storm moved inland and weakened over the mountains.
ex.zh: 暴風雨移入內陸，在山區減弱。

root.note: 在陸地裡面 → 內陸

senses.en: a narrow strip of water that goes into the land from a sea or lake
an opening through which something enters

ex.en: We anchored our boat in a quiet inlet for the night.
ex.zh: 我們把船停泊在一處寧靜的小海灣過夜。

root.note: 讓水進來的地方 → 水灣

senses.en: deepest or most private; innermost

ex.en: She wrote her inmost thoughts in a diary that no one else read.
ex.zh: 她把內心最深處的想法寫在沒人看過的日記裡。

root.note: 最裡面的

senses.en: not harmful or offensive

ex.en: What seemed like an innocuous joke deeply hurt her feelings.
ex.zh: 一個看似無傷大雅的玩笑，卻深深傷了她的心。

root.note: 不傷害的 → 無害的

senses.en: to introduce new methods, ideas, or products

ex.en: Companies must innovate to stay ahead of their competitors.
ex.zh: 企業必須創新才能領先競爭對手。

root.note: 帶入新的東西 → 創新

senses.en: an indirect remark suggesting something bad or rude

ex.en: The article was full of innuendo but offered no real evidence.
ex.zh: 這篇文章充滿影射，卻沒有提出任何真正的證據。

root.note: 點頭示意 → 暗示、影射

senses.en: too many to be counted

ex.en: On a clear night, innumerable stars fill the sky.
ex.zh: 晴朗的夜裡，無數星星布滿天空。

root.note: 數不清的

senses.en: not likely to upset or offend anyone

ex.en: He was a quiet, inoffensive man who kept to himself.
ex.zh: 他是個安靜、與人無爭的人，不太跟人來往。

root.note: 不冒犯人的

senses.en: happening at an inconvenient or bad time
senses.zh: 不合時宜的；時機不對的

ex.en: The phone rang at an inopportune moment, right in the middle of the exam.
ex.zh: 電話在不該響的時候響了，就在考試進行到一半時。

root.note: 風向不利於進港的 → 時機不對的

senses.en: to ask for information
to investigate

ex.en: I called the hotel to inquire about room prices.
ex.zh: 我打電話到飯店詢問房價。

root.note: 探問進去 → 詢問

senses.en: a long, harsh period of questioning or investigation
(the Inquisition) a Catholic court that punished heresy in past centuries

ex.en: The job interview felt more like an inquisition than a conversation.
ex.zh: 那場求職面試感覺比較像審訊，而不是對談。

root.note: 深入追問 → 審訊

senses.en: curious and eager to learn
too interested in other people's affairs

ex.en: The inquisitive child asked dozens of questions about the stars.
ex.zh: 那個好奇的孩子問了好幾十個關於星星的問題。

root.note: 喜歡深入追問的 → 好奇的

senses.en: a person who questions others harshly
an official of the Inquisition

ex.en: The reporter questioned the mayor like a stern inquisitor.
ex.zh: 記者像嚴厲的審問者一樣質問市長。

root.note: 深入追問的人 → 審問者

senses.en: (usually plural) progress made in entering a new area or market
a sudden attack into enemy territory

ex.en: The new phone brand made its first inroad into the Asian market.
ex.zh: 這個新手機品牌首次打入亞洲市場。

root.note: 騎馬闖入 → 侵入；打入

mn: 常見片語 make inroads into：打入、侵蝕。

senses.en: impossible to satisfy
senses.zh: 無法滿足的；貪得無厭的

ex.en: She has an insatiable appetite for mystery novels.
ex.zh: 她對推理小說的胃口永遠填不飽。

root.note: 無法使滿足的

senses.en: to write or carve words on a surface
to write a dedication in a book

ex.en: The jeweler will inscribe their initials inside the ring.
ex.zh: 珠寶師會把他們名字的縮寫刻在戒指內側。

root.note: 寫在上面 → 刻、題寫

senses.en: impossible to understand or interpret
senses.zh: 難以捉摸的；高深莫測的

ex.en: The poker player kept an inscrutable expression throughout the game.
ex.zh: 那位撲克玩家整場都保持著讓人看不透的表情。

root.note: 無法看透的 → 難以捉摸的

senses.en: lacking confidence; anxious
senses.zh: 沒有安全感的；缺乏自信的

senses.en: not safe or firmly fixed

ex.en: Many teenagers feel insecure about their appearance.
ex.zh: 許多青少年對自己的外表缺乏自信。

root.note: 不能免於憂慮的 → 沒有安全感的

senses.en: unconscious
unaware of or indifferent to something
too small to be noticed

ex.en: He seemed insensible to the danger he was in.
ex.zh: 他似乎沒意識到自己身處危險之中。

root.note: 無法感覺的

mn: insensible 不是 sensible（明智的）的反義，而是「沒感覺」。

senses.en: lacking the ability to feel or perceive

ex.en: A rock is an insentient object that feels neither heat nor pain.
ex.zh: 石頭是無知覺的物體，既感覺不到熱也感覺不到痛。

root.note: 沒有感覺的

senses.en: unable to be separated; always together

ex.en: The two cousins were inseparable as children.
ex.zh: 這兩個表兄弟小時候形影不離。

root.note: 無法分開的

senses.en: spreading gradually and quietly in a harmful way

ex.en: High blood pressure is an insidious disease with few early symptoms.
ex.zh: 高血壓是一種悄悄危害健康的疾病，早期幾乎沒有症狀。

root.note: 坐在裡面埋伏的 → 暗中為害的

senses.en: a deep and accurate understanding of someone or something

ex.en: The documentary offers insight into the lives of deep-sea fishermen.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片讓人深入了解深海漁民的生活。

root.note: 看進內部 → 洞察

senses.en: the quality of being too small or unimportant to matter

ex.en: Looking at the night sky made him feel his own insignificance.
ex.zh: 仰望夜空讓他感受到自己的渺小。

root.note: 沒有意義 → 微不足道

senses.en: too small or unimportant to be worth considering

ex.en: The difference in price between the two stores was insignificant.
ex.zh: 兩家店的價差微不足道。

root.note: 不具意義的 → 不重要的

senses.en: to suggest something bad in an indirect way
to gradually work oneself into a position

ex.en: Are you trying to insinuate that I cheated on the test?
ex.zh: 你是在暗示我考試作弊嗎？

root.note: 彎彎曲曲地鑽進去 → 拐彎抹角地暗示

senses.en: lacking flavor
dull and uninteresting

ex.en: Critics called the movie's plot predictable and insipid.
ex.zh: 影評說這部電影情節老套又乏味。

root.note: 沒有味道的 → 乏味的

senses.en: the act of firmly demanding something or refusing to accept refusal

ex.en: At my mother's insistence, I wore a heavy coat.
ex.zh: 在我媽的堅持下，我穿了厚外套。

root.note: 站在原地不動 → 堅持

senses.en: demanding something firmly and not accepting refusal
continuing in a way that is hard to ignore

ex.en: She was insistent that we stay for dinner.
ex.zh: 她堅持要我們留下來吃晚飯。

root.note: 站著不動的 → 堅持的

senses.en: rude and disrespectful behavior

ex.en: The soldier was punished for his insolence toward the officer.
ex.zh: 那名士兵因對軍官無禮而受罰。

root.note: 不合慣例的態度 → 無禮

senses.en: rude and showing no respect

ex.en: The insolent customer shouted at the waiter over a small mistake.
ex.zh: 那個無禮的客人為了一點小錯就對服務生大吼。

root.note: 不合慣例的 → 無禮的

senses.en: the inability to sleep well

ex.en: Drinking coffee late at night can cause insomnia.
ex.zh: 深夜喝咖啡可能導致失眠。

root.note: 無法睡眠的症狀 → 失眠

senses.en: an official whose job is to check that rules are followed
a police officer of fairly high rank

ex.en: A health inspector visits the restaurant twice a year.
ex.zh: 衛生稽查員每年到這家餐廳檢查兩次。

root.note: 往裡面看的人 → 檢查員
