senses.en: an example or single occurrence of something

ex.en: This is just one instance of how the program has helped students.
ex.zh: 這只是這個計畫如何幫助學生的其中一個例子。

root.note: 站在眼前的事 → 實例

mn: 常見片語 for instance：例如。

senses.en: happening immediately
a very short moment
(of food) prepared quickly and easily

ex.en: The new app was an instant success.
ex.zh: 這款新應用程式一推出就大受歡迎。

root.note: 就站在眼前的 → 立即的

senses.en: happening immediately, without delay

ex.en: The effect of the medicine was almost instantaneous.
ex.zh: 這種藥的效果幾乎是立即見效。

root.note: 瞬間的

senses.en: to cause something to start, especially something bad

ex.en: The police believe a small group tried to instigate the riot.
ex.zh: 警方認為有一小群人試圖煽動這場暴動。

root.note: 用棒子戳使行動 → 煽動

senses.en: a person who causes something to start, especially trouble

ex.en: The teacher tried to find out who was the instigator of the food fight.
ex.zh: 老師想找出誰是這場食物大戰的始作俑者。

root.note: 煽動的人

senses.en: to gradually establish an idea or feeling in someone's mind

ex.en: Good teachers instill a love of learning in their students.
ex.zh: 好老師會在學生心中培養對學習的熱愛。

root.note: 一滴一滴地滴進去 → 逐漸灌輸

senses.en: useful and informative; teaching something
senses.zh: 有教育意義的；有啟發性的

ex.en: It is instructive to compare how different countries handled the crisis.
ex.zh: 比較各國如何處理這場危機，很有啟發性。

root.note: 在心中建構知識的 → 有教育意義的

senses.en: the condition of not being enough
(medicine) the failure of an organ to work properly

ex.en: The project stalled because of an insufficiency of funds.
ex.zh: 這個計畫因為資金不足而停擺。

root.note: 不足夠

senses.en: not enough

ex.en: The judge ruled that there was insufficient evidence to convict him.
ex.zh: 法官裁定證據不足以定他的罪。

root.note: 不足夠的

senses.en: narrow-minded and uninterested in outside ideas
relating to an island

ex.en: The small, insular community was suspicious of newcomers.
ex.zh: 這個封閉的小社區對新來的人抱持懷疑。

root.note: 像孤島一樣的 → 閉塞的

senses.en: to cover something to prevent heat, sound, or electricity from passing
to protect someone from unpleasant influences

ex.en: We need to insulate the attic before winter.
ex.zh: 我們得在冬天前幫閣樓做隔熱。

root.note: 使像孤島一樣隔開 → 隔絕

senses.en: impossible to overcome

ex.en: The team faced what seemed like insuperable obstacles.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍面臨看似無法克服的障礙。

root.note: 無法越過的 → 無法克服的

senses.en: impossible to hold back or control

ex.en: An insuppressible giggle escaped her during the serious speech.
ex.zh: 在嚴肅的演講中，她忍不住咯咯笑了出來。

root.note: 壓不下去的

senses.en: an uprising or rebellion against authority

ex.en: The government sent troops to put down the insurgence in the north.
ex.zh: 政府派軍隊鎮壓北方的叛亂。

root.note: 起來反抗 → 叛亂

senses.en: a person fighting against a government or authority
rising up against authority

ex.en: An insurgent group took control of the border town.
ex.zh: 一個叛亂團體控制了這座邊境城鎮。

root.note: 起來反抗的（人）

senses.en: a violent uprising against a government

ex.en: The insurrection was crushed within a week.
ex.zh: 這場暴動在一週內就被鎮壓了。

root.note: 起來反抗 → 暴動

senses.en: not able to be touched; not physical
hard to describe or define
senses.zh: 難以捉摸的；難以言說的

ex.en: Team spirit is an intangible quality that can win championships.
ex.zh: 團隊精神是一種能贏得冠軍的無形特質。

root.note: 摸不到的 → 無形的

senses.en: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles
the state of being whole and undivided

ex.en: She is a journalist of great integrity who never accepts bribes.
ex.zh: 她是一位非常正直的記者，從不收受賄賂。

root.note: 未被碰觸、完好無缺 → 完整；正直

senses.en: the ability to think logically and understand ideas
a very intelligent person

ex.en: She was admired for her sharp intellect and quick wit.
ex.zh: 她以敏銳的智力和機智受人欽佩。

root.note: 在事物之間做選擇的能力 → 智力

senses.en: relating to the ability to think and understand
a person who is highly educated and enjoys thinking about ideas

ex.en: Chess is a game that requires great intellectual effort.
ex.zh: 西洋棋是一種需要大量腦力的遊戲。

root.note: 與智力有關的

senses.en: the ability to learn, understand, and think
secret information gathered about an enemy or rival

ex.en: Crows show remarkable intelligence when solving puzzles.
ex.zh: 烏鴉在解謎時展現出驚人的智力。

root.note: 能在事物之間辨別的能力 → 智力

senses.en: able to be understood

ex.en: The static made his voice barely intelligible over the radio.
ex.zh: 雜訊讓他在無線電裡的聲音幾乎聽不清楚。

root.note: 能被理解的

mn: intelligible（可理解的）≠ intelligent（聰明的）。

senses.en: lack of self-control, especially in drinking alcohol

ex.en: His intemperance eventually ruined both his health and his career.
ex.zh: 他的放縱最終毀了他的健康和事業。

root.note: 不節制

senses.en: (logic) the set of qualities that define a word or concept
(old use) intensity; great mental effort

ex.en: In logic class, we learned that the intension of "triangle" is "a shape with three sides."
ex.zh: 在邏輯課上，我們學到「三角形」的內涵是「有三個邊的圖形」。

root.note: 向內伸展 → 內涵

mn: 注意拼法：intension（內涵）≠ intention（意圖），發音相同。

senses.en: concentrated on one area in a short time; thorough
(farming) aiming to produce as much as possible from a small area

ex.en: She took an intensive Japanese course over the summer.
ex.zh: 她暑假上了一門日文密集課程。

root.note: 拉緊的 → 密集的

mn: 常見片語 intensive care unit（ICU）：加護病房。

senses.en: something that you plan or mean to do

ex.en: I have no intention of quitting before the job is done.
ex.zh: 工作沒完成之前我沒打算放棄。

root.note: 把心思伸向某目標 → 意圖

senses.en: to communicate or work together
to have an effect on each other

ex.en: Children learn social skills when they interact with others.
ex.zh: 孩子在與他人互動時學會社交技巧。

root.note: 彼此之間互相作用 → 互動

senses.en: to speak or act on behalf of someone in trouble
to step in to help settle a dispute

ex.en: She asked the principal to intercede with the teacher on her behalf.
ex.zh: 她請校長幫她向老師說情。

root.note: 走到兩方之間 → 說情、調停

senses.en: to stop and catch someone or something before it reaches its destination

ex.en: The defender jumped to intercept the pass.
ex.zh: 防守球員跳起來攔截傳球。

root.note: 在中途拿走 → 攔截

senses.en: the act of speaking or acting on behalf of another

ex.en: Only the intercession of the embassy secured the prisoner's release.
ex.zh: 全靠大使館出面斡旋，那名囚犯才獲釋。

root.note: 走到兩方之間 → 調解

senses.en: a person who speaks or acts on behalf of another

ex.en: The village elder acted as an intercessor between the two families.
ex.zh: 村中長老擔任兩家之間的調解人。

root.note: 走到兩方之間的人 → 調解人

senses.en: to forbid something officially; to stop the movement of goods
[ˋɪntɚˏdɪkt] an official order forbidding something

ex.en: The navy tried to interdict shipments of illegal weapons.
ex.zh: 海軍試圖攔截非法武器的運送。

root.note: 在中間說話阻止 → 禁止

senses.en: temporary; serving until something permanent is arranged
the time between two events

ex.en: The board appointed an interim director while it searched for a new one.
ex.zh: 董事會在尋找新主任期間任命了一位代理主任。

root.note: 在兩者之間 → 過渡期

mn: 常見片語 in the interim：在此期間。

senses.en: a person who takes part in a conversation
a person who acts as a go-between in talks

ex.en: She was a thoughtful interlocutor who listened more than she spoke.
ex.zh: 她是個體貼的談話對象，聽得比說得多。

root.note: 在彼此之間說話的人 → 對話者

senses.en: a short period of time between two events
a short piece of music or performance between parts of a longer work

ex.en: The sunny afternoon was a brief interlude in a week of rain.
ex.zh: 那個晴朗的下午是一週陰雨中的短暫插曲。

root.note: 兩段之間的表演 → 插曲

senses.en: between two stages, levels, or points

ex.en: This class is for intermediate learners who already know basic grammar.
ex.zh: 這門課是給已經懂基礎文法的中級學習者上的。

root.note: 在中間的

senses.en: seeming to last forever, in a tiresome way

ex.en: We sat through an interminable meeting that lasted four hours.
ex.zh: 我們熬過一場長達四小時、沒完沒了的會議。

root.note: 沒有終點的 → 沒完沒了的

senses.en: a short break between parts of a play, concert, or film

ex.en: We bought snacks during the intermission.
ex.zh: 我們在中場休息時買了點心。

root.note: 在中間放開一段時間 → 中場休息

senses.en: to stop for a time; to suspend

ex.en: The fever seemed to intermit for a day before returning.
ex.zh: 燒似乎退了一天，後來又回來了。

root.note: 在中間放開 → 暫停

senses.en: stopping and starting at irregular intervals

ex.en: The forecast calls for intermittent rain throughout the afternoon.
ex.zh: 天氣預報說整個下午會有間歇性降雨。

root.note: 中間有停頓的 → 斷斷續續的

senses.en: the insertion of words into a text or conversation
senses.zh: 插入的話語；（文本）竄改、增補

senses.en: (math) estimating a value between known values

ex.en: Scholars believe this line is a later interpolation, not part of the original poem.
ex.zh: 學者認為這一行是後人添加的，並非原詩的一部分。

root.note: 在中間加以修飾 → 插入、竄改

senses.en: to place something between two things
to interrupt a conversation with a remark

ex.en: The referee had to interpose himself between the two angry players.
ex.zh: 裁判只得站到兩名憤怒的球員中間。

root.note: 放在中間 → 介入

senses.en: the act of placing something between others or of intervening

ex.en: The interposition of a mountain range protects the valley from cold winds.
ex.zh: 一道山脈橫亙其間，使山谷免受冷風吹襲。

root.note: 放在中間 → 介入

senses.en: a person who translates speech from one language to another
a person who explains the meaning of something

ex.en: The president spoke through an interpreter at the summit.
ex.zh: 總統在高峰會上透過口譯員發言。

root.note: 在雙方之間協調的人 → 口譯員

senses.en: to question someone closely or aggressively

ex.en: Detectives will interrogate the suspect tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 警探明天早上會審問嫌犯。

root.note: 反覆詢問 → 審問

senses.en: having the form or function of a question
(grammar) a word used to ask a question

ex.en: For homework, turn each statement into an interrogative sentence.
ex.zh: 作業是把每個直述句改成疑問句。

root.note: 發問的 → 疑問的

senses.en: expressing a question
(law) a written question that must be answered under oath

ex.en: The lawyer sent a written interrogatory to the other side.
ex.zh: 律師向對方寄出一份書面質詢。

root.note: 用來發問的 → 質詢

senses.en: to stop someone while they are speaking or doing something
to cause something to stop for a time

ex.en: Please don't interrupt me while I'm explaining the rules.
ex.zh: 我在解釋規則的時候請不要打斷我。

root.note: 從中間打斷

senses.en: to cross or divide each other

ex.en: The two highways intersect just north of the city.
ex.zh: 這兩條公路在城市北邊交會。

root.note: 從中間切過 → 相交

senses.en: (regional, New England) a low, flat area of land along a river
senses.zh: （美國新英格蘭方言）河谷低地

ex.en: The farmers grew corn in the rich soil of the intervale.
ex.zh: 農民們在河谷低地的沃土上種玉米。

root.note: 山丘之間的河谷低地

senses.en: to become involved in a situation to change or improve it
to happen between two events

ex.en: The teacher had to intervene when the argument turned into a fight.
ex.zh: 爭吵演變成打架時，老師只好出面介入。

root.note: 來到中間 → 介入

senses.en: the condition of dying without a valid will

ex.en: In cases of intestacy, the law decides who inherits the property.
ex.zh: 在無遺囑死亡的情況下，由法律決定財產由誰繼承。

root.note: 沒有遺囑的狀態

senses.en: not having made a will before death

ex.en: Because he died intestate, his estate was divided according to state law.
ex.zh: 由於他死時沒有留下遺囑，他的遺產依州法分配。

root.note: 沒立遺囑的

senses.en: the long tube in the body that carries food from the stomach
(of conflict) within a country; internal

ex.en: Most nutrients are absorbed in the small intestine.
ex.zh: 大部分養分是在小腸被吸收的。

root.note: 身體內部的器官 → 腸

senses.en: a close, familiar, and affectionate relationship
a cozy, private atmosphere

ex.en: The small café has a warm intimacy that big chains lack.
ex.zh: 這家小咖啡館有種大型連鎖店沒有的溫馨私密感。

root.note: 最內心的關係 → 親密

senses.en: to frighten someone, especially to make them do what you want

ex.en: Don't let the size of the exam intimidate you.
ex.zh: 別被考試的份量嚇到。

root.note: 使膽小 → 恐嚇

senses.en: impossible to bear or endure

ex.en: The noise from the construction site was intolerable.
ex.zh: 工地的噪音讓人無法忍受。

root.note: 無法忍受的

senses.en: unwillingness to accept views or behavior different from one's own
(medicine) inability to eat or use a food or drug without bad effects

ex.en: The museum exhibit teaches visitors about the dangers of religious intolerance.
ex.zh: 這個博物館展覽教導參觀者宗教不寬容的危害。

root.note: 不能容忍

mn: lactose intolerance：乳糖不耐症。

senses.en: unwilling to accept views or behavior different from one's own
unable to eat or use something without bad effects

ex.en: He is intolerant of anyone who disagrees with him.
ex.zh: 他無法容忍任何和他意見不同的人。

root.note: 不能容忍的

senses.en: a substance such as alcohol that makes people drunk

ex.en: The law bans the sale of any intoxicant to minors.
ex.zh: 法律禁止販售任何致醉物給未成年人。

root.note: 使人中毒（醉）的東西

senses.en: to make someone drunk
to excite someone greatly

ex.en: Success can intoxicate a young star and make him arrogant.
ex.zh: 成功可能讓年輕明星沖昏頭而變得自大。

root.note: 使中毒 → 使醉

senses.en: located or occurring inside a cell

ex.en: Some viruses are intracellular parasites that can only live inside host cells.
ex.zh: 有些病毒是細胞內寄生物，只能在宿主細胞內生存。

root.note: 細胞內的

senses.en: taking place within a single school or institution

ex.en: He plays on an intramural basketball team with his classmates.
ex.zh: 他和同學一起參加校內籃球隊。

root.note: 在牆內的 → 校內的

senses.en: fearless and adventurous

ex.en: The intrepid explorers crossed the frozen sea on foot.
ex.zh: 這群無畏的探險家徒步穿越結冰的海洋。

root.note: 不驚慌發抖的 → 無畏的

mn: 反義是 trepidation（驚恐）。

senses.en: the quality of being complicated or detailed
(intricacies) the complicated details of something

ex.en: Visitors admired the intricacy of the carved wooden doors.
ex.zh: 遊客們讚嘆那扇木雕門的精緻繁複。

root.note: 纏進障礙中 → 錯綜複雜

senses.en: very complicated or detailed

ex.en: The rug has an intricate pattern of flowers and birds.
ex.zh: 這塊地毯有花鳥交織的精細圖案。

root.note: 纏進障礙中的 → 錯綜複雜的

senses.en: to arouse someone's curiosity or interest
secret planning of something harmful; a plot

ex.en: The strange title of the book will intrigue many readers.
ex.zh: 這本書古怪的書名會引起許多讀者的好奇。

parts.m: tricks, obstacles 詭計、糾纏（= tric）

root.note: 使纏進去 → 陰謀；吸引

senses.en: belonging naturally to something; essential

ex.en: The old letters have little money value but great intrinsic worth to the family.
ex.zh: 這些舊信件沒什麼金錢價值，但對這家人有很大的內在價值。

root.note: 在內部的 → 本質的

senses.en: serving to introduce a subject or begin something
(of an offer) available at a special price for a new product

ex.en: I signed up for an introductory course in psychology.
ex.zh: 我報名了一門心理學入門課。

root.note: 引領進入的 → 入門的

senses.en: (genetics) the movement of genes from one species into another through repeated interbreeding

ex.en: Scientists found evidence of introgression between wild and farmed salmon.
ex.zh: 科學家發現野生鮭魚與養殖鮭魚之間有基因滲入的證據。

root.note: 走進去 → 基因滲入

senses.en: (formal) to put in, insert, or let in

ex.en: The valve is designed to intromit air but keep water out.
ex.zh: 這個閥門的設計是讓空氣進入，但把水擋在外面。

root.note: 送進去 → 放入

senses.en: to examine one's own thoughts and feelings

ex.en: After the loss, the coach asked each player to introspect and find ways to improve.
ex.zh: 輸球之後，教練要每位球員自我反省，找出改進的方法。

root.note: 向內看 → 內省

senses.en: the examination of one's own thoughts and feelings

ex.en: A long walk alone is a good time for introspection.
ex.zh: 獨自散步很久是自我反省的好時機。

root.note: 向內看 → 內省

senses.en: the tendency to focus on one's own thoughts and prefer quiet settings

ex.en: Introversion is not the same as shyness; many introverts are confident.
ex.zh: 內向和害羞並不相同，許多內向的人都很有自信。

root.note: 向內轉 → 內向

senses.en: a quiet person who prefers to focus on their own thoughts

ex.en: As an introvert, she recharges by spending time alone.
ex.zh: 身為內向的人，她靠獨處來充電。

root.note: 心思向內轉的人 → 內向者

senses.en: to enter or interrupt where one is not welcome

ex.en: I'm sorry to intrude, but there is an urgent call for you.
ex.zh: 抱歉打擾了，有一通找你的緊急電話。

root.note: 推擠進去 → 闖入

senses.en: the act of entering a place or situation where one is not welcome

ex.en: Many people see the new cameras as an intrusion on their privacy.
ex.zh: 許多人認為新裝的監視器侵犯了他們的隱私。

root.note: 推擠進去 → 侵入

senses.en: the ability to understand something immediately without conscious reasoning

ex.en: My intuition told me something was wrong before I opened the door.
ex.zh: 開門之前，我的直覺就告訴我事情不對勁。

root.note: 一眼看出 → 直覺

senses.en: to overwhelm with a large amount of things
to flood

ex.en: Fans will inundate the website with orders when the tickets go on sale.
ex.zh: 門票一開賣，歌迷的訂單就會湧進網站。

root.note: 波浪湧上來 → 淹沒

senses.en: a flood; an overwhelming amount of something

ex.en: The inundation of the rice fields ruined the harvest.
ex.zh: 稻田被水淹沒，毀了收成。

root.note: 波浪湧上來 → 洪水

senses.en: to make someone used to something unpleasant

ex.en: Years of working in the ER can inure doctors to the sight of blood.
ex.zh: 在急診室工作多年，醫生對血腥場面會變得習以為常。

parts.m: use, work 使用（古法文 euvre）

root.note: 用久了 → 使習慣

mn: 常用句型 be inured to：對…習以為常。

senses.en: not legally or officially acceptable
not based on sound reasoning
[ˋɪnvəlɪd] a person weakened by illness or injury

ex.en: Your passport is invalid because it expired last month.
ex.zh: 你的護照上個月到期，已經失效了。

parts.m: strong, worth 有力的、有價值的

root.note: 沒有效力的 → 無效的

mn: 形容詞「無效的」重音在第二音節；名詞「病人」重音在第一音節。

senses.en: to make something legally void
to prove an argument or theory wrong

ex.en: Opening the device yourself will invalidate the warranty.
ex.zh: 自行拆開這個裝置會讓保固失效。

root.note: 使無效

senses.en: extremely useful or valuable

ex.en: Your advice has been invaluable to me during this difficult time.
ex.zh: 在這段艱難時期，你的建議對我來說非常寶貴。

root.note: 價值高到無法估計的 → 無價的

mn: invaluable 不是「沒價值」，而是「價值高到無法估算」；「沒價值」是 valueless。

senses.en: never changing

ex.en: His invariable breakfast is toast and black coffee.
ex.zh: 他的早餐一成不變，總是吐司配黑咖啡。

root.note: 不會變的

senses.en: the act of an army entering a country by force
an unwelcome intrusion

ex.en: Reading someone's diary is an invasion of privacy.
ex.zh: 偷看別人的日記是侵犯隱私。

root.note: 走進（別人的地方）→ 入侵

senses.en: insulting, abusive, or highly critical language

ex.en: The online debate quickly turned into a stream of invective.
ex.zh: 網路上的辯論很快就變成一連串的謾罵。

root.note: 把話帶著衝向對方 → 謾罵

senses.en: to speak or write about something with great hostility

ex.en: The critic loves to inveigh against modern architecture.
ex.zh: 那位評論家很喜歡猛烈抨擊現代建築。

root.note: 帶著怒氣衝向對方 → 抨擊

mn: 常與 against 連用：inveigh against；gh 不發音。

senses.en: having or showing creativity and new ideas
senses.zh: 有創意的；有發明才能的

ex.en: The chef is known for her inventive use of local ingredients.
ex.zh: 這位主廚以創意運用在地食材聞名。

root.note: 想法自己冒出來的 → 有創意的

senses.en: opposite in position, direction, or relationship
the exact opposite

ex.en: There is an inverse relationship between price and demand.
ex.zh: 價格和需求之間呈反向關係。

root.note: 轉過來的 → 相反的

senses.en: the act of turning something upside down or reversing its order
(grammar) reversing the normal word order

ex.en: "Never have I seen such a mess" is an example of inversion.
ex.zh: 「Never have I seen such a mess」是倒裝句的例子。

root.note: 翻轉過來 → 倒置

senses.en: to turn upside down or reverse the order of

ex.en: Carefully invert the cake pan onto a plate.
ex.zh: 小心地把蛋糕模倒扣在盤子上。

root.note: 轉過來 → 倒置

senses.en: a person who examines facts to discover the truth

ex.en: An insurance investigator examined the damaged car.
ex.zh: 保險調查員檢查了那輛受損的車。

root.note: 循著足跡追查的人 → 調查員

senses.en: a person or organization that puts money into something to earn a profit

ex.en: The startup found an investor willing to fund its first year.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司找到一位願意資助第一年營運的投資人。

root.note: 把錢「穿」進事業中的人 → 投資人

senses.en: having a long-established habit that is unlikely to change
senses.zh: 根深柢固的；積習難改的

ex.en: My uncle is an inveterate gambler who cannot pass a casino.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是個積習難改的賭徒，經過賭場就忍不住進去。

root.note: 年代久遠的 → 根深柢固的

senses.en: likely to cause resentment or unfairly discriminating

ex.en: The coach was in the invidious position of choosing between two friends.
ex.zh: 教練陷入必須在兩位朋友中二選一、吃力不討好的處境。

root.note: 用嫉妒的眼光看 → 招人嫉恨的

senses.en: to give strength, energy, or life to

ex.en: A cold shower can invigorate you in the morning.
ex.zh: 早上沖個冷水澡能讓你精神一振。

root.note: 注入活力

senses.en: too strong to be defeated

ex.en: After ten straight wins, the team seemed invincible.
ex.zh: 連贏十場後，這支球隊似乎所向無敵。

root.note: 無法被征服的

senses.en: never to be broken, attacked, or dishonored

ex.en: The constitution treats freedom of speech as an inviolable right.
ex.zh: 憲法把言論自由視為不可侵犯的權利。

root.note: 不能被侵犯的

senses.en: to cite or appeal to a law, rule, or authority as support
to call on a god or spirit for help
to bring a feeling or image to mind

ex.en: The witness decided to invoke her right to remain silent.
ex.zh: 證人決定行使她的緘默權。

root.note: 向…呼喚 → 援引；祈求

mn: invoke（援引、祈求）vs. evoke（喚起回憶或感受）。

senses.en: done without conscious control
done against one's will

ex.en: She let out an involuntary gasp when she saw the price.
ex.zh: 她看到價錢時忍不住倒抽一口氣。

root.note: 不是出於意志的 → 不自覺的

senses.en: the process of becoming complicated or intricate
(biology) the shrinking of an organ to its former size

ex.en: The involution of the plot made the novel hard to follow.
ex.zh: 這部小說情節錯綜複雜，很難讀懂。

root.note: 向內捲 → 糾纏、退縮

mn: 中國網路用語「內捲」常譯為 involution。

senses.en: to include something as a necessary part
to cause someone to take part in something

ex.en: The job will involve a lot of travel.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要經常出差。

root.note: 捲進來 → 牽涉、包含

senses.en: impossible to harm or damage
senses.zh: 刀槍不入的；無懈可擊的

ex.en: No computer system is completely invulnerable to hackers.
ex.zh: 沒有任何電腦系統能完全不受駭客攻擊。

root.note: 不會受傷的

senses.en: privately, in one's mind, without showing it

ex.en: She smiled politely but inwardly groaned at the bad joke.
ex.zh: 她禮貌地微笑，心裡卻對那個爛笑話暗自叫苦。

root.note: 向內地 → 在內心

senses.en: an extremely small amount
the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet

ex.en: There is not one iota of truth in that rumor.
ex.zh: 那則謠言沒有半點真實性。

mn: iota 是希臘字母中最小的一個，所以引申為「一丁點」。

senses.en: easily made angry

ex.en: The irascible old man yelled at anyone who parked near his house.
ex.zh: 那個脾氣暴躁的老人會對任何把車停在他家附近的人大吼。

root.note: 容易發怒的

senses.en: extremely angry

ex.en: Irate passengers crowded the desk after the flight was canceled.
ex.zh: 班機取消後，憤怒的乘客擠滿了櫃台。

root.note: 充滿怒氣的

senses.en: anger

ex.en: The new parking fees drew the ire of local residents.
ex.zh: 新的停車費引發當地居民的怒火。

mn: 常見說法 draw the ire of：引起…的憤怒。

senses.en: a display of shimmering rainbow colors that change with the angle of view

ex.en: The iridescence of the beetle's shell comes from tiny layered structures.
ex.zh: 這種甲蟲外殼的虹彩來自微小的層狀結構。

root.note: 呈現彩虹般的顏色 → 虹彩

senses.en: showing shimmering colors that change with the angle of view

ex.en: Soap bubbles have an iridescent surface.
ex.zh: 肥皂泡有彩虹般閃爍的表面。

root.note: 有彩虹色的

senses.en: to irritate or annoy

ex.en: It will irk her if you are late again.
ex.zh: 如果你又遲到，她會很不高興。

senses.en: annoying or tiresome

ex.en: Filling out the same form three times was irksome.
ex.zh: 同一份表格要填三次真令人厭煩。

root.note: 令人厭煩的

senses.en: a situation that is strange or funny because it is the opposite of what is expected
the use of words to express the opposite of their literal meaning

ex.en: The irony is that the fire station burned down.
ex.zh: 諷刺的是，消防局自己被燒毀了。

parts.m: pretended ignorance 假裝無知（希臘文 eirōneia）

root.note: 假裝不懂、說反話 → 反諷

mn: 發音 [ˋaɪrənɪ]，和 iron（鐵）無關。

senses.en: (physics) the amount of light energy falling on a surface
(literary) radiance; brightness

ex.en: Solar panels produce more power when irradiance is high.
ex.zh: 輻照度高時，太陽能板的發電量更大。

root.note: 光線照在上面 → 輻照度

senses.en: to expose something to radiation
to light up; to make bright

ex.en: Some companies irradiate food to kill harmful bacteria.
ex.zh: 有些公司用輻射照射食品來殺死有害細菌。

root.note: 把光線照在上面

senses.en: not logical or reasonable
(math) not expressible as a ratio of two integers

ex.en: She has an irrational fear of butterflies.
ex.zh: 她莫名其妙地害怕蝴蝶。

root.note: 不理性的

senses.en: impossible to reduce or simplify further
senses.zh: 不能再簡化的；不可約的

ex.en: The report cut costs to an irreducible minimum.
ex.zh: 這份報告把成本壓到無法再低的最低限度。

root.note: 無法再縮減的

senses.en: impossible to refute or deny
senses.zh: 無可辯駁的；不容置疑的

ex.en: The fingerprints provided irrefragable evidence of his presence.
ex.zh: 指紋提供了他在場的無可辯駁的證據。

root.note: 無法被反駁打破的

senses.en: not to be broken or violated
senses.zh: 不可違背的；牢不可破的

senses.en: (of light) not able to be refracted

ex.en: The monks followed an irrefrangible rule of silence.
ex.zh: 修士們遵守一條不可違背的靜默戒律。

root.note: 無法打破的

senses.en: not connected with or important to the matter

ex.en: Your age is irrelevant to whether you can join the club.
ex.zh: 你的年齡和你能不能加入社團無關。

root.note: 不能拿來支撐論點的 → 不相干的

senses.en: not religious; hostile to or indifferent to religion
senses.zh: 無宗教信仰的；反宗教的

ex.en: Though raised in an irreligious home, she later became a nun.
ex.zh: 雖然她在沒有宗教信仰的家庭長大，後來卻成了修女。

root.note: 不信宗教的

senses.en: impossible to repair or put right
senses.zh: 無法修復的；不可挽回的

ex.en: The flood caused irreparable damage to the old library.
ex.zh: 洪水對那座老圖書館造成無法挽回的損害。

root.note: 無法修復的

mn: 重音在第二音節：ir-REP-arable。

senses.en: not able to be controlled or held back, usually in a cheerful way
senses.zh: 抑制不住的；活力十足的

ex.en: Her irrepressible enthusiasm made everyone want to join the project.
ex.zh: 她那壓抑不住的熱情讓大家都想加入這個計畫。

root.note: 壓不回去的

senses.en: too attractive or strong to be resisted

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味讓人無法抗拒。

root.note: 無法站著對抗的 → 無法抗拒的

senses.en: not showing proper care for the consequences of one's actions

ex.en: It is irresponsible to text while driving.
ex.zh: 開車時傳簡訊是不負責任的行為。

root.note: 無法回應承諾的 → 不負責任的

senses.en: a lack of respect for people or things usually taken seriously

ex.en: The comedian is famous for his irreverence toward politicians.
ex.zh: 這位喜劇演員以對政客毫不客氣聞名。

root.note: 不敬畏 → 不敬

senses.en: showing a lack of respect, often in a humorous way

ex.en: The magazine is known for its irreverent humor.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌以玩世不恭的幽默著稱。

root.note: 不敬畏的 → 不敬的

senses.en: (rare) showing a lack of reverence; irreverent

ex.en: His irreverential remarks at the ceremony offended the elders.
ex.zh: 他在典禮上不敬的言論冒犯了長輩們。

root.note: 不敬畏的

senses.en: impossible to change back to a previous state

ex.en: Some effects of climate change may already be irreversible.
ex.zh: 氣候變遷的某些影響可能已經無法逆轉。

root.note: 無法轉回的

senses.en: (medicine) a liquid used to wash out a wound or body cavity

ex.en: The dentist used a saline irrigant to clean the tooth.
ex.zh: 牙醫用食鹽水沖洗液清潔那顆牙齒。

root.note: 用來沖洗的液體

senses.en: to supply water to land or crops through channels or pipes
(medicine) to wash out a wound with a flow of liquid

ex.en: Farmers use river water to irrigate their fields.
ex.zh: 農民利用河水灌溉田地。

root.note: 把水引進去 → 灌溉

senses.en: easily annoyed or made angry
(of a body part) overly sensitive
senses.zh: （身體部位）過敏的；易受刺激的

ex.en: Lack of sleep makes me irritable in the morning.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足讓我早上很煩躁。

root.note: 容易被激怒的

senses.en: the quality of causing irritation or annoyance

ex.en: Scientists tested the skin irritancy of the new soap.
ex.zh: 科學家測試了新肥皂對皮膚的刺激性。

root.note: 引起刺激的性質

senses.en: a substance that causes slight swelling or discomfort
something that continually annoys

ex.en: Smoke is a common irritant for people with asthma.
ex.zh: 煙對氣喘患者來說是常見的刺激物。

root.note: 引起刺激的東西

senses.en: to make someone annoyed or angry
to cause soreness or discomfort to part of the body

ex.en: Wool sweaters often irritate my skin.
ex.zh: 羊毛衣常會刺激我的皮膚。

root.note: 激怒

senses.en: a sudden, violent entry; a sudden increase in an animal population

ex.en: Birdwatchers were thrilled by the irruption of snowy owls this winter.
ex.zh: 今年冬天雪鴞數量暴增，讓賞鳥人士興奮不已。

root.note: 破門而入 → 闖入

mn: irruption 是「衝進來」；eruption 是「爆發出去」。

senses.en: (literary) an island, especially a small one

ex.en: They spent their honeymoon on a quiet isle in the Mediterranean.
ex.zh: 他們在地中海一座寧靜的小島上度蜜月。

mn: s 不發音，和 aisle（走道）同音。

senses.en: a very small island

ex.en: Seabirds nest on a rocky islet just off the coast.
ex.zh: 海鳥在海岸外一座岩石小島上築巢。

root.note: 小島

senses.en: a line on a weather map connecting places with the same air pressure

ex.en: On a weather map, each isobar connects places with equal air pressure.
ex.zh: 在天氣圖上，每一條等壓線都連接氣壓相等的地點。

root.note: 氣壓相等的線

senses.en: occurring at equal intervals of time

ex.en: A pendulum's swings are nearly isochronous, which makes it useful in clocks.
ex.zh: 鐘擺的擺動幾乎是等時的，所以適合用在時鐘上。

root.note: 時間相等的

senses.en: to separate someone or something from others
to identify and separate out a substance or cause

ex.en: Doctors had to isolate the patient to stop the infection from spreading.
ex.zh: 醫生必須隔離病人，以防感染擴散。

root.note: 使成為孤島 → 隔離

senses.en: having or taking place at a constant temperature

ex.en: In an isothermal process, the gas stays at the same temperature.
ex.zh: 在等溫過程中，氣體保持相同溫度。

root.note: 溫度相等的

senses.en: traveling from place to place, especially for work
a person who travels from place to place

ex.en: The itinerant musician played in a different town every night.
ex.zh: 那位流浪樂手每晚都在不同的小鎮演出。

root.note: 一直在旅途中的 → 巡迴的

senses.en: a planned route or schedule for a trip

ex.en: Our itinerary includes three days in Kyoto and two in Osaka.
ex.zh: 我們的行程包括在京都三天、大阪兩天。

root.note: 旅程的安排 → 行程

senses.en: to travel from place to place, especially to preach or work

ex.en: In the 1800s, many preachers would itinerate through frontier towns.
ex.zh: 在 19 世紀，許多傳教士會在邊疆小鎮之間巡迴佈道。

root.note: 一路旅行 → 巡迴

senses.en: special words used by a particular group that others find hard to understand

ex.en: The lawyer explained the contract without using legal jargon.
ex.zh: 律師不用法律術語，把合約解釋得很清楚。

senses.en: a medical condition that makes the skin and eyes turn yellow
bitterness or resentful cynicism

ex.en: The newborn baby was treated for mild jaundice.
ex.zh: 那個新生兒接受了輕微黃疸的治療。

root.note: 皮膚變黃的病 → 黃疸

mn: 形容詞 jaundiced 常指「帶有偏見、憤世嫉俗的」，如 a jaundiced view。

senses.en: to put something at risk of being harmed or lost

ex.en: One careless mistake could jeopardize the whole mission.
ex.zh: 一個粗心的錯誤就可能危及整個任務。

parts.m: even game, risk 勝負未定的賭局（古法文 jeu parti）

root.note: 勝負未定、置於風險中 → 危及

senses.en: a person who supports an aggressive, warlike foreign policy; an extreme patriot
senses.zh: 好戰的愛國主義者；沙文主義者

senses.en: (by jingo) an old-fashioned exclamation of surprise

ex.en: Every jingo in parliament cheered for war.
ex.zh: 國會裡每個好戰的沙文主義者都為開戰喝采。

mn: 源自 19 世紀英國的愛國歌曲「We don't want to fight, but by Jingo if we do」，衍生 jingoism（好戰愛國主義）。

senses.en: playful or humorous

ex.en: His jocose manner put the nervous guests at ease.
ex.zh: 他詼諧的態度讓緊張的客人放鬆下來。

root.note: 充滿玩笑的 → 詼諧的

senses.en: fond of joking; humorous

ex.en: The principal gave a jocular speech that made the students laugh.
ex.zh: 校長發表了一場幽默的演講，逗得學生哈哈大笑。

root.note: 愛開玩笑的

senses.en: to shake or move with small, quick jerks
a slight shake or jolt

ex.en: Try not to joggle the table while I'm pouring the tea.
ex.zh: 我倒茶的時候盡量別晃到桌子。

root.note: 反覆輕推 → 輕搖

senses.en: to record in a journal or diary; (accounting) to enter a transaction in a journal
senses.zh: 記入日記；（會計）記入日記帳

ex.en: Accountants must journalize every sale before posting it to the ledger.
ex.zh: 會計人員必須先把每筆銷售記入日記帳，再過到分類帳。

root.note: 寫進每日的紀錄 → 記入日記（帳）

senses.en: to fight on horseback with lances; to compete or argue closely
senses.zh: （騎士）馬上長槍比武；較量；爭論

senses.en: a contest between two knights on horseback with lances

ex.en: The two candidates will joust over tax policy in tonight's debate.
ex.zh: 兩位候選人將在今晚的辯論中就稅務政策交鋒。

senses.en: cheerful and friendly

ex.en: Our jovial neighbor always greets us with a joke and a wave.
ex.zh: 我們那位快活的鄰居總是笑著揮手跟我們說笑。

root.note: 古人認為在木星下出生的人個性開朗 → 快活的

senses.en: a feeling of great happiness and triumph

ex.en: There was jubilation in the streets when the home team won the championship.
ex.zh: 主隊奪冠時，街頭一片歡騰。

parts.m: shout for joy 歡呼（拉丁文 jubilare）

root.note: 高聲歡呼 → 歡欣鼓舞

senses.en: the ability to make sensible decisions
an opinion or conclusion; a decision of a court

ex.en: I trust her judgment because she always thinks before she acts.
ex.zh: 我信任她的判斷力，因為她總是三思而後行。

parts.m: judge 判斷（jus 法 + dic 說）

root.note: 做出判斷 → 判斷力；判決

senses.en: the administration of justice; the judiciary as a whole
senses.zh: 司法；司法行政；（總稱）法官、司法機關

ex.en: The reform changed how the courts of judicature were organized.
ex.zh: 這項改革改變了各級司法法院的組織方式。

root.note: 審判的事務 → 司法

senses.en: relating to courts of law or judges

ex.en: The new law will face a judicial review before it takes effect.
ex.zh: 這項新法在生效前將接受司法審查。

root.note: 說出法律的裁決 → 司法的

mn: judicial（司法的）和 judicious（明智的）容易混淆：cial 看法院，cious 看腦袋。

senses.en: the judges of a country considered as a group; the court system

ex.en: An independent judiciary is essential to a healthy democracy.
ex.zh: 獨立的司法體系對健全的民主至關重要。

parts.m: 名詞字尾（相關的人或機構）

root.note: 宣告法律的機構 → 司法部門

senses.en: having or showing good judgment; wise and sensible

ex.en: A judicious use of color can make a simple room feel warm.
ex.zh: 巧妙地運用色彩，能讓簡單的房間感覺溫暖。

root.note: 做出像法官一樣的判斷 → 明智的

senses.en: to keep several objects in the air by throwing and catching them
to manage several activities at the same time

ex.en: Many students have to juggle part-time jobs and schoolwork.
ex.zh: 許多學生必須同時兼顧打工和課業。

senses.en: the art of juggling; trickery or deception

ex.en: The company's profits were just financial jugglery designed to fool investors.
ex.zh: 這家公司的獲利只是用來欺騙投資人的財務把戲。

senses.en: one of the large veins in the neck; the most vulnerable point
relating to the neck or throat

ex.en: The debater went for the jugular by exposing his opponent's contradictions.
ex.zh: 那名辯手直攻要害，揭露了對手的前後矛盾。

parts.m: collarbone, throat 鎖骨、喉部（拉丁文 jugulum）

root.note: 喉部的 → 頸靜脈 → 要害

mn: 片語 go for the jugular：直攻要害、狠狠攻擊。

senses.en: full of juice
interesting because scandalous or exciting
senses.zh: （八卦、細節）有趣的；引人入勝的

ex.en: She bit into a juicy peach on the hot afternoon.
ex.zh: 在炎熱的午後，她咬了一口多汁的桃子。

senses.en: a point where two or more things, such as roads or railways, meet
senses.zh: 交叉點；交會處；（鐵路）樞紐站

ex.en: Turn left at the junction and the museum will be on your right.
ex.zh: 在路口左轉，博物館就在你的右手邊。

root.note: 連接之處 → 交會點

senses.en: a particular point in time or in a series of events, especially a critical one

ex.en: At this juncture, we need to decide whether to continue the project.
ex.zh: 在這個關頭，我們必須決定是否繼續這個計畫。

root.note: 事件連接的點 → 關鍵時刻

senses.en: a military group that rules a country after taking power by force
senses.zh: （政變後掌權的）軍政府；軍事執政團

ex.en: The junta suspended the constitution and banned all opposition parties.
ex.zh: 軍政府廢止了憲法，並禁止所有反對黨。

parts.m: join 聯合（西班牙文 junta 會議）

root.note: 聯合起來的團體 → 軍事執政團

mn: 源自西班牙文，j 唸成 h 的音；美式也常唸 [ˋdʒʌntə]。

senses.en: relating to the law or the administration of justice

ex.en: A corporation is treated as a juridical person under the law.
ex.zh: 在法律上，公司被視為法人。

root.note: 宣告法律的 → 法律上的

senses.en: the official power to make legal decisions
the area or field over which that power extends

ex.en: The case falls outside the jurisdiction of the local court.
ex.zh: 這個案件不屬於地方法院的管轄範圍。

root.note: 有權說出法律裁決 → 管轄權

senses.en: the theory or philosophy of law; a body of court decisions

ex.en: She studied jurisprudence before becoming a constitutional scholar.
ex.zh: 她在成為憲法學者之前研讀法理學。

root.note: 關於法律的智慧 → 法理學

senses.en: a member of a jury

ex.en: Each juror must listen carefully to all the evidence before voting.
ex.zh: 每位陪審員在投票前都必須仔細聽取所有證據。

root.note: 宣誓的人 → 陪審員

senses.en: a good reason or explanation for something

ex.en: There is no justification for treating customers so rudely.
ex.zh: 對顧客如此無禮是沒有任何正當理由的。

root.note: 使成為正當 → 正當理由

senses.en: relating to young people
childish or immature
a young person

ex.en: Pulling the chair away as a prank was a juvenile thing to do.
ex.zh: 惡作劇把椅子拉走實在是很幼稚的行為。

root.note: 年輕的 → 青少年的；幼稚的

senses.en: to place side by side, especially to compare or contrast

ex.en: The exhibit will juxtapose old photographs with modern images of the same streets.
ex.zh: 這次展覽會把同一條街的老照片和現代影像並排展示。

root.note: 放在旁邊 → 並列

senses.en: a small item kept in memory of a person or event

ex.en: She kept her grandmother's ring as a keepsake.
ex.zh: 她把祖母的戒指留下來當作紀念。

parts.m: for the sake of 為了

root.note: 為了（某人）而保存 → 紀念品

senses.en: a square of cloth worn on the head or around the neck

ex.en: The farmer tied a red kerchief around her head to block the sun.
ex.zh: 那位農婦在頭上綁了一條紅頭巾遮陽。

root.note: 蓋住頭的布 → 頭巾

senses.en: the soft inner part of a nut or seed; a grain of corn
the central or most important part of something

ex.en: There is a kernel of truth in every rumor.
ex.zh: 每則謠言都有幾分真實的成分。

root.note: 小小的種子 → 核心

mn: 常見片語 a kernel of truth：一點點真實成分。

senses.en: an oven for baking pottery or bricks, or drying things

ex.en: The potter placed the clay bowls in the kiln overnight.
ex.zh: 陶藝家把陶碗放進窯裡燒一整夜。

parts.m: cooking stove 爐灶（拉丁文 culina）

root.note: 烹煮用的爐 → 窯

senses.en: a unit of volume equal to 1,000 liters

ex.en: The tank can hold about one kiloliter of water.
ex.zh: 這個水槽大約可容納一千公升的水。

root.note: 一千公升

senses.en: a unit of length equal to 1,000 meters

ex.en: The school is only one kilometer from my house.
ex.zh: 學校離我家只有一公里。

root.note: 一千公尺 → 公里

mn: 美式也常唸 [kəˋlɑmətɚ]，兩種都常見。

senses.en: a unit of power equal to 1,000 watts

ex.en: This space heater uses about one kilowatt of electricity per hour.
ex.zh: 這台電暖器每小時大約耗電一千瓦。

root.note: 一千瓦特 → 千瓦

senses.en: a long, loose traditional Japanese robe with wide sleeves

ex.en: She wore a silk kimono to the summer festival in Kyoto.
ex.zh: 她穿著絲質和服去參加京都的夏日祭典。

root.note: 穿的東西 → 和服

senses.en: having a kind and sympathetic nature

ex.en: A kind-hearted teacher stayed late to help me with math.
ex.zh: 一位好心的老師留下來幫我補數學。

senses.en: a petty or minor king (often used with contempt)

ex.en: Each local kingling claimed to be the rightful ruler of the whole island.
ex.zh: 每個地方小王都自稱是全島的正統統治者。

root.note: 小小的國王 → 小王

senses.en: the position, power, or rule of a king

ex.en: The young prince was not yet ready for the burdens of kingship.
ex.zh: 年輕的王子還沒準備好承擔王位的重擔。

root.note: 國王的身分 → 王位

senses.en: a person's relatives; family members

ex.en: He traveled to the village to visit his kinsfolk during the holiday.
ex.zh: 他在假期時到村裡探望親戚。

root.note: 家族的人 → 親屬

senses.en: dishonest or deceitful behavior

ex.en: The merchant's knavery was finally exposed when his scales were checked.
ex.zh: 當商人的秤被檢查時，他的詐欺行為終於曝光。

root.note: 無賴的行為 → 欺詐

senses.en: to press and fold dough or clay with the hands
to massage by squeezing with the hands

ex.en: You need to knead the dough for ten minutes before letting it rise.
ex.zh: 要先揉麵團十分鐘，再讓它發酵。

mn: k 不發音，跟 need 同音：揉麵團需要（need）用力。

senses.en: a small decorative object of little value

ex.en: Every shelf in her house was covered with a knickknack from her travels.
ex.zh: 她家裡的每個架子上都擺著旅行帶回來的小擺飾。

senses.en: the rank or title of a knight

ex.en: The scientist received a knighthood for her contributions to medicine.
ex.zh: 這位科學家因對醫學的貢獻而獲頒爵士頭銜。

root.note: 騎士的身分

senses.en: requiring a lot of time and effort

ex.en: Copying every record by hand was a laborious process.
ex.zh: 用手抄寫每一筆紀錄是很費力的工作。

root.note: 需要大量勞動 → 費力的

senses.en: a complicated network of paths in which it is hard to find the way
something very complicated or confusing

ex.en: The old city is a labyrinth of narrow streets and alleys.
ex.zh: 舊城區是一座由狹窄街道和小巷組成的迷宮。

mn: 源自希臘神話中囚禁牛頭人的迷宮。

senses.en: to tear or deeply cut the skin
to hurt someone's feelings deeply

ex.en: Broken glass can lacerate your feet, so wear shoes on the beach.
ex.zh: 碎玻璃可能會割傷你的腳，所以在海灘上要穿鞋。

root.note: 撕破 → 割傷

senses.en: lacking enthusiasm and determination; carelessly lazy
senses.zh: 無精打采的；懶散的；不起勁的

ex.en: His lackadaisical attitude toward practice cost him a spot on the team.
ex.zh: 他對練習散漫的態度讓他失去了隊上的位置。

mn: 來自古語 lackaday（唉呀），整天唉聲嘆氣 → 無精打采。

senses.en: the production of milk by mammals to feed their young

ex.en: Nursing mothers need extra calories during lactation.
ex.zh: 哺乳中的母親在泌乳期間需要額外的熱量。

root.note: 產乳 → 泌乳

senses.en: relating to or like milk
a lymph vessel in the small intestine that absorbs fats

ex.en: Each lacteal in the small intestine absorbs digested fats.
ex.zh: 小腸中的每條乳糜管都負責吸收消化後的脂肪。

root.note: 像乳汁的 → 乳的；乳糜管

senses.en: relating to or obtained from milk

ex.en: Lactic acid builds up in your muscles during hard exercise.
ex.zh: 劇烈運動時，乳酸會在肌肉中堆積。

root.note: 乳的

senses.en: (chiefly Scottish, informal) a boy or young man

ex.en: "Come in out of the rain, laddie," said the old fisherman.
ex.zh: 「小伙子，進來躲雨吧。」老漁夫說。

root.note: 小男孩 → 小伙子

senses.en: a large, deep spoon with a long handle for serving soup
to serve with a ladle

ex.en: Use the ladle to serve the soup into each bowl.
ex.zh: 用湯杓把湯舀到每個碗裡。

senses.en: a person or thing that is slower than others
slow and lagging behind

ex.en: Once a laggard in technology, the country is now a leader in electric cars.
ex.zh: 這個國家曾是科技落後者，如今卻在電動車領域領先。

root.note: 落在後面的人 → 落後者

senses.en: a person who owns or rents land
senses.zh: 地主；土地所有人；土地承租人

ex.en: Each landholder had to pay a tax based on the size of the farm.
ex.zh: 每個地主都要依照農地大小繳稅。

senses.en: a person who rents out land, a house, or an apartment

ex.en: Our landlord finally agreed to fix the leaking roof.
ex.zh: 我們的房東終於同意修理漏水的屋頂。

senses.en: an object or feature that is easy to see and recognize
an event or discovery marking an important stage

ex.en: The court's decision was a landmark in the history of civil rights.
ex.zh: 法院的這項判決是民權史上的里程碑。

senses.en: all the visible features of an area of land
the general situation in a particular field

ex.en: Smartphones have completely changed the media landscape.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機徹底改變了媒體生態。

root.note: 土地的景色 → 風景

senses.en: slow and relaxed; lacking energy
senses.zh: 慵懶的；無精打采的；緩慢的

ex.en: We spent a languid afternoon lying by the pool.
ex.zh: 我們在泳池邊躺著，度過一個慵懶的下午。

root.note: 虛弱無力的 → 慵懶的

senses.en: a pleasant feeling of tiredness or laziness
an oppressive stillness of the air

ex.en: The summer heat filled the town with a sleepy languor.
ex.zh: 夏天的酷熱讓整個小鎮瀰漫著昏昏欲睡的慵懶。

root.note: 虛弱的狀態 → 倦怠

senses.en: a brief failure of concentration, memory, or judgment
an interval of time
to gradually pass into a worse state; to expire

ex.en: A momentary lapse in attention caused the accident.
ex.zh: 一時的疏忽導致了這場意外。

root.note: 滑落 → 疏忽；失效

senses.en: feeling or showing strong, offensive sexual desire

ex.en: The critic condemned the film for its lascivious scenes.
ex.zh: 評論家譴責這部電影有淫穢的情節。

root.note: 放縱的 → 淫蕩的

senses.en: (chiefly Scottish, informal) a girl or young woman

ex.en: The old woman smiled and called the girl a bonny lassie.
ex.zh: 老婦人笑著說那女孩是個漂亮的小姑娘。

root.note: 小女孩 → 小姑娘

senses.en: the state of existing but not yet being active or visible
(computing) the delay before data transfer begins

ex.en: Online gamers complain whenever the network latency rises.
ex.zh: 只要網路延遲變高，線上玩家就會抱怨。

root.note: 隱藏的狀態 → 潛伏；延遲

senses.en: existing but not yet developed or visible

ex.en: The coach saw latent talent in the shy young player.
ex.zh: 教練在那位害羞的年輕球員身上看到潛在的天分。

root.note: 藏著的 → 潛在的

senses.en: at a time in the future or after the time mentioned
coming after in time

ex.en: I'm busy now, so I'll call you back later.
ex.zh: 我現在很忙，晚點再回電給你。

senses.en: of, at, or toward the side

ex.en: Solving the puzzle required some lateral thinking.
ex.zh: 要解這個謎題需要一些跳脫框架的思考。

root.note: 側邊的

mn: lateral thinking：水平思考、跳脫框架的創意思考。

senses.en: somewhat late

ex.en: We had a latish breakfast after sleeping in on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天睡晚了，我們吃了頓稍晚的早餐。

root.note: 有點晚的

senses.en: a structure of crossed strips with open spaces between them
a regular repeated arrangement of points, such as atoms in a crystal

ex.en: Roses climbed up the wooden lattice beside the door.
ex.zh: 玫瑰沿著門邊的木格架往上攀爬。

senses.en: to praise highly, especially in public

ex.en: Critics continue to laud the novel for its honest portrait of rural life.
ex.zh: 評論家持續讚揚這部小說真實描繪了鄉村生活。

root.note: 讚美

senses.en: deserving praise

ex.en: Their goal of feeding every child in the city is laudable.
ex.zh: 他們讓全市每個孩子都能吃飽的目標值得讚揚。

root.note: 可讚美的

senses.en: praise; the act of praising

ex.en: The retiring professor received warm laudation from her former students.
ex.zh: 這位即將退休的教授獲得昔日學生熱烈的讚揚。

root.note: 讚美的行為

senses.en: expressing praise

ex.en: The film received laudatory reviews from nearly every newspaper.
ex.zh: 這部電影幾乎獲得每家報紙的好評。

root.note: 表達讚美的

senses.en: a woman whose job is washing and ironing clothes

ex.en: In the novel, the laundress knows every family's secrets.
ex.zh: 在這部小說裡，洗衣婦知道每戶人家的秘密。

root.note: 洗衣服的女人

senses.en: a person given an award for outstanding achievement
a poet laureate, an official national poet

ex.en: A Nobel laureate will speak at this year's graduation ceremony.
ex.zh: 一位諾貝爾獎得主將在今年的畢業典禮上致詞。

root.note: 戴上月桂冠的人 → 得獎者

senses.en: (literary) to wash or bathe; (of water) to flow against

ex.en: She knelt by the stream to lave her tired face.
ex.zh: 她跪在溪邊清洗疲憊的臉。

root.note: 洗（同 lavatory）

senses.en: a person who draws up and establishes a code of laws

ex.en: Solon is remembered as the great lawgiver of ancient Athens.
ex.zh: 梭倫被譽為古雅典偉大的立法者。

senses.en: a person who makes laws; a legislator

ex.en: One lawmaker proposed a bill to lower the voting age.
ex.zh: 一位議員提出降低投票年齡的法案。

senses.en: not strict, careful, or severe enough
loose; not tense

ex.en: Security at the airport was surprisingly lax.
ex.zh: 機場的安檢出奇地鬆散。

root.note: 鬆的 → 鬆懈的

senses.en: a medicine that helps the bowels empty
tending to loosen the bowels

ex.en: The doctor warned him not to take a laxative every day.
ex.zh: 醫生警告他不要每天吃瀉藥。

root.note: 使（腸道）放鬆 → 瀉藥

senses.en: (literary) an open area of grassy land; a meadow

ex.en: The cattle grazed slowly across the green lea.
ex.zh: 牛群慢慢地在綠色草地上吃草。

senses.en: a printed sheet of paper giving information, often free
a small leaf, part of a compound leaf

ex.en: Volunteers handed a leaflet to everyone who passed the station.
ex.zh: 志工們發傳單給每一位經過車站的人。

root.note: 小張紙 → 傳單

senses.en: a substance such as yeast that makes dough rise
to make something less serious or dull by adding something lively

ex.en: She tried to leaven the serious speech with a few jokes.
ex.zh: 她試著用幾個笑話來調劑這場嚴肅的演講。

root.note: 使（麵團）升起的東西 → 酵母

senses.en: on or toward the side sheltered from the wind
the side sheltered from the wind

ex.en: The boats anchored on the leeward side of the island to escape the storm.
ex.zh: 船隻停泊在島嶼的背風面以躲避暴風雨。

root.note: 朝向遮蔽處 → 背風的

mn: 航海用語常唸 [ˋluɚd]。

senses.en: using the left hand more naturally than the right
(of a compliment) insincere or ambiguous

ex.en: My sister is left-handed, so she needs special scissors.
ex.zh: 我姊姊是左撇子，所以需要特製的剪刀。

mn: a left-handed compliment：明褒暗貶的話。

senses.en: something handed down from a predecessor or from the past
money or property left to someone in a will

ex.en: The civil rights movement left a lasting legacy of equal protection.
ex.zh: 民權運動留下了平等保護的長遠影響。

parts.m: law, send 法；派遣（拉丁文 legare 遺贈）

root.note: 依遺囑留下的東西 → 遺產

senses.en: to make something allowed by law

ex.en: Several countries have voted to legalize same-sex marriage.
ex.zh: 好幾個國家已投票通過同性婚姻合法化。

root.note: 使合法

senses.en: a covering for the leg, usually from ankle to knee; (pl.) tight stretchy trousers

ex.en: The hiker wrapped a canvas legging around each calf to keep out snow.
ex.zh: 登山客在每隻小腿綁上帆布綁腿以防積雪滲入。

senses.en: clear enough to be read

ex.en: Please make sure your handwriting is legible on the exam.
ex.zh: 考試時請確保你的字跡清晰可讀。

root.note: 可以讀的

senses.en: a soldier in an ancient Roman legion
relating to a legion

ex.en: Each Roman legionary carried heavy armor and tools on long marches.
ex.zh: 每個羅馬軍團士兵在長途行軍時都背著沉重的盔甲和工具。

root.note: 挑選出來組成的軍團的人 → 軍團士兵

senses.en: to make or pass laws

ex.en: It is difficult to legislate against every kind of online abuse.
ex.zh: 要立法禁止每一種網路霸凌是很困難的。

root.note: 提出法律 → 立法

senses.en: having the power to make laws; relating to lawmaking

ex.en: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan votes on the national budget each year.
ex.zh: 台灣的立法院每年都要表決國家預算。

root.note: 制定法律的

senses.en: a person who makes laws; a member of a legislature

ex.en: The legislator met with parents to discuss school safety.
ex.zh: 這位立委與家長們會面討論校園安全。

root.note: 制定法律的人

senses.en: the quality of being lawful, reasonable, or acceptable

ex.en: Protesters questioned the legitimacy of the election results.
ex.zh: 抗議者質疑選舉結果的正當性。

root.note: 合法的性質

senses.en: allowed by law or rules
reasonable and justifiable
[lɪˋdʒɪtəˏmet] to make legitimate

ex.en: She had a legitimate reason for missing the meeting.
ex.zh: 她缺席會議有正當的理由。

root.note: 合乎法律的

senses.en: free time when one is not working

ex.en: She spends her leisure time painting and hiking.
ex.zh: 她空閒時畫畫和健行。

parts.m: be permitted 被允許（拉丁文 licere）

root.note: 被允許做自己想做的事的時間 → 閒暇

mn: 片語 at your leisure：在你方便的時候。

senses.en: the quality of being more merciful or tolerant than expected

ex.en: The judge showed leniency because it was the teenager's first offense.
ex.zh: 因為這是那名青少年初犯，法官從輕發落。

root.note: 柔和的態度 → 寬大

senses.en: not as strict or harsh as expected; merciful

ex.en: My parents are lenient about bedtime on weekends.
ex.zh: 週末時我爸媽對就寢時間比較寬鬆。

root.note: 柔和的 → 寬大的

senses.en: like or relating to a lion

ex.en: The old conductor had a leonine mane of white hair.
ex.zh: 那位老指揮家有一頭像獅子鬃毛般的白髮。

root.note: 像獅子的

senses.en: a lack of energy and enthusiasm

ex.en: Lack of sleep can cause lethargy and poor concentration.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足可能導致倦怠和注意力不集中。

parts.m: forgetfulness 遺忘（希臘神話忘川 Lethe）

root.note: 遺忘而懶散 → 昏睡、倦怠

senses.en: a bank built to prevent a river from flooding
(historical) a formal reception held by a monarch
senses.zh: （舊時君主的）早朝接見；招待會

ex.en: The levee broke during the hurricane and flooded the city.
ex.zh: 颶風期間堤防潰決，淹沒了整座城市。

root.note: 升高的土堤 → 堤防

mn: 別和 levy（徵稅）搞混。

senses.en: a bar used to move a heavy object by resting on a fixed point
a means of gaining power or influence

ex.en: Pull the lever to open the emergency exit.
ex.zh: 拉下操縱桿以打開緊急出口。

root.note: 舉起東西的工具 → 槓桿

senses.en: a huge sea monster; anything very large and powerful

ex.en: The tech company has grown into a leviathan that controls much of the market.
ex.zh: 這家科技公司已成長為掌控大半市場的龐然大物。

mn: 源自聖經中的海怪；霍布斯的名著《利維坦》用它比喻強大的國家。

senses.en: humor or lack of seriousness, especially when inappropriate

ex.en: His joke added a moment of levity to the tense meeting.
ex.zh: 他的笑話為緊張的會議帶來片刻輕鬆。

root.note: 輕的態度 → 輕浮

senses.en: to officially impose a tax, fee, or fine
a tax or fee that is imposed
to enlist soldiers for military service

ex.en: The city plans to levy a tax on plastic bags.
ex.zh: 市政府計劃對塑膠袋課稅。

root.note: （向人民）提取 → 徵收

senses.en: crude and offensive in a sexual way

ex.en: The comedian was fired for making lewd comments on air.
ex.zh: 那名喜劇演員因在節目中發表下流言論而被開除。

senses.en: a person who writes or compiles dictionaries

ex.en: A lexicographer must track how the meanings of words change over time.
ex.zh: 詞典編纂者必須追蹤字義隨時間的變化。

root.note: 寫字詞（解釋）的人 → 詞典編纂者

senses.en: the practice of compiling dictionaries

ex.en: Computers have transformed modern lexicography.
ex.zh: 電腦徹底改變了現代的詞典編纂。

root.note: 書寫字詞的學問 → 詞典編纂

senses.en: the vocabulary of a person, language, or field
a dictionary, especially of an ancient language

ex.en: The word "selfie" quickly entered the English lexicon.
ex.zh: 「自拍」這個字很快就進入了英語詞彙。

root.note: 字詞的集合 → 詞彙

senses.en: legally responsible for something
likely to do or experience something (usually bad)

ex.en: The company was held liable for the damage caused by the leak.
ex.zh: 這家公司被判須為漏油造成的損害負責。

root.note: 被（法律）綁住的 → 須負責的

senses.en: a false written statement that damages someone's reputation
to publish a false statement that damages someone's reputation

ex.en: The actor sued the magazine for libel over the false story.
ex.zh: 那名演員因不實報導控告雜誌誹謗。

root.note: 小冊子 → 散播中傷的文字 → 誹謗

mn: libel 是書面誹謗，slander 是口頭誹謗。

senses.en: a political view favoring individual rights, freedom, and gradual reform

ex.en: Classical liberalism stresses free markets and limited government.
ex.zh: 古典自由主義強調自由市場與有限政府。

root.note: 主張自由的思想

senses.en: to set someone or something free

ex.en: Allied troops arrived to liberate the town after four years of occupation.
ex.zh: 盟軍在被佔領四年後抵達解放了這座城鎮。

root.note: 使自由

senses.en: sexually immoral; ignoring accepted rules of behavior
senses.zh: 放蕩的；淫亂的；不守規矩的

ex.en: The king's licentious court shocked visiting diplomats.
ex.zh: 國王那放蕩的宮廷讓來訪的外交官大為震驚。

root.note: 自由過了頭 → 放蕩的

senses.en: allowed by law; legal

ex.en: Investigators found it hard to separate licit trade from smuggling.
ex.zh: 調查人員發現很難區分合法貿易和走私。

root.note: 被允許的 → 合法的

mn: 反義字 illicit（非法的）比 licit 常見得多。

senses.en: a feudal lord; also a vassal who owes loyalty to a lord
owing or entitled to feudal loyalty

ex.en: The knight knelt and swore loyalty to his liege.
ex.zh: 騎士跪下向他的君主宣誓效忠。

senses.en: a legal right to keep someone's property until a debt is paid

ex.en: The bank placed a lien on the house until the loan was repaid.
ex.zh: 在貸款還清前，銀行對這棟房子設定了留置權。

root.note: 把財產綁住 → 留置權

senses.en: place; used in the phrase "in lieu of," meaning instead of
senses.zh: 代替（用於 in lieu of）

ex.en: Workers were given extra vacation days in lieu of a raise.
ex.zh: 員工們以額外的假期代替加薪。

parts.m: place 地方（法文，源自拉丁文 locus）

root.note: 在……的位置上 → 代替

mn: lieutenant（副官）= lieu（位置）+ tenant（持有者）：替長官坐位置的人。

senses.en: very similar to the real person or thing

ex.en: The wax figures in the museum look incredibly lifelike.
ex.zh: 博物館裡的蠟像看起來栩栩如生。

senses.en: lasting or continuing through a person's life

ex.en: Reading with her father gave her a lifelong love of books.
ex.zh: 和父親一起讀書讓她一輩子熱愛閱讀。

senses.en: the length of time that a person lives or a thing lasts

ex.en: Visiting Antarctica was the trip of a lifetime.
ex.zh: 去南極是一生難得的旅行。

senses.en: a tough band of tissue connecting bones at a joint

ex.en: The soccer player tore a ligament in her knee.
ex.zh: 那名足球員膝蓋的韌帶撕裂了。

root.note: 把骨頭綁在一起的東西 → 韌帶

senses.en: a thread or cord used to tie something, especially a blood vessel
two letters joined together as one character, such as æ

ex.en: The surgeon tied a ligature around the artery to stop the bleeding.
ex.zh: 外科醫生在動脈上綁了結紮線以止血。

root.note: 綁東西用的 → 結紮線

senses.en: cheerful and carefree; not serious
senses.zh: 輕鬆愉快的；無憂無慮的

ex.en: The film is a light-hearted comedy about a family road trip.
ex.zh: 這部電影是一部關於家庭公路旅行的輕鬆喜劇。

senses.en: made of or like wood; woody

ex.en: Over time, the soft stem becomes ligneous and hard.
ex.zh: 隨著時間過去，柔軟的莖會變得木質化且堅硬。

root.note: 木頭的

senses.en: the chance that something will happen; probability

ex.en: Regular exercise reduces the likelihood of heart disease.
ex.zh: 規律運動可降低罹患心臟病的可能性。

root.note: 可能的狀態 → 可能性

senses.en: probably going to happen or be true
probably

ex.en: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
ex.zh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

senses.en: a feeling of enjoying or being fond of something

ex.en: He has developed a liking for spicy food since moving to Sichuan.
ex.zh: 搬到四川後，他開始喜歡吃辣。

mn: 片語 to one's liking：合某人的心意。

senses.en: a rule or condition that limits something; a restriction
a weakness or lack of ability

ex.en: Every research method has at least one limitation.
ex.zh: 每種研究方法都至少有一個局限。

root.note: 設下界限 → 限制

senses.en: arranged in or relating to a straight line
progressing from one stage to another in a single series of steps

ex.en: The story is not told in linear order but jumps back and forth in time.
ex.zh: 這個故事並非按時間順序敘述，而是在不同時間點來回跳躍。

root.note: 線的

senses.en: a large passenger ship
a layer of material inside something as a lining

ex.en: The ocean liner carried thousands of passengers across the Atlantic.
ex.zh: 那艘遠洋郵輪載著數千名旅客橫渡大西洋。

senses.en: (informal) a foreign language or the special vocabulary of a group

ex.en: It took me months to learn the tech lingo at my new job.
ex.zh: 我花了好幾個月才學會新工作裡的科技行話。

root.note: 語言 → 行話

senses.en: a language used for communication between people with different native languages

ex.en: English has become the lingua franca of international science.
ex.zh: 英語已成為國際科學界的共通語言。

root.note: 原指地中海商人使用的「法蘭克語」→ 通用語

senses.en: relating to the tongue or to language

ex.en: The dentist examined the lingual surface of her lower teeth.
ex.zh: 牙醫檢查了她下排牙齒靠舌頭那一側的表面。

root.note: 舌頭的；語言的

senses.en: a person who studies linguistics
a person skilled in foreign languages

ex.en: The linguist spent years recording the last speakers of the language.
ex.zh: 這位語言學家花了多年時間記錄該語言最後的使用者。

root.note: 研究語言的人

senses.en: the scientific study of language and its structure

ex.en: She majored in linguistics because she loved learning how languages work.
ex.zh: 她主修語言學，因為她熱愛探究語言的運作方式。

root.note: 研究語言的學科

senses.en: a liquid rubbed on the skin to relieve pain or stiffness

ex.en: The coach rubbed liniment on the runner's sore calves.
ex.zh: 教練在跑者痠痛的小腿上塗抹搽劑。

root.note: 用來塗抹的東西 → 搽劑

senses.en: causing something to become liquid
a substance that causes liquefaction

ex.en: The chemist added a liquefacient agent to dissolve the thick paste.
ex.zh: 化學家加入液化劑來溶解那團濃稠的糊狀物。

root.note: 使成為液體的

senses.en: to make or become liquid

ex.en: Extreme cold can liquefy gases such as oxygen.
ex.zh: 極度低溫可以使氧氣等氣體液化。

root.note: 使成為液體

senses.en: a strong, sweet, flavored alcoholic drink, usually taken after a meal

ex.en: The restaurant served a small glass of orange liqueur after dessert.
ex.zh: 餐廳在甜點後送上一小杯柳橙利口酒。

root.note: （法文）液體 → 利口酒

mn: liqueur（甜的利口酒）和 liquor（烈酒）拼法和發音都不同。

senses.en: to close a business and sell its assets to pay debts
to pay off a debt
to eliminate or kill

ex.en: The failing company was forced to liquidate its stores.
ex.zh: 那家經營不善的公司被迫清算旗下商店。

root.note: 使（帳目）清楚、變成流動現金 → 清算

senses.en: strong alcoholic drink such as whiskey or vodka

ex.en: The store is not allowed to sell liquor to anyone under eighteen.
ex.zh: 這家店不得販賣酒類給未滿十八歲的人。

root.note: 液體 → 酒

senses.en: lacking energy or interest

ex.en: The heat made everyone listless and irritable.
ex.zh: 炎熱讓每個人都無精打采又煩躁。

root.note: 沒有慾望的 → 無精打采

senses.en: the ability to read and write
knowledge or skill in a particular area

ex.en: Media literacy helps students recognize fake news.
ex.zh: 媒體素養能幫助學生辨識假新聞。

root.note: 懂文字 → 讀寫能力

senses.en: taking words in their usual or most basic sense
(of a translation) word for word

ex.en: The literal meaning of "break a leg" is very different from its real meaning.
ex.zh: 「break a leg」的字面意思和它的真正含義相差很多。

root.note: 照文字的 → 字面的

senses.en: written works, especially those of lasting artistic value
the published writings on a particular subject

ex.en: She studied Chinese literature at National Taiwan University.
ex.zh: 她在台大研讀中國文學。

root.note: 文字的作品 → 文學

senses.en: thin, supple, and graceful

ex.en: The lithe gymnast bent backward until her hands touched the floor.
ex.zh: 那位身段柔軟的體操選手向後彎到雙手碰地。

senses.en: (literary) lithe; flexible and graceful

ex.en: The lithesome dancer seemed to float across the stage.
ex.zh: 那位身段輕盈的舞者彷彿在舞台上飄浮。

root.note: 柔軟的

senses.en: a print made by lithography
to print by lithography

ex.en: The museum owns a rare lithograph by the famous poster artist.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了一幅那位知名海報藝術家罕見的石版畫。

root.note: 在石頭上畫 → 石版畫

senses.en: an etched stone surface used for printing; a print made from it

ex.en: The old printer showed us a lithotype used to make maps a century ago.
ex.zh: 老印刷師讓我們看一塊百年前用來印地圖的石版。

root.note: 石頭做的印版

senses.en: a person involved in a lawsuit

ex.en: Each litigant was given a chance to present evidence to the judge.
ex.zh: 每一方訴訟當事人都有機會向法官提出證據。

root.note: 推動訴訟的人 → 訴訟當事人

senses.en: to take a dispute to a court of law

ex.en: The two companies chose to litigate rather than settle privately.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司選擇打官司，而不是私下和解。

root.note: 推動訴訟

senses.en: too ready to go to court to settle disputes

ex.en: Doctors in a litigious society often order extra tests to protect themselves.
ex.zh: 在愛打官司的社會裡，醫生常會多做檢查來保護自己。

root.note: 動不動就提訴訟的

senses.en: relating to the shore of a sea or lake
a coastal region

ex.en: Many unique species live in the littoral zone between the tides.
ex.zh: 許多獨特物種生活在潮間帶的沿岸地區。

root.note: 海岸的

mn: 發音和 literal 很像，但意思完全不同。

senses.en: a fixed form of public worship used in a church

ex.en: The Easter liturgy includes special prayers and hymns.
ex.zh: 復活節禮拜儀式包含特別的禱告和聖詩。

root.note: 為公眾服務的工作 → 禮拜儀式

senses.en: a means of earning money to live

ex.en: The drought threatened the livelihood of thousands of farmers.
ex.zh: 這場乾旱威脅到數千名農民的生計。

senses.en: furiously angry
dark bluish-gray, like a bruise

ex.en: Dad was livid when he saw the dent in his new car.
ex.zh: 爸爸看到他新車上的凹痕時氣炸了。

root.note: （臉）氣得發青 → 暴怒的

senses.en: rich, fertile soil of clay, sand, and decayed plants

ex.en: Vegetables grow best in dark, crumbly loam.
ex.zh: 蔬菜在黑色鬆軟的壤土中長得最好。

senses.en: unwilling or reluctant to do something

ex.en: She was loath to leave her friends and move to another city.
ex.zh: 她很不願意離開朋友搬到另一個城市。

mn: loath（形容詞，不願意的，th 唸 [θ]）vs. loathe（動詞，厭惡，th 唸 [ð]）。

senses.en: to feel intense dislike or disgust for

ex.en: I loathe waiting in long lines at the bank.
ex.zh: 我非常討厭在銀行排長長的隊。

senses.en: (grammar) indicating place or location
the locative case

ex.en: Some languages use a locative ending to show where something is.
ex.zh: 有些語言用處所格詞尾來表示某物的位置。

root.note: 表示地方的

senses.en: (Scottish) a lake or narrow arm of the sea

ex.en: Tourists hope to spot a monster in the famous Scottish loch.
ex.zh: 遊客們希望在那座著名的蘇格蘭湖泊裡看到水怪。

mn: 蘇格蘭人唸 [lɑx]，結尾是喉音；尼斯湖就是 Loch Ness。

senses.en: movement or the ability to move from one place to another

ex.en: Snakes rely on their muscles for locomotion since they have no legs.
ex.zh: 蛇沒有腳，所以靠肌肉來移動。

root.note: 從一個地方移動 → 移動能力

senses.en: a vein of metal ore in rock
a rich source of something

ex.en: The miners struck a rich lode of silver in the mountains.
ex.zh: 礦工們在山中挖到一條豐富的銀礦脈。

senses.en: the act of formally submitting something, such as a complaint
a secure position gained in enemy territory; a place to stay

ex.en: The troops secured a lodgment on the enemy's shore.
ex.zh: 部隊在敵方海岸上取得了一個據點。

root.note: 安置下來 → 據點；提交

senses.en: a way of reasoning; the study of correct reasoning
sensible reasons behind something

ex.en: I can't follow the logic of your argument.
ex.zh: 我無法理解你論點的邏輯。

root.note: 關於說理的學問 → 邏輯

senses.en: following the rules of logic; reasonable

ex.en: Given the evidence, the only logical conclusion is that he lied.
ex.zh: 根據證據，唯一合理的結論就是他說謊。

root.note: 合乎理性的

senses.en: a person who studies or is skilled in logic

ex.en: The logician pointed out a hidden flaw in the famous proof.
ex.zh: 那位邏輯學家指出那個著名證明中的隱藏漏洞。

root.note: 研究邏輯的人

senses.en: a person who stands or waits around idly without purpose

ex.en: The guard asked a loiterer outside the bank to move along.
ex.zh: 警衛請一名在銀行外逗留的人離開。

root.note: 閒逛的人

senses.en: sadness because one has no friends or company

ex.en: Many elderly people suffer from loneliness after their children move away.
ex.zh: 許多老人在子女搬走後飽受孤獨之苦。

senses.en: long life; the length of time something lasts

ex.en: Scientists are studying the diet of Okinawa to understand its residents' longevity.
ex.zh: 科學家研究沖繩的飲食，以了解當地居民長壽的原因。

root.note: 年歲長 → 長壽

senses.en: to steal goods, especially during a war or riot
goods stolen; (informal) money or valuables

ex.en: Rioters began to loot shops after the power went out.
ex.zh: 停電後，暴民開始洗劫商店。

senses.en: tending to talk a great deal

ex.en: My loquacious uncle can turn a simple question into a two-hour story.
ex.zh: 我那個話多的叔叔能把一個簡單的問題變成兩小時的故事。

root.note: 說很多話的 → 多話的

senses.en: a minor or unimportant lord (often contemptuous)
senses.zh: 小貴族；小領主（常含輕蔑）

ex.en: The arrogant lordling demanded that the villagers bow to him.
ex.zh: 那個傲慢的小貴族要求村民向他鞠躬。

root.note: 小領主

senses.en: (Irish) a lake or arm of the sea

ex.en: Fishing boats rested on the calm waters of the Irish lough.
ex.zh: 漁船停泊在平靜的愛爾蘭湖面上。

mn: 愛爾蘭拼法的 loch，當地唸 [lɑx]。

senses.en: a small insect that lives on the skin of people or animals (plural lice)
(informal) a contemptible person

ex.en: The nurse found a louse in the student's hair and sent a note home.
ex.zh: 護理師在那個學生頭髮裡發現一隻蝨子，便寫了通知單給家長。

senses.en: inspiring love or affection; easy to like

ex.en: The movie's lovable robot won the hearts of children everywhere.
ex.zh: 這部電影裡可愛的機器人擄獲了各地孩子的心。

root.note: 可以被愛的

senses.en: sad and depressed

ex.en: He felt low-spirited after failing his driving test again.
ex.zh: 他駕照考試又沒過，心情很低落。

senses.en: low in status or importance; humble

ex.en: He started as a lowly clerk and became the company's president.
ex.zh: 他從一個卑微的小職員做起，最後成為公司總裁。

senses.en: clearly expressed and easy to understand
able to think clearly, especially between periods of confusion

ex.en: The professor gave a lucid explanation of a very complex theory.
ex.zh: 教授把一個非常複雜的理論解釋得清楚明瞭。

root.note: 有光照亮的 → 清楚的

senses.en: producing a lot of money; profitable

ex.en: She left a lucrative job in banking to become a teacher.
ex.zh: 她放棄了銀行業的高薪工作去當老師。

root.note: 帶來利益的

mn: lucre 是「錢財」（常含貶義），filthy lucre 意為不義之財。

senses.en: so foolish or unreasonable that it is amusing

ex.en: It is ludicrous to charge twenty dollars for a bottle of water.
ex.zh: 一瓶水賣二十美元實在太荒唐了。

root.note: 像鬧劇一樣的 → 荒唐可笑

senses.en: a person who inspires others or is famous in a particular field

ex.en: The conference featured a luminary of modern physics as its keynote speaker.
ex.zh: 這場研討會邀請了一位現代物理學的泰斗擔任主講人。

root.note: 發光體 → 領域中耀眼的人物

senses.en: light given off by a substance without heat

ex.en: The luminescence of the jellyfish lit up the dark water.
ex.zh: 水母發出的冷光照亮了黑暗的海水。

root.note: 開始發光 → 冷光

senses.en: giving off light without heat

ex.en: The hikers marked the trail with luminescent paint.
ex.zh: 健行者用發光漆標示步道。

root.note: 開始發光的

senses.en: the quality of giving off light; brightness

ex.en: Astronomers measured the luminosity of the distant star.
ex.zh: 天文學家測量了那顆遙遠恆星的亮度。

root.note: 充滿光的程度 → 亮度

senses.en: full of or giving off light; shining
very clear or brilliant

ex.en: The watch has luminous hands that glow in the dark.
ex.zh: 這支手錶的指針在黑暗中會發光。

root.note: 充滿光的

senses.en: extreme foolishness
(dated) mental illness

ex.en: It would be sheer lunacy to drive in this snowstorm.
ex.zh: 在這種暴風雪中開車簡直是瘋了。

root.note: 古人認為月亮會使人發瘋 → 瘋狂

senses.en: relating to the moon

ex.en: Families gather to celebrate the Lunar New Year.
ex.zh: 家人們團聚慶祝農曆新年。

root.note: 月亮的

senses.en: (informal, offensive) a mentally ill person; a very foolish person
extremely foolish

ex.en: Only a lunatic would try to swim across the river in winter.
ex.zh: 只有瘋子才會想在冬天游過這條河。

root.note: 受月亮影響的人 → 瘋子

senses.en: a crescent-shaped figure formed by two intersecting arcs

ex.en: The geometry problem asked us to find the area of a lune.
ex.zh: 這道幾何題要我們求出一個新月形的面積。

root.note: 像月亮（新月）的形狀

senses.en: presented in a shocking or sensational way
unpleasantly bright in color

ex.en: The tabloid printed lurid details of the crime.
ex.zh: 那份小報刊登了這起罪行駭人聽聞的細節。

senses.en: having a rich, sweet taste or smell
very attractive; appealing to the senses

ex.en: The market sells luscious mangoes every summer.
ex.zh: 這個市場每年夏天都有香甜多汁的芒果。

senses.en: having a soft, glowing shine

ex.en: The horse had a lustrous black coat.
ex.zh: 那匹馬有一身光亮的黑色毛皮。

root.note: 有光亮的

senses.en: rich and abundant growth

ex.en: Visitors were amazed by the luxuriance of the rainforest.
ex.zh: 遊客們對雨林的繁茂驚嘆不已。

root.note: 豐盛的狀態 → 繁茂

senses.en: (of plants or hair) growing thickly and richly

ex.en: The garden was full of luxuriant ferns and flowers.
ex.zh: 花園裡長滿了茂盛的蕨類和花朵。

root.note: 長得豐盛的

mn: luxuriant 是「茂盛的」，luxurious 才是「奢華的」。

senses.en: to relax and enjoy something pleasurable

ex.en: After the exam, I plan to luxuriate in a long hot bath.
ex.zh: 考完試後，我打算好好泡個長長的熱水澡。

root.note: 奢侈地享受

senses.en: the act of telling lies
not telling the truth

ex.en: Lying to your friends will eventually destroy their trust.
ex.zh: 對朋友說謊終究會摧毀他們對你的信任。

mn: lie（說謊）與 lie（躺）的現在分詞都是 lying。

senses.en: a small U-shaped stringed instrument used in ancient Greece

ex.en: In the myth, Orpheus played the lyre so beautifully that rocks wept.
ex.zh: 在神話中，奧菲斯的里拉琴彈得如此動聽，連岩石都落淚。

mn: lyric（抒情詩、歌詞）就是源自「伴著 lyre 吟唱的詩」。

senses.en: (usually plural) the words of a song
(of poetry) expressing the writer's personal emotions
a short poem expressing personal feelings

ex.en: She wrote a lyric poem about her childhood home.
ex.zh: 她寫了一首關於兒時老家的抒情詩。

root.note: 伴著里拉琴吟唱的 → 抒情的；歌詞

senses.en: to pave a road with layers of crushed stone

ex.en: The town council voted to macadamize the muddy main street.
ex.zh: 鎮議會投票決定用碎石鋪設泥濘的主要街道。

parts.m: John McAdam 麥克亞當（蘇格蘭工程師）

root.note: 用麥克亞當發明的碎石法鋪路

senses.en: machines collectively, or the parts of a machine
the system or structure by which something operates

ex.en: The factory replaced its old machinery with robots.
ex.zh: 這家工廠用機器人取代了舊機械。

senses.en: a person who operates or repairs machine tools

ex.en: The machinist carefully cut the metal part to exact measurements.
ex.zh: 機械工小心地把金屬零件切割成精確的尺寸。

root.note: 操作機器的人

senses.en: the universe as a whole; a large complex system

ex.en: The novel shows a small village as a mirror of the macrocosm of society.
ex.zh: 這部小說把一個小村莊描寫成整個社會的縮影。

root.note: 大的宇宙

senses.en: to make someone very angry or annoyed

ex.en: The constant noise from the construction site would madden anyone.
ex.zh: 工地不斷傳來的噪音會讓任何人抓狂。

root.note: 使生氣

senses.en: the Virgin Mary; a picture or statue of her

ex.en: The chapel contains a Renaissance painting of the Madonna and Child.
ex.zh: 這座小禮拜堂收藏了一幅文藝復興時期的聖母子像。

root.note: 我的女士 → 聖母

senses.en: a person who performs magic tricks; a wizard
a person with exceptional skill

ex.en: The magician pulled a rabbit out of an empty hat.
ex.zh: 魔術師從空帽子裡變出一隻兔子。

root.note: 會魔法的人

senses.en: having or showing great authority; commanding
relating to a magistrate

ex.en: Her magisterial history of the war is now a standard textbook.
ex.zh: 她那部權威的戰爭史如今已是標準教科書。

root.note: 大師般的 → 有權威的

senses.en: the office or authority of a magistrate; magistrates as a group
senses.zh: 地方法官職位；（總稱）地方法官

ex.en: He held the magistracy of the town for twenty years.
ex.zh: 他擔任該鎮的地方法官長達二十年。

root.note: 長官的職位 → 地方法官職位

senses.en: generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival or enemy

ex.en: She was magnanimous in victory and praised her opponent's effort.
ex.zh: 她勝而不驕，大方地稱讚對手的努力。

root.note: 心胸寬大的 → 寬宏大量

senses.en: a wealthy and powerful person in business or industry

ex.en: The shipping magnate donated millions to build a new hospital.
ex.zh: 那位航運大亨捐了數百萬元興建新醫院。

root.note: 大人物 → 大亨

mn: 別和 magnet（磁鐵）搞混，不過大亨也像磁鐵一樣吸金。

senses.en: a piece of iron or other material that attracts iron
a person or place that attracts others strongly

ex.en: The new night market has become a magnet for tourists.
ex.zh: 新夜市已成為吸引觀光客的熱點。

parts.m: lodestone 天然磁石（源自希臘地名 Magnesia）

root.note: 產磁石的地方 → 磁鐵

senses.en: to make something magnetic
to attract strongly; to charm

ex.en: You can magnetize a needle by rubbing it with a magnet.
ex.zh: 用磁鐵摩擦一根針就能讓它磁化。

root.note: 使成為磁鐵

senses.en: the quality of being extremely beautiful or impressive

ex.en: We were stunned by the magnificence of the palace.
ex.zh: 我們被宮殿的富麗堂皇震懾住了。

root.note: 做得宏大 → 壯麗

senses.en: extremely beautiful, impressive, or excellent

ex.en: From the summit we had a magnificent view of the valley.
ex.zh: 從山頂上我們看到壯麗的山谷景色。

root.note: 做得宏大的 → 壯麗的

senses.en: great size or importance
a measure of the strength of an earthquake or brightness of a star

ex.en: Few people understood the magnitude of the problem at first.
ex.zh: 起初很少人了解這個問題有多嚴重。

root.note: 大的程度 → 規模

senses.en: a great king or prince in India

ex.en: The maharaja's palace is now a luxury hotel.
ex.zh: 大君的宮殿如今成了豪華飯店。

root.note: 大王

senses.en: the state or time of being a young unmarried woman

ex.en: The poem describes her maidenhood in a quiet mountain village.
ex.zh: 這首詩描寫了她在寧靜山村度過的少女時代。

root.note: 少女的時期

senses.en: to keep something in good condition or at the same level
to state strongly that something is true

ex.en: It is important to maintain a healthy balance between work and rest.
ex.zh: 在工作與休息之間維持健康的平衡很重要。

root.note: 握在手中 → 維持

senses.en: the process of keeping something in good condition
financial support, such as money paid to a former spouse

ex.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance until Friday.
ex.zh: 電梯維修中，停用到星期五。

root.note: 握在手中照顧 → 維護

senses.en: corn; a tall cereal plant with large ears of yellow grain

ex.en: Maize was first grown by farmers in ancient Mexico.
ex.zh: 玉米最早是由古代墨西哥的農民種植。

mn: 和 maze（迷宮）同音。

senses.en: cosmetics used to improve one's appearance
the way something is composed; a person's character

ex.en: The genetic makeup of each person is unique.
ex.zh: 每個人的基因組成都是獨一無二的。

senses.en: a disease or illness
a serious problem in society

ex.en: Loneliness has been called the malady of modern life.
ex.zh: 孤獨被稱為現代生活的通病。

parts.m: have, hold 處於（拉丁文 male habitus）

root.note: 處於不好的狀態 → 疾病

senses.en: a serious disease spread by mosquitoes, causing fever and chills

ex.en: Bed nets help protect children from malaria.
ex.zh: 蚊帳可以幫助保護孩子免於瘧疾。

root.note: 古人以為瘧疾是沼澤的「壞空氣」造成的

senses.en: a person who is dissatisfied and complains or rebels
senses.zh: 不滿分子；牢騷滿腹的人

senses.en: dissatisfied and complaining

ex.en: Every office seems to have one malcontent who complains about everything.
ex.zh: 每間辦公室似乎都有一個對什麼都抱怨的人。

root.note: 不滿意的人

senses.en: a curse; a statement wishing harm on someone

ex.en: The old witch muttered a malediction as the knights rode away.
ex.zh: 騎士們騎馬離去時，老巫婆喃喃念著詛咒。

root.note: 說壞話 → 詛咒

senses.en: a person who commits a crime or does wrong

ex.en: The sheriff promised to bring every malefactor to justice.
ex.zh: 警長承諾要將每個作惡者繩之以法。

root.note: 做壞事的人

senses.en: causing harm or evil

ex.en: The story's maleficent fairy placed a curse on the baby princess.
ex.zh: 故事中邪惡的仙女對小公主下了詛咒。

root.note: 做壞事的 → 邪惡的

senses.en: the wish to do harm to others

ex.en: There was pure malevolence in the villain's smile.
ex.zh: 反派的笑容裡充滿了惡意。

root.note: 懷著壞的意願 → 惡意

senses.en: having or showing a wish to do evil to others

ex.en: The villain gave a malevolent smile as he locked the door.
ex.zh: 反派一邊鎖門，一邊露出惡毒的笑容。

root.note: 懷著壞的意願 → 惡毒的

senses.en: to speak about someone in a harmful and untrue way
evil or harmful in nature

ex.en: The politician tried to malign his rival with false rumors.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物試圖用不實謠言中傷對手。

root.note: 天生壞的 → 有害的；說壞話 → 中傷

senses.en: (of a tumor) cancerous and likely to spread
evil and wanting to cause harm

ex.en: Tests showed that the tumor was malignant.
ex.zh: 檢查顯示這個腫瘤是惡性的。

root.note: 天生就壞的 → 惡性的

senses.en: (of metal) able to be hammered or pressed into shape
easily influenced or changed

ex.en: Young children's minds are highly malleable.
ex.zh: 幼童的心智可塑性很高。

root.note: 可以用槌子敲打成形的 → 可塑的

senses.en: a hammer with a large wooden or rubber head

ex.en: He used a rubber mallet to tap the tiles into place.
ex.zh: 他用橡膠槌把磁磚敲到定位。

root.note: 小槌子

senses.en: to treat a person or animal cruelly or violently

ex.en: Anyone who is found to maltreat animals will face a heavy fine.
ex.zh: 任何被查到虐待動物的人都將面臨重罰。

root.note: 不好地對待 → 虐待

senses.en: an animal, such as a tiger or shark, that eats people
(informal) a woman who has many lovers

ex.en: Villagers feared that a man-eater was hiding in the jungle.
ex.zh: 村民擔心有吃人的猛獸躲在叢林裡。

senses.en: a trap for catching trespassers; any dangerous place or situation

ex.en: The old estate was guarded by a hidden man-trap in the woods.
ex.zh: 這座老莊園在樹林裡藏有捕人陷阱來防範闖入者。

senses.en: an official order or authority given to someone
to officially require something

ex.en: The winning party claimed a clear mandate to reform health care.
ex.zh: 勝選的政黨宣稱獲得了改革健保的明確民意授權。

root.note: 交到手上（的任務）→ 授權；命令

senses.en: required by law or rules; compulsory

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for all scooter riders in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 在台灣，所有騎機車的人都必須戴安全帽。

root.note: 交付的命令 → 強制的

senses.en: long hair on the neck of a horse or lion
a person's long, thick hair

ex.en: The lion shook its thick golden mane.
ex.zh: 獅子甩動牠濃密的金色鬃毛。

senses.en: a movement requiring skill and care
a clever plan to gain an advantage; (pl.) military exercises
senses.zh: 策略；花招；（複數）軍事演習

senses.en: to move or guide skillfully

ex.en: She had to maneuver the car carefully into the tiny parking space.
ex.zh: 她得小心地把車開進那個狹小的停車位。

root.note: 用手操作 → 操縱

senses.en: an extreme enthusiasm or craze
a mental state of extreme excitement and overactivity

ex.en: Beatle mania swept across America in 1964.
ex.zh: 1964 年，披頭四熱潮席捲美國。

senses.en: a person who behaves wildly or dangerously
a person with an extreme enthusiasm for something

ex.en: Some maniac was driving at twice the speed limit.
ex.zh: 有個瘋子以速限的兩倍在開車。

root.note: 瘋狂的人

senses.en: a public declaration of the aims and policies of a group

ex.en: The party published a manifesto promising cheaper housing.
ex.zh: 該黨發表了一份承諾降低房價的政見。

root.note: 清楚擺在眼前的聲明 → 宣言

senses.en: resembling a human being; having qualities typical of a man

ex.en: The fossil shows a manlike creature that walked on two legs.
ex.zh: 這塊化石顯示一種用雙腳行走、類似人類的生物。

senses.en: the qualities traditionally expected of a man, such as courage and strength

ex.en: The film questions old ideas about manliness and toughness.
ex.zh: 這部電影質疑了關於男子氣概和堅強的舊觀念。

senses.en: a habitual gesture or way of speaking
excessive use of a particular style in art or writing
senses.zh: （藝術、寫作的）矯揉造作；風格主義

ex.en: The actor copied every mannerism of the president perfectly.
ex.zh: 那名演員完美模仿了總統的每個習慣動作。

root.note: 特有的方式 → 習慣動作

senses.en: a large country house with lands; (historical) a feudal estate

ex.en: The old manor has been turned into a museum.
ex.zh: 那座古老的莊園已經改建成博物館。

parts.m: stay, remain 停留（拉丁文 manere）

root.note: 居住的地方 → 莊園

senses.en: a shelf above a fireplace

ex.en: Family photos lined the mantel above the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁爐上方的架子擺滿了全家福照片。

mn: mantel（壁爐架）與 mantle（斗篷；責任）同音。

senses.en: an important role or responsibility passed from one person to another
a loose sleeveless cloak; a covering layer
the layer of the earth between the crust and the core

ex.en: After her mother retired, she took on the mantle of family leader.
ex.zh: 母親退休後，她接下了一家之主的重任。

mn: 片語 take on the mantle：接下衣缽、承擔重任。

senses.en: a person or company that makes goods in large quantities

ex.en: The manufacturer recalled thousands of faulty phones.
ex.zh: 這家製造商召回了數千支有瑕疵的手機。

root.note: 原指用手做東西的人 → 製造商

senses.en: the act of freeing a slave

ex.en: Some slaves bought their own manumission after years of saving.
ex.zh: 有些奴隸存了多年的錢，為自己贖得了自由。

root.note: 從（主人）手中放走 → 解放奴隸

senses.en: to release from slavery

ex.en: In his will, the landowner chose to manumit all of his slaves.
ex.zh: 那位地主在遺囑中決定解放他所有的奴隸。

root.note: 從手中放走 → 解放奴隸

senses.en: relating to the sea
a member of a navy's infantry force

ex.en: Plastic waste is a serious threat to marine life.
ex.zh: 塑膠垃圾對海洋生物是嚴重的威脅。

root.note: 海的

senses.en: relating to the sea, especially shipping and trade
living or found near the sea

ex.en: The city's maritime museum displays models of old sailing ships.
ex.zh: 這座城市的海事博物館展出古代帆船模型。

root.note: 海的

senses.en: to leave someone trapped and alone in an isolated place
senses.zh: 將（人）遺棄在荒島；使受困

senses.en: a dark brownish-red color

ex.en: The pirates decided to maroon the traitor on a deserted island.
ex.zh: 海盜們決定把叛徒丟棄在荒島上。

senses.en: relating to war or the military

ex.en: The government declared martial law after the coup.
ex.zh: 政變後政府宣布戒嚴。

root.note: 戰神的 → 軍事的

mn: martial arts 武術；martial law 戒嚴。

senses.en: relating to the planet Mars
an imagined inhabitant of Mars

ex.en: The rover collected samples of Martian soil.
ex.zh: 探測車採集了火星土壤的樣本。

root.note: 火星的；火星人

senses.en: the death or suffering of a martyr
a display of suffering to gain sympathy

ex.en: The saint's martyrdom is remembered every year with a festival.
ex.zh: 每年都有節慶紀念這位聖人的殉道。

root.note: 以死作見證 → 殉道

senses.en: to be filled with wonder or surprise
a wonderful or astonishing person or thing
senses.zh: 奇蹟；令人驚嘆的人事物

ex.en: Visitors always marvel at the size of the ancient temple.
ex.zh: 遊客們總是對這座古廟的規模讚嘆不已。

root.note: 令人驚奇的事物

senses.en: stonework or brickwork; the craft of a mason
senses.zh: 石造建築；磚石工程；石工手藝

ex.en: Loose masonry fell from the old building during the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震時，老建築上鬆動的磚石掉了下來。

root.note: 石匠的作品 → 石造建築

senses.en: a false show or pretense
a party where people wear masks and costumes
to pretend to be someone or something else

ex.en: His friendliness was only a masquerade to hide his true intentions.
ex.zh: 他的友善只是為了掩飾真正意圖的偽裝。

root.note: 戴面具的活動 → 化裝舞會；偽裝

senses.en: the brutal killing of many people
to kill many people cruelly; (informal) to defeat heavily

ex.en: The village memorial honors the victims of the massacre.
ex.zh: 村裡的紀念碑悼念大屠殺的受害者。

senses.en: very large, heavy, and solid
exceptionally large in amount or degree

ex.en: The storm caused massive damage along the coast.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雨對沿海地區造成了巨大的破壞。
