root.note: 一大團的 → 巨大的

senses.en: a work of outstanding skill; a person's best work

ex.en: Many critics consider the novel a masterpiece of modern literature.
ex.zh: 許多評論家認為這部小說是現代文學的傑作。

senses.en: great skill or knowledge in a subject
control or power over something

ex.en: She showed complete mastery of the piano at a young age.
ex.zh: 她年紀輕輕就展現了對鋼琴的精湛掌握。

root.note: 大師的境界 → 精通

senses.en: the substance from which something is made
relating to physical things rather than the mind
important and relevant

ex.en: Bamboo is a strong and sustainable building material.
ex.zh: 竹子是一種堅固且永續的建材。

root.note: 萬物之母 → 物質、材料

senses.en: to become real or actually happen
to appear suddenly

ex.en: The promised pay raise did not materialize.
ex.zh: 說好的加薪並沒有實現。

root.note: 變成實體 → 實現；出現

senses.en: relating to a mother; motherly
related through the mother's side of the family

ex.en: My maternal grandparents live in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我的外公外婆住在台南。

root.note: 母親的

senses.en: an afternoon performance of a play or showing of a film

ex.en: Tickets for the Saturday matinee are cheaper than evening shows.
ex.zh: 週六午場的票比晚場便宜。

root.note: 原指上午的活動 → 日場

senses.en: the killing of one's mother; a person who does this

ex.en: The Greek tragedy tells of a son who commits matricide to avenge his father.
ex.zh: 這部希臘悲劇講述一個兒子為父報仇而弒母的故事。

root.note: 殺母

senses.en: the state of being married; marriage

ex.en: The couple were joined in holy matrimony last spring.
ex.zh: 這對佳偶去年春天結為連理。

root.note: 成為母親的狀態 → 婚姻

senses.en: an environment in which something develops
(mathematics) a rectangular array of numbers
a mold in which something is shaped

ex.en: Solve the equation by multiplying the matrix by the vector.
ex.zh: 把矩陣乘上向量來解這個方程式。

root.note: 孕育東西的母體 → 環境；鑄模

senses.en: unemotional and practical
senses.zh: 就事論事的；不帶感情的；實事求是的

ex.en: The doctor delivered the bad news in a calm, matter-of-fact tone.
ex.zh: 醫生以平靜、就事論事的語氣宣布了壞消息。

senses.en: self-pityingly or tearfully sentimental
senses.zh: 多愁善感的；（尤指醉後）自憐落淚的

ex.en: The movie's maudlin ending made some viewers roll their eyes.
ex.zh: 這部電影濫情的結局讓一些觀眾翻白眼。

root.note: 畫中常見哭泣的抹大拉的馬利亞 → 哭哭啼啼的

senses.en: a large, grand tomb

ex.en: The emperor's mausoleum was guarded by thousands of clay soldiers.
ex.zh: 皇帝的陵墓由數千個陶俑士兵守衛。

parts.m: Mausolus 摩索拉斯（古代國王）

root.note: 源自摩索拉斯王的巨大陵墓

senses.en: sentimental in an exaggerated or false way
senses.zh: 過於傷感的；肉麻的；濫情的

ex.en: The greeting card was full of mawkish verses about friendship.
ex.zh: 這張卡片寫滿了關於友誼的肉麻詩句。

senses.en: a short statement of a general truth or rule of conduct

ex.en: "Measure twice, cut once" is a maxim every carpenter knows.
ex.zh: 「量兩次，切一次」是每個木匠都知道的格言。

root.note: 最重要的道理 → 格言

senses.en: a complex network of paths designed as a puzzle
a confusing mass of information or things

ex.en: The children got lost in the hedge maze for almost an hour.
ex.zh: 孩子們在樹籬迷宮裡迷路了將近一小時。

senses.en: an alcoholic drink made from fermented honey and water
(literary) a meadow

ex.en: The Vikings drank mead from horns at their feasts.
ex.zh: 維京人在宴會上用牛角杯喝蜂蜜酒。

senses.en: lacking in quantity or quality; very small

ex.en: He could barely feed his family on his meager salary.
ex.zh: 他微薄的薪水幾乎養不活一家人。

senses.en: afraid to speak plainly or honestly
senses.zh: 說話拐彎抹角的；不敢直言的

ex.en: Voters were tired of mealy-mouthed answers from the candidates.
ex.zh: 選民受夠了候選人拐彎抹角的回答。

senses.en: to follow a winding course
to wander slowly and aimlessly

ex.en: We watched the river meander through the green valley.
ex.zh: 我們看著河流蜿蜒穿過翠綠的山谷。

parts.m: Maeander 米安德河（今土耳其）

root.note: 源自一條以彎曲出名的河流 → 蜿蜒

senses.en: the branch of physics dealing with motion and forces
the practical details or workings of something

ex.en: Students learn the basic laws of mechanics in first-year physics.
ex.zh: 學生在一年級物理課學習力學的基本定律。

root.note: 機器的學問 → 力學

senses.en: a large medal, often worn on a chain
a round decorative design

ex.en: The mayor wore a gold medallion on a chain around her neck.
ex.zh: 市長脖子上戴著一條掛著金色圓牌的鏈子。

root.note: 大型獎章

senses.en: fond of interfering in other people's business

ex.en: Our meddlesome neighbor always asks who is visiting us.
ex.zh: 我們那個愛管閒事的鄰居總是問誰來我們家。

root.note: 喜歡干涉的

senses.en: located in the middle; toward the middle of the body

ex.en: The injury was on the medial side of his left knee.
ex.zh: 受傷的部位在他左膝的內側。

root.note: 中間的

senses.en: to try to settle a dispute between two sides
to bring about or influence a result

ex.en: A neutral country offered to mediate between the two sides.
ex.zh: 一個中立國表示願意在雙方之間進行調停。

root.note: 站在中間 → 調解

senses.en: a substance taken to treat or prevent illness
the science or practice of treating illness

ex.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
ex.zh: 這個藥一天吃兩次，飯後服用。

root.note: 醫生的技藝 → 醫學；藥

senses.en: relating to the Middle Ages (about 500–1500 AD)
(informal) very old-fashioned or primitive

ex.en: The medieval castle still stands on the hill above the town.
ex.zh: 那座中世紀城堡仍矗立在小鎮上方的山丘上。

root.note: 中間的時代 → 中世紀的

senses.en: of only average or poor quality

ex.en: The food was mediocre, but the view from the restaurant was amazing.
ex.zh: 餐點普普通通，但餐廳的景觀很棒。

parts.m: mountain peak 山峰（拉丁文 ocris）

root.note: 只到半山腰 → 平庸的

senses.en: the practice of focusing the mind for relaxation or spiritual purposes
serious, careful thought; a written reflection

ex.en: Ten minutes of meditation each morning helps me stay calm.
ex.zh: 每天早上冥想十分鐘能幫助我保持冷靜。

root.note: 深入思考 → 沉思；冥想

senses.en: a mixture of different things
a series of songs performed as one piece; a swimming race using several strokes

ex.en: The band played a medley of hits from the 1980s.
ex.zh: 樂團演奏了一組 1980 年代的熱門歌曲組曲。

root.note: 混在一起的東西

senses.en: to make or become better; to improve

ex.en: Reformers hoped to meliorate the living conditions of factory workers.
ex.zh: 改革者希望改善工廠工人的生活條件。

root.note: 使更好

senses.en: (of a voice or words) sweet and smooth; pleasant to hear

ex.en: The radio host had a deep, mellifluous voice.
ex.zh: 那位電台主持人有著低沉悅耳的嗓音。

root.note: 像蜂蜜般流動的 → 甜美流暢

senses.en: pleasant-sounding; tuneful

ex.en: We woke to the melodious song of birds outside the window.
ex.zh: 我們在窗外悅耳的鳥鳴聲中醒來。

root.note: 有旋律的 → 悅耳的

senses.en: a play or film with exaggerated characters and emotions
behavior that is overly dramatic

ex.en: Stop the melodrama; it's just a small scratch.
ex.zh: 別這麼誇張了，只是個小擦傷而已。

root.note: 原指配樂的戲劇 → 情節誇張的通俗劇

senses.en: an object kept as a reminder of a person or event

ex.en: She kept the ticket stub as a memento of their first date.
ex.zh: 她留著票根作為兩人第一次約會的紀念。

parts.m: remember! 記住（拉丁文命令式）

root.note: 「記住！」→ 紀念品

senses.en: worth remembering or easily remembered

ex.en: Our trip to the mountains was truly memorable.
ex.zh: 我們的山區之旅真是令人難忘。

root.note: 值得記住的

senses.en: a person or thing that is likely to cause harm; a threat
to threaten

ex.en: Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone on the road.
ex.zh: 酒駕者對路上每個人都是威脅。

parts.m: project, threaten 突出、威脅（拉丁文 minae）

root.note: 逼近的威脅

senses.en: a collection of wild animals kept for display
a strange or varied group of people or things
senses.zh: 形形色色的一群人或物

ex.en: Her apartment houses a menagerie of cats, birds, and turtles.
ex.zh: 她的公寓裡養了貓、鳥和烏龜等一大群動物。

senses.en: not telling the truth; lying

ex.en: The report exposed the company's mendacious advertising claims.
ex.zh: 這份報告揭露了該公司不實的廣告說詞。

parts.m: fault, lie 缺陷、謊言（拉丁文 mendax）

root.note: 有說謊傾向的

mn: 和 mendicant（乞丐）拼法相近，別搞混。

senses.en: a beggar; a member of a religious order living on charity
living by begging

ex.en: A mendicant monk walked from village to village asking for food.
ex.zh: 一位托缽僧從一個村莊走到另一個村莊化緣。

root.note: 乞討的人

senses.en: a characteristic way of thinking of a person or group

ex.en: The coach tried to build a winning mentality in the team.
ex.zh: 教練努力在隊中建立求勝的心態。

root.note: 心智的狀態 → 心態

senses.en: an experienced and trusted adviser
to advise or train someone less experienced

ex.en: My high school mentor encouraged me to apply for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 我的高中導師鼓勵我申請這份獎學金。

mn: 源自荷馬史詩中奧德修斯之子的良師 Mentor。

senses.en: relating to trade or merchants

ex.en: Venice grew rich as a mercantile power in the Middle Ages.
ex.zh: 威尼斯在中世紀作為一個商業強權而致富。

root.note: 商人的 → 商業的

senses.en: a soldier hired to fight for a foreign army
motivated mainly by money

ex.en: It seemed mercenary of him to marry for money.
ex.zh: 他為了錢而結婚，似乎太唯利是圖了。

root.note: 為報酬做事的 → 傭兵；唯利是圖

senses.en: showing kindness or forgiveness to someone one could punish
giving relief from suffering

ex.en: The king was merciful and spared the prisoners' lives.
ex.zh: 國王很仁慈，饒了囚犯們的性命。

root.note: 充滿憐憫的

senses.en: showing no mercy; cruel

ex.en: The desert sun was merciless, and we ran out of water by noon.
ex.zh: 沙漠的太陽毫不留情，我們中午前就把水喝光了。

root.note: 沒有憐憫的

senses.en: attractive in a cheap or showy way but having no real value

ex.en: Critics dismissed the film as meretricious entertainment with no real ideas.
ex.zh: 評論家認為這部電影只是華而不實、沒有真正思想的娛樂。

parts.m: prostitute 妓女（拉丁文 meretrix，mer 賺取）

root.note: 像妓女般靠外表招攬 → 俗豔、華而不實

senses.en: to hold someone's attention completely; to fascinate
(dated) to hypnotize

ex.en: The dancer's graceful movements seemed to mesmerize the audience.
ex.zh: 舞者優雅的動作似乎讓觀眾看得入迷。

parts.m: Franz Mesmer 梅斯梅爾（18 世紀催眠術始祖）

root.note: 用梅斯梅爾的催眠術 → 迷住

senses.en: plural of monsieur; used as a formal title for two or more men (abbreviated Messrs.)
senses.zh: 先生們（monsieur 的複數；縮寫 Messrs.）

ex.en: The letter was addressed to messieurs Dupont and Martin.
ex.zh: 這封信是寫給杜邦先生和馬丁先生的。

root.note: 我的大人們 → 先生們

mn: 法文唸 [meˋsjø]，英文縮寫 Messrs. 則唸 [ˋmɛsɚz]。

senses.en: a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or copper

ex.en: Copper is a metal that conducts electricity very well.
ex.zh: 銅是一種導電性極佳的金屬。

mn: metal（金屬）和 mettle（勇氣）同音，原本是同一個字。

senses.en: the science of metals and how to extract and use them

ex.en: Advances in metallurgy allowed engineers to build lighter airplanes.
ex.zh: 冶金學的進步讓工程師能造出更輕的飛機。

root.note: 處理金屬的工作 → 冶金

senses.en: a complete change of form, as from caterpillar to butterfly
a complete change in character or appearance

ex.en: The old warehouse underwent a metamorphosis into a modern art center.
ex.zh: 那座老倉庫徹底蛻變成一座現代藝術中心。

root.note: 形狀的改變 → 變態；蛻變

senses.en: a figure of speech that describes something by calling it something else
a thing that symbolizes something else

ex.en: "Time is money" is a common metaphor in English.
ex.zh: 「時間就是金錢」是英文裡常見的隱喻。

root.note: 把意義轉移到別的事物上 → 隱喻

mn: simile（明喻）用 like/as；metaphor（暗喻）直接說 A 是 B。

senses.en: relating to metaphysics; concerned with abstract ideas about reality
beyond the physical world; supernatural

ex.en: The class debated metaphysical questions about whether time really exists.
ex.zh: 班上辯論了時間是否真實存在這類形而上的問題。

root.note: 超越自然的 → 形而上的

senses.en: a person who studies metaphysics

ex.en: The metaphysician argued that the mind cannot be reduced to the brain.
ex.zh: 那位形而上學家主張心靈無法化約為大腦。

root.note: 研究超越自然之事的人

senses.en: the branch of philosophy that studies the nature of reality and existence

ex.en: Aristotle's metaphysics explores what it means for something to exist.
ex.zh: 亞里斯多德的形而上學探討事物存在的意義。

root.note: 原指亞里斯多德排在《物理學》之後的著作 → 形而上學

senses.en: to hand out punishment or justice (usually mete out)
senses.zh: 給予（懲罰）；分配（常用 mete out）

ex.en: The court will mete out a harsh sentence to repeat offenders.
ex.zh: 法院將對累犯處以重刑。

root.note: 量好分配出去 → 給予（懲罰）

senses.en: the passing of the soul into another body after death; reincarnation

ex.en: Pythagoras believed in metempsychosis and refused to eat meat.
ex.zh: 畢達哥拉斯相信靈魂轉世，所以拒絕吃肉。

root.note: 靈魂換到（另一個身體）裡 → 轉世

senses.en: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
senses.zh: 一絲不苟的；極其仔細的

ex.en: The scientist kept meticulous records of every experiment.
ex.zh: 那位科學家把每一次實驗都記錄得一絲不苟。

root.note: 怕出錯 → 非常仔細

senses.en: a figure of speech in which something is called by the name of something closely related to it

ex.en: Using "the White House" to mean the president is an example of metonymy.
ex.zh: 用「白宮」來指美國總統就是轉喻的一個例子。

root.note: 換一個名字來稱呼 → 轉喻

senses.en: relating to the system of measurement based on meters and kilograms
a standard of measurement used to judge performance

ex.en: Most countries use the metric system for weights and distances.
ex.zh: 大多數國家的重量和距離都使用公制。

root.note: 測量的

senses.en: a device that marks time with a regular tick for musicians

ex.en: The piano teacher set the metronome to a slow beat.
ex.zh: 鋼琴老師把節拍器調到慢速。

root.note: 規律地測量（拍子）→ 節拍器

senses.en: a very large and important city

ex.en: Tokyo is a bustling metropolis of more than thirteen million people.
ex.zh: 東京是一座人口超過一千三百萬的繁華大都市。

root.note: 母城 → 首要的大城市

senses.en: relating to a large city and its surrounding area

ex.en: The Taipei metropolitan area has an excellent subway system.
ex.zh: 台北都會區有非常好的捷運系統。

root.note: 母城的 → 大都市的

senses.en: courage and strength of character in difficult situations

ex.en: The difficult final match tested the young player's mettle.
ex.zh: 艱難的決賽考驗了這名年輕球員的勇氣。

mn: 原是 metal 的另一種拼法：像金屬一樣硬的性格 → 勇氣。片語 test one's mettle。

senses.en: full of spirit and courage

ex.en: The mettlesome horse refused to stand still at the starting gate.
ex.zh: 那匹精力旺盛的馬在起跑閘門前不肯站定。

root.note: 有勇氣的

senses.en: a small place or situation that has the typical features of something much larger

ex.en: The classroom was a microcosm of society as a whole.
ex.zh: 這間教室就是整個社會的縮影。

root.note: 小小的世界 → 縮影

senses.en: an instrument for measuring very small distances or thicknesses
[ˋmaɪkroˏmitɚ] one millionth of a meter; a micron

ex.en: The engineer used a micrometer to check the thickness of the wire.
ex.zh: 工程師用測微計檢查電線的粗細。

root.note: 測量微小東西的工具；百萬分之一公尺

senses.en: a device that changes sound into electrical signals so it can be recorded or amplified

ex.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
ex.zh: 請對著麥克風說話，讓每個人都聽得到。

root.note: 讓微小的聲音放大的裝置

senses.en: an instrument used to see very small objects

ex.en: We looked at onion cells under the microscope in biology class.
ex.zh: 我們在生物課上用顯微鏡觀察洋蔥細胞。

root.note: 看微小東西的儀器

mn: under the microscope 也可比喻「受到仔細檢視」。

senses.en: so small that it can only be seen with a microscope
senses.zh: 極小的；顯微鏡才看得到的

senses.en: extremely detailed

ex.en: Microscopic organisms live in every drop of pond water.
ex.zh: 每一滴池塘水中都有微生物。

root.note: 要用顯微鏡看的 → 極小的

senses.en: the use of microscopes to study small objects

ex.en: Electron microscopy revealed the structure of the virus.
ex.zh: 電子顯微鏡技術揭示了病毒的結構。

root.note: 觀察微小事物的技術

senses.en: the middle of summer, around the summer solstice in late June

ex.en: Swedes celebrate midsummer by dancing around a flower-covered pole.
ex.zh: 瑞典人在仲夏節時繞著綴滿花朵的柱子跳舞慶祝。

root.note: 夏天的中間

senses.en: a person trained to help women during childbirth

ex.en: The midwife stayed with the mother through the long night of labor.
ex.zh: 助產士整夜陪著分娩中的母親。

root.note: 陪著產婦的婦人 → 助產士

senses.en: a person's look or manner, showing their mood or character

ex.en: The old judge had a serious mien that made lawyers nervous.
ex.zh: 老法官神情嚴肅，讓律師們都很緊張。

senses.en: a person who moves from one place to another, especially to find work
moving regularly from place to place

ex.en: Each migrant worker sends part of his wages home to his family.
ex.zh: 每位移工都會把部分薪水寄回家給家人。

root.note: 遷移的人

senses.en: (of animals) to move from one region to another with the seasons
(of people) to move to another place to live or work

ex.en: Many birds migrate south to escape the cold winter.
ex.zh: 許多鳥類往南遷徙以躲避寒冷的冬天。

root.note: 遷移

senses.en: moving from one place to another with the seasons

ex.en: The wetland is an important stop for migratory birds.
ex.zh: 這片濕地是候鳥重要的中途站。

root.note: 遷移的

senses.en: the number of miles traveled or a vehicle can travel per gallon of fuel
(informal) benefit or advantage gained from something

ex.en: This used car has very low mileage for its age.
ex.zh: 以車齡來說，這輛二手車的里程數很低。

root.note: 英里數 → 里程

senses.en: aggressively active in support of a cause
a person who uses aggressive or violent methods for a cause

ex.en: A militant group claimed responsibility for the attack.
ex.zh: 一個武裝組織宣稱對這起攻擊事件負責。

root.note: 像士兵一樣戰鬥的 → 激進的

senses.en: the belief that a country should have strong armed forces and use them aggressively

ex.en: The rise of militarism in the 1930s led to war in Asia.
ex.zh: 1930 年代軍國主義的興起導致了亞洲的戰爭。

root.note: 推崇軍事的主義

senses.en: (of a fact or circumstance) to have a strong effect in preventing something (usually militate against)
senses.zh: （事實、情況）阻礙；產生不利影響（常用 militate against）

ex.en: His lack of experience may militate against his chances of promotion.
ex.zh: 他經驗不足可能不利於他的升遷機會。

root.note: 像士兵一樣作戰 → 起作用（常指不利）

mn: 別和 mitigate（減輕）搞混：militate against 是「對……不利」。

senses.en: a military force of ordinary citizens rather than professional soldiers

ex.en: The town formed a militia to defend itself against raiders.
ex.zh: 小鎮組織了民兵以抵禦掠奪者。

root.note: 一群（平民）士兵 → 民兵

senses.en: the galaxy containing our solar system, seen as a band of light across the night sky

ex.en: Far from city lights, we could clearly see the Milky Way.
ex.zh: 遠離城市燈光，我們能清楚看見銀河。

mn: 希臘神話說是女神赫拉的乳汁灑在天上形成的，所以叫「牛奶路」。

senses.en: a cereal plant with very small seeds, grown for food

ex.en: The indigenous village holds a festival to celebrate the millet harvest.
ex.zh: 這個原住民部落舉辦祭典慶祝小米豐收。

senses.en: to copy someone's voice, movements, or behavior, often to amuse
a person or animal that copies others

ex.en: Parrots can mimic human speech surprisingly well.
ex.zh: 鸚鵡模仿人類說話的能力好得驚人。

parts.m: imitate 模仿（希臘文 mimos 演員）

root.note: 模仿

senses.en: very small; a small-scale version of something
a very small, detailed painting or model

ex.en: The museum displays a miniature model of the ancient city.
ex.zh: 博物館展示了那座古城的微縮模型。

senses.en: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount
to make something seem less important than it is

ex.en: Wear a seat belt to minimize the risk of serious injury.
ex.zh: 繫上安全帶，把重傷的風險降到最低。

root.note: 使成為最小

senses.en: an unimportant follower who obeys a powerful person

ex.en: The villain sent a minion to steal the plans.
ex.zh: 反派派一個手下去偷計畫書。

senses.en: (usually plural) the giving of help or care

ex.en: Thanks to the nurse's gentle ministration, the patient soon recovered.
ex.zh: 多虧護理師的細心照料，病人很快就康復了。

root.note: 僕人的服侍 → 照料

senses.en: a government department led by a minister
the work or office of a religious minister

ex.en: The Ministry of Education announced changes to the college entrance exam.
ex.zh: 教育部宣布了大學入學考試的改革。

root.note: 服務（國家、上帝）的機構或職務

senses.en: the smaller part of a group, less than half
a group differing in race, religion, or culture from the larger population

ex.en: Only a minority of students voted against the new dress code.
ex.zh: 只有少數學生投票反對新的服裝規定。

root.note: 較小的部分 → 少數

senses.en: a period of sixty seconds
(plural) the official written record of a meeting
[maɪˋnjut] extremely small; very detailed

ex.en: The scientist noticed a minute difference between the two samples.
ex.zh: 科學家注意到兩個樣本之間有極細微的差異。

root.note: 被分得很小的 → 微小的；小時再細分 → 分鐘

mn: 當「分鐘」唸 [ˋmɪnɪt]，當「微小的」唸 [maɪˋnjut]。

senses.en: a small or trivial detail (usually plural minutiae)
senses.zh: 細節；瑣事（常用複數 minutiae）

ex.en: The manager gets lost in every minutia and ignores the big picture.
ex.zh: 那位經理總是迷失在每個細枝末節中，忽略了大局。

root.note: 微小之處 → 細節

senses.en: an optical illusion, such as seeing water in a desert, caused by hot air
a hope or wish that cannot come true

ex.en: The lake in the distance turned out to be a mirage.
ex.zh: 遠處的湖泊結果只是海市蜃樓。

root.note: 看到令人驚奇的景象 → 幻影

senses.en: an unfortunate incident or accident

ex.en: The novel follows the comic misadventure of two tourists lost in Paris.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫兩個觀光客在巴黎迷路的爆笑倒楣遭遇。

root.note: 不好的遭遇

mn: 法律用語 death by misadventure：意外死亡。

senses.en: disliking and distrusting other people
senses.zh: 厭惡人類的；憤世嫉俗的

ex.en: The misanthropic old man refused to speak to his neighbors.
ex.zh: 那個憤世嫉俗的老人拒絕和鄰居說話。

root.note: 憎恨人類的

senses.en: a general dislike and distrust of people

ex.en: Years of betrayal had turned his disappointment into misanthropy.
ex.zh: 多年被背叛的經歷，讓他的失望變成了對人性的厭惡。

root.note: 憎恨人類

mn: 這裡的 mis 是希臘文「恨」，不是英文字首 mis-（錯）。

senses.en: to misunderstand words or actions

ex.en: Readers often misapprehend the author's irony as sincerity.
ex.zh: 讀者常把作者的反諷誤解成真心話。

root.note: 錯誤地理解

senses.en: to behave badly

ex.en: Children often misbehave when they are tired or hungry.
ex.zh: 孩子累了或餓了時常常會不乖。

root.note: 表現不好

senses.en: bad or unacceptable behavior

ex.en: The teacher would not tolerate any misbehavior during the field trip.
ex.zh: 老師在校外教學期間不容許任何不當行為。

root.note: 不好的行為

senses.en: playfully causing trouble
intended to cause harm or trouble

ex.en: The mischievous puppy chewed up my new shoes.
ex.zh: 那隻頑皮的小狗把我的新鞋咬爛了。

parts.m: come to an end, head 結果（古法文 chever）

root.note: 帶來壞結果 → 惹麻煩的；淘氣的

mn: 常被誤唸成 mis-CHEE-vee-ous；正確是三個音節 [ˋmɪstʃɪvəs]。

senses.en: to count wrongly
a wrong count

ex.en: Be careful not to miscount the votes this time.
ex.zh: 這次小心別把票數算錯了。

root.note: 算錯

senses.en: a person who behaves badly or breaks the law

ex.en: Police are searching for the miscreant who spray-painted the school walls.
ex.zh: 警方正在搜尋在學校牆上噴漆的那名歹徒。

root.note: 原指信錯宗教的人 → 惡棍

senses.en: a wicked or illegal act

ex.en: He spent years trying to make up for a single misdeed in his youth.
ex.zh: 他花了好多年來彌補年輕時犯下的一件錯事。

root.note: 壞的行為

senses.en: a minor crime, less serious than a felony
a wrong or improper act

ex.en: Shoplifting a candy bar is usually treated as a misdemeanor.
ex.zh: 偷一條巧克力棒通常被視為輕罪。

root.note: 不好的行為 → 輕罪

senses.en: a person who hoards money and hates spending it

ex.en: The old miser lived in poverty despite his huge fortune.
ex.zh: 那個老守財奴雖然家財萬貫，卻過得很窮困。

root.note: 可憐的人 → 捨不得花錢的人

mn: 和 misery（悲慘）同源：守財奴過得很悲慘。

senses.en: a small accident or piece of bad luck

ex.en: Apart from one minor mishap, the trip went smoothly.
ex.zh: 除了一個小意外之外，這趟旅行很順利。

root.note: 壞運氣 → 小意外

senses.en: to understand or explain something wrongly

ex.en: It is easy to misinterpret a short text message.
ex.zh: 簡短的文字訊息很容易被誤解。

root.note: 錯誤地解釋

senses.en: to put something somewhere and then forget where it is
senses.zh: 把……放錯地方；一時找不到

ex.en: I always mislay my keys when I'm in a hurry.
ex.zh: 我一匆忙就會忘記把鑰匙放在哪裡。

root.note: 放錯地方

senses.en: to manage badly or wrongly

ex.en: If you mismanage the budget, the project will run out of money.
ex.zh: 如果預算管理不當，這個計畫就會把錢用光。

root.note: 管理不好

senses.en: a wrong or inaccurate name or term

ex.en: "Koala bear" is a misnomer, because the koala is not a bear.
ex.zh: 「無尾熊」叫 koala bear 是誤稱，因為無尾熊並不是熊。

root.note: 取錯名字

senses.en: hatred of marriage

ex.en: The bachelor's misogamy was well known among his friends.
ex.zh: 這位單身漢厭惡婚姻是朋友們都知道的事。

root.note: 憎恨婚姻

senses.en: dislike of, contempt for, or prejudice against women

ex.en: The article criticized the misogyny in some online communities.
ex.zh: 這篇文章批評了一些網路社群中的厭女現象。

root.note: 憎恨女人

senses.en: to put something in the wrong place and lose it temporarily
to give trust or affection to the wrong person

ex.en: Try not to misplace your passport while traveling.
ex.zh: 旅行時盡量別把護照弄丟了。

root.note: 放錯地方

senses.en: to give a false or misleading account of something

ex.en: The ad seems to misrepresent how long the battery actually lasts.
ex.zh: 這則廣告似乎誇大了電池實際的續航時間。

root.note: 錯誤地呈現

senses.en: bad or unfair government; disorder
to govern badly

ex.en: Years of misrule left the country poor and divided.
ex.zh: 多年的惡政讓這個國家貧窮又分裂。

root.note: 不好的統治

senses.en: a book containing the prayers and texts for Catholic Mass

ex.en: The priest opened the missal and began to read the prayers.
ex.zh: 神父打開彌撒書，開始誦讀禱文。

root.note: 彌撒用的書

senses.en: a weapon that is self-propelled or guided and carries explosives
an object thrown or shot at a target

ex.en: The navy tested a new missile over the ocean.
ex.zh: 海軍在海上試射了一枚新型飛彈。

root.note: 可以投擲出去的東西 → 飛彈

senses.en: a letter or written message, especially a long or official one

ex.en: She received a long missive from her aunt full of family news.
ex.zh: 她收到阿姨寄來的一封長信，寫滿了家裡的消息。

root.note: 寄送的東西 → 信件

senses.en: lack of trust; suspicion
to be suspicious of

ex.en: There is deep mistrust between the two neighboring countries.
ex.zh: 這兩個鄰國之間存在很深的不信任。

root.note: 不信任

senses.en: full of or covered with mist
(of eyes) filled with tears; (of memories) vague

ex.en: We hiked up the misty mountain early in the morning.
ex.zh: 我們一大早爬上霧氣繚繞的山。

root.note: 有霧的

senses.en: to fail to understand correctly

ex.en: Please don't misunderstand me; I really like your idea.
ex.zh: 請別誤會，我真的很喜歡你的點子。

root.note: 錯誤地理解

senses.en: to use something wrongly or for a bad purpose
[mɪsˋjus] the wrong or improper use of something

ex.en: Officials must not misuse public money for personal travel.
ex.zh: 官員不得濫用公款從事私人旅遊。

root.note: 錯誤地使用

senses.en: a tiny creature related to spiders, often living on plants or animals
a very small amount; a small child

ex.en: A single dust mite is too small to see without a microscope.
ex.zh: 一隻塵蟎小到沒有顯微鏡就看不見。

mn: a mite + 形容詞（口語）表示「有點」，例如 a mite tired。

senses.en: a tall pointed hat worn by bishops
a joint made by cutting two pieces at an angle so they fit together

ex.en: The bishop wore a white miter embroidered with gold.
ex.zh: 主教戴著一頂繡金的白色法冠。

senses.en: to make something less severe, serious, or painful

ex.en: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of urban heat.
ex.zh: 種樹有助於減緩都市熱島效應。

parts.m: soft, mild 柔和（拉丁文 mitis）

root.note: 使柔和 → 減輕

mn: mitigating circumstances：可減輕罪責的情節。

senses.en: techniques or systems for improving memory

ex.en: Mnemonics can make memorizing vocabulary much easier.
ex.zh: 記憶術能讓背單字容易許多。

root.note: 記憶的技術

mn: 開頭的 m 不發音；這本 App 裡的 mn 欄位就是 mnemonic 的縮寫。

senses.en: a deep, wide ditch filled with water around a castle
a lasting advantage that protects a business from competitors

ex.en: A drawbridge crossed the moat to the castle gate.
ex.zh: 一座吊橋跨越護城河通往城堡大門。

senses.en: rule or domination by the masses or a mob

ex.en: Critics warned that the angry protests could turn into mobocracy.
ex.zh: 批評者警告，憤怒的抗議可能演變成暴民政治。

root.note: 暴民的統治

senses.en: a soft leather shoe without a heel, originally worn by Native Americans
senses.zh: （北美原住民的）鹿皮軟鞋；莫卡辛鞋

ex.en: Each moccasin was decorated with colorful beads.
ex.zh: 每隻鹿皮軟鞋上都綴著彩色串珠。

senses.en: teasing or making fun of someone
an absurd or worthless imitation of something

ex.en: The unfair trial was a mockery of justice.
ex.zh: 這場不公正的審判是對正義的嘲弄。

root.note: 嘲笑的行為

mn: make a mockery of：使……成為笑柄。

senses.en: the avoidance of excess or extremes

ex.en: Chocolate is fine if you eat it in moderation.
ex.zh: 巧克力只要適量吃就沒問題。

root.note: 合乎尺度 → 適度

senses.en: a person who leads a discussion or debate
a person who monitors an online forum

ex.en: The moderator asked each candidate the same three questions.
ex.zh: 主持人向每位候選人提出相同的三個問題。

root.note: 維持分寸的人 → 主持人

senses.en: the quality or condition of being modern

ex.en: The city blends ancient tradition with striking modernity.
ex.zh: 這座城市融合了古老傳統與鮮明的現代感。

parts.m: just now 剛才（拉丁文 modo）

root.note: 屬於現在的性質 → 現代性

senses.en: to adapt something to modern needs or habits; to update

ex.en: The government plans to modernize the old railway system.
ex.zh: 政府計劃將老舊的鐵路系統現代化。

root.note: 使現代化

senses.en: a small change made to improve something

ex.en: With one small modification, the recipe becomes vegan.
ex.zh: 只要稍作修改，這道食譜就能變成全素料理。

root.note: 調整尺度 → 修改

senses.en: to make partial changes to something
(grammar) to describe or limit the meaning of a word

ex.en: We had to modify our plans because of the typhoon.
ex.zh: 因為颱風，我們不得不修改計畫。

root.note: 調整尺度 → 修改

senses.en: fashionable; stylish

ex.en: The café is full of modish young people taking photos of their drinks.
ex.zh: 咖啡廳裡滿是替飲料拍照的時髦年輕人。

root.note: 合乎流行的

senses.en: to adjust or regulate the level or tone of something
(music) to change from one key to another

ex.en: A good speaker learns to modulate her voice to keep listeners interested.
ex.zh: 好的演說者會學習調整聲音，讓聽眾保持興趣。

root.note: 做小幅度的尺度調整 → 調節

senses.en: to calm someone's anger or anxiety

ex.en: The airline offered free meals to mollify the angry passengers.
ex.zh: 航空公司提供免費餐點來安撫憤怒的乘客。

root.note: 使（心情）軟化 → 安撫

senses.en: (of an animal) to shed old feathers, hair, or skin
the process of molting

ex.en: Snakes molt several times a year as they grow.
ex.zh: 蛇在成長過程中一年會脫好幾次皮。

root.note: 改變（外皮）→ 換毛；蛻皮

senses.en: lasting for a very short time

ex.en: There was a momentary silence before the audience burst into applause.
ex.zh: 觀眾爆出掌聲之前，現場安靜了片刻。

root.note: 片刻的

mn: momentary（短暫的）vs. momentous（重大的）：多了 ous 就變重要了。

senses.en: very important because of its effect on the future

ex.en: Choosing a college is a momentous decision.
ex.zh: 選擇大學是一個重大的決定。

parts.m: importance, movement 重要性（拉丁文 momentum）

root.note: 有重大影響的

senses.en: the force that keeps a moving object moving
the strength or speed gained by a developing process

ex.en: The campaign gained momentum after the popular singer joined it.
ex.zh: 那位人氣歌手加入後，這項運動的聲勢越來越大。

root.note: 移動的力量 → 動量；氣勢

senses.en: a system of government with a king or queen as head of state
a country ruled by a king or queen

ex.en: The United Kingdom is a constitutional monarchy.
ex.zh: 英國是君主立憲國家。

root.note: 一人統治 → 君主制

senses.en: a building where monks live and worship

ex.en: The monastery sits high in the mountains, far from any town.
ex.zh: 那座修道院高踞山中，遠離任何城鎮。

root.note: 獨居修行之處 → 修道院

senses.en: relating to money or currency

ex.en: The central bank sets the country's monetary policy.
ex.zh: 中央銀行負責制定國家的貨幣政策。

parts.m: money 錢（源自羅馬鑄幣所在的朱諾神廟 Moneta）

root.note: 錢的

senses.en: a dog of no definite breed
of mixed origin or character

ex.en: They adopted a friendly mongrel from the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 他們從收容所領養了一隻親人的米克斯。

root.note: 混雜而成的 → 雜種

senses.en: a warning of danger; a formal notice

ex.en: The dark clouds were a monition of the coming storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲是暴風雨即將來臨的警訊。

root.note: 警告

senses.en: giving a warning

ex.en: The principal sent a monitory letter to students who skipped class.
ex.zh: 校長寄了一封警告信給翹課的學生。

root.note: 警告的

senses.en: government by a single person

ex.en: Without checks and balances, the republic slowly became a monocracy.
ex.zh: 缺乏制衡機制，這個共和國漸漸變成一人統治。

root.note: 一人統治

senses.en: the practice of having only one spouse or partner at a time

ex.en: Some bird species practice lifelong monogamy.
ex.zh: 有些鳥類終身實行單一配偶制。

root.note: 只有一段婚姻 → 一夫一妻

senses.en: a design of combined initials of a name, used on clothing or stationery

ex.en: Her towels were embroidered with a gold monogram.
ex.zh: 她的毛巾繡著金色的姓名縮寫圖案。

root.note: 合成一個的字母圖案

senses.en: a detailed written study of a single specialized subject

ex.en: The historian published a monograph on tea farming in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這位歷史學家出版了一本關於台灣茶業的專著。

root.note: 只寫一個主題 → 專題論文

senses.en: a large single upright block of stone
a large, powerful organization that acts as a single unit and resists change

ex.en: An ancient monolith stands alone in the middle of the field.
ex.zh: 一根古老的巨石柱孤立在田野中央。

root.note: 單一塊石頭 → 巨石

senses.en: a long speech by one actor or person

ex.en: The actor delivered a moving monologue at the end of the play.
ex.zh: 那位演員在劇末發表了一段動人的獨白。

root.note: 一個人說話 → 獨白

senses.en: an obsessive focus on a single subject or idea

ex.en: Captain Ahab's monomania drives him to hunt the white whale at any cost.
ex.zh: 亞哈船長的偏執驅使他不惜一切代價獵捕白鯨。

root.note: 只對一件事瘋狂 → 偏執

senses.en: complete control of the supply of a product or service by one company
exclusive possession or control of something

ex.en: For decades the company held a monopoly on the city's electricity.
ex.zh: 幾十年來，這家公司壟斷了該市的電力供應。

root.note: 只有一家在賣 → 壟斷

senses.en: a word of one syllable

ex.en: The sulky teenager answered every question with a monosyllable.
ex.zh: 那個鬧脾氣的青少年每個問題都只回答一個字。

root.note: 一個音節的字

senses.en: a voice or sound that does not change in pitch
without variation in tone or color

ex.en: The lecturer spoke in a dull monotone that put everyone to sleep.
ex.zh: 講者用單調平板的語調說話，讓大家都睡著了。

root.note: 只有一個音調

senses.en: dull and boring because it never changes
senses.zh: 單調乏味的；一成不變的

ex.en: Working on an assembly line can be monotonous.
ex.zh: 在生產線上工作可能很單調乏味。

root.note: 只有一個音調的 → 單調的

senses.en: lack of variety; boring sameness

ex.en: A weekend trip helped break the monotony of her daily routine.
ex.zh: 一趟週末旅行幫她打破了日常生活的單調。

root.note: 一個音調 → 單調

senses.en: a French title or form of address for a man, equivalent to Mr. or sir

ex.en: "Good evening, monsieur," said the waiter with a small bow.
ex.zh: 「晚安，先生。」服務生微微鞠躬說道。

root.note: 我的大人 → 先生

mn: 法語唸 [məˋsjø]；複數是 messieurs。

senses.en: something very large and ugly, especially a building
senses.zh: 醜陋的龐然大物（尤指建築）

senses.en: something shockingly evil or wrong

ex.en: Residents called the new concrete tower a monstrosity.
ex.zh: 居民們把那棟新的水泥大樓稱為醜陋的怪物。

root.note: 像怪物一樣的東西

senses.en: a ray of moonlight

ex.en: A single moonbeam shone through the gap in the curtains.
ex.zh: 一道月光從窗簾的縫隙中灑了進來。

senses.en: the confidence and enthusiasm of a person or group

ex.en: Losing five games in a row hurt the team's morale.
ex.zh: 連輸五場比賽打擊了球隊的士氣。

root.note: 精神上的狀態 → 士氣

mn: morale [məˋræl]（士氣）重音在後；moral [ˋmɔrəl]（道德的）重音在前。

senses.en: a person who teaches or judges others' morals, often too strictly

ex.en: The moralist complained that modern music was corrupting young people.
ex.zh: 那位衛道人士抱怨現代音樂正在帶壞年輕人。

root.note: 講道德的人

senses.en: principles about right and wrong behavior
the extent to which an action is right or wrong

ex.en: The novel raises questions about the morality of war.
ex.zh: 這部小說提出了關於戰爭道德性的問題。

root.note: 品行的準則 → 道德

senses.en: to comment on right and wrong, usually in a self-righteous way

ex.en: Please just help me and don't moralize about my mistakes.
ex.zh: 拜託幫我就好，別對我的錯誤說教。

root.note: 講道德 → 說教

senses.en: a temporary ban or suspension of an activity
a legal delay in paying debts

ex.en: The government declared a moratorium on new coal plants.
ex.zh: 政府宣布暫停興建新的燃煤電廠。

root.note: 延遲 → 暫停

senses.en: having an unhealthy interest in death or disturbing subjects
senses.zh: 病態的；（對死亡等）有不健康興趣的

senses.en: (medicine) relating to disease

ex.en: He has a morbid fascination with plane crashes.
ex.zh: 他對空難有一種病態的著迷。

root.note: 生病的 → 病態的

senses.en: biting or sarcastic in style or manner

ex.en: The columnist was feared for her mordacious wit.
ex.zh: 那位專欄作家以尖酸刻薄的機智令人畏懼。

root.note: 愛咬人的 → 尖酸刻薄

senses.en: (of humor) sharply sarcastic
a substance used to fix dyes in cloth

ex.en: The comedian is known for his mordant humor about politics.
ex.zh: 這位喜劇演員以對政治的辛辣幽默聞名。

root.note: 咬人的 → 尖刻的

senses.en: at the point of death; (of a thing) losing strength and close to ending
senses.zh: 垂死的；瀕臨消亡的；停滯的

ex.en: The new mayor promised to revive the town's moribund economy.
ex.zh: 新市長承諾要振興鎮上奄奄一息的經濟。

root.note: 即將死去的

senses.en: sullen, gloomy, and unwilling to talk

ex.en: He became morose and withdrawn after losing his job.
ex.zh: 失業後，他變得悶悶不樂又孤僻。

root.note: 原指固執於習性 → 陰鬱

senses.en: the study of the form and structure of living things
the study of the forms of words

ex.en: Word morphology explains how "unhappiness" is built from smaller parts.
ex.zh: 構詞學解釋了 unhappiness 是如何由較小的部分組成的。

root.note: 研究形狀的學問

senses.en: made up of very different and mismatched kinds
senses.zh: 雜七雜八的；形形色色的

senses.en: the multicolored costume of a jester

ex.en: A motley crew of students, retirees, and artists joined the protest.
ex.zh: 學生、退休人士和藝術家等形形色色的人加入了抗議。

senses.en: a short phrase expressing a belief or guiding principle

ex.en: Our school motto is "Honesty, Diligence, Kindness."
ex.zh: 我們的校訓是「誠實、勤奮、仁慈」。

senses.en: a person who climbs mountains

ex.en: The experienced mountaineer reached the summit of Everest twice.
ex.zh: 這位經驗豐富的登山家兩度登上聖母峰。

root.note: 爬山的人

senses.en: having many mountains
extremely large

ex.en: Taiwan is a mountainous island with more than two hundred peaks over 3,000 meters.
ex.zh: 台灣是一座多山的島嶼，超過三千公尺的山峰有兩百多座。

root.note: 多山的

senses.en: the amount of food or drink that fills the mouth
(informal) a long word or phrase that is hard to say

ex.en: "Antidisestablishmentarianism" is quite a mouthful.
ex.zh: 「antidisestablishmentarianism」這個字真是又長又難唸。

root.note: 一嘴的量

senses.en: to confuse or mix things up
a state of confusion or disorder

ex.en: Too many instructions will only muddle the new employees.
ex.zh: 太多的指示只會把新員工搞糊塗。

mn: 片語 muddle through：勉強應付過去。

senses.en: to make a sound quieter or less clear
to wrap up for warmth

ex.en: Thick curtains help muffle the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 厚窗簾有助於減弱街上的噪音。

senses.en: (dated, now offensive) a person with one Black and one white parent
senses.zh: （過時且帶冒犯意味）黑白混血兒

ex.en: Historians note that the word mulatto appeared in colonial census records.
ex.zh: 歷史學家指出，mulatto 這個詞曾出現在殖民時期的人口普查紀錄中。

parts.m: mule 騾子（西班牙文 mulo）

root.note: 源自「騾子」的比喻，因此被視為冒犯用語

mn: 這是帶有種族歧視色彩的舊詞，現代請用 mixed-race 或 biracial。

senses.en: a person who drives mules

ex.en: The muleteer led the pack animals down the narrow mountain trail.
ex.zh: 趕騾人牽著馱獸走下狹窄的山路。

root.note: 趕騾子的人

senses.en: having many forms or shapes

ex.en: The artist explored the multiform beauty of clouds.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家探索雲朵千變萬化的美。

root.note: 多種形狀的

senses.en: a large number or variety

ex.en: The city offers a multiplicity of cultures, cuisines, and languages.
ex.zh: 這座城市擁有多元的文化、美食和語言。

root.note: 多層 → 多樣性

senses.en: ordinary and dull; lacking interest
relating to this world rather than a spiritual one

ex.en: The novel turns a mundane trip to the grocery store into an adventure.
ex.zh: 這部小說把一趟平凡的超市購物寫成了一場冒險。

root.note: 世間的 → 世俗、平凡的

senses.en: relating to a city or town or its local government

ex.en: The municipal government built a new library downtown.
ex.zh: 市政府在市中心蓋了一座新圖書館。

root.note: 承擔公共職責的（城市）→ 市政的

senses.en: a city or town with its own local government
senses.zh: 自治市；直轄市；市政當局

ex.en: Taichung became a special municipality in 2010.
ex.zh: 台中在 2010 年升格為直轄市。

root.note: 市 → 自治市

senses.en: great generosity in giving

ex.en: Thanks to one donor's munificence, the museum doubled its collection.
ex.zh: 多虧一位捐贈者的慷慨，博物館的館藏增加了一倍。

root.note: 送禮物 → 慷慨

senses.en: extremely generous

ex.en: The university received a munificent gift of fifty million dollars.
ex.zh: 這所大學獲得了五千萬美元的慷慨捐贈。

root.note: 送大禮的 → 慷慨的

senses.en: to gather up courage, strength, or support
to assemble troops for inspection or battle
a gathering of troops

ex.en: She finally managed to muster the courage to ask for a raise.
ex.zh: 她終於鼓起勇氣要求加薪。

root.note: 召集起來展示 → 集合

mn: pass muster：符合要求、過關。

senses.en: a change in the genetic structure of an organism
a change or alteration

ex.en: A single mutation can make a virus spread more easily.
ex.zh: 單一突變就能讓病毒更容易傳播。

root.note: 改變 → 突變

senses.en: to injure severely by cutting off or damaging part of the body
to damage or spoil something badly

ex.en: Careless editing can mutilate a good essay.
ex.zh: 粗心的編輯可能把一篇好文章改得面目全非。

root.note: 使殘缺

senses.en: an open rebellion against authority, especially by sailors or soldiers
to refuse to obey authority; to rebel

ex.en: The sailors staged a mutiny and took control of the ship.
ex.zh: 水手們發動叛變，奪取了船隻的控制權。

senses.en: countless; extremely many
a very large number of things

ex.en: The internet offers myriad ways to learn a new language.
ex.zh: 網路提供了無數種學習新語言的方法。

parts.m: ten thousand 一萬（希臘文 myrias）

root.note: 一萬 → 無數

senses.en: a person who seeks spiritual truth through meditation or prayer
mystical; having spiritual or hidden meaning

ex.en: The mystic spent years meditating alone in a mountain cave.
ex.zh: 那位神祕主義者獨自在山洞中冥想多年。

root.note: 參與祕密儀式的人 → 神祕主義者

senses.en: a state of confusion or bewilderment
the act of making something unnecessarily obscure

ex.en: She stared at the strange instructions in complete mystification.
ex.zh: 她一頭霧水地盯著那些奇怪的說明。

root.note: 使變得神祕 → 困惑

senses.en: a traditional story explaining natural or social events, often involving gods
a widely held but false belief

ex.en: It is a myth that we only use ten percent of our brains.
ex.zh: 人類只用了百分之十的大腦是一種迷思。

senses.en: a collection of myths of a particular culture
the study of myths

ex.en: In Greek mythology, Zeus is the king of the gods.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，宙斯是眾神之王。

root.note: 神話故事的集合；神話學

senses.en: having no name or an unknown name
too terrible or hard to describe

ex.en: A nameless donor paid for the children's new playground.
ex.zh: 一位不具名的捐贈者出錢蓋了孩子們的新遊樂場。

root.note: 沒有名字的

senses.en: a flammable liquid obtained from petroleum or coal, used as fuel or solvent

ex.en: The refinery turns crude oil into naphtha and other products.
ex.zh: 煉油廠把原油加工成石腦油和其他產品。

senses.en: (Greek myth) a beautiful youth who fell in love with his own reflection
senses.zh: （希臘神話）納西瑟斯（愛上自己倒影的美少年）

senses.en: (lowercase) a plant with white or yellow flowers, such as the daffodil

ex.en: Like Narcissus, the singer seemed to be in love with his own image.
ex.zh: 那位歌手就像納西瑟斯一樣，似乎愛上了自己的形象。

mn: narcissism（自戀）就是從這個神話人物而來。

senses.en: to tell a story; to give a spoken commentary for a film or show

ex.en: A famous actor agreed to narrate the nature documentary.
ex.zh: 一位知名演員答應為這部自然紀錄片擔任旁白。

root.note: 讓人知道 → 講述

mn: 美式也常唸 [ˋnæret]。

senses.en: the act of telling a story; a spoken commentary

ex.en: The film's narration is spoken by the main character as an old man.
ex.zh: 這部電影的旁白由年老時的主角來敘述。

root.note: 講述

senses.en: a spoken or written account of connected events; a story
a way of presenting events that reflects a particular point of view
in the form of a story

ex.en: The politician tried to change the narrative about the economy.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物試圖扭轉關於經濟的論述。

root.note: 講述的內容 → 敘事

senses.en: a person who tells a story, especially in a book, play, or film

ex.en: The narrator of the novel turns out to be unreliable.
ex.zh: 這部小說的敘述者結果是不可靠的。

root.note: 講述的人

senses.en: unwilling to accept ideas or opinions different from one's own
senses.zh: 心胸狹窄的；思想偏狹的

ex.en: It is narrow-minded to judge people by their accents.
ex.zh: 以口音來評斷別人是很狹隘的。

senses.en: relating to the nose
(of a voice) sounding as if breathed through the nose

ex.en: This nasal spray relieves stuffiness caused by allergies.
ex.zh: 這種鼻噴劑可以緩解過敏造成的鼻塞。

root.note: 鼻子的

senses.en: relating to the place or time of one's birth

ex.en: Salmon swim back to their natal streams to lay eggs.
ex.zh: 鮭魚會洄游到出生的溪流產卵。

root.note: 出生的

mn: prenatal（產前的）、postnatal（產後的）都含這個字根。

senses.en: the status of belonging to a particular nation; citizenship
an ethnic group forming part of a nation

ex.en: Please write your nationality on the immigration form.
ex.zh: 請在入境表格上填寫你的國籍。

root.note: 出生所屬的國家 → 國籍

senses.en: in a normal or expected way; of course
by nature; without artificial help

ex.en: Some people are naturally good at languages.
ex.zh: 有些人天生就擅長語言。

root.note: 天生地

senses.en: a feeling of sickness with an urge to vomit
strong disgust

ex.en: The medicine may cause mild nausea and headaches.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能引起輕微的噁心和頭痛。

root.note: 原指暈船 → 噁心

senses.en: to make someone feel sick or disgusted

ex.en: The smell of rotting fish would nauseate anyone.
ex.zh: 腐魚的氣味會讓任何人作嘔。

root.note: 使暈船 → 使噁心

senses.en: feeling sick and wanting to vomit
causing disgust; nauseating

ex.en: The winding mountain road made me feel nauseous.
ex.zh: 彎彎曲曲的山路讓我覺得想吐。

root.note: 暈船的 → 想吐的

senses.en: relating to sailors, ships, or navigation

ex.en: One nautical mile is slightly longer than a regular mile.
ex.zh: 一海里比一般的英里稍長一點。

root.note: 水手的 → 航海的

senses.en: relating to a navy or warships

ex.en: The naval base is located on the southern coast.
ex.zh: 海軍基地位於南部海岸。

root.note: 船的 → 海軍的

mn: naval（海軍的）和 navel（肚臍）同音，別寫錯。

senses.en: the small hollow in the middle of the belly; the belly button
the central point of something

ex.en: A navel orange has a small bump at one end that looks like a belly button.
ex.zh: 臍橙的一端有個小凸起，看起來像肚臍。

mn: navel-gazing：過度自省、只顧自己的事。

senses.en: (of a river or sea) wide and deep enough for ships to travel on
(of a website) easy to move around in

ex.en: The river is navigable only during the rainy season.
ex.zh: 這條河只有在雨季才能通航。

root.note: 可以行船的

senses.en: to plan and direct the route of a ship, aircraft, or vehicle
to find one's way through a difficult place or situation
senses.zh: 順利通過；應付（複雜情況）

ex.en: New students often need a map to navigate the huge campus.
ex.zh: 新生常常需要地圖才能在偌大的校園裡找到路。

root.note: 駕駛船隻 → 導航

senses.en: a cloud of gas and dust in outer space

ex.en: The telescope captured a glowing nebula where new stars are forming.
ex.zh: 望遠鏡拍到一團正在形成新恆星的發光星雲。

root.note: 太空中的雲霧 → 星雲

mn: 形容詞 nebulous 是「模糊不清的」，像雲霧一樣。

senses.en: required to be done or achieved; needed
happening as an unavoidable result

ex.en: It is necessary to wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle.
ex.zh: 騎機車時必須戴安全帽。

root.note: 不能退讓、省略的 → 必要的

senses.en: to make something necessary as a result

ex.en: The broken pipe will necessitate closing the school for a day.
ex.zh: 水管破裂將使學校必須停課一天。

root.note: 使變得必要

senses.en: the state of being required; something that is needed

ex.en: For many families, a car is a necessity rather than a luxury.
ex.zh: 對許多家庭而言，汽車是必需品而不是奢侈品。

root.note: 必要的東西 → 必需品

mn: 諺語：Necessity is the mother of invention.（需要為發明之母）

senses.en: a list of people who have died recently; an obituary

ex.en: The alumni magazine publishes a necrology in every issue.
ex.zh: 校友雜誌每期都會刊登一份過世校友名單。

root.note: 記錄死者的文字 → 死亡名單

senses.en: a person who claims to communicate with the dead; a sorcerer

ex.en: In the fantasy novel, a necromancer raises an army of skeletons.
ex.zh: 在那本奇幻小說裡，一名巫師召喚出一支骷髏大軍。

root.note: 透過死者占卜的人 → 通靈師、巫師

senses.en: a large ancient cemetery

ex.en: Archaeologists uncovered painted tombs in the ancient necropolis.
ex.zh: 考古學家在古代大墓地裡發現了彩繪墳墓。

root.note: 死者之城 → 大墓地

senses.en: the death of cells or tissue in a part of the body

ex.en: Frostbite can lead to necrosis of the fingers and toes.
ex.zh: 凍傷可能導致手指和腳趾壞死。

root.note: 組織死亡的狀態 → 壞死

senses.en: a sweet liquid produced by flowers and collected by bees
(in Greek myth) the drink of the gods; any delicious drink

ex.en: Hummingbirds hover in front of flowers to sip nectar.
ex.zh: 蜂鳥在花前盤旋吸食花蜜。

senses.en: a kind of peach with smooth skin

ex.en: She packed a ripe nectarine in her lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在午餐盒裡放了一顆熟透的油桃。

root.note: 像花蜜一樣甜的水果 → 油桃

senses.en: sewing or embroidery; articles made this way

ex.en: Her grandmother's needlework hangs framed in the living room.
ex.zh: 她祖母的刺繡作品裱框掛在客廳裡。

root.note: 用針做的工作 → 針線活

senses.en: lacking the necessities of life; very poor
needing a lot of emotional support or attention
senses.zh: （情感上）很黏人的；需要關注的

ex.en: The charity delivers hot meals to needy families every weekend.
ex.zh: 這個慈善團體每個週末都會送熱食給貧困家庭。

senses.en: wicked or criminal

ex.en: The hackers used the stolen data for nefarious purposes.
ex.zh: 駭客把偷來的資料拿去做不法的勾當。

root.note: 違反神的律法 → 邪惡的

senses.en: to cancel out the effect of something
to deny the existence or truth of

ex.en: Eating junk food every night will negate the benefits of your workouts.
ex.zh: 每晚吃垃圾食物會抵銷你運動的效果。

root.note: 說「不」→ 否定、使無效

senses.en: the act of denying or contradicting
the absence or opposite of something

ex.en: Censorship is the negation of free speech.
ex.zh: 審查制度就是言論自由的反面。

root.note: 否定的行為

senses.en: failing to give proper care or attention

ex.en: The neglectful landlord ignored the tenants' complaints about the leaking roof.
ex.zh: 那個不負責的房東對房客抱怨屋頂漏水置之不理。

root.note: 沒有撿起來照顧 → 疏忽的

senses.en: a light, thin dressing gown worn by women

ex.en: The actress wore a silk negligee in the bedroom scene.
ex.zh: 那位女演員在臥室那場戲裡穿著一件絲質睡袍。

root.note: 不講究穿著、隨意的衣服 → 睡袍

senses.en: failure to take proper care; carelessness

ex.en: The accident was caused by the driver's negligence.
ex.zh: 這場意外是駕駛的疏忽造成的。

parts.m: choose, pick up 選、拾起（= lect）

root.note: 不去照料 → 疏忽

senses.en: failing to take proper care in doing something

ex.en: The court ruled that the hospital had been negligent in its care of the patient.
ex.zh: 法院判定醫院在照護病人上有疏失。

parts.m: choose, pick up 選、拾起（= lect）

root.note: 不去照料的 → 疏忽的

mn: negligent 是「疏忽的」，negligible 是「可忽略的、微不足道的」，別搞混。

senses.en: so small or unimportant that it is not worth considering

ex.en: The difference in price between the two phones is negligible.
ex.zh: 這兩支手機的價差微不足道。

root.note: 可以不去理會的 → 可忽略的

senses.en: open to discussion or change
(of a road or obstacle) able to be passed or crossed

ex.en: The salary is negotiable, depending on your experience.
ex.zh: 薪資可依經驗商議。

root.note: 不閒著、做生意 → 談判 → 可協商的

senses.en: (Greek myth) the goddess of retribution who punishes pride
senses.zh: （希臘神話）復仇女神涅墨西斯

senses.en: (lowercase) a long-standing enemy or rival; a source of downfall
senses.zh: （小寫）死對頭；剋星；應得的懲罰

ex.en: In Greek myth, Nemesis punished mortals who became too proud.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，涅墨西斯會懲罰過於驕傲的凡人。

root.note: 分配應得的報應 → 復仇女神 → 剋星

senses.en: the modern theory of evolution combining natural selection with genetics

ex.en: Neo-Darwinism explains evolution through natural selection acting on genetic variation.
ex.zh: 新達爾文主義以天擇作用於基因變異來解釋演化。

root.note: 新的達爾文學說

senses.en: Latin as used in scholarly writing from the Renaissance onward
senses.zh: 新拉丁語（文藝復興後的學術拉丁文）

ex.en: Many scientific names for plants are written in neo-Latin.
ex.zh: 許多植物的學名是用新拉丁語寫成的。

root.note: 較新時期的拉丁文

senses.en: government by new or inexperienced people

ex.en: Critics warned that the cabinet full of first-time officials was a neocracy.
ex.zh: 批評者警告，這個滿是新手官員的內閣是外行人當政。

root.note: 由新人統治 → 新手政治

senses.en: relating to the later Stone Age, when farming began and polished stone tools were used

ex.en: Farming spread across Europe during the Neolithic period.
ex.zh: 農業在新石器時代傳遍了歐洲。

root.note: 新的石器 → 新石器時代的

senses.en: the creation or use of new words or new meanings

ex.en: Social media has sped up neology, with new slang appearing every month.
ex.zh: 社群媒體加快了新詞的產生，每個月都有新的流行語出現。

root.note: 新的字 → 造新詞

senses.en: a modern revival of pre-Christian nature religions

ex.en: Neopaganism often draws on ancient festivals marking the seasons.
ex.zh: 新異教主義常借用古代慶祝季節的節日。

root.note: 新興的異教信仰

senses.en: a beginner in a skill or activity; a new convert

ex.en: As a neophyte in the kitchen, he burned the rice twice.
ex.zh: 他是廚房新手，把飯燒焦了兩次。

root.note: 新種下的植物 → 新手

senses.en: to settle comfortably and snugly
to be situated in a sheltered position

ex.en: The puppy likes to nestle against its mother to keep warm.
ex.zh: 小狗喜歡依偎在媽媽身邊取暖。

root.note: 像待在巢裡一樣 → 依偎

senses.en: a young bird that is too young to leave the nest

ex.en: The mother robin brought worms to her hungry nestling.
ex.zh: 知更鳥媽媽帶蟲回來給飢餓的雛鳥。

root.note: 巢裡的小東西 → 雛鳥

senses.en: a plant with leaves covered in stinging hairs
to irritate or annoy

ex.en: His constant interruptions began to nettle the speaker.
ex.zh: 他不斷插嘴，開始惹惱演講者。

mn: 被蕁麻刺到會又癢又痛，所以 nettle 引申為「惹惱」。

senses.en: a system of connected people, things, or computers
to meet and exchange information with people for professional benefit

ex.en: The city has an efficient network of buses and subways.
ex.zh: 這座城市有很有效率的公車與捷運網路。

root.note: 網狀的結構

senses.en: relating to nerves or the nervous system

ex.en: Scientists studied the neural activity of patients while they slept.
ex.zh: 科學家研究病人睡眠時的神經活動。

root.note: 神經的

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with the nervous system

ex.en: She decided to specialize in neurology after her father's stroke.
ex.zh: 她父親中風後，她決定專攻神經科。

root.note: 研究神經的學問

senses.en: (grammar) neither masculine nor feminine
to remove the reproductive organs of an animal

ex.en: The shelter will neuter every cat before it is adopted.
ex.zh: 收容所會在每隻貓被領養前替牠結紮。

root.note: 兩者皆非 → 中性的

senses.en: not supporting either side in a conflict
having no strong qualities; (of color) not bright

ex.en: Switzerland stayed neutral during both world wars.
ex.zh: 瑞士在兩次世界大戰中都保持中立。

root.note: 不站在任何一邊 → 中立的

senses.en: in spite of that; however

ex.en: The hike was exhausting; nevertheless, the view from the top made it worthwhile.
ex.zh: 這趟健行很累人，儘管如此，山頂的景色讓一切都值得了。

senses.en: relating to Isaac Newton or his laws of physics

ex.en: Newtonian physics works well for everyday objects but fails near the speed of light.
ex.zh: 牛頓力學適用於日常物體，但接近光速時就不適用了。

root.note: 與牛頓有關的

senses.en: unwilling to spend or give; stingy; (of an amount) meager
senses.zh: 吝嗇的；（數量）少得可憐的

ex.en: The company gave its workers a niggardly raise of one percent.
ex.zh: 公司只給員工少得可憐的百分之一加薪。

mn: 此字與種族歧視用語無關，但因發音相近常引起誤會，寫作時可改用 stingy。

senses.en: a person who believes life is meaningless and rejects moral principles

ex.en: The novel's hero is a bitter nihilist who believes in nothing.
ex.zh: 小說主角是個憤世嫉俗、什麼都不相信的虛無主義者。

root.note: 相信一切皆空的人

senses.en: nothing; zero

ex.en: Without funding, the project's chances of success are nil.
ex.zh: 沒有資金，這個計畫成功的機會等於零。

parts.m: nothing 無（拉丁文 nihil 縮寫）

root.note: 無 → 零

senses.en: quick and light in movement
quick to understand and think

ex.en: The pianist's nimble fingers raced across the keys.
ex.zh: 鋼琴家靈巧的手指在琴鍵上飛快移動。

senses.en: the egg of a louse
(informal) a foolish person

ex.en: The nurse checked each child's hair for a nit or two.
ex.zh: 護理師檢查每個孩子的頭髮裡有沒有蝨卵。

mn: nitpick（挑蝨卵）引申為「吹毛求疵」。

senses.en: active at night
happening at night

ex.en: Owls are nocturnal birds that hunt after dark.
ex.zh: 貓頭鷹是夜行性鳥類，天黑後才出來獵食。

root.note: 夜晚的

senses.en: making no sound; silent

ex.en: The electric car made a noiseless departure from the driveway.
ex.zh: 電動車無聲無息地駛離車道。

root.note: 沒有聲音的

senses.en: having an extremely unpleasant smell; offensive
harmful or unhealthy

ex.en: A noisome smell rose from the overflowing garbage bins.
ex.zh: 滿出來的垃圾桶飄出一股惡臭。

root.note: 令人厭煩的 → 惡臭的

mn: noisome 跟 noise 無關！意思是「惡臭的」，不是「吵鬧的」。

senses.en: making a lot of noise; full of noise

ex.en: It was hard to study in the noisy café.
ex.zh: 在嘈雜的咖啡店裡很難讀書。

senses.en: a member of a people who move from place to place
a person who wanders without a fixed home

ex.en: The nomad moved his herd of goats to greener pastures each season.
ex.zh: 這位遊牧民每一季都把羊群趕往更肥沃的草場。

root.note: 四處放牧的人 → 遊牧民

mn: digital nomad：數位遊牧族，帶著筆電到處工作的人。

senses.en: customary or conventional, especially of spelling

ex.en: The dictionary lists the nomic spelling first and older variants after it.
ex.zh: 字典先列出通行拼法，再列出較舊的變體。

parts.m: law, custom 法則、慣例（希臘文 nomos）

root.note: 合乎慣例的 → 通行的

senses.en: existing in name only
(of a price or amount) very small

ex.en: The museum charges only a nominal fee for students.
ex.zh: 博物館只向學生收取象徵性的費用。

root.note: 只有名字的 → 名義上的

senses.en: to propose someone as a candidate for an election, award, or position
to appoint someone to a job

ex.en: The club voted to nominate her for president.
ex.zh: 社團投票提名她擔任社長。

root.note: 叫出名字 → 提名

senses.en: the act of formally suggesting someone for a position or award

ex.en: The film received a nomination for Best Picture.
ex.zh: 這部電影獲得最佳影片提名。

root.note: 提出名字的行為 → 提名

senses.en: a person who has been nominated

ex.en: Each nominee gave a short speech before the vote.
ex.zh: 每位被提名人在投票前都發表了簡短演說。

root.note: 被提名的人

senses.en: a person who is not fighting in a war, such as a civilian or medic

ex.en: International law forbids attacks on any non-combatant.
ex.zh: 國際法禁止攻擊任何非戰鬥人員。

root.note: 不參與打鬥的人 → 非戰鬥人員

senses.en: not existing or not real

ex.en: Public transportation in the small village is almost non-existent.
ex.zh: 那個小村莊幾乎沒有大眾運輸。

root.note: 沒有站出來、出現的 → 不存在的

senses.en: a person who does not live in a particular place
not living in a particular place

ex.en: As a non-resident, he had to pay higher tuition at the state university.
ex.zh: 身為非本州居民，他在州立大學得付較高的學費。

root.note: 沒有住下來的人 → 非居民

senses.en: a relaxed, calm manner that shows no anxiety or interest
senses.zh: 漫不經心；冷靜；若無其事

ex.en: She hid her nerves behind an air of nonchalance.
ex.zh: 她用一副若無其事的樣子掩飾緊張。

parts.m: be warm, care 熱心、在乎（拉丁文 calere）

root.note: 不熱衷、不在乎 → 漫不經心

senses.en: lacking distinctive or interesting features

ex.en: The spy drove a nondescript gray car so no one would notice him.
ex.zh: 那名間諜開著一輛毫不起眼的灰色汽車，好讓人不注意到他。

root.note: 無法被描寫下來的 → 沒特色的

senses.en: a person or thing with no importance

ex.en: Before his big discovery, he was a nonentity in the scientific world.
ex.zh: 在他有重大發現之前，他在科學界是個無名小卒。

root.note: 像不存在一樣 → 無足輕重的人

senses.en: having no equal; unrivaled
a person or thing without equal

ex.en: She was a nonpareil chess player who never lost a tournament.
ex.zh: 她是無人能敵的西洋棋手，從未輸過任何比賽。

root.note: 沒有相等的 → 無雙的

senses.en: something that is usual or standard
an accepted standard of behavior in a society

ex.en: Working from home has become the norm for many office workers.
ex.zh: 在家工作已成為許多上班族的常態。

parts.m: rule, carpenter's square 規矩、曲尺

root.note: 木匠的曲尺 → 標準、規範

senses.en: the state of being normal; the usual condition

ex.en: After the typhoon, the town slowly returned to normalcy.
ex.zh: 颱風過後，小鎮慢慢恢復正常。

root.note: 合乎標準的狀態 → 常態

senses.en: a member of the people from Normandy who conquered England in 1066
relating to the Normans or their style of architecture
senses.zh: 諾曼人的；諾曼式（建築）的

ex.en: The castle's thick walls and rounded arches are typical Norman features.
ex.zh: 這座城堡的厚牆和圓拱是典型的諾曼式特徵。

root.note: 北方人（維京人後裔）→ 諾曼人

senses.en: a medicine of doubtful effectiveness sold by an unqualified person
a favorite but ineffective remedy for social or political problems
senses.zh: （解決問題的）萬靈丹；靈丹妙藥

ex.en: Cutting taxes is his nostrum for every economic problem.
ex.zh: 減稅是他解決所有經濟問題的萬靈丹。

parts.m: our 我們的（拉丁文 noster）

root.note: 「我們自家的」祕方 → 偏方

senses.en: easily seen or noticed; clear

ex.en: There has been a noticeable improvement in her writing this semester.
ex.zh: 她這學期的寫作有明顯的進步。

root.note: 可以被注意到的

senses.en: famous for something bad
senses.zh: 惡名昭彰的；聲名狼藉的

ex.en: This intersection is notorious for traffic accidents.
ex.zh: 這個路口以車禍頻傳而惡名昭彰。

root.note: 人人都知道（的壞事）→ 惡名昭彰

mn: famous 是好名聲，notorious 是壞名聲。

senses.en: a short novel, often light or romantic
senses.zh: 中篇小說；短篇（通俗）小說

ex.en: She finished the romantic novelette in a single afternoon.
ex.zh: 她一個下午就讀完了那部浪漫的中篇小說。

root.note: 小的小說 → 中篇小說

senses.en: a person new to and inexperienced in an activity
a person who has entered a religious order but not yet taken final vows

ex.en: This ski slope is too steep for a novice.
ex.zh: 這條滑雪道對新手來說太陡了。

root.note: 新來的人 → 新手

senses.en: at the present time, in contrast with the past

ex.en: Nowadays, most people read the news on their phones.
ex.zh: 現今大多數人都用手機看新聞。

senses.en: not in or to any place
a remote or unimportant place

ex.en: The keys were nowhere to be found.
ex.zh: 鑰匙到處都找不到。

mn: 片語 in the middle of nowhere：在荒郊野外。

senses.en: harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant
senses.zh: 有毒的；有害的；令人不快的

ex.en: The factory was fined for releasing noxious fumes into the air.
ex.zh: 那間工廠因排放有毒氣體到空氣中而被罰款。

root.note: 造成傷害的 → 有害的

senses.en: a subtle difference in meaning, expression, or tone

ex.en: A good translator captures every nuance of the original text.
ex.zh: 好的譯者能掌握原文的每個細微差異。

root.note: 像雲一樣的濃淡變化 → 細微差別

senses.en: the central part of an atom or cell
the central and most important part of a group or thing

ex.en: These five players form the nucleus of the team.
ex.zh: 這五名球員組成了球隊的核心。

root.note: 果仁 → 核心

senses.en: wearing no clothes; naked
a painting or sculpture of a naked human figure

ex.en: The museum displays a famous marble nude from ancient Greece.
ex.zh: 博物館展出一尊來自古希臘的著名大理石裸像。

senses.en: of no value or importance; having no force

ex.en: Without enforcement, the new regulations are nugatory.
ex.zh: 如果沒有執行，這些新規定形同虛設。

root.note: 瑣碎不值一提的 → 無價值的

senses.en: a person or thing causing annoyance or trouble

ex.en: The mosquitoes were a constant nuisance during our camping trip.
ex.zh: 露營時蚊子一直很擾人。

root.note: 造成損害的東西 → 麻煩

senses.en: the act or method of counting or numbering

ex.en: The ancient Romans used a system of numeration based on letters.
ex.zh: 古羅馬人使用以字母為基礎的計數法。

root.note: 數數的方法

senses.en: relating to or expressed in numbers

ex.en: Please arrange the files in numerical order.
ex.zh: 請把檔案按數字順序排列。

root.note: 數字的

senses.en: a building where nuns live together; a convent

ex.en: The old nunnery has been turned into a quiet guesthouse.
ex.zh: 那座老修道院已改建成一間安靜的民宿。

root.note: 修女住的地方

senses.en: relating to marriage or weddings

ex.en: The couple signed a nuptial agreement before the wedding.
ex.zh: 這對新人在婚禮前簽了婚前協議。

root.note: 結婚的

mn: 複數 nuptials 可直接當名詞「婚禮」。

senses.en: to care for and encourage the growth of
upbringing and education, as opposed to inborn nature

ex.en: Good teachers nurture their students' curiosity.
ex.zh: 好老師會培養學生的好奇心。

root.note: 滋養 → 養育、培養

mn: nature vs. nurture：先天與後天之爭。

senses.en: a substance that provides nourishment; food

ex.en: The roots draw water and nutriment from the soil.
ex.zh: 根從土壤中吸取水分和養分。

root.note: 滋養身體的東西 → 養分

senses.en: providing nourishment; relating to nutrition

ex.en: Brown rice has more nutritive value than white rice.
ex.zh: 糙米的營養價值比白米高。

root.note: 能滋養的 → 有營養的

senses.en: made of oak wood

ex.en: The wine is aged in oaken barrels for three years.
ex.zh: 這款酒在橡木桶中陳釀三年。

root.note: 橡木做的

senses.en: loose fiber from old ropes, used to seal gaps between ship planks

ex.en: Sailors pressed oakum between the planks to keep the ship watertight.
ex.zh: 水手們把麻絮塞進船板縫隙，讓船不漏水。

senses.en: stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action

ex.en: Despite the protests, the mayor remained obdurate about closing the library.
ex.zh: 儘管有人抗議，市長仍執意要關閉圖書館。

root.note: 非常硬的 → 頑固的

senses.en: a tall, four-sided stone pillar that narrows to a pointed top

ex.en: An ancient Egyptian obelisk stands in the middle of the square.
ex.zh: 廣場中央矗立著一座古埃及方尖碑。

parts.m: spit, pointed pillar 烤肉叉、尖柱（希臘文 obelos）

root.note: 像小烤肉叉一樣尖的柱子 → 方尖碑

senses.en: very overweight, in a way that is unhealthy

ex.en: Doctors worry that more children are becoming obese.
ex.zh: 醫生擔心越來越多孩子變得過胖。

root.note: 吃太多 → 肥胖的

senses.en: the condition of being very overweight

ex.en: Sugary drinks are a major cause of childhood obesity.
ex.zh: 含糖飲料是兒童肥胖的主要原因之一。

root.note: 吃太多的狀態 → 肥胖

senses.en: a notice of someone's death, often with a short biography

ex.en: The newspaper ran a long obituary about the famous architect.
ex.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇關於那位知名建築師的長篇訃聞。

root.note: 走向（死亡）→ 訃聞

senses.en: not influenced by personal feelings; based on facts
a goal or aim

ex.en: A judge must stay objective and consider only the evidence.
ex.zh: 法官必須保持客觀，只考慮證據。

parts.m: against, in front of 對著、在前

root.note: 丟在眼前的東西 → 客觀存在的事物；目標

senses.en: a person who expresses disapproval or opposition

ex.en: The only objector to the plan was the school principal.
ex.zh: 唯一反對這項計畫的人是校長。

root.note: 丟出反對意見的人

mn: conscientious objector：基於良心拒服兵役者。

senses.en: to bind someone legally or morally to do something

ex.en: The contract will obligate you to work here for two years.
ex.zh: 這份合約會使你有義務在這裡工作兩年。

root.note: 把人綁住 → 使負有義務

senses.en: required by law, rule, or custom
done out of habit rather than real feeling

ex.en: Attendance at the safety training is obligatory for all staff.
ex.zh: 所有員工都必須參加安全訓練。

root.note: 被綁住的 → 強制的

senses.en: slanting; neither parallel nor at a right angle
not expressed directly; indirect

ex.en: She made an oblique reference to his past mistakes.
ex.zh: 她拐彎抹角地提起他過去的錯誤。

root.note: 斜著朝向 → 傾斜的、間接的

senses.en: to destroy completely; to wipe out
to cover or blot out so as to be invisible

ex.en: The earthquake could obliterate the entire village.
ex.zh: 那場地震可能會把整個村莊夷為平地。

root.note: 把文字塗掉 → 抹去、徹底消滅

senses.en: the state of being forgotten
the state of being unaware of what is happening

ex.en: Many popular songs of the past have faded into oblivion.
ex.zh: 許多過去的流行歌曲已被人遺忘。

root.note: （記憶）被抹平 → 遺忘

senses.en: having a shape that is longer than it is wide; rectangular
an oblong shape

ex.en: We ate at a long oblong table in the dining hall.
ex.zh: 我們在餐廳一張長方形的長桌上用餐。

root.note: 特別長的 → 長方形的

senses.en: extremely unpleasant or annoying

ex.en: An obnoxious passenger kept shouting into his phone during the flight.
ex.zh: 一個討人厭的乘客在飛行途中一直對著手機大吼。

root.note: 對人造成傷害的 → 令人反感的

senses.en: funeral rites (usually plural)

ex.en: The whole village attended the obsequies for the beloved doctor.
ex.zh: 全村的人都參加了那位受愛戴醫生的葬禮。

root.note: 跟隨靈柩送行 → 葬禮

senses.en: too eager to please or obey

ex.en: The obsequious waiter kept refilling our glasses and praising our choices.
ex.zh: 那個諂媚的服務生一直幫我們倒水，還一直稱讚我們點得好。

root.note: 一直跟在別人後面 → 諂媚的

senses.en: the act of obeying a law, rule, or custom
a ceremony or ritual, especially religious

ex.en: Strict observance of the safety rules prevented any injuries.
ex.zh: 嚴格遵守安全規定，避免了任何人受傷。

root.note: 守著（規定）→ 遵守

senses.en: quick to notice things
carefully following religious laws or customs

ex.en: An observant neighbor noticed smoke and called the fire department.
ex.zh: 一位眼尖的鄰居注意到冒煙，打電話給消防隊。

root.note: 一直注視著的 → 觀察敏銳的

senses.en: a building with telescopes for observing the sky

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from the observatory on the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們在山上的天文台觀看月食。

root.note: 觀看（天空）的地方 → 天文台

senses.en: the process of becoming outdated or no longer used

ex.en: Critics accuse phone makers of planned obsolescence.
ex.zh: 批評者指控手機廠商刻意讓產品提早淘汰。

root.note: 逐漸不再被習慣使用 → 過時

mn: planned obsolescence：計畫性汰舊，故意讓產品很快過時。

senses.en: becoming outdated; going out of use
senses.zh: 逐漸過時的；即將淘汰的

ex.en: Fax machines are obsolescent in most modern offices.
ex.zh: 傳真機在大多數現代辦公室裡已逐漸被淘汰。

root.note: 正在變得不被使用 → 逐漸過時的

mn: obsolescent 是「正在過時」，obsolete 是「已經過時」。

senses.en: no longer produced or used; out of date

ex.en: Floppy disks became obsolete once USB drives appeared.
ex.zh: 隨身碟出現後，磁碟片就被淘汰了。

root.note: 不再被習慣使用 → 過時的

senses.en: a doctor who specializes in pregnancy and childbirth

ex.en: Her obstetrician recommended regular walks during the pregnancy.
ex.zh: 她的產科醫師建議她懷孕期間規律散步。

root.note: 站在（產婦）前面幫忙的人 → 產科醫師

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with pregnancy and childbirth

ex.en: The hospital is known for its excellent department of obstetrics.
ex.zh: 這家醫院以優秀的產科聞名。

root.note: 站在產婦前接生的學問 → 產科學

senses.en: the quality of being stubborn

ex.en: His obstinacy prevented the two sides from reaching an agreement.
ex.zh: 他的固執讓雙方無法達成協議。

root.note: 對著站定不動 → 固執

senses.en: noisy and difficult to control
senses.zh: 吵鬧難管的；不守秩序的

ex.en: The substitute teacher struggled with the obstreperous class.
ex.zh: 代課老師拿那班吵鬧的學生沒辦法。

parts.m: make a noise 發出噪音

root.note: 對著人大吵大鬧 → 吵鬧難管的

senses.en: to block a path or passage
to prevent or hinder progress

ex.en: Do not park in a way that will obstruct the fire lane.
ex.zh: 停車時不要擋住消防通道。

root.note: 對著堆起東西 → 阻擋

senses.en: something that blocks a path or passage
the act of hindering, especially a legal process

ex.en: Workers removed a fallen tree that was an obstruction on the highway.
ex.zh: 工人移走了一棵倒在公路上擋路的樹。

root.note: 擋路的堆積物 → 障礙

mn: obstruction of justice：妨礙司法。

senses.en: to force oneself or one's ideas on others; to become noticeable in an unwelcome way
senses.zh: 強加於人；冒出來惹人注意

ex.en: She tried not to obtrude her opinions on the grieving family.
ex.zh: 她盡量不把自己的意見強加給悲痛的家屬。

root.note: 往前推到人面前 → 強加於人

senses.en: noticeable in an unwelcome or unpleasant way
senses.zh: 突兀的；惹人注目的；強加於人的

ex.en: The new cell tower is an obtrusive sight in the quiet valley.
ex.zh: 新的基地台在寧靜的山谷裡顯得很突兀。

root.note: 推到人面前的 → 突兀的

senses.en: to turn something so that a different side faces the viewer; (logic) to change a statement into its equivalent negative form

ex.en: In logic class, we learned to obvert the statement "All cats are mammals" into "No cats are non-mammals."
ex.zh: 邏輯課上，我們學會把「所有貓都是哺乳類」換質成「沒有貓不是哺乳類」。

root.note: 轉向另一面

senses.en: to remove a need or difficulty; to prevent

ex.en: Online forms obviate the need to visit the office in person.
ex.zh: 線上表單讓人不必親自跑一趟辦公室。

root.note: 在路上把問題攔下 → 事先排除

senses.en: a particular time when something happens; a special event
a reason or cause
to cause

ex.en: Her graduation was a joyful occasion for the whole family.
ex.zh: 她的畢業典禮是全家人的喜事。

root.note: （事情）降臨的時刻 → 場合、時機

senses.en: the countries of the West, especially Europe and the Americas

ex.en: Silk and spices traveled from the Orient to the Occident along ancient trade routes.
ex.zh: 絲綢與香料沿著古代商路從東方運往西方。

root.note: 太陽落下的方向 → 西方

senses.en: to close up or block an opening or passage

ex.en: A blood clot can occlude an artery and cause a stroke.
ex.zh: 血塊可能會阻塞動脈而導致中風。

root.note: 對著關起來 → 堵住

senses.en: supernatural, mystical, or magical powers and practices
relating to the supernatural; secret or hidden
senses.zh: 超自然的；神祕的；隱藏的

ex.en: The old bookstore sells rare books about the occult.
ex.zh: 那家舊書店販售有關神祕學的珍本書。

root.note: 被遮蓋起來的 → 隱祕的、神祕的

senses.en: a person who lives in or uses a building, room, or vehicle

ex.en: The previous occupant of the apartment left behind a piano.
ex.zh: 這間公寓的前任住戶留下了一架鋼琴。

root.note: 占住（地方）的人 → 居住者

senses.en: an event or incident
the fact of something happening or existing

ex.en: Power outages are a rare occurrence in this neighborhood.
ex.zh: 停電在這一區是很少發生的事。

root.note: 跑到面前來的事 → 發生

senses.en: a shape with eight straight sides and eight angles

ex.en: A stop sign is shaped like a red octagon.
ex.zh: 停車標誌是紅色八角形的。

root.note: 八個角 → 八邊形

senses.en: the interval between one musical note and the note eight steps above or below it

ex.en: The soprano's voice rose a full octave in the final line.
ex.zh: 女高音在最後一句升高了整整一個八度。

root.note: 數到第八個音 → 八度

senses.en: a book size made by folding a printing sheet into eight leaves

ex.en: The collector bought a rare octavo printed in 1750.
ex.zh: 收藏家買了一本 1750 年印製的罕見八開本。

root.note: 紙張折成八頁 → 八開本

senses.en: a person between 80 and 89 years old

ex.en: The energetic octogenarian still swims a mile every morning.
ex.zh: 那位精力充沛的八旬長者每天早上仍游一英里。

parts.m: ten times 十倍（拉丁文 octogeni）

root.note: 八十幾歲的人

senses.en: relating to the eyes or vision

ex.en: The patient needed surgery to repair an ocular injury.
ex.zh: 這名病人需要動手術修復眼部傷害。

root.note: 眼睛的

senses.en: an old term for an eye doctor

ex.en: In the old story, the king sent for an oculist to treat his failing eyes.
ex.zh: 在那個古老故事裡，國王召來一位眼科醫師治療他衰退的視力。

root.note: 治療眼睛的人

senses.en: a strange or peculiar person, thing, or trait

ex.en: A snowstorm in May is an oddity in this region.
ex.zh: 五月下雪在這個地區是件怪事。

root.note: 奇怪的東西

senses.en: a lyric poem written to praise or celebrate someone or something

ex.en: Keats wrote a famous ode to a nightingale.
ex.zh: 濟慈寫過一首著名的夜鶯頌。

senses.en: extremely unpleasant; hateful

ex.en: Cleaning the fish tank was an odious chore nobody wanted.
ex.zh: 清魚缸是一件沒人想做的討厭差事。

root.note: 令人憎恨的

mn: odious（可憎的）和 odorous（有氣味的）字形相近，意思不同。

senses.en: general hatred or disgrace directed at someone because of their actions

ex.en: The company faced public odium after the oil spill.
ex.zh: 漏油事件後，這家公司遭受公眾的唾棄。

root.note: 憎恨

senses.en: giving off a smell, often a strong one

ex.en: The odoriferous cheese filled the whole refrigerator with its smell.
ex.zh: 那塊氣味濃烈的起司讓整個冰箱都是它的味道。

root.note: 帶有氣味的

senses.en: having a smell, especially a noticeable one

ex.en: Odorous gases from the swamp drifted over the village.
ex.zh: 沼澤冒出的氣體飄散到村子上空。

root.note: 有氣味的

senses.en: away from a place; so as to be removed or disconnected
away from or down from
not operating; not quite right

ex.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave the room.
ex.zh: 離開房間時請把燈關掉。

senses.en: casual or careless in a way that seems rude
without preparation or checking

ex.en: His offhand remark about her cooking hurt her feelings.
ex.zh: 他對她廚藝隨口的一句評論傷了她的心。

root.note: 隨手丟出的 → 隨便的、即時的

senses.en: to perform official duties at a ceremony or event
to act as a referee in a sports game

ex.en: Her uncle will officiate at the wedding ceremony.
ex.zh: 她叔叔將擔任婚禮的證婚人。

root.note: 執行職務 → 主持

senses.en: too eager to give orders or offer unwanted help
senses.zh: 好管閒事的；愛發號施令的

ex.en: An officious guard insisted on checking every bag twice.
ex.zh: 一個愛擺架子的警衛堅持每個包包都要檢查兩次。

root.note: 過度盡職的 → 愛管閒事的

mn: officious 不是 official（官方的），而是「多管閒事的」。

senses.en: a side shoot growing from a plant's main stem
something that develops from something else

ex.en: The new company is an offshoot of a university research project.
ex.zh: 這家新公司是從一個大學研究計畫衍生出來的。

root.note: 從主幹長出去的芽 → 分支

senses.en: a man-eating giant in folklore
a cruel or frightening person

ex.en: In the fairy tale, a hungry ogre lives under the bridge.
ex.zh: 在童話故事中，一隻飢餓的食人妖住在橋下。

senses.en: a smooth oily substance rubbed on the skin as medicine

ex.en: Apply this ointment to the burn twice a day.
ex.zh: 這個藥膏一天擦兩次在燙傷處。

root.note: 塗抹用的東西 → 藥膏

mn: a fly in the ointment：美中不足之處。

senses.en: relating to the sense of smell

ex.en: Dogs have a far more powerful olfactory sense than humans.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺遠比人類敏銳。

root.note: 使聞到的 → 嗅覺的

senses.en: an offer to make peace or end a quarrel

ex.en: After the argument, she held out an olive-branch by inviting him to dinner.
ex.zh: 吵架後，她邀他吃晚餐，表示願意和解。

root.note: 橄欖枝象徵和平 → 和解的提議

mn: extend / hold out an olive branch：伸出橄欖枝，主動求和。

senses.en: suggesting that something bad is going to happen

ex.en: Ominous dark clouds gathered over the stadium before the game.
ex.zh: 比賽前，不祥的烏雲聚集在體育場上空。

root.note: 有（壞）預兆的 → 不祥的

senses.en: the act of leaving something out; something left out

ex.en: The omission of her name from the program was an honest mistake.
ex.zh: 節目單上漏掉她的名字只是無心之過。

root.note: 送走、放掉 → 省略

senses.en: unlimited or very great power

ex.en: The dictator acted as if he believed in his own omnipotence.
ex.zh: 那名獨裁者的行為彷彿他相信自己無所不能。

root.note: 擁有全部的力量 → 全能

senses.en: having unlimited power; all-powerful
(the Omnipotent) God

ex.en: In many religions, God is described as omnipotent and all-knowing.
ex.zh: 在許多宗教中，神被描述為全能且全知的。

root.note: 擁有全部力量的 → 全能的

senses.en: the state of knowing everything

ex.en: The narrator's omniscience lets readers know every character's thoughts.
ex.zh: 敘事者的全知視角讓讀者得知每個角色的想法。

root.note: 知道全部 → 全知

senses.en: knowing everything

ex.en: The story is told by an omniscient narrator who knows every secret.
ex.zh: 這個故事由一位知道所有祕密的全知敘事者講述。

root.note: 知道全部的 → 全知的

senses.en: eating both plants and animals
taking in everything available, such as all kinds of books

ex.en: Bears are omnivorous animals that eat berries, insects, and fish.
ex.zh: 熊是雜食性動物，吃莓果、昆蟲和魚。

root.note: 什麼都吃的 → 雜食性的

senses.en: involving heavy effort or responsibility; burdensome

ex.en: Caring for three young children alone is an onerous task.
ex.zh: 獨自照顧三個小孩是件繁重的工作。

root.note: 有負擔的 → 繁重的

senses.en: a sudden forward rush or flow

ex.en: The small boat was swamped by the onrush of water.
ex.zh: 小船被湧來的水淹沒了。

root.note: 向前衝 → 猛衝

senses.en: the beginning of something, especially something unpleasant

ex.en: Farmers rushed to harvest their crops before the onset of winter.
ex.zh: 農民趕在冬天來臨前收割作物。

root.note: 開始上路 → 開端

senses.en: a fierce or destructive attack
a large quantity of things arriving at once

ex.en: The singer faced an onslaught of criticism after the concert.
ex.zh: 演唱會後，那位歌手受到排山倒海的批評。

senses.en: a duty or responsibility

ex.en: The onus is on the landlord to repair the heating system.
ex.zh: 修理暖氣系統是房東的責任。

root.note: 負擔 → 責任

mn: the onus of proof：舉證責任（= burden of proof）。

senses.en: a milky, shimmering play of colors like that of an opal
senses.zh: 乳白光；貓眼石般的光彩

ex.en: The inside of the seashell had a lovely pink opalescence.
ex.zh: 貝殼內側泛著美麗的粉紅色乳白光澤。

root.note: 像蛋白石般閃爍的光澤

senses.en: not allowing light to pass through; not transparent
hard to understand; unclear

ex.en: The bathroom window is made of opaque glass for privacy.
ex.zh: 浴室窗戶用不透明玻璃，保護隱私。

senses.en: to work or function; to control a machine
to perform surgery
to manage a business or organization

ex.en: Only trained staff are allowed to operate the crane.
ex.zh: 只有受過訓練的員工才能操作起重機。

root.note: 進行工作 → 運作、操作

senses.en: functioning; in effect
a secret agent or worker

ex.en: The new law will be operative from next January.
ex.zh: 新法將從明年一月起生效。

root.note: 在運作的 → 有效的

mn: the operative word：關鍵字眼。

senses.en: a person who runs a machine or business
a person who connects telephone calls

ex.en: The tour operator canceled our trip because of the storm.
ex.zh: 旅行業者因為暴風雨取消了我們的行程。

root.note: 操作的人

senses.en: a short, light opera, often comic

ex.en: The school choir performed a cheerful operetta for the holiday concert.
ex.zh: 學校合唱團在節日音樂會上演出一齣歡樂的輕歌劇。

root.note: 小型歌劇

senses.en: a view or judgment not necessarily based on fact
the formal judgment of an expert

ex.en: In my opinion, the movie was better than the book.
ex.zh: 依我看，電影比原著好看。

senses.en: a person who competes against or disagrees with another

ex.en: She shook hands with her opponent after the match.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後她和對手握手。

root.note: 放在對面的人 → 對手

senses.en: well-chosen or especially convenient for a particular action

ex.en: The rain stopped at an opportune moment, just before the ceremony began.
ex.zh: 雨在典禮開始前恰好停了。

root.note: （風）吹向港口的 → 正是時候的

senses.en: a person who takes advantage of chances, often without regard to principles

ex.en: The opportunist raised prices on water right after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 那個投機分子在地震後立刻調漲飲用水價格。

root.note: 專抓時機的人 → 機會主義者

senses.en: a time or situation that makes it possible to do something

ex.en: Studying abroad gave her the opportunity to learn Spanish.
ex.zh: 出國留學讓她有機會學西班牙文。

root.note: 順風進港的時刻 → 機會

senses.en: completely different; on the other side
a person or thing that is totally different from another
across from

ex.en: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.
ex.zh: 銀行在街道的對面。

root.note: 放在對面的 → 相反的

senses.en: harsh criticism or public disgrace caused by shameful behavior

ex.en: The company's decision to dump waste in the river drew international opprobrium.
ex.zh: 這家公司把廢棄物倒進河裡的決定招致國際譴責。

root.note: 對著人施加恥辱 → 譴責

senses.en: relating to the eye or vision

ex.en: Damage to the optic nerve can cause blindness.
ex.zh: 視神經受損可能導致失明。

root.note: 看的 → 視覺的

senses.en: a person who makes or sells glasses and contact lenses

ex.en: The optician adjusted my new glasses so they fit comfortably.
ex.zh: 配鏡師調整了我的新眼鏡，讓它戴起來很舒服。

root.note: 處理視力用具的人 → 配鏡師

senses.en: the scientific study of light and vision
the way a situation appears to the public

ex.en: Isaac Newton made important discoveries in optics.
ex.zh: 牛頓在光學上有重要的發現。

root.note: 研究看的學問 → 光學

senses.en: hopefulness and confidence about the future

ex.en: Despite the setbacks, the team remained full of optimism.
ex.zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，隊伍仍然充滿樂觀。

root.note: 相信會有最好的結果 → 樂觀

senses.en: something that may be chosen; a choice
the right to buy or sell something at a set price

ex.en: Taking the train is the cheapest option.
ex.zh: 搭火車是最便宜的選擇。

root.note: 選擇

senses.en: the profession of examining eyes and prescribing glasses

ex.en: He studied optometry so he could open his own eye clinic.
ex.zh: 他攻讀視光學，好開一間自己的眼科診所。

root.note: 測量視力 → 驗光

senses.en: great wealth or luxury

ex.en: Visitors were stunned by the opulence of the palace's golden halls.
ex.zh: 遊客們被宮殿金碧輝煌的廳堂所震撼。

root.note: 財富 → 富裕、奢華

senses.en: rich and luxurious; wealthy

ex.en: They held the wedding in an opulent hotel ballroom.
ex.zh: 他們在一間豪華飯店的宴會廳舉行婚禮。

root.note: 富有的 → 奢華的

senses.en: spoken rather than written
relating to the mouth

ex.en: The final exam includes an oral presentation.
ex.zh: 期末考包含一場口頭報告。

root.note: 用嘴巴的 → 口頭的

senses.en: to make a speech, especially in a pompous way

ex.en: The candidate loved to orate about his own achievements for hours.
ex.zh: 那位候選人喜歡花好幾個小時大談自己的成就。

root.note: 開口說 → 演說

senses.en: a formal speech, especially on a ceremonial occasion

ex.en: The senator delivered a moving oration at the memorial.
ex.zh: 參議員在追悼會上發表了一篇感人的演說。

root.note: 說話 → 演說

senses.en: a skilled public speaker

ex.en: She was a gifted orator who could move a crowd to tears.
ex.zh: 她是位天賦異稟的演說家，能讓群眾感動落淚。

root.note: 演說的人

senses.en: a large musical work for orchestra and voices, usually on a religious theme, performed without costumes

ex.en: Handel's oratorio "Messiah" is performed every Christmas.
ex.zh: 韓德爾的神劇《彌賽亞》每年聖誕節都會演出。

root.note: 源自羅馬的祈禱室，當地演出宗教音樂 → 神劇

senses.en: the art of public speaking; eloquent speech
a small chapel for private prayer

ex.en: His powerful oratory helped him win the election.
ex.zh: 他強而有力的演說幫助他贏得選舉。

root.note: 說話的藝術 → 演講術；祈禱的地方 → 小禮拜堂

senses.en: a very unpleasant and difficult experience
