ex.en: The hikers described their three days lost in the forest as a terrible ordeal.
ex.zh: 健行者形容他們在森林迷路三天是一場可怕的折磨。

mn: 原指中世紀的「神判法」，用火燒水淹來判定有罪與否。

senses.en: showing position in a series, such as first, second, or third

ex.en: "Third" is an ordinal number, while "three" is a cardinal number.
ex.zh: 「第三」是序數，而「三」是基數。

root.note: 表示順序的

senses.en: the ceremony of making someone a priest or minister

ex.en: His family traveled far to attend his ordination as a priest.
ex.zh: 他的家人遠道而來參加他的神父授職典禮。

root.note: 納入（神職）等級 → 授職

senses.en: military weapons, ammunition, and equipment, especially artillery

ex.en: Farmers still find unexploded ordnance in fields decades after the war.
ex.zh: 戰後數十年，農民仍在田裡發現未爆彈。

mn: ordnance（軍火）和 ordinance（法令）只差一個 i。

senses.en: (plural of orgy) wild parties with much drinking; excessive indulgence in an activity
senses.zh: （orgy 的複數）狂歡縱樂；放縱行為

senses.en: secret rites in ancient religions honoring gods such as Dionysus

ex.en: The emperor was famous for his orgies of feasting and drinking.
ex.zh: 那位皇帝以大肆飲宴作樂聞名。

senses.en: the point where something begins or comes from
a person's family background or ancestry

ex.en: Scientists are still debating the origin of the universe.
ex.zh: 科學家仍在爭論宇宙的起源。

root.note: 升起的地方 → 起源

senses.en: existing from the beginning; first
new and creative
the first version from which copies are made

ex.en: The judges praised her original design for the bridge.
ex.zh: 評審稱讚她這座橋的設計很有獨創性。

root.note: 起源的 → 原始的、獨創的

senses.en: to have a specified beginning; to start
to create or initiate

ex.en: Scholars believe that chess may originate from an ancient Indian game.
ex.zh: 學者認為西洋棋可能起源於一種古印度遊戲。

root.note: 有了起源 → 發源

senses.en: elaborately decorated
(of writing) using unusual words and complex structure

ex.en: The theater has an ornate ceiling covered in gold leaf.
ex.zh: 這座劇院有貼滿金箔的華麗天花板。

root.note: 裝飾過的 → 華麗的

senses.en: following traditional or generally accepted beliefs
(Orthodox) relating to the Eastern Orthodox Church or strict traditional Judaism
senses.zh: （大寫）東正教的；正統派猶太教的

ex.en: The doctor combined orthodox medicine with traditional herbal remedies.
ex.zh: 那位醫師將正統醫學與傳統草藥療法結合。

root.note: 正確的見解 → 正統的

senses.en: generally accepted beliefs or practices; conformity to them

ex.en: The young scientist challenged the orthodoxy of her field.
ex.zh: 那位年輕科學家挑戰了她所屬領域的正統觀念。

root.note: 正確的見解 → 正統

senses.en: at right angles; perpendicular
unrelated or independent of each other

ex.en: The two streets meet at an orthogonal angle.
ex.zh: 這兩條街呈直角相交。

root.note: 直角的 → 垂直的

senses.en: relating to the treatment of bones, joints, and muscles

ex.en: After the accident, he saw an orthopedic surgeon about his knee.
ex.zh: 車禍後，他去找骨科醫師看膝蓋。

root.note: 原指矯正兒童骨骼 → 骨科的

senses.en: a doctor who specializes in bones, joints, and muscles

ex.en: The orthopedist said my broken wrist would heal in six weeks.
ex.zh: 骨科醫師說我骨折的手腕六週就會癒合。

root.note: 矯正骨骼的醫師

senses.en: to swing back and forth regularly
to waver between different opinions or feelings

ex.en: Her mood seemed to oscillate between hope and despair.
ex.zh: 她的心情似乎在希望與絕望之間擺盪。

parts.m: swing 擺動（拉丁文 oscillum 小面具，掛著會擺動）

root.note: 來回擺動

senses.en: (humorous or formal) to kiss
(mathematics) of curves, to touch closely at a point

ex.en: The poet asked, with mock seriousness, whether he might osculate her hand.
ex.zh: 詩人故作正經地問，能否親吻她的手。

root.note: 用小嘴碰觸 → 親吻

senses.en: to turn into bone
to become rigid and unable to change

ex.en: Without new ideas, a company's culture can ossify over time.
ex.zh: 如果沒有新想法，公司文化久了就會僵化。

root.note: 變成骨頭 → 骨化、僵化

senses.en: a showy display of wealth or knowledge meant to impress others

ex.en: The billionaire lives simply and avoids any ostentation.
ex.zh: 那位億萬富翁生活簡樸，避免任何炫耀。

root.note: 伸展到人面前給人看 → 炫耀

senses.en: exclusion from a society or group

ex.en: The whistleblower faced ostracism from her former colleagues.
ex.zh: 那名吹哨者遭到前同事的排擠。

root.note: 古雅典人在陶片上寫名字投票放逐 → 排斥

senses.en: to exclude someone from a group or society

ex.en: Students should never ostracize a classmate for being different.
ex.zh: 學生永遠不該因為同學與眾不同就排擠他。

root.note: 用陶片投票放逐 → 排斥

senses.en: (modal, used with 'to') used to indicate duty, correctness, or likelihood

ex.en: You ought to apologize for being so rude.
ex.zh: 你那麼沒禮貌，應該道歉。

senses.en: to force someone out of a position or place

ex.en: The shareholders voted to oust the chief executive.
ex.zh: 股東投票罷免了執行長。

senses.en: complete; absolute

ex.en: That story was an out-and-out lie.
ex.zh: 那個說法是徹頭徹尾的謊言。

senses.en: remote and seldom visited
unusual

ex.en: We found a quiet, out-of-the-way café in the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們在山裡找到一間安靜、偏僻的咖啡館。

senses.en: a sudden start of war, disease, or violence

ex.en: Health officials are investigating an outbreak of food poisoning.
ex.zh: 衛生官員正在調查一起食物中毒事件的爆發。

root.note: 破殼而出 → 爆發

senses.en: a sudden release of strong emotion

ex.en: The coach apologized for his angry outburst at the referee.
ex.zh: 教練為自己對裁判發飆道歉。

root.note: 向外爆開 → 爆發

senses.en: a person rejected by society or a group
senses.zh: 被驅逐者；被社會遺棄的人

ex.en: After the scandal, he became an outcast in his own village.
ex.zh: 醜聞之後，他在自己的村子裡成了被排斥的人。

root.note: 被丟出去的人 → 被遺棄者

senses.en: a strong public expression of anger or protest

ex.en: The plan to cut down the old trees caused a public outcry.
ex.zh: 砍伐老樹的計畫引起公眾強烈抗議。

root.note: 大聲喊出來 → 抗議

senses.en: to do better than someone else

ex.en: The two brothers always try to outdo each other in sports.
ex.zh: 那對兄弟在運動上總想勝過對方。

root.note: 做得超過 → 勝過

senses.en: strange and unusual in a way that seems silly or shocking

ex.en: The singer is famous for her outlandish costumes.
ex.zh: 那位歌手以古怪的服裝聞名。

root.note: 外國來的 → 奇特的

senses.en: to last or live longer than

ex.en: These sturdy boots will outlast any cheap pair.
ex.zh: 這雙耐穿的靴子比任何便宜貨都更持久。

root.note: 持續得更久

senses.en: to make something illegal
a fugitive from the law; a criminal

ex.en: Several countries plan to outlaw single-use plastic bags.
ex.zh: 有幾個國家計畫禁止一次性塑膠袋。

root.note: 放到法律之外 → 宣布非法；不法之徒

senses.en: to live longer than someone
to continue after something is no longer useful

ex.en: Parrots often outlive their owners.
ex.zh: 鸚鵡常常比牠們的主人活得還久。

root.note: 活得更久

senses.en: a small military camp or settlement far from the main one

ex.en: The research station is a lonely outpost in Antarctica.
ex.zh: 那座研究站是南極洲一個孤零零的前哨站。

root.note: 外圍的崗位 → 前哨站

senses.en: strong anger or shock
an extremely cruel or shocking act
to make someone very angry

ex.en: The price increase caused outrage among commuters.
ex.zh: 漲價引起通勤族的憤慨。

root.note: 超出限度 → 暴行、憤慨（和 rage 其實無關）

senses.en: shockingly bad or unacceptable
senses.zh: 駭人聽聞的；無法接受的

senses.en: wildly unusual or exaggerated

ex.en: The hotel charged an outrageous price for a bottle of water.
ex.zh: 那家飯店一瓶水收的價錢貴得離譜。

root.note: 令人憤慨的

senses.en: the effort to bring services or information to people who need them

ex.en: The library runs an outreach program for elderly residents.
ex.zh: 圖書館為年長居民辦理外展服務計畫。

root.note: 向外伸出援手 → 外展服務

senses.en: to ride faster or farther than
(of a ship) to survive a storm safely

ex.en: The young messenger managed to outride the soldiers chasing him.
ex.zh: 年輕的信差成功甩開追趕他的士兵。

root.note: 騎得超過

senses.en: a float attached to the side of a canoe to keep it steady; a canoe with such a float
senses.zh: （獨木舟的）舷外浮桿；舷外浮桿獨木舟

ex.en: The islanders paddled an outrigger across the lagoon.
ex.zh: 島民划著舷外浮桿獨木舟橫渡潟湖。

root.note: 裝在船外的支架

senses.en: open and direct; complete
openly, completely, or immediately

ex.en: The committee rejected the proposal outright.
ex.zh: 委員會斷然否決了這項提案。

senses.en: the outer edge of a town or city (usually plural: outskirts)
senses.zh: 郊區；市郊（多用複數 outskirts）

ex.en: The new stadium was built on the western outskirt of the city.
ex.zh: 新體育場建在城市西郊。

root.note: 外圍的邊緣 → 郊區

senses.en: to extend or stretch out

ex.en: The toddler would outstretch her arms whenever she wanted to be picked up.
ex.zh: 那個小娃兒每次想被抱，就會伸出雙臂。

root.note: 向外伸展

senses.en: to exceed or move faster than

ex.en: Demand for the new game console may outstrip supply.
ex.zh: 新遊戲主機的需求可能會超過供應。

root.note: 跑得超過 → 勝過

senses.en: to be greater in weight, value, or importance than

ex.en: The benefits of exercise far outweigh the risks.
ex.zh: 運動的好處遠大於風險。

root.note: 重量超過 → 比……重要

senses.en: to do something too much; to exaggerate

ex.en: Don't overdo it at the gym on your first day.
ex.zh: 第一天上健身房別練得太過頭。

root.note: 做得過度

senses.en: too large a dose of a drug
to take too much of a drug

ex.en: An overdose of this painkiller can damage the liver.
ex.zh: 這種止痛藥過量會傷害肝臟。

root.note: 劑量過多

senses.en: to eat too much

ex.en: It's easy to overeat at a buffet.
ex.zh: 在吃到飽餐廳很容易吃太多。

root.note: 吃得過度

senses.en: to stick out over something below
[ˋovɚˏhæŋ] a part that sticks out over something

ex.en: The branches overhang the path and drip water after rain.
ex.zh: 樹枝懸垂在小徑上方，雨後還會滴水。

root.note: 在上方懸掛 → 懸垂

senses.en: to leap over; to overlook or omit

ex.en: The deer tried to overleap the fence but got caught in the wire.
ex.zh: 那隻鹿想跳過圍籬，卻被鐵絲纏住。

root.note: 跳越過去

senses.en: a ruler with power over other rulers or lords

ex.en: The local chiefs paid taxes to their foreign overlord.
ex.zh: 地方首領向他們的外國霸主繳稅。

root.note: 在領主之上的人 → 霸主

senses.en: a bridge that carries one road over another

ex.en: Pedestrians use the overpass to cross the busy highway.
ex.zh: 行人利用天橋穿越繁忙的公路。

root.note: 從上面越過的通道 → 天橋

senses.en: to pay too much for something

ex.en: Compare prices online so you don't overpay for a used car.
ex.zh: 上網比價，買二手車才不會當冤大頭。

root.note: 付太多

senses.en: to defeat with greater strength
to be too intense for; to overwhelm

ex.en: The guards managed to overpower the thief before he escaped.
ex.zh: 警衛在小偷逃走前成功將他制伏。

root.note: 力量在上 → 制伏

senses.en: production of more goods than are needed or can be sold

ex.en: Overproduction of rice caused prices to fall sharply.
ex.zh: 稻米生產過剩導致價格大跌。

root.note: 生產過度

senses.en: to try to do more than one is able to or has authority to
senses.zh: 做得過頭；逾越權限；不自量力

ex.en: The court warned that the agency must not overreach its authority.
ex.zh: 法院警告該機關不得逾越其權限。

root.note: 手伸得太長 → 逾越

senses.en: to spread over or occupy a place in large numbers
to go beyond a limit of time or cost

ex.en: If we do nothing, weeds will overrun the garden.
ex.zh: 如果我們什麼都不做，雜草就會長滿整個花園。

root.note: 跑遍、越過 → 蔓延、超出

senses.en: to supervise a person or work

ex.en: She was hired to oversee the construction of the new library.
ex.zh: 她受聘監督新圖書館的興建工程。

root.note: 從上面看著 → 監督

senses.en: a person who supervises others, especially workers

ex.en: The overseer checked the workers' progress every morning.
ex.zh: 監工每天早上檢查工人的進度。

root.note: 在上面看著的人 → 監工

senses.en: to make someone or something seem less important
to cast a shadow over; to make gloomy

ex.en: The scandal will overshadow everything else the mayor has done.
ex.zh: 這樁醜聞將蓋過市長做過的其他一切。

root.note: 在上面投下陰影 → 使相形見絀

senses.en: to stride over or beyond; to straddle

ex.en: The giant could overstride the river in a single step.
ex.zh: 那個巨人一步就能跨過那條河。

root.note: 大步跨過

senses.en: to remove a leader or government from power by force
[ˋovɚˏθro] the removal of a government by force

ex.en: The rebels planned to overthrow the king.
ex.zh: 叛軍計畫推翻國王。

root.note: 翻倒丟下 → 推翻

senses.en: a subtle or implied quality, meaning, or feeling
(music) a higher tone heard along with the main note

ex.en: Her polite reply had an overtone of irritation.
ex.zh: 她禮貌的回應裡帶著一絲不耐煩。

root.note: 主音之上的聲音 → 泛音、弦外之音

senses.en: an approach or proposal made to start talks or a relationship
an orchestral piece at the start of an opera or musical work

ex.en: The company rejected every overture from its rival to discuss a merger.
ex.zh: 那家公司拒絕了競爭對手每一次商討合併的提議。

root.note: 打開（局面）→ 序曲、主動示好

senses.en: weighing more than is normal or healthy

ex.en: The airline charged extra because my suitcase was overweight.
ex.zh: 因為我的行李超重，航空公司多收了費用。

root.note: 重量過多

senses.en: to calm someone who is angry or upset
to bring peace to an area, often by force

ex.en: The manager offered a refund to pacify the angry customer.
ex.zh: 經理提出退款以安撫那位生氣的顧客。

root.note: 使和平 → 安撫

senses.en: a small package or envelope
a unit of data sent over a network

ex.en: Add one packet of sugar to your coffee.
ex.zh: 在咖啡裡加一包糖。

root.note: 小包裹

senses.en: a formal agreement between people or countries

ex.en: The two friends made a pact to study together every weekend.
ex.zh: 兩個朋友約定每個週末一起讀書。

root.note: 約定好的事 → 協定

senses.en: a person holding religious beliefs other than the main world religions, especially in ancient times
relating to such beliefs

ex.en: Many modern holidays began as pagan festivals celebrating the seasons.
ex.zh: 許多現代節日起源於慶祝季節的異教節慶。

parts.m: village, countryside 鄉村（拉丁文 pagus）

root.note: 鄉下人（較晚接受基督教）→ 異教徒

senses.en: a public show or parade, often in costume, depicting historical scenes
a beauty contest

ex.en: The town held a colorful pageant to celebrate its 300th anniversary.
ex.zh: 小鎮舉辦了一場多采多姿的遊行，慶祝建鎮三百週年。

senses.en: the roof of the mouth
a person's sense of taste

ex.en: This spicy dish may be too strong for a child's palate.
ex.zh: 這道辣菜對小孩的口味來說可能太重了。

mn: palate（上顎、味覺）、palette（調色盤）、pallet（貨板）發音相同，拼法不同。

senses.en: resembling a palace; large and luxurious

ex.en: The movie star lives in a palatial mansion by the sea.
ex.zh: 那位電影明星住在海邊一棟宮殿般的豪宅裡。

root.note: 像宮殿的

senses.en: the study of fossils and ancient life

ex.en: His love of dinosaurs led him to study paleontology.
ex.zh: 他對恐龍的熱愛讓他攻讀古生物學。

root.note: 研究古代生物的學問

senses.en: a thin board on which an artist mixes paints
the range of colors used by an artist or in a design

ex.en: The designer chose a calm palette of blues and greens for the room.
ex.zh: 設計師為房間選了一組沉靜的藍綠色調。

senses.en: a poem in which the poet takes back something said in an earlier poem; a formal retraction
senses.zh: （詩人所寫的）翻案詩；正式撤回前言

ex.en: After the criticism, the poet wrote a palinode taking back his harsh words.
ex.zh: 受到批評後，那位詩人寫了一首翻案詩，收回他嚴厲的言詞。

root.note: 唱反調的歌 → 翻案詩

senses.en: a dark cloud of smoke or dust; a gloomy atmosphere
a cloth spread over a coffin
to become less interesting or appealing

ex.en: The news of the accident cast a pall over the celebration.
ex.zh: 意外的消息讓慶祝活動蒙上一層陰影。

mn: cast a pall over：給……蒙上陰影。

senses.en: to make a disease or its symptoms less severe without curing it
to make an offense seem less serious

ex.en: The medicine can palliate the pain but cannot cure the illness.
ex.zh: 這種藥可以減輕疼痛，卻無法治癒疾病。

root.note: 用斗篷蓋住 → 掩飾、緩和

mn: palliative care：安寧緩和醫療。

senses.en: pale, especially because of poor health
lacking energy or interest; dull

ex.en: After weeks in the hospital, his face looked pallid and thin.
ex.zh: 住院幾週後，他的臉看起來蒼白消瘦。

root.note: 蒼白的

senses.en: so intense or obvious that it can almost be touched
able to be felt by touch

ex.en: The tension in the room was palpable as they waited for the results.
ex.zh: 等待結果時，房間裡的緊張氣氛幾乎可以摸得到。

root.note: 可以摸得到的 → 明顯的

senses.en: paralysis, often with uncontrollable shaking

ex.en: Cerebral palsy affects movement and muscle control.
ex.zh: 腦性麻痺會影響動作與肌肉控制。

mn: palsy 是 paralysis 在古法文中的縮略變形。

senses.en: (heraldry) divided into vertical stripes of alternating colors
(archaic) pale

ex.en: The knight's shield was paly of red and gold.
ex.zh: 騎士的盾牌是紅金相間的縱條紋。

parts.m: stake, vertical stripe 木樁、縱條

root.note: 像一排木樁的 → 縱條紋的

senses.en: a small booklet with information or arguments on a single subject

ex.en: The nurse gave me a pamphlet about healthy eating.
ex.zh: 護理師給了我一本關於健康飲食的小冊子。

senses.en: a writer of pamphlets, especially political ones
senses.zh: 小冊子作者（尤指政治性的）

ex.en: Thomas Paine was a famous pamphleteer during the American Revolution.
ex.zh: 湯瑪斯．潘恩是美國獨立戰爭期間著名的政論小冊作家。

root.note: 寫小冊子的人

senses.en: relating to all the countries of North, Central, and South America

ex.en: She won a gold medal at the Pan-American Games.
ex.zh: 她在泛美運動會上贏得金牌。

root.note: 全美洲的

senses.en: a solution or remedy for all problems or diseases

ex.en: Technology is not a panacea for every problem in education.
ex.zh: 科技不是解決所有教育問題的萬靈丹。

root.note: 治療一切 → 萬靈丹

senses.en: an outbreak of a disease over a whole country or the world
(of a disease) spread over a very wide area

ex.en: The pandemic forced schools around the world to move classes online.
ex.zh: 疫情大流行迫使全世界的學校改為線上上課。

root.note: 影響所有人的 → 大流行的

mn: epidemic 是地區性流行，pandemic 是跨國、全球性大流行。

senses.en: wild and noisy disorder or confusion

ex.en: Pandemonium broke out when the fire alarm went off during the concert.
ex.zh: 演唱會中火警鈴大作，現場一片大亂。

root.note: 所有惡魔聚集之處（彌爾頓《失樂園》）→ 大混亂

senses.en: a public speech or text in praise of someone

ex.en: The retiring professor's colleagues delivered a warm panegyric.
ex.zh: 同事們為即將退休的教授發表了一篇溫暖的頌詞。

root.note: 在全民集會上的演說 → 頌詞

senses.en: a flat piece forming part of a surface, such as a door or wall
a small group of people chosen to discuss or judge something

ex.en: A panel of experts will judge the science fair.
ex.zh: 一組專家將擔任科展的評審。

senses.en: sudden, uncontrollable fear
to feel sudden fear and act without thinking

ex.en: Don't panic if you forget a line; just keep going.
ex.zh: 忘詞時別慌，繼續下去就好。

root.note: 希臘牧神潘會在山林中製造令人恐慌的聲響 → 恐慌

senses.en: a complete or impressive collection of things
senses.zh: 一系列；全套；壯觀的陣容

senses.en: a complete suit of armor

ex.en: The kitchen has a whole panoply of gadgets for making desserts.
ex.zh: 這間廚房有全套做甜點的器具。

parts.m: arms, weapons 武器（希臘文 hopla）

root.note: 全副武裝 → 全套

senses.en: a wide, unbroken view of an area
a complete survey of a subject

ex.en: From the tower, we enjoyed a panorama of the entire city.
ex.zh: 從塔上，我們欣賞到整座城市的全景。

root.note: 看到全部的景色 → 全景

senses.en: the belief that God and the universe are identical

ex.en: The poet's love of nature bordered on pantheism.
ex.zh: 那位詩人對自然的熱愛近乎泛神論。

root.note: 一切皆神 → 泛神論

senses.en: a temple in Rome dedicated to all the gods
(lowercase) all the gods of a people; a group of highly respected people

ex.en: The Pantheon in Rome has a huge dome with an open hole at the top.
ex.zh: 羅馬萬神殿有一座頂端開著圓洞的巨大圓頂。

root.note: 所有神的神殿 → 萬神殿

senses.en: the use of gestures and movements without words to tell a story
(British) a comic musical play for families at Christmas

ex.en: The actor used pantomime to show he was trapped inside a glass box.
ex.zh: 那位演員以默劇動作表現自己被困在玻璃箱裡。

root.note: 模仿一切的表演 → 默劇

senses.en: a wide-angle camera or lens that photographs a very broad view
senses.zh: 廣角（全景）相機；廣角鏡頭

ex.en: The early photographer used a pantoscope to capture the whole harbor.
ex.zh: 那位早期攝影師用廣角相機拍下整個港口。

root.note: 看到全部 → 全景相機

senses.en: the office or authority of the pope; a pope's term
senses.zh: 教宗職位；教宗任期；教宗權力

ex.en: During his papacy, the pope visited more than fifty countries.
ex.zh: 這位教宗在任期間造訪了五十多個國家。

root.note: 教宗的職位

senses.en: a material like paper made from a water plant in ancient Egypt; a document written on it

ex.en: Ancient Egyptians wrote on papyrus made from reeds along the Nile.
ex.zh: 古埃及人在用尼羅河畔蘆葦做的莎草紙上書寫。

mn: paper 這個字就是從 papyrus 來的。

senses.en: a simple story used to teach a moral or spiritual lesson

ex.en: The teacher told a parable about a lost sheep to explain forgiveness.
ex.zh: 老師講了一則迷途羔羊的寓言來說明寬恕。

root.note: 把兩件事放在一起比較 → 比喻、寓言

senses.en: a statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true
senses.zh: 悖論；似非而是的說法；矛盾的事

ex.en: It is a paradox that the more choices we have, the less satisfied we feel.
ex.zh: 選擇越多反而越不滿足，這真是個矛盾。

root.note: 違反一般看法 → 悖論

senses.en: a perfect example of a quality

ex.en: My grandmother was a paragon of patience and kindness.
ex.zh: 我祖母是耐心與仁慈的典範。

senses.en: side by side and the same distance apart
similar or happening at the same time
a similarity or comparison

ex.en: The historian drew a parallel between the two economic crises.
ex.zh: 那位歷史學家將兩次經濟危機拿來類比。

parts.m: one another 彼此（希臘文 allelon）

root.note: 彼此並排 → 平行的

senses.en: the state of being parallel or similar
the use of similar grammatical structures in a sentence for effect

ex.en: The speech used parallelism to make its message memorable.
ex.zh: 那篇演講使用排比句，讓訊息令人難忘。

root.note: 平行的狀態

mn: SAT 文法常考 parallelism：並列的成分要用相同詞性與結構。

senses.en: the loss of the ability to move part of the body
a state of being unable to act or function

ex.en: Political paralysis prevented the government from passing a budget.
ex.zh: 政治僵局讓政府無法通過預算。

root.note: （肌肉）鬆開無力 → 癱瘓

senses.en: to make a person or body part unable to move
to bring to a stop; to make unable to function

ex.en: A major snowstorm could paralyze the city's transportation system.
ex.zh: 一場大雪可能使城市交通癱瘓。

root.note: 使鬆軟無力 → 使癱瘓

senses.en: more important than anything else; supreme

ex.en: Passenger safety is paramount for every airline.
ex.zh: 對每家航空公司來說，乘客安全都是最重要的。

root.note: 在最高處 → 最重要的

senses.en: a lover, especially a secret one of a married person

ex.en: In the opera, the queen secretly meets her paramour in the garden.
ex.zh: 在那齣歌劇裡，皇后在花園與她的情人祕密幽會。

root.note: 出於愛的人 → 情人

senses.en: the equipment or objects needed for an activity

ex.en: His car was full of camping paraphernalia.
ex.zh: 他的車裡塞滿了露營用品。

root.note: 嫁妝以外的私人物品 → 零星用品

senses.en: to express the meaning of something using different words
a restatement of a text in other words

ex.en: Try to paraphrase the article instead of copying it.
ex.zh: 試著改寫那篇文章，不要照抄。

root.note: 在旁邊用另一種說法 → 改寫

senses.en: to trim by cutting away the outer edge or skin
to reduce something gradually

ex.en: We need to pare the budget to save money.
ex.zh: 我們需要削減預算來省錢。

mn: pare down：削減、精簡。

senses.en: the identity or origin of a person's parents

ex.en: The orphan knew nothing about his parentage.
ex.zh: 那個孤兒對自己的身世一無所知。

root.note: 父母的身分 → 出身

senses.en: an outcast; a person rejected by society

ex.en: After the scandal, the senator became a political pariah.
ex.zh: 醜聞之後，那名參議員成了政壇上人人避之的對象。

mn: 原指印度南部的低種姓族群，現多小寫表示「被排斥者」。

senses.en: a church district with its own church and priest
a small unit of local government
senses.zh: （英國）行政教區；（美國路易斯安那州的）郡

ex.en: The priest knew almost everyone in his parish.
ex.zh: 那位神父幾乎認識他教區裡的每一個人。

senses.en: relating to Paris
a person from Paris

ex.en: The café had a charming Parisian atmosphere.
ex.zh: 那家咖啡館有迷人的巴黎風情。

root.note: 巴黎的；巴黎人

senses.en: the state of being equal, especially in pay or status

ex.en: Women's teams are demanding pay parity with men's teams.
ex.zh: 女子隊伍要求與男子隊伍同酬。

root.note: 相等的狀態 → 平等

senses.en: a particular way of speaking or using words

ex.en: In computer parlance, a "bug" is an error in a program.
ex.zh: 在電腦用語中，「bug」是指程式裡的錯誤。

root.note: 說話的方式 → 用語

senses.en: a discussion between enemies to settle a dispute
to hold such a discussion

ex.en: The two commanders agreed to parley under a flag of truce.
ex.zh: 兩名指揮官同意在停戰旗下進行和談。

root.note: 說話 → 談判

senses.en: the group of elected representatives that makes a country's laws

ex.en: The new law must be approved by parliament before it takes effect.
ex.zh: 新法必須經國會通過才會生效。

root.note: 談話、議事的地方 → 議會

senses.en: a shop providing a particular service or product
(old-fashioned) a sitting room in a private house

ex.en: We celebrated her birthday at an ice cream parlor.
ex.zh: 我們在一家冰淇淋店為她慶生。

root.note: 談話的房間 → 客廳

senses.en: an imitation of a style or work that exaggerates it for comic effect
to imitate in an exaggerated, humorous way

ex.en: The comedy show performed a parody of a famous cooking program.
ex.zh: 喜劇節目模仿惡搞了一個知名烹飪節目。

parts.m: beside, against 旁邊、對著（= para-）

root.note: 唱對台的歌 → 諷刺性模仿

senses.en: (of words) derived from the same root; similar in sound or form

ex.en: "Wise" and "wisdom" are paronymous words from the same root.
ex.zh: wise 和 wisdom 是同源的字。

root.note: 名字在旁邊的 → 同源的

senses.en: a sudden, violent attack of emotion or activity
a sudden recurrence of a disease's symptoms

ex.en: The joke sent the audience into a paroxysm of laughter.
ex.zh: 那個笑話讓觀眾爆出一陣狂笑。

root.note: 尖銳到極點 → 突然發作

senses.en: the killing of one's parent or close relative; a person who does this

ex.en: The Greek tragedy tells the story of a prince accused of parricide.
ex.zh: 這部希臘悲劇講述一位被控弒親的王子的故事。

root.note: 殺害親人 → 弒親

senses.en: to analyze a sentence into its parts and describe their grammatical roles
to examine or analyze something closely

ex.en: Lawyers will parse every word of the contract.
ex.zh: 律師會逐字仔細分析合約。

root.note: 分成各部分 → 剖析

senses.en: extremely unwilling to spend money

ex.en: The parsimonious landlord refused to fix the broken heater.
ex.zh: 吝嗇的房東拒絕修理壞掉的暖氣。

root.note: 什麼都要省 → 吝嗇的

mn: 想成 parse money：每一分錢都要仔細分析才肯花。

senses.en: able to be divided, especially of inherited property

ex.en: Under the old law, the land was partible among all the sons.
ex.zh: 依舊法，土地可以分給所有兒子。

root.note: 可以分成部分的

senses.en: a person who takes part in something

ex.en: Each participant in the study was paid twenty dollars.
ex.zh: 這項研究的每位參與者都獲得二十美元。

root.note: 拿走一部分的人 → 參與者

senses.en: to take part in an activity or event

ex.en: All students are encouraged to participate in the discussion.
ex.zh: 鼓勵所有學生參與討論。

root.note: 拿一份 → 參與

senses.en: strongly supporting one party or cause, often without fairness
a strong supporter of a party or cause
a member of an armed group fighting secretly against an occupying force

ex.en: The debate over the budget became bitterly partisan.
ex.zh: 預算的辯論變成了激烈的黨派之爭。

root.note: 屬於某一派的人 → 黨派的

senses.en: a light wall that divides a room
the division of a country into separate parts
to divide into parts

ex.en: A glass partition separates the kitchen from the dining area.
ex.zh: 一道玻璃隔間把廚房和用餐區隔開。

root.note: 分成部分 → 分割、隔板

senses.en: (theology) capable of feeling or suffering
senses.zh: （神學）能感受痛苦的；有感受力的

ex.en: Theologians have long debated whether God is passible.
ex.zh: 神學家長期辯論上帝是否能感受痛苦。

parts.m: suffer, feel 受苦、感受（= path）

root.note: 能受苦的

mn: 別和 passable（可通行的；還過得去的）搞混。

senses.en: accepting what happens without active response or resistance
(grammar) in the passive voice

ex.en: Watching TV is a passive activity compared with playing sports.
ex.zh: 和運動相比，看電視是一種被動的活動。

root.note: 承受的 → 被動的

senses.en: relating to the peaceful countryside or shepherds
relating to the spiritual care given by a priest or teacher
senses.zh: 牧師的；（對學生、信眾的）輔導的

ex.en: The painting shows a pastoral scene of sheep grazing by a stream.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪羊群在溪邊吃草的田園景色。

root.note: 牧羊人的 → 田園的；牧師的

senses.en: relating to a father; fatherly
related through the father

ex.en: My paternal grandparents live in the south of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母（父親那邊）住在台灣南部。

root.note: 父親的

senses.en: the state of being a father
authorship or origin

ex.en: He took two weeks of paternity leave after his daughter was born.
ex.zh: 女兒出生後，他請了兩週的陪產假。

root.note: 身為父親的狀態

senses.en: a quality that arouses pity or sadness

ex.en: The film's ending is full of pathos, and many viewers cried.
ex.zh: 電影結局充滿悲情，許多觀眾都哭了。

root.note: 引起受苦的感覺 → 悲情

mn: 修辭三要素：ethos（人格）、pathos（情感）、logos（邏輯）。

senses.en: the male head of a family or tribe
a senior bishop in some Christian churches

ex.en: The family patriarch gathered everyone for the New Year dinner.
ex.zh: 一家之長召集所有人吃年夜飯。

root.note: 父親作為統治者 → 族長

senses.en: a member of the noble class in ancient Rome; an aristocrat
aristocratic; refined

ex.en: She spoke with a patrician accent that revealed her wealthy upbringing.
ex.zh: 她說話帶著上流社會的口音，透露出優渥的成長背景。

root.note: 古羅馬「元老（父老）」的後代 → 貴族

senses.en: property inherited from one's father or ancestors
heritage or tradition

ex.en: He wasted his entire patrimony on gambling.
ex.zh: 他把祖產全都賭光了。

root.note: 父親留下來的東西 → 祖產

senses.en: love for and loyalty to one's country

ex.en: The soldiers' patriotism inspired the whole nation.
ex.zh: 士兵們的愛國情操激勵了全國。

root.note: 愛祖國的精神

senses.en: to treat someone as if they are less intelligent or important
senses.zh: 以高人一等的態度對待；瞧不起

senses.en: to be a regular customer of a store or business
to support an artist or cause financially

ex.en: Please don't patronize me; I understand the problem perfectly well.
ex.zh: 請別把我當小孩看，我完全了解這個問題。

parts.m: protector 保護者（源自 pater 父親）

root.note: 像父親般照顧 → 贊助；居高臨下 → 瞧不起

senses.en: a name derived from the name of one's father or ancestor

ex.en: In Iceland, a person's last name is usually a patronymic, such as Jónsson.
ex.zh: 在冰島，人的姓通常源自父名，例如 Jónsson。

root.note: 來自父親名字的名字

senses.en: a series of quick, light tapping sounds
rapid, smooth talk used by a salesperson or performer
to make quick, light tapping sounds

ex.en: I fell asleep listening to the patter of rain on the roof.
ex.zh: 我聽著雨滴在屋頂上啪嗒作響而睡著。

senses.en: a very small amount of something; scarcity

ex.en: The paucity of evidence made it impossible to convict him.
ex.zh: 證據不足，無法將他定罪。

root.note: 少的狀態 → 缺乏

senses.en: a very poor person

ex.en: The rich merchant lost everything and died a pauper.
ex.zh: 那位富商失去一切，最後窮困而死。

root.note: 窮人

mn: 馬克吐溫的小說《The Prince and the Pauper》即《乞丐王子》。

senses.en: the state of being extremely poor, especially needing public aid

ex.en: Nineteenth-century reformers tried to reduce pauperism in the cities.
ex.zh: 十九世紀的改革者試圖減少城市中的赤貧現象。

root.note: 貧窮的狀態

senses.en: a building or large tent used for an exhibition or event
a light, open building in a park or garden

ex.en: Each country built its own pavilion at the World Expo.
ex.zh: 每個國家都在世界博覽會上建造了自己的展館。

senses.en: a person to whom money is paid

ex.en: Write the payee's name clearly on the check.
ex.zh: 請在支票上清楚寫上收款人的姓名。

root.note: 被付款的人 → 收款人

senses.en: inclined to avoid conflict; peaceful
senses.zh: 愛好和平的；溫和的；和平的

ex.en: The protesters held a peaceable march through the city.
ex.zh: 抗議者在市區進行了一場和平遊行。

root.note: 傾向和平的

senses.en: free from disturbance; calm
not involving war or violence

ex.en: We spent a peaceful afternoon reading by the lake.
ex.zh: 我們在湖邊看書，度過一個寧靜的午後。

root.note: 充滿和平的

senses.en: capable of sinning or making mistakes

ex.en: Even the wisest leader is peccable and needs honest advisers.
ex.zh: 即使是最睿智的領袖也會犯錯，需要誠實的顧問。

root.note: 可能犯罪的

mn: 反義詞 impeccable（無瑕的）更常見。

senses.en: a small, unimportant sin or fault

ex.en: Being late once is a peccadillo, not a reason to fire someone.
ex.zh: 遲到一次只是小過失，不足以開除一個人。

root.note: 小罪 → 小過失

senses.en: guilty of wrongdoing; sinful

ex.en: The peccant clerk confessed to stealing from the register.
ex.zh: 那名犯錯的店員承認從收銀機偷錢。

root.note: 犯罪的

senses.en: relating to the chest
a chest muscle (usually plural)

ex.en: Push-ups strengthen the pectoral muscles.
ex.zh: 伏地挺身可以鍛鍊胸肌。

root.note: 胸部的

senses.en: relating to money

ex.en: He helped the charity without any pecuniary reward.
ex.zh: 他幫助那個慈善機構，不求任何金錢報酬。

root.note: 牲畜是古代的財產 → 金錢的

senses.en: the science or art of teaching

ex.en: The course in pedagogics prepares students to become teachers.
ex.zh: 教育學課程培養學生成為教師。

root.note: 引導兒童的學問 → 教育學

senses.en: a teacher, especially a strict or pedantic one
senses.zh: 教師；（尤指）古板嚴厲的老師

ex.en: The old pedagogue corrected every tiny mistake in our essays.
ex.zh: 那位古板的老教師會糾正我們作文裡的每一個小錯誤。

root.note: 古希臘帶孩子上學的奴隸 → 教師

senses.en: the method and practice of teaching

ex.en: Modern pedagogy emphasizes active learning over memorization.
ex.zh: 現代教學法強調主動學習，而非死背。

root.note: 引導兒童 → 教學法

senses.en: a lever operated by the foot
to move by pushing pedals, as on a bicycle

ex.en: She had to pedal hard to get up the steep hill.
ex.zh: 她必須用力踩踏板才能騎上陡坡。

root.note: 用腳踩的東西 → 踏板

mn: pedal（踏板）和 peddle（兜售）發音相同。

senses.en: a person overly concerned with minor details or rules, or with showing off learning
senses.zh: 賣弄學問的人；書呆子；吹毛求疵的人

ex.en: Only a pedant would complain about a missing comma in a text message.
ex.zh: 只有吹毛求疵的人才會抱怨簡訊裡少了一個逗號。

root.note: 原指教師 → 賣弄學問的人

senses.en: to sell goods by going from place to place
to promote an idea or view persistently

ex.en: Some websites peddle false health claims to sell products.
ex.zh: 有些網站散布不實的健康宣稱來賣產品。

senses.en: a person who travels around selling small goods
a person who sells illegal drugs

ex.en: A peddler sold toys and snacks outside the temple.
ex.zh: 一個小販在廟外賣玩具和零食。

root.note: 叫賣的人

senses.en: the base on which a statue or column stands
a position of great admiration

ex.en: The bronze statue stands on a marble pedestal.
ex.zh: 那座銅像立在大理石底座上。

root.note: 腳下的座 → 底座

mn: put someone on a pedestal：把某人捧得很高、過度崇拜。

senses.en: a person walking rather than driving
dull and ordinary; lacking imagination

ex.en: The critic called the novel's plot pedestrian and predictable.
ex.zh: 評論家說這本小說的情節平淡無奇、毫無新意。

root.note: 用腳走的 → 行人；步行般緩慢無趣 → 平凡的

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with children

ex.en: She chose pediatrics because she loves working with children.
ex.zh: 她選擇小兒科，因為她喜歡和孩子相處。

root.note: 治療兒童的學問 → 小兒科

senses.en: the record of an animal's ancestry; a person's family background
(of an animal) purebred

ex.en: The breeder showed us the puppy's pedigree.
ex.zh: 繁殖業者給我們看小狗的血統證明。

root.note: 族譜的分支線條像鶴腳 → 血統

senses.en: the nobility as a whole; the rank of a noble

ex.en: The scientist was raised to the peerage for his contributions.
ex.zh: 那位科學家因其貢獻而被封為貴族。

root.note: 貴族的身分

senses.en: better than all others; unequaled

ex.en: The chef's peerless skill earned her three stars.
ex.zh: 那位主廚無與倫比的手藝為她贏得三顆星。

root.note: 沒有同等對手 → 無雙的

senses.en: easily irritated, especially by small things

ex.en: The tired child grew peevish and started to whine.
ex.zh: 那個疲倦的孩子變得煩躁，開始哭鬧。

mn: pet peeve（最討厭的小事）的 peeve 和 peevish 同源。

senses.en: transparently clear
easy to understand

ex.en: Her pellucid prose makes difficult science easy to follow.
ex.zh: 她清晰的文筆讓艱深的科學變得容易理解。

root.note: 光能穿透的 → 清澈的

senses.en: a punishment for breaking a law or rule
a disadvantage suffered as a result of an action
(sports) a penalty kick or shot

ex.en: The penalty for littering is a fine of three thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 亂丟垃圾的處罰是罰款三千元。

root.note: 懲罰

senses.en: an act of self-punishment to show sorrow for wrongdoing

ex.en: As penance for forgetting her birthday, he cooked dinner all week.
ex.zh: 為了彌補忘記她生日，他煮了一整個星期的晚餐。

root.note: 悔恨而自我懲罰 → 贖罪

senses.en: a strong liking or tendency

ex.en: My sister has a penchant for spicy food.
ex.zh: 我妹妹特別愛吃辣。

parts.m: lean, hang 傾斜、懸掛（法文 pencher）

root.note: 傾向某方 → 偏好

senses.en: a piece of jewelry that hangs from a chain around the neck

ex.en: She wore a silver pendant shaped like a crescent moon.
ex.zh: 她戴著一個新月形的銀墜子。

root.note: 懸掛的東西 → 墜飾

senses.en: hanging down loosely; drooping

ex.en: The willow's pendulous branches touched the surface of the pond.
ex.zh: 柳樹下垂的枝條碰到了池塘水面。

root.note: 懸垂的

senses.en: a weight hung from a fixed point that swings back and forth
the tendency of opinion to swing between extremes

ex.en: The pendulum of the old clock swung slowly back and forth.
ex.zh: 老時鐘的鐘擺緩緩地來回擺動。

root.note: 懸掛擺動的東西 → 鐘擺

senses.en: able to be entered or passed through; understandable

ex.en: The jungle was barely penetrable without a machete.
ex.zh: 沒有砍刀幾乎無法穿越那片叢林。

root.note: 可以進入的 → 可穿透的

senses.en: to go into or through something
to understand something difficult
to succeed in entering a market or organization

ex.en: Sunlight cannot penetrate the thick forest canopy.
ex.zh: 陽光無法穿透濃密的樹冠。

root.note: 進到內部 → 穿透

senses.en: the act of entering or passing through
the ability to understand clearly; insight
the extent to which a product is used in a market

ex.en: Smartphone penetration in Taiwan is among the highest in the world.
ex.zh: 台灣的智慧型手機普及率名列世界前茅。

root.note: 進入內部 → 穿透、洞察

senses.en: relating to or shaped like a peninsula

ex.en: The peninsular region is surrounded by water on three sides.
ex.zh: 這個半島地區三面環水。

root.note: 幾乎是島的 → 半島的

mn: peninsula 是名詞「半島」，peninsular 是形容詞。

senses.en: sorrow and regret for having done wrong

ex.en: The boy showed real penitence after breaking the window.
ex.zh: 打破窗戶後，那男孩真心表示悔過。

root.note: 悔恨 → 悔過

senses.en: relating to or expressing penitence or penance

ex.en: The monks walked barefoot on a penitential pilgrimage.
ex.zh: 修士們赤腳踏上贖罪的朝聖之旅。

root.note: 悔過的

senses.en: a long, narrow triangular flag
a flag awarded to a sports champion; the championship itself

ex.en: A school pennant hung above his desk.
ex.zh: 他書桌上方掛著一面學校三角旗。

senses.en: regular payments made to a retired person
[pɑnˋsjɔn] a small guesthouse in Europe

ex.en: My grandfather lives on his government pension.
ex.zh: 我祖父靠政府發的退休金過活。

root.note: 支付的錢 → 退休金

senses.en: a group or set of five; a period of five years or days

ex.en: Weather data were averaged over each pentad of five days.
ex.zh: 氣象資料以每五天為一組取平均值。

root.note: 五個一組

senses.en: a shape with five sides and five angles
(the Pentagon) the headquarters of the US Department of Defense

ex.en: The children cut a pentagon out of colored paper.
ex.zh: 孩子們用色紙剪出一個五邊形。

root.note: 五個角 → 五邊形

senses.en: a five-pointed star drawn with five straight lines

ex.en: The magician drew a pentagram on the floor with chalk.
ex.zh: 魔術師用粉筆在地上畫了一個五芒星。

root.note: 五筆畫成的圖形

senses.en: a solid figure with five faces

ex.en: A pyramid with a square base is a pentahedron.
ex.zh: 底面為正方形的角錐是一種五面體。

root.note: 五個面

senses.en: a line of verse with five metrical feet

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote most of his plays in iambic pentameter.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞的劇作大多以抑揚五步格寫成。

root.note: 五個韻律單位

senses.en: an athletic contest consisting of five different events

ex.en: The modern pentathlon includes fencing, swimming, and horse riding.
ex.zh: 現代五項包括擊劍、游泳和馬術。

root.note: 五項比賽

senses.en: (chemistry) having a valence of five

ex.en: Phosphorus can form pentavalent compounds.
ex.zh: 磷可以形成五價化合物。

root.note: 五個化合價

senses.en: second to last

ex.en: The penultimate chapter reveals who the thief really is.
ex.zh: 倒數第二章揭露了小偷的真正身分。

root.note: 幾乎是最後的 → 倒數第二的

mn: 常被誤用為「終極的」，其實是「倒數第二」。

senses.en: extremely poor
unwilling to spend money; stingy

ex.en: The penurious old man reused the same tea bag for a week.
ex.zh: 那個吝嗇的老人一個茶包泡了一整個星期。

root.note: 缺乏的 → 赤貧的；小氣的

senses.en: extreme poverty

ex.en: The famous painter lived in penury and sold few works during his life.
ex.zh: 那位知名畫家生前一貧如洗，作品賣出的很少。

root.note: 缺乏 → 赤貧

senses.en: to walk or travel through or around a place, often slowly

ex.en: On Sundays, we like to perambulate through the old town.
ex.zh: 星期天我們喜歡在老城區漫步。

root.note: 走遍 → 漫步、巡行

mn: 英式 pram（嬰兒車）就是 perambulator 的縮寫。

senses.en: to notice or become aware of through the senses
to understand or regard in a particular way

ex.en: Many people perceive the city as expensive but exciting.
ex.zh: 許多人認為這座城市物價高但很有活力。

root.note: 完全抓住 → 察覺

senses.en: able to be seen or noticed, often only slightly

ex.en: There was a barely perceptible change in the color of the sky.
ex.zh: 天空的顏色有幾乎察覺不到的變化。

root.note: 可以抓到的 → 可察覺的

senses.en: the way something is understood or regarded
the ability to notice things through the senses; insight

ex.en: The ad campaign changed public perception of the brand.
ex.zh: 這波廣告活動改變了大眾對該品牌的觀感。

root.note: 完全掌握 → 知覺、看法

senses.en: the quality of noticing and understanding things well; perceptiveness

ex.en: The detective's percipience helped him spot the tiny clue.
ex.zh: 偵探的敏銳洞察力讓他發現了那條細微線索。

root.note: 完全掌握的能力 → 洞察力

senses.en: quick to notice and understand; perceptive
senses.zh: 感知敏銳的；有洞察力的

ex.en: A percipient reader will notice the hidden symbolism in the poem.
ex.zh: 敏銳的讀者會注意到這首詩中隱藏的象徵。

root.note: 能完全掌握的 → 敏銳的

senses.en: (of a liquid) to filter slowly through a porous material
(of ideas) to spread gradually

ex.en: Rainwater will percolate through the soil into the ground water.
ex.zh: 雨水會滲過土壤進入地下水。

root.note: 穿過濾網 → 滲透

senses.en: a coffee pot in which boiling water repeatedly passes through the grounds

ex.en: Grandpa still makes coffee in an old metal percolator.
ex.zh: 爺爺至今仍用一個老舊的金屬滲濾壺煮咖啡。

root.note: 讓水滲過咖啡粉的器具

senses.en: musical instruments played by striking, such as drums
the striking of one object against another

ex.en: He plays percussion in the school orchestra.
ex.zh: 他在學校管弦樂團負責打擊樂器。

root.note: 用力敲打 → 打擊樂

senses.en: insisting on immediate obedience; rudely commanding
(law) final; not open to appeal

ex.en: The manager's peremptory tone upset the whole team.
ex.zh: 經理不容分說的語氣讓整個團隊很不高興。

root.note: 完全拿走、不留餘地 → 不容分說的

senses.en: lasting for a very long time or happening again and again
(of a plant) living for several years
a plant that lives for several years

ex.en: Traffic jams are a perennial problem in this city.
ex.zh: 塞車是這座城市長久以來的問題。

root.note: 貫穿整年、年年都有 → 長久的

senses.en: capable of becoming perfect or improved

ex.en: The philosopher believed that human society is perfectible through education.
ex.zh: 那位哲學家相信人類社會能透過教育臻於完美。

root.note: 可以做到完全的 → 可臻完美的

senses.en: deliberate betrayal of trust; treachery

ex.en: The general's perfidy led to the fall of the city.
ex.zh: 那名將軍的背叛導致城池失守。

root.note: 背離信任 → 背叛

senses.en: to make a hole or holes through something

ex.en: A sharp nail can perforate a bicycle tire.
ex.zh: 尖銳的釘子可能刺穿腳踏車輪胎。

root.note: 鑽穿 → 穿孔

senses.en: to carry out a task or action
to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing

ex.en: The band will perform live on Saturday night.
ex.zh: 樂團將在星期六晚上現場演出。

root.note: 完全做好 → 執行、表演

senses.en: the making of perfumes; a shop selling perfumes

ex.en: The town of Grasse in France is famous for its perfumery.
ex.zh: 法國格拉斯鎮以香水製造聞名。

root.note: 透過煙霧散發香氣 → 香水製造

senses.en: done quickly and without real interest or care

ex.en: The guard gave my bag only a perfunctory glance.
ex.zh: 警衛只是敷衍地瞄了我的包包一眼。

root.note: 只求把事做完 → 敷衍的

senses.en: used to show uncertainty; possibly

ex.en: Perhaps we should leave early to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 或許我們應該早點出發避開車潮。

senses.en: the point in an orbit where the moon or a satellite is closest to Earth

ex.en: A supermoon occurs when a full moon is near its perigee.
ex.zh: 滿月接近近地點時就會出現超級月亮。

root.note: 靠近地球的點

senses.en: the tendency to recur at regular intervals

ex.en: Scientists studied the periodicity of the comet's appearances.
ex.zh: 科學家研究那顆彗星出現的週期性。

root.note: 繞一圈的路程 → 週期 → 週期性

senses.en: traveling from place to place, especially for work

ex.en: As a peripatetic music teacher, she visits five schools each week.
ex.zh: 身為巡迴音樂老師，她每週要跑五所學校。

root.note: 四處走動的；亞里斯多德邊散步邊講學 → 逍遙學派

senses.en: (perjure oneself) to lie deliberately in court after swearing to tell the truth

ex.en: The witness refused to perjure herself to protect her boss.
ex.zh: 那名證人拒絕為了保護老闆而作偽證。

root.note: 違背誓言 → 作偽證

senses.en: the crime of lying in court after promising to tell the truth

ex.en: He was charged with perjury after lying to the jury.
ex.zh: 他因對陪審團說謊而被控偽證罪。

root.note: 違背誓言 → 偽證

senses.en: the state of lasting forever or for a long time

ex.en: Tattoos have a permanence that some people later regret.
ex.zh: 刺青是永久的，有些人事後會後悔。

root.note: 一直停留 → 永久

senses.en: lasting or intended to last forever or for a long time

ex.en: After years of short contracts, she finally got a permanent job.
ex.zh: 做了多年的短期約後，她終於得到一份正職工作。

root.note: 一直停留的 → 永久的

senses.en: to spread throughout something

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread will permeate the whole house.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味會瀰漫整間屋子。

root.note: 穿透過去 → 瀰漫

senses.en: allowed by rules or law

ex.en: Is it permissible to bring food into the museum?
ex.zh: 可以帶食物進博物館嗎？

root.note: 可以放行的 → 可允許的

senses.en: each of the possible ways in which a set of things can be arranged

ex.en: Each permutation of the three digits gives a different lock code.
ex.zh: 這三個數字的每一種排列都是不同的密碼。

root.note: 徹底改變順序 → 排列

senses.en: having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or hidden way
senses.zh: 有害的；（潛移默化地）有毒害的

ex.en: Rumors can have a pernicious effect on a community.
ex.zh: 謠言會對社區造成潛移默化的傷害。

parts.m: death, harm 死亡、傷害（= nec/nox）

root.note: 徹底造成傷害 → 有害的

senses.en: at an angle of 90 degrees to a line or surface

ex.en: Draw a line perpendicular to the base of the triangle.
ex.zh: 畫一條垂直於三角形底邊的線。

root.note: 像鉛垂線一樣垂下 → 垂直的

senses.en: a person who commits a crime or harmful act

ex.en: Police are still searching for the perpetrator of the robbery.
ex.zh: 警方仍在搜捕那起搶案的犯人。

root.note: 把（壞事）做完的人 → 犯罪者

senses.en: to make something, often something bad, continue indefinitely

ex.en: Some movies perpetuate harmful stereotypes about women.
ex.zh: 有些電影延續了對女性的有害刻板印象。

root.note: 使持續 → 延續

senses.en: an extra benefit or privilege that comes with a job or position

ex.en: A company car is one perquisite of the manager's job.
ex.zh: 公司配車是經理職位的福利之一。

root.note: 額外獲得的東西 → 津貼

mn: 口語縮寫就是 perk（福利）。別和 prerequisite（先決條件）搞混。

senses.en: cruel treatment of a group because of race, religion, or beliefs

ex.en: Many families fled their homeland to escape religious persecution.
ex.zh: 許多家庭為逃避宗教迫害而離開故鄉。

root.note: 一路追著不放 → 迫害

mn: persecute（迫害）和 prosecute（起訴）容易搞混。

senses.en: continued effort to achieve something despite difficulties

ex.en: Learning a language takes patience and perseverance.
ex.zh: 學習語言需要耐心與毅力。

root.note: 始終嚴格要求自己 → 堅持不懈

senses.en: to keep trying despite difficulty or delay

ex.en: If you persevere, you will eventually pass the exam.
ex.zh: 只要堅持下去，你終究會通過考試。

root.note: 始終嚴格堅守 → 堅持

senses.en: light, joking talk; teasing banter

ex.en: The dinner party was full of witty persiflage and laughter.
ex.zh: 晚宴上充滿了機智的玩笑與笑聲。

root.note: 吹口哨般調侃 → 打趣

senses.en: to continue firmly despite difficulty or opposition
to continue to exist

ex.en: If the symptoms persist, see a doctor.
ex.zh: 如果症狀持續，請去看醫生。

root.note: 一直站著不倒 → 堅持、持續

senses.en: the quality of continuing firmly despite difficulties
the continued existence of something

ex.en: Her persistence finally convinced the company to hire her.
ex.zh: 她的堅持終於說服公司錄用她。

root.note: 一直站著 → 堅持

senses.en: an important or distinguished person

ex.en: The ambassador was treated as a royal personage.
ex.zh: 大使受到皇室貴賓般的禮遇。

root.note: （重要的）人物

senses.en: belonging to or affecting a particular person
relating to someone's private life or feelings

ex.en: Please keep your personal belongings with you at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時保管好您的個人物品。

root.note: 個人的

mn: personal（個人的，重音在前）vs. personnel（人員，重音在後）。

senses.en: a person's character and qualities
a famous person, especially in entertainment

ex.en: She has a warm and cheerful personality.
ex.zh: 她的個性溫暖又開朗。

root.note: 個人的特質 → 個性

senses.en: the people employed in an organization
the department dealing with employees

ex.en: Only authorized personnel may enter this area.
ex.zh: 只有經授權的人員可以進入此區。

root.note: 一群人 → 全體人員

senses.en: a particular way of thinking about something; a point of view
the ability to judge the relative importance of things
(art) the technique of showing depth and distance on a flat surface

ex.en: Traveling abroad gave him a new perspective on his own culture.
ex.zh: 出國旅行讓他對自己的文化有了新的看法。

root.note: 看穿 → 觀點、透視

senses.en: having a ready insight into and understanding of things

ex.en: A perspicacious investor saw the company's potential early.
ex.zh: 一位有眼光的投資人很早就看出這家公司的潛力。

root.note: 能看穿的 → 有洞察力的

senses.en: the ability to notice and understand things quickly

ex.en: The editor's perspicacity helped the young writer improve her novel.
ex.zh: 編輯的敏銳眼光幫助那位年輕作家改進了小說。

root.note: 看穿的能力 → 洞察力

senses.en: clearly expressed and easy to understand

ex.en: The manual gives perspicuous instructions for setting up the printer.
ex.zh: 這本手冊對印表機的安裝說明清楚易懂。

root.note: 一眼就能看穿的 → 清楚的

mn: perspicacious 形容「人」有洞察力；perspicuous 形容「文字」清楚。

senses.en: sweat; the process of sweating

ex.en: Beads of perspiration formed on his forehead during the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時，他額頭上冒出了汗珠。

root.note: 透過（皮膚）呼吸 → 出汗

mn: 愛迪生名言：天才是 1% 的 inspiration 加 99% 的 perspiration。

senses.en: to sweat

ex.en: People tend to perspire more when they are nervous.
ex.zh: 人緊張時往往比較會流汗。

root.note: 透過皮膚呼吸 → 出汗

senses.en: able to be persuaded

ex.en: The campaign targeted voters who were still persuadable.
ex.zh: 競選活動鎖定仍有可能被說服的選民。

root.note: 可以被勸動的

senses.en: to cause someone to do or believe something by giving reasons

ex.en: I tried to persuade my parents to let me study abroad.
ex.zh: 我試著說服父母讓我出國念書。

root.note: 徹底勸動 → 說服

senses.en: holding firmly to an opinion or course of action; persistent

ex.en: The pertinacious reporter called the mayor's office every day for a month.
ex.zh: 那位鍥而不捨的記者一個月來每天都打電話到市長辦公室。

root.note: 緊緊抓住不放 → 堅持的

senses.en: the quality of being determined and persistent

ex.en: Through sheer pertinacity, she won the case after five years.
ex.zh: 憑著堅持不懈，她在五年後打贏了官司。

root.note: 緊抓不放的特質

senses.en: relevant to the matter being considered

ex.en: Please include only pertinent information in your report.
ex.zh: 報告中請只放相關的資訊。

parts.m: hold, reach 抓住、延伸（= ten）

root.note: 緊扣著主題的 → 相關的

senses.en: to make someone anxious or unsettled

ex.en: Nothing seems to perturb her, even under great pressure.
ex.zh: 即使在龐大的壓力下，似乎沒有什麼能讓她心煩。

root.note: 徹底攪亂 → 使不安

senses.en: anxiety or mental uneasiness
(science) a small change in a system's normal state or path

ex.en: She hid her perturbation behind a calm smile.
ex.zh: 她用平靜的微笑掩飾內心的不安。

root.note: 被徹底攪亂的狀態 → 不安

senses.en: the act of reading or examining something

ex.en: A quick perusal of the menu showed there were no vegetarian dishes.
ex.zh: 快速瀏覽菜單後發現沒有素食料理。

root.note: 完全用過一遍 → 細讀

mn: peruse 原意是「細讀」，但現在也常用來指「瀏覽」。

senses.en: to spread through every part of something

ex.en: A sense of excitement began to pervade the stadium.
ex.zh: 一股興奮的氣氛開始瀰漫整個體育場。

root.note: 走遍每個地方 → 瀰漫

senses.en: the act of spreading throughout something

ex.en: The pervasion of smartphones has changed how teenagers socialize.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機的普及改變了青少年的社交方式。

root.note: 走遍 → 遍及

senses.en: spreading widely throughout an area or group

ex.en: Advertising has become pervasive in modern life.
ex.zh: 廣告在現代生活中已無所不在。

root.note: 走遍各處的 → 普遍的

senses.en: deliberately behaving in an unreasonable or unacceptable way
contrary to what is expected or wanted

ex.en: He takes a perverse pleasure in arguing with everyone.
ex.zh: 他以跟每個人唱反調為樂，實在很乖張。

root.note: 轉到錯的方向 → 乖張的

senses.en: the distortion or corruption of something from its original purpose
abnormal or unacceptable behavior

ex.en: The verdict was a perversion of justice.
ex.zh: 這項判決是對正義的扭曲。

root.note: 轉向錯誤 → 歪曲

senses.en: a deliberate desire to behave unreasonably

ex.en: Out of sheer perversity, he wore shorts to the formal dinner.
ex.zh: 他純粹為了唱反調，穿短褲去參加正式晚宴。

root.note: 故意轉向錯的方向

senses.en: to distort or misuse something for a bad purpose
[ˋpɝvɝt] a person with abnormal sexual behavior

ex.en: Bribes can pervert the course of justice.
ex.zh: 賄賂可能妨礙司法公正。

root.note: 轉到錯的方向 → 曲解

senses.en: allowing water or other liquid to pass through
open to arguments or ideas

ex.en: Pervious pavement lets rainwater soak into the ground.
ex.zh: 透水鋪面能讓雨水滲入地下。

root.note: 有路可穿過的 → 可滲透的

mn: 反義字 impervious（不透水的；不受影響的）更常考。

senses.en: a deadly epidemic disease, such as the plague

ex.en: The ancient city was struck by war, famine, and pestilence.
ex.zh: 那座古城遭受戰爭、饑荒與瘟疫的打擊。

root.note: 瘟疫

senses.en: deadly or harmful; causing disease
senses.zh: 致命的；有害的；引起瘟疫的

senses.en: (informal) annoying

ex.en: The pestilent swamp air made many workers sick.
ex.zh: 有害的沼澤空氣讓許多工人生病。

root.note: 帶來瘟疫的

senses.en: relating to or causing a deadly disease
(informal) very annoying

ex.en: Pestilential mosquitoes spread fever through the village.
ex.zh: 帶病的蚊子在村子裡傳播熱病。

root.note: 瘟疫的

senses.en: (peter out) to decrease gradually and then stop

ex.en: By evening, the rain began to peter out.
ex.zh: 到了傍晚，雨漸漸停了。

senses.en: to make someone so frightened that they cannot move
to turn organic matter into stone

ex.en: Spiders petrify my little brother.
ex.zh: 蜘蛛會把我弟弟嚇得動彈不得。

root.note: 變成石頭 → 石化、嚇呆

senses.en: childish bad temper or sulkiness

ex.en: The player threw his racket in a fit of petulance.
ex.zh: 那名選手一時鬧脾氣把球拍摔了。

root.note: 動不動就攻擊 → 任性、鬧脾氣

senses.en: bad-tempered and sulky in a childish way
senses.zh: 任性的；使性子的；易怒的

ex.en: The petulant child refused to eat anything but ice cream.
ex.zh: 那個任性的小孩除了冰淇淋什麼都不吃。

root.note: 動不動就發作 → 任性的

senses.en: an official book listing medicines and how to prepare them; a stock of drugs

ex.en: The herb is listed in the national pharmacopoeia.
ex.zh: 這種藥草收錄在國家藥典中。

root.note: 製藥的書 → 藥典

senses.en: a store where medicines are prepared and sold
the science of preparing medicines

ex.en: You can pick up your prescription at the pharmacy.
ex.zh: 你可以到藥局領取處方藥。

root.note: 藥物 → 藥局、藥學

senses.en: remarkable or extraordinary
relating to phenomena perceived by the senses

ex.en: The app has enjoyed phenomenal success among teenagers.
ex.zh: 那款應用程式在青少年之間大受歡迎。

root.note: 顯現出來的 → 現象的；引申為驚人的

senses.en: a fact or event that can be observed, especially one that is unusual
a remarkable person or thing

ex.en: The northern lights are a stunning natural phenomenon.
ex.zh: 北極光是一種壯麗的自然現象。

parts.m: 名詞字尾（希臘文被動分詞）

root.note: 顯現出來的事物 → 現象

mn: 複數是 phenomena。

senses.en: (of a man) to have casual affairs with many women

ex.en: In the novel, the rich count continues to philander despite being married.
ex.zh: 在小說中，那位富有的伯爵婚後仍然到處拈花惹草。

root.note: 原指「愛丈夫的」，後轉為男人到處調情

senses.en: generous in helping others, especially by giving money to good causes

ex.en: The foundation supports many philanthropic projects in rural areas.
ex.zh: 該基金會支持許多鄉村地區的慈善計畫。

root.note: 愛人類的 → 慈善的

senses.en: a person who gives money and time to help others

ex.en: A local philanthropist donated money to build the new library.
ex.zh: 一位當地慈善家捐款興建新圖書館。

root.note: 愛人類的人 → 慈善家

senses.en: the desire to help others, especially by donating money

ex.en: After retiring, she devoted herself to philanthropy.
ex.zh: 退休後，她投身慈善事業。

root.note: 愛人類 → 慈善

senses.en: the collection and study of postage stamps

ex.en: My uncle's hobby is philately, and he owns thousands of stamps.
ex.zh: 我叔叔的嗜好是集郵，他擁有好幾千張郵票。

parts.m: tax-free 免稅（希臘文 ateleia，指郵資已付）

root.note: 喜愛已付郵資的憑證 → 集郵

senses.en: devoted to music (used in the names of orchestras)
senses.zh: 愛好音樂的（用於交響樂團名稱）

senses.en: a symphony orchestra

ex.en: We have tickets to hear the city philharmonic on Friday.
ex.zh: 我們有星期五市立愛樂樂團演出的票。

root.note: 喜愛音樂的

senses.en: a person who likes or admires women

ex.en: The author, a true philogynist, wrote many strong female characters.
ex.zh: 那位作家是真正尊重女性的人，塑造了許多堅強的女性角色。

root.note: 喜愛女性的人

senses.en: a scholar of the history and development of languages
senses.zh: 語文學家；歷史語言學家

ex.en: J. R. R. Tolkien was a philologist before he became a famous novelist.
ex.zh: 托爾金在成為知名小說家之前是一位語文學家。

root.note: 喜愛文字的人 → 語文學家

senses.en: the study of the history and structure of languages, especially in literary texts

ex.en: She studied classical philology at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學攻讀古典語文學。

root.note: 喜愛文字的學問

senses.en: to think or talk about serious matters, often at length

ex.en: My uncle likes to philosophize about the meaning of life after dinner.
ex.zh: 我叔叔喜歡在飯後大談人生的意義。

root.note: 進行哲學思考

senses.en: the study of the nature of knowledge, reality, and existence
a set of beliefs or principles that guides behavior

ex.en: The coach's philosophy is that effort matters more than talent.
ex.zh: 這位教練的理念是努力比天分更重要。

root.note: 愛智慧 → 哲學

senses.en: calm and not easily excited or upset
senses.zh: 冷靜的；不易激動的；冷漠的

ex.en: Even when the plane shook, the phlegmatic pilot stayed calm.
ex.zh: 即使飛機晃動，那位沉著的機師仍保持冷靜。

root.note: 古代體液說：黏液過多的人性情冷淡 → 冷靜的

senses.en: relating to speech sounds; representing each sound with one symbol

ex.en: The dictionary uses phonetic symbols to show pronunciation.
ex.zh: 字典用音標來標示發音。

root.note: 聲音的 → 語音的

senses.en: relating to sound or speech sounds

ex.en: The teacher uses a phonic approach to help children read new words.
ex.zh: 老師用自然發音法幫助孩子讀出生字。

root.note: 聲音的

mn: phonics 就是「自然發音法」。

senses.en: a symbol representing a speech sound or word
(old use) a sound recording

ex.en: In the Chinese character for "ocean," one part is a phonogram that hints at the sound.
ex.zh: 「洋」這個字裡有一部分是提示讀音的聲符。

root.note: 寫下聲音的符號

senses.en: the study of the sound system of a language

ex.en: Phonology explains why English speakers find some Chinese tones hard to hear.
ex.zh: 音韻學解釋了為什麼說英語的人很難聽出某些中文聲調。

root.note: 研究聲音的學問

senses.en: light given off by a substance without noticeable heat, often continuing after exposure to light

ex.en: At night, the waves glowed with a blue phosphorescence.
ex.zh: 夜裡，海浪閃著藍色的磷光。

root.note: 帶光的狀態 → 磷光

senses.en: relating to electricity produced or affected by light

ex.en: Einstein won the Nobel Prize for explaining the photoelectric effect.
ex.zh: 愛因斯坦因解釋光電效應而獲得諾貝爾獎。

root.note: 光與電的

senses.en: an instrument for measuring the intensity of light

ex.en: The photographer used a photometer to check the lighting.
ex.zh: 攝影師用測光表檢查光線。

root.note: 測量光的儀器

senses.en: the science of measuring the intensity of light

ex.en: Astronomers use photometry to measure the brightness of stars.
ex.zh: 天文學家用光度測量法測定恆星的亮度。

root.note: 測量光的學問

senses.en: a scientist who studies physics

ex.en: The physicist explained black holes in simple language.
ex.zh: 那位物理學家用淺白的語言解釋黑洞。

root.note: 研究自然（物理）的人

mn: physicist 是物理學家，physician 是醫師。

senses.en: the science of matter, energy, motion, and force

ex.en: Physics helps us understand why the sky is blue.
ex.zh: 物理學幫助我們了解天空為什麼是藍色的。

root.note: 研究自然的學問 → 物理學

senses.en: an 18th-century French economic theory that land and agriculture are the source of all wealth

ex.en: Physiocracy taught that farming, not trade, creates a nation's wealth.
ex.zh: 重農主義主張國家財富來自農業而非貿易。

root.note: 由自然（法則）主導 → 重農主義

senses.en: a person's facial features or expression
the practice of judging character from facial features

ex.en: The painter captured the old sailor's weathered physiognomy.
ex.zh: 畫家捕捉到老水手飽經風霜的面容。

root.note: 從外表判斷本性 → 面相學；相貌

senses.en: the branch of geography that describes the natural features of the earth's surface

ex.en: Our geology course began with a unit on physiography and landforms.
ex.zh: 我們的地質學課程從自然地理學與地形單元開始。

root.note: 描寫自然地表的學問 → 自然地理學

senses.en: the study of how living things and their body parts function
the way an organism or body part functions

ex.en: She studied human physiology before applying to medical school.
ex.zh: 她在申請醫學院之前念了人體生理學。

root.note: 研究生物自然運作的學問 → 生理學

senses.en: the form, size, and development of a person's body

ex.en: The swimmer's powerful physique came from years of daily training.
ex.zh: 這位泳將強健的體格來自多年的每日訓練。

root.note: 身體的樣子 → 體格

senses.en: petty; of little value or importance

ex.en: The committee wasted an hour arguing over picayune details.
ex.zh: 委員會浪費了一小時爭論瑣碎的細節。

mn: 原指美國南方一種面額很小的硬幣，所以引申為「不值錢、瑣碎」。

senses.en: a small flute that plays notes an octave higher than an ordinary flute

ex.en: The bright sound of the piccolo rose above the whole marching band.
ex.zh: 短笛清亮的聲音蓋過了整個行進樂隊。

root.note: 小的長笛 → 短笛

senses.en: a part or portion of something
a single work of art, music, or writing

ex.en: Could you cut me a small piece of the chocolate cake?
ex.zh: 可以幫我切一小塊巧克力蛋糕嗎？

mn: a piece of pie：piece 裡面藏著 pie。

senses.en: gradually, one part at a time
done or made in stages rather than all at once

ex.en: The old house was renovated piecemeal over ten years.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子花了十年一點一點地整修完成。

root.note: 一份一份地 → 逐步地

senses.en: to rob a place using violence, especially in war
violent robbery, especially during war

ex.en: The invading army began to pillage every village along the river.
ex.zh: 入侵的軍隊開始掠奪沿河的每一個村莊。

senses.en: to attack or ridicule someone publicly
a wooden frame with holes for the head and hands, formerly used for public punishment

ex.en: The tabloids were quick to pillory the actor for one careless remark.
ex.zh: 八卦小報很快就因為那位演員一句無心的話而公開抨擊他。

mn: 古時候把犯人鎖在 pillory 上示眾讓人丟東西，所以引申為公開羞辱。

senses.en: a tool with two jaws used for gripping or pulling things
the front claws of a crab or lobster

ex.en: He used a pair of pincers to pull the rusty nail out of the board.
ex.zh: 他用一把鉗子把生鏽的釘子從木板上拔出來。

senses.en: a gripping tool; another form of "pincers"
senses.zh: 鉗子（pincers 的另一種說法）

senses.en: the claws of a crab or similar animal

ex.en: The crab raised its pinchers when the child got too close.
ex.zh: 小孩靠得太近時，螃蟹舉起了牠的螯。

root.note: 用來夾的東西 → 鉗子、螯

senses.en: the most successful or highest point
a tall pointed rock or mountain peak

ex.en: Winning the gold medal was the pinnacle of her athletic career.
ex.zh: 贏得金牌是她運動生涯的巔峰。

root.note: 尖尖的頂端 → 頂峰

senses.en: a person who is among the first to explore or develop something
to be the first to develop or use something

ex.en: She was a pioneer in the field of computer programming.
ex.zh: 她是電腦程式設計領域的先驅。

parts.m: foot soldier 步兵（古法文 peon）

root.note: 走在最前面開路的步兵 → 先驅

senses.en: deeply religious and devout
falsely showing moral superiority

ex.en: Her pious grandmother went to church every morning.
ex.zh: 她虔誠的祖母每天早上都去教堂。

parts.m: dutiful 盡本分的（拉丁文 pius）

root.note: 對神盡本分 → 虔誠的

senses.en: to stimulate interest or curiosity
a feeling of irritation or resentment from wounded pride

ex.en: The mysterious title was enough to pique my curiosity.
ex.zh: 那個神祕的標題足以激起我的好奇心。

mn: 常見片語 pique one's interest；和 peak（頂峰）、peek（偷看）同音別搞混。

senses.en: deserving or arousing pity

ex.en: The lost puppy let out a piteous cry in the rain.
ex.zh: 那隻走失的小狗在雨中發出可憐的哀鳴。

root.note: 引起憐憫的 → 可憐的

senses.en: deserving pity
deserving contempt; very poor in quality

ex.en: The refugees were living in pitiable conditions without clean water.
ex.zh: 難民生活在沒有乾淨水源的悲慘環境中。

root.note: 值得憐憫的 → 可憐的

senses.en: deserving or causing pity
very small or poor; contemptible

ex.en: The team made a pitiful attempt to score in the final minute.
ex.zh: 球隊在最後一分鐘做了一次差勁的得分嘗試。

root.note: 令人充滿憐憫 → 可憐的

senses.en: showing no pity; cruel

ex.en: The hikers struggled under the pitiless desert sun.
ex.zh: 健行者在無情的沙漠烈日下艱難前進。

root.note: 沒有憐憫 → 無情的

senses.en: a very small or inadequate amount of money

ex.en: The workers were paid a pittance for twelve hours of labor.
ex.zh: 工人辛苦工作十二小時卻只拿到微薄的工資。

senses.en: to make someone less angry or hostile

ex.en: The manager offered a free meal to placate the angry customer.
ex.zh: 經理提供免費餐點來安撫那位生氣的顧客。

root.note: 使平靜下來 → 安撫

senses.en: calm and peaceful; not easily upset

ex.en: We paddled across the placid lake just after sunrise.
ex.zh: 我們在日出後不久划船渡過平靜的湖面。

root.note: 平和安靜 → 平靜的

senses.en: the act of copying someone else's work or ideas and presenting them as one's own

ex.en: The student failed the course because of plagiarism in his final paper.
ex.zh: 那名學生因為期末報告抄襲而被當掉。

parts.m: kidnapper 綁架者（拉丁文 plagiarius）

root.note: 綁架別人的文字 → 抄襲

senses.en: a flat map of the sky or the earth, often with a rotating disk showing visible stars

ex.en: We used a planisphere to find the constellations visible that night.
ex.zh: 我們用星座盤找出當晚看得到的星座。

root.note: 把球體畫在平面上 → 平面天體圖

senses.en: the quality of being easily shaped or molded
the ability of the brain or an organism to adapt and change

ex.en: The plasticity of a child's brain makes learning languages easier.
ex.zh: 孩童大腦的可塑性讓學習語言更容易。

root.note: 能被塑造的性質 → 可塑性

senses.en: a remark that has been used too often to be interesting

ex.en: The speech was one platitude after another and offered no real solutions.
ex.zh: 這場演講一句接一句都是陳腔濫調，沒有提出任何真正的解決辦法。

ex.en: "Everything happens for a reason" is a common platitude.
ex.zh: 「凡事發生必有原因」是一句常見的老生常談。

root.note: 平淡無奇的話 → 陳腔濫調

senses.en: praise or enthusiastic approval (usually plural)

ex.en: The young director earned plaudit after plaudit for her first film.
ex.zh: 這位年輕導演的第一部電影讓她獲得一次又一次的讚揚。

root.note: 拍手叫好 → 讚揚（applaud 同源）

senses.en: seeming reasonable or probable

ex.en: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher accepted it.
ex.zh: 他的藉口聽起來合理，所以老師接受了。

root.note: 值得拍手認同的 → 看似合理的

senses.en: fond of games and fun; lighthearted
senses.zh: 愛玩的；鬧著玩的；開玩笑的

ex.en: The playful kitten chased a ball of yarn around the room.
ex.zh: 那隻愛玩的小貓在房間裡追著一團毛線跑。

root.note: 充滿玩心 → 愛玩的

senses.en: a person who writes plays

ex.en: The playwright rewrote the final scene after the first rehearsal.
ex.zh: 劇作家在第一次排練後重寫了最後一幕。

root.note: 製作戲劇的人 → 劇作家

mn: wright 是「工匠」不是 write，所以拼成 playwright 不是 playwrite。

senses.en: an urgent, emotional request
a formal statement in court of guilty or not guilty
senses.zh: （法庭上的）答辯；認罪與否的聲明

ex.en: The mayor made a plea for residents to conserve water.
ex.zh: 市長懇請居民節約用水。

senses.en: giving a sense of enjoyment; agreeable
friendly and polite

ex.en: We had a pleasant afternoon walking along the beach.
ex.zh: 我們沿著海灘散步，度過了愉快的下午。

root.note: 令人高興的 → 愉快的

senses.en: giving pleasure; enjoyable

ex.en: Reading on a rainy day is a simple but pleasurable habit.
ex.zh: 在雨天看書是個簡單卻令人愉快的習慣。

root.note: 能帶來樂趣的 → 令人愉快的

senses.en: of or belonging to the common people; unrefined
a member of the common people, originally in ancient Rome

ex.en: The snobbish critic dismissed pop music as plebeian entertainment.
ex.zh: 那位勢利的評論家把流行音樂斥為平民的娛樂。

parts.m: common people 平民（拉丁文 plebs）

root.note: 屬於平民的 → 平民的、粗俗的

senses.en: a person to whom something is pledged as security for a loan

ex.en: The pledgee may keep the jewelry until the loan is repaid.
ex.zh: 在借款償還之前，受質人可以保管這些珠寶。

root.note: 接受抵押品的人 → 受質人

senses.en: a person who pledges property as security for a loan (usually spelled pledgor)

ex.en: The pledgeor handed over his watch as security for the loan.
ex.zh: 出質人交出手錶作為借款的擔保。

root.note: 提供抵押品的人 → 出質人

senses.en: (of a meeting) attended by all members
unqualified; absolute

ex.en: The final decision will be made at the plenary session tomorrow.
ex.zh: 最後的決定將在明天的全體會議上做出。

root.note: 人數滿的、完整的 → 全體的

senses.en: a diplomat given full power to act for a government
having full power to take independent action

ex.en: The king sent a plenipotentiary to negotiate the peace treaty.
ex.zh: 國王派出一位全權代表去談判和約。

root.note: 擁有完整權力的人 → 全權代表

senses.en: an abundance; a large amount
the condition of being full or complete

ex.en: The market offered a plenitude of fresh fruit in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天的市場上有大量新鮮水果。

root.note: 滿滿的狀態 → 豐富

senses.en: plentiful; abundant (literary)
senses.zh: 豐富的；充足的（文學用語）

ex.en: The farmers gave thanks for a plenteous harvest.
ex.zh: 農夫們為豐盛的收成感恩。

root.note: 充足的 → 豐富的

senses.en: to explore or understand something completely
exactly vertical
exactly; completely (informal)

ex.en: The novel tries to plumb the depths of human loneliness.
ex.zh: 這部小說試圖探究人類孤獨的深處。

root.note: 用綁鉛的繩子測深度、測垂直 → 探究、垂直的

mn: b 不發音；plumber（水管工）也來自鉛，因為古時水管是鉛做的。

senses.en: to fall or drop straight down very quickly

ex.en: Temperatures can plummet at night in the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠裡的氣溫在夜間可能驟降。

root.note: 小鉛錘直直往下掉 → 暴跌

senses.en: (grammar) the past perfect tense
the past perfect tense, as in "had eaten"

ex.en: "She had left" is an example of the pluperfect tense.
ex.zh: 「她已經離開了」是過去完成式的例子。

root.note: 比完成更往前 → 過去完成式

senses.en: (grammar) referring to more than one
the plural form of a word

ex.en: The plural form of "mouse" is "mice."
ex.zh: mouse 的複數形是 mice。

root.note: 不只一個 → 複數的

senses.en: the largest number of votes when no one has a majority
a large number or variety

ex.en: She won with a plurality of the vote, but not a majority.
ex.zh: 她以相對多數票勝選，但沒有過半。

root.note: 較多的狀態 → 相對多數

mn: majority 是過半數；plurality 只是比別人多，不一定過半。

senses.en: government by the wealthy; a society ruled by the rich

ex.en: Critics warned that the country was becoming a plutocracy.
ex.zh: 批評者警告這個國家正在變成財閥統治。

root.note: 由財富統治 → 財閥政治

senses.en: filled with or operated by air or gas under pressure

ex.en: The mechanic used a pneumatic drill to remove the bolts.
ex.zh: 技師用氣動鑽拆下螺栓。

root.note: 靠空氣運作的 → 氣動的

mn: p 不發音；pneumonia（肺炎）也是同一個字根。

senses.en: poetry or the art of writing poetry (archaic)

ex.en: The old book praised the beauty of pastoral poesy.
ex.zh: 那本舊書讚美田園詩歌之美。

parts.m: make, create 創作（希臘文 poiein）

root.note: 創作 → 詩

senses.en: a person who writes poor or trivial poetry

ex.en: The critic called him a mere poetaster with no real talent.
ex.zh: 評論家說他只是個沒有真正才華的蹩腳詩人。

root.note: 低劣的詩人

senses.en: relating to or like poetry; beautifully expressive

ex.en: Her description of the sunset was almost poetic.
ex.zh: 她對夕陽的描寫幾乎充滿詩意。

root.note: 像詩的 → 富有詩意的

mn: poetic justice：因果報應、惡有惡報。

senses.en: the study or theory of poetry and literary form

ex.en: Aristotle's Poetics is one of the oldest works of literary theory.
ex.zh: 亞里斯多德的《詩學》是最古老的文學理論著作之一。

root.note: 研究詩的學問 → 詩學

senses.en: the quality of evoking a strong sense of sadness or regret

ex.en: The poignancy of the final scene left the audience in tears.
ex.zh: 最後一幕的辛酸讓觀眾都流下眼淚。

root.note: 刺痛人心的性質 → 辛酸

senses.en: evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret; deeply moving
senses.zh: 令人心酸的；深深感人的

ex.en: The letter from the soldier to his mother was deeply poignant.
ex.zh: 那名士兵寫給母親的信非常令人心酸。

root.note: 刺痛人心的 → 令人心酸的（pungent 同源）

mn: g 不發音，唸作 poin-yənt。

senses.en: graceful and elegant bearing; calm self-confidence
to be or keep balanced; to be ready to act

ex.en: She answered the difficult questions with remarkable poise.
ex.zh: 她以驚人的沉著回答了那些困難的問題。

mn: be poised to...：蓄勢待發、準備好要…。

senses.en: relating to the North or South Pole
completely opposite

ex.en: Polar bears depend on sea ice to hunt seals.
ex.zh: 北極熊依賴海冰來獵捕海豹。

root.note: 極的 → 極地的、兩極的

senses.en: the practice of strong written or spoken attack or argument

ex.en: The debate quickly turned from reasoned discussion to angry polemics.
ex.zh: 這場辯論很快就從理性討論變成憤怒的論戰。

root.note: 用言語打仗 → 論戰

senses.en: a fine powder produced by flowers that fertilizes other plants

ex.en: Bees carry pollen from one flower to another.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂把花粉從一朵花帶到另一朵花。

senses.en: to make air, water, or land dirty or harmful
to corrupt morally

ex.en: Factories must not pollute the river with chemical waste.
ex.zh: 工廠不得用化學廢料污染河川。

senses.en: government by many people

ex.en: The political scientist described modern democracy as a form of polyarchy.
ex.zh: 那位政治學者把現代民主描述為一種多元政體。

root.note: 多人統治 → 多頭政治

senses.en: government by many rulers

ex.en: After the king died, the empire fell into a weak polycracy of rival lords.
ex.zh: 國王死後，帝國陷入由敵對領主共治的脆弱多頭政治。

root.note: 多人統治 → 多頭政治

senses.en: the practice of having more than one spouse at the same time

ex.en: Polygamy is illegal in most countries.
ex.zh: 多配偶制在大多數國家是違法的。

root.note: 多重婚姻 → 多配偶制

senses.en: a person who knows and uses several languages
knowing or written in several languages

ex.en: A true polyglot, the tour guide switched easily between six languages.
ex.zh: 那位導遊是真正的多語人才，能在六種語言之間輕鬆切換。

root.note: 很多條舌頭 → 通曉多種語言

senses.en: a flat shape with three or more straight sides

ex.en: A hexagon is a polygon with six sides.
ex.zh: 六邊形是有六個邊的多邊形。

root.note: 很多角的圖形 → 多邊形

senses.en: a solid shape with many flat faces

ex.en: A cube is a polyhedron with six square faces.
ex.zh: 立方體是有六個正方形面的多面體。

root.note: 很多面的立體 → 多面體

senses.en: a word of more than three syllables

ex.en: "Responsibility" is a polysyllable that young readers often stumble over.
ex.zh: responsibility 是年幼讀者常唸不順的多音節字。

root.note: 多個音節的字

senses.en: a college offering courses in many technical and applied subjects
teaching many technical subjects

ex.en: He studied engineering at a polytechnic in Hong Kong.
ex.zh: 他在香港一所理工學院念工程。

root.note: 教多種技術的 → 理工學院

senses.en: the belief in or worship of more than one god

ex.en: Ancient Greek religion was a form of polytheism.
ex.zh: 古希臘宗教是一種多神信仰。

root.note: 信奉多個神 → 多神論

senses.en: the raised front part of a saddle, or the knob at the end of a sword handle
to beat repeatedly with the fists (variant of pummel)

ex.en: The rider grabbed the pommel of the saddle as the horse jumped.
ex.zh: 馬跳起來時，騎士抓住了鞍頭。

root.note: 像小蘋果的圓頭 → 劍柄頭、鞍頭

mn: 體操的 pommel horse 就是「鞍馬」。

senses.en: the quality of being self-important and pretentious

ex.en: The speaker's pomposity made it hard to take his ideas seriously.
ex.zh: 講者的自大浮誇讓人很難認真看待他的想法。

root.note: 擺排場的性質 → 浮誇

senses.en: acting in a self-important, grand, or pretentious way
senses.zh: 自大的；浮誇的；愛擺架子的

ex.en: The pompous official insisted that everyone call him "Your Excellency."
ex.zh: 那位自大的官員堅持大家要叫他「閣下」。

root.note: 愛擺排場的 → 浮誇的

senses.en: to think about something carefully

ex.en: Take a moment to ponder the question before you answer.
ex.zh: 回答之前，花點時間仔細思考這個問題。

root.note: 在心裡秤一秤 → 仔細考慮

senses.en: slow and clumsy because of great weight
dull, labored, and boring

ex.en: The elephant moved with ponderous steps toward the water.
ex.zh: 大象邁著沉重的步伐走向水邊。

root.note: 很重的 → 笨重的、沉悶的

senses.en: the Pope
a high priest or chief religious leader

ex.en: Thousands gathered in the square to hear the pontiff speak.
ex.zh: 數千人聚集在廣場聽教宗講話。

root.note: 造橋者（連接人與神的人）→ 大祭司、教宗

senses.en: the people living in a particular country or area; the general public

ex.en: The new law was popular with the general populace.
ex.zh: 新法律受到一般民眾的歡迎。

root.note: 一般人民 → 民眾

senses.en: having a large population; densely populated
senses.zh: 人口眾多的；人口稠密的

ex.en: Tokyo is one of the most populous cities in the world.
ex.zh: 東京是世界上人口最多的城市之一。

root.note: 人很多的 → 人口眾多的

senses.en: to be a sign or warning that something, often bad, will happen

ex.en: Dark clouds on the horizon seemed to portend a storm.
ex.zh: 地平線上的烏雲似乎預示著暴風雨。

root.note: 向前伸出指向未來 → 預示

senses.en: a sign or warning that something, especially bad, is about to happen

ex.en: Some villagers saw the comet as a portent of disaster.
ex.zh: 有些村民把彗星視為災難的預兆。

root.note: 向前伸出的指示 → 預兆

senses.en: a set of pieces of creative work collected to show someone's ability
a range of investments held by a person or organization
the area of responsibility of a government minister

ex.en: She brought her portfolio of drawings to the art school interview.
ex.zh: 她帶著自己的素描作品集去參加美術學校的面試。

root.note: 攜帶紙張的夾子 → 作品集

senses.en: to put forward as a fact or basis for argument

ex.en: Some scientists posit that life may exist on other planets.
ex.zh: 有些科學家假定其他星球上可能存在生命。

root.note: 把論點擺出來 → 假定

senses.en: a place where someone or something is
a job or a point of view
to put something in a particular place

ex.en: She applied for a position at a large law firm.
ex.zh: 她應徵了一家大型律師事務所的職位。

root.note: 被放置的地方 → 位置

senses.en: hopeful and confident; good or useful
completely certain
(of a test) showing the presence of something

ex.en: Try to keep a positive attitude even when things go wrong.
ex.zh: 即使事情出錯，也試著保持積極的態度。

root.note: 明確放下、確立的 → 肯定的、正面的

senses.en: a group of people gathered by a sheriff to help catch a criminal
a group of friends or followers (informal)

ex.en: In the old western, the sheriff formed a posse to chase the bandits.
ex.zh: 在那部老西部片裡，警長組了一支民團追捕土匪。

parts.m: be able 能夠（拉丁文 posse comitatus）

root.note: 郡裡有權力的人 → 民團

senses.en: to have or own something
(of a feeling or spirit) to control someone's mind

ex.en: Very few people possess the patience to become great teachers.
ex.zh: 很少人擁有成為優秀老師所需的耐心。

parts.m: able, master 有能力的主人（拉丁文 potis）

root.note: 以主人身分坐在上面 → 擁有

senses.en: the state of having or owning something
something that is owned

ex.en: The old photo album was her most treasured possession.
ex.zh: 那本舊相簿是她最珍貴的東西。

root.note: 擁有的狀態或東西

senses.en: demanding someone's total attention and love; unwilling to share
(grammar) showing ownership

ex.en: He became possessive and got angry whenever she talked to other friends.
ex.zh: 他變得佔有慾很強，只要她和別的朋友說話就生氣。

root.note: 想要擁有的 → 佔有慾強的

senses.en: a person who owns or has something

ex.en: She is the proud possessor of a first-edition copy of the novel.
ex.zh: 她很自豪地擁有這本小說的初版。

root.note: 擁有的人

senses.en: able to be done or to happen

ex.en: Is it possible to finish the project by Friday?
ex.zh: 有可能在星期五前完成這個專案嗎？

root.note: 能夠做到的 → 可能的

senses.en: to write a later date on a document than the actual date
senses.zh: （在文件上）填寫比實際晚的日期

senses.en: to happen or exist later than something else

ex.en: You can postdate the check so it cannot be cashed until next month.
ex.zh: 你可以在支票上填寫較晚的日期，這樣下個月才能兌現。

root.note: 填寫較晚的日期

senses.en: further back in position; at the rear
a person's buttocks (humorous)

ex.en: The posterior part of the brain processes visual information.
ex.zh: 大腦後部負責處理視覺訊息。

root.note: 比較後面的 → 後部的

senses.en: relating to study done after a first college degree
senses.zh: 研究所的；大學畢業後的

senses.en: a student taking such a course

ex.en: She plans to do postgraduate research in marine biology.
ex.zh: 她打算在研究所做海洋生物學的研究。

root.note: 畢業之後的 → 研究所的

senses.en: an extra note added at the end of a letter (P.S.)
a later addition to a story or event

ex.en: In a postscript, she added that she missed everyone.
ex.zh: 她在附言裡補充說她很想念大家。

root.note: 寫在後面的 → 附言

senses.en: power or strength, especially of a drug or argument

ex.en: The medicine loses its potency if it is stored in heat.
ex.zh: 這種藥如果存放在高溫下會失去藥效。

root.note: 有力量的性質 → 效力

senses.en: having great power, influence, or effect
senses.zh: 強有力的；有效的；（藥、酒）強烈的

ex.en: Fear can be a potent motivator.
ex.zh: 恐懼可能是很強大的動力。

root.note: 有力的

senses.en: a ruler with great power, especially an absolute one

ex.en: The ancient potentate ruled his kingdom without any council.
ex.zh: 那位古代君主不設任何議會就統治他的王國。

root.note: 有權力的人 → 君主

senses.en: having the ability to develop into something in the future
qualities that may develop and lead to future success

ex.en: The coach saw great potential in the young player.
ex.zh: 教練在這位年輕球員身上看到很大的潛力。

root.note: 有能力成為… → 潛在的

senses.en: a liquid drink with medicinal, magical, or poisonous properties

ex.en: In the story, the witch gave the prince a sleeping potion.
ex.zh: 故事裡，女巫給了王子一瓶安眠藥水。

root.note: 喝的東西 → 藥水

senses.en: without ability, influence, or power

ex.en: We felt powerless as the flood waters rose around the house.
ex.zh: 洪水在房子四周上漲時，我們感到無能為力。

root.note: 沒有力量 → 無能為力

senses.en: able to be done or put into practice successfully

ex.en: Building a bridge across the bay is not practicable at this cost.
ex.zh: 以這樣的成本在海灣上建橋並不可行。

root.note: 可以實行的 → 可行的

mn: practicable 是「做得到」；practical 是「實用的、務實的」。

senses.en: to talk foolishly or at length about something

ex.en: He would prate for hours about his youth without letting anyone speak.
ex.zh: 他會一連好幾個小時嘮叨他年輕時的事，不讓別人插話。

senses.en: to talk at length in a foolish or childish way
senses.zh: 喋喋不休地閒聊；說孩子氣的話

senses.en: foolish or childish talk

ex.en: The children began to prattle excitedly about their trip to the zoo.
ex.zh: 孩子們開始興奮地嘰嘰喳喳聊著去動物園的事。

root.note: 一直閒扯 → 喋喋不休

senses.en: an introduction to a speech, document, or law

ex.en: The preamble to the Constitution begins with "We the People."
ex.zh: 美國憲法的序言以「我們人民」開頭。

root.note: 走在前面的部分 → 序言

senses.en: not securely held; likely to fall or collapse
dependent on chance; uncertain and risky

ex.en: The climber found herself in a precarious position on the icy ledge.
ex.zh: 那位登山者發現自己在結冰的岩架上處境危險。

root.note: 要靠祈求別人才得到的 → 不穩的、靠不住的

senses.en: an action taken in advance to prevent something bad from happening

ex.en: As a precaution, please back up your files before the update.
ex.zh: 為了預防起見，更新前請先備份你的檔案。

root.note: 事先小心 → 預防措施

senses.en: to come before something in time, order, or position

ex.en: A short speech will precede the awards ceremony.
ex.zh: 頒獎典禮之前會有一段簡短的致詞。

root.note: 走在前面 → 先於

mn: precede 是「在前面」，proceed 是「繼續進行」，別搞混。

senses.en: the condition of being more important or coming first

ex.en: Safety must take precedence over speed on the construction site.
ex.zh: 在工地上，安全必須優先於速度。

root.note: 走在前面的地位 → 優先

mn: 常見片語 take precedence over：比…優先。

senses.en: an earlier event or decision used as an example or guide

ex.en: The court's ruling set a precedent for future privacy cases.
ex.zh: 法院的判決為日後的隱私權案件立下先例。

root.note: 之前發生過的事 → 先例

mn: unprecedented（史無前例的）是常考字。

senses.en: serving as or relating to a precedent

ex.en: The appeals court said its decision had no precedential value.
ex.zh: 上訴法院表示其判決不具先例效力。

root.note: 先例的

senses.en: the slow change in the direction of the axis of a spinning object, such as the earth

ex.en: Because of precession, the North Star will change over thousands of years.
ex.zh: 由於歲差，北極星在數千年後會改變。

root.note: 分點逐年往前移動 → 歲差

senses.en: a very steep side of a cliff or mountain
a very dangerous situation

ex.en: The hikers stopped at the edge of the precipice to take photos.
ex.zh: 健行者在懸崖邊停下來拍照。

root.note: 頭朝前栽下去的地方 → 懸崖

senses.en: a cause of a particular action or event; a trigger
(chemistry) a substance that causes precipitation

ex.en: Stress is often a precipitant of migraine headaches.
ex.zh: 壓力常常是偏頭痛的誘因。

root.note: 使事情一頭栽下去的東西 → 誘因

senses.en: to cause something bad to happen suddenly or sooner than expected
[prɪˋsɪpətɪt] done suddenly and without careful thought
(chemistry) a solid that separates from a liquid
