ex.en: One small mistake could precipitate a financial crisis.
ex.zh: 一個小錯誤就可能引發金融危機。

root.note: 頭朝前栽下去 → 倉促、突然促成

senses.en: exact and accurate in every detail

ex.en: The recipe gives precise measurements for every ingredient.
ex.zh: 這份食譜每種材料都有精確的份量。

root.note: 把前端切齊 → 精確的

senses.en: the quality of being exact and accurate

ex.en: The surgeon worked with great precision.
ex.zh: 外科醫生以極高的精準度動手術。

root.note: 切得整整齊齊 → 精確

senses.en: to prevent something from happening; to make impossible

ex.en: A busy schedule will preclude me from joining the trip.
ex.zh: 忙碌的行程讓我無法參加這趟旅行。

root.note: 事先把門關上 → 阻止

senses.en: (of a child) having developed certain abilities earlier than usual

ex.en: The precocious six-year-old was already reading novels.
ex.zh: 那個早慧的六歲孩子已經在讀小說了。

root.note: 提早煮熟 → 早熟的

senses.en: a person or thing that comes before and leads to another

ex.en: The abacus was a precursor of the modern calculator.
ex.zh: 算盤是現代計算機的前身。

root.note: 跑在前面的 → 先驅

senses.en: (of an animal) living by killing and eating other animals
seeking to exploit or harm others for gain

ex.en: Sharks are predatory fish found in oceans around the world.
ex.zh: 鯊魚是分布在世界各大洋的掠食性魚類。

root.note: 掠奪的 → 掠食性的

senses.en: a person who held a job or position before someone else
a thing that has been replaced by something newer

ex.en: The new principal promised to continue her predecessor's reforms.
ex.zh: 新校長承諾延續前任校長的改革。

root.note: 之前已離開的人 → 前任

senses.en: a difficult, unpleasant, or embarrassing situation

ex.en: Locked out of the house without a phone, she was in quite a predicament.
ex.zh: 她沒帶手機又被鎖在門外，處境相當尷尬。

root.note: 原指被斷言的狀態、類別 → 引申為處境、困境

senses.en: (grammar) the part of a sentence that says something about the subject
[ˋprɛdɪˏket] to base something on a belief or condition

ex.en: In "The dog barked loudly," the predicate is "barked loudly."
ex.zh: 在 The dog barked loudly 這句裡，述語是 barked loudly。

root.note: 公開說出來、斷定 → 述語

mn: 常見片語 be predicated on：以…為前提。

senses.en: to say that something will happen in the future

ex.en: Experts predict that prices will rise next year.
ex.zh: 專家預測明年物價會上漲。

root.note: 事先說出 → 預測

senses.en: a statement about what will happen in the future

ex.en: His prediction about the election turned out to be correct.
ex.zh: 他對選舉的預測後來證明是對的。

root.note: 事先說出的話 → 預測

senses.en: the state of being greater in number, power, or importance

ex.en: The predominance of young people in the audience surprised the band.
ex.zh: 觀眾以年輕人居多，讓樂團感到意外。

root.note: 統治地位在前 → 優勢

senses.en: present as the strongest or main element

ex.en: Blue is the predominant color in the painting.
ex.zh: 藍色是這幅畫的主色。

root.note: 居於統治地位的 → 主要的

senses.en: to be the strongest or main element; to be greater in number

ex.en: In this forest, pine trees predominate.
ex.zh: 這片森林以松樹居多。

root.note: 處於統治地位 → 佔優勢

senses.en: the fact of being better or more important than all others

ex.en: The university's preeminence in engineering attracts students worldwide.
ex.zh: 這所大學在工程領域首屈一指，吸引了全球學生。

root.note: 突出在所有人前面 → 卓越

senses.en: to take action to prevent something expected from happening
to take or acquire something before others can

ex.en: The company lowered its prices to preempt competition from new rivals.
ex.zh: 公司降價以先發制人，防範新對手的競爭。

root.note: 搶先買下 → 先發制人

senses.en: the act of acting first to prevent something
the right to buy something before others

ex.en: The general argued that preemption was the only way to avoid a larger war.
ex.zh: 那位將軍主張先發制人是避免更大戰爭的唯一方法。

root.note: 搶先取得 → 先發制人、優先購買權

senses.en: to engage, book, or commit in advance

ex.en: We had to preengage the hall months before the wedding.
ex.zh: 我們必須在婚禮前幾個月就預訂禮堂。

root.note: 事先約定

senses.en: to set up or decide in advance

ex.en: It helps to preestablish clear rules before the game starts.
ex.zh: 在比賽開始前預先訂好明確的規則會很有幫助。

root.note: 事先建立

senses.en: to exist at an earlier time or before something else

ex.en: Some of these problems seem to preexist the new policy.
ex.zh: 這些問題有些似乎在新政策之前就已存在。

root.note: 之前就存在

senses.en: existence before something else, especially of the soul before birth
senses.zh: 先存在；（靈魂的）前世存在

ex.en: Some ancient philosophers believed in the preexistence of the soul.
ex.zh: 有些古代哲學家相信靈魂在出生前就已存在。

root.note: 之前就存在

senses.en: an introduction to a book written by the author
to introduce or begin with something

ex.en: In the preface, the author thanks her family for their support.
ex.zh: 作者在序言中感謝家人的支持。

root.note: 在前面說的話 → 序言

senses.en: serving as an introduction

ex.en: After a few prefatory remarks, the speaker got to the main topic.
ex.zh: 講者說了幾句開場白後，進入了主題。

root.note: 在前面說的 → 序言的

senses.en: to like one thing more than another

ex.en: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
ex.zh: 早上我比較喜歡喝茶而不是咖啡。

root.note: 把喜歡的放在前面 → 比較喜歡

senses.en: more desirable or suitable

ex.en: Walking is preferable to driving for such a short distance.
ex.zh: 這麼短的距離，走路比開車更好。

root.note: 值得比較喜歡的 → 更好的

senses.en: a greater liking for one thing over another
favor or advantage shown to someone

ex.en: Do you have a preference for a window or an aisle seat?
ex.zh: 你偏好靠窗還是靠走道的座位？

root.note: 比較喜歡的傾向 → 偏好

senses.en: giving an advantage or special treatment to someone
senses.zh: 優惠的；優先的；差別待遇的

ex.en: Members receive preferential treatment when booking tickets.
ex.zh: 會員訂票時可以享有優先待遇。

root.note: 給予優待的

senses.en: promotion to a higher position or office

ex.en: The young officer hoped for preferment after the successful campaign.
ex.zh: 那位年輕軍官希望在戰役成功後獲得晉升。

root.note: 被推舉到前面 → 升遷

senses.en: a group of letters added to the beginning of a word to change its meaning
to add something at the beginning

ex.en: The prefix "un-" turns "happy" into "unhappy."
ex.zh: 字首 un- 把 happy 變成 unhappy。

root.note: 固定在前面的部分 → 字首

senses.en: able to be grasped or seized

ex.en: The handle was shaped to be easily prehensible for small hands.
ex.zh: 這個把手的形狀讓小手也很容易握住。

root.note: 可以抓住的

senses.en: (of a tail or limb) able to grasp or hold things

ex.en: The monkey hung from the branch by its prehensile tail.
ex.zh: 猴子用牠能抓握的尾巴掛在樹枝上。

root.note: 能抓住東西的

senses.en: the action of grasping or seizing
understanding; mental grasp

ex.en: Human hands are highly adapted for prehension.
ex.zh: 人類的手高度適合抓握。

root.note: 抓住的動作（comprehension 同源）

senses.en: an unfair opinion formed without knowledge or reason
to cause someone to have an unfair opinion; to harm

ex.en: The law aims to protect people from prejudice at work.
ex.zh: 這項法律旨在保護人們在職場上免受偏見。

root.note: 事先下判斷 → 偏見

senses.en: the office or rank of a prelate; church government by bishops
senses.zh: 高級教士職位；主教制度

ex.en: The reformers wanted to abolish prelacy and let congregations govern themselves.
ex.zh: 改革者想廢除主教制度，讓各教會自治。

root.note: 高級教士的職位或制度

senses.en: a high-ranking member of the clergy, such as a bishop

ex.en: The prelate led the ceremony in the great cathedral.
ex.zh: 那位高級教士在大教堂主持儀式。

root.note: 被擺在別人前面的人 → 高級教士

senses.en: an action or event that comes before and introduces something more important
a short introductory piece of music

ex.en: The small protests were a prelude to a much larger movement.
ex.zh: 那些小型抗議是一場更大規模運動的序幕。

root.note: 在前面演奏的 → 前奏

senses.en: happening or done before the proper or usual time

ex.en: It is premature to celebrate before all the votes are counted.
ex.zh: 還沒開完票就慶祝還太早。

root.note: 成熟之前 → 過早的

senses.en: a prime minister or head of government
first in importance or quality

ex.en: The premier met with foreign leaders at the summit.
ex.zh: 總理在高峰會上與各國領袖會面。

root.note: 排第一的人 → 首相

mn: premiere（首映）和 premier（首相、首要的）拼法差一個 e。

senses.en: a statement or idea on which an argument or theory is based
(premises) a building and the land around it

ex.en: The whole plan rests on the premise that customers will pay more.
ex.zh: 整個計畫建立在顧客會願意付更多錢的前提上。

root.note: 先放在前面的話 → 前提

senses.en: a strong feeling that something, usually bad, is about to happen

ex.en: She had a premonition that the flight would be delayed.
ex.zh: 她預感班機會延誤。

root.note: 事先的警告 → 預感

senses.en: the state of being completely absorbed in thinking about something
senses.zh: 全神貫注；心事；最關心的事

ex.en: His preoccupation with his phone annoyed everyone at dinner.
ex.zh: 他在晚餐時一直盯著手機，讓大家很不耐煩。

root.note: 心思被事先佔滿 → 全神貫注

senses.en: to fill someone's mind so that they think of little else

ex.en: Try not to let small worries preoccupy you before the exam.
ex.zh: 考試前別讓小事佔據你的心思。

root.note: 事先佔據心思 → 使全神貫注

senses.en: to decide or determine beforehand, as if by fate

ex.en: She did not believe that fate could preordain every event in life.
ex.zh: 她不相信命運能預先決定人生中的每一件事。

root.note: 事先規定好 → 注定

senses.en: the action of making ready for something
a substance prepared for use, such as a medicine

ex.en: Good preparation is the key to doing well on the SAT.
ex.zh: 充分準備是在 SAT 考好的關鍵。

root.note: 事先準備

senses.en: done in order to prepare for something

ex.en: The team held a preparatory meeting before the big presentation.
ex.zh: 團隊在重要簡報前開了一場籌備會議。

root.note: 準備用的

mn: 美國的 prep school 就是 preparatory school（大學預科私校）。

senses.en: greater in number, weight, or importance

ex.en: Tourism is the preponderant source of income on the island.
ex.zh: 觀光業是這座島主要的收入來源。

root.note: 秤起來比較重 → 佔優勢的

senses.en: to be greater in number, weight, or influence

ex.en: In this debate, the arguments for change seem to preponderate.
ex.zh: 在這場辯論中，支持改變的論點似乎佔了上風。

root.note: 重量較重 → 佔優勢

senses.en: an opinion formed beforehand; a bias

ex.en: A fair judge must set aside every prepossession about the case.
ex.zh: 公正的法官必須拋開對案件的一切先入之見。

root.note: 心思被事先佔有 → 成見

senses.en: completely absurd or ridiculous

ex.en: The idea that the moon is made of cheese is preposterous.
ex.zh: 月亮是起司做的這種想法太荒謬了。

root.note: 把後面的放到前面、前後顛倒 → 荒謬的

senses.en: a right or privilege belonging to a particular person or group

ex.en: It is the teacher's prerogative to change the due date.
ex.zh: 更改截止日期是老師的權利。

root.note: 先被徵詢意見的權利 → 特權

senses.en: a sign or warning of a future event
[prɪˋsedʒ] to be a sign that something will happen

ex.en: The early flowers were a presage of a warm spring.
ex.zh: 提早開的花是溫暖春天的預兆。

root.note: 事先察覺 → 預兆

senses.en: knowledge of events before they happen; foresight

ex.en: With remarkable prescience, the writer described smartphones decades early.
ex.zh: 那位作家有驚人的先見之明，早在幾十年前就描寫出智慧型手機。

root.note: 事先知道 → 先見之明

senses.en: having knowledge of events before they happen

ex.en: Her prescient warning about the housing bubble was ignored.
ex.zh: 她對房市泡沫具先見之明的警告被忽視了。

root.note: 事先知道的 → 有先見之明的

senses.en: a rule, law, or command

ex.en: The monks followed every prescript of their ancient order.
ex.zh: 僧侶們遵守他們古老修會的每一條規定。

root.note: 事先寫下的規定

senses.en: (law) subject to or acquired by long-term use or possession
senses.zh: （法律）可依時效取得的；受時效約束的

ex.en: The lawyer argued that the right of way was prescriptible after twenty years of use.
ex.zh: 律師主張，這條通行權在使用二十年後可依時效取得。

root.note: 可依時效規定取得的

senses.en: a doctor's written order for medicine
a recommended way of doing something

ex.en: You need a prescription to buy this medicine.
ex.zh: 買這種藥需要處方。

root.note: 事先寫好的指示 → 處方

senses.en: having a feeling of what is about to happen

ex.en: The old sailor seemed presentient of the storm before any clouds appeared.
ex.zh: 那位老水手似乎在雲還沒出現前就預感到暴風雨要來。

root.note: 事先感覺到的 → 有預感的

senses.en: a feeling that something, especially bad, is about to happen

ex.en: She had a presentiment of danger as she entered the dark alley.
ex.zh: 她走進那條暗巷時，有種危險的預感。

root.note: 事先的感覺 → 預感

senses.en: a formal statement or report, especially one made by a grand jury
the act of presenting something

ex.en: The grand jury issued a presentment criticizing the prison conditions.
ex.zh: 大陪審團發出一份報告，批評監獄的狀況。

root.note: 正式呈上的東西 → 報告

senses.en: the act of keeping something in its original state or safe from harm

ex.en: The group works for the preservation of historic buildings.
ex.zh: 這個團體致力於保存歷史建築。

root.note: 事先保存起來 → 保存

senses.en: an idea taken to be true without proof
behavior that is too bold or disrespectful

ex.en: The law is based on the presumption of innocence until proven guilty.
ex.zh: 這項法律建立在未經證明有罪前推定無罪的原則上。

root.note: 事先就拿來當真 → 假定；擅自拿取 → 放肆

senses.en: failing to respect limits; too bold or confident
senses.zh: 放肆的；冒昧的；自以為是的

ex.en: It would be presumptuous to plan the party before she agrees to come.
ex.zh: 在她答應要來之前就計畫派對，未免太自以為是。

root.note: 不經同意就先拿 → 放肆的

senses.en: a claim or wish to be something, often without justification
the act of pretending to be more important than one is

ex.en: The restaurant serves good food without any pretension.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的菜很好吃，一點也不做作。

root.note: 把自己伸展到別人面前 → 自命不凡

senses.en: trying to seem more important, intelligent, or cultured than one is

ex.en: He used pretentious words just to impress his classmates.
ex.zh: 他用一些故作高深的字眼，只為了讓同學佩服。

root.note: 把自己撐大給人看 → 做作的

senses.en: beyond what is normal or natural

ex.en: The young pianist showed a preternatural talent for music.
ex.zh: 那位年輕鋼琴家展現出異於常人的音樂天分。

root.note: 超越自然的 → 異常的

senses.en: a false reason given to hide the real reason for an action

ex.en: He called her on the pretext of asking about homework.
ex.zh: 他以問作業為藉口打電話給她。

root.note: 在前面編織的東西 → 藉口

senses.en: the fact of being widespread or common

ex.en: Doctors are studying the prevalence of allergies among children.
ex.zh: 醫生正在研究兒童過敏的普遍程度。

root.note: 力量居前、佔上風 → 盛行

senses.en: widespread in a particular area or time

ex.en: This disease is more prevalent in tropical countries.
ex.zh: 這種疾病在熱帶國家較為普遍。

root.note: 力量居上 → 盛行的

senses.en: to speak evasively or avoid telling the whole truth

ex.en: When asked about the missing money, the treasurer began to prevaricate.
ex.zh: 被問到那筆不見的錢時，財務開始支吾其詞。

parts.m: straddle, walk crookedly 跨開、歪著走

root.note: 走路歪來歪去、不走直路 → 支吾搪塞

senses.en: the act of stopping something from happening

ex.en: Prevention is better than cure.
ex.zh: 預防勝於治療。

root.note: 先到一步擋住 → 預防

senses.en: a small sharp point on a plant or animal
to feel a slight stinging sensation

ex.en: I felt a prickle of fear on the back of my neck.
ex.zh: 我感到後頸一陣發麻的恐懼。

root.note: 小刺

senses.en: self-righteously correct in behavior; smugly moral
senses.zh: 自命清高的；一本正經的

ex.en: His priggish comments about everyone's manners made him unpopular.
ex.zh: 他對大家的禮貌指指點點，自命清高的態度讓他不受歡迎。

root.note: 像道學先生的 → 自命清高的

senses.en: stiffly formal and proper; easily shocked by anything rude
neat and tidy

ex.en: She sat in a prim posture with her hands folded in her lap.
ex.zh: 她拘謹地坐著，雙手交疊放在腿上。

mn: 常見片語 prim and proper：規規矩矩、一板一眼。

senses.en: the chief female singer in an opera
a very temperamental, self-important person

ex.en: The star player acted like a prima donna and refused to practice with the team.
ex.zh: 那位明星球員耍大牌，拒絕和球隊一起練習。

root.note: 第一女士 → 歌劇女主角 → 耍大牌的人

senses.en: an elementary textbook or introduction to a subject
[ˋpraɪmɚ] a first coat of paint

ex.en: This short book is a good primer on personal finance.
ex.zh: 這本小書是很好的理財入門書。

root.note: 第一本讀的書 → 入門書；第一層漆 → 底漆

senses.en: of the earliest ages of the world; very ancient

ex.en: We hiked through a primeval forest that had never been logged.
ex.zh: 我們走過一片從未被砍伐過的原始森林。

root.note: 最初年代的 → 太古的

senses.en: relating to an early stage of development
very simple and basic

ex.en: Early humans made primitive tools from stone.
ex.zh: 早期人類用石頭製作原始的工具。

root.note: 最初的 → 原始的

senses.en: most important; main
the head of a school
a sum of money lent or invested, not including interest

ex.en: The principal reason for the delay was bad weather.
ex.zh: 延誤的主要原因是天氣不好。

root.note: 拿第一的 → 主要的

mn: principAL 校長是你的 PAL（朋友）；principLE 是原則（ruLE）。

senses.en: a state ruled by a prince

ex.en: Monaco is a tiny principality on the Mediterranean coast.
ex.zh: 摩納哥是地中海沿岸的一個小公國。

root.note: 親王統治的國家 → 公國

senses.en: a basic truth, rule, or belief
a moral rule that guides behavior

ex.en: She refused the bribe as a matter of principle.
ex.zh: 她基於原則拒絕了賄賂。

root.note: 最先的根本 → 原則

mn: principle 原則（ruLE 結尾同 -le）；principal 主要的、校長。

senses.en: a small monastery or convent governed by a prior or prioress

ex.en: The ruins of a medieval priory stand on the hill.
ex.zh: 山丘上矗立著一座中世紀小修道院的遺跡。

root.note: 由 prior 管理的地方 → 小修道院

senses.en: in its original condition; unspoiled
clean and fresh as if new

ex.en: The island's pristine beaches attract divers from all over the world.
ex.zh: 島上未受破壞的海灘吸引了世界各地的潛水客。

parts.m: former, original 原本的（拉丁文 pristinus）

root.note: 維持原本樣子的 → 原始的

senses.en: a privately owned armed ship, or its captain, authorized by a government to attack enemy ships
senses.zh: （政府特許的）私掠船；私掠船船長

ex.en: The privateer captured three merchant ships during the war.
ex.zh: 那艘私掠船在戰爭期間擄獲了三艘商船。

root.note: 私人的武裝船 → 私掠船

senses.en: a special right or advantage given to a particular person or group
something that is an honor to do

ex.en: It is a privilege to work with such talented people.
ex.zh: 能和這麼有才華的人一起工作是我的榮幸。

root.note: 只給個人的法律 → 特權

senses.en: (law) a legally recognized relationship between parties, as in a contract
private or secret knowledge shared with others

ex.en: The court ruled that there was no privity between the buyer and the manufacturer.
ex.zh: 法院判定買方與製造商之間沒有契約關係。

root.note: 私下的關係 → 當事人關係

senses.en: sharing in knowledge of something secret
senses.zh: 知道內情的；參與祕密的

senses.en: an outdoor toilet

ex.en: Only a few advisers were privy to the president's plans.
ex.zh: 只有少數顧問知道總統的計畫。

root.note: 私下的 → 知道內情的

mn: 常見片語 be privy to：知道（祕密）。

senses.en: the official process of proving that a will is valid
to establish the validity of a will

ex.en: The house cannot be sold until probate is complete.
ex.zh: 遺囑認證完成之前，這棟房子不能出售。

root.note: 證明遺囑有效

senses.en: a period of supervision given to an offender instead of prison
a trial period for a new employee or student

ex.en: New employees are on probation for their first three months.
ex.zh: 新員工前三個月是試用期。

root.note: 測試期間 → 試用期、緩刑

senses.en: to investigate or examine thoroughly
a thorough investigation
a device used to explore space or the body

ex.en: Journalists continued to probe the mayor's financial dealings.
ex.zh: 記者持續深入調查市長的財務往來。

root.note: 測試、檢驗 → 探查

senses.en: the quality of having strong moral principles; honesty

ex.en: The judge was respected for her probity and fairness.
ex.zh: 那位法官因正直與公正而受到尊敬。

parts.m: good, honest 好的、正直的（拉丁文 probus）

root.note: 正直的性質

senses.en: an established or official way of doing something
a medical operation

ex.en: Follow the safety procedure carefully when using the machine.
ex.zh: 使用這台機器時，請仔細遵守安全程序。

root.note: 一步步往前走的方式 → 程序

senses.en: to continue or begin a course of action
to move forward to a place

ex.en: Passengers should proceed to gate 12 for boarding.
ex.zh: 旅客請前往 12 號登機門登機。

root.note: 向前走 → 繼續進行

senses.en: a public or official announcement

ex.en: The king issued a proclamation declaring a national holiday.
ex.zh: 國王發布公告，宣布一個國定假日。

root.note: 向前大聲喊出 → 宣言

senses.en: to delay or postpone doing something

ex.en: If you procrastinate, you will have to cram the night before the test.
ex.zh: 如果你拖延，就得在考試前一晚臨時抱佛腳。

parts.m: of tomorrow 明天的（拉丁文 cras）

root.note: 推到明天 → 拖延

senses.en: the habit of delaying or postponing things

ex.en: Procrastination caused him to miss the application deadline.
ex.zh: 拖延讓他錯過了申請截止日期。

root.note: 推到明天的習慣 → 拖延

senses.en: a person who supervises students during an exam
to supervise an exam

ex.en: The proctor collected our phones before the exam began.
ex.zh: 考試開始前，監考人員收走了我們的手機。

parts.m: procurator 代理人、管理者（縮寫）

root.note: 管理者 → 監考人員

senses.en: spending money or resources wastefully
a person who spends money wastefully

ex.en: The prodigal heir spent his fortune in just a few years.
ex.zh: 那個揮霍無度的繼承人短短幾年就把財產花光了。

root.note: 把錢往外趕 → 揮霍的

mn: 聖經中「浪子回頭」就是 the prodigal son。

senses.en: remarkably or impressively great in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: She has a prodigious memory for names and faces.
ex.zh: 她對名字和長相有驚人的記憶力。

parts.m: omen, wonder 奇蹟（拉丁文 prodigium）

root.note: 像奇蹟一樣的 → 驚人的

senses.en: a young person with exceptional talent
an amazing or unusual thing

ex.en: The chess prodigy beat a grandmaster at the age of ten.
ex.zh: 那位西洋棋神童十歲時就打敗了一位特級大師。

root.note: 奇蹟般的人 → 神童

senses.en: producing a lot; achieving useful results

ex.en: I feel most productive in the early morning.
ex.zh: 我在清晨時覺得最有效率。

root.note: 把東西引導出來 → 有生產力的

senses.en: a paid job that requires special training, such as law or medicine
an open declaration of belief or feeling

ex.en: Teaching is a demanding but rewarding profession.
ex.zh: 教書是一份辛苦但很有意義的職業。

root.note: 公開宣誓從事的工作 → 專業

senses.en: a university teacher of the highest rank

ex.en: Our history professor tells great stories in every lecture.
ex.zh: 我們的歷史教授每堂課都會講很精彩的故事。

root.note: 公開講授學問的人 → 教授

senses.en: to offer or hold out something for someone to accept

ex.en: She stepped forward to proffer her hand in greeting.
ex.zh: 她走上前伸出手打招呼。

root.note: 向前遞出 → 提供

senses.en: a high degree of skill; expertise

ex.en: The job requires proficiency in at least two languages.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要精通至少兩種語言。

root.note: 做得很有進展 → 熟練

senses.en: skilled and competent at something

ex.en: You must be proficient in English to study at this university.
ex.zh: 你必須精通英文才能在這所大學就讀。

root.note: 做得很有進展的 → 熟練的

senses.en: a side view of a face or object
a short description of a person or organization
the extent to which someone attracts public attention

ex.en: She updated her online profile with a new photo.
ex.zh: 她用一張新照片更新了自己的網路個人檔案。

root.note: 畫出外形線條 → 側面輪廓

mn: keep a low profile：保持低調。

senses.en: a person who makes unfair profits, especially by selling scarce goods at high prices
to make unfair profits

ex.en: During the storm, a profiteer sold bottled water at ten times the normal price.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間，有個奸商用十倍的價格賣瓶裝水。

root.note: 只求利潤的人 → 奸商

senses.en: reckless wastefulness
immoral, shamelessly indulgent behavior

ex.en: The government's profligacy left the country deep in debt.
ex.zh: 政府的揮霍無度讓國家債台高築。

root.note: 被打倒、毀壞 → 揮霍墮落

senses.en: recklessly wasteful of money or resources
shamelessly immoral

ex.en: Critics attacked the city's profligate spending on luxury offices.
ex.zh: 批評者抨擊市政府揮霍公帑打造豪華辦公室。

root.note: 被打垮、毀掉的 → 揮霍、放蕩的

senses.en: produced or given in large amounts
senses.zh: 大量的；豐富的；毫不吝惜的

ex.en: He offered profuse apologies for being late.
ex.zh: 他為遲到連連道歉。

root.note: 往外大量傾倒 → 大量的

senses.en: the descendants or offspring of a person, animal, or plant

ex.en: The farmer hoped the prize bull's progeny would be just as strong.
ex.zh: 農夫希望那頭得獎公牛的後代也同樣強壯。

root.note: 往後生出來的 → 後代

senses.en: the process of developing or moving gradually toward a more advanced state
a sequence of numbers or events

ex.en: The doctor monitored the progression of the disease.
ex.zh: 醫生監測病情的發展。

root.note: 一步步向前 → 進展

senses.en: the action of forbidding something, especially by law
(Prohibition) the period from 1920 to 1933 when alcohol was banned in the U.S.

ex.en: The prohibition on smoking in restaurants began last year.
ex.zh: 餐廳禁菸的禁令從去年開始實施。

root.note: 擋在前面不讓過 → 禁止

senses.en: a person who supports banning the sale of alcohol

ex.en: The prohibitionist gave speeches about the dangers of drinking.
ex.zh: 那位禁酒主義者到處演講飲酒的危害。

root.note: 主張禁（酒）的人

senses.en: serving to forbid or restrict

ex.en: The city posted prohibitory signs along the dangerous cliff.
ex.zh: 市政府在危險的懸崖沿線立了禁止標誌。

root.note: 禁止的

senses.en: an estimate of future amounts based on present trends
the showing of an image on a screen
something that sticks out

ex.en: The sales projection for next year looks very positive.
ex.zh: 明年的銷售預測看起來非常樂觀。

root.note: 往前丟 → 投射、預測

senses.en: relating to the working class
senses.zh: 無產階級的；勞工階級的

senses.en: a member of the working class

ex.en: The novel describes proletarian life in an industrial city.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫工業城市裡勞工階級的生活。

parts.m: citizen of the lowest class 最低階層公民（拉丁文 proles 子孫）

root.note: 古羅馬只有子女沒有財產的階層 → 無產階級

senses.en: producing many works, results, or offspring

ex.en: The prolific author has published more than fifty novels.
ex.zh: 這位多產的作家已經出版了五十多本小說。

root.note: 生出很多後代 → 多產的

senses.en: using too many words; tediously long

ex.en: The report was so prolix that nobody finished reading it.
ex.zh: 這份報告冗長到沒有人讀完。

root.note: 一直往前流個不停 → 冗長的

senses.en: an introductory section of a play, book, or piece of music
an event that leads to another

ex.en: The novel's prologue is set one hundred years before the main story.
ex.zh: 這部小說的序幕發生在主要故事的一百年前。

root.note: 在前面說的話 → 序言

senses.en: to make something last longer

ex.en: Regular exercise can prolong your life.
ex.zh: 規律運動可以延長壽命。

root.note: 往前拉長 → 延長

senses.en: a paved public walk, especially along the sea
a leisurely walk taken for pleasure
to take a leisurely public walk

ex.en: Families strolled along the promenade at sunset.
ex.zh: 日落時，一家家人沿著海濱步道散步。

root.note: 往前走 → 散步、散步道

mn: 美國高中舞會 prom 就是 promenade 的縮寫。

senses.en: the state of being important or famous
something that sticks out, such as a hill

ex.en: The young scientist rose to prominence after her discovery.
ex.zh: 這位年輕科學家在有所發現後聲名鵲起。

root.note: 向前突出 → 顯著、知名

senses.en: important or famous
sticking out; easily noticed

ex.en: A prominent scientist will speak at the graduation ceremony.
ex.zh: 一位著名的科學家將在畢業典禮上致詞。

root.note: 向前突出的 → 顯眼、著名的

senses.en: having many casual sexual partners
indiscriminate; mixing different things without care

ex.en: The critic complained about the promiscuous use of special effects in the film.
ex.zh: 評論家抱怨這部電影濫用特效。

root.note: 全部混在一起、不挑選 → 雜亂的

senses.en: containing or expressing a promise, especially to pay

ex.en: He signed a promissory note agreeing to repay the loan within a year.
ex.zh: 他簽了一張本票，同意一年內還清借款。

root.note: 事先送出承諾的 → 約定的

mn: promissory note：本票；借據。

senses.en: a high point of land that sticks out into the sea

ex.en: A lighthouse stands at the tip of the rocky promontory.
ex.zh: 一座燈塔矗立在岩石海岬的尖端。

root.note: 向前伸出的山 → 海角

senses.en: a person who organizes or finances events such as concerts or sports matches
a supporter of a cause or idea

ex.en: The concert promoter sold all the tickets in one hour.
ex.zh: 演唱會主辦人在一小時內賣光了所有門票。

root.note: 把事情往前推動的人 → 推廣者

senses.en: to make an idea or belief widely known
to officially announce a new law

ex.en: The group used social media to promulgate its ideas.
ex.zh: 這個團體利用社群媒體宣揚他們的理念。

parts.m: milk out, make known 擠出、公開（拉丁文 promulgare）

root.note: 向前公開 → 頒布、宣揚

senses.en: biased or misleading information used to promote a political cause

ex.en: The posters were wartime propaganda designed to stir up hatred.
ex.zh: 這些海報是戰時用來煽動仇恨的宣傳品。

root.note: 應被傳播的東西 → 宣傳

senses.en: to spread an idea or belief widely
to grow new plants from a parent plant

ex.en: Gardeners can propagate roses from small cuttings.
ex.zh: 園丁可以用小段插枝繁殖玫瑰。

parts.m: set, fasten 插枝（拉丁文 propago）

root.note: 用插枝繁殖 → 繁殖、傳播

senses.en: to drive or push something forward
to cause someone to move into a situation

ex.en: A strong wind helped propel the sailboat across the lake.
ex.zh: 強風推動帆船駛過湖面。

root.note: 向前推 → 推進

senses.en: a fuel or gas used to push a rocket or spray from a can

ex.en: The rocket carries liquid oxygen as part of its propellant.
ex.zh: 這枚火箭攜帶液態氧作為推進劑的一部分。

root.note: 向前推的東西 → 推進劑

senses.en: a device with spinning blades that moves a ship or aircraft

ex.en: The small plane's propeller began to spin before takeoff.
ex.zh: 小飛機的螺旋槳在起飛前開始轉動。

root.note: 向前推的裝置 → 螺旋槳

senses.en: a prediction of what will happen in the future

ex.en: The old woman's prophecy about the flood came true.
ex.zh: 那位老婦人對洪水的預言成真了。

root.note: 事先說出 → 預言

mn: prophecy（名詞，唸 -sɪ）；prophesy（動詞，唸 -saɪ）。

senses.en: to say that something will happen in the future

ex.en: No one can prophesy exactly how technology will change our lives.
ex.zh: 沒有人能準確預言科技將如何改變我們的生活。

root.note: 事先說出 → 預言

senses.en: giving or indicating a good chance of success; favorable

ex.en: The calm weather made it a propitious time to set sail.
ex.zh: 平靜的天氣正是啟航的好時機。

parts.m: seek, go toward 趨向（拉丁文 petere）

root.note: 往好的方向前進 → 有利的

senses.en: corresponding in size or amount to something else

ex.en: The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.
ex.zh: 懲罰應該與罪行相稱。

root.note: 依份量分配的 → 成比例的

senses.en: correct social or moral behavior

ex.en: She always behaved with perfect propriety at formal dinners.
ex.zh: 她在正式晚宴上總是舉止得體。

root.note: 合乎本分 → 得體

senses.en: the action of driving or pushing forward

ex.en: Jet propulsion allows planes to fly much faster.
ex.zh: 噴射推進讓飛機飛得更快。

root.note: 向前推 → 推進

senses.en: lacking imagination or excitement; dull and ordinary

ex.en: The truth turned out to be far more prosaic than the rumors.
ex.zh: 事實原來比謠言平淡得多。

root.note: 像散文般平鋪直敘、沒有詩意 → 平淡的

senses.en: the part of a stage in front of the curtain, or the arch framing it

ex.en: The actors bowed beneath the gilded proscenium arch.
ex.zh: 演員們在鍍金的舞台拱門下鞠躬。

root.note: 舞台前面的部分

senses.en: to forbid, especially by law
to denounce or condemn

ex.en: The new rules proscribe the use of phones during class.
ex.zh: 新規定禁止上課時使用手機。

ex.en: The government decided to proscribe the extremist group.
ex.zh: 政府決定取締那個極端團體。

root.note: 古羅馬把罪犯名字公開寫出 → 禁止、放逐

mn: proscribe 是禁止；prescribe 是開處方、規定，只差一個字母意思相反。

senses.en: the act of forbidding something; a ban
the act of outlawing or exiling someone

ex.en: The proscription of certain books only made them more popular.
ex.zh: 禁止某些書反而讓它們更受歡迎。

root.note: 公開寫出名單 → 放逐、禁止

senses.en: a person who has converted from one religion, opinion, or party to another

ex.en: The new proselyte was eager to share his faith with everyone.
ex.zh: 那位新皈依的信徒急著把他的信仰分享給每個人。

root.note: 過來加入的人 → 皈依者

senses.en: the study of the rhythm and sound patterns of poetry
the patterns of stress and intonation in speech

ex.en: Our poetry class spent a week studying prosody and meter.
ex.zh: 我們的詩歌課花了一週研究韻律和格律。

root.note: 配合歌唱的音調 → 韻律

senses.en: a person who searches an area for gold, oil, or minerals

ex.en: The prospector spent years searching the hills for gold.
ex.zh: 那位探礦者花了好幾年在山中尋找黃金。

root.note: 往前看、尋找的人 → 探礦者

senses.en: a printed document describing a school, business, or investment
senses.zh: （學校、公司的）簡介；招股說明書

ex.en: Investors should read the prospectus carefully before buying shares.
ex.zh: 投資人在購買股票前應仔細閱讀公開說明書。

root.note: 讓人先看看的文件 → 簡介

senses.en: lying stretched out on the ground, face downward
completely overcome or exhausted
to lie face down, especially in worship or submission

ex.en: The exhausted runner lay prostrate on the grass after the race.
ex.zh: 那名精疲力竭的跑者賽後俯臥在草地上。

root.note: 向前整個攤平 → 俯臥的

mn: 別和 prostate（攝護腺）搞混，prostrate 多一個 r。

senses.en: the main character in a story, play, or film
a leading supporter of a cause

ex.en: The protagonist of the novel is a young girl searching for her father.
ex.zh: 這部小說的主角是一位尋找父親的年輕女孩。

root.note: 第一位演員 → 主角

senses.en: the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm

ex.en: Wear sunscreen for protection against harmful rays.
ex.zh: 擦防曬乳來防護有害的紫外線。

root.note: 在前面遮蓋 → 保護

senses.en: intended to protect someone or something
wanting to protect someone from harm

ex.en: Workers must wear protective gloves when handling chemicals.
ex.zh: 工人處理化學品時必須戴防護手套。

root.note: 在前面遮蓋的 → 保護的

senses.en: a person or thing that protects

ex.en: The older brother saw himself as his sister's protector.
ex.zh: 哥哥把自己當成妹妹的保護者。

root.note: 遮蓋保護的人或物

senses.en: a member of a Western Christian church separated from the Roman Catholic Church
relating to Protestants or their churches

ex.en: She was raised in a Protestant family in Scotland.
ex.zh: 她在蘇格蘭一個新教家庭長大。

root.note: 公開表示抗議（天主教會）的人 → 新教徒

senses.en: the official rules for behavior on formal occasions
a set of rules for a procedure or for exchanging data

ex.en: The hospital follows a strict protocol for treating infections.
ex.zh: 這家醫院依照嚴格的規程治療感染。

root.note: 黏在文件最前面的一頁 → 正式規範

senses.en: the first martyr of a cause or country

ex.en: Saint Stephen is traditionally called the protomartyr of Christianity.
ex.zh: 聖司提反傳統上被稱為基督教的第一位殉道者。

root.note: 第一位殉道者

senses.en: the living substance inside a cell

ex.en: Under the microscope, we could see the protoplasm moving inside the cell.
ex.zh: 在顯微鏡下，我們看得到細胞內的原生質在流動。

root.note: 最初形成的物質 → 原生質

senses.en: a first model of something from which other forms are developed

ex.en: The engineers tested a prototype of the new electric car.
ex.zh: 工程師測試了新款電動車的原型。

root.note: 第一個模型 → 原型

senses.en: to make something last longer than expected or necessary

ex.en: Lawyers on both sides tried to protract the trial.
ex.zh: 雙方律師都試圖拖延審判。

root.note: 往前拉長 → 延長

senses.en: to stick out from a surface

ex.en: Sharp rocks protrude from the water at low tide.
ex.zh: 退潮時，尖銳的岩石會突出水面。

root.note: 往前推出來 → 突出

senses.en: something that sticks out

ex.en: The climber grabbed a small protrusion in the rock wall.
ex.zh: 攀岩者抓住岩壁上一個小小的突出處。

root.note: 往前推出的東西 → 突出物

senses.en: a thing that bulges or swells out from a surface

ex.en: The doctor examined a small protuberance on the patient's wrist.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查病人手腕上的一個小隆起。

root.note: 往外腫起 → 隆起

senses.en: bulging or swelling outward

ex.en: The frog stared at us with its protuberant eyes.
ex.zh: 青蛙用牠凸出的眼睛盯著我們。

root.note: 往外腫起的 → 突出的

senses.en: to bulge or swell outward

ex.en: The tree roots began to protuberate through the old sidewalk.
ex.zh: 樹根開始從老舊的人行道下隆起。

root.note: 往外腫起 → 隆起

senses.en: a short, well-known saying that gives advice or states a truth

ex.en: An old proverb says, "Actions speak louder than words."
ex.zh: 一句古老的諺語說：「行動勝於空談。」

root.note: 廣為流傳的話 → 諺語

senses.en: making or showing careful preparation for the future

ex.en: Provident families put aside money for emergencies.
ex.zh: 有遠見的家庭會存錢以備急用。

root.note: 往前看的 → 有遠見的

senses.en: happening at a favorable time; lucky, as if arranged by God

ex.en: A providential rainstorm put out the forest fire.
ex.zh: 一場及時雨撲滅了森林大火。

root.note: 像天意安排的 → 幸運的

senses.en: relating to a province or region
narrow-minded or unsophisticated

ex.en: His provincial attitudes changed after he traveled abroad.
ex.zh: 他出國旅行後，狹隘的觀念改變了。

root.note: 地方省份的 → 見識不廣的

senses.en: a condition attached to an agreement

ex.en: He agreed to lend the car, with the proviso that she return it by noon.
ex.zh: 他同意借車，但條件是她要在中午前還回來。

root.note: 事先看好、說明的條件 → 但書

senses.en: an action or speech that makes someone angry, especially deliberately

ex.en: He lost his temper at the slightest provocation.
ex.zh: 他稍微被激一下就發脾氣。

root.note: 把人叫出來 → 挑釁

senses.en: skill or expertise in a particular activity
bravery in battle

ex.en: The team is known for its prowess on defense.
ex.zh: 這支球隊以強大的防守能力聞名。

parts.m: brave, valiant 英勇的（古法文 prou）

root.note: 英勇 → 高超的本領

senses.en: directly or immediately, as the nearest cause

ex.en: The fire was proximately caused by a faulty wire.
ex.zh: 這場火的直接原因是一條故障的電線。

root.note: 最接近地 → 直接地

senses.en: the authority to act or vote for another person, or the person given it
something used to represent or measure something else

ex.en: Since she could not attend, she voted by proxy.
ex.zh: 因為她無法出席，所以委託代理人投票。

root.note: 代理職務 → 代理人

senses.en: the quality of being careful and sensible about the future

ex.en: Financial prudence helped the family survive the recession.
ex.zh: 理財謹慎讓這個家庭撐過了經濟衰退。

parts.m: foresee 預見（拉丁文 providentia 的縮略）

root.note: 能預見未來 → 謹慎

senses.en: involving or showing care and forethought, especially in business
senses.zh: 審慎的；出於謹慎考量的

ex.en: The bank raised its reserves for prudential reasons.
ex.zh: 銀行基於審慎考量提高了準備金。

root.note: 謹慎的

senses.en: the quality of being easily shocked by matters relating to sex or nudity

ex.en: The film was banned in some places because of old-fashioned prudery.
ex.zh: 這部電影因為老派的假正經觀念而在某些地方被禁。

root.note: 拘謹過頭的態度

senses.en: having or encouraging too much interest in sexual matters

ex.en: The tabloid appealed to readers' prurient curiosity about celebrities.
ex.zh: 那份八卦小報迎合讀者對名人的窺淫好奇心。

root.note: 心癢難耐的 → 好色的

senses.en: a false apostle; one who falsely claims to be a messenger of a faith

ex.en: The early church warned believers against every pseudapostle who asked for money.
ex.zh: 早期教會警告信徒提防每個索討錢財的假使徒。

root.note: 假的使徒

senses.en: a false name used by an author or other person

ex.en: The author published her first novel under a pseudonym.
ex.zh: 這位作家用筆名出版了她的第一本小說。

root.note: 假的名字 → 筆名

mn: p 不發音，唸作 sudonim。

senses.en: the state of using a false name

ex.en: Online pseudonymity lets users speak freely without revealing their identity.
ex.zh: 網路上使用化名讓用戶可以自由發言而不暴露身分。

root.note: 用假名的狀態

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with mental illness

ex.en: After medical school, he chose to specialize in psychiatry.
ex.zh: 醫學院畢業後，他選擇專攻精神醫學。

root.note: 治療心靈的醫學

senses.en: relating to powers of the mind beyond natural laws, such as telepathy
a person claiming such powers
relating to the mind

ex.en: The psychic claimed she could read people's thoughts.
ex.zh: 那位靈媒聲稱她能讀出別人的想法。

root.note: 心靈的 → 通靈的

senses.en: having a mental disorder marked by a lack of empathy and antisocial behavior
senses.zh: 精神病態的；反社會人格的

ex.en: The movie's villain was a psychopathic genius with no sense of guilt.
ex.zh: 電影的反派是一個毫無罪惡感的精神病態天才。

root.note: 心靈有病的 → 精神病態的

senses.en: the treatment of mental disorders by talking rather than by medicine

ex.en: Psychotherapy helped her cope with anxiety.
ex.zh: 心理治療幫助她應對焦慮。

root.note: 治療心靈

senses.en: slightly fat; chubby

ex.en: The baby reached for the toy with pudgy little hands.
ex.zh: 嬰兒用胖嘟嘟的小手去抓玩具。

senses.en: childishly silly and immature

ex.en: The comedian's puerile jokes did not amuse the adult audience.
ex.zh: 那位喜劇演員幼稚的笑話沒能逗樂成年觀眾。

root.note: 像小孩的 → 幼稚的

senses.en: eager or quick to argue, quarrel, or fight

ex.en: The pugnacious senator attacked every proposal from the other party.
ex.zh: 那位好鬥的參議員攻擊對方政黨的每一項提案。

root.note: 愛打架的 → 好鬥的

mn: pug 是鬥牛犬般的「狗臉」，聯想愛打架的樣子。

senses.en: having great power or influence (archaic)

ex.en: The puissant king commanded the largest army in Europe.
ex.zh: 那位強大的國王統領著歐洲最大的軍隊。

parts.m: be able 能夠（古法文 poeir）

root.note: 有能力的 → 強大的

senses.en: relating to the lungs

ex.en: Smoking greatly increases the risk of pulmonary disease.
ex.zh: 吸菸會大幅增加肺部疾病的風險。

root.note: 肺的

senses.en: showing great attention to details of correct behavior or procedure
senses.zh: 一絲不苟的；拘泥細節的

ex.en: She is punctilious about answering every email within a day.
ex.zh: 她一絲不苟，每封電子郵件都在一天內回覆。

root.note: 連每個小點都注意 → 一絲不苟

senses.en: happening or doing something at the agreed time

ex.en: Please be punctual, because the bus will leave at eight sharp.
ex.zh: 請準時，因為巴士八點整就會出發。

root.note: 在準確的時間點 → 準時的

senses.en: a strong, sharp taste or smell
sharpness or bite in speech or writing

ex.en: The pungency of the garlic filled the whole kitchen.
ex.zh: 大蒜的刺鼻氣味瀰漫整個廚房。

root.note: 刺激人的性質 → 辛辣

senses.en: having a strong, sharp taste or smell
(of remarks) sharply critical

ex.en: A pungent smell of vinegar came from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房傳來一股刺鼻的醋味。

root.note: 刺激鼻子的 → 刺鼻的（poignant 同源）

senses.en: intended as punishment
(of taxes or costs) extremely high

ex.en: The court ordered the company to pay punitive damages.
ex.zh: 法院判決該公司支付懲罰性賠償金。

root.note: 懲罰用的

senses.en: the state or period of being a pupil or apprentice

ex.en: During his pupilage, the young lawyer followed a senior barrister to court.
ex.zh: 見習期間，這位年輕律師跟著資深律師出庭。

root.note: 當學生的時期

senses.en: (in Catholic belief) a place where souls are purified before entering heaven
a place or state of temporary suffering

ex.en: Waiting for the test results felt like purgatory.
ex.zh: 等待檢查結果的感覺就像在煉獄受煎熬。

root.note: 淨化靈魂的地方 → 煉獄

senses.en: (of a stream) to flow with a soft murmuring sound
a knitting stitch made in reverse

ex.en: We could hear the brook purl over the stones.
ex.zh: 我們聽得見小溪在石頭上潺潺流過。

senses.en: to steal something, often something small

ex.en: Someone managed to purloin the answer key from the teacher's desk.
ex.zh: 有人設法從老師的桌上偷走了答案卷。

root.note: 把東西拿到遠處 → 偷竊

senses.en: to claim to be or do something, often falsely
[ˋpɝport] the general meaning of something

ex.en: The ads purport to show a cure for baldness, but the evidence is weak.
ex.zh: 那些廣告號稱能治好禿頭，但證據很薄弱。

root.note: 向外帶出的意思 → 聲稱、大意

senses.en: a person or company that supplies goods or services
a person who spreads an idea or view

ex.en: The shop is a purveyor of fine cheeses from around the world.
ex.zh: 這家店供應來自世界各地的優質起司。

root.note: 事先預備、照料所需的人 → 供應商

senses.en: showing a lack of courage; cowardly

ex.en: The critics called the mayor's pusillanimous response a failure of leadership.
ex.zh: 批評者說市長懦弱的回應是領導上的失敗。

root.note: 精神很小的 → 膽小的

senses.en: becoming rotten; decaying

ex.en: A putrescent smell rose from the garbage left in the sun.
ex.zh: 曬在太陽底下的垃圾發出腐臭味。

root.note: 開始腐爛的

senses.en: a pile of wood for burning a dead body during a funeral

ex.en: The warrior's body was placed on a funeral pyre.
ex.zh: 那位戰士的遺體被放在火葬柴堆上。

root.note: 用來燒的火堆

senses.en: an uncontrollable urge to set things on fire

ex.en: The arsonist was diagnosed with pyromania.
ex.zh: 那名縱火犯被診斷出患有縱火癖。

root.note: 對火的狂熱 → 縱火狂

senses.en: relating to fireworks
brilliantly showy, especially in skill

ex.en: The festival ended with a pyrotechnic display over the harbor.
ex.zh: 節慶在港口上空的煙火表演中落幕。

root.note: 用火的技藝 → 煙火的

senses.en: a small container in which consecrated bread for Communion is kept
a box at a mint where sample coins are kept for testing

ex.en: The priest carried the pyx to the sick woman's home.
ex.zh: 神父帶著聖體盒前往那位生病婦人的家。

root.note: 盒子 → 聖體盒

senses.en: dishonest practices and claims of fake medical skill

ex.en: Doctors warned that the miracle diet pill was pure quackery.
ex.zh: 醫生警告，那種神奇減肥藥根本是江湖騙術。

root.note: 庸醫的行為

senses.en: square or roughly square
a square or rectangular object or bone

ex.en: The quadrate stones were cut to fit together perfectly.
ex.zh: 這些方形石塊被切割得能完美拼合。

root.note: 四邊的 → 方形的

senses.en: to increase or be increased four times
consisting of four parts; four times as great

ex.en: The company expects its profits to quadruple within five years.
ex.zh: 公司預期五年內獲利會成長為四倍。

root.note: 四倍

senses.en: a degree, skill, or quality that makes someone suitable for a job
a statement that limits or changes another statement

ex.en: A teaching qualification is required for this position.
ex.zh: 這個職位需要教師資格。

ex.en: She agreed with the plan without qualification.
ex.zh: 她毫無保留地同意了這個計畫。

parts.m: of what kind 什麼樣的

root.note: 使成為某種人 → 資格；使帶有某種性質 → 限制

senses.en: to meet the necessary standard or conditions
to limit or add to a statement to make it less absolute

ex.en: You must be over eighteen to qualify for the loan.
ex.zh: 你必須年滿十八歲才符合貸款資格。

parts.m: of what kind 什麼樣的

root.note: 使成為合適的樣子 → 取得資格

senses.en: an uneasy feeling of doubt or worry about whether one is doing the right thing

ex.en: He had no qualm about telling the boss what he really thought.
ex.zh: 他毫不猶豫地告訴老闆他的真實想法。

mn: l 不發音，唸 kwɑm；常用 have no qualms about...。

senses.en: a state of uncertainty about what to do in a difficult situation

ex.en: Offered two great jobs, she was in a quandary about which to choose.
ex.zh: 兩份好工作同時找上門，她不知道該選哪一個。

senses.en: an amount or number of something

ex.en: The restaurant cares more about quality than quantity.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳重質不重量。

root.note: 有多少 → 數量

senses.en: a period of isolation to prevent the spread of disease
to put a person or animal in isolation

ex.en: Travelers had to stay in quarantine for two weeks.
ex.zh: 旅客必須隔離兩週。

parts.m: forty 四十（義大利文 quaranta）

root.note: 原指船隻需隔離四十天 → 隔離

senses.en: tending to argue or fight

ex.en: The quarrelsome neighbors argued about the fence every week.
ex.zh: 那對愛吵架的鄰居每週都在為圍籬吵架。

root.note: 傾向爭吵的

senses.en: one of four equal parts
a district or area of a town
mercy shown to an enemy

ex.en: We will meet at a quarter past three.
ex.zh: 我們三點十五分見面。

root.note: 四分之一

mn: give no quarter：毫不留情。

senses.en: happening or produced every three months
a magazine published four times a year

ex.en: The company will release its quarterly report next week.
ex.zh: 公司下週將公布季度報告。

root.note: 每季的

senses.en: a group of four musicians or singers, or a piece written for them
a set of four people or things

ex.en: A string quartet played during the wedding dinner.
ex.zh: 婚宴上有一組弦樂四重奏演出。

root.note: 四人的小組

senses.en: a book size made by folding a printed sheet twice to form four leaves

ex.en: Several of Shakespeare's plays were first printed in quarto.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞有幾部劇本最初是以四開本印行的。

parts.m: fourth 第四（拉丁文 in quarto）

root.note: 一張紙摺成四頁 → 四開本

senses.en: a stone or metal platform along the water where ships load and unload

ex.en: Fishermen unloaded their catch onto the quay at dawn.
ex.zh: 漁夫們在黎明時把漁獲卸到碼頭上。

mn: 拼法怪但唸 [ki]，跟 key 同音。

senses.en: complaining in a whining or irritable way

ex.en: The querulous passenger complained about everything from the seats to the snacks.
ex.zh: 那位愛抱怨的乘客從座位抱怨到點心。

root.note: 一直抱怨的

mn: 別跟 query（詢問）搞混：querulous 是愛抱怨，不是愛發問。

senses.en: a question, especially one expressing doubt
to ask a question about something, often to express doubt

ex.en: If you have any query about your bill, please call our office.
ex.zh: 如果你對帳單有任何疑問，請打電話到我們辦公室。

parts.m: ask, seek 詢問（拉丁文 quaerere）

root.note: 詢問

senses.en: a line of people or vehicles waiting their turn
to wait in a line

ex.en: There was a long queue outside the new bakery.
ex.zh: 新開的麵包店外面排了一條長長的隊伍。

root.note: 像尾巴一樣長長一串 → 隊伍

mn: 後面四個字母 ueue 都不發音，整個字唸起來就是字母 Q。

senses.en: to argue or object about a trivial matter
a minor objection or criticism

ex.en: Let's not quibble over a few dollars.
ex.zh: 我們別為了幾塊錢斤斤計較。

senses.en: a state of inactivity or rest

ex.en: After years of quiescence, the volcano suddenly erupted.
ex.zh: 沉寂多年後，這座火山突然噴發了。

root.note: 安靜下來的狀態 → 靜止

senses.en: in a state of inactivity or dormancy

ex.en: The disease can remain quiescent for years before symptoms appear.
ex.zh: 這種疾病可能潛伏多年才出現症狀。

root.note: 安靜下來的 → 靜止的

senses.en: making little or no noise
calm, peaceful, and without much activity
absence of noise or disturbance

ex.en: Please keep quiet while the baby is sleeping.
ex.zh: 寶寶在睡覺時請保持安靜。

mn: quiet（安靜的，兩音節）、quite（相當，一音節）、quit（放棄）要分清楚。

senses.en: death, or something that causes death or ends something
release from life or duty

ex.en: The new evidence gave the old rumor its quietus.
ex.zh: 新證據讓那個舊謠言徹底平息。

root.note: 得到安息 → 死亡、了結

senses.en: the most perfect or typical example of something

ex.en: The little café was the quintessence of Parisian charm.
ex.zh: 那家小咖啡館是巴黎風情的典型代表。

root.note: 古人認為四元素之外的第五元素最純粹 → 精髓

senses.en: a group of five musicians or singers, or a piece written for them
a group of five people or things

ex.en: A jazz quintet played at the hotel bar every Friday.
ex.zh: 每週五都有一組爵士五重奏在飯店酒吧演出。

root.note: 五人的小組

senses.en: to a certain or fairly significant extent
completely; entirely

ex.en: The movie was quite good, but a little too long.
ex.zh: 這部電影還不錯，但有點太長。

senses.en: extremely idealistic and romantic but unrealistic or impractical
senses.zh: 唐吉訶德式的；不切實際的理想主義的

ex.en: His quixotic plan to end world hunger by himself inspired but worried his friends.
ex.zh: 他想憑一己之力終結世界飢餓的不切實際計畫，讓朋友們既感動又擔心。

root.note: 像唐吉訶德一樣挑戰風車 → 不切實際的理想主義

senses.en: having extreme or fanatical views
(of an animal) having rabies

ex.en: He is a rabid baseball fan who never misses a game.
ex.zh: 他是個從不錯過任何比賽的狂熱棒球迷。

parts.m: rage, madness 瘋狂（拉丁文 rabere）

root.note: 發狂的 → 狂熱的；狂犬病的

senses.en: lively, entertaining, and slightly shocking, especially sexually
(of a car or style) designed to look fast

ex.en: The novel was considered racy when it was first published.
ex.zh: 這本小說剛出版時被認為內容有點大膽。

senses.en: light or heat given off by something
great joy or beauty shown in someone's face

ex.en: The bride's face glowed with radiance as she walked down the aisle.
ex.zh: 新娘走過紅毯時容光煥發。

root.note: 發出光線 → 光輝

senses.en: to send out light, heat, or energy
to clearly show a feeling or quality
to spread out from a central point

ex.en: She seemed to radiate confidence when she walked on stage.
ex.zh: 她走上舞台時似乎散發著自信。

root.note: 發出光線 → 放射

senses.en: affecting the fundamental nature of something; thorough
favoring extreme political or social change
a person with extreme political views

ex.en: The new principal made radical changes to the school schedule.
ex.zh: 新校長對學校課表做了徹底的改變。

root.note: 觸及根本的 → 根本的、激進的

senses.en: (mathematics) the base of a number system
a root or source

ex.en: The decimal system uses a radix of ten.
ex.zh: 十進位系統以十為基數。

root.note: 根 → 基數

senses.en: good-humored teasing

ex.en: The old friends exchanged gentle raillery over dinner.
ex.zh: 老朋友們在晚餐時互相打趣。

root.note: 開玩笑地嘲弄 → 揶揄

senses.en: to form branches or spread out into parts

ex.en: Small decisions can ramify into consequences no one expected.
ex.zh: 小小的決定可能衍生出沒人預料到的後果。

root.note: 長出枝條 → 分支（ramification 後果同源）

senses.en: having many branches

ex.en: The botanist sketched the ramose coral she found on the reef.
ex.zh: 那位植物學家畫下她在礁石上發現的多分枝珊瑚。

root.note: 很多枝條的

senses.en: (of something bad) spreading or flourishing without control
(of plants) growing wildly

ex.en: Corruption was rampant in the old government.
ex.zh: 貪腐在舊政府裡十分猖獗。

parts.m: climb, rear up 攀爬、直立（古法文 ramper）

root.note: 像猛獸般直立起來 → 猖獗的

senses.en: a defensive wall of a castle or city, with a broad top
a protective barrier

ex.en: Soldiers stood guard on the rampart of the old fort.
ex.zh: 士兵們在舊堡壘的城牆上站崗。

senses.en: bitter, long-lasting resentment

ex.en: She spoke of her former business partner without rancor.
ex.zh: 她談起從前的合夥人時毫無怨恨。

parts.m: rancid, rotten 腐臭的（拉丁文 rancere）

root.note: 心裡的東西發臭 → 怨恨

senses.en: (of a memory or comment) to cause lasting annoyance or bitterness
senses.zh: 使耿耿於懷；使一直不舒服

ex.en: The unfair criticism continued to rankle him for weeks.
ex.zh: 那次不公平的批評讓他耿耿於懷好幾個星期。

senses.en: aggressively greedy

ex.en: Rapacious developers cut down the forest to build luxury homes.
ex.zh: 貪婪的開發商砍掉森林來蓋豪宅。

root.note: 一直想抓取的 → 貪婪的

senses.en: happening in a short time; fast
(rapids) a part of a river where water flows fast

ex.en: The city has seen rapid growth over the past decade.
ex.zh: 這座城市在過去十年快速成長。

root.note: 一把抓走般迅速的

senses.en: the violent seizure of property; plunder

ex.en: The chronicle describes years of war and rapine in the region.
ex.zh: 這部編年史描述了該地區多年的戰亂與掠奪。

root.note: 強行奪取 → 掠奪

senses.en: completely fascinated or absorbed by what one is seeing or hearing

ex.en: The children listened with rapt attention to the story.
ex.zh: 孩子們全神貫注地聽故事。

parts.m: seized, carried away 被抓走的

root.note: 心被抓走了 → 入迷的

mn: 和 wrapped 同音：被故事緊緊「包住」，所以聽得入迷。

senses.en: (of a bird or animal) predatory; adapted for seizing prey
senses.zh: 猛禽的；適於捕捉獵物的

ex.en: The mantis uses its raptorial front legs to catch insects.
ex.zh: 螳螂用適於捕捉的前腳抓昆蟲。

root.note: 捕食者的 → 猛禽的

senses.en: a fixed amount of food or other goods allowed to each person
to limit the amount of something each person can have

ex.en: During the drought, the town had to ration water.
ex.zh: 乾旱期間，鎮上必須限量供水。

root.note: 計算好的份量 → 配給量

senses.en: the belief that reason, rather than experience or religion, is the main source of knowledge

ex.en: Descartes is often seen as a founder of modern rationalism.
ex.zh: 笛卡兒常被視為現代理性主義的奠基者之一。

root.note: 以理性為本的主義

senses.en: making a harsh, loud, and disturbing noise

ex.en: The raucous party next door kept us awake all night.
ex.zh: 隔壁喧鬧的派對讓我們整晚睡不著。

root.note: 沙啞刺耳的 → 喧鬧的

senses.en: to cause severe damage to something
(ravages) the destructive effects of something

ex.en: Wildfires continue to ravage the dry hills every summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天野火持續摧殘乾燥的山丘。

parts.m: seize, carry off 奪走（拉丁文 rapere）

root.note: 強行奪取 → 破壞

senses.en: extremely hungry
very eager or greedy

ex.en: After hiking all day, we were ravenous.
ex.zh: 健行了一整天後，我們餓壞了。

parts.m: seize, plunder 掠奪（古法文 raviner）

root.note: 像掠奪一樣吃 → 極餓的

senses.en: a deep, narrow valley with steep sides

ex.en: A rope bridge crosses the deep ravine.
ex.zh: 一座吊橋橫跨那道深谷。

parts.m: violent rush of water 急流（法文）

root.note: 急流沖刷出的溝 → 峽谷

senses.en: something done or felt in response to something
a chemical process in which substances change

ex.en: Her first reaction to the news was shock.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息的第一個反應是震驚。

root.note: 回過來做 → 反應

senses.en: opposing political or social change and wanting a return to the past
a person with such views

ex.en: The reactionary leader tried to undo every reform of the past decade.
ex.zh: 那位守舊的領導人試圖推翻過去十年的所有改革。

root.note: 反對（進步）的 → 反動的

senses.en: without hesitation; willingly
without difficulty; easily

ex.en: Fresh vegetables are readily available at the market.
ex.zh: 市場上很容易買到新鮮蔬菜。

root.note: 隨時準備好地 → 爽快地、容易地

senses.en: to adapt again to a changed situation
to change the position or setting of something again

ex.en: It took her months to readjust to life at home after studying abroad.
ex.zh: 留學回來後，她花了好幾個月才重新適應家裡的生活。

root.note: 再次調整

senses.en: fully prepared for something
willing or quick to do something

ex.en: Are you ready to leave for the airport?
ex.zh: 你準備好出發去機場了嗎？

senses.en: the attitude of accepting a situation as it is and dealing with it practically
the style of representing things accurately in art and literature

ex.en: The painter was praised for the realism of her portraits.
ex.zh: 這位畫家的肖像畫因寫實而受到讚賞。

root.note: 重視真實的主義 → 現實主義、寫實主義

senses.en: to change the position, order, or time of something

ex.en: We decided to rearrange the furniture in the living room.
ex.zh: 我們決定重新擺放客廳的家具。

root.note: 再次安排

senses.en: to say or do something to remove someone's fears or doubts

ex.en: The pilot tried to reassure the passengers during the turbulence.
ex.zh: 機長試著在亂流中讓乘客安心。

root.note: 再次保證 → 使安心

senses.en: showing a desire to resist authority or rules

ex.en: As a rebellious teenager, he dyed his hair green.
ex.zh: 還是個叛逆少年時，他把頭髮染成綠色。

root.note: 再度發動戰爭 → 反叛的

senses.en: to reject an offer, request, or friendly gesture in a rude way
a rude rejection

ex.en: She chose to rebuff every offer of help from her rivals.
ex.zh: 她選擇拒絕對手提供的每一次幫助。

senses.en: to build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed

ex.en: It took the town ten years to rebuild after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後，這個小鎮花了十年才重建完成。

root.note: 再次建造

senses.en: to prove that a statement or accusation is false

ex.en: The lawyer presented new evidence to rebut the witness's claims.
ex.zh: 律師提出新證據來反駁證人的說法。

parts.m: strike, push 推、撞（古法文 boter）

root.note: 推回去 → 反駁

senses.en: to say publicly that one no longer holds a former opinion or belief
senses.zh: 公開撤回（聲明）；改變信仰

ex.en: The witness was pressured to recant her testimony.
ex.zh: 那名證人被迫撤回她的證詞。

root.note: 把唱過的收回來 → 撤回

senses.en: to summarize and state again the main points

ex.en: Let me recapitulate the main ideas before we finish.
ex.zh: 結束前讓我再扼要重述一下重點。

root.note: 再把標題重點說一遍 → 扼要重述（recap 是縮寫）

senses.en: to capture a person or animal that has escaped
to experience or bring back a past feeling

ex.en: The film tries to recapture the magic of the original.
ex.zh: 這部電影試圖重現原作的魅力。

root.note: 再次捕獲

senses.en: to move back or further away
to become smaller or weaker

ex.en: We waited for the flood waters to recede.
ex.zh: 我們等待洪水退去。

root.note: 往回走 → 後退

mn: receding hairline：髮線後退。

senses.en: (of a bill or money) waiting to be paid
(receivables) money owed to a business

ex.en: The accountant checked all the accounts receivable at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 會計在月底核對了所有應收帳款。

root.note: 可以收到的 → 應收的

senses.en: willing to consider new ideas or suggestions

ex.en: The manager was receptive to our ideas for improving the office.
ex.zh: 經理很樂意接受我們改善辦公室的想法。

root.note: 願意收下的 → 樂於接受的

senses.en: (of a gene) appearing only when inherited from both parents
tending to recede or withdraw

ex.en: Blue eyes are caused by a recessive gene.
ex.zh: 藍眼睛是由隱性基因造成的。

root.note: 退到後面的 → 隱性的

senses.en: a convicted criminal who repeatedly commits crimes

ex.en: The program aims to keep a released prisoner from becoming a recidivist.
ex.zh: 這項計畫旨在防止出獄者成為累犯。

root.note: 又跌回去的人 → 累犯

senses.en: given or done in return; mutual
(mathematics) the number 1 divided by a given number

ex.en: The two countries signed a reciprocal trade agreement.
ex.zh: 兩國簽署了互惠貿易協定。

root.note: 來來回回 → 相互的

senses.en: to respond to an action or feeling with a similar one

ex.en: She helped me move, so I offered to reciprocate next month.
ex.zh: 她幫我搬家，所以我提議下個月回報她。

root.note: 來回互相給予 → 回報

senses.en: the practice of exchanging things with others for mutual benefit

ex.en: Friendship is built on reciprocity and trust.
ex.zh: 友誼建立在互惠與信任之上。

root.note: 來回交換 → 互惠

senses.en: the act of saying a poem or text aloud from memory
a detailed spoken list of facts

ex.en: Her recitation of the long poem impressed the whole class.
ex.zh: 她背誦那首長詩讓全班都很佩服。

root.note: 再次把文字喚出來 → 背誦

senses.en: to pay attention to or care about (archaic)

ex.en: The proud knight did not reck the danger ahead.
ex.zh: 那位驕傲的騎士毫不在意前方的危險。

mn: 現代英文幾乎只剩 reckless（不在意後果的 → 魯莽的）還看得到它。

senses.en: acting without thinking about the danger or consequences

ex.en: He lost his license for reckless driving.
ex.zh: 他因為魯莽駕駛被吊銷駕照。

root.note: 不在意後果 → 魯莽的

senses.en: to get back something that was lost or taken
to make wasteland or land under water usable

ex.en: Passengers can reclaim their luggage at carousel five.
ex.zh: 旅客可以在五號轉盤領取行李。

root.note: 喊著要回來 → 取回

senses.en: to lean or lie back in a relaxed position

ex.en: You can recline your seat once the plane has taken off.
ex.zh: 飛機起飛後，你就可以把椅背往後調。

root.note: 往後傾 → 斜倚

senses.en: a person who lives alone and avoids other people

ex.en: The famous writer became a recluse and rarely left his cabin.
ex.zh: 那位知名作家變成隱士，很少離開他的小屋。

root.note: 把自己關起來 → 隱士

senses.en: a place where a recluse lives; a hermitage

ex.en: The monk spent forty years in a small reclusory in the mountains.
ex.zh: 那位修士在山中一間小小的隱居處住了四十年。

root.note: 隱士住的地方

senses.en: a legal promise made to a court to appear when required or to keep the peace

ex.en: The judge released the defendant on his own recognizance.
ex.zh: 法官讓被告以自己具結的方式獲釋。

root.note: 在法庭上承認、保證 → 具結

senses.en: to identify someone or something seen before
to accept or acknowledge that something is true or valid

ex.en: I did not recognize her with her new haircut.
ex.zh: 她剪了新髮型，我都認不出來了。

root.note: 再次知道 → 認出

senses.en: to suddenly move back in fear, horror, or disgust
(of a gun) to move backward when fired
the backward movement of a gun when fired

ex.en: She tends to recoil at the sight of spiders.
ex.zh: 她一看到蜘蛛就會往後縮。

root.note: 屁股往後退 → 退縮

senses.en: to remember something

ex.en: I can't recollect where I put my keys.
ex.zh: 我想不起來把鑰匙放在哪裡了。

root.note: 把記憶重新收集起來 → 回想

senses.en: able to be made consistent or brought into agreement

ex.en: Are economic growth and environmental protection reconcilable?
ex.zh: 經濟成長和環境保護可以兼顧嗎？

root.note: 可以再度和好的 → 可調和的

senses.en: to make a military observation of an area to gain information

ex.en: The captain sent two scouts to reconnoiter the enemy camp.
ex.zh: 上尉派了兩名偵察兵去偵察敵營。

root.note: 去重新認識地形 → 偵察（recon 是縮寫）

senses.en: to think again about a decision, especially in order to change it

ex.en: Please reconsider your decision to quit the team.
ex.zh: 請重新考慮你退出球隊的決定。

root.note: 再次考慮

senses.en: to build again after damage or destruction
to form an idea of a past event from evidence

ex.en: Police tried to reconstruct the events leading up to the crash.
ex.zh: 警方試圖還原車禍發生前的經過。

root.note: 再次建造 → 重建

senses.en: a source of help in a difficult situation
the use of something as a means of help

ex.en: Without a contract, the workers had no legal recourse.
ex.zh: 沒有合約，工人們在法律上求助無門。

parts.m: run 跑（在這個字裡拼成 cours）

root.note: 跑回去求助 → 求助的對象

senses.en: to return to a normal state of health or strength
to get back something lost or stolen

ex.en: It took him three weeks to recover from the flu.
ex.zh: 他花了三個星期才從流感中康復。

root.note: 把失去的取回 → 恢復

senses.en: cowardly; unfaithful to a duty or belief (archaic)
a coward or traitor

ex.en: The recreant knight fled the battle and abandoned his king.
ex.zh: 那個懦弱的騎士臨陣脫逃，拋棄了他的國王。

root.note: 收回誓言、背棄信仰 → 不忠的、懦弱的

senses.en: to make something again or reproduce it
[ˋrɛkrɪˏet] to refresh oneself through play or leisure

ex.en: The museum tried to recreate a typical Victorian kitchen.
ex.zh: 博物館試著重現典型的維多利亞時代廚房。

root.note: 再次創造 → 再現

senses.en: a return of something bad, such as a disease, after a period of inactivity

ex.en: Doctors feared a recrudescence of the fever in the spring.
ex.zh: 醫生擔心發燒在春天會復發。

root.note: 傷口再度流血 → 復發

senses.en: breaking out again after a period of inactivity

ex.en: Health officials tracked the recrudescent outbreak closely.
ex.zh: 衛生官員密切追蹤這波再度爆發的疫情。

root.note: 再度流血的 → 復發的

senses.en: to get someone to join a company, army, or group
a newly enlisted person

ex.en: The club hopes to recruit twenty new members this year.
ex.zh: 社團希望今年能招募二十名新成員。

root.note: 使（軍隊）再成長 → 招募

senses.en: to correct something that is wrong

ex.en: The company promised to rectify the billing error immediately.
ex.zh: 公司承諾立刻更正帳單錯誤。

root.note: 使變直、變正確 → 糾正

senses.en: morally correct behavior; honesty

ex.en: The senator was admired for his moral rectitude.
ex.zh: 那位參議員因道德上的正直而受人敬佩。

root.note: 行為筆直 → 正直

senses.en: to recover from illness or exhaustion
to get back money or losses

ex.en: She went to the countryside to recuperate after surgery.
ex.zh: 她手術後到鄉下休養。

parts.m: get, take 拿（拉丁文 capere）

root.note: 把健康拿回來 → 復原

senses.en: to happen again, especially repeatedly

ex.en: If the pain should recur, call your doctor.
ex.zh: 如果疼痛再次發生，請打給你的醫生。

root.note: 再跑回來 → 再發生

senses.en: to cure or heal again; to recover (archaic)

ex.en: In the old tale, only a magic herb could recure the wounded prince.
ex.zh: 在古老的故事裡，只有一種神奇草藥能治好受傷的王子。

root.note: 再次治療 → 治癒

senses.en: happening often or repeatedly

ex.en: Loneliness is a recurrent theme in her novels.
ex.zh: 孤獨是她小說中反覆出現的主題。

root.note: 一再跑回來的 → 反覆發生的

senses.en: the act of saving or being saved from sin or evil
the act of exchanging something for money or goods

ex.en: The film is a story of redemption about a man who rebuilds his life.
ex.zh: 這部電影講述一個男人重建人生的救贖故事。

root.note: 買回來 → 贖回、救贖

senses.en: a pleasant, strong smell

ex.en: The redolence of fresh bread filled the little shop.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香氣瀰漫整間小店。

root.note: 散發出氣味 → 芬芳

senses.en: strongly reminiscent or suggestive of something
strongly smelling of something

ex.en: The old house was redolent of my grandmother's cooking.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子讓我想起祖母做菜的味道。

root.note: 散發氣味的 → 芬芳、令人聯想的

mn: 常見用法 be redolent of：充滿…的氣息、令人想起…。

senses.en: formidable, especially as an opponent; worthy of respect or fear
senses.zh: 令人敬畏的；可怕的（對手）

ex.en: She faced a redoubtable opponent in the chess final.
ex.zh: 她在西洋棋決賽中碰上一位令人畏懼的對手。

root.note: 非常值得害怕的 → 令人敬畏的

senses.en: to contribute to or have an effect on someone's credit or advantage
to come back upon someone as a result

ex.en: Her success will redound to the credit of the whole school.
ex.zh: 她的成功會為全校增光。

parts.m: wave, surge 波浪（拉丁文 unda）

root.note: 浪潮湧回來 → 影響回到某人身上

senses.en: to correct an unfair situation
money or action given to make up for a wrong

ex.en: The new law aims to redress the balance between workers and employers.
ex.zh: 新法旨在矯正勞資之間的失衡。

parts.m: set straight 擺正（古法文 dresser）

root.note: 再擺正 → 糾正

senses.en: able to be reduced or simplified to a smaller or simpler form
senses.zh: 可簡化的；可歸納的；可減少的

ex.en: Human behavior is not simply reducible to a few rules.
ex.zh: 人類行為不能單純簡化成幾條規則。

root.note: 可以帶回更簡單的形式 → 可簡化的

senses.en: the state of being more than needed; unnecessary repetition (usually redundancy)

ex.en: The editor cut every redundance from the long essay.
ex.zh: 編輯把長文中所有冗贅的地方都刪掉了。

root.note: 一直湧出 → 過多

senses.en: not needed; more than necessary
(British) no longer employed because the job is not needed

ex.en: The phrase "free gift" is redundant because all gifts are free.
ex.zh: free gift 這個詞是多餘的，因為禮物本來就是免費的。

root.note: 一直湧出來、過多的 → 多餘的

senses.en: to establish something again, such as a relationship or system

ex.en: The two countries hope to reestablish diplomatic relations.
ex.zh: 兩國希望恢復邦交。

root.note: 再次建立

senses.en: to mention or talk about someone or something
to look at something for information
to send someone to another person or place for help

ex.en: You may refer to your notes during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試時你可以查閱筆記。

root.note: 帶回去（給某人、某資料）→ 提及、參考

senses.en: able to be attributed or assigned to something

ex.en: The symptoms were referable to a problem in the spine.
ex.zh: 這些症狀可以歸因於脊椎的問題。

root.note: 可以歸於某處的

senses.en: an official who makes sure players follow the rules in a game
a person who gives a reference for a job applicant
to act as a referee

ex.en: The referee blew the whistle to stop the game.
ex.zh: 裁判吹哨停止比賽。

root.note: 爭議被提交給他的人 → 裁判

senses.en: a person or thing that refers someone to another, such as a website that sends visitors
senses.zh: 推薦者；轉介者；（網站）來源頁

ex.en: Each new customer's referrer receives a small discount.
ex.zh: 每位新顧客的推薦人都能得到一點折扣。

root.note: 轉介的人或來源

senses.en: a factory where substances such as oil or sugar are purified

ex.en: The oil refinery employs over a thousand workers.
ex.zh: 這座煉油廠僱用了超過一千名員工。

root.note: 把東西弄得更純的地方 → 精煉廠

senses.en: able to be reflected

ex.en: Only reflectible light can be seen bouncing off the mirror.
ex.zh: 只有可反射的光才能看到從鏡子上反彈出來。

root.note: 可以彎回去的 → 可反射的

senses.en: an image seen in a mirror or on a shiny surface
serious thought or consideration
a sign or result of something

ex.en: She saw her reflection in the calm lake.
ex.zh: 她在平靜的湖面上看到自己的倒影。

root.note: 光線彎回來 → 反射、倒影；思緒回轉 → 反省

senses.en: a piece of glass, metal, or plastic that reflects light

ex.en: Put a reflector on your bike so drivers can see you at night.
ex.zh: 在腳踏車上裝反光片，這樣晚上駕駛才看得到你。

root.note: 把光彎回去的東西

senses.en: capable of being reflected or bent back

ex.en: Early scientists debated whether heat rays were reflexible like light.
ex.zh: 早期科學家爭論熱射線是否像光一樣可以反射。

root.note: 可以彎回去的

senses.en: to make changes in something in order to improve it
a change made to improve something
to improve one's behavior

ex.en: Many people agree that we need to reform the tax system.
ex.zh: 許多人同意我們需要改革稅制。

root.note: 重新塑形 → 改革

senses.en: a person who works to make changes in society or politics

ex.en: The young reformer fought to improve conditions in city schools.
ex.zh: 這位年輕的改革者努力改善城市學校的狀況。

root.note: 推動改革的人

senses.en: (of water, glass, etc.) to make light change direction as it passes through

ex.en: A prism can refract white light into a rainbow of colors.
ex.zh: 稜鏡能把白光折射成彩虹般的顏色。

root.note: 把光打斷、轉彎 → 折射

senses.en: stubborn and difficult to control
(of a disease) not responding to treatment
resistant to heat

ex.en: The refractory mule refused to move another step.
ex.zh: 那頭倔強的騾子一步也不肯再走。

root.note: 打破（規矩）、頂回去 → 倔強的

senses.en: able to be refuted or disproved

ex.en: Even the professor admitted that her theory was refragable.
ex.zh: 就連教授也承認她的理論是可以被反駁的。

parts.m: vote, oppose 投票、反對（拉丁文 refragari）

root.note: 可以投反對票的 → 可反駁的

mn: 反義字 irrefragable（無可辯駁的）比較常見。

senses.en: the power of refracting light

ex.en: Diamond has a very high refringency, which makes it sparkle.
ex.zh: 鑽石的折射力很高，所以閃閃發光。

root.note: 使光折斷轉彎的能力 → 折射力

senses.en: refracting light; refractive

ex.en: The refringent crystal split the sunlight into bands of color.
ex.zh: 那塊有折射力的晶體把陽光分成一道道色帶。

root.note: 使光折斷轉彎的 → 折射的

senses.en: the act of saying or showing that one will not do or accept something

ex.en: His refusal to apologize made the situation worse.
ex.zh: 他拒絕道歉讓情況變得更糟。

root.note: 拒絕

senses.en: to prove a statement or theory to be wrong

ex.en: The scientist used new data to refute the old theory.
ex.zh: 那位科學家用新數據推翻了舊理論。

root.note: 打回去 → 駁斥

senses.en: to entertain or amuse someone with talk
to give someone plenty of food and drink

ex.en: Grandpa likes to regale us with stories of his travels.
ex.zh: 爺爺喜歡講他旅行的故事逗我們開心。

parts.m: pleasure, merriment 歡樂（古法文 gale）

root.note: 讓人非常開心 → 款待

senses.en: the emblems or special clothing of royalty or an official position
senses.zh: 王權標誌；正式禮服；徽章

ex.en: The graduates marched in full academic regalia.
ex.zh: 畢業生們穿著全套學位服行進。

root.note: 國王的物品 → 王權標誌

senses.en: the state of being royal; kingly dignity

ex.en: The actress played the queen with great regality.
ex.zh: 那位女演員把女王演得很有王者風範。

root.note: 國王的特質 → 王者風範

senses.en: (of a living thing) to grow new tissue or parts
to bring new life or energy to a place or system

ex.en: A lizard can regenerate its tail if it loses it.
ex.zh: 蜥蜴斷尾後可以再生。

root.note: 再次產生 → 再生

senses.en: a person who rules while a king or queen is too young, absent, or ill
a member of a governing board of a university

ex.en: The prince's uncle served as regent until the boy turned eighteen.
ex.zh: 王子的叔叔擔任攝政，直到男孩滿十八歲。

root.note: 代為統治的人 → 攝政者

senses.en: the killing of a king, or a person who kills a king

ex.en: The plot ended in regicide and years of civil war.
ex.zh: 那場陰謀以弒君告終，並引發多年內戰。

root.note: 殺國王 → 弒君

senses.en: a government, especially an authoritarian one
a system or ordered way of doing things

ex.en: The military regime banned all opposition parties.
ex.zh: 軍政府禁止所有反對黨。

root.note: 統治方式 → 政權

senses.en: a planned program of diet, exercise, or medical treatment
senses.zh: （飲食、運動、治療的）養生法；療程

ex.en: The athlete follows a strict training regimen.
ex.zh: 那位運動員遵循嚴格的訓練計畫。

root.note: 規範生活的方法 → 養生法

mn: regimen（養生計畫）、regime（政權）、regiment（軍團）長得很像要分清楚。

senses.en: a permanent unit of an army
[ˋrɛdʒəˏmɛnt] to organize or control strictly

ex.en: Her grandfather served in a cavalry regiment during the war.
ex.zh: 她的祖父戰時在騎兵團服役。

root.note: 受統轄的單位 → 軍團

senses.en: reigning; ruling in one's own right
currently having the greatest influence

ex.en: Victoria was a queen regnant, not merely the wife of a king.
ex.zh: 維多利亞是在位女王，而不只是國王的妻子。

root.note: 正在統治的

senses.en: to return to an earlier and less advanced state

ex.en: Without practice, your language skills may regress.
ex.zh: 不練習的話，你的語言能力可能會退步。

root.note: 往回走 → 倒退

senses.en: feeling or showing sadness or disappointment about something one did or did not do

ex.en: He gave a regretful smile and said he could not come.
ex.zh: 他露出遺憾的微笑，說自己沒辦法來。

root.note: 充滿悔意的

mn: regretful 形容人的感受；regrettable 形容事情令人遺憾。

senses.en: to help someone return to normal life after illness, injury, or prison
to restore something to good condition or a good reputation

ex.en: The program helps rehabilitate former prisoners through job training.
ex.zh: 這個計畫透過職業訓練幫助前受刑人重返社會。

root.note: 使再次有能力 → 復健

senses.en: the period during which a king or queen rules
to rule as a king or queen
to be the main or most noticeable quality

ex.en: The castle was built during the reign of Henry VIII.
ex.zh: 這座城堡建於亨利八世在位期間。

parts.m: kingdom, rule 統治（拉丁文 regnum）

root.note: 統治

mn: reign（統治）、rein（韁繩）、rain（雨）同音不同字。

senses.en: to repay someone for money they have spent

ex.en: The company will reimburse you for travel expenses.
ex.zh: 公司會幫你報銷差旅費。

root.note: 把錢放回錢包裡 → 償還

senses.en: a long strap used to control a horse
(reins) the power to control something
to control or restrain

ex.en: The government must rein in its spending.
ex.zh: 政府必須控制支出。

mn: rein in 控制；give free rein 放手讓人自由發揮。

senses.en: to restore someone to a former job or position
to bring back a law, rule, or practice

ex.en: The court ordered the company to reinstate the fired workers.
ex.zh: 法院命令公司讓被解僱的工人復職。

root.note: 再放回原來的狀態 → 復職

senses.en: to say something again, often for emphasis

ex.en: Let me reiterate that safety is our top priority.
ex.zh: 讓我再強調一次，安全是我們的第一優先。

parts.m: again 又一次（拉丁文 iterum）

root.note: 一次又一次地說 → 重申

senses.en: to join or return to a group or person again
[rɪˋdʒɔɪn] to say something in reply, especially sharply

ex.en: After his injury healed, he was able to rejoin the team.
ex.zh: 傷好之後，他得以重回球隊。

root.note: 再次加入；回話 → 反駁

senses.en: to make someone or something look or feel younger or more lively

ex.en: A week at the beach helped rejuvenate the tired family.
ex.zh: 在海邊待一週讓疲憊的一家人恢復了活力。

root.note: 使再次年輕 → 恢復活力

senses.en: the process of becoming young or vigorous again

ex.en: Spring brings a rejuvenescence to the whole forest.
ex.zh: 春天讓整片森林重新恢復生機。

root.note: 再度變年輕的過程

senses.en: a return to illness after a period of improvement
to return to a worse state or bad habit after improving

ex.en: The patient suffered a relapse after leaving the hospital.
ex.zh: 那位病人出院後病情復發。

root.note: 又滑回去 → 復發

senses.en: to move someone or something to a lower or less important position
senses.zh: 貶謫；降級；置於次要地位

ex.en: The new manager tried to relegate her to a desk job.
ex.zh: 新主管試圖把她貶去做內勤工作。

root.note: 派到遠處去 → 貶謫

senses.en: to finally agree to something after refusing
to become less severe or intense

ex.en: Her parents finally agreed to relent and let her go to the concert.
ex.zh: 她的父母終於讓步，讓她去聽演唱會。

parts.m: slow, soft 慢、軟（拉丁文 lentus）

root.note: 軟化下來 → 讓步

mn: relentless（不停的、無情的）就是「不肯 relent」。

senses.en: closely connected or appropriate to the matter at hand

ex.en: Please include only relevant information in your report.
ex.zh: 請在報告中只放相關的資訊。

root.note: 被舉出來協助說明的 → 相關的

senses.en: dependence on or trust in someone or something

ex.en: Our reliance on smartphones keeps growing every year.
ex.zh: 我們對智慧型手機的依賴逐年增加。

root.note: 依靠

senses.en: dependent on someone or something

ex.en: The island is heavily reliant on tourism.
ex.zh: 這座島非常依賴觀光業。

root.note: 依靠的

senses.en: to give up something, often unwillingly

ex.en: The old king refused to relinquish power.
ex.zh: 老國王拒絕交出權力。

root.note: 留下離開 → 放棄

senses.en: a container for holy relics

ex.en: The golden reliquary is said to hold a bone of the saint.
ex.zh: 據說那個金色聖骨匣裡存放著聖人的一塊骨頭。

root.note: 裝遺物的容器 → 聖物盒

senses.en: to enjoy greatly; to look forward to eagerly
great enjoyment
a chopped pickle sauce eaten with food

ex.en: She seemed to relish the chance to prove her critics wrong.
ex.zh: 她似乎很享受證明批評者錯了的機會。

root.note: 吃完後留下的餘味 → 滋味、享受

senses.en: unwillingness to do something

ex.en: He agreed to help, but his reluctance was obvious.
ex.zh: 他答應幫忙，但明顯很不情願。

root.note: 掙扎著抗拒 → 不情願

senses.en: unwilling and hesitant

ex.en: Many residents were reluctant to leave their homes before the storm.
ex.zh: 很多居民在暴風雨來臨前都不願離開家。

root.note: 掙扎著抗拒 → 不情願的

senses.en: the act of remembering, especially honoring the dead
a memory or a keepsake

ex.en: The town holds a ceremony of remembrance every November.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮每年十一月都會舉行紀念儀式。

root.note: 再次放在心上 → 紀念

senses.en: a story or act of recalling past experiences

ex.en: Her reminiscence about summers on the farm made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 她講起在農場度過的夏天，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

root.note: 再次想起 → 回憶

senses.en: tending to remind one of something
senses.zh: 令人想起…的；使人聯想到的

ex.en: The smell of the bakery was reminiscent of my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 麵包店的香味讓我想起奶奶的廚房。

root.note: 讓人再次想起 → 令人聯想的

mn: 常用片語 be reminiscent of（讓人想起…）。

senses.en: careless in performing one's duty

ex.en: It would be remiss of me not to thank everyone who helped.
ex.zh: 如果我不感謝每位幫忙的人，那就太失禮了。

root.note: 放鬆、放手不管 → 疏忽的

senses.en: a period in which a disease becomes less severe
the canceling of a debt, charge, or penalty

ex.en: After a year of treatment, her cancer went into remission.
ex.zh: 經過一年的治療，她的癌症進入緩解期。

root.note: 放鬆、放掉 → 緩解、免除

senses.en: to change the structure or form of something, especially a building

ex.en: We plan to remodel the kitchen next spring.
ex.zh: 我們打算明年春天改造廚房。

root.note: 重新塑造形式 → 改建

senses.en: a forceful protest or complaint

ex.en: The villagers sent a formal remonstrance to the governor about the new tax.
ex.zh: 村民針對新稅正式向總督提出抗議。

root.note: 反覆指出錯誤 → 抗議、諫言

senses.en: expressing protest or objection
a person who protests

ex.en: The committee ignored every remonstrant letter from the parents.
ex.zh: 委員會對家長們寄來的每一封抗議信都置之不理。

root.note: 反覆指出錯誤的（人）→ 抗議的

senses.en: to make a forcefully reproachful protest

ex.en: She tried to remonstrate with the referee, but he would not listen.
ex.zh: 她試著向裁判抗議，但他不肯聽。

root.note: 一再指出對方的錯 → 抗議、規勸

senses.en: to pay someone for work or services

ex.en: The company will remunerate volunteers for their travel expenses.
ex.zh: 公司會補償志工的交通費。

root.note: 回贈禮物 → 酬謝

senses.en: money paid for work or a service

ex.en: The job offers generous remuneration and flexible hours.
ex.zh: 這份工作待遇優渥，而且工時彈性。

root.note: 回贈的禮物 → 報酬

senses.en: the revival of art and learning in Europe from the 14th to 16th century
(renaissance) a revival of interest or activity

ex.en: Florence was the heart of the Italian Renaissance.
ex.zh: 佛羅倫斯是義大利文藝復興的中心。

root.note: 再次誕生 → 文藝復興

mn: Renaissance man 指多才多藝的通才。

senses.en: a meeting at an agreed time and place
to meet at an agreed time and place

ex.en: The two teams agreed on a rendezvous at the bridge at noon.
ex.zh: 兩隊約定中午在橋邊會合。

root.note: 法文「請你們到場」→ 約定會面

mn: 來自法文，最後的 s 和 z 都不發音。

senses.en: a performance or interpretation of a song, role, or work
a translation

ex.en: Her rendition of the national anthem brought the crowd to tears.
ex.zh: 她演唱的國歌讓全場觀眾感動落淚。

root.note: 把作品重新「交出來」→ 演繹

senses.en: to restore something old to good condition

ex.en: The city plans to renovate the old train station.
ex.zh: 市政府打算整修舊火車站。

root.note: 使再變新 → 翻新

senses.en: the formal giving up of a claim, right, or belief

ex.en: His renunciation of the throne shocked the entire nation.
ex.zh: 他放棄王位的決定震驚了全國。

root.note: 宣告收回 → 放棄

senses.en: to change the way something is organized

ex.en: The new manager decided to reorganize the entire sales team.
ex.zh: 新經理決定重組整個業務團隊。

root.note: 再組織一次 → 重組

senses.en: able to be repaired or set right

ex.en: Fortunately, the damage to the old bridge is reparable.
ex.zh: 幸好這座老橋的損壞是可以修復的。

root.note: 可以再準備好 → 可修補的

mn: 重音在第一音節 RE-parable，和 repair 不一樣；反義字 irreparable 較常見。

senses.en: making amends for a wrong by paying money or helping
(reparations) compensation paid by a defeated nation after war

ex.en: The company offered reparation to families harmed by the chemical spill.
ex.zh: 公司對因化學物質外洩而受害的家庭提出賠償。

root.note: 把損壞的再弄好 → 賠償

senses.en: quick, witty conversation or replies

ex.en: The talk show host was famous for her clever repartee with guests.
ex.zh: 那位脫口秀主持人以和來賓機智對答聞名。

parts.m: set out 出發（法文 partir）

root.note: 立刻回擊 → 機智的應答

senses.en: to officially cancel a law
the act of canceling a law

ex.en: Protesters urged lawmakers to repeal the unpopular tax.
ex.zh: 抗議者敦促立法者廢除這項不得人心的稅。

root.note: 把（法令）叫回來 → 撤銷

senses.en: to drive or force back
to cause disgust in
(of a substance) to resist mixing with

ex.en: This special coating can repel water and dirt.
ex.zh: 這種特殊塗層能防水防污。

root.note: 往回推 → 擊退

senses.en: a substance that keeps insects or water away
causing strong dislike; disgusting

ex.en: Don't forget to bring mosquito repellent on the camping trip.
ex.zh: 去露營別忘了帶防蚊液。

root.note: 把東西趕回去的 → 驅除劑、令人反感

senses.en: sincere regret for wrongdoing

ex.en: The prisoner showed genuine repentance for his crimes.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯對自己的罪行表現出真誠的悔意。

root.note: 深深後悔 → 懺悔

senses.en: a theater company that performs a series of works in rotation
a stock of works that a performer knows; repertoire

ex.en: She got her start as an actress in a small repertory theater.
ex.zh: 她在一家小型定目劇團開始了演員生涯。

root.note: 可以再找出來的清單 → 劇目庫

senses.en: the act of repeating something

ex.en: Learning a language takes a lot of repetition.
ex.zh: 學語言需要大量反覆練習。

root.note: 再去做一次 → 重複

senses.en: to feel or express discontent; to fret

ex.en: There is no use to repine over chances you have already missed.
ex.zh: 為已經錯過的機會抱怨是沒有用的。

root.note: 一再憔悴難過 → 抱怨不滿

senses.en: to fill something up again

ex.en: Drink plenty of water to replenish the fluids you lost while running.
ex.zh: 多喝水，補充跑步時流失的水分。

root.note: 使再滿 → 補充

senses.en: filled or well supplied with something
very full of food

ex.en: The novel is replete with memorable characters.
ex.zh: 這本小說裡充滿令人難忘的角色。

root.note: 填得滿滿的 → 充滿的

mn: 常用片語 be replete with（充滿…）。

senses.en: an exact copy or model of something

ex.en: The museum displays a full-size replica of a dinosaur skeleton.
ex.zh: 博物館展示了一副等比例的恐龍骨骼複製品。

root.note: 摺回去重做一份 → 複製品

senses.en: a place where things are stored
a person or thing full of information

ex.en: The library serves as a repository for rare manuscripts.
ex.zh: 這座圖書館是珍貴手稿的收藏處。

root.note: 把東西放回去的地方 → 存放處

senses.en: to criticize or blame sharply

ex.en: The judge did not hesitate to reprehend the lawyer's rude behavior.
