ex.zh: 法官毫不猶豫地斥責那位律師的無禮行為。

root.note: 把人抓回來 → 斥責

senses.en: deserving strong criticism

ex.en: Cheating on the exam was reprehensible behavior.
ex.zh: 考試作弊是應受譴責的行為。

root.note: 應該被抓回來責罵的 → 應受譴責的

senses.en: the act of criticizing or blaming

ex.en: His careless remark drew sharp reprehension from the audience.
ex.zh: 他輕率的言論引來觀眾嚴厲指責。

root.note: 抓回來責罵 → 譴責

senses.en: to hold back a feeling or reaction
to control people by force

ex.en: She tried to repress a smile when the teacher tripped.
ex.zh: 老師絆了一下，她努力忍住不笑。

root.note: 壓回去 → 壓抑、鎮壓

senses.en: able to be held back or controlled

ex.en: Her laughter was barely repressible during the serious speech.
ex.zh: 在那場嚴肅的演講中，她幾乎忍不住笑出來。

root.note: 可以被壓回去的 → 可抑制的

mn: 反義字 irrepressible（壓抑不住的）比較常見。

senses.en: a cancellation or delay of a punishment
a temporary relief from something unpleasant
to cancel or postpone a punishment

ex.en: The rain gave farmers a brief reprieve from the drought.
ex.zh: 這場雨讓農民暫時擺脫了乾旱。

root.note: 把判決拿回來 → 暫緩執行

senses.en: to criticize someone formally
a formal expression of disapproval

ex.en: The coach had to reprimand the player for arriving late.
ex.zh: 教練不得不訓斥那名遲到的球員。

root.note: 應被壓下去的事 → 訓斥

senses.en: an act of retaliation

ex.en: Workers were afraid to report the problem for fear of reprisal.
ex.zh: 員工害怕遭到報復，不敢舉報問題。

root.note: 把東西搶回來 → 報復

senses.en: an unprincipled person
morally bad; unprincipled

ex.en: In the movie, the charming reprobate eventually changes his ways.
ex.zh: 電影裡那個迷人的浪子最後改過自新。

root.note: 不被認可的 → 墮落的人

senses.en: to produce a copy of
to produce offspring

ex.en: Other scientists were unable to reproduce the results of the experiment.
ex.zh: 其他科學家無法重現這項實驗的結果。

root.note: 再產出一次 → 複製、繁殖

senses.en: the process of producing offspring
a copy of a work of art

ex.en: Frogs rely on water for reproduction.
ex.zh: 青蛙靠水來繁殖。

root.note: 再產出 → 繁殖、複製

senses.en: an expression of blame or disapproval

ex.en: The mother's gentle reproof made the child apologize.
ex.zh: 媽媽溫和的責備讓孩子道了歉。

root.note: 反證對方有錯 → 責備

mn: reproof 是名詞，動詞是 reprove（責備）。

senses.en: to refuse to accept or be associated with
senses.zh: 否認；拒絕接受；斷絕關係

ex.en: The candidate was quick to repudiate the offensive comments made by his supporter.
ex.zh: 那位候選人很快就撇清與支持者冒犯性言論的關係。

root.note: 引以為恥而推開 → 否認、拒絕

senses.en: intense disgust

ex.en: She could not hide her repugnance at the cruelty toward the animals.
ex.zh: 她無法掩飾對虐待動物的厭惡。

root.note: 想要對抗的感覺 → 厭惡

senses.en: extremely distasteful; unacceptable

ex.en: Many people find the idea of eating insects repugnant.
ex.zh: 很多人覺得吃昆蟲這個想法很噁心。

root.note: 讓人想反擊的 → 令人厭惡的

senses.en: to drive back an attack
to cause intense disgust in
to reject rudely

ex.en: The soldiers managed to repulse the enemy attack.
ex.zh: 士兵們成功擊退了敵人的攻擊。

root.note: 推回去 → 擊退

senses.en: causing strong dislike or disgust

ex.en: The smell from the garbage truck was absolutely repulsive.
ex.zh: 垃圾車傳來的味道真的非常噁心。

root.note: 讓人想推開的 → 令人厭惡的

senses.en: the opinion generally held of someone; reputation
(be reputed) to be generally believed

ex.en: She is a doctor of great repute in the medical community.
ex.zh: 她是醫學界享有盛名的醫師。

root.note: 大家反覆認為的 → 名聲

senses.en: a Mass or musical piece for the dead

ex.en: The choir performed a requiem in memory of the victims.
ex.zh: 合唱團演唱安魂曲，悼念罹難者。

root.note: 彌撒開頭的拉丁文「願他們安息」→ 安魂曲

senses.en: required for a particular purpose
a thing that is necessary

ex.en: She lacked the requisite experience for the manager position.
ex.zh: 她缺乏擔任經理職位所需的經驗。

root.note: 被要求的 → 必需的

senses.en: a return for a kindness or a wrong; repayment

ex.en: He expected no requital for the help he gave his neighbors.
ex.zh: 他幫助鄰居，從不期待任何回報。

root.note: 回頭清償 → 報答或報復

senses.en: to return a favor or feeling
to take revenge for

ex.en: She loved him deeply, but he did not requite her feelings.
ex.zh: 她深愛著他，但他並沒有回應她的感情。

root.note: 回頭清償 → 回報

mn: unrequited love 是「單戀、得不到回應的愛」。

senses.en: to cancel a law, order, or agreement

ex.en: The university decided to rescind the offer after learning he had lied.
ex.zh: 大學得知他說謊後，決定撤銷錄取。

root.note: 切斷收回 → 撤銷

senses.en: to seat again or in a different place
to fit a part back into its correct position

ex.en: The usher had to reseat the family because of a ticket mix-up.
ex.zh: 因為票弄錯了，帶位員只好幫那家人換座位。

root.note: 再安排座位

senses.en: the state of looking or being alike

ex.en: There is a strong resemblance between the two sisters.
ex.zh: 這對姊妹長得很像。

root.note: 很相似 → 相像

senses.en: to feel bitterness about something unfair

ex.en: Many employees resent having to work on weekends without extra pay.
ex.zh: 很多員工對週末加班卻沒有加班費感到不滿。

root.note: 強烈地感受（不滿）→ 怨恨

senses.en: a large natural or artificial lake used to store water
a large supply of something

ex.en: The reservoir is almost empty after months without rain.
ex.zh: 好幾個月沒下雨，水庫幾乎乾了。

root.note: 保存東西的地方 → 水庫、儲藏

senses.en: a small amount of something that remains

ex.en: Wash the fruit to remove any pesticide residue.
ex.zh: 把水果洗乾淨，去除農藥殘留。

root.note: 坐著留在後面的 → 殘留物

senses.en: the ability to recover quickly from difficulties
the ability of a material to spring back into shape

ex.en: The community showed remarkable resilience after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後，這個社區展現出驚人的韌性。

root.note: 跳回原狀 → 韌性、彈性

senses.en: able to recover quickly from difficulties
senses.zh: 有韌性的；能迅速恢復的

senses.en: able to spring back into shape

ex.en: Children are often more resilient than adults expect.
ex.zh: 孩子往往比大人以為的更有韌性。

root.note: 能跳回原狀的 → 有韌性的

senses.en: the refusal to accept or comply with something
the ability not to be affected by something
the degree to which a material opposes electric current

ex.en: The new policy met strong resistance from teachers.
ex.zh: 新政策遭到老師們強烈反對。

root.note: 站著對抗 → 抵抗

senses.en: not affected or harmed by something
opposed to something

ex.en: Some bacteria have become resistant to common antibiotics.
ex.zh: 有些細菌已經對常見的抗生素產生抗藥性。

root.note: 站著對抗的 → 抵抗的

mn: 常見複合字：water-resistant（防水的）、heat-resistant（耐熱的）。

senses.en: tending to resist; relating to electrical resistance

ex.en: Older phones used a resistive touch screen that needed firm pressure.
ex.zh: 舊型手機用的是電阻式觸控螢幕，要用力按才有反應。

root.note: 具有對抗性質的 → 電阻的

senses.en: impossible to resist; irresistible
offering no resistance

ex.en: The river swept everything away with resistless force.
ex.zh: 河水以不可抗拒的力量把一切沖走。

root.note: 無法抵抗的

senses.en: a deep, full, reverberating quality of sound
the power to evoke feelings or memories

ex.en: The story has special resonance for anyone who grew up in a small town.
ex.zh: 對在小鎮長大的人來說，這個故事特別能引起共鳴。

root.note: 聲音再次響起 → 共鳴

senses.en: to produce a deep, full, echoing sound
to evoke a feeling of shared emotion or belief

ex.en: Her speech about hard work seemed to resonate with the students.
ex.zh: 她關於努力的演講似乎引起了學生的共鳴。

root.note: 聲音再次響起 → 共鳴

senses.en: a supply of money, materials, or staff that can be used
something that provides help or information

ex.en: Water is a precious resource in desert regions.
ex.zh: 在沙漠地區，水是珍貴的資源。

root.note: 不斷湧出的來源 → 資源

senses.en: a short period of rest or relief from something difficult

ex.en: The cool breeze offered a brief respite from the summer heat.
ex.zh: 涼爽的微風讓人暫時擺脫夏天的炎熱。

root.note: 回頭看一下、停一停 → 喘息

mn: 發音是 RES-pit，不要唸成 re-SPITE。

senses.en: impressive through being richly colorful or dazzling

ex.en: The bride looked resplendent in her silk gown.
ex.zh: 新娘穿著絲綢禮服，光彩奪目。

root.note: 閃閃發亮 → 燦爛的（splendid 同源）

senses.en: a person who answers a survey or questionnaire
a defendant in a lawsuit, especially in an appeal or divorce

ex.en: Each respondent was asked to rate the product from one to ten.
ex.zh: 每位受訪者都被要求為產品打一到十分。

root.note: 回應的人 → 受訪者

senses.en: the return of something lost or stolen to its owner
payment for injury or loss

ex.en: The court ordered him to pay restitution to the victims.
ex.zh: 法院命令他賠償受害者。

parts.m: set up, place 設立、放置

root.note: 放回原處 → 歸還、賠償

senses.en: the act of beginning something again after a pause

ex.en: Both sides welcomed the resumption of peace talks.
ex.zh: 雙方都歡迎和談重新展開。

root.note: 再拿起來 → 恢復

senses.en: rising again; increasing after a period of little activity

ex.en: The resurgent economy created thousands of new jobs.
ex.zh: 復甦的經濟創造了數千個新工作機會。

root.note: 再次升起的 → 復甦的

senses.en: the act of rising from the dead
the revival of something that had disappeared

ex.en: The band's reunion tour marked the resurrection of their career.
ex.zh: 這個樂團的重聚巡演標誌著他們事業的重生。

root.note: 再次站起來 → 復活

senses.en: to revive someone from unconsciousness or apparent death
to make something active or successful again

ex.en: Paramedics worked for twenty minutes to resuscitate the swimmer.
ex.zh: 急救人員花了二十分鐘搶救那名泳客。

root.note: 再次喚醒 → 使甦醒

senses.en: to attack or harm someone in return

ex.en: The country threatened to retaliate with higher tariffs.
ex.zh: 該國揚言要以提高關稅作為報復。

parts.m: such, like 同樣的（拉丁文 talis）

root.note: 以同樣方式回敬 → 報復

senses.en: to make the sound and movement of vomiting

ex.en: The terrible smell made him retch.
ex.zh: 那股可怕的味道讓他乾嘔。

mn: 發音同 wretch（可憐的人），但意思完全不同。

senses.en: the continued keeping or holding of something
the ability to remember things

ex.en: The company offered bonuses to improve employee retention.
ex.zh: 公司提供獎金來提高員工留任率。

root.note: 留住不放 → 保留

senses.en: the quality of not revealing one's thoughts or feelings

ex.en: His reticence about his personal life made him seem mysterious.
ex.zh: 他對私生活的沉默寡言讓他顯得很神祕。

root.note: 一直保持沉默 → 沉默寡言

senses.en: not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily
senses.zh: 沉默寡言的；有所保留的

ex.en: He was reticent about his past and rarely talked about his childhood.
ex.zh: 他對過去總是有所保留，很少提起童年。

parts.m: be silent 沉默（拉丁文 tacere）

root.note: 一直保持沉默 → 沉默寡言

senses.en: a group of assistants or servants accompanying an important person

ex.en: The pop star arrived with a retinue of bodyguards and assistants.
ex.zh: 那位流行歌手帶著一群保鑣和助理抵達。

root.note: 被留在身邊的人 → 隨從

senses.en: to reply quickly in a sharp or witty way
a sharp or witty reply

ex.en: "That's none of your business," she was quick to retort.
ex.zh: 「這不關你的事。」她立刻回嘴。

root.note: 把話扭回去 → 反駁

senses.en: to improve a photo or painting by making small changes

ex.en: The magazine promised not to retouch photos of its models.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌承諾不會修改模特兒的照片。

root.note: 再加幾筆 → 修飾

senses.en: to go back over the same route
to trace something back to its origin

ex.en: I had to retrace my steps to find my lost keys.
ex.zh: 我只好沿著原路走回去找我掉的鑰匙。

root.note: 沿著足跡回去 → 折回、追溯

senses.en: to withdraw a statement or accusation
to draw something back in

ex.en: The newspaper had to retract the story after it proved false.
ex.zh: 那則報導被證實是假的之後，報社只好撤回。

root.note: 拉回來 → 撤回、縮回

senses.en: to reduce costs or spending

ex.en: Falling sales forced the company to retrench.
ex.zh: 銷售下滑迫使公司緊縮開支。

root.note: 把花費切掉 → 削減

senses.en: to get or bring something back
to find and extract stored information

ex.en: I went back to the office to retrieve my laptop.
ex.zh: 我回辦公室去拿我的筆電。

root.note: 再找到 → 取回

mn: retriever（尋回犬）就是幫獵人把獵物叼回來的狗。

senses.en: taking effect from a date in the past
senses.zh: 追溯既往的；溯及既往的

ex.en: The pay raise is retroactive to January first.
ex.zh: 這次加薪從一月一日起追溯生效。

root.note: 往回作用的 → 追溯既往的

senses.en: moving backward; returning to a worse state
(of a planet) appearing to move backward

ex.en: Critics called the new law a retrograde step for women's rights.
ex.zh: 批評者稱這項新法是女權的倒退。

root.note: 往後退步 → 倒退的

senses.en: the process of returning to an earlier or worse state

ex.en: The war caused a retrogression in the country's economic development.
ex.zh: 戰爭讓該國的經濟發展倒退。

root.note: 往後走 → 倒退

senses.en: a review of past events

ex.en: In retrospect, I should have studied harder for the test.
ex.zh: 回想起來，我當時應該更用功準備考試。

root.note: 往後看 → 回顧

mn: 最常用片語 in retrospect（回想起來）。

senses.en: looking back on past events
an exhibition showing an artist's work over a long period

ex.en: The museum is holding a retrospective of the painter's work.
ex.zh: 博物館正在舉辦這位畫家的作品回顧展。

root.note: 往後看的 → 回顧的

senses.en: to come together or bring together again after separation

ex.en: The rescue workers helped reunite the lost child with her parents.
ex.zh: 救援人員幫助迷路的孩子與父母團聚。

root.note: 再次合而為一 → 重聚

senses.en: a surprising fact that is made known
something surprisingly good or impressive
a divine or supernatural disclosure

ex.en: The revelation that he had lied shocked his friends.
ex.zh: 他說謊的事被揭穿，讓朋友們震驚不已。

root.note: 揭開面紗 → 揭露

senses.en: to feel deep respect or admiration for

ex.en: Many scientists revere Marie Curie for her groundbreaking work.
ex.zh: 許多科學家崇敬居禮夫人的開創性研究。

parts.m: fear, respect 敬畏（拉丁文 vereri）

root.note: 深深敬畏 → 崇敬

senses.en: feeling or showing deep respect

ex.en: The crowd fell into a reverent silence as the ceremony began.
ex.zh: 儀式開始時，群眾恭敬地安靜下來。

root.note: 充滿敬畏的 → 恭敬的

senses.en: a return to a previous state or practice
the return of property to a former owner

ex.en: The team's poor play was a reversion to their old bad habits.
ex.zh: 球隊表現不佳是因為又回到了過去的壞習慣。

root.note: 轉回原狀 → 回復

senses.en: to return to a previous state, practice, or topic
(of property) to return to the original owner

ex.en: After the diet ended, he began to revert to his old eating habits.
ex.zh: 節食結束後，他開始恢復以前的飲食習慣。

root.note: 轉回去 → 恢復

mn: 常用片語 revert to（回到原狀）；注意 revert 不是「回覆（信件）」，回信要用 reply。

senses.en: to criticize in an abusive or angrily insulting way

ex.en: Some critics revile the film, while others call it a masterpiece.
ex.zh: 有些影評人痛罵這部電影，也有人稱它為傑作。

root.note: 把人說得很卑劣 → 辱罵

senses.en: the act of revising; a revision

ex.en: The manuscript went through a careful revisal before printing.
ex.zh: 原稿在付印前經過仔細的校訂。

root.note: 再看一次 → 修訂

senses.en: to change something to correct or improve it
to reconsider and change an opinion or estimate

ex.en: Please revise your essay before you submit it.
ex.zh: 交作文之前請先修改。

root.note: 再看一次 → 修訂

mn: 英式英文中 revise 也有「複習（考試）」的意思。

senses.en: the official cancellation of a decree, decision, or promise

ex.en: Drunk driving can lead to the revocation of your license.
ex.zh: 酒駕可能導致駕照被吊銷。

root.note: 叫回來 → 撤銷

senses.en: to officially cancel a decree, decision, or promise

ex.en: The government can revoke a passport under certain conditions.
ex.zh: 在某些情況下，政府可以註銷護照。

root.note: 叫回來 → 撤銷

senses.en: an expression of great enthusiasm or joy
a free-flowing, emotional piece of music

ex.en: The pianist played a famous rhapsody by Liszt.
ex.zh: 鋼琴家演奏了一首李斯特的著名狂想曲。

root.note: 把一段段歌縫在一起 → 狂想曲

senses.en: language designed to persuade, often seen as insincere
the art of effective speaking or writing

ex.en: Voters are tired of empty rhetoric and want real solutions.
ex.zh: 選民已經厭倦空洞的口號，想要真正的解決辦法。

root.note: 演說者的技藝 → 修辭

senses.en: a skilled public speaker or an expert in rhetoric

ex.en: A skilled rhetorician can make a weak argument sound convincing.
ex.zh: 高明的雄辯家能讓薄弱的論點聽起來很有說服力。

root.note: 精通演說的人

senses.en: referring to sex in a rudely humorous way

ex.en: The comedian's ribald jokes were not suitable for children.
ex.zh: 那位喜劇演員的黃色笑話不適合小孩聽。

senses.en: the action of getting rid of something unwanted

ex.en: When the noisy neighbors moved out, we said good riddance.
ex.zh: 吵鬧的鄰居搬走時，我們都說「走了正好」。

root.note: 清除掉 → 擺脫

mn: 最常見的用法是 Good riddance!（走了最好！）。

senses.en: words or actions intended to mock someone
to make fun of

ex.en: He was afraid his classmates would ridicule his accent.
ex.zh: 他怕同學會嘲笑他的口音。

root.note: 笑人 → 嘲笑

senses.en: deserving to be laughed at; absurd

ex.en: It is ridiculous to charge ten dollars for a bottle of water.
ex.zh: 一瓶水賣十美元太荒謬了。

root.note: 讓人發笑的 → 荒謬的

senses.en: (of something bad) widespread
(rife with) full of

ex.en: The report was rife with errors.
ex.zh: 這份報告錯誤百出。

senses.en: the quality of being morally right

ex.en: She spoke with the calm righteousness of someone sure she was right.
ex.zh: 她說話帶著一種確信自己沒錯的平靜正氣。

root.note: 正直的特質

senses.en: having a legitimate right to something

ex.en: The stolen painting was finally returned to its rightful owner.
ex.zh: 被偷的畫終於歸還給它的合法主人。

root.note: 有權利的 → 合法的

senses.en: a long, complicated, and annoying procedure
a long, rambling story

ex.en: Getting a visa involved a lot of rigmarole and paperwork.
ex.zh: 辦簽證要經過一大堆繁瑣的手續和文件。

senses.en: the quality of being extremely thorough and careful
harshness or severity

ex.en: The study was praised for its scientific rigor.
ex.zh: 這項研究因科學上的嚴謹而受到讚揚。

root.note: 僵硬不變通 → 嚴格、嚴謹

senses.en: extremely thorough and careful
demanding or strict

ex.en: All new drugs must pass rigorous testing before they are sold.
ex.zh: 所有新藥上市前都必須通過嚴格的測試。

root.note: 一點都不放鬆的 → 嚴格的

senses.en: a small ripple

ex.en: A single ripplet spread across the still pond.
ex.zh: 一道細小的漣漪在平靜的池面上擴散開來。

root.note: 小漣漪

senses.en: so foolish that it causes laughter; ridiculous

ex.en: The company's risible excuse convinced no one.
ex.zh: 公司可笑的藉口根本說服不了任何人。

root.note: 讓人笑的 → 可笑的

senses.en: a very small stream

ex.en: A rivulet of sweat ran down his forehead.
ex.zh: 一道汗水從他的額頭流下來。

parts.m: small stream 小溪（拉丁文 rivus）

root.note: 小河流 → 小溪

senses.en: strong and healthy; vigorous
(of a system or argument) strong and effective in all conditions

ex.en: The country's economy remained robust despite the crisis.
ex.zh: 儘管有危機，該國經濟依然穩健。

parts.m: oak, strength 橡木、力量（拉丁文 robur）

root.note: 像橡木一樣結實 → 強健的

senses.en: a musical form in which a main theme returns several times

ex.en: The last movement of the sonata is a lively rondo.
ex.zh: 這首奏鳴曲的最後一個樂章是輕快的迴旋曲。

root.note: 主題一直繞回來 → 迴旋曲

senses.en: a breeding colony of rooks, seabirds, or seals

ex.en: Thousands of penguins gather at the rookery each spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天都有數千隻企鵝聚集在這片繁殖地。

root.note: 白嘴鴉聚集的地方 → 群棲地

senses.en: moving in a circle around a center
a traffic circle; roundabout

ex.en: My grandparents still have an old rotary phone.
ex.zh: 我爺爺奶奶家還有一台舊式的轉盤電話。

root.note: 像輪子一樣轉的 → 旋轉的

senses.en: to turn around a central point
to take turns or change in a regular order

ex.en: Farmers rotate crops to keep the soil healthy.
ex.zh: 農夫輪作作物，讓土壤保持健康。

root.note: 像輪子一樣轉 → 旋轉、輪流

senses.en: mechanical repetition used to memorize something

ex.en: Students often learn multiplication tables by rote.
ex.zh: 學生常常用死背的方式學九九乘法表。

mn: 常用片語 learn by rote（死記硬背）、rote learning（背誦式學習）。

senses.en: (of a person) plump and round
(of speech) full and deep in sound

ex.en: The rotund chef laughed as he tasted the soup.
ex.zh: 圓胖的廚師一邊嚐湯一邊笑。

parts.m: 形容詞字尾（拉丁文 rotundus）

root.note: 像輪子一樣圓 → 圓胖的（round 同源）

senses.en: involving only basic principles; elementary
undeveloped or simple

ex.en: I have only a rudimentary knowledge of French.
ex.zh: 我對法文只懂一點皮毛。

root.note: 粗略、未加工的 → 基本的

senses.en: to bitterly regret something
a bitter-tasting herb

ex.en: You will rue the day you ignored my advice.
ex.zh: 你會後悔當初沒聽我的建議。

mn: 常見片語 rue the day（後悔當初）；形容詞 rueful 是「懊悔的」。

senses.en: a violent, lawless person

ex.en: A ruffian grabbed the old man's wallet and ran away.
ex.zh: 一個流氓搶走老人的錢包就跑了。

senses.en: an animal, such as a cow, that chews the cud
chewing the cud; also, thoughtful

ex.en: A cow is a ruminant with a stomach divided into four parts.
ex.zh: 牛是一種反芻動物，胃分成四個部分。

parts.m: throat, cud 喉嚨、反芻的食物（拉丁文 rumen）

root.note: 會把食物回到喉嚨再嚼的動物 → 反芻動物

senses.en: to think deeply about something
(of an animal) to chew the cud

ex.en: She liked to ruminate on the meaning of life during long walks.
ex.zh: 她喜歡在長時間散步時思索人生的意義。

root.note: 像牛反芻一樣反覆咀嚼 → 反覆思考

senses.en: a sudden break or burst
a breach of a relationship
to break or burst suddenly

ex.en: A rupture in the pipe flooded the basement.
ex.zh: 水管破裂讓地下室淹水了。

root.note: 破裂

senses.en: relating to the countryside; simple and charming
an unsophisticated country person

ex.en: We stayed in a rustic cabin in the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們住在山上一間質樸的小木屋。

root.note: 鄉村的 → 質樸的

senses.en: (archaic) a feeling of pity or compassion

ex.en: The tyrant showed no ruth toward his enemies.
ex.zh: 那名暴君對敵人毫無憐憫。

root.note: 悲憫之情

mn: ruth 本身很少用，但 ruthless（無情的）非常常見。

senses.en: giving up something valuable for something more important
to give up something valuable
an offering to a god

ex.en: Her parents made a huge sacrifice so she could study abroad.
ex.zh: 她的父母做了很大的犧牲，讓她能出國念書。

root.note: 使成為神聖的 → 獻祭、犧牲

senses.en: relating to or offered as a sacrifice

ex.en: Ancient priests led a sacrificial lamb to the altar.
ex.zh: 古代祭司把獻祭用的羔羊牽到祭壇上。

root.note: 獻祭的

mn: sacrificial lamb 比喻「代罪羔羊、被犧牲的人」。

senses.en: violation or misuse of something sacred

ex.en: To many fans, changing the ending of the classic film is sacrilege.
ex.zh: 對許多影迷來說，改掉這部經典電影的結局簡直是褻瀆。

parts.m: steal, gather 偷取（拉丁文 legere）

root.note: 偷取神聖之物 → 褻瀆

senses.en: involving disrespect toward something sacred

ex.en: Some visitors considered the graffiti on the temple walls sacrilegious.
ex.zh: 有些遊客認為廟牆上的塗鴉是褻瀆神明的行為。

root.note: 偷取神聖之物的 → 褻瀆的

mn: 拼法容易錯：不是 sacreligious，前面是 sacri-，和 religious 無關。

senses.en: to protect from harm or damage
a measure taken to protect something

ex.en: New laws were passed to safeguard children's privacy online.
ex.zh: 政府通過新法來保護兒童的網路隱私。

root.note: 保護安全

senses.en: having good judgment and keen understanding; wise

ex.en: The sagacious investor sold her stocks just before the crash.
ex.zh: 那位精明的投資人在股市崩盤前剛好賣掉了股票。

parts.m: wise, perceive keenly 敏銳察覺

root.note: 很有洞察力的 → 睿智的

mn: sage（聖人、智者）同源。

senses.en: having or showing excessive interest in sexual matters
senses.zh: 淫穢的；色情的；（八卦）腥羶的

ex.en: The tabloid was full of salacious gossip about celebrities.
ex.zh: 這份八卦小報充滿名人的腥羶緋聞。

root.note: 蠢蠢欲動 → 好色的

senses.en: the quality of being noticeable or important

ex.en: The scandal gave new salience to the debate over campaign finance.
ex.zh: 這起醜聞讓競選經費的爭議再度成為焦點。

root.note: 跳出來的 → 顯著

senses.en: most noticeable or important

ex.en: The teacher summarized the salient points of the chapter.
ex.zh: 老師總結了這一章的重點。

root.note: 跳出來的 → 顯眼的、重要的

senses.en: containing salt
a solution of salt in water, used in medicine

ex.en: The nurse used a saline solution to clean the wound.
ex.zh: 護理師用生理食鹽水清洗傷口。

root.note: 含鹽的

senses.en: producing good effects, though often unpleasant
senses.zh: 有益的；（雖然不好受但）有教育意義的

ex.en: Failing the first test was a salutary lesson for him.
ex.zh: 第一次考不及格對他來說是個有益的教訓。

root.note: 對健康有益的 → 有益的

mn: 別和 salutatory 搞混；salutary 是「有益的」，salutation 才是「問候」。

senses.en: a greeting
the opening words of a letter, such as "Dear Sir"

ex.en: He raised his hat in salutation as she passed.
ex.zh: 她經過時，他舉起帽子向她致意。

root.note: 祝人健康 → 問候

senses.en: a welcoming speech, especially at a graduation
expressing a greeting

ex.en: The second-ranked student gave the salutatory at graduation.
ex.zh: 畢業典禮上由第二名的學生致歡迎詞。

root.note: 問候用的 → 歡迎詞

mn: 美國畢業典禮：salutatorian（第二名）致歡迎詞，valedictorian（第一名）致告別詞。

senses.en: to rescue something from loss or destruction
the rescue of a ship or property from loss
senses.zh: 打撈；救援；被搶救的財物

ex.en: The coach tried to salvage the season after a string of losses.
ex.zh: 連敗之後，教練試著挽救這個球季。

root.note: 拯救 → 搶救

senses.en: a simultaneous firing of guns or bombs
a sudden burst of attacks, criticism, or applause

ex.en: The senator's speech was the opening salvo in a long political battle.
ex.zh: 那位參議員的演講是一場長期政治戰的第一砲。

parts.m: safe, greet 平安、致敬（義大利文 salva）

root.note: 原指鳴砲致敬 → 齊射

mn: 常見片語 opening salvo（開場第一擊）。

senses.en: making a show of being morally superior to others
senses.zh: 假裝神聖的；道貌岸然的

ex.en: I'm tired of his sanctimonious lectures about healthy eating.
ex.zh: 我受夠了他那副道貌岸然的健康飲食說教。

root.note: 表現得很神聖的樣子 → 假裝神聖

senses.en: a penalty for disobeying a law, especially one placed on a country
official permission or approval
to give official permission for; also, to impose a penalty on

ex.en: The United Nations voted to impose a trade sanction on the country.
ex.zh: 聯合國投票決定對該國實施貿易制裁。

root.note: 使成為神聖的法令 → 認可；違反者受制裁

mn: sanction 有兩個相反的意思：「批准」和「制裁」，要看上下文判斷。

senses.en: the state of being holy or sacred

ex.en: The judge spoke about the sanctity of human life.
ex.zh: 法官談到人命的神聖不可侵犯。

root.note: 神聖性

senses.en: involving much bloodshed; bloodthirsty

ex.en: The sanguinary battle left thousands of soldiers dead.
ex.zh: 這場血腥的戰役造成數千名士兵死亡。

root.note: 流很多血的 → 血腥的

mn: 別和 sanguine（樂觀的）搞混；sanguinary 才是「血腥的」。

senses.en: optimistic, especially in a difficult situation
(of the face) ruddy

ex.en: The doctors are sanguine about her chances of recovery.
ex.zh: 醫生對她康復的機會很樂觀。

root.note: 古代認為血液旺盛的人性格開朗 → 樂觀的

senses.en: relating to or containing blood; blood-red

ex.en: The nurse noted a small amount of sanguineous fluid from the wound.
ex.zh: 護理師記錄傷口流出少量帶血的液體。

root.note: 含血的

senses.en: having a strong, pleasant taste; flavorful
(of writing or talk) interesting

ex.en: The chef added herbs to make the plain soup more sapid.
ex.zh: 廚師加了香草，讓清淡的湯更有滋味。

parts.m: taste 嚐、有智慧（拉丁文 sapere）

root.note: 有味道的

mn: 反義字 insipid（淡而無味的）比較常用。

senses.en: wisdom; deep understanding

ex.en: The old monk was admired for his sapience and kindness.
ex.zh: 那位老僧以睿智和仁慈受人敬重。

parts.m: be wise 有智慧（拉丁文 sapere）

root.note: 智慧

senses.en: wise, or attempting to appear wise
senses.zh: 有智慧的；（常帶諷刺）自以為聰明的

ex.en: Science fiction often imagines contact with sapient alien species.
ex.zh: 科幻小說常想像和有智慧的外星物種接觸。

root.note: 有智慧的

mn: Homo sapiens（智人）就是「有智慧的人」。

senses.en: relating to or containing wisdom

ex.en: Proverbs is one of the sapiential books of the Bible.
ex.zh: 《箴言》是聖經中的智慧書之一。

root.note: 關於智慧的

senses.en: of, like, or containing soap; soapy

ex.en: The water left a saponaceous film on the dishes.
ex.zh: 水在碗盤上留下一層像肥皂的薄膜。

root.note: 像肥皂的

senses.en: the use of irony to mock or show contempt

ex.en: "Great job," he said with obvious sarcasm after I dropped the cake.
ex.zh: 我把蛋糕弄掉之後，他語帶諷刺地說：「幹得好。」

root.note: 原意「撕肉」→ 說話像咬人的肉一樣尖刻

senses.en: a stone coffin, often decorated

ex.en: The pharaoh's sarcophagus was covered in gold and carvings.
ex.zh: 法老的石棺上覆滿黃金和雕刻。

root.note: 「吃肉的石頭」，古人認為這種石頭會分解屍體 → 石棺

senses.en: grimly mocking or cynical

ex.en: He gave a sardonic smile when his rival fell behind.
ex.zh: 對手落後時，他露出一抹冷笑。

root.note: 傳說吃了薩丁尼亞的毒草會臉部抽搐像在冷笑 → 嘲諷的

senses.en: to satisfy fully or to excess

ex.en: Nothing seemed to satiate his curiosity about space.
ex.zh: 似乎沒有什麼能滿足他對太空的好奇心。

root.note: 使足夠 → 使飽足

senses.en: the use of humor or exaggeration to criticize people or ideas

ex.en: The TV show is a sharp satire of modern politics.
ex.zh: 這部電視節目是對現代政治的尖銳諷刺。

parts.m: full 滿（拉丁文 satura，雜燴）

root.note: 原指裝滿各種東西的雜燴 → 混雜各種嘲諷的詩文

mn: 別和 satyr（半人半羊的森林之神）搞混。

senses.en: containing or using satire

ex.en: The magazine is known for its satiric cartoons.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌以諷刺漫畫聞名。

root.note: 諷刺的

senses.en: to mock or criticize using satire

ex.en: The comedy sketch tried to satirize the lives of the very rich.
ex.zh: 那段喜劇短劇試圖諷刺有錢人的生活。

root.note: 諷刺

senses.en: (Greek myth) a woodland god with some features of a goat
senses.zh: （希臘神話）森林之神，半人半羊

senses.en: a man with strong, uncontrolled sexual desires

ex.en: The ancient vase shows a satyr playing a flute.
ex.zh: 這個古代花瓶上畫著一個吹笛的半羊人。

mn: KK 也可唸 [ˋsætɚ]；別和 satire（諷刺）搞混。

senses.en: fierce, violent, and uncontrolled
(of criticism) very harsh
to attack violently or criticize harshly

ex.en: The film received a savage review in the newspaper.
ex.zh: 這部電影在報上被罵得體無完膚。

parts.m: forest 森林（拉丁文 silvaticus，拼法演變成 savage）

root.note: 住在森林裡的 → 野蠻的

senses.en: to taste or enjoy something slowly and completely
a characteristic taste or smell

ex.en: Take a moment to savor your success before starting the next project.
ex.zh: 在開始下一個計畫前，先花點時間好好享受成功。

root.note: 品嚐滋味

senses.en: a sheath for a sword or dagger

ex.en: The knight slid his sword back into its scabbard.
ex.zh: 騎士把劍插回劍鞘。

senses.en: the state of being in short supply

ex.en: The scarcity of water is a serious problem in the region.
ex.zh: 缺水是這個地區的嚴重問題。

root.note: 稀少的狀態

senses.en: involving or relating to serious academic study

ex.en: She has published several scholarly articles on ancient history.
ex.zh: 她發表過幾篇關於古代史的學術文章。

parts.m: school 學校（希臘文 skholē，閒暇）

root.note: 學者的 → 學術的

senses.en: relating to schools and education
relating to medieval philosophy based on Aristotle and the Church

ex.en: Her scholastic achievements earned her a full scholarship.
ex.zh: 她的學業成就為她贏得全額獎學金。

root.note: 學校的

senses.en: a tiny trace or amount

ex.en: There is not a scintilla of evidence to support his claim.
ex.zh: 沒有一丁點證據能支持他的說法。

root.note: 一點火花 → 一點點

mn: 常用於否定句：not a scintilla of（一點都沒有）。

senses.en: to give off flashes of light; sparkle
to be brilliantly clever or lively

ex.en: Stars seem to scintillate on a clear winter night.
ex.zh: 在晴朗的冬夜，星星好像在閃爍。

root.note: 冒出火花 → 閃爍

mn: 形容詞 scintillating（妙語如珠的）更常見。

senses.en: the range of a subject or activity
the opportunity to do something

ex.en: That question is beyond the scope of this course.
ex.zh: 那個問題超出這門課的範圍。

parts.m: look at, target 看、目標（希臘文 skopos）

root.note: 看得到的範圍

senses.en: a dishonest or unscrupulous person

ex.en: The scoundrel stole money from his own grandmother.
ex.zh: 那個惡棍連自己奶奶的錢都偷。

senses.en: to write or draw carelessly or hurriedly
a piece of careless writing or drawing

ex.en: Let me scribble down your phone number before I forget.
ex.zh: 讓我趁忘記之前把你的電話號碼隨手記下來。

root.note: 匆忙地寫 → 潦草書寫

senses.en: a person who copied documents by hand before printing
(humorous) a writer or journalist

ex.en: A medieval scribe could spend years copying a single book.
ex.zh: 中世紀的抄寫員可能要花好幾年抄寫一本書。

root.note: 寫字的人 → 抄寫員

senses.en: the written text of a play, film, or broadcast
handwriting or a system of writing
a list of computer instructions

ex.en: The actor forgot his lines and had to check the script.
ex.zh: 演員忘詞，只好看一下劇本。

root.note: 寫下來的東西 → 劇本

senses.en: relating to the Bible or other sacred writings

ex.en: The pastor supported his argument with a Scriptural passage.
ex.zh: 牧師引用一段經文來支持他的論點。

root.note: （神聖）寫下的文字的 → 經文的

senses.en: a feeling of doubt about whether an action is morally right
to hesitate because of moral doubts

ex.en: He had no scruple about lying to get what he wanted.
ex.zh: 他為了得到想要的東西，說謊毫無顧忌。

parts.m: small sharp stone 小尖石（拉丁文 scrupulus）

root.note: 鞋裡的小石子讓人不安 → 良心上的顧慮

senses.en: very careful and thorough
very concerned to do what is morally right

ex.en: The accountant was scrupulous about recording every expense.
ex.zh: 那位會計師對記錄每筆開支都一絲不苟。

root.note: 連小石子都在意 → 一絲不苟

mn: 反義字 unscrupulous（不擇手段的）也很常考。

senses.en: making false and insulting statements to damage someone's reputation

ex.en: The blog spread scurrilous rumors about the mayor's family.
ex.zh: 那個部落格散播中傷市長家人的謠言。

root.note: 小丑般粗鄙地嘲弄人 → 惡意中傷的

senses.en: to run with short, quick steps
to deliberately sink a ship; to cause a plan to fail

ex.en: A lack of funding could scuttle the entire project.
ex.zh: 缺乏資金可能讓整個計畫泡湯。

senses.en: a tool with a long curved blade used for cutting grass or crops
to cut with a scythe

ex.en: The farmer used a scythe to cut the tall wheat.
ex.zh: 農夫用長柄大鐮刀割高高的小麥。

mn: 死神的標準配備就是 scythe；注意 c 不發音，th 唸 [ð]。

senses.en: a meeting at which people try to contact the dead

ex.en: The guests held hands during the seance in the dark room.
ex.zh: 在黑暗的房間裡舉行通靈會時，客人們手牽著手。

parts.m: sit 坐（法文 séance，拉丁文 sedere）

root.note: 坐下來的聚會 → 降神會

senses.en: to burn or scorch the surface of something with sudden heat
to cause sudden, sharp pain; to be deeply memorable

ex.en: Sear the steak over high heat for two minutes on each side.
ex.zh: 用大火把牛排每面煎兩分鐘封住表面。

senses.en: relating to oil or fat, especially the oily glands of the skin

ex.en: Acne occurs when sebaceous glands become clogged.
ex.zh: 皮脂腺阻塞時就會長青春痘。

parts.m: tallow, grease 油脂（拉丁文 sebum）

root.note: 油脂的

senses.en: (math) a line that cuts a curve at two or more points
(math) the ratio of the hypotenuse to the adjacent side of an angle

ex.en: Draw a secant that crosses the circle at two points.
ex.zh: 畫一條與圓交於兩點的割線。

root.note: 切過去的線 → 割線

senses.en: to formally withdraw from a political union or organization

ex.en: Several southern states voted to secede from the Union in 1861.
ex.zh: 1861 年，南方數州投票決定脫離聯邦。

root.note: 分開走 → 脫離

senses.en: the formal withdrawal from a political union

ex.en: The region's secession led to years of conflict.
ex.zh: 該地區的脫離導致多年的衝突。

root.note: 分開走 → 脫離

senses.en: to keep someone away from other people

ex.en: The writer chose to seclude herself in a cabin to finish her novel.
ex.zh: 那位作家選擇隱居在小屋裡完成她的小說。

root.note: 關起來與人分開 → 隔離

senses.en: the state of being private and away from other people

ex.en: After the scandal, the actor lived in seclusion for years.
ex.zh: 醜聞之後，那位演員隱居了好幾年。

root.note: 關起來與人分開 → 隱居

senses.en: of mediocre or poor quality

ex.en: The hotel was expensive but offered only second-rate service.
ex.zh: 這家飯店很貴，但服務只有二流水準。

root.note: 第二等級 → 二流的

senses.en: less important than something else
coming after or derived from something primary
relating to education for students aged about 11 to 18

ex.en: For him, money is secondary to job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 對他來說，錢比工作成就感次要。

root.note: 排在後面的 → 次要的

mn: secondary school 是中學；secondary source 是二手資料。

senses.en: used to introduce a second point or reason

ex.en: Firstly, the plan is too expensive; secondly, it will take too long.
ex.zh: 第一，這個計畫太貴；第二，它太花時間。

senses.en: the action or state of keeping something secret

ex.en: The negotiations were conducted in complete secrecy.
ex.zh: 談判在完全保密的情況下進行。

root.note: 分開藏起來 → 祕密

senses.en: a person who handles office work, letters, and appointments
the head of a government department

ex.en: The secretary scheduled the meeting for Monday morning.
ex.zh: 祕書把會議排在星期一早上。

root.note: 負責機密事務的人 → 祕書

mn: 美國的 Secretary of State 是國務卿，相當於外交部長。

senses.en: inclined to hide feelings or information
senses.zh: 遮遮掩掩的；守口如瓶的

ex.en: He became secretive and stopped telling his parents where he went.
ex.zh: 他變得神神祕祕，不再告訴父母他去哪裡。

root.note: 愛保密的

senses.en: calm, quiet, and unhurried
to calm someone with a drug

ex.en: The vet had to sedate the frightened dog before examining it.
ex.zh: 獸醫在檢查那隻受驚的狗之前，得先給牠打鎮靜劑。

root.note: 使坐定、安靜下來 → 沉著的；使鎮靜

senses.en: involving a lot of sitting and little physical activity
(of animals or people) staying in one place

ex.en: A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 久坐不動的生活方式會增加心臟病的風險。

root.note: 一直坐著的 → 久坐的

senses.en: matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid

ex.en: Over thousands of years, sediment built up at the bottom of the lake.
ex.zh: 經過數千年，湖底堆積了沉積物。

root.note: 沉坐在底部的東西 → 沉積物

senses.en: speech or action that encourages rebellion against the government

ex.en: The journalist was arrested and charged with sedition.
ex.zh: 那名記者被捕，並被控煽動叛亂。

root.note: 分開走、另立門戶 → 叛亂

senses.en: inciting rebellion against authority

ex.en: The government banned the seditious pamphlets.
ex.zh: 政府查禁了那些煽動叛亂的小冊子。

root.note: 煽動分離的 → 煽動叛亂的

senses.en: to attract someone into sexual activity
to persuade someone to do something unwise by making it attractive

ex.en: Low prices can seduce shoppers into buying things they don't need.
ex.zh: 低價會誘使消費者買下不需要的東西。

root.note: 把人引到一旁 → 誘惑

senses.en: showing dedication and careful effort; diligent

ex.en: The sedulous student reviewed her notes every single night.
ex.zh: 那位勤勉的學生每天晚上都複習筆記。

parts.m: zealous 熱心的（拉丁文 sedulus）

root.note: 熱心投入的 → 勤勉的

senses.en: a person who can supposedly see the future

ex.en: The king asked the old seer what the future held.
ex.zh: 國王問那位老預言家未來會如何。

root.note: 看得見（未來）的人 → 預言家

senses.en: to be filled with intense but hidden anger
(of a liquid) to boil or churn
(of a place) to be crowded with moving people

ex.en: She would silently seethe whenever her brother took credit for her work.
ex.zh: 每當哥哥搶她的功勞，她都會默默怒火中燒。

senses.en: a feudal lord; a man of rank

ex.en: Every peasant owed labor to the local seignior.
ex.zh: 每個農奴都必須為當地領主服勞役。

parts.m: older 年長的（拉丁文 senior）

root.note: 年長者 → 領主（senior 同源）

senses.en: an instrument that measures and records earthquakes

ex.en: The seismograph recorded a strong earthquake early this morning.
ex.zh: 地震儀記錄到今天清晨的一場強烈地震。

root.note: 記錄地震的儀器

senses.en: to take hold of suddenly and forcefully
to take an opportunity eagerly
(of police) to confiscate

ex.en: You should seize every chance to practice speaking English.
ex.zh: 你應該把握每個練習說英文的機會。

mn: 拼法例外：seize 是 ei，不是 ie。

senses.en: careful in choosing; choosing only the best
affecting only certain things

ex.en: The university is very selective and accepts only ten percent of applicants.
ex.zh: 這所大學非常挑，只錄取百分之十的申請者。

root.note: 分開挑選的 → 挑剔的

senses.en: pride and confidence in oneself

ex.en: Losing his job hurt his self-respect more than his bank account.
ex.zh: 失業對他自尊的打擊比對存款的打擊還大。

root.note: 回頭好好看待自己 → 自尊

senses.en: the outward appearance of something, often when the reality is different

ex.en: After the storm, the town slowly returned to some semblance of normal life.
ex.zh: 暴風雨後，小鎮慢慢恢復了一點正常生活的樣子。

root.note: 看起來相似 → 表象

senses.en: occurring twice a year
senses.zh: 半年一次的；一年兩次的

ex.en: The store is holding its semiannual sale this weekend.
ex.zh: 這家店這個週末舉辦半年一次的特賣。

root.note: 每半年的

senses.en: half of a circle

ex.en: The children sat in a semicircle around the teacher.
ex.zh: 孩子們圍著老師坐成半圓形。

root.note: 半個圓

senses.en: partly civilized

ex.en: Older travel books often described foreign tribes as semicivilized.
ex.zh: 舊時的遊記常把外國部落描述成半開化的。

root.note: 一半文明化的

mn: 這是帶有殖民偏見的舊式用詞，現代文章中應避免使用。

senses.en: partly conscious; not fully awake or aware

ex.en: The injured hiker was semiconscious when rescuers found him.
ex.zh: 救援人員找到那位受傷的登山客時，他已經半昏迷。

root.note: 一半清醒的

senses.en: a class or meeting for discussion and training

ex.en: I signed up for a seminar on public speaking.
ex.zh: 我報名了一場關於公開演講的研討會。

root.note: 播撒知識種子的地方 → 研討會

senses.en: a school that trains priests, ministers, or rabbis

ex.en: He studied at a seminary for four years before becoming a priest.
ex.zh: 他在神學院念了四年才成為神父。

root.note: 培育種子的苗圃 → 培育神職人員的學校

senses.en: having weakened mental ability because of old age

ex.en: Her grandfather is ninety but not at all senile.
ex.zh: 她爺爺九十歲了，但一點也不糊塗。

root.note: 年老的 → 衰老的（senior 同源）

senses.en: a physical feeling
a state of great public excitement, or its cause
senses.zh: 轟動；轟動一時的人或事

ex.en: The young singer became an overnight sensation.
ex.zh: 那位年輕歌手一夜爆紅。

root.note: 感覺；引起強烈感受 → 轟動

senses.en: one of the faculties such as sight or hearing
good judgment
to become aware of without being told

ex.en: Dogs have a very strong sense of smell.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺非常靈敏。

root.note: 感覺

mn: make sense 是「合理」；common sense 是「常識」。

senses.en: the ability to appreciate and respond to complex emotions or art
(sensibilities) a person's feelings that can easily be offended

ex.en: The poet's sensibility shows in every line she writes.
ex.zh: 這位詩人細膩的感受力展現在她寫的每一行詩裡。

root.note: 感受的能力

mn: 不是 sense（理智）的名詞；珍．奧斯汀的《理性與感性》就是 Sense and Sensibility。

senses.en: quick to detect or respond to slight changes
easily upset or offended
senses.zh: 易受傷害的；神經過敏的

senses.en: requiring careful handling; secret

ex.en: Politics can be a sensitive topic at family dinners.
ex.zh: 在家庭聚餐時，政治可能是個敏感話題。

root.note: 容易感覺到的 → 敏感的

senses.en: the sensory apparatus or faculties considered as a whole

ex.en: Virtual reality aims to engage the entire human sensorium.
ex.zh: 虛擬實境的目標是調動人全部的感官。

root.note: 產生感覺的地方 → 感覺中樞

senses.en: relating to physical, especially sexual, pleasure
senses.zh: 肉慾的；感官享樂的；性感的

ex.en: The perfume ad showed a slow, sensual dance.
ex.zh: 那支香水廣告拍了一段緩慢而性感的舞蹈。

root.note: 身體感覺上的 → 肉慾的

mn: sensual 偏向肉體慾望；sensuous 偏向美感享受。

senses.en: relating to or pleasing the senses, especially aesthetically

ex.en: The painter was known for his sensuous use of color.
ex.zh: 那位畫家以色彩運用帶給人豐富的感官享受而聞名。

root.note: 訴諸感官的

mn: sensuous 是感官上的美感（音樂、色彩）；sensual 是肉慾的。

senses.en: a group of words that expresses a complete thought
the punishment given by a court
to state the punishment for a convicted person

ex.en: The judge gave him a sentence of five years in prison.
ex.zh: 法官判他五年徒刑。

root.note: 表達意見 → 句子；法官的意見 → 判決

senses.en: the ability to perceive or feel things

ex.en: Scientists debate whether fish have sentience and can feel pain.
ex.zh: 科學家爭論魚是否有感知能力、會不會感到疼痛。

root.note: 能感覺 → 知覺

senses.en: able to perceive or feel things
senses.zh: 有知覺的；有感知能力的

ex.en: The movie is about a robot that becomes sentient.
ex.zh: 這部電影講一個產生自我意識的機器人。

root.note: 能感覺的 → 有知覺的

senses.en: a soldier or guard who keeps watch

ex.en: An old oak tree stood like a sentinel at the edge of the field.
ex.zh: 一棵老橡樹像哨兵一樣佇立在田野邊緣。

root.note: 負責察覺動靜的人 → 哨兵

senses.en: able to be separated or treated separately

ex.en: In this case, the two issues are not easily separable.
ex.zh: 在這個案例中，這兩個問題不容易分開處理。

root.note: 可以分開安排的

senses.en: [ˋsɛpəˏret] to cause to move or be apart
[ˋsɛpərɪt] forming a unit by itself; not joined

ex.en: Please separate the recyclables from the regular trash.
ex.zh: 請把可回收物和一般垃圾分開。

root.note: 分開安排 → 分離

mn: 拼法常錯：中間是 -par-（there is "a rat" in sep-a-rate）。

senses.en: a person who supports separation of a group from a larger body, especially a country
supporting such separation

ex.en: The separatist movement demanded independence for the region.
ex.zh: 這個分離主義運動要求該地區獨立。

root.note: 主張分離的人

senses.en: lasting for or occurring every seven years
senses.zh: 每七年一次的；持續七年的

ex.en: The town celebrates a septennial festival that draws huge crowds.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮每七年舉辦一次節慶，吸引大批人潮。

root.note: 七年的

senses.en: a small room or monument cut in rock where a dead person is buried

ex.en: The king was laid to rest in a marble sepulcher.
ex.zh: 國王被安葬在一座大理石墓室中。

root.note: 埋葬之處 → 墳墓

senses.en: inclined to follow others without thinking; lacking independence

ex.en: The sequacious crowd cheered whatever the leader said.
ex.zh: 盲從的群眾對領袖說的任何話都報以歡呼。

root.note: 很愛跟隨的 → 盲從的

senses.en: a book, film, or game that continues an earlier story
something that follows as a result

ex.en: Fans are waiting eagerly for the sequel to the hit movie.
ex.zh: 影迷熱切期待這部賣座電影的續集。

root.note: 跟在後面的 → 續集

senses.en: a particular order in which things follow each other
a set of related events or things

ex.en: Put the pictures in the correct sequence to tell the story.
ex.zh: 把圖片按照正確的順序排好來說故事。

root.note: 一個跟著一個 → 順序

senses.en: following in order or as a result

ex.en: Each sequent chapter builds on the ideas of the one before.
ex.zh: 每一個接續的章節都建立在前一章的概念上。

root.note: 跟在後面的

senses.en: to isolate or hide away
to take legal possession of property until a debt is paid
(science) to absorb and store, such as carbon

ex.en: The judge decided to sequester the jury during the trial.
ex.zh: 法官決定在審判期間隔離陪審團。

root.note: 交給第三方保管 → 隔離、扣押

senses.en: to take legal possession of assets until a debt is paid

ex.en: The court can sequestrate the company's assets to pay its creditors.
ex.zh: 法院可以扣押公司資產來償還債權人。

root.note: 交給第三方保管 → 扣押

senses.en: a noncommissioned officer in the army or a police officer below lieutenant

ex.en: The sergeant ordered the soldiers to line up.
ex.zh: 中士命令士兵排好隊。

root.note: 服事的人 → 士官

mn: 拼法和發音不同：ser 唸成 [sɑr]。

senses.en: an officer who keeps order in a legislature or court

ex.en: The sergeant-at-arms escorted the noisy protester out of the chamber.
ex.zh: 警衛官把吵鬧的抗議者帶出議事廳。

senses.en: a high-ranking noncommissioned officer

ex.en: The sergeant-major inspected the troops before the parade.
ex.zh: 士官長在閱兵前檢閱部隊。

senses.en: the action of helping or doing work for someone
a system supplying a public need
a religious ceremony

ex.en: The restaurant is famous for its friendly service.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳以親切的服務出名。

root.note: 服務

senses.en: fulfilling its function adequately; usable
functional rather than attractive

ex.en: The old car is not pretty, but it is still serviceable.
ex.zh: 這台舊車不好看，但還能用。

root.note: 還能提供服務的 → 堪用的

senses.en: the state of being a slave or completely controlled by someone

ex.en: Many immigrants were trapped in servitude to pay off their debts.
ex.zh: 許多移民為了還債而陷入被奴役的處境。

root.note: 做奴隸的狀態

senses.en: the ending of a connection or relationship
money paid to an employee whose job is ended

ex.en: The laid-off workers each received a month of severance pay.
ex.zh: 被裁的員工每人拿到一個月的資遣費。

root.note: 切斷關係 → 斷絕；解雇補償

senses.en: to a very great or serious degree
in a strict or harsh way

ex.en: Several houses were severely damaged by the flood.
ex.zh: 好幾間房子被洪水嚴重損壞。

root.note: 嚴重地

senses.en: a group of six people playing music or singing together, or music for them

ex.en: A jazz sextet played at the wedding reception.
ex.zh: 一個爵士六重奏樂團在婚宴上表演。

root.note: 六人組

senses.en: consisting of six parts; six times as much
to multiply by six

ex.en: Sales managed to sextuple in just two years.
ex.zh: 銷售額在短短兩年內成長了六倍。

root.note: 六倍的

senses.en: nothing but; complete (used for emphasis)
(of a cliff or wall) extremely steep
(of fabric) very thin

ex.en: She won the race through sheer determination.
ex.zh: 她完全靠決心贏得這場比賽。

senses.en: lazy and lacking ambition

ex.en: His parents worried that he had become shiftless after dropping out of school.
ex.zh: 父母擔心他輟學後變得懶散不求上進。

root.note: 不想辦法、不努力 → 懶惰的

senses.en: having sharp judgment, especially in practical matters

ex.en: She made a shrewd decision to buy the house before prices rose.
ex.zh: 她很精明，在房價上漲前就買了房子。

senses.en: to make a high, loud cry
a high, loud cry

ex.en: The children began to shriek with delight when they saw the clown.
ex.zh: 孩子們看到小丑，開心得尖叫起來。

senses.en: the process or amount of becoming smaller
loss of stock in a store due to theft or damage

ex.en: Wash the sweater in cold water to prevent shrinkage.
ex.zh: 用冷水洗毛衣，以免縮水。

root.note: 收縮的量

senses.en: to wrinkle and shrink, especially from heat or dryness

ex.en: Without water, the leaves will shrivel and turn brown.
ex.zh: 沒有水的話，葉子會枯萎變成褐色。

senses.en: to walk by dragging one's feet
to mix playing cards into a random order
to rearrange or move things around

ex.en: Please shuffle the cards before you deal them.
ex.zh: 發牌前請先洗牌。

senses.en: a hissing sound, especially of s or sh

ex.en: The poem's sibilance imitates the sound of the sea.
ex.zh: 這首詩大量的嘶嘶音模仿海浪的聲音。

parts.m: hiss 嘶嘶作響（拉丁文 sibilare）

root.note: 嘶嘶聲

senses.en: making a hissing sound
a speech sound like s, z, or sh

ex.en: The snake made a low, sibilant sound.
ex.zh: 那條蛇發出低沉的嘶嘶聲。

root.note: 嘶嘶作響的

senses.en: to make a hissing sound; to pronounce with a hiss

ex.en: The steam began to sibilate as it escaped from the pipe.
ex.zh: 蒸氣從管子冒出時開始嘶嘶作響。

root.note: 發嘶嘶聲

senses.en: directed to or from one side; sideways
toward the side; obliquely

ex.en: She gave him a sidelong glance to see if he was listening.
ex.zh: 她斜眼瞄了他一下，看他有沒有在聽。

root.note: 沿著側邊 → 斜的

senses.en: relating to the stars or measured by them

ex.en: A sidereal day is about four minutes shorter than a solar day.
ex.zh: 一個恆星日比一個太陽日短大約四分鐘。

root.note: 星星的

senses.en: a military operation surrounding a place to force it to surrender
a period of persistent attack or pressure

ex.en: The city survived a siege that lasted almost a year.
ex.zh: 這座城市撐過了將近一年的圍城。

parts.m: seat 座位（拉丁文 sedere 坐）

root.note: 軍隊坐在城外不走 → 包圍

mn: under siege 是「被包圍、受到強烈攻擊」。

senses.en: the quality of being important
the meaning of something

ex.en: Historians still debate the significance of the treaty.
ex.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在爭論這份條約的重要性。

root.note: 做出記號、表示意義 → 意義、重要性

senses.en: large or important enough to be noticed
having a particular meaning

ex.en: There has been a significant increase in the number of students.
ex.zh: 學生人數大幅增加。

root.note: 值得做記號的 → 重要的

mn: significant other 是「另一半、伴侶」。

senses.en: the meaning of a word or sign

ex.en: Linguists study the signification of words across cultures.
ex.zh: 語言學家研究詞語在不同文化中的含義。

root.note: 用記號表達的東西 → 含義

senses.en: alike but not identical

ex.en: The two brothers have similar tastes in music.
ex.zh: 這兩兄弟的音樂品味很相似。

root.note: 相似的

senses.en: a figure of speech comparing two things using "like" or "as"

ex.en: "As brave as a lion" is a simile.
ex.zh: 「像獅子一樣勇敢」是一個明喻。

root.note: 用「像」來比喻 → 明喻

mn: simile 用 like/as；metaphor（隱喻）直接說 A 是 B。

senses.en: the quality of being similar; resemblance
a comparison or parable

ex.en: The novel has a strong similitude to real events of the war.
ex.zh: 這本小說與那場戰爭的真實事件非常相似。

root.note: 相似的狀態

senses.en: to make something easier to understand or do

ex.en: The new app helps simplify the process of paying bills.
ex.zh: 這個新 App 幫忙簡化繳帳單的流程。

root.note: 使簡單

senses.en: to imitate the appearance or conditions of something
to pretend to have or feel

ex.en: Pilots train on machines that simulate real flight conditions.
ex.zh: 飛行員在模擬真實飛行狀況的機器上受訓。

root.note: 使看起來相似 → 模擬

senses.en: happening at the same time

ex.en: The speech was broadcast with simultaneous translation into five languages.
ex.zh: 這場演講同步翻譯成五種語言播出。

parts.m: at the same time 同時（拉丁文 simul）

root.note: 同時發生的

senses.en: a job that pays well but requires little work

ex.en: His title sounded impressive, but the job was really a sinecure.
ex.zh: 他的頭銜聽起來很厲害，但那份工作其實是個閒差。

root.note: 不必操心照顧（教區）的職位 → 閒差

senses.en: to burn slightly on the surface

ex.en: Be careful not to singe your eyebrows when you light the grill.
ex.zh: 點烤爐時小心別燒到眉毛。

mn: 別和 sing（唱歌）搞混：singe 多了個 e，唸 [sɪndʒ]。

senses.en: giving the impression that something harmful or evil is happening

ex.en: There was something sinister about the empty house at the end of the street.
ex.zh: 街尾那間空屋有種說不出的陰森感。

root.note: 古代認為左邊不吉利 → 不祥的

senses.en: the quality of having many curves; a bend

ex.en: The sinuosity of the mountain road made the drive slow.
ex.zh: 山路蜿蜒曲折，讓車速變得很慢。

parts.m: curve, bend 彎曲（拉丁文 sinus）

root.note: 彎曲的程度

senses.en: having many curves and turns
moving in a graceful, flowing way

ex.en: A sinuous river winds through the green valley.
ex.zh: 一條蜿蜒的河流穿過翠綠的山谷。

root.note: 彎彎曲曲的

senses.en: a hollow space in the bones of the face connected to the nose

ex.en: A sinus infection can cause headaches and a stuffy nose.
ex.zh: 鼻竇炎會造成頭痛和鼻塞。

parts.m: curve, hollow 彎曲、凹處（拉丁文）

root.note: 骨頭裡的凹洞 → 鼻竇

senses.en: a device that makes a loud warning sound
(Greek myth) a creature whose singing lured sailors to their death; a dangerously attractive woman
senses.zh: （希臘神話）海妖賽蓮；妖豔危險的女子

ex.en: We heard the siren of an ambulance in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們聽到遠處救護車的警笛聲。

mn: siren song 比喻「誘人但危險的吸引力」。

senses.en: a hot, dusty wind blowing from North Africa across the Mediterranean
senses.zh: 西洛可風（北非吹向南歐的熱風）

ex.en: The sirocco brought red dust all the way to Sicily.
ex.zh: 西洛可風把紅色沙塵一路吹到西西里島。

senses.en: the relationship between sisters; a feeling of friendship among women
a group of women with a shared interest, especially a religious order

ex.en: The team members shared a strong sense of sisterhood.
ex.zh: 隊員之間有著深厚的姊妹情誼。

root.note: 姊妹關係

senses.en: a person who tends to doubt accepted opinions
senses.zh: 懷疑論者；抱持懷疑態度的人

ex.en: Even the biggest skeptic was convinced after seeing the evidence.
ex.zh: 連最多疑的人看到證據後也被說服了。

parts.m: examine, consider 審視（希臘文 skeptesthai）

root.note: 凡事都要仔細審視的人 → 懷疑者

senses.en: a doubting attitude toward claims or beliefs

ex.en: The public greeted the company's promises with skepticism.
ex.zh: 民眾對這家公司的承諾抱持懷疑。

root.note: 凡事審視的態度 → 懷疑

senses.en: a small, light boat for rowing or sailing

ex.en: The fisherman rowed his skiff across the calm lake.
ex.zh: 漁夫划著小艇越過平靜的湖面。

senses.en: a brief fight between small groups of soldiers
a short argument
to engage in a skirmish

ex.en: A skirmish broke out between the two groups of fans after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，兩派球迷爆發小衝突。

senses.en: skill in using the hands, especially to deceive

ex.en: The magician's sleight of hand amazed the audience.
ex.zh: 魔術師的巧妙手法讓觀眾看得目瞪口呆。

mn: 幾乎只用在 sleight of hand（手法、障眼法）；發音同 slight。

senses.en: small in degree; minor
(of a person) small and thin
to insult by treating with disrespect

ex.en: There has been a slight improvement in his condition.
ex.zh: 他的病情稍微好轉了。

senses.en: lazy and inactive

ex.en: After a slothful weekend on the couch, he felt guilty.
ex.zh: 在沙發上懶散度過一個週末之後，他感到很內疚。

root.note: 充滿懶惰的

mn: sloth 也是動作超慢的「樹懶」。

senses.en: a lazy, sluggish person

ex.en: The old proverb tells the sluggard to learn from the busy ant.
ex.zh: 古老的箴言叫懶惰的人向勤勞的螞蟻學習。

root.note: 遲緩的人 → 懶漢

senses.en: willing to talk and do things with other people

ex.en: Our new neighbor is very sociable and invited everyone to dinner.
ex.zh: 我們的新鄰居很好客，請大家吃晚飯。

root.note: 可以當同伴的 → 愛交際的

senses.en: a political and economic theory in which society or the state owns or controls major industries

ex.en: The class compared capitalism and socialism.
ex.zh: 課堂上比較了資本主義和社會主義。

root.note: 以社會為主的主義

senses.en: a person who supports socialism
relating to socialism

ex.en: The socialist party promised free healthcare for all.
ex.zh: 社會黨承諾全民免費醫療。

root.note: 支持社會主義的人

senses.en: the study of human society and social behavior

ex.en: She is majoring in sociology because she wants to understand inequality.
ex.zh: 她主修社會學，因為她想了解不平等的問題。

root.note: 研究社會的學問

senses.en: (poetic) the sun, personified; the Roman sun god

ex.en: In the old poem, Sol drives his golden chariot across the sky.
ex.zh: 在那首古詩裡，太陽神駕著金色戰車橫越天空。

root.note: 太陽

mn: solar（太陽的）就是從 Sol 來的。

senses.en: comfort in a time of sadness
to give comfort to

ex.en: After her father died, she found solace in music.
ex.zh: 父親過世後，她在音樂中找到慰藉。

root.note: 安慰

senses.en: relating to or powered by the sun

ex.en: The school installed solar panels on its roof.
ex.zh: 學校在屋頂裝了太陽能板。

root.note: 太陽的

senses.en: a soft metal alloy melted to join metal parts
to join with solder

ex.en: You need to solder the wire to the circuit board.
ex.zh: 你需要把電線焊到電路板上。

parts.m: solid 固體（拉丁文 solidare 使堅固）

root.note: 使接合處堅固 → 焊接

mn: 美式發音 l 不發音，唸 [ˋsɑdɚ]。

senses.en: a person who serves in an army
(soldier on) to keep going despite difficulties

ex.en: The soldier wrote letters home every week.
ex.zh: 那名士兵每週都寫信回家。

senses.en: a grammatical mistake
a breach of good manners

ex.en: The editor corrected every solecism in the student's essay.
ex.zh: 編輯把學生作文裡的每個文法錯誤都改正了。

parts.m: speaking incorrectly 說話不正確（希臘文 soloikos，指 Soloi 城的人說希臘語不標準）

root.note: 像 Soloi 城人一樣說錯話 → 語法錯誤

senses.en: (British) a lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares documents
(US) a person who asks for business or donations
(US) the chief law officer of a city or department

ex.en: She asked her solicitor to review the contract before signing.
ex.zh: 她在簽約前請事務律師先審閱合約。

root.note: 替人請求、辦事的人

mn: 美國門口常見的 No Solicitors 是「謝絕推銷」。

senses.en: care or concern for someone

ex.en: The nurse treated every patient with great solicitude.
ex.zh: 那位護理師對每位病人都非常關懷。

parts.m: anxious 焦慮的（拉丁文 sollicitus）

root.note: 為人焦慮擔心 → 關懷

senses.en: a speech in a play in which a character speaks their thoughts aloud alone

ex.en: Hamlet's soliloquy "To be or not to be" is world-famous.
ex.zh: 哈姆雷特那段「生存還是毀滅」的獨白舉世聞名。

root.note: 一個人說話 → 獨白

senses.en: the time of year when the sun is farthest north or south, giving the longest or shortest day

ex.en: The summer solstice is the longest day of the year.
ex.zh: 夏至是一年中白天最長的一天。

root.note: 太陽彷彿停住不動 → 至日

senses.en: able to be dissolved in a liquid
(of a problem) able to be solved

ex.en: Sugar is soluble in water, but sand is not.
ex.zh: 糖可溶於水，沙子則不行。

root.note: 可以鬆開、溶開的

senses.en: having enough money to pay one's debts
a liquid that can dissolve other substances

ex.en: The business struggled but managed to stay solvent.
ex.zh: 這家公司經營艱難，但仍有能力償債。

root.note: 能解開（債務、物質）的

senses.en: dark or dull in color
serious, sad, and gloomy

ex.en: The mood at the funeral was somber.
ex.zh: 葬禮上的氣氛很凝重。

root.note: 在陰影之下 → 昏暗、陰沉

senses.en: causing sleep

ex.en: The professor's somniferous lecture put half the class to sleep.
ex.zh: 教授那堂催眠般的課讓半個班都睡著了。

root.note: 帶來睡眠的 → 催眠的

senses.en: sleepiness; drowsiness

ex.en: This medicine may cause somnolence, so do not drive after taking it.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能讓人嗜睡，服用後請勿開車。

root.note: 想睡的狀態

senses.en: sleepy; drowsy
causing sleepiness; very quiet

ex.en: We drove through a somnolent village where nothing seemed to move.
ex.zh: 我們開車經過一個寂靜的小村莊，彷彿一切都靜止了。

root.note: 想睡的

senses.en: a piece of music for one or two instruments, usually in several movements

ex.en: She played a Beethoven sonata at her piano recital.
ex.zh: 她在鋼琴獨奏會上彈了一首貝多芬的奏鳴曲。

root.note: 用樂器發聲演奏的曲子 → 奏鳴曲

senses.en: a poem of fourteen lines with a fixed rhyme scheme

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote more than 150 poems in the sonnet form.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞寫了超過 150 首十四行詩。

root.note: 小小的歌 → 十四行詩

senses.en: (of a sound) deep, full, and rich
(of speech) impressive in style

ex.en: The actor's sonorous voice filled the whole theater.
ex.zh: 那位演員渾厚的嗓音響徹整個劇院。

root.note: 聲音飽滿的 → 宏亮的

senses.en: a person believed to be able to predict the future

ex.en: The soothsayer warned Caesar to beware the Ides of March.
ex.zh: 預言家警告凱撒要小心三月十五日。

root.note: 說出真相的人 → 預言家

senses.en: a false argument that seems clever, used to deceive

ex.en: His claim that stealing from the rich is fair is a mere sophism.
ex.zh: 他說偷有錢人的東西很公平，這只是一種詭辯。

root.note: 耍聰明的論點 → 詭辯

senses.en: using clever but false arguments

ex.en: The lawyer's sophistical reasoning did not fool the judge.
ex.zh: 律師的詭辯沒有騙過法官。

root.note: 耍聰明的 → 詭辯的

senses.en: a person with a lot of worldly experience and refined taste
senses.zh: 老於世故的人；品味高雅的人

senses.en: to make less natural or more refined

ex.en: The city sophisticate found country life a little boring.
ex.zh: 那個見多識廣的都市人覺得鄉下生活有點無聊。

root.note: 變得聰明世故

senses.en: the use of clever but false arguments to deceive

ex.en: The debate was full of sophistry and empty slogans.
ex.zh: 這場辯論充斥著詭辯和空洞的口號。

root.note: 古希臘「智者（sophist）」的手法 → 詭辯

senses.en: the highest singing voice, or a singer with this voice

ex.en: The soprano hit the high note perfectly.
ex.zh: 女高音完美地唱出那個高音。

parts.m: above 上面（義大利文 sopra，= super）

root.note: 在最上面的聲部 → 女高音

senses.en: the use of magic, especially evil magic

ex.en: In the story, the queen used sorcery to put the princess to sleep.
ex.zh: 故事裡，王后用巫術讓公主沉睡。

parts.m: lot, fate 籤、命運（拉丁文 sors）

root.note: 抽籤占卜命運 → 巫術

senses.en: morally shameful or dishonest
dirty and unpleasant

ex.en: The newspaper revealed the sordid details of the bribery scandal.
ex.zh: 報紙揭露了這起賄賂醜聞的不堪細節。

root.note: 骯髒的 → 卑鄙的

senses.en: a thing kept as a reminder of a place or event

ex.en: I bought a small souvenir for my sister in Kyoto.
ex.zh: 我在京都幫妹妹買了一個小紀念品。

parts.m: under, up 從下往上（= sub-）

root.note: （回憶）浮上心頭 → 紀念品

senses.en: thinly scattered; small in number or amount

ex.en: Vegetation is sparse in the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠裡植物稀少。

root.note: 散布開來的 → 稀疏的

senses.en: (spartan) simple and lacking comfort or luxury
relating to ancient Sparta

ex.en: The hostel room was Spartan, with only a bed and a chair.
ex.zh: 青年旅館的房間很簡陋，只有一張床和一把椅子。

root.note: 像斯巴達人一樣刻苦 → 簡樸的

senses.en: occurring in brief, irregular bursts
caused by or like a muscle spasm

ex.en: His efforts to study were spasmodic, so his grades stayed low.
ex.zh: 他讀書總是斷斷續續，所以成績一直很差。

root.note: 像痙攣一樣一陣一陣的 → 間歇的

senses.en: to concentrate on a particular subject or skill

ex.en: She decided to specialize in heart surgery.
ex.zh: 她決定專攻心臟外科。

root.note: 專注於某一種類 → 專攻

senses.en: a field in which someone is an expert
a product or dish that a place is famous for

ex.en: Beef noodle soup is the restaurant's specialty.
ex.zh: 牛肉麵是這家餐廳的招牌菜。

root.note: 特別的一種 → 專長、特產

senses.en: money in the form of coins rather than notes

ex.en: During the crisis, banks stopped paying out specie.
ex.zh: 危機期間，銀行停止兌付硬幣。

parts.m: kind, form 形式（拉丁文 in specie，以實物形式）

root.note: 以實物形式支付 → 硬幣

mn: 別和 species（物種）搞混；specie 是硬幣。

senses.en: a group of living things that can breed together

ex.en: This species of frog is found only in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這種青蛙只有在台灣才找得到。

root.note: 外觀相同的一類 → 物種

mn: 單複數同形：one species, two species。

senses.en: an example of something used for study or testing

ex.en: The museum has a rare specimen of an ancient fish.
ex.zh: 博物館有一件罕見的古代魚類標本。

root.note: 拿來看的東西 → 樣本

senses.en: seeming reasonable or true but actually false
senses.zh: 似是而非的；華而不實的

ex.en: His argument sounded good, but it was based on specious reasoning.
ex.zh: 他的論點聽起來不錯，但推理似是而非。

root.note: 只是看起來好看 → 似是而非

senses.en: a person who watches an event, especially a sports event

ex.en: Every spectator in the stadium stood up and cheered.
ex.zh: 體育場裡的每位觀眾都站起來歡呼。

root.note: 看的人 → 觀眾

senses.en: a ghost
something frightening that may happen

ex.en: The specter of war hung over the region.
ex.zh: 戰爭的陰影籠罩著這個地區。

root.note: 看見的幻影 → 鬼魂

senses.en: the band of colors produced when light is split
a wide range of related ideas or qualities

ex.en: People from across the political spectrum supported the bill.
ex.zh: 政治光譜上各派的人都支持這項法案。

root.note: 看得見的景象 → 光譜

senses.en: to form a theory without firm evidence
to invest in something risky hoping for profit

ex.en: Scientists can only speculate about what caused the explosion.
ex.zh: 科學家只能推測爆炸的原因。

root.note: 觀望、揣想 → 推測

senses.en: a person who invests in risky things hoping for quick profit

ex.en: A land speculator bought the farm and sold it a year later for twice the price.
ex.zh: 一個炒地皮的人買下那座農場，一年後以兩倍價格賣出。

root.note: 觀望行情的人 → 投機者

senses.en: the quality of being shaped like a sphere

ex.en: Satellite data confirmed the near sphericity of the planet.
ex.zh: 衛星資料證實這顆行星近乎球形。

root.note: 球的性質

senses.en: a shape that is nearly but not perfectly a sphere

ex.en: Earth is not a perfect ball but a slightly flattened spheroid.
ex.zh: 地球不是完美的球，而是一個稍微扁平的橢球體。

root.note: 像球的形狀

senses.en: an instrument for measuring the curvature of a surface

ex.en: The lab technician used a spherometer to check the curve of the lens.
ex.zh: 實驗室技術員用球徑計檢查鏡片的曲率。

root.note: 測量球面的儀器

senses.en: having spines or thorns; spiny

ex.en: The spinous leaves of the plant protect it from animals.
ex.zh: 這種植物多刺的葉子能保護它不被動物吃掉。

root.note: 有刺的

senses.en: (dated, often offensive) an unmarried woman past the usual age for marriage

ex.en: In the old novel, the spinster aunt lived alone with her cats.
ex.zh: 在那本舊小說裡，未婚的阿姨和她的貓獨自住在一起。

root.note: 紡紗的女人（多為未婚女性）→ 未婚女性

mn: 這是帶貶義的舊式用詞，現代英文通常直接說 single woman。

senses.en: done without planning, from a sudden impulse
happening naturally without an outside cause

ex.en: The crowd burst into spontaneous applause.
ex.zh: 群眾自發地爆出掌聲。

parts.m: of one's own accord 自願（拉丁文 sponte）

root.note: 出於自願的 → 自發的

senses.en: lively and full of energy, especially of an older person

ex.en: My sprightly grandmother still hikes every weekend at eighty.
ex.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了，精神還很好，每週末都去爬山。

root.note: 像精靈一樣輕快 → 活潑的

senses.en: false or fake; not genuine
based on false reasoning

ex.en: The article made spurious claims about the vaccine.
ex.zh: 那篇文章對疫苗提出了不實的說法。

parts.m: illegitimate 私生的（拉丁文 spurius）

root.note: 不正統的 → 假的

senses.en: to argue noisily about something unimportant
a noisy argument over a small matter

ex.en: The kids always squabble over who gets the front seat.
ex.zh: 孩子們總是為了誰坐前座而吵架。

senses.en: extremely dirty and unpleasant, especially from poverty
morally shameful

ex.en: The refugees lived in squalid conditions without clean water.
ex.zh: 難民住在沒有乾淨水源的骯髒環境中。

parts.m: be dirty 骯髒（拉丁文 squalere）

root.note: 骯髒的

senses.en: a person who lives in a building or on land without permission
senses.zh: 擅自占用房屋或土地的人

ex.en: A squatter had moved into the abandoned house.
ex.zh: 有人擅自住進那間廢棄的房子。

root.note: 擅自占住的人

senses.en: (of water or air) not flowing and often smelly
showing no activity or growth

ex.en: Wages have remained stagnant for over a decade.
ex.zh: 薪資已經停滯了十多年。

root.note: 像池塘裡的死水 → 停滯的

senses.en: to stop developing or growing
(of water) to stop flowing and become stale

ex.en: Without new ideas, the company will stagnate.
ex.zh: 沒有新點子，這家公司會停滯不前。

root.note: 變成死水 → 停滯

senses.en: the state of not flowing, moving, or developing

ex.en: The country suffered years of economic stagnation.
ex.zh: 這個國家經歷了多年的經濟停滯。

root.note: 死水的狀態 → 停滯

senses.en: exaggerated and unnatural, as if on stage

ex.en: The actor's stagy performance made the movie feel fake.
ex.zh: 那位演員誇張做作的表演讓這部電影顯得很假。

root.note: 像在舞台上一樣 → 做作的

mn: 也拼作 stagey。

senses.en: serious, dull, and old-fashioned

ex.en: The staid old bank tried to attract young customers with a new app.
ex.zh: 那家古板的老銀行推出新 App，想吸引年輕客戶。

parts.m: stayed 留住（stay 的舊過去分詞）

root.note: 一直停在原地不動 → 古板、沉穩

senses.en: an adult male horse that has not been castrated

ex.en: The black stallion galloped across the field.
ex.zh: 那匹黑色公馬在田野上奔馳。

root.note: 養在馬廄裡配種的馬

senses.en: an upright bar or post that supports something

ex.en: She held on to a metal stanchion as the bus turned.
ex.zh: 公車轉彎時，她抓住一根金屬立柱。

root.note: 立著的柱子

senses.en: a group of lines forming a unit in a poem

ex.en: Read the first stanza of the poem aloud.
ex.zh: 把這首詩的第一節大聲唸出來。

parts.m: room, stopping place 房間、停留處（義大利文）

root.note: 詩中停頓的一個「房間」→ 詩節

senses.en: the skill of managing government and state affairs

ex.en: Ending the war required great statecraft and patience.
ex.zh: 結束這場戰爭需要高明的治國手腕和耐心。

root.note: 治國的技藝

senses.en: not moving or changing
crackling noise on a radio or TV
static electricity

ex.en: Prices have remained static for the past three months.
ex.zh: 過去三個月價格都維持不變。

root.note: 站著不動的 → 靜止的

senses.en: the branch of mechanics dealing with bodies at rest and balanced forces

ex.en: Engineers study statics to make sure bridges stay standing.
ex.zh: 工程師學習靜力學，確保橋樑穩穩站立。

root.note: 研究靜止物體的學科

senses.en: not moving

ex.en: The car hit a stationary truck parked on the shoulder.
ex.zh: 那輛車撞上一台停在路肩的卡車。

root.note: 站在原處的 → 靜止的

mn: stationAry（靜止的，A 想成 at rest）；stationEry（文具，E 想成 envelope）。

senses.en: an expert in statistics

ex.en: The statistician warned that the sample size was too small.
ex.zh: 統計學家警告樣本數太少。

root.note: 統計專家

senses.en: (of a woman) tall, graceful, and dignified
senses.zh: （女性）高挑優雅的；如雕像般的

ex.en: The statuesque model walked confidently down the runway.
ex.zh: 那位身材高挑的模特兒自信地走上伸展台。

root.note: 像雕像一樣 → 高挑優雅

senses.en: a small statue

ex.en: The Oscar is a gold-plated statuette.
ex.zh: 奧斯卡獎是一座鍍金的小雕像。

root.note: 小雕像

senses.en: a person's natural height
importance or reputation gained by ability

ex.en: She is a scientist of international stature.
ex.zh: 她是一位享譽國際的科學家。

root.note: 站起來的高度 → 身高、地位

senses.en: a written law passed by a legislature

ex.en: The new statute makes it illegal to text while driving.
ex.zh: 新法規定開車時傳簡訊是違法的。

root.note: 設立的規定 → 法令

mn: statute of limitations 是「追訴時效」。

senses.en: cautious and secret action or movement
(of aircraft) designed to avoid radar

ex.en: The cat crept toward the bird with great stealth.
ex.zh: 那隻貓悄悄地朝小鳥靠近。

root.note: 像小偷一樣 → 偷偷摸摸

senses.en: relating to stars
outstanding; excellent

ex.en: She gave a stellar performance in the final match.
ex.zh: 她在決賽中表現得非常出色。

root.note: 星星的 → 像明星一樣出色

senses.en: a large area of flat, grassy land without trees, especially in Eastern Europe or Asia

ex.en: Nomads have herded horses across the Mongolian steppe for centuries.
ex.zh: 幾百年來，遊牧民族一直在蒙古大草原上放牧馬群。

mn: 發音同 step；北美的叫 prairie，南美的叫 pampas。

senses.en: British money
(of silver) of standard high purity
excellent; of great value

ex.en: He has a sterling reputation for honesty.
ex.zh: 他以誠實享有極好的名聲。

mn: sterling silver 是純度 92.5% 的「925 純銀」。

senses.en: to prevent something from developing or being expressed
to make it hard to breathe

ex.en: Too many rules can stifle creativity.
ex.zh: 太多規定會扼殺創意。

senses.en: a mark of shame associated with something
the part of a flower that receives pollen

ex.en: There is still a stigma attached to mental illness.
ex.zh: 心理疾病至今仍背負著污名。

parts.m: prick, mark 刺、烙印（希臘文 stizein）

root.note: 烙在身上的印記 → 恥辱

senses.en: a short dagger with a narrow blade
a woman's shoe with a very thin high heel

ex.en: She could barely walk on the cobblestones in her stiletto heels.
ex.zh: 她穿著細高跟鞋，在石板路上幾乎走不動。

parts.m: dagger 匕首（義大利文 stilo）

root.note: 小匕首 → 像匕首一樣細的高跟

senses.en: a substance that increases activity in the body or mind

ex.en: Caffeine is a mild stimulant found in coffee and tea.
ex.zh: 咖啡因是咖啡和茶中含有的溫和興奮劑。

root.note: 像刺棒一樣刺激的東西

senses.en: to encourage activity or growth
to make someone interested or excited

ex.en: The government cut taxes to stimulate the economy.
ex.zh: 政府減稅以刺激經濟。

root.note: 用刺棒戳 → 刺激

senses.en: something that causes a reaction
something that encourages activity or growth

ex.en: The pupil of the eye shrinks in response to a light stimulus.
ex.zh: 瞳孔會因光線刺激而縮小。

root.note: 刺棒 → 刺激

mn: 複數是 stimuli [ˋstɪmjəˏlaɪ]。

senses.en: unwilling to give or spend money

ex.en: He is so stingy that he never tips at restaurants.
ex.zh: 他小氣到在餐廳從不給小費。

mn: 發音是 [ˋstɪndʒɪ]，g 唸 [dʒ]，和 sting（刺）不同音。

senses.en: a fixed regular payment, such as for a student or intern

ex.en: Graduate students receive a monthly stipend for teaching.
ex.zh: 研究生教課每個月可領一筆津貼。

parts.m: coin, wages 錢幣（拉丁文 stips）

root.note: 支付錢幣 → 津貼

senses.en: an ancient Greek philosophy teaching self-control and acceptance of fate
(stoicism) endurance of pain or hardship without complaint

ex.en: She faced her illness with remarkable stoicism.
ex.zh: 她以驚人的堅忍面對病痛。

parts.m: porch 柱廊（希臘文，創始人在此講學）

root.note: 柱廊學派 → 堅忍的哲學

senses.en: calm and showing little emotion

ex.en: The stolid guard didn't react even when tourists made faces at him.
ex.zh: 遊客對著他做鬼臉，那個不動聲色的衛兵也毫無反應。

parts.m: dull, stupid 遲鈍（拉丁文 stolidus）

root.note: 遲鈍、沒反應的

senses.en: a narrow passage of water connecting two seas
(straits) a difficult situation

ex.en: Ships pass through the Taiwan Strait every day.
ex.zh: 每天都有船隻通過台灣海峽。

parts.m: narrow, tight 狹窄（拉丁文 strictus）

root.note: 狹窄的水道 → 海峽

mn: in dire straits 是「陷入困境」；和 straight（直的）同音。

senses.en: a plan or trick to deceive an enemy or achieve a goal

ex.en: The general used a clever stratagem to trap the enemy.
ex.zh: 將軍用了一條妙計困住敵軍。

root.note: 帶兵的計謀

senses.en: a layer of rock or soil
a level or class of society

ex.en: Fossils were found in a deep stratum of limestone.
ex.zh: 化石是在一層很深的石灰岩層中發現的。

root.note: 鋪開的一層 → 地層

mn: 複數是 strata。

senses.en: a small stream

ex.en: A clear streamlet ran beside the hiking trail.
ex.zh: 一條清澈的小溪沿著登山步道流過。

root.note: 小溪

senses.en: strictness; the quality of being severe
a shortage of money or credit

ex.en: The stringency of the safety rules surprised the new workers.
ex.zh: 安全規定之嚴格讓新進員工很驚訝。

root.note: 拉得很緊 → 嚴格

senses.en: strict, precise, and demanding

ex.en: The factory must follow stringent environmental regulations.
ex.zh: 這家工廠必須遵守嚴格的環保法規。

parts.m: draw tight 拉緊（拉丁文 stringere）

root.note: 拉得很緊的 → 嚴格的（strict 同源）

senses.en: a young man; a youth

ex.en: He was just a stripling when he joined the navy.
ex.zh: 他加入海軍時還只是個毛頭小子。

root.note: 細瘦的年輕人

senses.en: spending a lot of time studying
done deliberately and carefully

ex.en: She is a studious girl who spends most evenings in the library.
ex.zh: 她是個用功的女孩，大部分晚上都待在圖書館。

root.note: 熱心學習的

senses.en: to make someone feel bored or dull by routine
to make something ineffective or useless

ex.en: Endless paperwork can stultify even the most creative employee.
ex.zh: 沒完沒了的文書工作連最有創意的員工都會被磨得呆滯。

root.note: 使變愚鈍

senses.en: extremely impressive or large

ex.en: The view from the mountaintop was stupendous.
ex.zh: 山頂的景色令人嘆為觀止。

root.note: 讓人驚呆的

senses.en: a state of near unconsciousness or confusion

ex.en: He wandered around in a stupor after working all night.
ex.zh: 熬夜工作後，他恍恍惚惚地到處晃。

root.note: 驚呆、麻木的狀態

senses.en: persuasion, as opposed to force

ex.en: The teacher relied on moral suasion rather than punishment.
ex.zh: 這位老師靠道德勸說，而不是懲罰。

root.note: 勸說（persuade 同源）

senses.en: charming, confident, and elegant, especially of a man

ex.en: The suave spy talked his way past the guards.
ex.zh: 那個圓滑的間諜靠一張嘴就混過了警衛。

parts.m: sweet, pleasant 甜美（拉丁文 suavis）

root.note: 讓人愉快的 → 溫文儒雅

senses.en: slightly acid or sour
(of remarks) somewhat sharp

ex.en: The apple had a pleasant subacid flavor.
ex.zh: 這顆蘋果有種宜人的微酸味。

root.note: 稍微酸的

senses.en: existing or happening underwater

ex.en: The divers explored a colorful subaquatic cave.
ex.zh: 潛水員探索了一個色彩繽紛的水下洞穴。

root.note: 在水面下的

senses.en: existing in the mind without one being aware of it
the part of the mind one is not fully aware of

ex.en: Advertisers try to influence our subconscious desires.
ex.zh: 廣告商試圖影響我們潛意識裡的慾望。

root.note: 在意識之下的 → 潛意識的

senses.en: situated below or underneath

ex.en: The subjacent rock layers are much older than the surface soil.
ex.zh: 下層的岩層比地表土壤古老得多。

root.note: 躺在下面的

senses.en: the act of bringing under control; the state of being controlled

ex.en: The empire kept its colonies in subjection for centuries.
ex.zh: 帝國統治它的殖民地長達數百年。

root.note: 被丟到下面 → 受支配

senses.en: to bring under control by force; conquer

ex.en: The invaders tried to subjugate the local people.
ex.zh: 侵略者試圖征服當地人民。

root.note: 使套在軛下 → 征服

senses.en: affecting the mind without one being aware of it

ex.en: Some people believe movies contain subliminal messages.
ex.zh: 有些人相信電影裡藏有潛意識訊息。

root.note: 在（意識）門檻之下的

senses.en: located or given under the tongue

ex.en: The patient took a sublingual tablet for chest pain.
ex.zh: 病人服用舌下錠來緩解胸痛。

root.note: 舌頭下面的

senses.en: a ship that can travel underwater
existing or used under the sea

ex.en: The submarine stayed underwater for three months.
ex.zh: 那艘潛艇在水下待了三個月。

root.note: 在海面下的

senses.en: to go or put under water
to hide or cover completely

ex.en: Rising seas could submerge entire islands.
ex.zh: 海平面上升可能淹沒整座島嶼。

root.note: 沉到下面 → 淹沒

senses.en: the state of being under water

ex.en: Long submergence in flood water killed the rice crop.
ex.zh: 長時間泡在洪水中讓稻作全部死光。

root.note: 沉入水下

senses.en: designed to operate under water
a small underwater vehicle

ex.en: Scientists used a submersible to explore the deep ocean floor.
ex.zh: 科學家使用潛水器探索深海海床。

root.note: 可沉入水下的

senses.en: the act of putting or going under water

ex.en: The phone survived thirty minutes of submersion in the pool.
ex.zh: 那支手機在泳池裡泡了三十分鐘還能用。

root.note: 沉入水下

senses.en: the act of accepting someone's authority; surrender
the act of handing in something for consideration

ex.en: The deadline for submission of essays is Friday.
ex.zh: 作文繳交截止日是星期五。

root.note: 送到下面 → 屈服；呈上 → 提交

senses.en: the act of submitting something for approval

ex.en: The architect prepared the drawings for submittal to the city.
ex.zh: 建築師準備好圖面，要呈送給市政府。

root.note: 呈上 → 提交

senses.en: lower in rank or importance
a person under the authority of another
[səˋbɔrdṇˏet] to treat as less important

ex.en: A good manager listens to every subordinate.
ex.zh: 好的主管會傾聽每位部屬的意見。

root.note: 排在下面等級的

senses.en: coming after something in time

ex.en: The first test was easy, but subsequent tests got harder.
ex.zh: 第一次考試很簡單，但之後的考試越來越難。

root.note: 緊跟在後的

senses.en: willingness to obey others without question

ex.en: The novel criticizes the subservience expected of women in that era.
ex.zh: 這本小說批判那個時代對女性順從的要求。

root.note: 在下面服侍 → 順從

senses.en: too willing to obey others
senses.zh: 卑躬屈膝的；百依百順的

senses.en: less important; subordinate

ex.en: He refused to play a subservient role in the partnership.
ex.zh: 他拒絕在合夥關係中扮演唯命是從的角色。

root.note: 在下面服侍的 → 順從的

senses.en: to become less intense or severe
(of water or ground) to sink to a lower level

ex.en: We waited for the storm to subside before driving home.
ex.zh: 我們等暴風雨減弱後才開車回家。

root.note: 坐下、沉下去 → 平息

senses.en: to maintain life, especially with limited resources
to continue to exist

ex.en: The villagers subsist on rice and fish from the river.
ex.zh: 村民靠米飯和河裡的魚維生。

root.note: 在底下撐住 → 維生

senses.en: the state of having just enough to stay alive

ex.en: Most families in the area practice subsistence farming.
ex.zh: 這一區大部分家庭都從事自給自足的農耕。

root.note: 勉強撐住 → 維生

senses.en: having real importance or meaning; significant
(grammar) a noun

ex.en: The two leaders held substantive talks on trade.
ex.zh: 兩位領袖就貿易舉行了實質性的會談。

root.note: 站在底下支撐 → 實質的

senses.en: (geometry) to be opposite to and stretch across an angle or arc

ex.en: Each side of a triangle can subtend the angle opposite it.
ex.zh: 三角形的每一邊都對應著它對面的角。

root.note: 在下面伸展 → 對向

senses.en: deceit used to achieve a goal

ex.en: The reporter used subterfuge to get inside the factory.
ex.zh: 那名記者用計混進了工廠。

root.note: 暗中逃脫 → 詭計

senses.en: existing or happening under the ground
secret or hidden

ex.en: The city has a network of subterranean tunnels.
ex.zh: 這座城市有一整套地下隧道網絡。

root.note: 在地底下的

senses.en: so slight or delicate that it is hard to notice
clever and indirect

ex.en: There is a subtle difference between the two shades of blue.
ex.zh: 這兩種藍色之間有細微的差別。

parts.m: web, weave 編織（拉丁文 tela）

root.note: 織得很細的 → 細微的

mn: b 不發音，唸 [ˋsʌtḷ]。

senses.en: a number that is subtracted from another

ex.en: In 10 minus 3, the subtrahend is 3.
ex.zh: 在 10 減 3 中，減數是 3。

root.note: 要被拉走的數 → 減數

senses.en: the attempt to weaken or destroy a government or system

ex.en: The activists were accused of subversion by the government.
ex.zh: 這些運動人士被政府指控顛覆政權。

root.note: 從下面翻轉 → 顛覆

senses.en: to undermine the power or authority of a system

ex.en: The film tries to subvert typical superhero stereotypes.
ex.zh: 這部電影試圖顛覆典型的超級英雄刻板印象。

root.note: 從下面翻過來 → 顛覆

senses.en: to achieve an aim or purpose
to take over a position after someone

ex.en: If you work hard, you will succeed.
ex.zh: 只要你努力，就會成功。

root.note: 跟在後面走 → 接替；一路走下去 → 成功

senses.en: the achievement of an aim
a person or thing that achieves fame or wealth

ex.en: The school play was a huge success.
ex.zh: 學校話劇演出非常成功。

root.note: 一路走到結果 → 成功

senses.en: achieving the desired result

ex.en: The surgery was successful, and she went home a week later.
ex.zh: 手術很成功，她一週後就出院回家了。

root.note: 成功的

senses.en: a person or thing that follows another in a role

ex.en: The retiring CEO chose her successor carefully.
ex.zh: 即將退休的執行長謹慎地挑選了接班人。

root.note: 跟在後面走的人 → 繼任者

senses.en: briefly and clearly expressed

ex.en: Please give a succinct summary of the article in two sentences.
ex.zh: 請用兩句話簡要總結這篇文章。

root.note: 把衣服束緊 → 簡潔

senses.en: (of food) juicy and delicious
a plant with thick, fleshy leaves that store water

ex.en: The chef served a succulent roast chicken.
ex.zh: 主廚端上一道多汁的烤雞。

root.note: 充滿汁液的

senses.en: to give in to pressure or temptation
to die from an illness or injury

ex.en: I tried to diet, but I couldn't help but succumb to the chocolate cake.
ex.zh: 我試著節食，但還是抵擋不住巧克力蛋糕的誘惑。

root.note: 躺倒在下 → 屈服

mn: b 不發音，唸 [səˋkʌm]。

senses.en: permission that is given reluctantly or not actively refused; tolerance

ex.en: He stayed in the house only on sufferance after the argument.
ex.zh: 吵架之後，他只是被勉強容許住在那間房子裡。

root.note: 在下面忍受 → 容忍

mn: 常用片語 on sufferance（勉強被容許）。

senses.en: the condition of being adequate
an adequate amount

ex.en: The country aims for sufficiency in food production.
ex.zh: 這個國家的目標是糧食生產自給自足。

root.note: 做到足夠的程度

senses.en: the right to vote in political elections

ex.en: Women in New Zealand won suffrage in 1893.
ex.zh: 紐西蘭女性於 1893 年贏得選舉權。

parts.m: vote, support 投票支持（拉丁文 suffragium）

root.note: 投票支持 → 選舉權

mn: 爭取女性選舉權的運動人士叫 suffragette / suffragist。

senses.en: to gradually spread over or through something

ex.en: A warm glow began to suffuse the sky at sunset.
ex.zh: 夕陽西下時，溫暖的光芒漸漸布滿天空。

root.note: 從下面倒進去、流滿 → 布滿

senses.en: easily influenced by others' suggestions
senses.zh: 易受暗示的；容易被影響的

ex.en: Young children are highly suggestible during interviews.
ex.zh: 年幼的孩子在問話時很容易受到暗示。

root.note: 容易被帶著走的

senses.en: tending to bring an idea to mind
hinting at sexual matters

ex.en: The dark clouds were suggestive of an approaching storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲暗示著暴風雨即將來臨。

root.note: 把想法帶到腦中的 → 暗示的

senses.en: a brief statement of the main points
done immediately without the usual formalities

ex.en: Write a one-paragraph summary of the chapter.
ex.zh: 寫一段這一章的摘要。

root.note: 總括起來 → 摘要

senses.en: splendid and expensive-looking

ex.en: The wedding guests enjoyed a sumptuous banquet.
ex.zh: 婚禮賓客享用了一場豐盛的宴席。

root.note: 花很多錢的 → 奢華的

senses.en: a very great or excessive amount

ex.en: There was a superabundance of food at the party.
ex.zh: 派對上的食物多到吃不完。

root.note: 多到溢出來還超過

senses.en: to add something extra to what has already been added

ex.en: The builders chose to superadd a decorative tower to the design.
ex.zh: 建商決定在設計中再加一座裝飾塔。

root.note: 在上面再加

senses.en: to retire someone with a pension because of age
senses.zh: 使（因年老）退休並領年金

senses.en: to make obsolete

ex.en: The company plans to superannuate its oldest machines as well as staff.
ex.zh: 公司打算讓最老舊的機器和員工一併退役。

root.note: 超過年限 → 退休、過時
