mn: 形容詞 superannuated（年老退休的；老舊過時的）比較常見。

senses.en: excellent; of very high quality

ex.en: The hotel offers superb views of the ocean.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有絕佳的海景。

parts.m: 字尾（拉丁文 superbus 驕傲的）

root.note: 高高在上的 → 極好的

senses.en: behaving as if one is better than others

ex.en: The supercilious waiter looked down on customers who ordered cheap wine.
ex.zh: 那個高傲的服務生看不起點便宜酒的客人。

root.note: 把眉毛挑高 → 高傲的

senses.en: existing or occurring only on the surface
not thorough or deep; shallow

ex.en: The accident caused only superficial damage to the car.
ex.zh: 這起事故只造成車子表面的損傷。

root.note: 在表面上的 → 膚淺的

senses.en: an amount that is more than needed

ex.en: The report suffered from a superfluity of detail.
ex.zh: 這份報告的缺點是細節太多了。

root.note: 流出超過需要 → 過剩

senses.en: unnecessary, especially through being more than enough

ex.en: Remove any superfluous words from your essay.
ex.zh: 把作文中多餘的字刪掉。

root.note: 滿到溢出來的 → 多餘的

mn: 重音在第二音節 su-PER-fluous。

senses.en: to heat a liquid above its boiling point without it boiling, or a vapor above saturation

ex.en: Microwaves can superheat water in a smooth cup.
ex.zh: 微波爐可能讓光滑杯子裡的水過熱。

root.note: 加熱過度

senses.en: to manage or oversee

ex.en: She was hired to superintend the construction of the new library.
ex.zh: 她受聘負責監督新圖書館的興建。

root.note: 在上面注意著 → 監督

senses.en: the act of managing or overseeing

ex.en: The project was completed under the superintendence of a senior engineer.
ex.zh: 這個計畫在一位資深工程師的監督下完成。

root.note: 在上面照看 → 監督

senses.en: a person who manages an organization or activity
(US) a person who takes care of an apartment building

ex.en: The school superintendent announced a new schedule.
ex.zh: 學區督學宣布了新的課表。

root.note: 在上面照看的人 → 主管

senses.en: of the highest quality or degree
(grammar) the form of an adjective meaning "most"

ex.en: The restaurant is known for its superlative seafood.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳以頂級海鮮聞名。

root.note: 被帶到最上面的 → 最高的

senses.en: beyond the laws of nature
(the supernatural) supernatural forces or beings

ex.en: The movie is about a family haunted by supernatural forces.
ex.zh: 這部電影講一家人被超自然力量糾纏的故事。

root.note: 超越自然的

senses.en: more than the usual or needed number
an extra person, such as an actor with a small non-speaking part

ex.en: She worked as a supernumerary in the opera, standing silently in crowd scenes.
ex.zh: 她在歌劇裡當臨時演員，在群眾場景中默默站著。

root.note: 超出定額的（人）

senses.en: to take the place of something older or less effective

ex.en: Smartphones have come to supersede digital cameras for most people.
ex.zh: 對多數人來說，智慧型手機已經取代了數位相機。

root.note: 坐到上面 → 取代

mn: 拼法易錯：是 -sede 不是 -cede（來自 sed 坐）。

senses.en: lying face upward
failing to act or protest because of weakness or laziness
senses.zh: 消極的；懶散而不作為的

ex.en: The patient was placed in a supine position on the table.
ex.zh: 病人被安置成仰臥姿勢躺在檯上。

root.note: 臉朝上的 → 仰臥

mn: supine 是仰躺（臉朝上），prone 是趴著（臉朝下）。

senses.en: to replace someone or something, often by force or scheming

ex.en: Streaming services have begun to supplant traditional TV.
ex.zh: 串流服務已經開始取代傳統電視。

parts.m: sole of the foot 腳底

root.note: 從腳底下絆倒 → 取而代之

senses.en: bending easily; flexible

ex.en: Yoga keeps your muscles strong and supple.
ex.zh: 瑜伽能讓你的肌肉強壯又柔韌。

senses.en: added to complete or improve something

ex.en: The teacher handed out supplementary materials for extra practice.
ex.zh: 老師發了補充教材讓大家多練習。

root.note: 填補不足的 → 補充的

senses.en: a person who asks humbly for something

ex.en: Each supplicant knelt before the king to ask for mercy.
ex.zh: 每位懇求者都跪在國王面前請求寬恕。

root.note: 彎下身子請求的人

senses.en: to ask or beg humbly for something

ex.en: The prisoners could only supplicate the guards for food.
ex.zh: 囚犯們只能哀求警衛給他們食物。

root.note: 屈膝請求 → 懇求

senses.en: an idea believed true without proof

ex.en: The police acted on the supposition that the thief was still nearby.
ex.zh: 警方假定小偷還在附近而採取行動。

root.note: 放在下面作為基礎 → 假定

senses.en: to end something by force
to stop oneself from showing a feeling or reaction
to prevent information from being known

ex.en: She tried to suppress a yawn during the long meeting.
ex.zh: 冗長的會議中，她努力忍住不打哈欠。

root.note: 往下壓 → 壓制

senses.en: able to be held back or put down

ex.en: His anger was barely suppressible after the unfair call.
ex.zh: 那次不公平的判決之後，他的怒氣幾乎壓不住。

root.note: 可以壓下去的

senses.en: the act of stopping something by force
the act of keeping something from being seen or known

ex.en: The suppression of free speech led to mass protests.
ex.zh: 對言論自由的壓制引發大規模抗議。

root.note: 往下壓 → 壓制

senses.en: above or beyond the ordinary world; spiritual

ex.en: The monk spoke of a supramundane peace beyond worldly desires.
ex.zh: 那位僧人談到一種超脫塵世慾望的寧靜。

root.note: 在世界之上的 → 超塵世的

senses.en: an extra charge or payment
to charge an extra amount

ex.en: The airline added a fuel surcharge to every ticket.
ex.zh: 航空公司在每張機票上加收燃油附加費。

root.note: 額外的收費

senses.en: a person who takes responsibility for another's debt or behavior
money given as a guarantee

ex.en: His uncle agreed to stand surety for the loan.
ex.zh: 他叔叔同意當這筆貸款的保證人。

root.note: 確保的人或物 → 保證

senses.en: an excessive amount of something
to cause to have too much of something

ex.en: There is a surfeit of cooking shows on TV these days.
ex.zh: 最近電視上的烹飪節目多到氾濫。

root.note: 做得過頭 → 過量

senses.en: to suppose something without proof
a guess

ex.en: From her smile, I could only surmise that she had passed the exam.
ex.zh: 從她的笑容，我只能推測她考過了。

root.note: 把想法放上去 → 推測

senses.en: to overcome a difficulty
to stand or be placed on top of

ex.en: She had to surmount many obstacles to become a doctor.
ex.zh: 她克服了許多障礙才成為醫生。

root.note: 爬過去 → 克服

senses.en: done secretly because it would not be approved

ex.en: He took a surreptitious glance at his phone during the test.
ex.zh: 他在考試時偷偷瞄了一眼手機。

root.note: 暗中抓取 → 偷偷摸摸的

senses.en: a substitute, especially a person acting in place of another
acting as a substitute

ex.en: The aunt became a surrogate mother to the orphaned children.
ex.zh: 這位阿姨成了那些孤兒的代理母親。

parts.m: in place of 代替（= sub-）

root.note: 被要求來頂替的人 → 代理人

senses.en: to be all around something or someone

ex.en: Tall mountains surround the quiet village on every side.
ex.zh: 高山從四面八方環繞著這個寧靜的村莊。

senses.en: a person who measures and examines land or buildings

ex.en: The surveyor marked the exact boundary between the two farms.
ex.zh: 測量員標出了兩座農場之間的確切界線。

root.note: 從上方察看的人 → 測量員

senses.en: the state of being easily affected or harmed by something
senses.zh: 易受影響（感染）的程度；敏感性

ex.en: Lack of sleep increases your susceptibility to colds.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會讓你更容易感冒。

parts.m: up from under 由下往上（= sub-）

root.note: 容易接受（外來影響）→ 易感性

senses.en: likely to be influenced or harmed by something

ex.en: Young children are especially susceptible to this virus.
ex.zh: 幼童特別容易感染這種病毒。

parts.m: up from under 由下往上（= sub-）

root.note: 容易接受（外來影響）→ 易受影響的

mn: 常用片語 be susceptible to（容易受到…）。

senses.en: a feeling of excited or anxious uncertainty about what will happen

ex.en: The movie kept the audience in suspense until the very last scene.
ex.zh: 這部電影讓觀眾一直懸著心，直到最後一幕。

root.note: 懸在半空中 → 懸念

senses.en: the temporary stopping or delaying of something
a temporary removal from a job, school, or team as punishment
the system of springs that supports a vehicle

ex.en: The player received a two-game suspension for fighting.
ex.zh: 這名球員因打架被禁賽兩場。

root.note: 掛起來、懸而不動 → 暫停

senses.en: having a feeling that something is wrong or someone is dishonest
causing a feeling that something is wrong

ex.en: Please report any suspicious package to the security desk.
ex.zh: 如有可疑包裹，請通報保全櫃檯。

parts.m: up from under 由下往上（= sub-）

root.note: 從底下偷偷往上看 → 懷疑的

senses.en: food and drink that keep someone alive
the act of maintaining or supporting something

ex.en: The stranded hikers relied on berries for sustenance.
ex.zh: 受困的登山客靠吃莓果維生。

parts.m: up from under 由下往上（= sub-）

root.note: 從下方撐住生命 → 食物、營養

senses.en: having a dark or sunburned complexion

ex.en: The old fisherman had a swarthy face from years at sea.
ex.zh: 老漁夫因長年出海而有一張黝黑的臉。

senses.en: a person who is devoted to luxury and pleasure
senses.zh: 貪圖享樂的人；奢侈逸樂者

ex.en: A true Sybarite, he refused to travel anywhere without a private chef.
ex.zh: 他是個十足的享樂主義者，沒有私人廚師就不肯出門旅行。

parts.m: 古希臘城市名，以奢華聞名

root.note: 錫巴里斯城的居民以奢侈著稱 → 貪圖享樂的人

senses.en: a person who flatters powerful people to gain advantage

ex.en: Every sycophant in the office laughed loudly at the boss's terrible joke.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡每個馬屁精都對老闆超冷的笑話哈哈大笑。

parts.m: fig 無花果（希臘文 sykon）

root.note: 原指「告密者」，後來轉成巴結討好的人

mn: 唸起來像 sick of fan：對老闆「死忠粉」到讓人想吐。

senses.en: relating to or based on syllables
(of a consonant) forming a syllable by itself

ex.en: Japanese kana is a syllabic writing system, not an alphabet.
ex.zh: 日文假名是一種音節文字，而不是字母系統。

root.note: 合在一起唸的音 → 音節的

senses.en: the division of words into syllables

ex.en: Dictionaries use dots to show the syllabication of each word.
ex.zh: 字典用圓點標示每個字的音節劃分。

root.note: 把字切成一個個音節 → 音節劃分

senses.en: a unit of pronunciation with one vowel sound

ex.en: In the word "banana," the stress falls on the second syllable.
ex.zh: banana 這個字的重音落在第二個音節。

root.note: 合在一起唸的一組音 → 音節

senses.en: an outline of the topics covered in a course

ex.en: The professor handed out the syllabus on the first day of class.
ex.zh: 教授在第一天上課時發下課程大綱。

senses.en: an imaginary spirit of the air
a slender, graceful woman or girl

ex.en: The ballerina moved across the stage like a sylph.
ex.zh: 那位芭蕾舞者像精靈般在舞台上飄移。

senses.en: having matching parts on both sides of a line or center

ex.en: A butterfly's wings are almost perfectly symmetrical.
ex.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀幾乎完全對稱。

parts.m: together, same 一起、相同（= syn-）

root.note: 兩邊量起來一樣 → 對稱的

senses.en: the quality of having parts that match exactly on both sides
pleasing balance and proportion

ex.en: The architect admired the perfect symmetry of the ancient temple.
ex.zh: 建築師讚嘆這座古廟完美的對稱。

parts.m: together, same 一起、相同（= syn-）

root.note: 兩邊量起來一樣 → 對稱

senses.en: feeling or showing concern for someone else's suffering
showing approval of or support for an idea

ex.en: My teacher was sympathetic when I explained why my essay was late.
ex.zh: 我解釋作文遲交的原因時，老師很體諒我。

root.note: 和別人有相同的感受 → 同情的

mn: 注意：sympathetic 不是「令人好感的」，那是 likable。

senses.en: to feel or express sorrow for someone's trouble
to agree with or support an opinion

ex.en: I sympathize with anyone who has to commute two hours a day.
ex.zh: 我很同情每天通勤要兩小時的人。

root.note: 感同身受 → 同情

senses.en: relating to or having the form of a symphony

ex.en: The band recorded a symphonic version of their greatest hits.
ex.zh: 這個樂團錄製了他們暢銷金曲的交響樂版本。

root.note: 各種聲音合在一起 → 交響樂的

senses.en: harmonious in sound

ex.en: The choir's voices blended into one symphonious sound.
ex.zh: 合唱團的歌聲融合成和諧悅耳的樂音。

root.note: 聲音合在一起很協調 → 和諧的

senses.en: a long piece of music for a full orchestra
a harmonious combination of elements

ex.en: The orchestra performed Beethoven's Ninth Symphony to a sold-out hall.
ex.zh: 管弦樂團在座無虛席的音樂廳演奏貝多芬第九號交響曲。

root.note: 各種聲音合在一起 → 交響曲

senses.en: the fact of happening at the same time
a chronological arrangement of events side by side

ex.en: Engineers worked to keep the two motors in perfect synchronism.
ex.zh: 工程師設法讓兩部馬達保持完全同步。

root.note: 在相同的時間 → 同時發生

senses.en: a group of people or companies working together for a shared business purpose
[ˋsɪndɪˏket] to sell articles, shows, or other content to many outlets at once
senses.zh: （將文章、節目）同時賣給多家媒體

ex.en: A syndicate of investors bought the struggling football club.
ex.zh: 一個投資財團買下了這家經營困難的足球俱樂部。

parts.m: judge, justice 審判、正義（希臘文 dikē）

root.note: 原指一起處理事務的代表 → 聯合組織

senses.en: the contraction of two vowels or syllables into one
the separation of liquid from a gel

ex.en: In poetry, syneresis can squeeze two syllables into one to fit the meter.
ex.zh: 詩中常用元音縮合，把兩個音節擠成一個以配合格律。

root.note: 拿在一起合併 → 縮合

senses.en: an official meeting of church leaders

ex.en: The bishops gathered in Rome for a synod on family life.
ex.zh: 主教們齊聚羅馬，召開有關家庭生活的宗教會議。

root.note: 走到一起來開會 → 宗教會議

senses.en: a word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another

ex.en: "Happy" is a common synonym for "glad."
ex.zh: happy 是 glad 的一個常見同義字。

root.note: 相同意思的名稱 → 同義字

senses.en: a brief summary of a book, film, or subject

ex.en: Read the synopsis on the back cover before choosing a novel.
ex.zh: 挑小說前先讀一下封底的內容簡介。

root.note: 一眼看到全貌 → 摘要

senses.en: done according to a fixed plan or method

ex.en: The detectives made a systematic search of the entire building.
ex.zh: 警探們對整棟大樓進行了有系統的搜查。

root.note: 放在一起組成整體 → 有系統的

senses.en: a group of models or motionless figures representing a scene
senses.zh: （由人扮演的）靜態畫面；活人畫

senses.en: a striking scene or picture

ex.en: The students posed in a tableau of the signing of the Constitution.
ex.zh: 學生們擺出簽署憲法的靜態畫面。

root.note: 一小幅畫 → 靜態畫面

senses.en: understood or implied without being stated

ex.en: By not objecting, the teacher gave tacit approval to the plan.
ex.zh: 老師沒有反對，等於默許了這個計畫。

root.note: 在沉默中表示 → 心照不宣

senses.en: habitually saying very little

ex.en: The taciturn farmer answered every question with a single word.
ex.zh: 那位沉默寡言的農夫每個問題都只用一個字回答。

parts.m: be silent 沉默（拉丁文 tacere）

root.note: 習慣保持沉默 → 寡言的

mn: 與 tacit（心照不宣的）同字根，都跟「不說出口」有關。

senses.en: a small, sharp nail with a broad head
a course of action or approach
to fasten with tacks; to add something as an extra

ex.en: When friendly requests failed, the landlord tried a different tack.
ex.zh: 好言相勸沒用之後，房東換了一種做法。

senses.en: skill in dealing with people or difficult situations without offending

ex.en: It takes tact to tell a friend that her singing is off-key.
ex.zh: 要告訴朋友她唱歌走音，得講得很得體才行。

root.note: 對人事有敏銳的觸感 → 圓滑得體

mn: 不要和 tactic（策略）搞混：tact 是說話做事得體。

senses.en: a person skilled in planning tactics

ex.en: The coach was a brilliant tactician who always found an opponent's weakness.
ex.zh: 這位教練是傑出的戰術家，總能找到對手的弱點。

root.note: 擅長安排部署的人 → 戰術家

senses.en: actions carefully planned to achieve a specific goal
the art of arranging forces in battle

ex.en: The company used aggressive sales tactics to attract new customers.
ex.zh: 這家公司用強勢的銷售手法吸引新客戶。

root.note: 安排部署的技術 → 戰術

senses.en: the state of touching at a single point without crossing

ex.en: The point of tangency is where the line just touches the circle.
ex.zh: 切點就是直線恰好碰到圓的地方。

root.note: 剛好碰觸 → 相切

senses.en: a sudden change of subject in speech or thought
a straight line that touches a curve at one point

ex.en: The lecture went off on a tangent about the professor's cat.
ex.zh: 這堂課突然岔題去講教授的貓了。

root.note: 只碰一下就離開的線 → 切線；話題一碰就岔開 → 離題

mn: 片語 go off on a tangent：講話突然離題。

senses.en: able to be touched; physical
clear and definite; real

ex.en: The new policy has produced tangible results in just six months.
ex.zh: 新政策在短短六個月內就產生了具體成效。

root.note: 能摸得到 → 有形的、具體的

senses.en: a place where animal skins are made into leather

ex.en: The old tannery by the river gave off a terrible smell.
ex.zh: 河邊那間老製革廠散發出難聞的臭味。

root.note: 鞣製皮革的地方 → 製革廠

senses.en: to tease or torment with something desired but kept out of reach

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread seemed to tantalize the hungry students.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味讓飢腸轆轆的學生們心癢難耐。

parts.m: 坦塔洛斯（希臘神話人物）

root.note: 坦塔洛斯受罰站在水中，水果與水都碰不到 → 可望而不可及

senses.en: equivalent in effect or seriousness to

ex.en: Staying silent about the fraud would be tantamount to approving it.
ex.zh: 對這樁詐欺保持沉默，就等於是贊同它。

parts.m: so much 那麼多（拉丁文 tantus）

root.note: 數量達到那麼多 → 等同於

mn: 幾乎都用 be tantamount to（等於…）。

senses.en: a heavy cloth with pictures or designs woven into it
a complex and varied combination of things

ex.en: The city is a rich tapestry of cultures and languages.
ex.zh: 這座城市是由多元文化和語言交織而成的豐富織錦。

senses.en: to damage someone's reputation
to make or become dull and discolored

ex.en: One scandal can tarnish a company's image for years.
ex.zh: 一件醜聞就可能讓公司的形象蒙塵好幾年。

senses.en: stretched or pulled tight
tense or anxious; (of writing) concise and controlled
senses.zh: 緊張的；（文筆）簡潔緊湊的

ex.en: Pull the rope taut before you tie the knot.
ex.zh: 打結之前先把繩子拉緊。

mn: taut 和 taunt（嘲弄）只差一個 n，別搞混。

senses.en: the system by which a government collects money through taxes

ex.en: The colonists protested taxation without representation.
ex.zh: 殖民地居民抗議「無代表權卻被課稅」。

root.note: 課稅的制度 → 稅制

senses.en: the art of preserving and stuffing the skins of dead animals

ex.en: The museum displays owls and foxes preserved through taxidermy.
ex.zh: 博物館展示以剝製術保存的貓頭鷹和狐狸。

root.note: 把皮整理擺好 → 標本剝製術

senses.en: technique or technical method (older use)
technical

ex.en: The old manual described the technic of casting bronze bells.
ex.zh: 那本舊手冊描述了鑄造青銅鐘的技術。

root.note: 技藝的 → 技術

senses.en: a small detail of a rule or law, especially one that affects the outcome
senses.zh: （法律、規則上的）細節；技術性問題

senses.en: the use of technical terms or methods

ex.en: The suspect was released on a technicality because the warrant was dated wrong.
ex.zh: 由於搜索票日期寫錯，嫌犯因程序上的細節而獲釋。

root.note: 技術層面的細節 → 技術性問題

senses.en: a particular way of doing something that requires skill

ex.en: The swimmer improved her breathing technique before the race.
ex.zh: 這位泳者在比賽前改進了她的換氣技巧。

root.note: 做事的技藝 → 技巧

senses.en: the description of the arts and crafts of different peoples

ex.en: Her book on technography compares weaving methods across the Pacific islands.
ex.zh: 她那本工藝誌比較了太平洋各島嶼的編織方法。

root.note: 記錄各地技藝 → 工藝誌

senses.en: the use of scientific knowledge for practical purposes; machines and equipment developed this way

ex.en: New technology has changed the way students take notes in class.
ex.zh: 新科技改變了學生上課做筆記的方式。

root.note: 研究技藝的學問 → 科技

senses.en: to be full of or swarming with
(of rain) to pour down heavily

ex.en: During summer, the pond will teem with frogs and dragonflies.
ex.zh: 夏天時，池塘裡會到處都是青蛙和蜻蜓。

mn: 常用 teem with（充滿），別和 team（隊伍）搞混。

senses.en: communication of thoughts directly from one mind to another

ex.en: The twins joked that they could communicate by telepathy.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎開玩笑說他們能用心電感應溝通。

root.note: 遠距離感受到對方 → 心電感應

senses.en: the technology of transmitting voice over a distance

ex.en: Internet telephony lets people make calls without a landline.
ex.zh: 網路電話技術讓人不需要市話也能打電話。

root.note: 把聲音傳到遠方 → 電話通訊

senses.en: an instrument that makes distant objects appear larger
to shorten or compress

ex.en: Through the telescope, we could see the rings of Saturn.
ex.zh: 透過望遠鏡，我們看得到土星環。

root.note: 看遠方的工具 → 望遠鏡

senses.en: revealing something that is meant to be hidden
senses.zh: 暴露真相的；露出馬腳的

senses.en: a person who reveals secrets; a sign that reveals something

ex.en: Chocolate on his face was a telltale sign that he had eaten the cake.
ex.zh: 他臉上的巧克力，洩露了他偷吃蛋糕的事實。

senses.en: excessive confidence or boldness; nerve

ex.en: The intern had the temerity to correct the CEO in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 那個實習生竟敢當眾糾正執行長。

parts.m: rashly 輕率地（拉丁文 temere）

root.note: 輕率的態度 → 魯莽

mn: 常用 have the temerity to do（竟敢做…）。

senses.en: relating to time
relating to worldly rather than spiritual affairs
relating to the temples of the head

ex.en: The medieval pope held both spiritual and temporal power.
ex.zh: 中世紀的教宗同時握有宗教與世俗的權力。

root.note: 屬於時間（而非永恆）的 → 時間的、世俗的

senses.en: lasting for only a limited time

ex.en: The road closure is only temporary while workers repair the bridge.
ex.zh: 道路封閉只是暫時的，工人正在修橋。

root.note: 只在一段時間內 → 暫時的

senses.en: to avoid making a decision in order to gain time

ex.en: The mayor tried to temporize until after the election.
ex.zh: 市長試圖拖延，等到選後再說。

root.note: 在時間上打轉 → 拖延

senses.en: to make someone want to do something, especially something unwise
to attract or persuade

ex.en: Don't tempt me with dessert while I'm on a diet.
ex.zh: 我在節食，別拿甜點誘惑我。

senses.en: a person or thing that tempts; (the Tempter) the Devil

ex.en: In the story, the tempter offers the hero riches in exchange for his soul.
ex.zh: 故事中，誘惑者用財富換取主角的靈魂。

senses.en: holding firmly to something; not giving up easily
keeping a firm hold

ex.en: The tenacious reporter kept digging until she uncovered the truth.
ex.zh: 那位鍥而不捨的記者一直追查，直到揭露真相。

root.note: 緊緊抓住不放 → 頑強的

senses.en: a person who rents land or a building from a landlord

ex.en: The new tenant signed a one-year lease on the apartment.
ex.zh: 新房客簽了一年的公寓租約。

root.note: 持有（租用）房產的人 → 房客

senses.en: an inclination to behave or develop in a certain way

ex.en: He has a tendency to talk too fast when he is nervous.
ex.zh: 他一緊張就容易講話太快。

root.note: 朝某方向伸展 → 傾向

senses.en: a principle or belief held by a group

ex.en: Freedom of speech is a basic tenet of democracy.
ex.zh: 言論自由是民主的基本信條。

parts.m: 拉丁文動詞變化（他持有）

root.note: 大家所持有的信念 → 信條

senses.en: the general meaning or character of something
the highest ordinary adult male singing voice

ex.en: The overall tenor of the meeting was surprisingly positive.
ex.zh: 整場會議的基調出乎意料地正面。

root.note: 貫串始終、持守的方向 → 要旨；歌曲中持守主旋律的聲部 → 男高音

senses.en: nervous and unable to relax; stretched tight
a verb form showing the time of an action
to make or become tight

ex.en: The room was tense as everyone waited for the results.
ex.zh: 大家等著結果時，房間裡氣氛很緊張。

root.note: 被拉緊的 → 緊張的

senses.en: not certain or fixed; provisional
done without confidence; hesitant

ex.en: We made tentative plans to meet next Friday.
ex.zh: 我們暫定下星期五見面。

root.note: 只是嘗試性的 → 暫定的

senses.en: the period during which someone holds an office or position
a permanent position, especially for a professor

ex.en: During her tenure as principal, test scores rose steadily.
ex.zh: 在她擔任校長期間，考試成績穩定上升。

root.note: 持有職位的期間 → 任期

senses.en: a three-hundredth anniversary

ex.en: The university held a festival to mark its tercentenary.
ex.zh: 這所大學舉辦慶典，紀念創校三百週年。

root.note: 三個一百年 → 三百週年

senses.en: a harsh, bad-tempered woman

ex.en: In the old comedy, the hero's mother-in-law is portrayed as a termagant.
ex.zh: 在那齣老喜劇裡，主角的岳母被描寫成一個悍婦。

senses.en: (of a disease) leading to death; at the end
a station at the end of a transport route; a building at an airport
a device for entering data into a computer

ex.en: Our flight leaves from Terminal 2, so we should hurry.
ex.zh: 我們的班機從第二航廈出發，得快一點。

root.note: 在終點的 → 末期的、終點站

senses.en: to bring to an end or come to an end
to dismiss from a job

ex.en: Either side may terminate the contract with thirty days' notice.
ex.zh: 任何一方只要提前三十天通知，就可以終止合約。

root.note: 使到達終點 → 終止

senses.en: the act of bringing something to an end
dismissal from a job

ex.en: The termination of the project left twenty engineers without work.
ex.zh: 這項計畫終止後，二十名工程師失去了工作。

root.note: 到達終點 → 終止

senses.en: the final stop at the end of a railway or bus route
an end point or goal

ex.en: We stayed on the train until it reached the terminus.
ex.zh: 我們一直坐到火車抵達終點站。

root.note: 路線的盡頭 → 終點站

senses.en: to make someone extremely frightened

ex.en: Loud thunder can terrify young dogs.
ex.zh: 響雷可能會把幼犬嚇壞。

root.note: 使人害怕 → 嚇壞

senses.en: relating to the ownership of land or sea areas
(of animals or people) defending an area against others
senses.zh: 有地盤意識的；護地盤的

ex.en: The two countries have a long-running territorial dispute over the islands.
ex.zh: 兩國對這些島嶼有長期的領土爭議。

root.note: 屬於某片土地的 → 領土的

senses.en: using few words, often in a way that seems rude
senses.zh: 簡短的；（態度）冷淡簡慢的

ex.en: Her terse reply made it clear she did not want to talk.
ex.zh: 她簡短的回答清楚表示她不想談。

parts.m: wiped, polished 擦淨（拉丁文 tergere）

root.note: 擦得乾乾淨淨、沒有多餘 → 簡潔的

senses.en: something that serves as clear proof of a fact or quality
a will stating how a person's property is to be divided
(Testament) either of the two main parts of the Bible

ex.en: The bridge still standing after the earthquake is a testament to good engineering.
ex.zh: 這座橋在地震後依然屹立，證明了工程品質優良。

root.note: 見證下所立的東西 → 證明、遺囑

mn: 常用 be a testament to（是…的證明）。

senses.en: a person who has made a will

ex.en: The testator left most of his fortune to a local hospital.
ex.zh: 立遺囑人把大部分財產留給了當地一家醫院。

root.note: 在見證下立遺囑的人 → 立遺囑人

senses.en: a formal statement praising someone's character or a product's quality
a gift or event honoring someone's service

ex.en: Her former coach wrote a glowing testimonial for her college application.
ex.zh: 她以前的教練為她的大學申請寫了一封熱情洋溢的推薦函。

root.note: 為某人某物作見證 → 推薦、證言

senses.en: rule by a god or gods; a system of gods ranked in order
senses.zh: 神權統治；諸神的階級體系

ex.en: Ancient Greek thearchy placed Zeus at the head of all the gods.
ex.zh: 古希臘的諸神體系把宙斯置於眾神之首。

root.note: 由神統治 → 神權政治

senses.en: belief in the existence of a god or gods, especially one creator

ex.en: The philosophy class debated the arguments for theism and atheism.
ex.zh: 哲學課上辯論了有神論與無神論的論點。

root.note: 相信神的主義 → 有神論

senses.en: a system of government in which religious leaders rule in the name of God

ex.en: In a theocracy, religious law is also the law of the state.
ex.zh: 在神權國家中，宗教律法也就是國家的法律。

root.note: 以神之名統治 → 神權政治

senses.en: a mixing of different gods or forms of worship
mystical union of the soul with God

ex.en: Roman theocrasy blended local gods with the gods of conquered peoples.
ex.zh: 羅馬的諸神混合崇拜把本地神祇與被征服民族的神祇融合在一起。

root.note: 把各種神混合起來 → 諸神混合崇拜

mn: 與 theocracy（神權政治）只差字母順序：crasy 是混合，cracy 是統治。

senses.en: a person who studies religion and religious beliefs

ex.en: The theologian wrote a book on the meaning of forgiveness.
ex.zh: 這位神學家寫了一本探討寬恕意義的書。

root.note: 研究神的學者 → 神學家

senses.en: relating to the study of religion

ex.en: He spent three years at a theological seminary before becoming a pastor.
ex.zh: 他在神學院讀了三年後才成為牧師。

root.note: 關於神的學問的 → 神學的

senses.en: the study of the nature of God and religious belief
a particular system of religious beliefs

ex.en: She majored in theology and later taught world religions.
ex.zh: 她主修神學，後來教授世界宗教。

root.note: 研究神的學問 → 神學

senses.en: based on theory rather than practice or experience
possible in principle but not yet proven

ex.en: The danger is only theoretical, since no such accident has ever happened.
ex.zh: 這種危險只是理論上的，因為從來沒發生過這類事故。

parts.m: look at, contemplate 觀看、思考

root.note: 只在思考層面上的 → 理論的

senses.en: a person who develops or studies theories

ex.en: A political theorist argued that power always seeks to expand.
ex.zh: 一位政治理論家主張權力總是尋求擴張。

root.note: 建構理論的人 → 理論家

senses.en: to form a theory or ideas about something

ex.en: Scientists theorize that the crater was formed by a meteor.
ex.zh: 科學家推論這個坑洞是隕石撞擊所形成。

root.note: 形成理論 → 推論

senses.en: near that place, time, number, or amount

ex.en: The ship sank off the coast of Maine or thereabout.
ex.zh: 那艘船在緬因州外海或其附近沉沒。

mn: 較常見的形式是 thereabouts，常用 or thereabouts（…左右）。

senses.en: (formal, legal) for that; for it

ex.en: The tenant broke the window and must pay the landlord therefor.
ex.zh: 房客打破了窗戶，必須為此賠償房東。

mn: 不要和 therefore（因此）混淆：therefor 少一個 e，意思是「為此」。

senses.en: relating to heat
(of clothing) designed to keep the body warm
a rising current of warm air

ex.en: Iceland uses thermal energy from volcanoes to heat homes.
ex.zh: 冰島利用火山的熱能為住宅供暖。

root.note: 與熱有關的 → 熱的

senses.en: producing electricity from a difference in temperature

ex.en: The probe uses a thermoelectric generator to power its instruments in deep space.
ex.zh: 這艘探測器在深太空中以熱電發電機為儀器供電。

root.note: 由熱產生電的 → 熱電的

senses.en: electricity produced directly from heat, as by a temperature difference between two metals

ex.en: Researchers hope thermoelectricity can turn waste heat from cars into useful power.
ex.zh: 研究人員希望熱電技術能把汽車的廢熱轉換為可用的電力。

root.note: 由熱產生的電 → 熱電

senses.en: a statement or theory put forward and supported by argument
a long essay written for a university degree

ex.en: Every good essay begins with a clear thesis statement.
ex.zh: 每篇好文章都從一個清楚的論點陳述開始。

parts.m: put, place 放置（希臘文 tithenai）

root.note: 提出來放在桌上的主張 → 論點

senses.en: a horse of a pure breed, especially one used for racing
of pure breed; (of a person) well-bred and first-class
senses.zh: 純種的；教養良好的；一流的

ex.en: The thoroughbred won the race by three full lengths.
ex.zh: 那匹純種賽馬以整整三個馬身的差距贏得比賽。

senses.en: a main road or public street through a place

ex.en: The parade blocked the city's busiest thoroughfare for hours.
ex.zh: 遊行隊伍把城裡最繁忙的大街封住了好幾個小時。

root.note: 可以穿行而過的路 → 大街

mn: 標誌上 No Thoroughfare 意思是「此路不通」。

senses.en: the state of being controlled or strongly influenced by someone or something
a slave or servant

ex.en: The audience sat in thrall as the magician performed his final trick.
ex.zh: 魔術師表演最後一個戲法時，觀眾全都看得入迷。

mn: in thrall to 意為「受…支配、被…迷住」；enthrall（使著迷）由此而來。

senses.en: the condition of soil for growing crops
the cultivation of land

ex.en: Adding compost will improve the tilth of heavy clay soil.
ex.zh: 加入堆肥能改善黏重土壤的耕性。

root.note: 耕種的狀態 → 耕作狀況

senses.en: the particular quality of a sound or voice that makes it distinct

ex.en: A violin and a flute playing the same note differ in timbre.
ex.zh: 小提琴和長笛演奏同一個音時，音色不同。

mn: 發音也可讀作 [ˋtæmbɚ]；別和 timber（木材）搞混。

senses.en: showing or feeling nervousness and lack of confidence

ex.en: The timorous puppy hid under the bed whenever guests arrived.
ex.zh: 每當有客人來，那隻膽小的小狗就躲到床底下。

root.note: 充滿害怕的 → 膽小的

senses.en: a medicine made by dissolving a drug in alcohol
a slight trace or tint
senses.zh: 些微的痕跡；淡淡的色調

ex.en: The nurse applied a tincture of iodine to the cut.
ex.zh: 護士在傷口上塗了碘酒。

root.note: 染上的顏色 → 淡淡色調；泡製的藥液 → 酊劑

senses.en: a slight trace of a color, feeling, or quality
to color slightly or add a trace of a feeling

ex.en: There was a tinge of sadness in her voice as she said goodbye.
ex.zh: 她道別時，聲音裡帶著一絲哀傷。

root.note: 染上一點點 → 一絲色調

senses.en: slightly drunk

ex.en: After two glasses of wine, my uncle got a little tipsy and started singing.
ex.zh: 兩杯酒下肚，我叔叔有點醉，開始唱起歌來。

senses.en: a long, angry speech of criticism

ex.en: The coach launched into a tirade about the referee's decisions.
ex.zh: 教練對裁判的判決發表了一長串激烈的抨擊。

senses.en: working hard without seeming to get tired
senses.zh: 不知疲倦的；孜孜不倦的

ex.en: The nurse was praised for her tireless care of patients during the pandemic.
ex.zh: 這位護理師因疫情期間不眠不休地照顧病患而受到表揚。

senses.en: causing annoyance or boredom

ex.en: Filling out the same form again and again is tiresome.
ex.zh: 一次又一次填寫同樣的表格真令人厭煩。

senses.en: of enormous size, strength, or power

ex.en: The two companies fought a titanic battle for control of the market.
ex.zh: 兩家公司為了掌控市場展開一場巨大的激戰。

parts.m: 泰坦（希臘神話中的巨人族）

root.note: 像泰坦巨神一樣的 → 巨大的

mn: 鐵達尼號（Titanic）就是取「巨大」之意。

senses.en: involving hard, tiring work

ex.en: The climb up the steep trail was long and toilsome.
ex.zh: 爬上那條陡峭的山路漫長又辛苦。

root.note: 充滿辛勞的 → 辛苦的

senses.en: able to be endured
fairly good; acceptable

ex.en: The pain was tolerable, so she decided not to take medicine.
ex.zh: 疼痛還能忍受，所以她決定不吃藥。

root.note: 能夠忍受的

senses.en: willingness to accept opinions or behavior different from one's own
the ability to endure something, such as a drug or hardship

ex.en: The school promotes tolerance and respect for all cultures.
ex.zh: 這所學校提倡對所有文化的包容與尊重。

root.note: 能忍受不同 → 寬容

senses.en: willing to accept views or behavior different from one's own
able to endure specific conditions

ex.en: Cactus plants are tolerant of heat and drought.
ex.zh: 仙人掌很耐熱又耐旱。

root.note: 能忍受的 → 寬容的

senses.en: to allow something that one dislikes or disagrees with
to endure without harm

ex.en: The teacher will not tolerate cheating of any kind.
ex.zh: 老師絕不容忍任何形式的作弊。

root.note: 忍受 → 容忍

senses.en: the practice of allowing opinions or religions different from the official one
senses.zh: （宗教、意見上的）寬容政策；容忍

ex.en: The treaty granted religious toleration to minority groups.
ex.zh: 這項條約給予少數群體宗教寬容。

root.note: 容忍的做法 → 寬容政策

senses.en: the physical features of an area of land, such as hills and rivers
the study or mapping of such features

ex.en: The rugged topography made building a railway extremely difficult.
ex.zh: 崎嶇的地形讓鐵路興建極為困難。

root.note: 描繪一個地方 → 地形

senses.en: a state of physical or mental inactivity; sluggishness
a temporary state of lowered body activity in animals

ex.en: After the huge holiday meal, the whole family sank into torpor.
ex.zh: 吃完豐盛的節日大餐後，全家人都懶洋洋地動不了。

root.note: 麻木的狀態 → 遲鈍

senses.en: very hot and dry
full of passion; intense

ex.en: The travelers rested in the shade during the torrid afternoon.
ex.zh: 旅人們在酷熱的午後躲在陰涼處休息。

root.note: 被烤乾的 → 酷熱的

senses.en: (law) relating to a wrongful act that causes harm and can lead to a civil lawsuit

ex.en: The lawyer argued that the company's negligence was tortious.
ex.zh: 律師主張公司的疏失構成侵權。

parts.m: twist, wrong 扭曲、不法行為

root.note: 扭曲正道的不法行為 → 侵權的

mn: tortious（侵權的）、tortuous（彎曲的）、torturous（折磨人的）三個字常被混淆。

senses.en: full of twists and turns
excessively long and complicated
senses.zh: 冗長複雜的；拐彎抹角的

ex.en: The bus crawled up the tortuous mountain road.
ex.zh: 公車沿著蜿蜒的山路慢慢爬升。

root.note: 扭來扭去的 → 曲折的

mn: tortuous 是彎曲，torturous 是折磨人的，別搞混。

senses.en: causing great pain or suffering

ex.en: Waiting for the test results was a torturous experience.
ex.zh: 等待檢查結果的過程非常煎熬。

root.note: 像被扭絞般痛苦 → 折磨人的

senses.en: easy to control or influence
(of a problem) easy to deal with

ex.en: The horse became more tractable after months of patient training.
ex.zh: 經過數月的耐心訓練，這匹馬變得溫順多了。

root.note: 能被牽著走的 → 溫順的

senses.en: a distinguishing quality or characteristic

ex.en: Curiosity is a common trait among successful scientists.
ex.zh: 好奇心是成功科學家的共同特質。

root.note: 畫出來的一筆線條 → 特徵

senses.en: the path of an object moving through the air or space
the general direction of development

ex.en: The company's growth trajectory impressed investors.
ex.zh: 這家公司的成長軌跡讓投資人印象深刻。

root.note: 投擲出去橫越天空的路線 → 軌道

senses.en: something that restricts freedom of action (usually plural)
to restrict or hinder

ex.en: Artists should not let tradition trammel their imagination.
ex.zh: 藝術家不該讓傳統束縛他們的想像力。

senses.en: free from disturbance; calm and peaceful

ex.en: We spent a tranquil afternoon by the lake.
ex.zh: 我們在湖邊度過了一個寧靜的下午。

senses.en: a state of peace and calm

ex.en: The monks value the tranquility of their mountain home.
ex.zh: 僧侶們珍惜山中居所的寧靜。

root.note: 平靜的狀態 → 寧靜

senses.en: to make calm, especially by giving a drug

ex.en: The vet had to tranquilize the tiger before examining it.
ex.zh: 獸醫必須先讓老虎鎮定下來才能檢查。

root.note: 使平靜 → 鎮定

senses.en: to carry out or conduct business

ex.en: Customers can transact most bank business online now.
ex.zh: 顧客現在可以在網路上辦理大多數銀行業務。

root.note: 把事情做完、推動到底 → 處理交易

senses.en: on the other side of the Alps, especially as seen from Italy; crossing the Alps
senses.zh: 阿爾卑斯山那一邊的；橫越阿爾卑斯山的

ex.en: The new transalpine rail tunnel cuts hours off the trip from Zurich to Milan.
ex.zh: 新的阿爾卑斯山鐵路隧道讓蘇黎世到米蘭的車程縮短了好幾個小時。

root.note: 越過阿爾卑斯山的

senses.en: crossing the Atlantic Ocean; involving countries on both sides of it
senses.zh: 橫越大西洋的；跨大西洋的

ex.en: Lindbergh made the first solo transatlantic flight in 1927.
ex.zh: 林白在 1927 年完成首次單人飛越大西洋的飛行。

root.note: 越過大西洋的

senses.en: to go beyond the limits of something
to be greater or better than

ex.en: Great music can transcend barriers of language and culture.
ex.zh: 偉大的音樂能超越語言和文化的隔閡。

root.note: 爬過去、越過去 → 超越

senses.en: going beyond ordinary limits; surpassing
existing beyond the physical world
senses.zh: 超驗的；超越物質世界的

ex.en: Critics called her performance a transcendent moment in theater history.
ex.zh: 評論家稱她的演出是戲劇史上超凡的一刻。

root.note: 越過一般界限的 → 超凡的

senses.en: crossing or extending across a continent

ex.en: The first transcontinental railroad in the U.S. was completed in 1869.
ex.zh: 美國第一條橫貫大陸鐵路於 1869 年完工。

root.note: 橫越大陸的

senses.en: to write down spoken words or copy text in written form
to arrange music for a different instrument

ex.en: The assistant will transcribe the interview recording by Friday.
ex.zh: 助理會在週五前把訪談錄音謄成文字稿。

root.note: 把內容轉寫過去 → 謄寫

senses.en: a written or printed copy of spoken words
an official record of a student's grades

ex.en: Colleges will ask for your high school transcript.
ex.zh: 大學會要求你提供高中成績單。

root.note: 轉寫出來的東西 → 文字稿

senses.en: to move from one place, person, or job to another
[ˋtrænsfɚ] the act of moving something or someone

ex.en: She plans to transfer to a university closer to home.
ex.zh: 她打算轉學到離家比較近的大學。

root.note: 帶到另一邊 → 轉移

senses.en: able to be moved or passed to another person, place, or use

ex.en: Communication is a transferable skill that is useful in any job.
ex.zh: 溝通是一項可轉移的技能，在任何工作中都用得上。

root.note: 可以帶到別處的 → 可轉移的

senses.en: a person to whom something is transferred, or who is transferred
senses.zh: 受讓人；被調任者；轉學生

ex.en: The ticket's transferee must show ID at the gate.
ex.zh: 這張票的受讓人入場時必須出示身分證件。

root.note: 接受轉讓的人 → 受讓人

senses.en: the act of moving something from one place or person to another
(psychology) the redirection of feelings onto another person

ex.en: The transference of power to the new government went smoothly.
ex.zh: 政權移交給新政府的過程很順利。

root.note: 帶到另一邊 → 轉移

senses.en: a person who transfers something, especially property

ex.en: The transferrer must sign the form before the shares can change hands.
ex.zh: 股份易手前，轉讓人必須先在表格上簽名。

root.note: 把東西轉過去的人 → 轉讓人

senses.en: to change the appearance of, making it more beautiful or spiritual
senses.zh: 使改觀；使變得光彩美好

ex.en: A single smile seemed to transfigure her tired face.
ex.zh: 一抹微笑彷彿讓她疲憊的臉龐煥然一新。

root.note: 改變形狀 → 使改觀

senses.en: to transfer blood or fluid into a person's body
to cause to pass through; to permeate

ex.en: Doctors had to transfuse two units of blood during surgery.
ex.zh: 醫生在手術中必須輸兩單位的血。

root.note: 倒過去 → 輸血

senses.en: able to be transfused

ex.en: Only blood that passes safety screening is considered transfusible.
ex.zh: 只有通過安全篩檢的血液才被視為可輸用。

root.note: 可以倒過去的 → 可輸入的

senses.en: the transfer of blood from one person into another
an injection of something new, such as money or energy

ex.en: The accident victim needed a blood transfusion right away.
ex.zh: 那名車禍傷者需要立即輸血。

root.note: 倒過去 → 輸血

senses.en: to break a law, rule, or moral principle
to go beyond a limit

ex.en: Players who transgress the rules will be sent off the field.
ex.zh: 違反規則的球員將被罰出場。

root.note: 走過界線 → 違反

senses.en: the state of lasting only a short time

ex.en: Cherry blossoms remind us of the transience of beauty.
ex.zh: 櫻花提醒我們美好事物的短暫。

root.note: 一下就走過去了 → 短暫

senses.en: lasting only for a short time
a person who stays in a place only briefly

ex.en: Fame on social media is often transient.
ex.zh: 社群媒體上的名氣往往轉瞬即逝。

root.note: 一下就走過去的 → 短暫的

senses.en: the process of changing from one state or condition to another
to undergo or cause a change

ex.en: The transition from high school to college can be challenging.
ex.zh: 從高中過渡到大學可能充滿挑戰。

root.note: 從一邊走到另一邊 → 過渡

senses.en: not permanent; lasting only briefly

ex.en: The economic slowdown proved to be transitory.
ex.zh: 這波經濟放緩後來證明只是暫時的。

root.note: 只是走過去的 → 短暫的

senses.en: to express words in another language
to change or be converted into another form

ex.en: Hard work does not always translate into success.
ex.zh: 努力不一定總能轉化為成功。

root.note: 把意思帶到另一種語言 → 翻譯

senses.en: a person who translates written text from one language to another

ex.en: The novel's translator spent two years on the English edition.
ex.zh: 這本小說的譯者花了兩年完成英文版。

root.note: 把意思帶過去的人 → 譯者

senses.en: the quality of allowing light to pass through partially

ex.en: Collectors prize the translucence of fine porcelain.
ex.zh: 收藏家很看重精緻瓷器的半透明質感。

root.note: 光能穿透 → 半透明

senses.en: allowing light to pass through but not completely clear

ex.en: The bathroom window is made of translucent glass for privacy.
ex.zh: 浴室窗戶用半透明玻璃來保護隱私。

root.note: 光能穿透的 → 半透明的

mn: transparent 是完全透明，translucent 是透光但看不清。

senses.en: able to be passed from one person or organism to another

ex.en: The new variant appears to be more transmissible than earlier strains.
ex.zh: 新變種似乎比先前的病毒株更容易傳播。

root.note: 能被送過去的 → 可傳播的

senses.en: the act of passing something from one person or place to another
a broadcast; the sending of signals
the part of a vehicle that sends power from the engine to the wheels

ex.en: Washing hands reduces the transmission of germs.
ex.zh: 洗手可以減少細菌的傳播。

root.note: 送過去 → 傳送

senses.en: to send or pass from one person, place, or thing to another
to broadcast a signal

ex.en: Mosquitoes can transmit diseases such as malaria.
ex.zh: 蚊子會傳播瘧疾等疾病。

root.note: 送過去 → 傳送

senses.en: to change completely into a different form or substance

ex.en: Alchemists hoped to transmute lead into gold.
ex.zh: 煉金術士希望把鉛變成黃金。

root.note: 徹底改變 → 轉化

senses.en: allowing light through so objects behind can be clearly seen
open and honest; easy to understand
senses.zh: 公開透明的；顯而易見的

ex.en: Voters want a government that is transparent about how it spends money.
ex.zh: 選民希望政府公開透明地說明如何花錢。

root.note: 東西能穿透顯現出來 → 透明的

senses.en: to happen; to become known
(of plants) to give off water vapor through leaves

ex.en: Nobody knows exactly what will transpire at tomorrow's meeting.
ex.zh: 沒有人確切知道明天的會議會發生什麼事。

root.note: 透過（葉面）呼氣 → 蒸散；消息透出來 → 被得知、發生

senses.en: to move a plant, organ, or person to another place
[ˋtrænsˏplænt] an operation to move an organ from one body to another

ex.en: Gardeners transplant tomato seedlings once the frost is over.
ex.zh: 霜期一過，園丁就移植番茄幼苗。

root.note: 種到別處 → 移植

senses.en: the act of switching the order or position of things
the act of writing or playing music in a different key

ex.en: A simple transposition of two digits caused the error in the bill.
ex.zh: 兩個數字的前後顛倒造成了帳單的錯誤。

root.note: 放到另一邊 → 調換位置

senses.en: placed or extending across something

ex.en: The surgeon made a small transverse cut across the abdomen.
ex.zh: 外科醫生在腹部橫向切了一個小切口。

root.note: 轉向橫著放 → 橫向的

senses.en: painful or exhausting effort; hardship (often plural)
(old use) the pain of childbirth

ex.en: The memoir describes the travail of immigrants building a new life.
ex.zh: 這本回憶錄描述了移民重建新生活的艱辛。

mn: travel（旅行）就是從 travail 演變而來：古時旅行是件苦差事。

senses.en: a false, absurd, or distorted version of something

ex.en: The unfair trial was a travesty of justice.
ex.zh: 這場不公的審判是對正義的嘲弄。

root.note: 換上別的衣服、變了樣 → 歪曲、拙劣模仿

mn: 常見片語 a travesty of justice（對正義的嘲弄）。

senses.en: guilty of betraying trust
having hidden dangers

ex.en: Icy roads made the mountain drive treacherous.
ex.zh: 結冰的路面讓山路駕駛變得危機四伏。

senses.en: betrayal of trust

ex.en: The general's treachery led to the fall of the city.
ex.zh: 將軍的背叛導致這座城市淪陷。

senses.en: involving the crime of betraying one's country

ex.en: Selling military secrets to a foreign power is a treasonable offense.
ex.zh: 把軍事機密賣給外國是叛國罪。

root.note: 構成叛國的

senses.en: a formal written work that deals with a subject systematically

ex.en: Newton's treatise on motion changed the course of physics.
ex.zh: 牛頓關於運動的論著改變了物理學的發展。

senses.en: three times as much or as many
to become or make three times as large
a high-pitched voice or sound; the highest part in music

ex.en: The price of the concert tickets could treble on resale sites.
ex.zh: 演唱會門票在轉售網站上可能漲到三倍。

senses.en: three times as much; triply

ex.en: After the accident, she was trebly careful on the stairs.
ex.zh: 那次意外後，她上下樓梯時格外加倍小心。

root.note: 三倍地

senses.en: very great in amount, size, or power
extremely good

ex.en: The volunteers made a tremendous effort to clean up the beach.
ex.zh: 志工們花了極大的力氣清理海灘。

root.note: 大到令人發抖的 → 巨大的

senses.en: a slight earthquake
an involuntary shaking movement

ex.en: A small tremor shook the windows early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天清晨一次小地震把窗戶震得嘎嘎響。

root.note: 顫動 → 輕微地震

senses.en: shaking or trembling slightly, often from nervousness

ex.en: She answered in a tremulous voice, clearly afraid.
ex.zh: 她用顫抖的聲音回答，顯然很害怕。

root.note: 一直在顫抖的

senses.en: sharp, clear, and forceful in expression

ex.en: The critic's trenchant review exposed every flaw in the plot.
ex.zh: 評論家尖銳的評論揭露了情節的每一個漏洞。

root.note: 像刀一樣切得深 → 尖銳的

senses.en: a feeling of fear or worry about something that may happen

ex.en: She opened the college letter with some trepidation.
ex.zh: 她有些忐忑地打開大學寄來的信。

root.note: 因害怕而發抖 → 惶恐

mn: intrepid（無畏的）是 in-（不）+ trepid（害怕）。

senses.en: a frame with a horizontal beam and legs, used to support a table
a framework supporting a bridge

ex.en: The old train crossed the valley on a wooden trestle.
ex.zh: 老火車沿著木造棧橋穿越山谷。

senses.en: a group or set of three related things or people
a musical chord of three notes

ex.en: The triad of poor diet, stress, and little sleep harms health.
ex.zh: 飲食不良、壓力與睡眠不足這三者會損害健康。

root.note: 三個一組

senses.en: an official in ancient Rome chosen to protect the rights of common people
a champion of the people; a raised platform for speakers

ex.en: The Roman tribune could veto laws that harmed ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 羅馬護民官可以否決有損平民的法律。

root.note: 代表部族的官員 → 護民官

mn: 很多報紙取名 Tribune，意思是「人民的喉舌」。

senses.en: the use of tricks to deceive or cheat

ex.en: The scammers used trickery to get people's bank details.
ex.zh: 詐騙集團用詭計騙取人們的銀行資料。

senses.en: a flag with three bands of different colors, especially the French flag
having three colors

ex.en: The French tricolor flew above the town hall.
ex.zh: 法國三色旗在市政廳上空飄揚。

root.note: 三種顏色 → 三色旗

senses.en: a vehicle like a bicycle but with three wheels

ex.en: My little brother rode his tricycle around the park.
ex.zh: 我弟弟騎著他的三輪車繞公園。

root.note: 三個輪子 → 三輪車

senses.en: a spear with three points

ex.en: The statue shows Poseidon holding a trident above the waves.
ex.zh: 這尊雕像呈現波塞頓在浪濤上高舉三叉戟。

root.note: 有三個齒 → 三叉戟

senses.en: happening every three years; lasting three years
senses.zh: 每三年一次的；持續三年的

senses.en: an event held every three years
senses.zh: 三年展；三年一度的活動

ex.en: The city hosts a triennial art festival that draws visitors worldwide.
ex.zh: 這座城市每三年舉辦一次藝術節，吸引世界各地的遊客。

root.note: 每三年的

senses.en: the quality of being neat, tidy, and in good order; slimness

ex.en: Visitors admired the trimness of the small garden.
ex.zh: 訪客讚賞這座小花園的整潔。

root.note: 整齊的狀態

senses.en: a group of three closely related things
(the Trinity) in Christianity, the union of Father, Son, and Holy Spirit

ex.en: Speed, strength, and skill formed the trinity of her success.
ex.zh: 速度、力量與技巧是她成功的三大支柱。

root.note: 三者合一

senses.en: a group of three people or things
a piece of music for three performers

ex.en: The trio of friends traveled across Europe by train.
ex.zh: 這三個好朋友搭火車遊遍歐洲。

root.note: 三個一組

senses.en: consisting of three parts; three times as much
to increase to three times as much

ex.en: The number of online shoppers could triple in five years.
ex.zh: 網購人數五年內可能增加到三倍。

root.note: 三倍

senses.en: one of three identical copies (often in triplicate)
existing in three copies
[ˋtrɪpləˏket] to make three copies of

ex.en: The form must be filled out in triplicate.
ex.zh: 這份表格必須填寫一式三份。

root.note: 摺成三份 → 一式三份

mn: 對照 duplicate（一式兩份）。

senses.en: the state of being threefold; a group of three
(astrology) a set of three zodiac signs of the same element

ex.en: The poem explores the triplicity of mind, body, and spirit.
ex.zh: 這首詩探討心智、身體與靈魂的三重性。

root.note: 三重的性質

senses.en: a three-legged stand used to support a camera or other device

ex.en: Use a tripod to keep the camera steady in low light.
ex.zh: 光線不足時，用三腳架讓相機保持穩定。

root.note: 三隻腳 → 三腳架

senses.en: to divide into three equal parts

ex.en: Ancient mathematicians tried to trisect an angle using only a compass and ruler.
ex.zh: 古代數學家試圖只用圓規和直尺三等分一個角。

root.note: 切成三份 → 三等分

senses.en: overused and therefore dull or unoriginal

ex.en: The movie's ending felt trite and predictable.
ex.zh: 這部電影的結局感覺老套又可預測。

parts.m: rubbed, worn 磨損（拉丁文 terere）

root.note: 被磨舊了的 → 陳腐的

senses.en: one of three people who share power, especially in ancient Rome
senses.zh: （古羅馬）三執政之一；三巨頭之一

ex.en: Julius Caesar ruled as a triumvir alongside Pompey and Crassus.
ex.zh: 凱撒與龐培、克拉蘇共同組成三頭政治，是三巨頭之一。

root.note: 三個男人之一 → 三執政之一

mn: 三人共治的政權稱為 triumvirate。

senses.en: of little value or importance

ex.en: Don't waste the meeting arguing about trivial details.
ex.zh: 別把會議時間浪費在爭論瑣碎的細節上。

root.note: 三岔路口的閒聊 → 瑣碎的

senses.en: causing difficulty or annoyance

ex.en: The troublesome printer jammed three times this morning.
ex.zh: 那台麻煩的印表機今天早上卡紙了三次。

root.note: 帶來麻煩的

senses.en: an eager or quick tendency to argue or fight

ex.en: His truculence made every negotiation longer and more tense.
ex.zh: 他好鬥的態度讓每次談判都拖得更久、更緊繃。

root.note: 兇猛的性情 → 好鬥

senses.en: eager to argue or fight; aggressively defiant

ex.en: The truculent customer shouted at every employee in the store.
ex.zh: 那位好鬥的顧客對店裡每個員工大吼。

root.note: 充滿兇猛 → 好鬥的

senses.en: a statement so obviously true that it is hardly worth saying
senses.zh: 不言而喻的道理；老生常談

ex.en: It is a truism that practice makes perfect.
ex.zh: 熟能生巧是個不言而喻的道理。

root.note: 明顯真實的話 → 老生常談

senses.en: telling or expressing the truth; honest

ex.en: Please be truthful about why you missed the meeting.
ex.zh: 請誠實說明你為什麼沒來開會。

senses.en: (of language) pompous, overly complex, and boring
swollen or distended

ex.en: The report's turgid prose made it hard to find the main point.
ex.zh: 報告文字浮誇冗長，很難找出重點。

root.note: 膨脹起來的 → 腫脹的；文字膨脹 → 浮誇的

senses.en: wickedness; depraved behavior

ex.en: The official was fired for moral turpitude after the bribery case.
ex.zh: 那名官員在賄賂案後因道德敗壞而遭免職。

parts.m: base, shameful 卑鄙的（拉丁文 turpis）

root.note: 卑鄙可恥 → 墮落

mn: 法律上常用 moral turpitude（道德敗壞）。

senses.en: protection or guidance, especially by a teacher
guardianship

ex.en: Under the tutelage of a famous chef, he learned to make perfect pastry.
ex.zh: 在名廚的指導下，他學會了做完美的酥皮點心。

parts.m: watch, protect 看護（拉丁文 tueri）

root.note: 看護照顧 → 監護、指導

senses.en: serving as a guardian or protector

ex.en: The villagers believed a tutelar spirit watched over the old well.
ex.zh: 村民相信有一位守護神看守著那口古井。

root.note: 看護著的 → 守護的

senses.en: the position or work of a tutor

ex.en: Under her tutorship, the struggling student passed every exam.
ex.zh: 在她的輔導下，原本吃力的學生通過了每一科考試。

root.note: 導師的身分 → 導師職

senses.en: a sudden, sharp, short pain
a brief pang of emotion

ex.en: She felt a twinge of guilt for eating her roommate's cookies.
ex.zh: 她吃了室友的餅乾，心裡有點內疚。

senses.en: having the usual qualities of a particular type
characteristic of someone's usual behavior

ex.en: A typical school day begins at eight and ends at four.
ex.zh: 典型的上學日從八點開始，四點結束。

root.note: 符合類型模式的 → 典型的

senses.en: to be a typical example of

ex.en: These glass towers typify the city's modern architecture.
ex.zh: 這些玻璃大樓是這座城市現代建築的典型代表。

root.note: 成為某類型的代表 → 作為典型

senses.en: relating to printing or typing
senses.zh: 印刷上的；排版的；打字上的

ex.en: The editor caught a typographical error in the headline.
ex.zh: 編輯在標題中抓到一個打字錯誤。

root.note: 用字模書寫的 → 印刷的

mn: typo（錯字）就是 typographical error 的縮寫。

senses.en: the style and arrangement of printed text
the art or process of printing

ex.en: Good typography makes a website easier to read.
ex.zh: 好的字體排印讓網站更容易閱讀。

root.note: 用字模書寫的技術 → 字體排印

senses.en: using power in a cruel and unfair way

ex.en: The novel is about a village living under a tyrannical landlord.
ex.zh: 這部小說講述一個生活在暴虐地主統治下的村莊。

root.note: 像暴君的 → 暴虐的

senses.en: cruel and oppressive government or rule
cruel or unfair control over others

ex.en: The revolutionaries vowed to fight against tyranny.
ex.zh: 革命者誓言對抗暴政。

root.note: 暴君的統治 → 暴政

senses.en: a beginner or novice

ex.en: As a tyro at chess, he lost every game in the tournament.
ex.zh: 身為西洋棋新手，他在比賽中每局都輸了。

senses.en: present, appearing, or found everywhere
senses.zh: 無所不在的；到處都是的

ex.en: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, even among young children.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機已經無所不在，連小孩子都有。

root.note: 到處都在 → 無所不在

senses.en: (of a reason) hidden or secret, especially selfish
further; beyond what is immediate

ex.en: I suspect he has an ulterior motive for being so helpful.
ex.zh: 我懷疑他那麼熱心是別有用心。

root.note: 在更遠處、看不到的 → 隱藏的

mn: 最常見的片語：ulterior motive（不可告人的動機）。

senses.en: final; being the end result
the best or most extreme of its kind
basic or fundamental

ex.en: The ultimate goal of the project is to provide clean water to every village.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的最終目標是讓每個村莊都有乾淨的水。

root.note: 最遠的 → 最終的

senses.en: a final demand, with a threat of punishment if it is refused

ex.en: The landlord gave them an ultimatum: pay the rent or leave.
ex.zh: 房東給他們下了最後通牒：付房租，不然就搬走。

root.note: 最後的條件 → 最後通牒

senses.en: supporting the supreme authority of the Pope
situated beyond the mountains, especially the Alps
senses.zh: 山那邊的；阿爾卑斯山以南的

ex.en: The ultramontane bishops opposed any limit on papal power.
ex.zh: 主張教皇至上的主教們反對任何限制教皇權力的做法。

root.note: 在山那邊的（從法國看，教廷在阿爾卑斯山另一邊）→ 教皇至上的

senses.en: beyond the physical world or the solar system
senses.zh: 超越塵世的；太陽系以外的

ex.en: Mystics claimed to glimpse an ultramundane realm during meditation.
ex.zh: 神秘主義者聲稱在冥想中瞥見了超越塵世的境界。

root.note: 超越世界的

senses.en: offense or annoyance
(literary) shade or shadow

ex.en: He took umbrage at the suggestion that he had cheated.
ex.zh: 有人暗示他作弊，他為此很不高興。

root.note: 心中蒙上陰影 → 不快

mn: 固定用法 take umbrage at（對…感到不快）；umbrella（傘）同字根。

senses.en: impossible to explain
senses.zh: 無法解釋的；莫名其妙的

senses.en: not responsible to anyone for one's actions
senses.zh: 不必負責的；不受問責的

ex.en: For some unaccountable reason, the lights kept flickering.
ex.zh: 不知為何，燈一直閃個不停。

root.note: 無法說明的 → 莫名其妙的

senses.en: not influenced or changed by something
natural and sincere; not pretentious

ex.en: Towns in the north were unaffected by the flood.
ex.zh: 北部的城鎮沒有受到洪水影響。

root.note: 沒被影響的；沒有故作姿態的 → 自然的

senses.en: complete agreement among everyone involved

ex.en: The jury's decision requires unanimity in criminal cases.
ex.zh: 刑事案件中，陪審團的裁決必須全體一致。

root.note: 大家同一條心 → 全體一致

senses.en: fully agreed on by everyone
senses.zh: 全體一致的；一致同意的

ex.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision to approve the plan.
ex.zh: 委員會一致決定通過這項計畫。

root.note: 同一條心 → 一致的

senses.en: not able to be avoided or prevented

ex.en: Some delays are unavoidable during heavy snowstorms.
ex.zh: 大雪期間，有些延誤是無法避免的。

root.note: 不能避免的

senses.en: too painful or unpleasant to endure
senses.zh: 無法忍受的；難以承受的

ex.en: The summer heat in the classroom was almost unbearable.
ex.zh: 夏天教室裡的高溫幾乎讓人無法忍受。

root.note: 不能忍受的

senses.en: not suitable or proper for a person's position
(of clothing) not flattering

ex.en: Yelling at referees is behavior unbecoming of a team captain.
ex.zh: 對裁判大吼不是隊長該有的得體行為。

root.note: 不合適的 → 不得體的

senses.en: lack of religious belief; skepticism

ex.en: The novel follows a priest struggling with his own unbelief.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫一位與自身信仰動搖掙扎的神父。

root.note: 沒有信仰

senses.en: fair and not influenced by personal opinions

ex.en: We need an unbiased judge to settle the dispute.
ex.zh: 我們需要一位公正的裁判來解決這場爭議。

root.note: 沒有偏斜的 → 公正的

senses.en: uncontrolled; unrestrained

ex.en: The children ran into the pool with unbridled joy.
ex.zh: 孩子們帶著無拘無束的喜悅衝進泳池。

root.note: 沒套上韁繩的 → 不受約束的

senses.en: not happening or found often; unusual
remarkably great

ex.en: It is not uncommon for students to feel stressed before exams.
ex.zh: 學生考前感到壓力並不罕見。

root.note: 不常見的

senses.en: not right or reasonable; morally unacceptable
excessive

ex.en: Charging sick patients such high prices is unconscionable.
ex.zh: 向生病的患者收這麼高的費用實在沒良心。

root.note: 良心（conscience）無法接受的 → 違背良心的

senses.en: not awake and not aware of surroundings
done without realizing
the part of the mind one is not aware of

ex.en: The boxer lay unconscious on the floor for a full minute.
ex.zh: 那名拳擊手昏倒在地上整整一分鐘。

root.note: 不知道周遭的 → 失去知覺的

senses.en: the act of anointing with oil in a religious ceremony
a manner of excessive, insincere earnestness

ex.en: The priest performed the unction at the dying man's bedside.
ex.zh: 神父在臨終者床邊為他施行塗油禮。

root.note: 塗油 → 塗油禮；說話油滑 → 虛情假意

senses.en: excessively and insincerely flattering or polite
senses.zh: 油腔滑調的；虛情假意的

senses.en: greasy or oily

ex.en: The unctuous salesman praised every car I looked at.
ex.zh: 那個油腔滑調的業務員對我看的每輛車都大加讚美。

root.note: 油油的 → 油腔滑調的

senses.en: to free someone from a mistaken belief

ex.en: Someone should undeceive him before he invests all his savings.
ex.zh: 應該有人在他投入所有積蓄之前讓他看清真相。

root.note: 解除欺騙 → 使醒悟

senses.en: to charge less than the proper price

ex.en: The cashier did not mean to undercharge us for the groceries.
ex.zh: 收銀員不是故意少收我們的菜錢。

parts.m: below, too little 在下、不足

root.note: 收費不足 → 少收

senses.en: (of a photograph) too dark because not enough light was used
not given enough publicity or experience
senses.zh: 缺乏曝光的；接觸不足的

ex.en: The photos came out underexposed because the room was so dim.
ex.zh: 房間太暗，照片都曝光不足。

root.note: 放出來見光不足 → 曝光不足的

senses.en: a piece of clothing worn under other clothes

ex.en: Wear a warm undergarment beneath your jacket when skiing.
ex.zh: 滑雪時在外套裡面穿一件保暖內衣。

root.note: 穿在裡面的衣物 → 內衣

senses.en: acting or done secretly and dishonestly
senses.zh: 祕密的；不光明正大的；陰險的

ex.en: The rival company used underhanded tactics to steal clients.
ex.zh: 對手公司用不正當的手段搶客戶。

root.note: 手藏在底下偷偷做 → 不光明的

senses.en: to be the cause or basis of something
senses.zh: 構成…的基礎；是…的根本原因

senses.en: to lie beneath

ex.en: Several factors underlie the rise in housing prices.
ex.zh: 房價上漲背後有好幾個因素。

root.note: 躺在底下 → 構成基礎

senses.en: a person lower in rank, often used disapprovingly

ex.en: The boss never talks to an underling unless something goes wrong.
ex.zh: 老闆除非出了問題，否則從不跟底下的人說話。

root.note: 在下面的小人物 → 嘍囉

senses.en: to provide with too few workers or crew

ex.en: Managers should not underman the night shift during flu season.
ex.zh: 流感季節時，主管不該讓夜班人手不足。

root.note: 配置人手不足

senses.en: to weaken gradually, especially in a secret way
to dig under the base of something
senses.zh: 在…下挖坑道；侵蝕…的基礎

ex.en: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
ex.zh: 不斷的批評會逐漸削弱孩子的自信。

root.note: 在底下挖坑道 → 暗中破壞

senses.en: to underestimate the ability or value of

ex.en: Never underrate the power of a good night's sleep.
ex.zh: 千萬別低估一夜好眠的威力。

root.note: 評價過低 → 低估

senses.en: to sell at a lower price than a competitor
senses.zh: 賤賣；以低於對手的價格出售

senses.en: to present something as less valuable than it is

ex.en: Don't undersell yourself in the job interview.
ex.zh: 求職面試時別貶低自己。

root.note: 賣得比別人低 → 削價出售

senses.en: smaller than usual or than is required
senses.zh: 比一般小的；尺寸不足的

ex.en: Fishermen must throw back any undersized crabs.
ex.zh: 漁民必須把尺寸不足的螃蟹放回海中。

root.note: 尺寸不足的

senses.en: to describe something as smaller or less important than it really is

ex.en: It would understate the problem to call it a small leak.
ex.zh: 把它說成小漏水，就太輕描淡寫這個問題了。

root.note: 說得比實際少 → 輕描淡寫

senses.en: to rate something as less important or valuable than it is

ex.en: Many companies undervalue the work of customer service staff.
ex.zh: 很多公司低估了客服人員的工作價值。

root.note: 估價過低

senses.en: the world of organized crime
(in myths) the world of the dead beneath the earth

ex.en: In Greek myth, Hades ruled the underworld.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，黑帝斯統治冥界。

root.note: 地底下的世界 → 冥界；社會底層的世界 → 黑社會

senses.en: to agree to pay for or financially support
to accept financial risk, as in insurance

ex.en: A local bank agreed to underwrite the cost of the festival.
ex.zh: 一家地方銀行同意負擔這個節慶的費用。

root.note: 在文件下方簽名擔保 → 承保、資助

senses.en: more than is necessary or reasonable; excessive

ex.en: The new rules put undue pressure on small businesses.
ex.zh: 新規定對小型企業造成過度的壓力。

root.note: 超出應有的 → 過度的

senses.en: to move or be shaped like waves

ex.en: Fields of wheat undulate gently in the summer breeze.
ex.zh: 麥田在夏日微風中輕輕起伏。

root.note: 像小波浪一樣 → 起伏

senses.en: wavy; rising and falling like waves

ex.en: The painter captured the undulous hills beneath a pale sky.
ex.zh: 畫家捕捉到淡色天空下起伏的山丘。

root.note: 像小波浪的 → 波浪狀的

senses.en: expressing disapproval
not helpful or advantageous

ex.en: Unfavorable weather forced the launch to be delayed.
ex.zh: 不利的天候迫使發射延期。

root.note: 不支持的 → 不利的

senses.en: awkward and clumsy in movement

ex.en: The newborn giraffe took a few ungainly steps.
ex.zh: 剛出生的長頸鹿笨拙地走了幾步。

senses.en: a soft, greasy substance used on skin or wounds

ex.en: The healer rubbed a soothing unguent on the burn.
ex.zh: 治療師在燙傷處塗上舒緩的藥膏。

root.note: 塗抹的油膏 → 藥膏

senses.en: made up of a single cell

ex.en: Bacteria are unicellular organisms.
ex.zh: 細菌是單細胞生物。

root.note: 只有一個細胞的

senses.en: to bring together to form a single unit

ex.en: The new leader promised to unify the divided country.
ex.zh: 新領導人承諾要統一這個分裂的國家。

root.note: 使成為一體 → 統一

senses.en: being the only one of its kind
very special or unusual

ex.en: Each snowflake has a unique pattern.
ex.zh: 每一片雪花都有獨一無二的圖案。

root.note: 只有一個的 → 獨一無二的

senses.en: the act of doing or saying something at the same time
the same musical pitch sung or played together

ex.en: The students answered in unison, "Good morning, teacher!"
ex.zh: 學生們齊聲回答：「老師早！」

root.note: 同一個聲音 → 齊聲、一致

mn: 常用 in unison（一齊、一致）。

senses.en: having the same pitch; in unison

ex.en: The two flutes played a unisonant melody.
ex.zh: 兩支長笛吹奏同音的旋律。

root.note: 發出同一個聲音的 → 同音的

senses.en: a member of a Christian group that believes God is one being, rejecting the Trinity
relating to the Unitarians

ex.en: The town's Unitarian church welcomes people of many beliefs.
ex.zh: 鎮上的一位論派教會歡迎各種信仰的人。

root.note: 相信神是唯一一體的人 → 一位論派

senses.en: (chemistry) the property of having a valence of one

ex.en: The univalence of sodium explains why it forms simple salts with chlorine.
ex.zh: 鈉的一價特性說明了它為何能和氯形成簡單的鹽類。

root.note: 一個價數 → 一價

senses.en: not allowed by law; illegal

ex.en: It is unlawful to drive without a valid license.
ex.zh: 無照駕駛是違法的。

root.note: 不合法的

senses.en: not limited in number, amount, or extent

ex.en: The phone plan includes unlimited data for one month.
ex.zh: 這個手機方案包含一個月的無限上網。

root.note: 沒有界限的

senses.en: different from what is normal or found in nature
forced or affected

ex.en: Her smile in the photo looked stiff and unnatural.
ex.zh: 她在照片裡的笑容看起來很僵硬、不自然。

root.note: 不自然的

senses.en: not needed

ex.en: Please avoid unnecessary travel during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間請避免不必要的外出。

root.note: 不是必要的

senses.en: to make someone anxious or uneasy
to disturb the stability of

ex.en: Sudden changes in routine can unsettle young children.
ex.zh: 作息突然改變會讓小孩感到不安。

root.note: 使不再安定 → 使不安

senses.en: lacking worldly experience or refined taste
simple; not complicated

ex.en: The early computers were unsophisticated by today's standards.
ex.zh: 以今天的標準來看，早期電腦很陽春。

root.note: 不世故的 → 單純的

senses.en: too bad or horrific to be expressed in words
senses.zh: 說不出口的；極其惡劣的

senses.en: (of a feeling) too great to be described

ex.en: The survivors described unspeakable conditions in the camp.
ex.zh: 倖存者描述了營中駭人聽聞的處境。

root.note: 無法說出口的

senses.en: happening too soon or at the wrong time

ex.en: The musician's untimely death shocked his fans.
ex.zh: 這位音樂家英年早逝，讓歌迷非常震驚。

root.note: 不合時的

senses.en: unexpected and inappropriate or inconvenient

ex.en: The guard reported that nothing untoward happened during the night.
ex.zh: 警衛報告說夜裡一切正常，沒發生什麼異狀。

senses.en: too great or awful to be described in words

ex.en: She felt unutterable relief when her son walked through the door.
ex.zh: 看到兒子走進門，她感到說不出的寬慰。

root.note: 說不出來的

senses.en: hard to carry or move because of size or weight
(of a system) too large or complex to work well

ex.en: The old sofa was too unwieldy to carry up the stairs.
ex.zh: 那張舊沙發太笨重，搬不上樓。

root.note: 不好操控的 → 笨重的

senses.en: showing poor judgment; foolish

ex.en: It would be unwise to hike alone without telling anyone.
ex.zh: 不告訴任何人就獨自健行是不明智的。

root.note: 不明智的

senses.en: to release animals from a yoke
to set free from a burden or bond

ex.en: At sunset the farmer would unyoke the oxen and lead them home.
ex.zh: 日落時，農夫會卸下牛軛，把牛牽回家。

root.note: 解開軛 → 解除束縛

senses.en: the process or cost of keeping something in good condition

ex.en: The up-keep of a large house can be very expensive.
ex.zh: 大房子的維護費用可能非常高。

root.note: 保持在良好狀態 → 維修保養

mn: 現代多拼成 upkeep。

senses.en: to scold or criticize severely

ex.en: The coach did not upbraid the players after the loss; he encouraged them.
ex.zh: 輸球後教練沒有責罵球員，反而鼓勵他們。

senses.en: directed or thrown upward
a shaft through which air leaves a mine

ex.en: She prayed silently with upcast eyes.
ex.zh: 她抬眼向上，默默祈禱。

root.note: 向上投 → 朝上的

senses.en: a sudden, violent change or disruption
an upward movement of the earth's surface

ex.en: The war caused great social and economic upheaval.
ex.zh: 這場戰爭造成了巨大的社會與經濟動盪。

root.note: 被猛然向上掀起 → 劇變

senses.en: to lift or be lifted forcefully upward

ex.en: The earthquake could upheave whole sections of the coast.
ex.zh: 地震可能讓整段海岸隆起。

root.note: 向上舉起

senses.en: highest in position or rank
most important in one's mind

ex.en: Safety was uppermost in the pilot's mind during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨中，飛行員心中最重視的是安全。

root.note: 最上面的

senses.en: very noisy and full of excitement
extremely funny

ex.en: The comedian's uproarious show left the audience in tears.
ex.zh: 這位喜劇演員爆笑的表演讓觀眾笑到流淚。

root.note: 一片喧鬧的

senses.en: to pull a plant out of the ground with its roots
to force someone to leave their home
senses.zh: 使離開家園；使流離失所

ex.en: The typhoon managed to uproot dozens of trees along the road.
ex.zh: 颱風把路旁數十棵樹連根拔起。

root.note: 把根往上拔起

senses.en: an improvement or upward trend, especially in the economy
[ʌpˋtɝn] to turn something upward or upside down

ex.en: Shops are hoping for an upturn in sales during the holidays.
ex.zh: 商店希望假期期間銷售能夠回升。

root.note: 向上轉 → 好轉

senses.en: relating to a city or town

ex.en: More than half the world's people now live in urban areas.
ex.zh: 如今全世界超過一半的人口住在都市地區。

root.note: 城市的

senses.en: polished courtesy and sophistication in manner
urban life or character

ex.en: The ambassador handled the tense dinner with charm and urbanity.
ex.zh: 大使以魅力與優雅得體的風度化解了晚宴的緊張氣氛。

root.note: 城市人的舉止 → 溫文儒雅

senses.en: a poor, often dirty and mischievous child
short for sea urchin

ex.en: A barefoot urchin begged for coins outside the train station.
ex.zh: 一個赤腳的小孩在火車站外討零錢。

mn: 原意是「刺蝟」，海膽 sea urchin 就是「海裡的刺蝟」。

senses.en: importance that requires quick action

ex.en: The doctor's tone showed the urgency of the situation.
ex.zh: 醫生的語氣顯示出情況的緊急。

root.note: 被催促著 → 緊急

senses.en: the way in which words are normally used
the action or amount of using something

ex.en: Water usage rises sharply during the hot summer months.
ex.zh: 炎熱的夏季月份用水量急劇上升。

root.note: 使用的方式或數量

senses.en: charging extremely high interest on loans
senses.zh: 放高利貸的；利息過高的

ex.en: The payday lender charged usurious rates of over 300 percent.
ex.zh: 那家發薪日貸款業者收取超過 300% 的高利貸利率。

root.note: 收取過高利息的

senses.en: to take a position of power illegally or by force

ex.en: The general tried to usurp the throne while the king was abroad.
ex.zh: 將軍趁國王出國時企圖篡奪王位。

senses.en: the practice of lending money at extremely high interest

ex.en: Many medieval laws banned usury as a sin.
ex.zh: 許多中世紀法律把放高利貸視為罪行而加以禁止。

root.note: 借錢給人使用而收取費用 → 高利貸

senses.en: the belief that the right action is the one that produces the greatest good for the most people

ex.en: Utilitarianism judges actions only by their results.
ex.zh: 功利主義只根據結果來評斷行為。

root.note: 以效用為依歸的主義 → 功利主義

senses.en: the state of being useful or beneficial
a public service such as electricity, water, or gas

ex.en: Our monthly rent does not include utility bills.
ex.zh: 我們的月租不包含水電瓦斯費。

root.note: 可使用的性質 → 效用

senses.en: greatest; most extreme
the greatest amount or extent possible

ex.en: This matter is of the utmost importance.
ex.zh: 這件事極為重要。

root.note: 最外面的、最遠的 → 極度的

mn: 常見片語 do one's utmost（盡最大努力）、of the utmost importance（極其重要）。

senses.en: to leave a place so it becomes empty
to give up a position or job
(law) to cancel or annul

ex.en: Guests must vacate their rooms by noon.
ex.zh: 房客必須在中午前退房。

root.note: 使變空 → 空出

senses.en: to give someone a vaccine to protect against a disease

ex.en: Doctors recommend that you vaccinate your children against measles.
ex.zh: 醫生建議讓孩子接種麻疹疫苗。

root.note: 最早的疫苗取自牛痘 → 接種疫苗

senses.en: to keep changing between different opinions or actions

ex.en: I vacillate between wanting to study law and wanting to study art.
ex.zh: 我一直在想念法律還是念藝術之間搖擺不定。

root.note: 來回搖晃 → 猶豫不決

senses.en: showing a lack of thought or intelligence; empty-headed

ex.en: The celebrity gave a vacuous answer that said nothing at all.
ex.zh: 那位名人給了一個空洞的回答，等於什麼都沒說。

root.note: 腦袋空空的 → 空洞的

senses.en: a space completely empty of matter or air
a gap left by the absence of something
to clean with a vacuum cleaner

ex.en: His resignation left a power vacuum in the company.
ex.zh: 他的辭職在公司裡留下了權力真空。

root.note: 空無一物 → 真空

senses.en: a person who wanders from place to place without a home or job
wandering; having no settled home

ex.en: He lived like a vagabond, traveling from town to town with a guitar.
ex.zh: 他像流浪漢般過活，帶著一把吉他一鎮走過一鎮。

root.note: 喜歡四處遊蕩的人 → 流浪者

senses.en: a person without a home or job who lives by begging
wandering; moving without direction

ex.en: A vagrant slept on the bench outside the library each night.
ex.zh: 每晚都有一名遊民睡在圖書館外的長椅上。

root.note: 四處漫遊的人 → 流浪漢

senses.en: excessive pride and boastfulness

ex.en: The king's vainglory led him into a war he could not win.
ex.zh: 國王的自負讓他捲入一場不可能打贏的戰爭。

root.note: 空虛的榮耀 → 虛榮自負

senses.en: (literary) a valley

ex.en: A small stream wound through the quiet vale.
ex.zh: 一條小溪蜿蜒流過寧靜的山谷。

mn: 片語 vale of tears 指「塵世苦海」。

senses.en: the act of saying farewell; a farewell speech or statement

ex.en: The retiring teacher's valediction brought many students to tears.
ex.zh: 退休老師的告別辭讓許多學生落淚。

parts.m: farewell 再會（拉丁文，原意「保重」）

root.note: 說再見 → 告別辭

senses.en: the top-ranking student who gives the farewell speech at graduation
senses.zh: （畢業典禮上致辭的）畢業生代表；第一名畢業生

ex.en: As valedictorian, she thanked her teachers in her graduation speech.
ex.zh: 身為畢業生代表，她在畢業致詞中感謝了老師們。

root.note: 上台說再見的人 → 畢業生代表

senses.en: serving as a farewell
a farewell speech

ex.en: The senator gave a valedictory speech on her last day in office.
ex.zh: 這位參議員在任期最後一天發表了告別演說。

root.note: 說再見的 → 告別的

senses.en: based on sound reasoning; logically correct
legally or officially acceptable

ex.en: You raise a valid point about the cost of the trip.
ex.zh: 你對旅費提出的看法很有道理。

root.note: 站得住腳的 → 有效的

senses.en: showing great courage, especially in battle

ex.en: The firefighters were honored for their valorous rescue.
ex.zh: 消防員因英勇的救援行動而受到表揚。

root.note: 充滿勇氣（valor）的

senses.en: lacking interest, liveliness, or challenge; dull

ex.en: The song's vapid lyrics were quickly forgotten.
ex.zh: 那首歌空洞乏味的歌詞很快就被遺忘了。

senses.en: a device that turns liquid into vapor, often used for medicine or moisture

ex.en: We put a vaporizer in the baby's room to ease her cough.
ex.zh: 我們在寶寶房間放了蒸氣機來緩解她的咳嗽。

root.note: 使變成蒸氣的器具

senses.en: likely to change; not consistent
a factor or quantity that can change, as in an experiment

ex.en: In this experiment, temperature is the only variable we change.
ex.zh: 這個實驗中，溫度是我們唯一改變的變因。

root.note: 能變化的

senses.en: the amount by which something differs; disagreement
official permission to break a rule, such as a building regulation

ex.en: His actions are at variance with his words.
ex.zh: 他的行為和他說的話不一致。

root.note: 變化的程度 → 差異

mn: at variance with 表示「與…不一致」。

senses.en: a form or version that differs slightly from others
differing slightly from a standard form

ex.en: Scientists are tracking a new variant of the virus.
ex.zh: 科學家正在追蹤這種病毒的一個新變種。

root.note: 起了變化的 → 變體

senses.en: a change or difference in amount, level, or form
a different version of something

ex.en: There is little variation in temperature near the equator.
ex.zh: 赤道附近的氣溫變化不大。

root.note: 變化

senses.en: to mark with patches of different colors
to give variety to

ex.en: Gardeners breed plants that variegate their leaves with white stripes.
ex.zh: 園藝家培育出葉片帶有白色斑紋的植物。

parts.m: do, make 做（拉丁文 agere）

root.note: 做成各種顏色 → 使雜色

senses.en: in the feudal system, a person who held land from a lord in return for loyalty
a person or country that is dependent on and controlled by another

ex.en: Each vassal swore loyalty to the king in exchange for land.
ex.zh: 每位封臣宣誓效忠國王，以換取封地。

senses.en: a type of stage entertainment with a mix of short acts such as songs, dances, and comedy

ex.en: Many early film stars began their careers in vaudeville.
ex.zh: 許多早期電影明星都是從雜耍歌舞表演起家的。

senses.en: relating to plants

ex.en: The wine has a slightly vegetal smell, like cut grass.
ex.zh: 這支酒帶有些微像割過的草般的植物氣味。

parts.m: grow, be lively 生長、有活力

root.note: 會生長的 → 植物的

senses.en: a person who does not eat meat or fish
not containing meat or fish

ex.en: The restaurant offers a vegetarian option for every dish.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳每道菜都有素食選項。

root.note: 只吃植物的人 → 素食者

senses.en: to live a dull, inactive life with little mental effort
senses.zh: 過單調無所事事的生活；混日子

ex.en: Don't just vegetate in front of the TV all summer.
ex.zh: 別整個暑假都坐在電視前面混日子。

root.note: 像植物一樣不動 → 無所事事

senses.en: plants in general, especially those in a particular area

ex.en: Thick vegetation covered the hillside after the rainy season.
ex.zh: 雨季過後，山坡上長滿了茂密的植被。

root.note: 植物的總稱 → 植被

senses.en: relating to growth or reproduction in plants without seeds
senses.zh: （植物）營養生長的；無性繁殖的

senses.en: (of a person) alive but without brain activity or awareness

ex.en: Potatoes can reproduce by vegetative means from their tubers.
ex.zh: 馬鈴薯可以用塊莖進行無性繁殖。

root.note: 與生長有關的

senses.en: showing strong and intense feeling

ex.en: Residents voiced vehement opposition to the new highway.
ex.zh: 居民強烈反對興建新的公路。

senses.en: speed in a particular direction

ex.en: The rocket must reach a high velocity to escape Earth's gravity.
ex.zh: 火箭必須達到很高的速度才能擺脫地球引力。

root.note: 快速的程度 → 速度

senses.en: smooth and soft like velvet
senses.zh: 天鵝絨般柔滑的；柔順的

ex.en: The peach had a velvety skin and a sweet smell.
ex.zh: 這顆桃子有著絨毛般柔滑的外皮和香甜的氣味。

root.note: 像天鵝絨的

senses.en: willing to do dishonest things in return for money; corrupt

ex.en: The venal official accepted bribes to approve the permits.
ex.zh: 那名貪腐官員收賄後核發了許可證。

root.note: 可以被賣的 → 可收買的

mn: venal（貪汙的）和 venial（可原諒的）只差一個 i，意思差很多。

senses.en: able to be sold; salable

ex.en: The farmers sorted out the vendible fruit from the damaged ones.
ex.zh: 農民把能賣的水果和受損的挑開。

root.note: 能賣的

senses.en: the act of selling; sale

ex.en: The law forbade the vendition of church property.
ex.zh: 法律禁止出售教會財產。

root.note: 販賣的行為

senses.en: a person or company that sells something

ex.en: We bought grilled corn from a street vendor at the night market.
ex.zh: 我們在夜市向路邊攤販買了烤玉米。

root.note: 賣東西的人

senses.en: a thin layer of fine wood or material covering a cheaper surface
an attractive appearance that hides the true nature

ex.en: Beneath his veneer of politeness, he was deeply angry.
ex.zh: 在他禮貌的外表下，其實怒火中燒。

senses.en: deserving great respect because of age, wisdom, or character
senses.zh: 德高望重的；令人尊敬的

ex.en: The venerable professor has taught at the university for fifty years.
ex.zh: 這位德高望重的教授已在大學任教五十年。

root.note: 值得尊敬的

senses.en: to regard with great respect; to revere

ex.en: Many cultures venerate their ancestors with special ceremonies.
ex.zh: 許多文化以特別的儀式崇敬祖先。

root.note: 尊敬

senses.en: relating to diseases spread by sexual contact

ex.en: The clinic offers free testing for venereal disease.
ex.zh: 這家診所提供免費的性病篩檢。

root.note: 與愛神維納斯（性愛）有關的 → 性病的

senses.en: (of a fault or sin) minor and easily forgiven

ex.en: Forgetting to return a pen is a venial mistake, not a crime.
ex.zh: 忘了還筆只是小過失，不是什麼罪行。

root.note: 可寬恕的

senses.en: meat from a deer

ex.en: The hunter's family served venison stew for dinner.
ex.zh: 獵人一家晚餐吃燉鹿肉。

senses.en: poison produced by snakes, spiders, and other animals
extreme hatred or spite

ex.en: The critic's review was full of venom.
ex.zh: 那位評論家的評論充滿惡意。

senses.en: relating to veins

ex.en: Venous blood is darker because it carries less oxygen.
ex.zh: 靜脈血含氧較少，所以顏色較暗。

root.note: 靜脈的

senses.en: speaking or representing the truth; truthful

ex.en: The witness gave a veracious account of the accident.
ex.zh: 證人如實陳述了事故經過。

root.note: 說真話的 → 誠實的

mn: 別和 voracious（貪吃的）混淆：veracious 的 ver = true。

senses.en: truthfulness; accuracy

ex.en: Journalists must check the veracity of their sources.
ex.zh: 記者必須查證消息來源的真實性。

root.note: 真實的性質

senses.en: in exactly the same words
repeated word for word

ex.en: The student copied the article verbatim, which counts as plagiarism.
ex.zh: 這名學生一字不差地抄了那篇文章，這算抄襲。

root.note: 一個字一個字地

senses.en: excessively long or technical wording

ex.en: Cut the verbiage and get to the point.
ex.zh: 刪掉廢話，直接講重點。

root.note: 一堆字 → 冗詞

senses.en: using more words than needed

ex.en: The verbose instructions confused more people than they helped.
ex.zh: 冗長的說明讓更多人困惑，而不是幫上忙。

root.note: 充滿字的 → 冗長的

senses.en: green with grass or rich vegetation

ex.en: After the spring rains, the valley turned verdant and lush.
ex.zh: 春雨過後，山谷變得青翠茂盛。

root.note: 綠油油的

senses.en: the process of confirming that something is true or correct

ex.en: The bank requires verification of your identity before opening an account.
ex.zh: 銀行在開戶前需要核實你的身分。

root.note: 證明為真 → 驗證

senses.en: to check or prove that something is true or correct

ex.en: Please verify your email address by clicking the link.
ex.zh: 請點擊連結驗證你的電子郵件地址。

root.note: 證明為真

senses.en: (old use) truly; certainly

ex.en: "Verily, I tell you," the old preacher began.
ex.zh: 「我實在告訴你們，」老牧師開口說道。

root.note: 真實地

senses.en: a true principle or belief, especially one of lasting importance
truth

ex.en: The novel explores the eternal verity that love requires sacrifice.
ex.zh: 這部小說探討愛需要犧牲這個永恆的真理。

root.note: 真實 → 真理

senses.en: small animals or insects that are harmful or carry disease, such as rats
people regarded as harmful or worthless

ex.en: Keep food sealed so it does not attract vermin.
ex.zh: 食物要密封，以免招來蟲鼠。

senses.en: the everyday language spoken by ordinary people in a region
using the local everyday language

ex.en: Dante wrote in the Italian vernacular instead of Latin.
ex.zh: 但丁用義大利白話文而非拉丁文寫作。

senses.en: relating to or occurring in spring

ex.en: The vernal equinox marks the start of spring.
ex.zh: 春分標誌著春天的開始。

root.note: 春天的

senses.en: able to do many different things well
having many different uses

ex.en: She is a versatile actor who can play both comedy and drama.
ex.zh: 她是位多才多藝的演員，喜劇和正劇都能演。

root.note: 能靈活轉換的 → 多才多藝的

senses.en: a particular form of something that differs from others
a particular account of an event from one point of view

ex.en: Each witness told a different version of what happened.
ex.zh: 每位目擊者對事發經過的說法都不一樣。

root.note: 轉了個樣子 → 版本

senses.en: the highest point; top
a point where two or more lines meet, as in an angle

ex.en: A triangle has three sides and three angles, each with a vertex.
ex.zh: 三角形有三條邊和三個角，每個角都有一個頂點。

root.note: 轉折點 → 頂點

senses.en: standing or pointing straight up and down

ex.en: The climbers faced an almost vertical wall of rock.
ex.zh: 登山者面對一面幾乎垂直的岩壁。

root.note: 朝向頂點的 → 垂直的

senses.en: a feeling of dizziness and losing balance, especially when high up

ex.en: Looking down from the tower gave me a sudden attack of vertigo.
ex.zh: 從塔上往下看，我突然一陣暈眩。

root.note: 天旋地轉 → 暈眩

senses.en: a small remaining trace of something that once existed

ex.en: Not a vestige of the old castle remains today.
ex.zh: 如今那座古堡連一點遺跡都沒留下。

root.note: 留下的足跡 → 遺跡

senses.en: a robe worn by clergy during religious services

ex.en: The priest put on a white vestment for the Easter service.
ex.zh: 神父為復活節禮拜穿上白色祭袍。

root.note: 穿的衣服 → 法衣

senses.en: the official right to reject a decision or law
to reject a proposal or law officially

ex.en: The president may veto the bill if Congress passes it.
ex.zh: 如果國會通過這項法案，總統可能會否決。

parts.m: I forbid 我禁止（拉丁文）

root.note: 我禁止 → 否決

senses.en: experienced through the actions of another person rather than directly
senses.zh: 間接感受的；感同身受的

senses.en: acting or done for another

ex.en: Parents often feel vicarious pride in their children's success.
ex.zh: 父母常因孩子的成功而感同身受地驕傲。

root.note: 由別人代替去經歷 → 間接感受的

senses.en: a ruler who governs a colony or province on behalf of a king or queen

ex.en: The viceroy ruled the colony in the name of the Spanish crown.
ex.zh: 總督以西班牙王室之名統治這塊殖民地。

root.note: 代替國王者 → 總督

senses.en: a change of circumstances, usually unwelcome (often plural)

ex.en: She stayed calm through every vicissitude of her long career.
ex.zh: 在漫長職業生涯的每一次起伏中，她都保持冷靜。

root.note: 輪流變換 → 變遷

mn: 常用複數 the vicissitudes of life（人生的起起落落）。

senses.en: to compete eagerly with others to achieve something

ex.en: Dozens of cities vie to host the Olympic Games.
ex.zh: 數十個城市爭相爭取奧運主辦權。

mn: 常用 vie for（爭奪…）、vie with（和…競爭）。

senses.en: the action of carefully watching for possible danger

ex.en: Police urged vigilance after a string of burglaries in the area.
ex.zh: 該地區接連發生竊案後，警方呼籲民眾提高警覺。

root.note: 保持清醒守望 → 警覺

senses.en: keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties

ex.en: Stay vigilant for suspicious emails that ask for your password.
ex.zh: 要對索取密碼的可疑郵件保持警覺。

root.note: 保持清醒守望的 → 警覺的

senses.en: a brief, vivid description or scene
senses.zh: 簡短生動的描寫；小品文
